question_en: A licensed contractor receives a CSLB citation for a serious violation. What is the maximum civil penalty that can be imposed for that citation?
question_cn: 持牌承包商因严重违规行为收到 CSLB 处罚通知。对此处罚通知可施加的最高民事罚款是多少？

options.en: Up to $50,000 for flagrant violations
options.cn: 对恶劣违规行为最高可罚款 50,000 美元

options.en: Up to $15,000 for serious violations
options.cn: 对严重违规行为最高可罚款 15,000 美元

options.en: Up to $30,000 for serious violations
options.cn: 对严重违规行为最高可罚款 30,000 美元

options.en: Up to $8,000 for any violation
options.cn: 对任何违规行为最高可罚款 8,000 美元

explanation_en: B&P Code §7099.2(b) sets the maximum civil penalty at $30,000 for serious violations, including those involving B&P §§7110, 7114, 7118, and 7125.4.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 7099.2(b) 条规定，严重违规行为的最高民事罚款为 30,000 美元，包括涉及第 7110、7114、7118 和 7125.4 条的违规行为。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7099.2(b) (Document p. 2, PDF p. 25)

question_en: An unlicensed contractor is cited by CSLB. Within how many working days must a written appeal be filed to prevent the citation from becoming a final order?
question_cn: 未持证的承包商收到加州承包商执照委员会（CSLB）的处罚通知。必须在多少个工作日内提交书面上诉，以防止处罚通知成为最终命令？

options.en: Within 25 working days of service
options.cn: 在送达后的 25 个工作日内

options.en: Within 15 working days of service
options.cn: 在送达后的 15 个工作日内

options.en: Within 20 working days of service
options.cn: 在送达后的 20 个工作日内

options.en: Within 30 working days of service
options.cn: 在送达后的 30 个工作日内

explanation_en: Under B&P Code §7028.7, unless the board receives a written appeal within 15 working days after the citation is served, the citation becomes a final order of the registrar.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第 7028.7 条规定，除非委员会在送达处罚通知后 15 个工作日内收到书面上诉，否则该处罚通知将成为注册主任的最终命令。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7028.7 (Document p. 5, PDF p. 28)

question_en: A contractor's license is revoked by CSLB. Which of the following is NOT required before the license can be reinstated or reissued?
question_cn: 承包商的执照被加利福尼亚州承包商执照委员会（CSLB）吊销。在执照可以恢复或重新颁发之前，下列哪项不是必需的？

options.en: Filing a disciplinary bond set by the registrar
options.cn: 提交由注册主任设定的纪律处分保证金

options.en: Settling losses caused by the revocation act
options.cn: 赔偿吊销行为造成的损失

options.en: Waiting the one-to-five year penalty period
options.cn: 等待一到五年的处罚期

options.en: Retaking and passing the CSLB licensing exam
options.cn: 重新参加并通过CSLB执照考试

explanation_en: The statute does not require the licensee to retake the licensing exam as a reinstatement condition. The requirements are the penalty period, compliance with the decision, settling losses, and filing a disciplinary bond.
explanation_cn: 法规并不要求执照持有人作为恢复执照的条件重新参加执照考试。要求包括处罚期、遵守决定、赔偿损失以及提交纪律处分保证金。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7071.8 (Document p. 3, PDF p. 26)

question_en: CSLB citations issued against a licensed contractor are disclosed to the public for how long after the date of compliance?
question_cn: 根据 CSLB 执法披露规定，发给持牌承包商的 CSLB 处罚自遵守日期起向公众披露多久？

options.en: Seven years from the compliance date
options.cn: 自遵守之日起七年

options.en: Indefinitely from the effective revocation date
options.cn: 自有效吊销之日起无限期

options.en: Five years from the compliance date
options.cn: 自遵守之日起五年

options.en: Three years from the compliance date
options.cn: 自遵守之日起三年

explanation_en: The source text states that citations are disclosed to the public from the date of issuance and for five years from the date of compliance, per CSLB enforcement disclosure rules.
explanation_cn: 根据 CSLB 执法披露规则，处罚自发出之日起向公众披露，并自遵守之日起五年内公开。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7099.2 (Document p. 4, PDF p. 27)

question_en: Starting July 1, 2026, what is the minimum civil penalty CSLB must impose for violations related to unlicensed contracting?
question_cn: 自 2026 年 7 月 1 日起，CSLB 对无执照承包行为的违规行为必须施加的最低民事罚款是多少？

options.en: At least $1,500 per violation
options.cn: 每次违规至少 1,500 美元

options.en: At least $1,000 per violation
options.cn: 每次违规至少 1,000 美元

options.en: At least $2,500 per violation
options.cn: 每次违规至少 2,500 美元

options.en: At least $500 per violation
options.cn: 每次违规至少 500 美元

explanation_en: SB 779 (Chapter 233, Statutes of 2025) establishes that commencing July 1, 2026, minimum civil penalties for unlicensed contracting violations must be at least $1,500.
explanation_cn: 2025 年第 233 号法案 SB 779 规定，自 2026 年 7 月 1 日起，无执照承包行为的最低民事罚款必须至少为 1,500 美元。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7028.7, as amended by SB 779 (Document p. -8, PDF p. 15)

question_en: A homeowner hires a local muralist to paint a large hand-drawn mural on the exterior wall of their building. Under SB 456, effective January 1, 2026, does the artist need a contractor's license?
question_cn: 房主雇用一位本地壁画艺术家，在其建筑物的外墙上绘制大型手工壁画。根据SB 456，自2026年1月1日起，该艺术家是否需要承包商执照？

options.en: Yes, exterior work always requires a license
options.cn: 是，外部工作始终需要执照

options.en: No, only if the mural includes a painted sign
options.cn: 否，仅当壁画包含绘制的标牌时才需要

options.en: Yes, unless the project value is under $500
options.cn: 是，除非项目价值低于500美元

options.en: No, mural artists are exempt from licensure
options.cn: 否，壁画艺术家不需要执照

explanation_en: B&P Code §7050, added by SB 456, exempts artists who paint or apply murals pursuant to an agreement with a person legally authorized to approve the work, provided the mural meets the statutory definition.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7050条，由SB 456新增，豁免与依法有权批准工作的人签订协议后进行绘制或施加壁画的艺术家，前提是壁画符合法定定义。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7050, as added by SB 456 (Document p. -9, PDF p. 14)

question_en: Under AB 1002, which state official is authorized to file a civil action to suspend or revoke a contractor's license for failure to pay workers?
question_cn: 根据 AB 1002，哪位州官员有权因承包商未支付工人工资而提起民事诉讼以暂停或吊销其执照？

options.en: The Attorney General
options.cn: 总检察长

options.en: The local district attorney
options.cn: 当地地区检察官

options.en: The CSLB Registrar of Contractors
options.cn: 承包商执照注册主任（CSLB）

options.en: The Labor Commissioner
options.cn: 劳工专员

explanation_en: B&P §7036, added by AB 1002, authorizes the Attorney General to file a civil action to suspend, revoke, or deny licensure when a contractor fails to pay workers or comply with a wage judgment.
explanation_cn: 由 AB 1002 添加的 B&P §7036 授权总检察长在承包商未支付工人工资或未遵守工资判决时提起民事诉讼，以暂停、吊销或拒绝发放执照。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7036, as added by AB 1002 (Document p. -11, PDF p. 12)

question_en: A contractor on probation violates one of the terms of their stay of suspension. What is the immediate consequence?
question_cn: 处于考察期期的承包商违反了其暂停执照效力暂缓的任何一项条款。立即的后果是什么？

options.en: The license is automatically downgraded to inactive
options.cn: 许可证会自动降级为非活跃状态

options.en: The suspension or revocation takes effect
options.cn: 暂停执照效力或吊销生效

options.en: The contractor must file an additional disciplinary bond
options.cn: 承包商必须提交额外的纪律处分保证金

options.en: CSLB issues a new citation with civil penalty
options.cn: CSLB 发出带有民事处罚的新处罚通知

explanation_en: Under the stay of suspension or revocation (probation) provisions, violating any term of the agreement results in the suspension or revocation going into effect.
explanation_cn: 根据暂停执照效力或吊销暂缓（考察期）规定，违反协议的任何条款将导致暂停执照效力或吊销生效。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7071.8 (Document p. 3, PDF p. 26)

question_en: CSLB's SWIFT team visits a jobsite without any prior complaint. Which of the following actions is SWIFT authorized to take?
question_cn: CSLB 的 SWIFT 团队在没有任何事先投诉的情况下访问工地。以下哪些行动是 SWIFT 被授权采取的？

options.en: Revoke licenses on-site for serious violations
options.cn: 对严重违规行为在现场吊销执照

options.en: Arrest contractors for unlicensed activity
options.cn: 因未持证活动逮捕承包商

options.en: Issue stop-work orders on any active project
options.cn: 对任何在建项目下达停工令

options.en: Cite contractors not properly licensed
options.cn: 处罚未正确持证的承包商

explanation_en: B&P Code §§7011.4 and 7099 authorize SWIFT to visit any jobsite without cause, require contractors to produce proof of licensure in good standing, and cite those who are not properly licensed.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》 §§7011.4 和 7099 授权 SWIFT 在没有原因的情况下访问任何工地，要求承包商出示有效执照证明，并处罚那些未正确持证的人。
code_reference: B&P Code Sections 7011.4 and 7099 (Document p. 6, PDF p. 29)

question_en: Under SB 779, how often may CSLB raise minimum fine amounts based on increases in the Consumer Price Index?
question_cn: 根据 SB 779，加州承包商执照委员会 (CSLB) 可以多久根据消费者价格指数的涨幅提高最低罚款金额一次？

options.en: Every ten years by legislative approval
options.cn: 每十年，由立法批准

options.en: Every five years based on CPI increases
options.cn: 每五年，基于 CPI 的涨幅

options.en: Annually, based on the prior year index
options.cn: 每年，基于前一年的指数

options.en: Every three years as needed
options.cn: 根据需要每三年一次

explanation_en: SB 779 (Chapter 233, Statutes of 2025) amends B&P §7138.1 to allow CSLB to raise minimum fine amounts based on increases to the Consumer Price Index every five years.
explanation_cn: SB 779（第 233 章，2025 年法规）修订了《商业与专业法》第 7138.1 节，允许 CSLB 每五年根据消费者价格指数的涨幅提高最低罚款金额。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7138.1, as amended by SB 779 (Document p. -8, PDF p. 15)

question_en: A contractor's license is revoked for serious violations. Which personnel associated with that license are barred from applying for a new license during the penalty period?
question_cn: 承包商的执照因严重违规而被吊销。在处罚期间，哪些与该执照相关的人员被禁止申请新执照？

options.en: Only the license qualifier and the licensee of record
options.cn: 仅执照资格持有人和登记执照持有人

options.en: All employees who worked on the project
options.cn: 所有在该项目工作的员工

options.en: Only the Responsible Managing Employee on the license
options.cn: 仅执照上的责任管理员工

options.en: Official personnel who knew of or participated in violations
options.cn: 知悉或参与违规行为的正式人员

explanation_en: B&P §7071.8 bars all official personnel listed in CSLB records for the revoked license who were found to have known about or participated in the acts constituting grounds for revocation.
explanation_cn: 《商业与专业法》第7071.8条禁止在吊销执照的CSLB记录中列出的、被发现知晓或参与导致吊销行为的所有正式人员申请新执照。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7071.8 (Document p. 3, PDF p. 26)

question_en: If a CSLB investigation results in an accusation that leads to a stayed revocation, for how long is that accusation publicly disclosed after it is settled?
question_cn: 如果 CSLB 调查导致的指控最终导致暂停吊销，该指控在解决后会公开披露多久？

options.en: Three years from the accusation filing date
options.cn: 自指控提交之日起三年

options.en: Five years from the date of settlement
options.cn: 自解决之日起五年

options.en: Indefinitely from the accusation filing date
options.cn: 自指控提交之日起无限期

options.en: Seven years from the date of settlement
options.cn: 自解决之日起七年

explanation_en: Accusations resulting in suspension or stayed revocation are disclosed from the date the accusation is filed and for seven years after the accusation has been settled, including probation terms.
explanation_cn: 造成暂停执照效力或暂停吊销的指控从指控提交之日起披露，并在指控解决后七年内披露，包括考察期条款。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7099.2 (Document p. 4, PDF p. 27)

question_en: A contractor hires a salesperson to solicit home improvement contracts at homeowners' residences. What must the salesperson do before legally beginning this work?
question_cn: 承包商雇佣了一名销售员到业主的住宅推销家庭装修合同。销售员在合法开始这项工作之前必须做什么？

options.en: Submit fingerprints and receive a CSLB registration number
options.cn: 提交指纹并获得 CSLB 注册号码

options.en: Submit an application and begin work immediately
options.cn: 提交申请并立即开始工作

options.en: Obtain a general contractor license from CSLB
options.cn: 从 CSLB 获取总承包商执照

options.en: Complete 40 hours of pre-employment training
options.cn: 完成 40 小时的入职前培训

explanation_en: Under B&P Code Section 7153, a person must be registered with CSLB as a Home Improvement Salesperson before legally working. Registration requires fingerprint submission and CSLB must issue a registration number before work may begin.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第 7153 条的规定，个人在合法工作之前必须在 CSLB 注册为家庭装修销售员。注册需要提交指纹，并且工作开始前 CSLB 必须发放注册号码。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7153 (Document p. 10, PDF p. 33)

question_en: Which of the following individuals is NOT required to register as a Home Improvement Salesperson with CSLB?
question_cn: 以下哪位个人不需要向加州承包商州立委员会(CSLB)注册为家庭装修销售员(HIS)？

options.en: A commissioned salesperson working from home offices
options.cn: 在家庭办公室工作的佣金销售员

options.en: A person who solicits contracts at customer homes
options.cn: 在客户家中招揽合同的人

options.en: A person who negotiates contracts at job sites
options.cn: 在工地协商合同的人

options.en: A qualifying individual listed on the contractor's license
options.cn: 列在承包商执照上的资格人员

explanation_en: The law exempts official personnel listed in CSLB's records for the contractor license, including qualifiers, officers, partners, and RMOs, from the HIS registration requirement.
explanation_cn: 法律豁免CSLB承包商执照记录中列出的官方人员，包括资格人员、官员、合伙人和注册管理负责人(RMO)的HIS注册要求。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7152 (Document p. 9, PDF p. 32)

question_en: A contractor acting as a home improvement salesperson submits an HIS application and fee to CSLB on Monday. A job opportunity arises on Thursday of the same week. Can the contractor legally begin soliciting that job?
question_cn: 一名承包商以家庭装修销售员身份提交 HIS 申请和费用给 CSLB，在星期一。 同一周的星期四出现了一个工作机会。 该承包商可以合法开始招揽该工作吗？

options.en: Yes, if the contractor's own license is active
options.cn: 可以，如果承包商自己的执照是有效的

options.en: Yes, if the employer notifies CSLB in advance
options.cn: 可以，如果雇主提前通知 CSLB

options.en: Yes, submission of the application is sufficient
options.cn: 可以，仅提交申请就足够了

options.en: No, CSLB must issue a registration number first
options.cn: 不可以，CSLB 必须先发放注册号码

explanation_en: Under B&P Code Section 7153, a person may not legally work as a home improvement salesperson until CSLB reviews the application and issues a registration number. Submitting the application alone is insufficient.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第 7153 条，在 CSLB 审查申请并发放注册号码之前，任何人都不能合法地作为家庭装修销售员工作。仅提交申请是不够的。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7153 (Document p. 10, PDF p. 33)

question_en: A contractor employs an unregistered person to negotiate home improvement contracts. What is the contractor's exposure under B&P Code Section 7154?
question_cn: 一名承包商雇佣未经注册的人来协商家庭装修合同。根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7154条，承包商会面临什么处罚？

options.en: A civil fine only, not disciplinary action
options.cn: 仅为民事罚款，不进行纪律处分

options.en: Criminal misdemeanor charges against the contractor
options.cn: 对承包商提起刑事轻罪指控

options.en: Disciplinary action by the CSLB registrar
options.cn: CSLB（承包商州许可委员会）注册主任的纪律处分

options.en: Automatic license revocation without a hearing
options.cn: 无需听证会即自动吊销执照

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7154 specifically states that a contractor who employs an unregistered person to negotiate home improvement contracts is subject to disciplinary action by the registrar.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7154条明确规定，雇佣未经注册的人来协商家庭装修合同的承包商将受到注册主任的纪律处分。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7154 (Document p. 11, PDF p. 34)

question_en: A contractor's license is issued to a general partnership. One partner retires and leaves the business. What happens to the license?
question_cn: 承包商执照颁发给一个普通合伙企业。一名合伙人退休并退出业务。执照会发生什么变化？

options.en: It transfers automatically to the remaining partners
options.cn: 它会自动转移给剩余的合伙人

options.en: It remains valid for 90 days pending reorganization
options.cn: 在重组期间，它在90天内仍然有效

options.en: It is suspended until a new partner is added
options.cn: 它会被暂停，直到加入新的合伙人

options.en: The partnership license is immediately and permanently canceled
options.cn: 合伙企业许可证会立即且永久取消

explanation_en: When a contractor's license is issued to a general partnership and a general partner leaves for any reason, the license is canceled. This is stated explicitly in the source text under General Partnership rules.
explanation_cn: 当承包商执照颁发给普通合伙企业并且任何原因导致一名普通合伙人离开时，该执照会被取消。这在普通合伙企业规则下的原文中有明确说明。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7068.1 (Document p. 17, PDF p. 40)

question_en: Which form of business organization allows investors to participate in a partnership while limiting their personal liability to only their original investment?
question_cn: 哪种商业组织形式允许投资者参与合伙，但将其个人责任限制在原始投资金额以内？

options.en: Sole proprietorship
options.cn: 独资企业

options.en: S corporation
options.cn: S型公司

options.en: General partnership
options.cn: 普通合伙

options.en: Limited partnership
options.cn: 有限合伙

explanation_en: A limited partnership allows investors (limited partners) to join without full business responsibility, risking only their original investment. At least one general partner must remain fully liable for business obligations.
explanation_cn: 有限合伙允许投资者（有限合伙人）加入而不承担全部业务责任，仅冒原始投资的风险。至少需要一名普通合伙人对业务义务承担全部责任。
code_reference: California Corporations Code Section 15900 et seq. (Document p. 17, PDF p. 40)

question_en: A contractor forms a California LLC and prepares an operating agreement. Where must this agreement be filed?
question_cn: 一名承包商在加利福尼亚州成立有限责任公司并准备了一份运营协议。此协议必须在哪里备案？

options.en: With the California Franchise Tax Board
options.cn: 向加利福尼亚州特许经营税务委员会备案

options.en: With the California Secretary of State
options.cn: 向加利福尼亚州州务卿备案

options.en: At the LLC's own office records location
options.cn: 在有限责任公司自己的办公记录所在地备案

options.en: With the Contractors State License Board
options.cn: 向加州承包商执照委员会备案

explanation_en: The source text states that an LLC does not file the operating agreement with the Secretary of State but instead maintains it at the office where the LLC's records are kept.
explanation_cn: 原文指出，有限责任公司不将运营协议提交给州务卿，而是保存在有限责任公司记录所在的办公室。
code_reference: California Corporations Code Section 17701.10 (Document p. 18, PDF p. 41)

question_en: A contractor wants to use CSLB's mandatory arbitration program to resolve a dispute. Which of the following would DISQUALIFY the contractor from participating?
question_cn: 承包商希望使用 CSLB 的强制仲裁程序来解决争议。以下哪项会使承包商失去参与资格？

options.en: The contractor does not have an attorney
options.cn: 承包商没有律师

options.en: The contractor's license is currently suspended
options.cn: 承包商的执照目前被暂停

options.en: The dispute involves a residential remodeling project
options.cn: 争议涉及住宅改造项目

options.en: The alleged damages are under $25,000
options.cn: 所称的损害低于 25,000 美元

explanation_en: Per the source text, to qualify for CSLB arbitration, the contractor's license must be in good standing -- current and not under suspension -- at the time of the alleged violation. A suspended license disqualifies the contractor.
explanation_cn: 根据原文，为了符合 CSLB 仲裁资格，承包商的执照在所称违规行为发生时必须是有效状态——当前有效且未被暂停。被暂停的执照会使承包商失去资格。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7085 (CSLB Arbitration Program eligibility) (Document p. 49, PDF p. 72)

question_en: A contractor completes drilling a water well in California. Within how many days must the Well Completion Report be filed with the Department of Water Resources?
question_cn: 一名承包商在加利福尼亚完成钻井作业。完成后的多少天内必须向水资源部提交井完工报告？

options.en: Within 30 days after completion
options.cn: 完工后30天内

options.en: Within 60 days after completion
options.cn: 完工后60天内

options.en: Within 45 days after completion
options.cn: 完工后45天内

options.en: Within 90 days after completion
options.cn: 完工后90天内

explanation_en: California Water Code Section 13751 requires that the Well Completion Report (DWR 188) be filed with the Department of Water Resources within 60 days after completion of any well construction, alteration, or destruction work.
explanation_cn: 《加利福尼亚水法》第13751条规定，任何井的建造、改造或破坏工作完成后，井完工报告（DWR 188）必须在60天内提交给水资源部。
code_reference: California Water Code Sections 13751-13754 (Document p. 67, PDF p. 90)

question_en: A contractor fails to file the Well Completion Report after finishing a monitoring well project. What are the consequences?
question_cn: 承包商在完成监测井项目后未提交井竣工报告，会有什么后果？

options.en: A civil fine and mandatory license suspension
options.cn: 民事罚款和强制性许可证暂停

options.en: A misdemeanor and grounds for license disciplinary action
options.cn: 轻罪以及作为许可证纪律处分的依据

options.en: An administrative warning with no criminal charge
options.cn: 行政警告且没有刑事指控

options.en: A felony charge and possible license revocation
options.cn: 重罪指控并可能吊销许可证

explanation_en: Water Code Section 13754 classifies failure to file the Well Completion Report as a misdemeanor, and Business and Professions Code Section 7110 makes it grounds for disciplinary action against the contractor's license.
explanation_cn: 《水法》第13754条将未提交井竣工报告归类为轻罪，《加州商业与职业法典》第7110条规定这构成对承包商执照进行纪律处分的依据。
code_reference: Water Code Section 13754; Business and Professions Code Section 7110 (Document p. 67, PDF p. 90)

question_en: A contractor performing water well work fails to obtain a C-57 license but completes the project. What classification does this violation carry under the California Water Code?
question_cn: 承包商在进行水井工程时未获得C-57执照，但仍完成了项目。根据加利福尼亚水法，这种违规行为属于哪一类？

options.en: A misdemeanor under contractor license law
options.cn: 根据承包商执照法的轻罪

options.en: A civil infraction with a monetary fine only
options.cn: 仅罚款的民事违规行为

options.en: An administrative violation with no criminal exposure
options.cn: 无刑事责任的行政违规行为

options.en: A felony punishable by state prison
options.cn: 可判州监狱的重罪

explanation_en: Water Code Section 13750.5 requires a C-57 license to perform water well work. Performing such work without the required license violates B&P Code Section 7028, which classifies unlicensed contracting as a misdemeanor.
explanation_cn: 《水法》第13750.5条要求进行水井工程必须持有C-57执照。未持有所需执照而进行此类工作违反了《加州商业与职业法典》第7028条，该条将未持证承包行为归类为轻罪。
code_reference: California Water Code Section 13750.5 (Document p. 67, PDF p. 90)

question_en: A contractor settles a civil dispute with a homeowner and includes a clause requiring the homeowner to withdraw their CSLB complaint. What is the legal consequence of that clause?
question_cn: 承包商与房主解决民事纠纷，并在协议中加入一条要求房主撤回其 CSLB 投诉的条款。该条款的法律后果是什么？

options.en: The clause is void and the licensee faces disciplinary action
options.cn: 该条款无效，持证人将面临纪律处分

options.en: The contractor must renegotiate the settlement agreement
options.cn: 承包商必须重新协商和解协议

options.en: Only the settlement clause is voided; the rest stands
options.cn: 仅和解条款无效；其余部分仍然有效

options.en: The clause is enforceable if both parties signed it
options.cn: 如果双方签署了该条款，它是可执行的

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 143.5(a) explicitly states that any provision prohibiting a party from filing or cooperating with a DCA board complaint is void as against public policy, and the licensee is subject to disciplinary action.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 143.5(a) 条明确规定，任何禁止一方提交或配合 DCA 董事会投诉的条款因违反公共政策而无效，持证人将面临纪律处分。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 143.5(a) (Document p. 128, PDF p. 151)

question_en: After a CSLB licensee settles a civil dispute for full monetary satisfaction, the board opens a disciplinary case based on the same complaint. Which of the following actions may the board NOT take?
question_cn: CSLB持牌人与对方达成民事和解并使全部金钱赔偿结清后，委员会又根据同一投诉启动纪律处分案件。以下哪项措施是委员会不得采取的？

options.en: Issue a formal accusation against the licensee
options.cn: 对持牌人发出正式指控

options.en: Suspend or revoke the licensee's contractor license
options.cn: 暂停或吊销持牌承包商的执照

options.en: Place the contractor on probation with conditions
options.cn: 对承包商进行有条件的考察期

options.en: Require the licensee to pay additional sums to the plaintiff
options.cn: 要求持牌人向原告支付额外款项

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 143.5(b) prohibits the board from requiring the licensee to pay additional sums to the plaintiff's benefit when the civil action has already been settled for full and final monetary satisfaction.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第143.5(b)条规定，民事诉讼已经达成完整、最终的金钱和解后，委员会不得再要求持牌人向原告支付额外款项；但仍可采取其他纪律处分措施。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 143.5(b) (Document p. 128, PDF p. 151)

question_en: Which agency requires applicants to submit fingerprints for criminal history background checks before a contractor's license is issued?
question_cn: 哪个机构要求申请人在承包商执照发放前提交指纹以进行犯罪记录背景调查？

options.en: The Contractors State License Board
options.cn: 加州承包商执照委员会

options.en: The Department of Consumer Affairs directly
options.cn: 消费者事务部直接处理

options.en: The California Department of Industrial Relations
options.cn: 加利福尼亚州工业关系部

options.en: The California Department of Justice only
options.cn: 仅加利福尼亚州司法部

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 144(b)(23) specifically lists the Contractors State License Board as an agency required to collect a full set of fingerprints from applicants for criminal history checks.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第144(b)(23)条特别列出加州承包商执照委员会作为要求申请人提供完整指纹以进行犯罪记录检查的机构。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 144(b)(23) (Document p. 129, PDF p. 152)

question_en: A board within the DCA wants to extend a contractor's license renewal date by four months to balance its workload. Which condition must be met for this extension to be valid?
question_cn: DCA 内的一个委员会希望将承包商的执照续期日期延长四个月，以平衡其工作负荷。为了使该延期有效，必须满足哪种条件？

options.en: The Director of Consumer Affairs must approve it
options.cn: 必须得到消费者事务主任的批准

options.en: The extension must not exceed twelve months
options.cn: 延期不得超过十二个月

options.en: The licensee must pay the full next renewal fee upfront
options.cn: 执照持有人必须预付下一次续费的全额

options.en: The licensee must request the extension in writing
options.cn: 执照持有人必须书面申请延期

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 152.5 allows boards to extend renewal dates by up to six months only with the approval of the Director of Consumer Affairs, and any fee must be prorated accordingly.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 152.5 条允许各委员会在获得消费者事务主任批准的情况下最多将续期日期延长六个月，并且任何费用必须按比例调整。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 152.5 (Document p. 131, PDF p. 154)

question_en: Records related to treatment and rehabilitation of a licensee impaired by alcohol or drugs must be retained by a DCA contract vendor for how long after the last service rendered?
question_cn: 与酒精或药物损害的持证人治疗和康复相关的记录，DCA合同供应商必须在最后一次提供服务后保留多久？

options.en: Until the department completes its audit review
options.cn: 直到部门完成其审计审核

options.en: Five years after the final treatment
options.cn: 最终治疗后五年

options.en: Three years after the last service rendered
options.cn: 最后一次提供服务后三年

options.en: Seven years after the last service date
options.cn: 最后一次服务日期后七年

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 156.1(a) explicitly requires retention of treatment and rehabilitation records for three years from the date of the last service rendered, after which they may be purged and destroyed.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》规第156.1(a)条明确要求自最后一次提供服务之日起三年内保留治疗和康复记录，之后可进行清除和销毁。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 156.1(a) (Document p. 134, PDF p. 157)

question_en: A well driller completing a new water well in California must submit a well completion report to which agency using which system?
question_cn: 在加利福尼亚完成新水井的钻井工必须向哪个机构提交水井完工报告，并使用哪个系统？

options.en: County environmental health, via paper submission
options.cn: 县环境卫生部门，通过纸质提交

options.en: DWR, via the OSWCR online system
options.cn: 水资源部，通过OSWCR在线系统

options.en: Cal/OSHA, via the employer injury log
options.cn: 加州职业安全与健康署（Cal/OSHA），通过雇主伤害记录表

options.en: CSLB, via the BreEZe online portal
options.cn: 加州承包商州立委员会（CSLB），通过BreEZe在线门户

explanation_en: Per DWR requirements, well drillers submit well completion reports to the Department of Water Resources through the Online System of Well Completion Reports (OSWCR), using an account validated against their C-57 license.
explanation_cn: 根据水资源部要求，钻井工通过水井完工报告在线系统（OSWCR）向水资源部提交水井完工报告，并使用与其C-57执照验证的账户。
code_reference: California Water Code / DWR Well Completion Report Requirements (Document p. 68, PDF p. 91)

question_en: A C-57 licensed driller plans to rehabilitate an existing water well. Beyond statewide DWR Bulletin 74 standards, what additional step is required before work begins?
question_cn: 一名持有 C-57 证照的钻井工计划翻修现有水井。除全州范围的 DWR 公告第 74 号标准之外，在开始工作之前还需要采取什么额外步骤？

options.en: Obtain CSLB approval for the specific well work
options.cn: 获取 CSLB 对特定水井工作的批准

options.en: Contact the local enforcing agency for permit compliance
options.cn: 联系当地执行机构以确保许可证合规

options.en: File an environmental impact report with the state
options.cn: 向州政府提交环境影响报告

options.en: Submit a modified OSWCR report before starting work
options.cn: 在开始工作前提交修改后的 OSWCR 报告

explanation_en: DWR guidance states that the designated local enforcing agency -- usually the county environmental health department -- should be contacted whenever work on a well is planned to ensure compliance with local ordinances, which may require permits and fees.
explanation_cn: DWR 指南指出，每当计划对水井进行工作时，应联系指定的地方执行机构——通常是县环境卫生部门——以确保符合当地条例，该条例可能要求获取许可和支付费用。
code_reference: California Well Standards, DWR Bulletin 74-90 (Document p. 68, PDF p. 91)

question_en: The Director of Consumer Affairs wants to investigate the work of a board within the DCA. Which of the following records may the director NOT access?
question_cn: 消费者事务主任希望调查消费者事务局（DCA）内某个委员会的工作。以下哪些记录主任不得访问？

options.en: Copies of disciplinary hearing transcripts
options.cn: 纪律听证会记录副本

options.en: Financial records of individual board members
options.cn: 个别委员会成员的财务记录

options.en: License application files and supporting documents
options.cn: 执照申请文件及支持文件

options.en: Examination questions before they are administered
options.cn: 在考试之前的考试题目

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 153 grants broad investigative access to board records but explicitly excludes examination questions prior to submission to applicants at scheduled examinations.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第153条授予对委员会记录的广泛调查权限，但明确排除了在计划的考试中提交给申请人之前的考试题目。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 153 (Document p. 132, PDF p. 155)

question_en: A non-employee expert hired by the CSLB to evaluate a licensee's conduct is named as a defendant in a civil lawsuit arising from opinions given to the board. Who is responsible for providing that expert's legal defense?
question_cn: 由CSLB聘请的非雇员专家，用于评估持牌人的行为，如果因向委员会提供意见而成为民事诉讼的被告，谁负责提供该专家的法律辩护？

options.en: The CSLB board provides representation through the Attorney General
options.cn: CSLB委员会通过总检察长提供法律代理

options.en: The expert must retain and fund their own attorney
options.cn: 专家必须自行聘请并支付律师费用

options.en: The Department of Consumer Affairs pays all legal costs
options.cn: 消费者事务部支付所有法律费用

options.en: The licensee being investigated covers the expert's defense
options.cn: 被调查的持牌人承担专家的辩护费用

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 154.5 requires the board to provide representation for the expert-defendant, with the Attorney General being utilized and the cost charged to the board. However, the board is not liable for any judgment against the expert.
explanation_cn: 《职业与商业法》第154.5条要求委员会为专家被告提供法律代理，使用总检察长进行代理，费用由委员会承担。然而，委员会不对针对专家的任何判决承担责任。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 154.5 (Document p. 132, PDF p. 155)

question_en: A board within DCA charges a fee for providing copies of its public records to a citizen. How must that fee be determined?
question_cn: DCA 内的一个委员会向公民提供其公共记录副本时会收取费用。该费用应如何确定？

options.en: Fixed at a flat rate established by the Legislature
options.cn: 由立法机构以固定费率确定

options.en: Determined by the director with DGS approval
options.cn: 由主管在获得 DGS 批准后确定

options.en: Set by the board at its sole discretion
options.cn: 由委员会全权决定

options.en: Waived for any person filing a contractor complaint
options.cn: 对提交承包商投诉的任何人免收

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 161 states that the charge for public records copies shall be sufficient to pay actual costs and shall be determined by the director with the approval of the Department of General Services.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 161 条规定，公共记录副本的收费应足以支付实际成本，并应由主管在获得一般服务部批准后确定。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 161 (Document p. 136, PDF p. 159)

question_en: A board within DCA collects application fees it later determines were collected by mistake. What must happen to those fees?
question_cn: DCA内的一个委员会收取了后来确定是错误收取的申请费。这些费用必须如何处理？

options.en: They may be refunded at the board's discretion
options.cn: 可以由委员会自行决定退还

options.en: They are credited toward the next renewal fee
options.cn: 可抵作下一次续费

options.en: They are forfeited and deposited into the General Fund
options.cn: 被没收并存入普通基金

options.en: They must be refunded through the State Controller
options.cn: 必须通过州审计长退还

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 158 states that fees collected illegally, by mistake, or error shall be refunded. Claims authorized by the department are filed with the State Controller, who draws a warrant from the agency's fund.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第158条规定，非法、错误或失误收取的费用应予退还。经部门授权的索赔应提交给州审计长，由其从机构基金开具支付令。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 158 (Document p. 135, PDF p. 158)

question_en: A board within DCA wants to extend a license renewal date by eight months to distribute workload. Why would this extension be impermissible?
question_cn: DCA内部的一个委员会想将执照续期日期延长八个月以分配工作量。为什么这种延长是不可允许的？

options.en: Renewal dates cannot be altered without legislative approval
options.cn: 未经立法批准，续期日期不能更改

options.en: The licensee would be required to pay a higher fee
options.cn: 持证人将需要支付更高的费用

options.en: The extension exceeds the statutory six-month maximum
options.cn: 延长期限超过法定的六个月上限

options.en: Only CSLB may extend renewal dates, not other boards
options.cn: 只有CSLB可以延长续期日期，其他委员会不能

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 152.5 limits renewal date extensions to not more than six months. An eight-month extension would violate this cap regardless of the director's approval.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第152.5条规定续期日期的延长不得超过六个月。无论主管批准与否，八个月的延长都会违反此上限。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 152.5 (Document p. 131, PDF p. 154)

question_en: Under B&P Code Section 144, fingerprint submission by CSLB applicants allows the board to obtain criminal history from which sources?
question_cn: 根据加州《加州商业与职业法典》第144条，CSLB申请人提交指纹使委员会能够从哪些来源获取犯罪记录？

options.en: Local law enforcement and the California DOJ
options.cn: 当地执法机构和加州司法部

options.en: Any law enforcement database at the board's discretion
options.cn: 委员会自行决定的任何执法数据库

options.en: Only the California Department of Justice
options.cn: 仅加州司法部

options.en: The California DOJ and the U.S. FBI
options.cn: 加州司法部和美国联邦调查局

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 144(a) states that the designated agency may obtain and receive criminal history information from the Department of Justice and the United States Federal Bureau of Investigation.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第144(a)条规定，指定机构可以从司法部和美国联邦调查局获取和接收犯罪记录信息。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 144(a) (Document p. 129, PDF p. 152)

question_en: A contractor who completed a prison rehabilitation training program applies for a CSLB license after release. Which condition must be met before the license can be granted?
question_cn: 一名完成监狱康复培训计划的承包商在获释后申请CSLB执照。在授予执照之前必须满足哪个条件？

options.en: The licensing agency must find the applicant a fit person
options.cn: 执照颁发机构必须认定申请人适合从业

options.en: The applicant must pass the exam within one year of release
options.cn: 申请人必须在获释后一年的时间内通过考试

options.en: The conviction must have been overturned on appeal
options.cn: 定罪必须在上诉中被推翻

options.en: The prison training program must be CSLB-approved specifically
options.cn: 监狱培训项目必须经过CSLB的特别批准

explanation_en: Under B&P Code Section 23.9, the licensing agency must find, upon recommendation of the Adult Authority or Department of Youth Authority, that the individual is a fit person to be licensed. This is the key gatekeeping condition.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第23.9条，执照颁发机构必须根据成人管理局或青少年管理局的推荐，认定该个人适合获得执照。这是关键的门槛条件。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 23.9 (Document p. 75, PDF p. 98)

question_en: Under B&P Code Section 27, which type of personal information is a CSLB licensee's address of record allowed to be?
question_cn: 根据《加州《加州商业与职业法典》》第27条，CSLB执照持有人的登记地址允许是哪种类型的个人信息？

options.en: The licensee's date of birth as filed
options.cn: 备案时的执照持有人出生日期

options.en: A home telephone number on file with CSLB
options.cn: CSLB档案中的家庭电话号码

options.en: A social security number kept on public record
options.cn: 公共记录中保留的社会安全号码

options.en: A post office box or other alternate address
options.cn: 邮政信箱或其他备用地址

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 27(a) explicitly allows a licensee to provide a post office box number or other alternate address instead of a home address as the address of record disclosed publicly.
explanation_cn: 《加州《加州商业与职业法典》》第27(a)条明确允许执照持有人提供邮政信箱号码或其他备用地址，以代替家庭住址作为公开披露的登记地址。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 27(a) (Document p. 76, PDF p. 99)

question_en: Under B&P Code Section 7.5, when may a board take disciplinary action against a licensee following a criminal conviction?
question_cn: 根据《商业与专业法规》第7.5条，在刑事定罪后，委员会何时可以对持牌人采取纪律处分？

options.en: Only after the conviction is affirmed on appeal
options.cn: 仅在上诉确认定罪后

options.en: When the appeal period has elapsed or probation is granted
options.cn: 当上诉期限届满或判考察期时

options.en: Sixty days after the guilty plea is entered in court
options.cn: 在法庭认罪六十天后

options.en: Immediately upon arrest, before any court verdict
options.cn: 在被逮捕后立即，在任何法院裁决之前

explanation_en: Under B&P Code Section 7.5(a), a board may act when the time for appeal has elapsed, when conviction is affirmed on appeal, or when an order granting probation suspending sentence is made -- whichever occurs first.
explanation_cn: 根据《商业与专业法规》第7.5(a)条，当上诉期限届满、上诉确认定罪或下达暂停刑期的考察期令时，委员会可以采取行动——以先发生者为准。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7.5(a) (Document p. 72, PDF p. 95)

question_en: A CSLB licensee legally changes their gender and requests an updated license. Which document alone is sufficient to demonstrate the gender change to the board?
question_cn: 一名持CSLB执照的人合法更改了性别，并申请更新执照。单独哪份文件足以向委员会证明性别变更？

options.en: An employer verification letter with updated personal information
options.cn: 包含更新个人信息的雇主验证信

options.en: A certified copy of a legal name change order only
options.cn: 仅法律姓名变更命令的经认证副本

options.en: A certified court order indicating a gender change
options.cn: 指示性别变更的经认证法院命令

options.en: A letter from a licensed physician confirming the change
options.cn: 经许可的医生确认变更的信函

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 27.5(b)(2)(E) explicitly lists a court order indicating a gender change from a qualifying court as sufficient documentation to demonstrate a gender change to the board.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第27.5(b)(2)(E)条明确列出来自合格法院的性别变更法院命令作为向委员会证明性别变更的充分文件。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 27.5(b)(2) (Document p. 78, PDF p. 101)

question_en: Which of the following does the CSLB's internet license disclosure NOT include for licensees, per B&P Code Section 27?
question_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第27条，CSLB的互联网执照披露对持证人不包括以下哪项内容？

options.en: Labor Commissioner information provided under Labor Code Section 98.9
options.cn: 根据《劳动法》第98.9条提供的劳动专员信息

options.en: Accusations filed under the Administrative Procedure Act
options.cn: 根据《行政程序法》提交的指控

options.en: Records of license suspensions and revocations
options.cn: 执照暂停和吊销的记录

options.en: The licensee's personal date of birth information
options.cn: 持证人的个人出生日期信息

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 27(a) expressly prohibits including personal information such as date of birth, home telephone number, and social security number in the internet license disclosure.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第27(a)条明确禁止在互联网执照披露中包含诸如出生日期、家庭电话号码和社会安全号码等个人信息。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 27(a) (Document p. 76, PDF p. 99)

question_en: Under B&P Code Section 10, if a public officer is granted a power by the code, who may exercise that power on the officer's behalf?
question_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第10条，如果公共官员被该法规定赋予权力，谁可以代表该官员行使该权力？

options.en: Any licensed contractor working under state contract
options.cn: 任何在州合同下工作的持证承包商

options.en: Only the officer personally, with no delegation allowed
options.cn: 仅限该官员本人，不允许委托他人

options.en: A deputy or person authorized by law by the officer
options.cn: 由官员授权的副手或法律允许的人员

options.en: The Director of Consumer Affairs in all cases
options.cn: 在所有情况下由消费者事务主管行使

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 10 provides that powers granted to a public officer may be exercised by a deputy or by a person authorized pursuant to law by the officer, unless the code expressly provides otherwise.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第10条规定，除非法律另有明确规定，赋予公共官员的权力可以由副手或经官员法律授权的人行使。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 10 (Document p. 73, PDF p. 96)

question_en: A contractor partnership applies for a CSLB license. Under B&P Code Section 30, what tax identification information must the partnership provide at the time of license issuance?
question_cn: 承包商合伙企业申请CSLB执照。根据《加州商业与职业法典》第30条，合伙企业在颁发执照时必须提供哪些税务识别信息？

options.en: Each partner's individual social security number
options.cn: 每位合伙人的个人社会保障号码

options.en: The qualifying individual's social security number only
options.cn: 仅提供合格个人的社会保障号码

options.en: The partnership's federal employer identification number
options.cn: 合伙企业的联邦雇主识别号码

options.en: Either a FEIN or individual taxpayer number, applicant's choice
options.cn: 由申请人选择提供FEIN或个人纳税人号码

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 30(a)(1) requires a partnership applicant to provide its federal employer identification number at the time of license issuance. Individual SSN applies only to non-partnership applicants.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第30(a)(1)条要求合伙企业申请人在颁发执照时提供其联邦雇主识别号码。个人社会保障号码仅适用于非合伙企业申请人。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 30(a)(1) (Document p. 80, PDF p. 103)

question_en: Under B&P Code Section 27.5, what happens to enforcement records posted online when a licensee's former name is replaced due to a legal name change?
question_cn: 根据《商业与专业法规》第27.5条，当执照持有人的原姓名因法定更名而被替换时，在线发布的执法记录会发生什么变化？

options.en: They are transferred to a confidential DCA archive only
options.cn: 它们仅会转移到机密的DCA档案中

options.en: They are permanently deleted from all board records
options.cn: 它们会从所有委员会记录中永久删除

options.en: The board posts a statement directing the public to contact them
options.cn: 委员会会发布一条声明，指示公众与其联系

options.en: They remain posted online under the former name only
options.cn: 它们仅以原姓名继续在线发布

explanation_en: Under B&P Code Section 27.5(a)(2)(B), when a licensee with prior enforcement action updates their name, the board shall not post the enforcement records online but shall instead post a statement that the individual was previously subject to enforcement action and direct the public to contact the board for details.
explanation_cn: 根据《商业与专业法规》第27.5(a)(2)(B)条，当有先前执法动作的执照持有人更新姓名时，委员会不得将执法记录在线发布，而应发布一条声明说明该个人曾经受到执法行动，并指示公众联系委员会以获取详情。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 27.5(a)(2)(B) (Document p. 78, PDF p. 101)

question_en: Under B&P Code Section 12.5, if a board is authorized to issue a citation for a code violation, what additional citation authority does it automatically possess?
question_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第12.5条，如果董事会被授权对法规违规行为发出处罚通知，它自动拥有哪些额外的传票权？

options.en: Authority to assess fines double the standard citation amount
options.cn: 有权对标准传票金额加倍罚款

options.en: Authority to cite violations of regulations adopted under that code
options.cn: 有权对根据该法规制定的规定的违规行为发出传票

options.en: Authority to impose criminal penalties without a hearing
options.cn: 有权在未经听证的情况下实施刑事处罚

options.en: Authority to immediately suspend licenses pending investigation
options.cn: 有权在调查期间立即暂停执照

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 12.5 provides that whenever citation authority for a code violation exists, that authority automatically extends to violations of any regulation adopted pursuant to that code provision.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第12.5条规定，每当存在针对法规违规行为的传票权时，该权力也自动扩展至根据该法规制定的任何规定的违规行为。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 12.5 (Document p. 73, PDF p. 96)

question_en: Under B&P Code Section 27.5, records related to a licensee's request to update their name or gender on a license are classified as which of the following?
question_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》案第27.5条，涉及持证人请求更新其执照上的姓名或性别的记录被归类为以下哪种？

options.en: Semi-public records disclosed only upon written request
options.cn: 仅在书面请求时披露的半公开记录

options.en: Restricted records accessible only by the Director of Consumer Affairs
options.cn: 仅由消费者事务局局长可访问的受限记录

options.en: Confidential and not subject to public inspection or disclosure
options.cn: 机密记录，不可公开检查或披露

options.en: Public records available under the California Public Records Act
options.cn: 根据《加州公共记录法》可获取的公共记录

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 27.5(c) states that all records related to a name or gender update request, including supporting documentation, are confidential and not subject to public inspection or disclosure.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第27.5(c)条规定，所有与姓名或性别更新请求相关的记录，包括支持文件，均为机密记录，不可公开检查或披露。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 27.5(c) (Document p. 79, PDF p. 102)

question_en: A CSLB licensee fails to provide their social security number or taxpayer identification number after being notified. Which agency is the licensing board required to notify of this failure?
question_cn: 当 CSLB 持证人被通知后仍未提供其社会保障号码或纳税人识别号码，许可委员会需要将此违规情况通知哪个机构？

options.en: The California Department of Justice
options.cn: 加利福尼亚州司法部

options.en: The Internal Revenue Service
options.cn: 美国国税局

options.en: The Employment Development Department directly
options.cn: 直接通知就业发展部

options.en: The Franchise Tax Board
options.cn: 加州特许税务委员会

explanation_en: Under B&P Code Section 30(b), when a licensee fails to provide the required federal employer identification number or social security/taxpayer ID number, the licensing board must report the licensee to the Franchise Tax Board.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第30(b)条，当持证人未能提供所需的联邦雇主识别号或社会保障/纳税人识别号码时，许可委员会必须将该持证人报告给加州特许税务委员会。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 30(b) (Document p. 80, PDF p. 103)

question_en: Under B&P Code Section 7.5, a board may NOT deny a license to an otherwise qualified applicant based solely on a conviction if which condition is met?
question_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7.5条，如果满足以下条件，委员会不得仅因刑事定罪而拒绝向其他符合条件的申请人颁发执照？

options.en: The applicant qualifies under Section 480 subdivision (b) or (c)
options.cn: 申请人符合《加州商业与职业法典》第480条(b)或(c)款的条件

options.en: The applicant's sentence has been fully served and discharged
options.cn: 申请人的刑期已全部服完并解除

options.en: The conviction occurred more than ten years ago
options.cn: 定罪发生在十年以上以前

options.en: The conviction was for a misdemeanor rather than a felony
options.cn: 定罪是轻罪而非重罪

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7.5(a) expressly states that a board may not deny a license to an applicant who is otherwise qualified pursuant to subdivision (b) or (c) of Section 480, which governs when prior convictions may or may not be used to deny licensure.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7.5(a)条明确规定，委员会不得因为《加州商业与职业法典》第480条(b)或(c)款中规定的情况而拒绝向其他符合条件的申请人颁发执照，该条款规定了以往刑事定罪何时可以或不可以被用来拒绝执照。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7.5(a) and B&P Code Section 480 (Document p. 72, PDF p. 95)

question_en: The Department of Consumer Affairs' mission includes partnering with which groups to combat fraud and enforce consumer protection laws?
question_cn: 消费者事务部的使命包括与哪些团体合作以打击欺诈并执行消费者保护法？

options.en: Business and consumer groups and law enforcement
options.cn: 商业和消费者团体以及执法机构

options.en: Federal regulatory agencies and Congress
options.cn: 联邦监管机构和国会

options.en: The Governor's office and legislative committees
options.cn: 州长办公室和立法委员会

options.en: Licensed trade associations and professional guilds
options.cn: 持牌行业协会和专业行会

explanation_en: The DCA mission statement on page 94 specifically cites partnering with 'business and consumer groups in California and the nation' and 'working with law enforcement to combat fraud and enforce consumer protection laws vigorously and fairly.'
explanation_cn: DCA在第94页的使命声明中特别提到与“加州及全国的商业和消费者团体合作”，并“与执法部门合作，积极且公平地打击欺诈并执行消费者保护法。”
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7 et seq. (DCA Mission Statement) (Document p. 71, PDF p. 94)

question_en: Under B&P Code Section 30, which circumstance would prevent a licensing board from processing a contractor's initial license application?
question_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第30条，哪种情况会阻止许可委员会处理承包商的初始执照申请？

options.en: The applicant is not a U.S. citizen or permanent resident
options.cn: 申请人不是美国公民或永久居民

options.en: The applicant has an outstanding child support judgment
options.cn: 申请人有未结的子女抚养判决

options.en: The applicant fails to provide a required tax identification number
options.cn: 申请人未能提供所需的纳税识别号

options.en: The applicant's business address is outside California
options.cn: 申请人的营业地址位于加利福尼亚州之外

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 30(c) states that a licensing board shall not process an application for an initial license unless the applicant provides the required federal employer identification number or individual taxpayer identification/social security number.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第30(c)条规定，除非申请人提供所需的联邦雇主识别号或个人纳税人识别号/社会安全号码，否则许可委员会不得处理初始执照申请。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 30(c) (Document p. 80, PDF p. 103)

question_en: Under B&P Code Section 9, how do division, chapter, and section headings affect the interpretation of code provisions?
question_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第9条，分部、章节和条款标题如何影响法典条文的解释？

options.en: They govern and limit the meaning of each section
options.cn: 它们管理并限制每个条款的含义

options.en: They do not govern, limit, or affect code provisions
options.cn: 它们不管理、不限制也不影响法典条文

options.en: They clarify ambiguous language in the code text
options.cn: 它们澄清法典文本中含糊的语言

options.en: They supplement the text when a conflict arises
options.cn: 当出现冲突时，它们补充文本

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 9 expressly states that headings 'shall not be deemed to govern, limit, modify, or in any manner affect the scope, meaning, or intent of the provisions of this code.'
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第9条明确规定，标题“不得被视为管理、限制、修改或以任何方式影响本法典条款的范围、含义或意图。”
code_reference: B&P Code Section 9 (Document p. 73, PDF p. 96)

question_en: A contractor's license has expired, but no successor has been appointed. How long may the current board member continue to hold office?
question_cn: 承包商的执照已过期，但尚未任命继任者。目前的董事会成员可以继续任职多久？

options.en: Until the expiration date of the term only
options.cn: 仅到任期的截止日期

options.en: Until a successor qualifies or one year passes
options.cn: 直到继任者资格确认或经过一年

options.en: Until the director formally removes the member
options.cn: 直到主管正式免除该成员职务

options.en: Until the next regularly scheduled board meeting
options.cn: 直到下次定期安排的董事会会议

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 105.5 states a board member holds office until the appointment and qualification of a successor, or until one year has elapsed since term expiration, whichever occurs first.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第105.5条规定，董事会成员在继任者被任命并确认任职之前，或者直到任期届满后一年（以先到者为准）仍可继续任职。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 105.5 (Document p. 95, PDF p. 118)

question_en: Under what conditions may the Governor remove a licensing board member without following the normal removal process?
question_cn: 在什么情况下州长可以在不遵循正常免职程序的情况下罢免执照委员会成员？

options.en: Accepting gifts from license applicants
options.cn: 接受执照申请人的赠礼

options.en: Incompetence or unprofessional conduct
options.cn: 无能或不专业行为

options.en: Disclosing exam questions to an applicant
options.cn: 向申请人泄露考试题目

options.en: Continued neglect of required board duties
options.cn: 持续忽视所要求的委员会职责

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 106.5 authorizes the Governor to remove a board member who has knowledge of specific exam questions and directly or indirectly discloses them to any applicant before or during the examination.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第106.5条授权州长罢免知晓特定考试题目的委员会成员，并在考试前或考试期间直接或间接向任何申请人泄露这些题目。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 106.5 (Document p. 95, PDF p. 118)

question_en: A licensing board board member is also a full-time state employee. On a day when both the board meeting and the member's regular state job overlap, which of the following is true?
question_cn: 一名许可委员会的委员同时也是全职州政府雇员。在委员会会议与该委员的常规州政府工作发生重叠的那一天，下列哪一项是正确的？

options.en: The board covers the member's expenses only
options.cn: 委员会只承担该委员的费用

options.en: The member collects both the per diem and regular pay
options.cn: 该委员同时领取每日津贴和常规工资

options.en: The member receives no per diem for that day
options.cn: 该委员当天不领取每日津贴

options.en: The member may choose which compensation to receive
options.cn: 该委员可以选择领取哪种报酬

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 103 states that no public officer or employee shall receive per diem salary compensation on any day when they also received compensation for regular public employment.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第103条规定，任何公职人员或雇员在领取常规公务报酬的当天，不得领取每日工资补偿。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 103 (Document p. 94, PDF p. 117)

question_en: A licensing board wants to share a licensee's social security number with another state's licensing authority. Under what condition is this permitted?
question_cn: 一个许可委员会想要将持证人的社会保障号码共享给另一个州的许可机构。在什么情况下这是允许的？

options.en: When a reciprocity agreement exists and a national exam is used
options.cn: 当存在互惠协议并使用全国性考试时

options.en: Only after the individual licensee provides written consent
options.cn: 仅在个人持证人提供书面同意后

options.en: Only with the Franchise Tax Board's prior written approval
options.cn: 仅在获得特许税务委员会的事先书面批准后

options.en: Whenever the other state formally requests the information
options.cn: 每当其他州正式请求该信息时

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 30(k) allows release of a licensee's taxpayer ID or SSN to another state's examination or licensing entity only when the board uses a national examination and a reciprocity agreement or comity exists between California and that state.
explanation_cn: 《商业和职业法典》第30(k)条允许在加利福尼亚州与该州之间存在全国性考试并有互惠协议或承认关系的情况下，将持证人的纳税人识别号或社会保障号码提供给另一个州的考试或许可机构。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 30(k) (Document p. 82, PDF p. 105)

question_en: Which of the following is NOT a permissible use of licensure information shared by the department with the Office of the Chancellor of the California Community Colleges?
question_cn: 以下哪一项不是加州社区学院校长办公室可使用部门共享的执照信息的允许用途？

options.en: Recommending improvements to career technical programs
options.cn: 建议改进职业技术课程

options.en: Measuring employment outcomes of career technical students
options.cn: 测量职业技术学生的就业结果

options.en: Identifying licensees with delinquent state tax obligations
options.cn: 识别拖欠州税的持证人

options.en: Sharing data with a contracted third party performing outcome analysis
options.cn: 与执行结果分析的合同第三方共享数据

explanation_en: Section 30(n) limits use of licensure information shared with the chancellor's office strictly to measuring employment outcomes and improving programs. Tax delinquency enforcement is handled under Section 31, a separate provision, not through the community college data sharing channel.
explanation_cn: 第30(n)条将与校长办公室共享的执照信息的使用严格限制于测量就业结果和改进课程。税务欠缴执法由第31条处理，这是一项单独规定，不通过社区学院的数据共享渠道进行。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 30(n) (Document p. 82, PDF p. 105)

question_en: How many times per year must a licensing board within the Department of Consumer Affairs hold meetings, and where must those meetings be held?
question_cn: 消费者事务部下的许可委员会每年必须召开多少次会议，这些会议必须在哪里举行？

options.en: Once yearly at any location in California
options.cn: 每年一次，可在加利福尼亚州的任何地点举行

options.en: At least four times yearly throughout the state
options.cn: 每年四次或以上，在全州各地举行

options.en: At least twice yearly in northern and southern California
options.cn: 每年至少两次，在加利福尼亚州北部和南部举行

options.en: Monthly, alternating between northern and southern California
options.cn: 每月一次，在加利福尼亚州北部和南部轮流举行

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 101.7(a) requires boards to meet at least two times each calendar year — at least once in northern California and once in southern California — to facilitate public participation.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第101.7(a)条要求委员会每年召开至少两次会议——至少一次在加利福尼亚州北部，一次在南部——以方便公众参与。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 101.7 (Document p. 92, PDF p. 115)

question_en: A contractor fails to pay a state tax obligation. Which of the following consequences does the law authorize?
question_cn: 承包商未能支付州税义务。法律授权以下哪种后果？

options.en: Suspension of the contractor's license by the board
options.cn: 承包商执照可能被委员会暂停

options.en: A civil fine equal to twice the unpaid tax amount
options.cn: 民事罚款，金额为未缴税款的两倍

options.en: Automatic license revocation without any hearing
options.cn: 在未举行任何听证会的情况下自动吊销执照

options.en: Immediate criminal referral to the state attorney general
options.cn: 立即将案件提交州总检察长作刑事处理

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 31(e) expressly states that a licensee's license may be suspended if the state tax obligation is not paid. License applications must disclose this consequence.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第31(e)条明确规定，如果未支付州税义务，执照持有人的执照可能被暂停。执照申请必须披露这一后果。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 31(e) (Document p. 84, PDF p. 107)

question_en: When a board enters into a contract with an expert consultant for enforcement-related testimony, which procurement law does NOT apply?
question_cn: 当一个委员会与专家顾问签订与执法相关的证词合同时，哪项采购法律不适用？

options.en: Board's own internal consultant selection policies
options.cn: 委员会自身的内部顾问选择政策

options.en: Public Contract Code Part 2 procurement provisions
options.cn: 公共合同法典第2部分的采购规定

options.en: State contracting requirements under the Government Code
options.cn: 《政府法典》下的州合同要求

options.en: Due process protections during administrative hearings
options.cn: 行政听证期间的正当程序保护

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 40(b) expressly exempts expert consultant contracts from Part 2 (commencing with Section 10100) of Division 2 of the Public Contract Code, allowing boards to bypass standard public procurement bidding requirements for these contracts.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第40(b)条明确将专家顾问合同从公共合同法典第2部分（从第10100条开始）中豁免，使委员会能够绕过这些合同的标准公共采购招标要求。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 40(b) (Document p. 85, PDF p. 108)

question_en: A veteran applies for a contractor's license and wants credit for training received during military service. Which agencies must a licensing board consult before adopting rules on this topic?
question_cn: 一名退伍军人申请承包商执照，并希望将其在服役期间获得的培训计入学分。执照委员会在制定有关此主题的规则之前必须咨询哪些机构？

options.en: The Governor's office and the State Personnel Board
options.cn: 州长办公室和州人事委员会

options.en: The Legislature and the Department of Consumer Affairs director
options.cn: 立法机构和消费者事务部主任

options.en: The Department of Veterans Affairs and the Military Department
options.cn: 退伍军人事务部和军事部门

options.en: The Department of Defense and the Employment Development Department
options.cn: 国防部和就业发展部

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 35 explicitly requires each board to consult with the Department of Veterans Affairs and the Military Department before adopting rules and regulations for evaluating military education, training, and experience toward licensure requirements.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第35条明确要求各委员会在制定用于评估军事教育、培训和经验以满足执照要求的规则和法规之前，必须咨询退伍军人事务部和军事部门。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 35 (Document p. 84, PDF p. 107)

question_en: A contractor who is also a public employee attends a licensing board hearing as a witness. How much may the witness receive per day for attending?
question_cn: 作为公众雇员的承包商以证人身份出席许可委员会听证会。该证人每日报酬多少？

options.en: One hundred dollars per day
options.cn: 每天一百美元

options.en: 10 dollars per day
options.cn: 每天十美元

options.en: Twelve dollars per day
options.cn: 每天十二美元

options.en: Twenty-five dollars per day
options.cn: 每天二十五美元

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 108.5 specifies that any witness appearing at a board investigation, proceeding, or hearing may be paid twelve dollars ($12) per day for every day in actual attendance, plus actual, necessary, and reasonable expenses.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第108.5条规定，任何出席委员会调查、程序或听证会的证人，每天可获得十二美元（$12）报酬，按实际出席天数计算，并可报销实际、必要且合理的开支。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 108.5 (Document p. 96, PDF p. 119)

question_en: Which of the following information is a licensing board NOT required to report to the Franchise Tax Board about each licensee?
question_cn: 以下哪项信息不是许可委员会必须向特许税务局报告每位持证人的？

options.en: Whether the license is new or a renewal
options.cn: 该许可是新发还是续期

options.en: The licensee's bonding company and bond amount
options.cn: 持证人的保证公司及保证金额

options.en: Whether the license is active or inactive
options.cn: 该许可是有效还是无效

options.en: The effective date of the license or renewal
options.cn: 许可或续期的生效日期

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 30(d) lists eight specific data elements boards must report. Bonding information is not among them. Required items include name, address, taxpayer ID, license type, effective date, expiration date, active/inactive status, and new/renewal status.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第30(d)条列出了委员会必须报告的八个具体数据元素。保证信息不在其中。必须报告的项目包括姓名、地址、纳税人识别号、许可类型、生效日期、到期日期、有效/无效状态以及新发/续期状态。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 30(d) (Document p. 81, PDF p. 104)

question_en: A board employee who had access to a licensee's social security number during their employment later leaves the agency. May this former employee disclose that information?
question_cn: 在担任职务期间有权访问持牌人社会保障号码的董事会员工，后来离开了机构。前员工可以披露该信息吗？

options.en: No, former employees remain bound by the same restrictions
options.cn: 不可以，前员工仍受相同限制约束

options.en: Yes, but only to other government agencies
options.cn: 可以，但仅限于其他政府机构

options.en: Yes, if the licensee gives verbal consent
options.cn: 可以，如果持牌人给予口头同意

options.en: Yes, once they leave the board employment
options.cn: 可以，一旦他们离开董事会工作

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 30(i) extends the non-disclosure obligation to 'any former officer or employee or other individual' who had access to the information during employment — the restriction does not end when employment ends.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第30(i)条将保密义务延伸至“在职期间有权访问信息的任何前任官员、员工或其他个人”——限制在雇佣结束时并不会终止。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 30(i) (Document p. 81, PDF p. 104)

question_en: What is the primary purpose for which licensing boards within the Department of Consumer Affairs are established?
question_cn: 加利福尼亚消费者事务部内设立许可委员会的主要目的是什么？

options.en: To provide employment for state government workers
options.cn: 为州政府工作人员提供就业机会

options.en: To generate revenue for the state general fund
options.cn: 为州一般基金创造收入

options.en: To protect people of California from unqualified practitioners
options.cn: 保护加利福尼亚州民众不受不合格从业者的影响

options.en: To restrict competition in licensed trades
options.cn: 限制许可行业的竞争

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 101.6 states boards are established to ensure that businesses and professions with potential impact on public health, safety, and welfare are adequately regulated to protect the people of California.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第101.6条规定，设立委员会是为了确保对可能影响公共健康、安全和福祉的企业和职业进行充分监管，以保护加利福尼亚州民众。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 101.6 (Document p. 92, PDF p. 115)

question_en: An expert consultant hired by a licensing board to evaluate exam content later claims the contract expanded their authorized scope of practice. Is this claim valid?
question_cn: 一个由许可委员会雇佣来评估考试内容的专家顾问后来声称合同扩大了他们的授权执业范围。这个说法有效吗？

options.en: Yes, if the board approved the expanded duties in writing
options.cn: 是的，如果委员会以书面形式批准了扩展的职责

options.en: Yes, if the director approved the consultant agreement
options.cn: 是的，如果主任批准了顾问协议

options.en: Yes, when the consultant holds a valid California license
options.cn: 是的，当顾问持有有效的加利福尼亚执照时

options.en: No, the contract cannot expand an expert consultant's scope of practice
options.cn: 不，合同不能扩大专家顾问的执业范围

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 40(d) explicitly states that nothing in Section 40 shall be construed to expand the scope of practice of an expert consultant providing services under that section — the contract confers no additional practice authority.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第40(d)条明确规定，第40条的任何内容不得被解释为扩大根据该条提供服务的专家顾问的执业范围——合同不会授予额外的执业权。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 40(d) (Document p. 85, PDF p. 108)

question_en: A licensing board receives a request to provide a licensee's federal employer identification number to a member of the public. How must the board respond?
question_cn: 许可委员会收到请求，要求向公众成员提供持证人的联邦雇主识别号。委员会应如何回应？

options.en: Deny the request; these numbers are not public records
options.cn: 拒绝请求；这些号码不是公开记录

options.en: Provide it, since license information is a public record
options.cn: 提供，因为许可证信息是公开记录

options.en: Provide it after redacting the last four digits
options.cn: 提供，但需将最后四位数字隐去

options.en: Provide it only if the requestor files a formal written demand
options.cn: 仅在请求者提交正式书面要求时提供

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 30(h) states that, notwithstanding the Public Records Act, a federal employer identification number, individual taxpayer ID, or social security number furnished under Section 30 shall not be deemed a public record and shall not be open to public inspection.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第30(h)条规定，尽管有《公共记录法》，根据第30条提供的联邦雇主识别号、个人纳税人识别号或社会保障号不应视为公共记录，也不得向公众公开查看。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 30(h) (Document p. 81, PDF p. 104)

question_en: A contractor who served in the U.S. Armed Forces was honorably discharged two years ago. They now apply for an initial California contractor's license. What must the licensing board do?
question_cn: 一名曾服役于美军的承包商两年前光荣退伍。他们现在申请加利福尼亚州初始承包商执照。许可委员会必须做什么？

options.en: Expedite the initial licensure process
options.cn: 加快初始执照审批流程

options.en: Issue a temporary license without investigation
options.cn: 无需调查发放临时执照

options.en: Deny the application; two years have passed
options.cn: 拒绝申请；已过去两年

options.en: Waive all fees and examination requirements
options.cn: 免除所有费用和考试要求

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 115.4(a) requires a board within the department to expedite, and may assist, the initial licensure process for an applicant who provides satisfactory evidence of honorable discharge from active duty U.S. Armed Forces service.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第115.4(a)条要求部门下属委员会加快初始执照审批流程，并可协助向提交光荣退伍证据的美军现役服役申请人提供服务。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 115.4 (Document p. 101, PDF p. 124)

question_en: A licensed contractor's spouse holds an active, unrestricted out-of-state license and relocates to California due to the contractor's military duty assignment here. What fee relief does the board provide for a standard license application?
question_cn: 一名持牌承包商的配偶持有有效的、无限制的州外执照，并因承包商的军事任务调动而搬到加利福尼亚州。委员会在标准执照申请中提供什么费用减免？

options.en: Waive only the renewal fee for one year
options.cn: 仅免除一年续费

options.en: Reduce fees by 50% for the first year
options.cn: 第一年的费用减半

options.en: Waive all fees, including continuing education costs
options.cn: 免除所有费用，包括继续教育费用

options.en: Waive the application fee and initial license fee
options.cn: 免除申请费和初始执照费

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 115.5(a) requires the board to waive the licensure application fee and the initial or original license fee for a qualifying military spouse who holds a current out-of-state license and whose active duty partner is stationed in California.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第115.5(a)条要求委员会免除符合资格的军事配偶的执照申请费以及初始或原始执照费，该配偶持有有效的州外执照，并且其现役配偶驻扎在加利福尼亚州。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 115.5 (Document p. 102, PDF p. 125)

question_en: A contractor's license expired while the licensee was on active military duty. The licensee applies for reinstatement within one year of discharge. Which of the following is NOT required for reinstatement without examination?
question_cn: 承包商的执照在持证人服现役期间过期。持证人在退役一年内申请恢复执照。以下哪项不是无需考试即可恢复执照所必需的？

options.en: License was valid when entering military service
options.cn: 入伍时执照有效

options.en: Affidavit showing date of entry into service
options.cn: 显示入伍日期的宣誓书

options.en: Payment of the current renewal period fee
options.cn: 支付当前续期费用

options.en: Proof of active practice during military service
options.cn: 服役期间活跃执业的证明

explanation_en: Section 114 does NOT require proof of active practice during service. In fact, Section 114(c) states that if the agency determines the applicant was NOT actively practicing while on duty, it MAY require an exam — but proof of practice is not a prerequisite for reinstatement.
explanation_cn: 第114条不要求提供服役期间活跃执业的证明。实际上，第114(c)条规定，如果机构确定申请人在服役期间没有积极执业，可能需要考试——但执业证明并非恢复执照的前提条件。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 114 (Document p. 99, PDF p. 122)

question_en: A board receives a completed temporary license application from a qualifying military spouse, including all required documentation and a clean criminal background check. Within how many days must the board issue the temporary license?
question_cn: 委员会收到一份合格军人配偶的完整临时执照申请，包括所有所需的文件和清白的刑事背景检查。委员会必须在多少天内发放临时执照？

options.en: Within 90 days of receiving documentation
options.cn: 自收到文件之日起90天内

options.en: Within 30 days of receiving documentation
options.cn: 自收到文件之日起30天内

options.en: Within 45 days of receiving documentation
options.cn: 自收到文件之日起45天内

options.en: Within 60 days of receiving documentation
options.cn: 自收到文件之日起60天内

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 115.6(e) requires the board to issue the temporary license within 30 days of receiving documentation that the applicant has met all requirements, provided the criminal background check does not show grounds for denial.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第115.6(e)条规定，委员会必须在收到申请人已满足所有要求的文件之日起30天内发放临时执照，前提是刑事背景检查未显示拒绝发放的依据。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 115.6(e) (Document p. 104, PDF p. 127)

question_en: A military spouse receives a temporary California license under Section 115.6. Which event will NOT cause the temporary license to expire?
question_cn: 根据第115.6条规定，军人配偶可以获得临时加利福尼亚州执照。哪种情况不会导致临时执照失效？

options.en: Denial of a license by endorsement
options.cn: 通过认可方式被拒发执照

options.en: Issuance of a standard license by the board
options.cn: 委员会签发标准执照

options.en: 12 months passing since the license was issued
options.cn: 自执照签发之日起12个月过去

options.en: The spouse's active duty service member relocating
options.cn: 配偶的现役军人搬迁

explanation_en: Section 115.6(h) lists specific expiration triggers: 12 months after issuance, issuance or denial of a standard license, license by endorsement, or expedited license under Section 115.5. Relocation of the service member is not listed as an expiration event.
explanation_cn: 第115.6(h)条列出了具体的失效触发事件：自签发之日起12个月、签发或拒发标准执照、通过认可方式获得的执照，或根据第115.5条加急签发的执照。现役军人的搬迁未列为失效事件。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 115.6(h) (Document p. 104, PDF p. 127)

question_en: A contractor on active military duty has their renewal fees waived under Section 114.3. After discharge, within how many months must the contractor meet all renewal requirements to resume licensed activities?
question_cn: 根据第114.3条，现役军人的承包商可免除续约费。退伍后，该承包商必须在多少个月内满足所有续约要求才能恢复持牌活动？

options.en: Within 60 days of discharge
options.cn: 退伍后60天内

options.en: Within 12 months of discharge
options.cn: 退伍后12个月内

options.en: Within 3 months of discharge
options.cn: 退伍后3个月内

options.en: Within 6 months of discharge
options.cn: 退伍后6个月内

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 114.3(d) requires a licensee or registrant to meet all necessary renewal requirements as determined by the board within six months from the date of discharge from active duty service before resuming licensed activities.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第114.3(d)条规定，持牌人或登记人必须在退役日期起六个月内，按照委员会的要求完成所有必要的续约要求，方可恢复持牌活动。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 114.3(d) (Document p. 100, PDF p. 123)

question_en: After receiving notice of their discharge date, within how many days must a contractor notify their board of discharge from active military duty under Section 114.3?
question_cn: 在收到退伍通知后，根据第114.3条，承包商必须在多少天内通知其委员会他们已从现役军队退伍？

options.en: Within 90 days of receiving discharge notice
options.cn: 在收到退伍通知后90天内

options.en: Within 60 days of receiving discharge notice
options.cn: 在收到退伍通知后60天内

options.en: Within 12 months of receiving discharge notice
options.cn: 在收到退伍通知后12个月内

options.en: Within 6 months of receiving discharge notice
options.cn: 在收到退伍通知后6个月内

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 114.3(e) specifically requires the licensee or registrant to notify the board of their discharge from active duty within 60 days of receiving their notice of discharge.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第114.3(e)条明确要求持证人或注册人在收到退伍通知后60天内通知委员会他们已从现役服役退伍。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 114.3(e) (Document p. 100, PDF p. 123)

question_en: A board has determined that there is probable cause to believe a board member's conduct violates criminal law. Which DCA director action is authorized under Section 109?
question_cn: 董事会已确定有可能的理由相信某位董事会成员的行为违反刑法。根据第109条，DCA主任可以采取什么行动？

options.en: Override the board's licensing examination results
options.cn: 推翻董事会的执照考试结果

options.en: Apply for a restraining order or injunctive relief
options.cn: 申请限制令或禁令救济

options.en: Appoint a replacement board member immediately
options.cn: 立即任命替代董事会成员

options.en: Directly revoke the board member's license
options.cn: 直接撤销董事会成员的执照

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 109(c) authorizes the director to 'intervene,' which may include an application for a restraining order or injunctive relief as specified in Section 123.5, or a referral for criminal prosecution, when Division of Investigation findings disclose probable cause of criminal conduct.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第109(c)条授权主任“干预”，当调查部门的调查结果显示有可能的刑事行为理由时，这可能包括根据第123.5条规定申请限制令或禁令救济，或转介进行刑事起诉。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 109(c) (Document p. 97, PDF p. 120)

question_en: A contractor applying for a military spouse temporary license in California holds a current license in another state but has a pending disciplinary complaint in that state. Is the contractor eligible for the temporary license?
question_cn: 在加利福尼亚州申请军人配偶临时执照的承包商，在其他州持有有效执照，但该州有待处理的纪律投诉。该承包商是否有资格获得临时执照？

options.en: Yes, if the complaint has not yet resulted in discipline
options.cn: 是的，如果投诉尚未导致纪律处分

options.en: No, unless the other state dismisses the complaint first
options.cn: 否，除非其他州先撤销投诉

options.en: Yes, provided the license is otherwise in good standing
options.cn: 是的，前提是执照在其他方面保持良好状态

options.en: No, the pending complaint disqualifies the applicant entirely
options.cn: 否，待处理的投诉会完全取消申请人的资格

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 115.6(c)(5) expressly disqualifies any applicant who 'is the subject of an unresolved complaint, review procedure, or disciplinary proceeding conducted by a licensing entity in another jurisdiction.' A pending complaint triggers this bar.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第115.6(c)(5)条明确规定，任何“是其他司法管辖区许可实体正在进行的未解决投诉、审查程序或纪律程序对象”的申请人均不符合资格。待处理的投诉会触发此限制。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 115.6(c)(5) (Document p. 103, PDF p. 126)

question_en: Which agency within the Department of Consumer Affairs is expressly EXEMPT from the general rule that agencies are not required to publish a directory of licensees?
question_cn: 在消费者事务部内，哪一个机构明确豁免于一般规则，即机构不需要发布持证人名录？

options.en: The Contractors State License Board
options.cn: 承包商州许可委员会

options.en: The California Board of Accountancy
options.cn: 加利福尼亚会计委员会

options.en: The Medical Board of California
options.cn: 加利福尼亚医疗委员会

options.en: The Board for Professional Engineers and Land Surveyors
options.cn: 专业工程师与土地测量师委员会

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 112 explicitly states that 'no agency in the department, with the exception of the Board for Professional Engineers and Land Surveyors, shall be required to compile, publish, sell, or otherwise distribute a directory.' This board is the sole mandatory exception.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第112条明确规定，“本部门的任何机构，除了专业工程师与土地测量师委员会外，不得被要求编制、发布、出售或以其他方式分发名录。”该委员会是唯一的强制性例外。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 112 (Document p. 98, PDF p. 121)

question_en: A contractor who served in the military applies for license reinstatement more than one year after discharge. The board reviews the application. What is the board's authority regarding examination?
question_cn: 一位曾服役的承包商在退役一年后申请恢复执照。委员会审查了该申请。委员会在考试方面有什么权限？

options.en: Must reinstate the license without examination
options.cn: 必须在不考试的情况下恢复执照

options.en: Must require a full examination without exception
options.cn: 必须无例外地要求进行全面考试

options.en: May require the applicant to pass an examination
options.cn: 可以要求申请人通过考试

options.en: Must deny the application as untimely
options.cn: 必须因申请逾期而拒绝申请

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 114(b) states that if application for reinstatement is filed more than one year after discharge or return to inactive status, the licensing agency 'may,' in its discretion, require the applicant to pass an examination.
explanation_cn: 《商务与职业法典》第114(b)条规定，如果恢复申请是在退役或恢复非活动状态一年后提交，发证机构可以酌情要求申请人通过考试。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 114(b) (Document p. 99, PDF p. 122)

question_en: Under Section 114.3, a contractor's license renewal fees are waived while on active military duty. Which condition must be met for the waiver to apply?
question_cn: 根据第114.3条，对于在现役军务中的承包商，执照续费可豁免。该豁免适用必须满足哪一条件？

options.en: The licensee must cease all business operations completely
options.cn: 持证人必须完全停止所有业务操作

options.en: The license was current and valid at call-up
options.cn: 执照在被召入时必须是当前有效的

options.en: The licensee must have served at least two years
options.cn: 持证人必须至少服役两年

options.en: The licensee must waive all continuing education credits
options.cn: 持证人必须放弃所有继续教育学分

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 114.3(a)(1) requires that the licensee or registrant possessed a current and valid license with the board at the time they were called to active duty. This is one of three conditions that must all be met for the waiver to apply.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第114.3(a)(1)条规定，持证人或注册人在被召入现役时必须持有董事会颁发的当前有效执照。这是适用豁免的三个必要条件之一，三者必须全部满足。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 114.3(a) (Document p. 100, PDF p. 123)

question_en: A military spouse applies for a temporary California license under Section 115.6. Which of the following documents is required as part of the application?
question_cn: 军人配偶根据第115.6条申请加利福尼亚州临时执照。以下哪份文件是申请所需的？

options.en: Written verification of good standing from original jurisdiction
options.cn: 原执照辖区出具的良好信誉书面证明

options.en: Proof of passing a California law and ethics exam
options.cn: 加利福尼亚州法律和道德考试合格证明

options.en: A certified copy of the marriage certificate
options.cn: 结婚证书的认证副本

options.en: A copy of the active duty member's deployment orders
options.cn: 现役成员部署命令的副本

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 115.6(c)(3) requires the application to include 'written verification from the applicant's original licensing jurisdiction stating that the applicant's license is in good standing in that jurisdiction,' along with a signed affidavit from the applicant.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第115.6(c)(3)条要求申请包括“由申请人原执照辖区出具的书面证明，说明申请人的执照在该辖区内处于良好状态”，以及申请人签署的宣誓书。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 115.6(c)(3) (Document p. 103, PDF p. 126)

question_en: Under Section 115.10, a servicemember spouse seeking registration in California based on an out-of-state professional license must demonstrate active practice. How recently must that practice have occurred?
question_cn: 根据第115.10条，寻求基于外州专业执照在加利福尼亚注册的军人配偶必须证明其有实际执业经历。这种执业经历需要多近期的？

options.en: At least once in the prior two years
options.cn: 在过去两年中至少进行过一次

options.en: At least once in the prior five years
options.cn: 在过去五年中至少进行过一次

options.en: At least once in the prior six months
options.cn: 在过去六个月中至少进行过一次

options.en: At least once in the prior three years
options.cn: 在过去三年中至少进行过一次

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 115.10(b)(3) requires the applicant to have 'performed at least one activity within the scope and under the authority of their professional license during the two years immediately preceding the relocation to this state.'
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第115.10(b)(3)条要求申请人在搬迁到本州前的两年内“至少完成过一次其专业执照范围内并在其授权下的活动。”
code_reference: B&P Code Section 115.10(b)(3) (Document p. 106, PDF p. 129)

question_en: A board is conducting a licensing examination. The board wants to appoint a non-member to administer part of the examination. Which condition must be met?
question_cn: 委员会正在进行许可考试。委员会希望任命一个非委员来管理部分考试。必须满足哪一条件？

options.en: The person must have the same qualifications as members
options.cn: 该人必须具备与委员相同的资格

options.en: The Governor must approve each individual appointment made
options.cn: 州长必须批准每一项任命

options.en: The non-member must pass the board's own exam
options.cn: 非委员必须通过委员会自己的考试

options.en: The board director must personally approve each appointment
options.cn: 委员会主任必须亲自批准每一项任命

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 111 states that a commissioner on examination 'need not be a member of the board but shall have the same qualifications as one and shall be subject to the same rules.' Approval of the appointing power is also required.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第111条规定，考试委员会成员“无需是委员会成员，但应具备与委员相同的资格，并且应遵守相同的规则。”还需要任命权的批准。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 111 (Document p. 98, PDF p. 121)

question_en: A licensed contractor is found guilty of subverting a licensing examination. In addition to criminal penalties, what is the maximum civil damages amount the contractor may owe to the examining agency?
question_cn: 一名持牌承包商被判意图破坏许可考试。除了刑事处罚之外，该承包商可能需要向考试机构支付的最高民事赔偿金额是多少？

options.en: Up to $5,000 plus litigation costs
options.cn: 最高5,000美元加上诉讼费用

options.en: Up to $10,000 with no additional costs
options.cn: 最高10,000美元，不含其他费用

options.en: Up to $25,000 plus attorney fees
options.cn: 最高25,000美元加上律师费

options.en: Up to $10,000 plus litigation costs
options.cn: 最高10,000美元加上诉讼费用

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 123 states a person found guilty shall be liable for actual damages not to exceed $10,000 and the costs of litigation, in addition to any other criminal penalties.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第123条规定，被判有罪的人应承担实际损失赔偿金，最高不超过10,000美元，并承担诉讼费用，此外还需承担其他任何刑事处罚。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 123 (Document p. 111, PDF p. 134)
