question_en: A contractor timely renews their license before it expires, but the renewal certificate has not yet arrived due to a mail delay. May the contractor legally continue working during this gap?
question_cn: 承包商在执照到期前及时续期，但由于邮件延误，续期证书尚未收到。在此期间，承包商可以合法继续工作吗？

options.en: No, work must stop until the certificate arrives
options.cn: 不可以，必须在收到证书之前停止工作

options.en: Yes, if renewal was completed before the license expired
options.cn: 可以，如果续期在执照到期前完成

options.en: Yes, but only if the board grants written approval
options.cn: 可以，但仅在委员会书面批准的情况下

options.en: Yes, but only for residential projects under $500
options.cn: 可以，但仅限于500美元以下的住宅项目

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 121 states that a licensee who renewed prior to expiration is not deemed to be practicing illegally during any delay in receiving evidence of renewal that is not the licensee's fault.
explanation_cn: 《商用与专业法典》第121条规定，执照持有人如果在到期前完成续期，则在因非执照持有人过错导致的续期证书延误期间，不视为非法执业。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 121 (Document p. 109, PDF p. 132)

question_en: Which of the following actions by a licensee is NOT considered a misdemeanor under B&P Code Section 119?
question_cn: 持证人以下哪项行为不被视为《加州商业与职业法典》第119条项下的轻罪？

options.en: Renewing a license after a prior citation
options.cn: 在收到先前的处罚通知后续期执照

options.en: Lending your license to another person
options.cn: 将你的执照借给他人

options.en: Buying a counterfeit license knowingly
options.cn: 明知购买伪造执照

options.en: Displaying a suspended license as valid
options.cn: 显示已被暂停的执照为有效

explanation_en: Section 119 lists specific misdemeanor acts involving fraudulent or improper license use. Renewing a license after receiving a citation is a normal administrative action and is not listed as a misdemeanor offense.
explanation_cn: 第119条列出了涉及欺诈或不当使用执照的具体轻罪行为。在收到处罚通知后续期执照是一种正常的行政行为，并未列为轻罪行为。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 119 (Document p. 108, PDF p. 131)

question_en: A contractor is found in a disciplinary proceeding to have violated the licensing act. The board seeks reimbursement for investigation costs. Under what condition may the board conditionally renew the contractor's license despite unpaid costs?
question_cn: 一名承包商在纪律程序中被认定违反了《执照法》。委员会寻求补偿调查费用。在什么情况下，委员会可以在费用未支付的情况下有条件地续发承包商的执照？

options.en: The contractor files an appeal with the administrative law judge
options.cn: 承包商向行政法法官提起上诉

options.en: The contractor agrees to pay within 90 days
options.cn: 承包商同意在90天内付款

options.en: The contractor demonstrates financial hardship and signs a repayment agreement
options.cn: 承包商证明经济困难并签署还款协议

options.en: The board director approves a waiver of all costs
options.cn: 委员会主任批准免除所有费用

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 125.3(g)(2) allows the board to conditionally renew a license for up to one year if the licensee demonstrates financial hardship and enters a formal agreement to reimburse costs within that period.
explanation_cn: 《商务与职业法典》第125.3(g)(2)条允许委员会在执照持有人证明经济困难并签署正式协议在该期间内偿还费用的情况下，有条件地续发执照最长一年。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 125.3 (Document p. 113, PDF p. 136)

question_en: A contractor withdraws their license application after it has been filed. What authority does the CSLB retain after the withdrawal?
question_cn: 承包商在提交执照申请后撤回其申请。撤回后，加州承包商执照委员会（CSLB）保留哪些权力？

options.en: Authority to pursue denial only if fraud is proven
options.cn: 仅在作弊行为被证明的情况下有权追究拒绝权

options.en: No authority; the withdrawal ends all proceedings
options.cn: 无权力；撤回终止所有程序

options.en: Full authority to deny the license on any lawful ground
options.cn: 有完全权力在任何合法理由下拒绝执照

options.en: Authority to deny only within 30 days of withdrawal
options.cn: 仅在撤回后的30天内有权拒绝

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 118(a) states that withdrawal does not deprive the board of authority to institute or continue denial proceedings on any ground provided by law, unless the board consented in writing to the withdrawal.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第118(a)条规定，除非委员会书面同意撤回，否则撤回并不剥夺委员会依据法律规定的任何理由发起或继续拒绝程序的权力。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 118 (Document p. 108, PDF p. 131)

question_en: A registering authority receives a complete registration application from a military spouse seeking to practice in California. Within how many days must the authority register the applicant?
question_cn: 注册机构收到一名希望在加利福尼亚州执业的军人配偶的完整注册申请。该机构必须在多少天内完成申请人的注册？

options.en: Within 60 days of receiving documentation
options.cn: 在收到文件后的60天内

options.en: Within 30 days of receiving documentation
options.cn: 在收到文件后的30天内

options.en: Within 45 days of receiving documentation
options.cn: 在收到文件后的45天内

options.en: Within 15 days of receiving documentation
options.cn: 在收到文件后的15天内

explanation_en: B&P Code Section (c)(1) (SB 143, 2023) requires the registering authority to register a qualifying applicant within 30 days of receiving all applicable documentation described in subdivision (b).
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第(c)(1)条（SB 143，2023）要求注册机构在收到(b)款所述的所有相关文件后的30天内完成对符合条件申请人的注册。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 115.5 (SB 143, Stats 2023 ch 196) (Document p. 107, PDF p. 130)

question_en: A military spouse is registered to practice under the California military license registration program. When does that registration automatically expire?
question_cn: 军人配偶已根据加利福尼亚军事执照注册计划注册执业。该注册何时会自动失效？

options.en: When the servicemember's military orders expire
options.cn: 当军人订单到期时

options.en: When the registering authority issues a notice of termination
options.cn: 当注册机构发出终止通知时

options.en: When the spouse obtains a permanent California license
options.cn: 当配偶获得加利福尼亚永久执照时

options.en: Two years after the registration was issued
options.cn: 注册发放两年后

explanation_en: Under Section (e) of the military spouse registration statute (SB 143, 2023), the registration expires when the military orders described in subdivision (b)(2) expire.
explanation_cn: 根据军事配偶注册法规第(e)条款（SB 143, 2023），当(b)(2)款中描述的军事命令到期时，注册即失效。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 115.5 (SB 143, Stats 2023 ch 196) (Document p. 107, PDF p. 130)

question_en: Under B&P Code Section 119, a contractor reproduces a portion of their own license to display at a job site. Under what circumstance would this NOT be a misdemeanor?
question_cn: 根据加利福尼亚州商会与职业法规第119条，承包商可以在工地上展示自己执照的部分复制件。在什么情况下这不会构成轻罪？

options.en: If the reproduction is in black and white only
options.cn: 如果复制件仅为黑白色

options.en: If the reproduction is authorized by the code
options.cn: 如果复制件是法规授权的

options.en: If the display is limited to one job site
options.cn: 如果展示仅限于一个工地

options.en: If the contractor notifies the board beforehand
options.cn: 如果承包商事先通知委员会

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 119(f) prohibits reproducing a license in a manner it could be mistaken for a valid license, 'unless authorized by this code.' Code-authorized reproduction is the statutory exception.
explanation_cn: 商会与职业法规第119(f)条禁止以可能被误认为有效执照的方式复制执照，‘除非本法授权。’法规授权的复制是法律上的例外。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 119 (Document p. 109, PDF p. 132)

question_en: What is the maximum fee a licensing board may charge for issuing a duplicate copy of a certificate of licensure?
question_cn: 发证委员会为发放执照副本可收取的最高费用是多少？
explanation_en: B&P Code Section 122 states the fee for a duplicate certificate shall not exceed twenty-five dollars ($25) and must be sufficient to cover all costs of issuance.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第122条规定，副本证书的费用不得超过25美元 ($25)，且必须足以覆盖所有发证成本。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 122 (Document p. 110, PDF p. 133)

question_en: A licensed contractor is disciplined and ordered to pay investigation costs. The board's decision is later subject to judicial review. What happens to any restraining order that was previously issued against the contractor?
question_cn: 持牌承包商受到纪律处分并被命令支付调查费用。该委员会的决定随后可能受到司法审查。先前对承包商发布的任何禁令会发生什么？

options.en: The contractor must petition the court to dissolve it
options.cn: 承包商必须向法院申请解除禁令

options.en: The board may extend the order for 30 more days
options.cn: 委员会可以将禁令延长30天

options.en: The restraining order remains until the court rules
options.cn: 禁令在法院作出裁决前仍然有效

options.en: It dissolves automatically by operation of law
options.cn: 根据法律自动解除

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 125.7(d) states that any restraining order issued under this section shall be dissolved by operation of law at the time the board's decision is subject to judicial review under CCP Section 1094.5.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第125.7(d)条规定，根据本条发布的任何禁令，在委员会的决定根据CCP第1094.5条受到司法审查时，应依法自动解除。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 125.7 (Document p. 116, PDF p. 139)

question_en: After a restraining order is issued against a licensee under B&P Code Section 125.7, within how many days must an accusation be filed with the board?
question_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第125.7条，在对持证人发布禁止令后，必须在多少天内向委员会提交指控？

options.en: Within 30 days of the restraining order
options.cn: 在禁止令发布后30天内

options.en: Within 45 days of the restraining order
options.cn: 在禁止令发布后45天内

options.en: Within 60 days of the restraining order
options.cn: 在禁止令发布后60天内

options.en: Within 15 days of the restraining order
options.cn: 在禁止令发布后15天内

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 125.7(d) requires the accusation to be filed within a time allowed by the superior court, but in no case more than 30 days after the restraining order is issued.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第125.7(d)条规定，指控必须在高级法院允许的时间内提交，但无论如何不得超过禁止令发布后30天。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 125.7 (Document p. 116, PDF p. 139)

question_en: A registering authority is considering whether to charge a fee when a qualifying military servicemember applies for registration under the military license registration program. What does the law require?
question_cn: 注册机构正在考虑在符合条件的军人申请军事执照注册计划时是否收取费用。法律要求是什么？

options.en: The standard application fee must be charged
options.cn: 必须收取标准申请费

options.en: A fee is optional at the registering authority's discretion
options.cn: 是否收费由注册机构自行决定

options.en: No fee may be collected or required
options.cn: 不得收取或要求任何费用

options.en: A reduced fee not to exceed $25 may be charged
options.cn: 可收取不超过25美元的减免费用

explanation_en: B&P Code Section (g) (SB 143, 2023) explicitly states: 'A registering authority shall not collect or require a fee for registration pursuant to this section.'
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第(g)条（SB 143, 2023）明确规定："注册机构不得按照本条款收取或要求注册费用。"
code_reference: B&P Code Section 115.5(g) (SB 143, Stats 2023 ch 196) (Document p. 108, PDF p. 131)

question_en: A contractor conspires with an unlicensed person to complete a project, allowing the unlicensed person to use the contractor's license. Which of the following best describes the contractor's legal exposure?
question_cn: 承包商与无证人员合谋完成一个项目，允许无证人员使用承包商的执照。以下哪个最能描述承包商的法律责任？

options.en: A warning letter from the CSLB only
options.cn: 仅收到CSLB的警告信

options.en: Misdemeanor and disciplinary action under the code
options.cn: 根据法规属于轻罪并受到纪律处分

options.en: Civil liability only, not criminal charges
options.cn: 仅承担民事责任，不涉及刑事指控

options.en: License suspension only, no criminal exposure
options.cn: 仅暂停执照，不涉及刑事责任

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 125 states that a licensed person who allows their license to be used by an unlicensed person, or acts as their agent with intent to assist violations, is guilty of a misdemeanor and subject to disciplinary action.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第125条规定，持证人员允许无证人员使用其执照，或作为其代理人意图协助违法行为，均属轻罪，并可能受到纪律处分。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 125 (Document p. 112, PDF p. 135)

question_en: A licensee requests a hearing after a restraining order is issued against them under B&P Code Section 125.7. Within how many days must the board provide that hearing?
question_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第125.7条，如果对持证人发布了限制令，持证人请求听证会。董事会必须在多少天内提供该听证会？

options.en: Within 60 days of the hearing request
options.cn: 自听证请求之日起60天内

options.en: Within 30 days of the hearing request
options.cn: 自听证请求之日起30天内

options.en: Within 45 days of the hearing request
options.cn: 自听证请求之日起45天内

options.en: Within 90 days of the hearing request
options.cn: 自听证请求之日起90天内

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 125.7(d) states that if the licensee requests a hearing on the accusation, the board shall provide a hearing within 30 days of the request, or the court may nullify the restraining order.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第125.7(d)条规定，如果持证人对指控请求听证会，董事会应在请求之日起30天内提供听证会，否则法院可以取消限制令。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 125.7 (Document p. 116, PDF p. 139)

question_en: Under B&P Code Section 125.3, a disciplined contractor fails to pay court-ordered investigation costs on time. What action may the board take to enforce payment?
question_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第125.3条，如果一个受处分的承包商未按时支付法院下令的调查费用，委员会可以采取什么行动来强制付款？

options.en: Automatically revoke the license without a hearing
options.cn: 在不举行听证会的情况下自动吊销执照

options.en: Refer the debt to the Franchise Tax Board
options.cn: 将债务提交给特许经营税务委员会

options.en: Enforce the order in any appropriate court
options.cn: 在任何适当的法院执行该裁定

options.en: Assess additional penalties up to double the original amount
options.cn: 评估额外罚款，最高可达原金额的两倍

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 125.3(e) states that if timely payment is not made, the board may enforce the order for repayment in any appropriate court, in addition to any other rights the board may have.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第125.3(e)条规定，如果未及时付款，委员会可以在任何适当法院强制执行还款命令，此外还可以行使委员会可能拥有的其他权利。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 125.3 (Document p. 112, PDF p. 135)

question_en: A contractor receives a temporary restraining order prohibiting them from working. If the contractor requests a hearing on the accusation, within how many days must the board provide that hearing?
question_cn: 承包商收到暂时禁令，禁止其工作。如果承包商要求对指控进行听证，委员会必须在多少天内提供该听证？

options.en: Within 45 days of the request
options.cn: 在请求后的45天内

options.en: Within 30 days of the request
options.cn: 在请求后的30天内

options.en: Within 15 days of the request
options.cn: 在请求后的15天内

options.en: Within 30 days of the restraining order
options.cn: 在禁令后的30天内

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 124(d) explicitly requires the board to provide a hearing within 30 days of the licensee's request, or the court may nullify the restraining order.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第124(d)条明确要求委员会必须在执照持有人提出请求后的30天内提供听证，否则法院可能会宣布禁令无效。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 124 (d) (Document p. 117, PDF p. 140)

question_en: After a temporary restraining order is issued against a licensee, what must the board file within 30 days?
question_cn: 在对持证人发布临时禁令后，委员会必须在30天内提交什么？

options.en: An accusation with the board
options.cn: 向委员会提交指控

options.en: A written citation describing the violation
options.cn: 描述违规行为的书面传票

options.en: A final decision revoking the license
options.cn: 吊销执照的最终决定

options.en: A notice of suspension with findings
options.cn: 附有调查结果的暂停通知

explanation_en: Under B&P Code Section 124(d), an accusation must be filed with the board pursuant to Government Code Section 11503 within 30 days of the restraining order being issued.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第124(d)条，必须根据《政府法》第11503条的规定，在禁令发布后30天内向委员会提交指控。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 124 (d) (Document p. 117, PDF p. 140)

question_en: A board issues a restraining order against a licensed contractor. The contractor requests a hearing. The board holds the hearing on day 28, but does not issue a decision until day 50 after the hearing. What is the consequence?
question_cn: 董事会对一名有执照的承包商发布禁令。承包商请求听证会。董事会在第28天举行听证会，但直到听证会后的第50天才作出决定。后果是什么？

options.en: The accusation is automatically dismissed
options.cn: 指控将自动驳回

options.en: The license is automatically reinstated permanently
options.cn: 执照将自动永久恢复

options.en: The board may extend the restraining order another 30 days
options.cn: 董事会可以将禁令再延长30天

options.en: The court may nullify the restraining order
options.cn: 法院可以取消禁令

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 124(d) requires a decision within 15 days of the hearing's conclusion. Missing that deadline allows the court to nullify the previously issued restraining order.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第124(d)条要求在听证会结束后15天内作出决定。错过该期限允许法院取消先前发布的禁令。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 124 (d) (Document p. 117, PDF p. 140)

question_en: Under what narrow circumstance may a court issue a temporary restraining order against a licensee WITHOUT prior notice to that licensee?
question_cn: 在什么特定情况下，法院可以在未通知持牌人的情况下对其发布临时禁令？

options.en: When the board requests expedited review
options.cn: 当委员会请求加急审查时

options.en: When the licensee has prior disciplinary history
options.cn: 当持牌人有先前的纪律处分记录时

options.en: When serious public injury would occur before notice
options.cn: 当在通知之前会对公众造成严重伤害时

options.en: When the licensee cannot be located for service
options.cn: 当无法找到持牌人以送达文件时

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 124(b) allows a no-notice restraining order only when affidavits show that serious injury to the public would result before the matter could be heard with notice to the licensee.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第124(b)条规定，只有宣誓书证明：在能够向持牌人发出通知并举行听证之前，公众将遭受严重伤害时，法院才可在不事先通知的情况下签发临时禁令。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 124 (b) (Document p. 117, PDF p. 140)

question_en: A board issues a citation to a contractor for violating a licensing regulation. Which of the following must the citation include?
question_cn: 委员会向承包商发出违反执照法规的处罚通知。处罚通知必须包括以下哪些内容？

options.en: A specific reference to the provision violated
options.cn: 具体引用被违反的条款

options.en: Signatures from at least two board members
options.cn: 至少两名委员会成员的签名

options.en: A mandatory suspension period for the license
options.cn: 许可的强制暂停执照效力期限

options.en: The licensee's full employment and financial history
options.cn: 持证人的完整就业和财务历史

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 125.9(b)(1) requires citations to describe the nature of the violation with particularity and include specific reference to the provision of law determined to have been violated.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第125.9(b)(1)条要求通知详细描述违规性质，并具体引用被认为已被违反的法律条款。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 125.9 (b)(1) (Document p. 117, PDF p. 140)

question_en: When is it appropriate for a citation issued under the Section 125.9 citation system to include an order of abatement?
question_cn: 根据第125.9条引文系统，何时适合在引文中包括整改命令？

options.en: Only when the fine exceeds $5,000
options.cn: 仅在罚款超过5,000美元时

options.en: Only after a formal hearing has been held
options.cn: 仅在举行正式听证会之后

options.en: Only when the licensee has prior citations
options.cn: 仅在持证人有先前引文记录时

options.en: Whenever the board deems it appropriate
options.cn: 只要委员会认为适当

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 125.9(b)(2) states that 'whenever appropriate,' the citation shall contain an order of abatement fixing a reasonable time for the licensee to correct the violation.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第125.9(b)(2)条规定，“只要适当”，引文应包含整改命令，并为持证人设定合理的时间以纠正违规行为。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 125.9 (b)(2) (Document p. 117, PDF p. 140)

question_en: A temporary restraining order is issued against a licensed contractor who is later found to have been wrongly accused. At what point does the restraining order dissolve by operation of law?
question_cn: 针对一位后来被发现被错误指控的持证承包商颁布了临时禁令。该禁令在何时因法律效力而解除？

options.en: When the board's decision becomes final
options.cn: 当委员会的决定生效时

options.en: When the accusation is dismissed by the board
options.cn: 当委员会驳回指控时

options.en: When the board's decision is subject to judicial review
options.cn: 当委员会的决定可以接受司法复审时

options.en: When the 30-day hearing window expires unused
options.cn: 当30天的听证期未使用到期时

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 124(d) states the restraining order is dissolved by operation of law when the board's decision becomes subject to judicial review pursuant to CCP Section 1094.5.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第124(d)条规定，当委员会的决定根据《民事诉讼法》第1094.5条接受司法复审时，禁令按法律效力自动解除。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 124 (d) (Document p. 117, PDF p. 140)

question_en: A contractor receives a citation with an administrative fine. Within how many days must the contractor request a hearing to contest the violation?
question_cn: 承包商收到附有行政罚款的传票。承包商必须在多少天内请求听证会以对抗违规行为？

options.en: Within 60 days of citation issuance
options.cn: 在传票发出后的60天内

options.en: Within 30 days of citation issuance
options.cn: 在传票发出后的30天内

options.en: Within 10 days of citation issuance
options.cn: 在传票发出后的10天内

options.en: Within 45 days of citation issuance
options.cn: 在传票发出后的45天内

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 125.9(b)(4) specifically requires the licensee to request a hearing by written notice to the board within 30 days of the date of issuance of the citation or assessment.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第125.9(b)(4)条明确要求持证人在传票或评估发出之日起30天内，以书面通知委员会的方式请求听证会。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 125.9(b)(4) (Document p. 118, PDF p. 141)

question_en: A CSLB licensee is cited for a violation and does not contest the fine. The licensee also fails to pay within 30 days. What is the most likely consequence?
question_cn: 一名CSLB持证人因违规被引用，并且不对罚款提出异议。该持证人还未在30天内缴纳罚款。最可能的后果是什么？

options.en: The license is immediately and automatically revoked
options.cn: 执照会立即且自动被吊销

options.en: The fine is automatically waived by the board
options.cn: 董事会会自动免除罚款

options.en: The board may take disciplinary action
options.cn: 董事会可能会采取纪律处分

options.en: The fine doubles and a lien is recorded
options.cn: 罚款翻倍并记录留置权

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 125.9(b)(5) states that failure to pay a fine within 30 days of assessment, unless the citation is being appealed, may result in disciplinary action by the board.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第125.9(b)(5)条规定，如果未能在评估后的30天内缴纳罚款，除非该处罚通知正在上诉中，董事会可能会采取纪律处分。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 125.9(b)(5) (Document p. 118, PDF p. 141)

question_en: What is the maximum administrative fine a licensing board may assess per inspection or investigation of a violation?
question_cn: 许可委员会在检查或调查违规行为时可评估的最高行政罚款是多少？

options.en: $10,000 per inspection or investigation
options.cn: 每次检查或调查 10,000 美元

options.en: $1,000 per inspection or investigation
options.cn: 每次检查或调查 1,000 美元

options.en: $5,000 per inspection or investigation
options.cn: 每次检查或调查 5,000 美元

options.en: $2,500 per inspection or investigation
options.cn: 每次检查或调查 2,500 美元

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 125.9(b)(3) explicitly states the administrative fine shall not exceed $5,000 for each inspection or investigation made with respect to the violation.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第125.9(b)(3)条明确规定，对于与违规行为有关的每次检查或调查，行政罚款不得超过 5,000 美元。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 125.9(b)(3) (Document p. 118, PDF p. 141)

question_en: A contractor pays an administrative fine in full to resolve a citation. How must this resolution be represented for purposes of public disclosure?
question_cn: 承包商全额支付行政罚款以解决违规通知。这种解决方案在公共披露中应如何表示？

options.en: As a sustained disciplinary action on record
options.cn: 作为记录中的持续纪律处分

options.en: As an admission of the violation charged
options.cn: 作为对所指控违规行为的承认

options.en: As a pending disciplinary investigation
options.cn: 作为待处理的纪律调查

options.en: As a satisfactory resolution of the matter
options.cn: 作为事项的满意解决

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 125.9(d) states that payment of the fine plus compliance with any abatement order shall be represented as satisfactory resolution for public disclosure purposes.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 125.9(d) 条规定，支付罚款并遵守任何纠正命令应在公共披露中表示为满意解决。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 125.9(d) (Document p. 118, PDF p. 141)

question_en: A supplier knowingly sells $150 worth of equipment to a person planning to perform unlicensed contracting work. What is the minimum penalty the supplier faces?
question_cn: 一名供应商明知某人计划从事无证承包工作仍向其出售价值150美元的设备。供应商面临的最低处罚是多少？

options.en: A fine of not less than $2,500
options.cn: 不低于2,500美元的罚款

options.en: No penalty; civil matter only
options.cn: 无处罚；仅为民事问题

options.en: A fine of not less than $500
options.cn: 不低于500美元的罚款

options.en: A fine of not less than $1,000
options.cn: 不低于1,000美元的罚款

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 128 provides that a violation is punishable by a fine of not less than $1,000 and imprisonment in the county jail not exceeding six months. The $100 cash-sale exemption does not apply to a $150 transaction.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第128条规定，违反者将受到不低于1,000美元的罚款和不超过六个月的县监狱监禁的处罚。100美元现金销售的豁免不适用于150美元的交易。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 128 (Document p. 119, PDF p. 142)

question_en: Which of the following cash sales of equipment to an unlicensed contractor is EXEMPT from criminal liability under B&P Code Section 128?
question_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第128条，以下哪种向无执照承包商的设备现金销售可免于刑事责任？

options.en: A $150 cash sale of tools
options.cn: 150美元的工具现金销售

options.en: A $100 cash sale of equipment
options.cn: 100美元的设备现金销售

options.en: A $200 credit sale of materials
options.cn: 200美元的材料赊账销售

options.en: A $99 cash sale of supplies
options.cn: 99美元的供应品现金销售

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 128 explicitly exempts cash sales of less than $100 from its criminal misdemeanor provisions, regardless of knowledge.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第128条明确规定，现金销售少于100美元的行为，无论是否知情，都可免于其刑事轻罪规定。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 128 (Document p. 119, PDF p. 142)

question_en: A licensed contractor fails to notify CSLB of a new mailing address. Within how many days after the change was the notification required?
question_cn: 持证承包商未能通知 CSLB 新的邮寄地址。在变更后的多少天内需要进行通知？

options.en: Within 20 days after the change
options.cn: 变更后 20 天内

options.en: Within 30 days after the change
options.cn: 变更后 30 天内

options.en: Within 10 days after the change
options.cn: 变更后 10 天内

options.en: Within 14 days after the change
options.cn: 变更后 14 天内

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 136(a) requires each licensee to notify the issuing board of any mailing address change within 30 days after the change, unless the board has set a shorter period by regulation.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 136(a) 条要求每位持证人须在变更后的 30 天内通知发证委员会其邮寄地址的变更，除非委员会通过法规设定了更短的期限。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 136(a) (Document p. 124, PDF p. 147)

question_en: A contractor fails to pay investigative costs assessed under B&P Code Section 140. What may the board do?
question_cn: 一名承包商未能支付根据《加州《加州商业与职业法典》》第140条评估的调查费用。委员会可能采取什么措施？

options.en: Suspend the license for 30 days
options.cn: 暂停其执照30天

options.en: Add the costs to the next renewal fee
options.cn: 将费用加入下一次执照续费

options.en: Revoke the contractor's license for nonpayment
options.cn: 因未支付而吊销承包商执照

options.en: Issue an additional citation to the contractor only
options.cn: 仅向承包商发出额外罚单

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 140 states that failure to pay investigative costs assessed for wage record violations may result in revocation of the license.
explanation_cn: 《加州《加州商业与职业法典》》第140条规定，未支付因工资记录违规而评估的调查费用可能导致执照被吊销。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 140 (Document p. 127, PDF p. 150)

question_en: A California contractor is disciplined by the state of Nevada for conduct substantially related to licensed contracting. What effect can this have on the contractor's California license?
question_cn: 一名加利福尼亚承包商因与持证承包活动实质相关的行为而受到内华达州的处罚。这会对该承包商的加利福尼亚执照产生什么影响？

options.en: Grounds for CSLB disciplinary action
options.cn: CSLB 纪律处分的依据

options.en: None; California acts independently only
options.cn: 无；加利福尼亚独立行事

options.en: Automatic revocation of the California license
options.cn: 加利福尼亚执照自动吊销

options.en: Mandatory license suspension pending review
options.cn: 许可证暂停，待审查

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 141(a) provides that disciplinary action taken by another state for acts substantially related to the California-licensed practice may be grounds for disciplinary action by the California licensing board.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第141(a)条规定，另一州因与加利福尼亚持证执业实质相关的行为而采取的纪律处分，可构成加利福尼亚许可委员会采取纪律处分的依据。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 141(a) (Document p. 127, PDF p. 150)

question_en: A board receives a written complaint about one of its licensees. Within how many days must the board notify the complainant of the initial administrative action taken?
question_cn: 一个委员会收到关于其某个持牌人的书面投诉。委员会必须在收到投诉后多少天内通知投诉人所采取的初步行政措施？

options.en: Within 10 days of receipt
options.cn: 收到后 10 天内

options.en: Within 5 days of receipt
options.cn: 收到后 5 天内

options.en: Within 30 days of receipt
options.cn: 收到后 30 天内

options.en: Within 15 days of receipt
options.cn: 收到后 15 天内

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 129(b) requires each board to notify the complainant of the initial administrative action taken on the complaint within 10 days of receipt.
explanation_cn: 《职业与商业法》第 129(b) 条要求每个委员会在收到投诉后 10 天内通知投诉人所采取的初步行政措施。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 129(b) (Document p. 120, PDF p. 143)

question_en: A CSLB member has just completed two consecutive full terms. Which of the following is TRUE regarding further service?
question_cn: CSLB 的一名成员刚刚完成了连续两个完整任期。关于进一步服务，以下哪项是正确的？

options.en: The member may serve indefinitely by reappointment
options.cn: 该成员可以通过重新任命无限期服务

options.en: The member must wait one term before reappointment
options.cn: 该成员必须在重新任命前等待一个任期

options.en: The member may serve one additional partial term
options.cn: 该成员可以再服务一个额外的部分任期

options.en: The member may not serve more consecutive full terms
options.cn: 该成员不得再服务更多的连续完整任期

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 131 provides that no member of the CSLB or similar DCA agency shall serve more than two consecutive full terms, prohibiting additional consecutive full-term service.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 131 条规定，CSLB 或类似 DCA 机构的任何成员不得连续服务超过两个完整任期，禁止额外的连续完整任期服务。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 131 (Document p. 122, PDF p. 145)

question_en: A licensing board cannot deny an applicant a license solely because the applicant is not a United States citizen. Under which condition may citizenship still be relevant?
question_cn: 一个许可委员会不能仅仅因为申请人不是美国公民而拒绝发放执照。在什么情况下国籍仍可能相关？

options.en: When the board's regulations require citizenship
options.cn: 当委员会的规定要求国籍时

options.en: When a specific licensing act statute requires it
options.cn: 当特定的许可法法规要求时

options.en: When the applicant holds a tourist visa
options.cn: 当申请人持有旅游签证时

options.en: When the applicant's work authorization has expired
options.cn: 当申请人的工作许可已过期时

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 135.5(b) prohibits citizenship-based denial 'except as required by subdivision (e) of Section 7583.23,' showing that a specific statutory provision in a licensing act can still make citizenship relevant.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第135.5(b)条禁止基于国籍的拒绝，‘除非第7583.23条(e)款另有规定’，这表明许可法中的特定法定条款仍可能使国籍相关。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 135.5(b) (Document p. 123, PDF p. 146)

question_en: A licensee contests a citation by requesting a hearing. If the licensee ultimately pays the fine after losing the hearing, what is the effect of that payment on the public record?
question_cn: 持牌人通过请求听证会对罚单提出异议。如果持牌人在输掉听证会后最终支付罚款，这笔付款对公共记录有何影响？

options.en: Payment is an admission of the charged violation
options.cn: 付款即承认所指控的违规行为

options.en: The record is sealed from public view entirely
options.cn: 记录完全对公众隐藏

options.en: The matter is represented as satisfactorily resolved
options.cn: 此事项被表示为已满意地解决

options.en: The matter remains open as a disciplinary case
options.cn: 此事项仍作为纪律案件未结

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 125.9(d) provides that payment of the fine, plus compliance with any abatement order, shall be represented as satisfactory resolution for public disclosure purposes -- even after a contested hearing.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第125.9(d)条规定，为了公共披露目的，支付罚款并遵守任何纠正命令应被视为满意解决——即使是在经过争议的听证会之后。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 125.9(b)(4) and (d) (Document p. 118, PDF p. 141)

question_en: A contractor submits a personal check to renew a license, but the check is returned unpaid by the bank. What must the contractor do before a license will be granted?
question_cn: 一名承包商提交个人支票以续办执照，但银行退回支票且未付款。在获得执照之前，承包商必须做什么？

options.en: Pay only the original renewal fee amount
options.cn: 只支付原续费金额

options.en: Pay the outstanding amount plus any delinquency fee
options.cn: 支付未支付的金额以及任何逾期费用

options.en: Resubmit the personal check within 30 days
options.cn: 在 30 天内重新提交个人支票

options.en: Wait 30 days, then reapply for licensure
options.cn: 等待 30 天，然后重新申请执照

explanation_en: Under B&P Code Section 206, no license shall be granted until the applicant pays the amount from the dishonored check together with the applicable fee, including any delinquency fee.
explanation_cn: 根据《商务与职业法典》第 206 条，在申请人支付因被拒付的支票而产生的金额及适用费用（包括任何逾期费用）之前，不得授予执照。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 206 (Document p. 142, PDF p. 165)

question_en: A licensee's renewal notice is mailed by the licensing agency. After how many days can a delinquency fee first be assessed if the licensee has not yet renewed?
question_cn: 执照持有人的续期通知由发证机构邮寄。如果执照持有人尚未续期，多久后可以首次收取逾期费用？

options.en: After 45 days from the mailing date
options.cn: 从邮寄日期起45天后

options.en: After 60 days from the mailing date
options.cn: 从邮寄日期起60天后

options.en: After 120 days from the mailing date
options.cn: 从邮寄日期起120天后

options.en: After 30 days from the mailing date
options.cn: 从邮寄日期起30天后

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 163.5 states that a delinquency, penalty, or late fee shall not be assessed until 30 days have elapsed from the date the licensing agency mailed the renewal notice to the licensee.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第163.5条规定，在发证机构将续期通知邮寄给执照持有人之日起未满30天前，不得评估任何逾期、罚款或滞纳费用。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 163.5 (Document p. 137, PDF p. 160)

question_en: Which of the following does NOT describe a purpose of the Consumer Affairs Act as declared by the Legislature?
question_cn: 以下哪一项不描述立法机关所宣告的《消费者事务法》的目的？

options.en: Protecting consumers from deceptive methods and practices
options.cn: 保护消费者免受欺骗性手段和行为的侵害

options.en: Educating consumers to ensure rational marketplace choices
options.cn: 教育消费者以确保理性的市场选择

options.en: Fostering competition in the marketplace
options.cn: 促进市场竞争

options.en: Setting maximum prices for consumer goods and services
options.cn: 设定消费品和服务的最高价格

explanation_en: Section 301 does not authorize the DCA to set maximum prices. The Act promotes competition, consumer education, and protection from deception — price controls are not among its stated purposes.
explanation_cn: 第301条并未授权消费者事务局设定最高价格。该法案旨在促进竞争、消费者教育和防止欺骗——价格管制并非其声明的目的之一。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 301 (Document p. 144, PDF p. 167)

question_en: Under the Consumer Affairs Act, which of the following entities qualifies as a 'consumer'?
question_cn: 根据《消费者事务法》，下列哪一实体符合“消费者”的定义？

options.en: A corporation leasing equipment for commercial use
options.cn: 为商业用途租赁设备的公司

options.en: An individual purchasing services for household purposes
options.cn: 为家庭用途购买服务的个人

options.en: A contractor buying materials for a client's project
options.cn: 为客户项目购买材料的承包商

options.en: A partnership acquiring goods for resale
options.cn: 为转售购买商品的合伙企业

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 302(c) defines 'consumer' as any individual who seeks or acquires goods, services, money, or credit for personal, family, or household purposes — precisely this scenario.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第302(c)节将“消费者”定义为为个人、家庭或家庭用途而寻求或获取商品、服务、金钱或信用的任何个人——正是这种情况。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 302(c) (Document p. 144, PDF p. 167)

question_en: The Director of Consumer Affairs learns that the position of executive officer of a board within the department has just become vacant. Within how many days must the director notify the appropriate legislative policy committees?
question_cn: 消费者事务署署长得知部门内某委员会的执行官职位刚刚出现空缺。署长必须在多少天内通知相应的立法政策委员会？

options.en: Within 30 days of the vacancy
options.cn: 在职位空缺后的 30 天内

options.en: Within 45 days of the vacancy
options.cn: 在职位空缺后的 45 天内

options.en: Within 10 days of the vacancy
options.cn: 在职位空缺后的 10 天内

options.en: Within 60 days of the vacancy
options.cn: 在职位空缺后的 60 天内

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 308 requires the director to notify the appropriate policy committees of the Legislature within 60 days after a board or bureau chief or executive officer position becomes vacant.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第308条规定，委员会、局长或执行官职位出现空缺后，署长必须在60天内通知立法机构相应的政策委员会。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 308 (Document p. 145, PDF p. 168)

question_en: A contractor wants to verify that a competitor's license was revoked. The CSLB provides a certified copy of its records showing the revocation. How does this certified record function in a court of law?
question_cn: 一名承包商希望核实竞争对手的执照是否被吊销。CSLB 提供了一份显示吊销情况的认证副本。该认证记录在法庭上如何发挥作用？

options.en: It is conclusive proof of the revocation
options.cn: 它是吊销的决定性证据

options.en: It is only admissible in administrative hearings
options.cn: 它仅在行政听证中可被采纳

options.en: It is prima facie evidence of the facts recited
options.cn: 它是所述事实的初步证据

options.en: It is inadmissible without a live witness
options.cn: 没有在场证人其不可采纳

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 162 states that a certified copy of board records showing a revocation or suspension shall be admitted in court as prima facie evidence of the facts therein recited.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第162条规定，显示吊销或暂停的委员会记录的认证副本应作为所述事实的初步证据在法庭上被采纳。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 162 (Document p. 137, PDF p. 160)

question_en: Which of the following is a power expressly granted to the Director of Consumer Affairs under the Consumer Affairs Act?
question_cn: 根据《消费者事务法》，下列哪项权力是明确授予消费者事务局局长的？

options.en: Issue cease-and-desist orders to any business
options.cn: 向任何企业发布停止和终止命令

options.en: Subpoena witnesses and compel production of documents
options.cn: 传唤证人并强制提交文件

options.en: Set maximum prices for consumer goods
options.cn: 设定消费品最高价格

options.en: Suspend licenses of businesses under investigation
options.cn: 暂停正在接受调查的企业的许可证

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 310(e) expressly authorizes the director to hold public hearings, subpoena witnesses, take testimony, and compel the production of books, papers, documents, and other evidence.
explanation_cn: 《商法典》第310(e)条明确授权局长举行公开听证会，传唤证人，记录证词，并强制提交账簿、文件、资料及其他证据。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 310 (Document p. 146, PDF p. 169)

question_en: A board within the Department of Consumer Affairs wants to submit a fiscal impact analysis to the Legislature regarding pending legislation. What must happen before that submission is made?
question_cn: 消费者事务部内的一个委员会希望向立法机关提交关于待议立法的财政影响分析。在提交之前必须发生什么？

options.en: The analysis must be submitted to the director for review
options.cn: 分析必须提交给主管审查

options.en: The Department of Finance must review and approve it
options.cn: 财政部必须审查并批准

options.en: The Governor's office must approve the analysis first
options.cn: 州长办公室必须首先批准分析

options.en: The board must hold a public hearing on the analysis
options.cn: 委员会必须就分析举行公开听证会

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 165 requires that no board shall submit a fiscal impact analysis to the Legislature until the analysis has been submitted to the Director of Consumer Affairs for review and comment, and the director's comments must be included.
explanation_cn: 《商务与专业法典》第165条规定，在分析提交给消费者事务主管进行审查和评论，并将主管的评论包括在内之前，任何委员会不得向立法机关提交财政影响分析。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 165 (Document p. 138, PDF p. 161)

question_en: A board within DCA responds directly to a legislator's staff request for fiscal data. Within how many days must the board also transmit that information to the director?
question_cn: DCA 内的一个委员会直接回应立法者工作人员对财务数据的请求。该委员会必须在多少天内将该信息也传送给主管？

options.en: Within 3 working days of the response
options.cn: 在回应后的 3 个工作日内

options.en: Within 10 working days of the response
options.cn: 在回应后的 10 个工作日内

options.en: Within 30 calendar days of the response
options.cn: 在回应后的 30 个日历日内

options.en: Within 5 working days of the response
options.cn: 在回应后的 5 个工作日内

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 165 states that when a board responds directly to a legislator or staff with fiscal data, the board must also transmit that information to the director within five working days.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第165条规定，当委员会直接向立法者或其工作人员提供财务数据时，委员会必须在五个工作日内将该信息传送给主管。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 165 (Document p. 138, PDF p. 161)

question_en: When a board within the DCA proposes to amend its existing mandatory continuing education program, what must the board ensure?
question_cn: 当DCA内的一个委员会提议修改其现有的强制性继续教育计划时，该委员会必须确保什么？

options.en: The amendment is proposed only after public comment
options.cn: 该修正案仅在公众意见之后提出

options.en: The amendment is approved by the Legislature before adoption
options.cn: 该修正案在采纳前获得立法机构批准

options.en: The amendment is consistent with the director's guidelines
options.cn: 该修正案与主任的指导方针一致

options.en: The amendment is submitted to the governor for approval
options.cn: 将该修正案提交州长批准

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 166(d) states that any board proposing to amend its current mandatory continuing education program shall do so in a manner consistent with the guidelines developed by the director.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第166(d)条规定，任何提议修改其现行强制性继续教育计划的委员会，应以与主任制定的指导方针一致的方式进行。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 166(d) (Document p. 139, PDF p. 162)

question_en: A board's mandatory continuing education program accepts hours earned out of state. What must the board verify before granting credit for those hours?
question_cn: 一个委员会的强制性继续教育项目接受在外州获得的学时。在给予这些学时学分之前，委员会必须核实什么？

options.en: The course provider is accredited by a national body
options.cn: 课程提供者已获得国家机构的认可

options.en: The course complies with the director's guideline components
options.cn: 课程符合主管的指导方针组成部分

options.en: The course was approved by the out-of-state licensing board
options.cn: 课程已获得外州许可委员会的批准

options.en: The licensee submits a notarized certificate of completion
options.cn: 持证人提交了公证的完成证书

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 166(f) requires that when a board accepts out-of-state continuing education hours, the board must ensure the course is administered in accordance with the guidelines addressed in subdivision (a), including course validity, relevancy, and attendance.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第166(f)条规定，当委员会接受外州继续教育学时时，委员会必须确保课程按照(a)款中提到的指导方针进行管理，包括课程的有效性、相关性和出勤情况。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 166(f) (Document p. 139, PDF p. 162)

question_en: Which fund within the Professions and Vocations Fund is specifically named to hold revenues from contractor licensing fees?
question_cn: 在职业与行业基金中，哪个基金被专门指定用于存放承包商许可费的收入？

options.en: The Contractors License Fund
options.cn: 承包商许可基金

options.en: The Professional Engineer's Fund
options.cn: 职业工程师基金

options.en: The Consumer Affairs Fund
options.cn: 消费者事务基金

options.en: The Private Security Services Fund
options.cn: 私人保安服务基金

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 205(a)(6) expressly lists the Contractors License Fund as one of the special funds within the Professions and Vocations Fund.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 205(a)(6) 条明确将承包商许可基金列为职业与行业基金中的一个专项基金。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 205(a)(6) (Document p. 141, PDF p. 164)

question_en: A board within DCA seeks to charge $3 per document for certifying copies of records in its custody. Is this permissible under the law?
question_cn: DCA 内的一个委员会试图收取每份文件 3 美元的费用，用于认证其管理的记录副本。根据法律，这允许吗？

options.en: No, certification of records must always be free
options.cn: 不，记录的认证必须始终免费

options.en: No, the statutory fee is $2 per certified copy
options.cn: 不，法定费用是每份认证副本 2 美元

options.en: Yes, if the director approves the higher fee
options.cn: 是的，如果主任批准更高的费用

options.en: Yes, boards may set fees at their own discretion
options.cn: 是的，委员会可以自行决定设定费用

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 163 sets a uniform fee of $2 for certification of any record, document, or paper in the department's custody, except where another law expressly provides a different amount. A $3 fee would exceed this statutory limit.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 163 条规定，对部门管理的任何记录、文件或纸张的认证统一收费 2 美元，除非其他法律明确规定不同金额。3 美元的费用将超过此法定限制。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 163 (Document p. 137, PDF p. 160)

question_en: A public member is being considered for appointment to a state licensing board. Within how many years prior to appointment must the person NOT have been an employer of a licensee of that board?
question_cn: 正在考虑任命一位公众成员加入州许可委员会。在被任命之前的多少年内，该人不得成为该委员会持证人的雇主？

options.en: Within the past five years
options.cn: 过去五年内

options.en: Within the past two years
options.cn: 过去两年内

options.en: Within the past three years
options.cn: 过去三年内

options.en: Within the past one year
options.cn: 过去一年内

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 450 expressly disqualifies anyone who has been an employer of a board licensee within the five years immediately preceding their appointment as a public member.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第450条明确规定，任何在被任命为公众成员之前五年内曾是委员会持证人的雇主的人，都被取消资格。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 450 (Document p. 151, PDF p. 174)

question_en: A public board member holds a retired license and a consumer files a complaint about that person's past conduct. Which of the following best describes the board's authority?
question_cn: 一名公共委员会成员持有已退休的执照，且有消费者对该人的过去行为提出投诉。下列哪一项最能描述委员会的权力？

options.en: The board cannot act on a retired license
options.cn: 委员会不能对已退休的执照采取行动

options.en: The board shall investigate upon receiving the complaint
options.cn: 委员会在收到投诉后应进行调查

options.en: Only the Attorney General may investigate retired licensees
options.cn: 只有总检察长可以调查已退休执照持有者

options.en: The board must wait for a court order first
options.cn: 委员会必须先等待法院命令

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 464(c) states that a board shall investigate upon receipt of a complaint from any person about a licensee, including those with retired, inactive, canceled, revoked, or suspended licenses.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第464(c)条规定，委员会在收到任何人关于执照持有者的投诉时应进行调查，包括那些持有已退休、非活跃、取消、吊销或暂停执照的人。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 464(c) (Document p. 155, PDF p. 178)

question_en: Which of the following duties may NOT be delegated solely to a public member of a licensing board?
question_cn: 以下哪项职责不得仅委托给许可委员会的公众成员？

options.en: Participating in policy formation for exams
options.cn: 参与考试政策的制定

options.en: Serving on a multi-member subcommittee
options.cn: 在多成员小组委员会中任职

options.en: Grading licensee examinations alone
options.cn: 单独评分执照考试

options.en: Approving or modifying another member's action
options.cn: 批准或修改其他成员的行动

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 451 prohibits delegating the preparation, administration, or grading of examinations solely to a public or lay member. These duties require professional board members.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第451条禁止将考试的准备、管理或评分工作仅委托给公众或外行成员。这些职责需要专业委员会成员执行。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 451 (Document p. 152, PDF p. 175)

question_en: A holder of an inactive contractor license wants to restore it to active status. Which requirement does the law impose?
question_cn: 持有非活跃承包商执照的人希望将其恢复为活跃状态。法律规定了哪些要求？

options.en: Obtain board approval at a public hearing
options.cn: 在公开听证会上获得委员会批准

options.en: Submit a new license application to the board
options.cn: 向委员会提交新的执照申请

options.en: Pay the renewal fee and complete continuing education
options.cn: 支付续期费并完成继续教育

options.en: Retake the original licensing examination
options.cn: 重新参加原始的执照考试

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 462(b)(4) requires the inactive licensee to pay the renewal fee and, if the board requires it, complete continuing education equivalent to that required for an active license renewal.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第462(b)(4)条要求非活跃执照持有人支付续期费，并且如果委员会要求，还需完成与活跃执照续期相当的继续教育。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 462(b)(4) (Document p. 154, PDF p. 177)

question_en: A contractor's license is placed in retired status. How often must the holder renew that retired license?
question_cn: 承包商的执照被置于退休状态。持有人多久必须更新一次该退休执照？

options.en: Once every ten years only
options.cn: 每十年一次

options.en: No renewal is required at all
options.cn: 完全不需要更新

options.en: Every four years at a reduced fee
options.cn: 每四年一次，费用减少

options.en: Every two years, same as an active license
options.cn: 每两年一次，与有效执照相同

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 464(b)(3) states that the holder of a retired license shall not be required to renew that license, distinguishing it from inactive licenses which must be renewed on the active license schedule.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第464(b)(3)条规定，退休执照的持有人无需更新该执照，这与必须按照有效执照时间表更新的非活动执照不同。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 464(b)(3) (Document p. 154, PDF p. 177)

question_en: A city passes an ordinance prohibiting a state-licensed contractor from performing a type of work that falls within the contractor's CSLB-authorized scope. Under state law, what is the effect of that ordinance?
question_cn: 一座城市通过了一项条例，禁止持有州执照的承包商执行属于其CSLB授权范围内的一类工作。根据州法律，该条例的效力如何？

options.en: The contractor must obtain a separate local permit
options.cn: 承包商必须获得单独的本地许可证

options.en: The ordinance is unenforceable against the contractor
options.cn: 该条例对承包商不可执行

options.en: The ordinance is valid if adopted before 2010
options.cn: 如果在2010年前通过，该条例有效

options.en: The city may enforce it for zoning purposes only
options.cn: 该城市只能为分区目的执行该条例

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 460(a) expressly provides that no city or county shall prohibit a person authorized by a DCA agency license from engaging in that business or any portion thereof. The local ordinance is preempted by state law.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第460(a)条明确规定，任何城市或县不得禁止DCA机构授权的人员从事该业务或其任何部分。本地条例被州法律取代。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 460(a) (Document p. 153, PDF p. 176)

question_en: When a consumer files a complaint with the DCA director involving a probable violation of law by a licensee, what must the director do with that complaint?
question_cn: 当消费者向 DCA 局长提交涉及持证人可能违法的投诉时，局长必须对该投诉做什么？

options.en: Dismiss it if the licensee responds within 30 days
options.cn: 如果持证人在 30 天内回应，则驳回投诉

options.en: Hold a public hearing before taking any action
options.cn: 在采取任何行动前举行公开听证会

options.en: Refer it solely to the Attorney General for prosecution
options.cn: 仅将其转交给总检察长进行起诉

options.en: Transmit it to the appropriate law enforcement or regulatory agency
options.cn: 将其转交给相关的执法或监管机构

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 326(c) requires the director to transmit valid complaints indicating a probable violation to the appropriate law enforcement or regulatory agency and may request the Attorney General to take legal action.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 326(c) 条要求局长将显示可能违法的有效投诉转交给相关的执法或监管机构，并可请求总检察长采取法律行动。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 326(b)-(c) (Document p. 150, PDF p. 173)

question_en: An application for a state license asks the applicant to disclose every prior arrest. One arrest did not result in a conviction or nolo contendere plea. Which of the following is correct?
question_cn: 州执照申请要求申请人披露所有以往的逮捕记录。其中一次逮捕没有导致定罪或无异议认罪。以下哪项是正确的？

options.en: The applicant need not disclose the non-conviction arrest
options.cn: 申请人无需披露未定罪的逮捕记录

options.en: The applicant must disclose all arrests regardless of outcome
options.cn: 申请人必须披露所有逮捕记录，不论结果如何

options.en: The agency may ask, but the applicant may refuse
options.cn: 机构可以询问，但申请人可以拒绝披露

options.en: The disclosure is required only for felony arrests
options.cn: 仅对重罪逮捕要求披露

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 461 prohibits any public agency from asking an applicant on an initial license application to reveal a record of arrest that did not result in a conviction or nolo contendere plea. Asking for such disclosure is a misdemeanor.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第461条禁止任何公共机构在初始执照申请中要求申请人透露未导致定罪或无异议认罪的逮捕记录。要求披露此类信息属于轻罪。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 461 (Document p. 153, PDF p. 176)

question_en: A public board member holds a 3% ownership stake in a company that is regulated by the board on which the member serves. Under state law, what is the consequence?
question_cn: 一名公共董事会成员在一家受其所在董事会监管的公司中持有3%的所有权股份。根据州法律，后果是什么？

options.en: Allowed if ownership is below 10%
options.cn: 如果所有权低于10%，则允许

options.en: Allowed if the member recuses on votes affecting that company
options.cn: 如果该成员在涉及该公司的投票中回避，则允许

options.en: Allowed if disclosed in writing to the board
options.cn: 如果以书面形式向董事会披露，则允许

options.en: Prohibited; the member cannot hold any such financial interest
options.cn: 禁止；该成员不能持有任何此类财务利益

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 450.3 expressly prohibits a public member from having any financial interest in any organization subject to regulation by the board, either at the time of appointment or during their tenure in office.
explanation_cn: 《商法典》第450.3条明确禁止公共成员在担任职务时或被任命时在任何受董事会监管的组织中拥有任何财务利益。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 450.3 (Document p. 151, PDF p. 174)

question_en: Which of the following BEST describes the continuing education requirement for renewing a license held in inactive status?
question_cn: 以下哪一项最能描述持有非活跃状态执照的续期继续教育要求？

options.en: Same continuing education hours as an active renewal
options.cn: 与活跃续期相同的继续教育小时数

options.en: No continuing education is required at inactive renewal
options.cn: 非活跃续期无需继续教育

options.en: Board-approved online courses in lieu of standard hours
options.cn: 由委员会批准的在线课程可替代标准小时数

options.en: Half the continuing education hours of an active renewal
options.cn: 活跃续期继续教育小时数的一半

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 462(b)(2) specifically states that the holder of an inactive license need not comply with any continuing education requirement for renewal of an active license. The exemption applies at renewal.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 462(b)(2) 条明确规定，非活跃执照持有人在续期时无需遵守活跃执照的任何继续教育要求。此豁免适用于续期。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 462(b)(2) (Document p. 154, PDF p. 177)

question_en: The Dispute Resolution Advisory Council consists of seven members. How many of those members must be appointed by the Governor?
question_cn: 争议解决咨询委员会由七名成员组成。其中多少名成员必须由州长任命？

options.en: Six members
options.cn: 六名成员

options.en: Three members
options.cn: 三名成员

options.en: Five members
options.cn: 五名成员

options.en: All seven members
options.cn: 七名成员全部

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 467(b) expressly states that five of the seven advisory council members shall be appointed by the Governor, with one each appointed by the Senate Rules Committee and the Speaker of the Assembly.
explanation_cn: 《B&P条例》第467(b)条明确规定，七名咨询委员会成员中有五名应由州长任命，参议院规则委员会和众议院议长各任命一名。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 467(b) (Document p. 156, PDF p. 179)

question_en: Which of the following activities is a public board member PERMITTED to perform under state law?
question_cn: 根据州法律，下列哪项活动是公共董事会成员被允许执行的？

options.en: Participate in forming examination scope policy
options.cn: 参与制定考试范围政策

options.en: Solely inspect a licensee's place of business
options.cn: 仅检查持证人的营业场所

options.en: Solely prepare and grade a licensing exam
options.cn: 仅准备和评分执照考试

options.en: Solely administer a licensee examination
options.cn: 仅管理持证人考试

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 451 expressly states that nothing in the section precludes a public member from participating in the formation of policy relating to the scope of examination activities. Policy formation is allowed; sole execution is not.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第451条明确规定，本条款的任何内容都不阻止公共成员参与制定与考试活动范围相关的政策。允许参与政策制定；不允许独自执行。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 451 (Document p. 152, PDF p. 175)

question_en: A licensee on probation tests positive for a substance prohibited under the terms of the probation. A cease practice order is issued. Does this order constitute disciplinary action?
question_cn: 处于考察期期的持证人在药物测试中检测出考察期条款禁止的物质。于是发布了停止执业令。该命令是否构成纪律处分？

options.en: No, it does not constitute disciplinary action
options.cn: 不，这不构成纪律处分

options.en: Yes, it is formal disciplinary action
options.cn: 是的，这是正式的纪律处分

options.en: Yes, but only if the licensee had prior violations
options.cn: 是的，但仅在持证人有先前违规的情况下

options.en: Only if the board follows APA hearing procedures first
options.cn: 仅在委员会先遵循《行政程序法》听证程序的情况下

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 315.2(c) is unambiguous: a cease practice order issued because a probationer tested positive for a prohibited substance shall not constitute disciplinary action.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第315.2(c)条款明确规定：因缓刑持证人检出禁止物质而发布的停止执业令不应构成纪律处分。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 315.2(c) (Document p. 148, PDF p. 171)

question_en: A public board member was employed full-time by a licensed general contractor four years before being appointed. Is this person qualified to serve as a public member?
question_cn: 一名公共董事会成员在被任命前四年曾全职受雇于一家有执照的总承包商。此人有资格担任公共成员吗？

options.en: No, because the employment falls within the five-year window
options.cn: 不，因为该雇佣关系位于五年期限内

options.en: Yes, past employment never disqualifies a public member
options.cn: 是的，以前的雇佣经历从不使公共成员失去资格

options.en: Yes, because the employment ended more than three years ago
options.cn: 是的，因为雇佣关系已在三年前结束

options.en: Yes, if prior employment was under two percent of the practice
options.cn: 是的，如果之前的雇佣占比少于该行业实践的百分之二

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 450(c) disqualifies anyone who was an employee of a board licensee within the five years immediately preceding appointment. Four years falls squarely within that window.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第450(c)条规定，任何在被任命前五年内曾为董事会执照持有者工作的人员均不得担任公共成员。四年正好在这一期限内。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 450(c) (Document p. 151, PDF p. 174)

question_en: A contractor applicant was convicted of fraud five years ago, completed probation, and later had the conviction dismissed under Penal Code Section 1203.4. Can the CSLB deny the license based on that conviction?
question_cn: 一名承包商申请人五年前因欺诈被定罪，完成了考察期，后来根据《刑法》第1203.4条取消了该定罪。CSLB 是否可以基于该定罪拒绝发放执照？

options.en: Yes, if substantially related to contracting duties
options.cn: 可以，如果与承包职责有实质性关联

options.en: No, a dismissed conviction cannot be basis for denial
options.cn: 不可以，被撤销的定罪不能作为拒绝的依据

options.en: Yes, fraud convictions always justify denial
options.cn: 可以，欺诈定罪总是可以作为拒绝理由

options.en: No, only if the applicant provides proof of dismissal
options.cn: 不可以，除非申请人提供撤销定罪的证明

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 480(c) expressly prohibits denying a license based on a conviction dismissed under Penal Code Section 1203.4. The board cannot use the dismissed conviction or its underlying acts.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第480(c)条明确禁止基于《刑法》第1203.4条下被撤销的定罪来拒绝发放执照。委员会不能利用被撤销的定罪或其相关行为。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 480(c) (Document p. 168, PDF p. 191)

question_en: Which of the following is NOT a valid ground for denying a contractor's license application under B&P Code Section 475?
question_cn: 根据《商务与职业法》第475条，下列哪一项不是拒绝承包商执照申请的有效理由？

options.en: Knowingly making a false statement on the application
options.cn: 在申请中 knowingly 提供虚假陈述

options.en: Applicant's poor reputation or personal habits
options.cn: 申请人的声誉不佳或个人习惯

options.en: Conviction of a crime substantially related to contracting
options.cn: 被判定犯有与承包有关的重大犯罪

options.en: Commission of an act involving dishonesty or fraud
options.cn: 实施涉及不诚实或欺诈的行为

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 475(c) expressly prohibits denying a license on the basis of lack of good moral character or any similar ground relating to reputation, personality, or habits.
explanation_cn: 《商务与职业法》第475(c)条明确禁止基于缺乏良好道德品行或任何与声誉、个性或习惯相关的类似理由而拒绝发放执照。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 475(c) (Document p. 166, PDF p. 189)

question_en: A contractor applicant was arrested two years ago but the case was dismissed without a conviction. Can the CSLB deny the license based on that arrest?
question_cn: 一名承包商申请人在两年前被逮捕，但案件在未定罪的情况下被驳回。CSLB 能否基于该逮捕拒发执照？

options.en: No, only if the applicant discloses the arrest voluntarily
options.cn: 不，除非申请人自愿披露逮捕情况

options.en: Yes, if the arrest was within the past seven years
options.cn: 是的，如果逮捕发生在过去七年内

options.en: No, arrests without convictions cannot support denial
options.cn: 不，没有定罪的逮捕不能作为拒发依据

options.en: Yes, if the underlying acts are substantially related
options.cn: 是的，如果相关行为与业务实质上相关

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 480(d) explicitly states that a board shall not deny a license based on an arrest that resulted in a disposition other than a conviction, including infractions, citations, or juvenile adjudications.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第480(d)条明确规定，委员会不得基于导致非定罪结果的逮捕拒发执照，包括违规行为、传票或未成年人裁定。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 480(d) (Document p. 169, PDF p. 192)

question_en: How long must a licensing board retain application forms and supporting documents after they are submitted?
question_cn: 许可委员会在收到申请表及支持文件后必须保留多久？

options.en: For a minimum of five years
options.cn: 至少五年

options.en: For a minimum of seven years
options.cn: 至少七年

options.en: For a minimum of three years
options.cn: 至少三年

options.en: For a minimum of four years
options.cn: 至少四年

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 480(g)(1) requires each board to retain application forms and other submitted documents for a minimum of three years.
explanation_cn: 商业和职业法第480(g)(1)条要求每个委员会至少保留申请表和其他提交的文件三年。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 480(g)(1) (Document p. 169, PDF p. 192)

question_en: When a board denies a license application based on the applicant's conviction history, which of the following must it include in the written notice to the applicant?
question_cn: 当一个委员会基于申请人的犯罪记录拒绝其执照申请时，书面通知申请人时必须包括以下哪些内容？

options.en: A list of similar programs the applicant may attend
options.cn: 申请人可以参加的类似项目列表

options.en: The applicant's right to appeal the board's decision
options.cn: 申请人对委员会决定的上诉权利

options.en: A detailed explanation of each board member's vote
options.cn: 每位委员会成员投票的详细解释

options.en: The minimum waiting period before reapplying
options.cn: 重新申请前的最短等待期

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 480(f)(3)(C) requires the written denial notice to inform the applicant of the right to appeal the board's decision, along with procedures for challenging, requesting reconsideration, and accessing conviction records.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第480(f)(3)(C)条要求书面拒绝通知告知申请人有权对委员会的决定提出上诉，并说明挑战、请求重新考虑及获取犯罪记录的程序。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 480(f)(3) (Document p. 169, PDF p. 192)

question_en: A dispute resolution program funded by a county charges full price to high-income participants but provides free services to low-income participants. Does this satisfy the eligibility funding requirements?
question_cn: 由县政府资助的争议解决计划对高收入参与者收取全额费用，但为低收入参与者提供免费服务。这是否符合资助资格要求？

options.en: Yes, if county supervisors approve the fee schedule
options.cn: 是的，如果县主管批准收费标准

options.en: No, fees must be uniform for all participants
options.cn: 不，费用必须对所有参与者统一

options.en: Yes, sliding scale with no cost to indigents is required
options.cn: 是的，需要按滑动收费标准，对贫困人士免费

options.en: No, all participants must receive free services
options.cn: 不，所有参与者都必须获得免费服务

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 467.2(c) requires programs to provide dispute resolution on a sliding scale basis and without cost to indigents. Charging based on income level satisfies this requirement.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第467.2(c)条要求项目按滑动收费标准提供争议解决服务，并且对贫困人士免费。根据收入水平收费符合此要求。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 467.2(c) (Document p. 157, PDF p. 180)

question_en: What is the maximum amount that can be distributed per court filing fee for support of county dispute resolution programs?
question_cn: 为支持县级争议解决项目，每笔诉讼费最多可分配的金额是多少？

options.en: Eight dollars per filing fee
options.cn: 每笔诉讼费八美元

options.en: Four dollars per filing fee
options.cn: 每笔诉讼费四美元

options.en: Ten dollars per filing fee
options.cn: 每笔诉讼费十美元

options.en: Twelve dollars per filing fee
options.cn: 每笔诉讼费十二美元

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 470.5(c) expressly states that the total amount to be distributed for the support of dispute resolution programs may not exceed eight dollars per filing fee.
explanation_cn: 商业与职业法典第470.5(c)条明确规定，用于支持争议解决项目的总分配金额不得超过每笔诉讼费八美元。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 470.5(c) (Document p. 161, PDF p. 184)

question_en: How often must county-funded dispute resolution programs provide statistical data to the county?
question_cn: 县资助的争议解决项目必须多久向县提供一次统计数据？

options.en: Biannually, at program midpoint and year-end
options.cn: 每半年一次，在项目中期和年末

options.en: Quarterly, or as the county requests
options.cn: 每季度一次，或按县的要求

options.en: Monthly, along with operating budget reports
options.cn: 每月一次，并附运营预算报告

options.en: Annually, with required statistical data
options.cn: 每年一次，提供所需的统计数据

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 471.5 requires each funded program to annually provide the county with statistical data including budget, referrals, disputes resolved, compliance rates, and other metrics, while maintaining party confidentiality.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第471.5条要求每个获得资助的项目每年向县提供统计数据，包括预算、转介、解决的争议、合规率及其他指标，同时保持当事人机密。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 471.5 (Document p. 162, PDF p. 185)

question_en: What is the maximum percentage of a program's approved estimated cost that a county may fund under the county dispute resolution chapter?
question_cn: 根据县争议解决章节，县可以资助的项目批准估算成本的最高百分比是多少？

options.en: 100 percent if no private funds are available
options.cn: 如果没有私人资金，则为100%

options.en: 75 percent of the approved estimated cost
options.cn: 批准估算成本的75%

options.en: 25 percent of the approved estimated cost
options.cn: 批准估算成本的25%

options.en: 50 percent of the approved estimated cost
options.cn: 批准估算成本的50%

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 470.2 states that a county's share of funding under this chapter shall not exceed 50 percent of the approved estimated cost of the program.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第470.2条规定，根据本章节，县的资助份额不得超过项目批准估算成本的50%。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 470.2 (Document p. 160, PDF p. 183)

question_en: A contractor applicant received formal discipline from an out-of-state licensing board three years ago. Under what condition can CSLB deny the license based on that discipline?
question_cn: 三年前，一名承包商申请人因外州许可委员会的正式纪律处分而受到处罚。在什么情况下 CSLB 可以基于该纪律处分拒绝发放执照？

options.en: Only if the out-of-state board notifies CSLB directly
options.cn: 只有在外州委员会直接通知 CSLB 时

options.en: If substantially related to contracting duties and within seven years
options.cn: 如果与承包职责有实质关联并且在七年内

options.en: Only if the applicant was also convicted of a crime
options.cn: 只有在申请人也被判定犯罪时

options.en: Never — out-of-state discipline cannot affect California licensure
options.cn: 永远不会——外州纪律处分不会影响加利福尼亚州的执照申请

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 480(a)(2) allows denial when an applicant has been subjected to formal discipline by a board in or outside California within the preceding seven years, based on misconduct substantially related to the qualifications and duties of contracting.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第480(a)(2)条规定，如果申请人在过去七年内因与承包资质和职责实质相关的不当行为而受到加州内外委员会的正式纪律处分，可以拒绝其申请。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 480(a)(2) (Document p. 167, PDF p. 190)

question_en: When a county wants to change its distribution amount from superior court filing fees for dispute resolution programs, when may that change take effect?
question_cn: 当一个县想要更改用于争议解决项目的高等法院提交费分配金额时，该更改何时生效？

options.en: The first day of any fiscal quarter
options.cn: 任何财政季度的第一天

options.en: January 1 or July 1 of any year
options.cn: 任何年份的1月1日或7月1日

options.en: On any date after board of supervisors approval
options.cn: 在获得县监督委员会批准后的任何日期

options.en: Immediately upon filing with the Administrative Office of Courts
options.cn: 向法院行政办公室提交后立即生效

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 470.5(d) specifies that a county may make distribution changes effective only on January 1 or July 1 of any year, and must provide the Administrative Office of the Courts with the board of supervisors' action at least 15 days before the change takes effect.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第470.5(d)条规定，县只能在任何年份的1月1日或7月1日使分配更改生效，并且必须在更改生效前至少15天向法院行政办公室提供县监督委员会的行动通知。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 470.5(d) (Document p. 161, PDF p. 184)

question_en: A licensing board wants to require all contractor applicants to disclose their full criminal conviction history on the application. Under B&P Code Section 480, which of the following is true?
question_cn: 一个许可委员会希望要求所有承包商申请人在申请表上披露其完整的刑事定罪历史。根据《加州商业与职业法典》第480条，下列哪项陈述是正确的？

options.en: Only boards in the listed chapters may require disclosure
options.cn: 只有列出章节中的委员会可以要求披露

options.en: No board may require criminal history disclosure at all
options.cn: 任何委员会都不得要求披露刑事历史

options.en: Boards may require disclosure only for felony convictions
options.cn: 委员会只能要求披露重罪定罪

options.en: All boards may freely require full conviction disclosure
options.cn: 所有委员会都可以自由要求披露全部定罪记录

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 480(f)(1) authorizes only specific boards — those issuing licenses under listed chapters — to require criminal conviction disclosure on applications. Section 480(f)(2) prohibits other boards from requiring such disclosure, though they may request mitigating information voluntarily.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第480(f)(1)条仅授权特定委员会——即根据列出章节发放执照的委员会——在申请表上要求披露刑事定罪。第480(f)(2)条禁止其他委员会要求此类披露，但他们可以自愿要求提供减轻信息。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 480(f)(1) and (f)(2) (Document p. 169, PDF p. 192)

question_en: An applicant whose license was denied receives a notice of denial from the board. Within how many days must the applicant submit a written hearing request to preserve that right?
question_cn: 被拒绝执照的申请人会收到委员会发出的拒绝通知。申请人必须在多少天内提交书面听证请求以保留该权利？

options.en: Within 45 days after service of the notice
options.cn: 通知送达后45天内

options.en: Within 90 days after service of the notice
options.cn: 通知送达后90天内

options.en: Within 30 days after service of the notice
options.cn: 通知送达后30天内

options.en: Within 60 days after service of the notice
options.cn: 通知送达后60天内

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 485(b) states that the applicant must make a written request for hearing within 60 days after service of the notice of denial, or the right to a hearing is deemed waived.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第485(b)条规定，申请人必须在收到拒绝通知后的60天内提出书面听证请求，否则听证权利将被视为放弃。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 485(b) (Document p. 174, PDF p. 197)

question_en: After a license applicant requests a hearing following denial, within how many days must the board conduct that hearing?
question_cn: 在执照申请人在被拒后请求听证会后，委员会必须在多少天内进行该听证会？

options.en: Within 60 days of the request
options.cn: 在请求后的60天内

options.en: Within 30 days of the request
options.cn: 在请求后的30天内

options.en: Within 90 days of the request
options.cn: 在请求后的90天内

options.en: Within 45 days of the request
options.cn: 在请求后的45天内

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 487 requires the board to conduct the hearing within 90 days from the date the hearing is requested, unless the applicant agrees in writing to a postponement.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第487条规定，委员会必须在收到听证请求之日起90天内进行听证会，除非申请人书面同意延期。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 487 (Document p. 174, PDF p. 197)

question_en: A contractor's license application is denied. The board's notice is silent about when the applicant may reapply. Under state law, what is the earliest the applicant may reapply?
question_cn: 承包商执照申请被拒绝。董事会的通知未说明申请人何时可以重新申请。根据州法律，申请人最早什么时候可以重新申请？

options.en: Six months after the denial decision
options.cn: 拒绝决定后六个月

options.en: Immediately, after submitting new evidence
options.cn: 立即，在提交新证据后

options.en: One year after the denial decision
options.cn: 拒绝决定后一年

options.en: Two years after the denial decision
options.cn: 拒绝决定后两年

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 486 states the earliest reapplication date is one year from the effective date of the decision or service of the notice, unless the board sets an earlier date or another statute prescribes a later one.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第486条规定，最早的重新申请日期是从决定生效日期或通知送达之日起算的一年，除非董事会设定了更早的日期或其他法规规定了更晚的日期。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 486 (Document p. 175, PDF p. 198)

question_en: When a board issues an interim license suspension order without prior notice to the licensee, within how many days must the licensee receive a hearing on that order?
question_cn: 当一个委员会在未事先通知持牌人的情况下发出临时执照暂停令时，持牌人必须在多少天内获得该命令的听证会？

options.en: Within 20 days of the order
options.cn: 命令发布后的20天内

options.en: Within 5 business days of the order
options.cn: 命令发布后的5个工作日内

options.en: Within 10 days of the order
options.cn: 命令发布后的10天内

options.en: Within 15 days of the order
options.cn: 命令发布后的15天内

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 494(c) requires that when an interim order is issued without notice, the licensee is entitled to a hearing within 20 days of issuance. Failure to provide it dissolves the order by operation of law.
explanation_cn: 《职业与商业法》第494(c)条规定，当发出临时命令而未通知时，持牌人有权在命令发布后的20天内举行听证会。未提供听证会将依法使该命令失效。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 494(c) (Document p. 178, PDF p. 201)

question_en: A board issues an interim suspension order against a licensee. Within how many days must the board file an accusation to keep the interim order in effect?
question_cn: 委员会对持证人发布临时停牌命令。委员会必须在多少天内提交控告书以使临时命令继续有效？

options.en: Within 20 days of the interim order
options.cn: 临时命令发布后20天内

options.en: Within 5 days of the interim order
options.cn: 临时命令发布后5天内

options.en: Within 30 days of the interim order
options.cn: 临时命令发布后30天内

options.en: Within 15 days of the interim order
options.cn: 临时命令发布后15天内

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 494(f) requires the board to file an accusation within 15 days of issuance of the interim order. Failure to do so dissolves the interim order by operation of law.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第494(f)条要求委员会在临时命令发布后15天内提交控告书。未能在规定时间内提交的，临时命令将依法自动解除。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 494(f) (Document p. 179, PDF p. 202)

question_en: Under what circumstance may a board deny a license application WITHOUT holding a hearing?
question_cn: 在什么情况下，委员会可以在不举行听证会的情况下拒绝许可申请？

options.en: When the board determines the applicant lacks good moral character
options.cn: 当委员会认定申请人缺乏良好的道德品质时

options.en: Whenever the applicant has any prior felony conviction
options.cn: 每当申请人有任何前科重罪记录时

options.en: When the applicant failed to disclose prior denials
options.cn: 当申请人未披露以前的拒绝情况时

options.en: When denied on the same ground within the past year
options.cn: 当在过去一年因同一原因被拒绝时

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 489 allows a board to deny an application without a hearing when, within the preceding one year, it denied an application from the same applicant on the same ground after proper proceedings.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第489条允许委员会在前一年内，经过适当程序后，基于同一原因拒绝过同一申请人的申请时，无需举行听证会即可拒绝申请。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 489 (Document p. 176, PDF p. 199)

question_en: A board is evaluating whether a prior conviction justifies denying a contractor's license application. Which of the following factors does the law NOT require the board to consider?
question_cn: 一个委员会正在评估先前的定罪是否足以拒绝承包商的执照申请。法律不要求委员会考虑以下哪一因素？

options.en: The number of years since the offense
options.cn: 违法行为发生至今的年数

options.en: The nature and gravity of the offense
options.cn: 违法行为的性质和严重性

options.en: The nature and duties of the licensed profession
options.cn: 执照职业的性质和职责

options.en: The applicant's current financial net worth
options.cn: 申请人的当前净资产

explanation_en: Section 481(b) lists only three criteria: nature and gravity of the offense, years elapsed, and the nature and duties of the profession. Financial net worth is not among them.
explanation_cn: 第481(b)条仅列出了三个标准：违法行为的性质和严重性、经过的年数以及职业的性质和职责。财务净资产不包括在内。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 481(b) (Document p. 173, PDF p. 196)

question_en: An applicant with a prior felony conviction submits a license application. Under what condition may the board NOT deny the license based solely on that felony?
question_cn: 有前科重罪记录的申请人提交了执照申请。在什么情况下委员会不得仅仅基于该重罪拒绝发放执照？

options.en: The applicant obtained a certificate of rehabilitation
options.cn: 申请人已获得康复证书

options.en: The felony is unrelated to the licensed profession
options.cn: 重罪与所申请的职业无关

options.en: The applicant completed probation without violations
options.cn: 申请人在没有违规的情况下完成了考察期

options.en: More than ten years have passed since sentencing
options.cn: 自判刑已过去超过十年

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 480.2(b) states a person shall not be denied a license solely on the basis of a felony conviction if that person has obtained a certificate of rehabilitation under Penal Code Section 4852.01.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第480.2(b)条规定，如果某人根据《刑法》第4852.01条获得了康复证书，则不得仅以重罪定罪为理由拒绝其申请执照。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 480.2(b) (Document p. 171, PDF p. 194)

question_en: A board is conducting a disciplinary proceeding and presents a certified record of the licensee's criminal conviction. What is the legal effect of that record as evidence?
question_cn: 一个董事会正在进行纪律程序，并出示了被许可人的刑事定罪的认证记录。该记录作为证据的法律效力是什么？

options.en: Conclusive proof that the conviction occurred, and only that
options.cn: 该定罪发生的确定性证明，仅此而已

options.en: Conclusive proof of guilt and unfitness to hold a license
options.cn: 有罪及不适合持有执照的确定性证明

options.en: Rebuttable presumption that the crime is substantially related
options.cn: 可反驳的推定，即该犯罪与职业密切相关

options.en: Prima facie evidence that the licensee committed misconduct
options.cn: 对被许可人不当行为的初步证据

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 493(a) states the record of conviction is conclusive evidence of the fact that the conviction occurred, but only of that fact. Other inferences must be independently established.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第493(a)条规定，定罪记录是该定罪事实的确凿证据，但仅限于该事实。其他推论必须独立证明。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 493(a) (Document p. 177, PDF p. 200)

question_en: A board suspends a contractor's license. Which of the following must the board send to the former licensee at the time of suspension?
question_cn: 一个委员会暂停承包商的执照。委员会在暂停时必须向前执照持有人发送以下哪项内容？

options.en: A written offer of a settlement agreement
options.cn: 一份书面和解协议提议

options.en: A copy of the board's internal investigation file
options.cn: 委员会内部调查文件的副本

options.en: Notice of the earliest date for reinstatement
options.cn: 恢复执照的最早日期通知

options.en: Copies of Government Code Section 11522 and rehabilitation criteria
options.cn: 《政府法典》第11522条和康复标准的副本

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 491 requires the board to send the ex-licensee a copy of Government Code Section 11522 (reinstatement rights) and a copy of the rehabilitation criteria formulated under Section 482.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第491条要求委员会向前执照持有人发送《政府法典》第11522条（恢复权利）副本以及根据第482条制定的康复标准副本。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 491 (Document p. 177, PDF p. 200)

question_en: A board can suspend a contractor's license for failure to comply with a child support order. Under which code does this authority arise?
question_cn: 委员会可以暂停承包商的执照，若其未能遵守子女抚养令。这一权限依据哪个法规产生？

options.en: The Penal Code, Section 1203.4
options.cn: 刑法典，第1203.4条

options.en: The Family Code, Section 17520
options.cn: 家庭法典，第17520条

options.en: The Government Code, Section 11522
options.cn: 政府法典，第11522条

options.en: The Labor Code, relating to wage garnishment
options.cn: 劳动法典，关于工资扣押的规定

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 490.5 expressly authorizes a board to suspend a license pursuant to Family Code Section 17520 when a licensee is not in compliance with a child support order or judgment.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第490.5条明确授权委员会在执照持有人未遵守子女抚养令或判决时，根据家庭法典第17520条暂停其执照。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 490.5; Family Code Section 17520 (Document p. 177, PDF p. 200)

question_en: A licensing board is considering denial of an application and has received evidence of rehabilitation from the applicant. Under what circumstance must the board treat the applicant as having made a showing of rehabilitation?
question_cn: 一个许可委员会正在考虑拒绝一份申请，并已收到申请人提交的康复证据。在什么情况下，委员会必须将申请人视为已显示出康复？

options.en: The applicant obtained a dismissal under Penal Code Section 1203.4
options.cn: 申请人根据《刑法》第1203.4条获得了撤销判决

options.en: The applicant submitted three letters of character reference
options.cn: 申请人提交了三封品行推荐信

options.en: The applicant has been crime-free for five or more years
options.cn: 申请人已经五年或以上未犯新罪

options.en: The applicant completed the sentence without parole or probation violations
options.cn: 申请人完成了刑期且未违反假释或考察期规定

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 482(b)(1) states the board shall consider the applicant rehabilitated if the applicant has completed the criminal sentence without a violation of parole or probation.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第482(b)(1)条规定，如果申请人在完成刑期过程中未违反假释或考察期，委员会应视申请人为已康复。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 482(b) (Document p. 173, PDF p. 196)

question_en: Which of the following licensing entities is expressly exempt from the rehabilitation criteria requirements of B&P Code Section 482?
question_cn: 以下哪一个许可实体明确豁免遵守《商务与职业法典》第482条的康复标准要求？

options.en: The Medical Board of California
options.cn: 加利福尼亚州医学委员会

options.en: The Bureau for Private Postsecondary Education
options.cn: 私立高等教育局

options.en: The Contractors State License Board
options.cn: 承包商州许可委员会

options.en: The Department of Real Estate
options.cn: 房地产部

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 482(c) explicitly states the section does not modify or affect the existing authority of the Bureau for Private Postsecondary Education, the State Athletic Commission, and the California Horse Racing Board.
explanation_cn: 《商务与职业法典》第482(c)条明确规定，本条款不修改或影响私立高等教育局、州运动委员会和加利福尼亚赛马委员会的现有权限。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 482(c) (Document p. 174, PDF p. 197)

question_en: An applicant is denied a license and the board issues a notice of denial. Along with that notice, what additional document must the board serve on the applicant?
question_cn: 申请人的执照被拒绝，董事会发出拒绝通知。除了该通知外，董事会还必须向申请人送达哪份附加文件？

options.en: A transcript of the denial hearing proceedings
options.cn: 拒绝听证会程序的记录

options.en: A copy of the investigating officer's report
