options.cn: 调查官报告的副本

options.en: A list of alternative licenses the applicant may pursue
options.cn: 申请人可申请的替代执照列表

options.en: A copy of the Section 482 rehabilitation criteria
options.cn: 第482条康复标准的副本

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 486 requires the board to serve a copy of the rehabilitation criteria formulated under Section 482 along with the denial decision or notice, so the applicant knows what is needed to reapply successfully.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第486条要求董事会在作出拒绝决定或通知时，同时送达根据第482条制定的康复标准副本，以便申请人了解重新申请成功所需的条件。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 486 (Document p. 175, PDF p. 198)

question_en: A board issues an interim suspension order without prior notice because serious public injury was imminent. Within how many days must the board notify the licensee of the subsequent hearing?
question_cn: 因为严重的公众伤害即将发生，委员会在未提前通知的情况下发布临时停牌令。委员会必须在多少天内通知持牌人随后的听证会？

options.en: Within 2 days of the interim order
options.cn: 在临时命令发布后的2天内

options.en: Within 15 days of the interim order
options.cn: 在临时命令发布后的15天内

options.en: Within 30 days of the interim order
options.cn: 在临时命令发布后的30天内

options.en: Within 5 days of the interim order
options.cn: 在临时命令发布后的5天内

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 494(c) requires that when an interim order is issued without notice, the licensee must be given notice of the hearing within two days after issuance of the initial interim order.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第494(c)条规定，当临时命令在未通知的情况下发布时，必须在初始临时命令发布后的两天内通知持牌人听证会时间。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 494(c) (Document p. 178, PDF p. 201)

question_en: A licensing entity sends a preliminary notice to a contractor on the certified tax delinquency list. Within what window of time after mailing that notice may the entity suspend or refuse to issue the contractor's license?
question_cn: 许可机构向列入认证税务拖欠名单的承包商发送初步通知。在邮寄该通知后多长时间内，该机构可以暂停或拒绝发放承包商执照？

options.en: No sooner than 90 days, no later than 120 days
options.cn: 不早于90天，不晚于120天

options.en: No sooner than 30 days, no later than 60 days
options.cn: 不早于30天，不晚于60天

options.en: No sooner than 60 days, no later than 90 days
options.cn: 不早于60天，不晚于90天

options.en: No sooner than 90 days, no later than 180 days
options.cn: 不早于90天，不晚于180天

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 494.5(f)(1) states that a licensing entity shall refuse to issue or suspend a license no sooner than 90 days and no later than 120 days after mailing the preliminary notice, unless a release has been received.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第494.5(f)(1)条规定，许可机构在邮寄初步通知后不得早于90天且不得晚于120天之前拒绝发放或暂停执照，除非已经收到豁免证明。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 494.5(f)(1) (Document p. 183, PDF p. 206)

question_en: Which of the following entities is specifically EXCLUDED from the definition of 'state governmental licensing entity' under B&P Code Section 494.5?
question_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第494.5条，下列哪个实体被明确排除在“州政府许可实体”的定义之外？

options.en: The State Bar of California
options.cn: 加利福尼亚州律师协会

options.en: The Department of Insurance
options.cn: 保险部

options.en: The Contractors State License Board
options.cn: 承包商州许可委员会

options.en: The Department of Real Estate
options.cn: 房地产部

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 494.5(b)(4) expressly states that 'State governmental licensing entity shall not include the Contractors State License Board,' carving out CSLB from the mandatory tax-delinquency suspension requirements.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第494.5(b)(4)条明确规定，“州政府许可实体不包括承包商州许可委员会”，将CSLB从强制税务拖欠暂停执照效力要求中排除。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 494.5(b)(4) (Document p. 182, PDF p. 205)

question_en: A contractor is on the certified tax delinquency list and wants to challenge the suspension of their license. Which of the following constitutes the SOLE administrative remedy available?
question_cn: 承包商在认证的税务拖欠名单上，并希望对其执照的暂停提出异议。以下哪项构成唯一可用的行政救济？

options.en: Filing a petition for writ of mandate in superior court
options.cn: 向高级法院提交命令状请愿书

options.en: Requesting a release under subdivision (h)
options.cn: 根据(h)款请求解除

options.en: Requesting a hearing before the licensing entity's board
options.cn: 请求在许可机构的董事会前举行听证会

options.en: Filing an appeal with the Office of Administrative Hearings
options.cn: 向行政听证办公室提出上诉

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 494.5(m) states that the process described in subdivision (h) -- requesting a release from the State Board of Equalization or Franchise Tax Board -- constitutes the sole administrative remedy for contesting suspension under this section.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第494.5(m)条规定，如(h)款所述的程序——向州平衡委员会或特许税务委员会请求解除——构成根据本条款对暂停进行抗辩的唯一行政救济。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 494.5(m) (Document p. 186, PDF p. 209)

question_en: A licensing entity receives a preliminary notice request for release from a contractor who is on the certified tax delinquency list. After receiving the release, a wrongful suspension occurred. Within how many business days must the entity purge the suspension from its public website?
question_cn: 一个许可机构收到一个来自位于认证税务拖欠名单上的承包商的解除预通知请求。在收到解除后，发生了错误的暂停。该机构必须在多少个工作日内从其公开网站上清除该暂停？

options.en: Within ten business days of the release
options.cn: 在解除后的十个工作日内

options.en: Within thirty days of the release
options.cn: 在解除后的三十天内

options.en: Within five business days of the release
options.cn: 在解除后的五个工作日内

options.en: Within three business days of the release
options.cn: 在解除后的三个工作日内

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 494.5(q)(3) requires that upon release from the certified list, the suspension or revocation shall be purged from the licensing entity's internet website or other publication within three business days.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 494.5(q)(3) 条规定，在从认证名单中解除后，暂停或吊销应在三个工作日内从许可机构的互联网网站或其他出版物上清除。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 494.5(q)(3) (Document p. 187, PDF p. 210)

question_en: A contractor licensed under the Business and Professions Code is found by the Labor Commissioner to have violated Labor Code Section 244(b). Which of the following factors must the Labor Commissioner consider before suspending or revoking the contractor's license?
question_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》持有执照的承包商，如果被劳工专员认定违反了《劳工法》第244(b)条款，劳工专员在暂停或吊销该承包商的执照之前必须考虑以下哪些因素？

options.en: Harm to employees and the licensee's good-faith resolution efforts
options.cn: 对员工的伤害以及执照持有人善意解决问题的努力

options.en: The financial impact on the contractor's business revenue
options.cn: 对承包商业务收入的财务影响

options.en: The contractor's prior disciplinary history with the CSLB
options.cn: 承包商在州承包商许可委员会（CSLB）之前的纪律记录

options.en: Whether the contractor holds a valid bond and insurance
options.cn: 承包商是否持有有效的保证金和保险

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 494.6(a) requires the court or Labor Commissioner to consider any harm such suspension or revocation would cause to employees of the licensee, as well as the good-faith efforts of the licensee to resolve alleged violations after receiving notice.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第494.6(a)条要求法院或劳工专员在决定暂停或吊销执照时，必须考虑此类暂停或吊销对执照持有人员工造成的任何伤害，以及执照持有人在收到违规通知后善意解决违规问题的努力。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 494.6(a) (Document p. 188, PDF p. 211)

question_en: Under B&P Code Section 494.6, which of the following actions does NOT expose an employer to license suspension or revocation?
question_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第494.6条，以下哪种行为不会导致雇主面临执照暂停或吊销？

options.en: Reporting an employee's immigration status to retaliate for a complaint
options.cn: 因员工投诉而报告其移民身份以进行报复

options.en: Retaliating against an employee who filed a wage complaint
options.cn: 对提出工资投诉的员工进行报复

options.en: Threatening to contact immigration authorities over a wage dispute
options.cn: 因工资纠纷威胁联系移民机构

options.en: Requiring a new hire to submit an I-9 form within three business days
options.cn: 要求新员工在三个工作日内提交I-9表格

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 494.6(c) expressly exempts employers from suspension or revocation for requiring a prospective or current employee to submit an I-9 Employment Eligibility Verification form within three business days of the first day of work for pay.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第494.6(c)条明确规定，雇主要求潜在或现有员工在首个工作日后三个工作日内提交I-9就业资格验证表，不会导致执照暂停或吊销。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 494.6(c) (Document p. 188, PDF p. 211)

question_en: A contractor obtains a license by deliberately omitting a prior felony conviction from the application. Under which code section may the CSLB revoke the contractor's license on this basis?
question_cn: 一名承包商通过在申请中故意隐瞒之前的重罪定罪而获得执照。根据哪一条法规，加州承包商州立委员会（CSLB）可基于此撤销承包商的执照？

options.en: B&P Code Section 495, public reproval procedures
options.cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》规第495条，公开谴责程序

options.en: B&P Code Section 496, subversion of licensing examinations
options.cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》规第496条，破坏执照考试

options.en: B&P Code Section 499, false statements on another's application
options.cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》规第499条，在他人申请上作虚假陈述

options.en: B&P Code Section 498, fraud or knowing omission of material fact
options.cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》规第498条，通过欺诈或故意遗漏重要事实

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 498 authorizes a board to revoke, suspend, or restrict a license if the licensee secured it by fraud, deceit, or knowing misrepresentation or by knowingly omitting to state a material fact, which fits this scenario exactly.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》规第498条授权委员会在执照持有人通过欺诈、欺骗、故意虚假陈述或故意遗漏重要事实获得执照的情况下，撤销、暂停或限制其执照，这正好符合本案例。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 498 (Document p. 189, PDF p. 212)

question_en: A qualifying individual vouches for a license applicant and knowingly omits a material fact about the applicant's prior disciplinary history. Under B&P Code Section 499, what action may the board take against the qualifying individual's own license?
question_cn: 一名资格认证人担保执照申请人，并故意遗漏申请人之前纪律处分历史的重要事实。根据《加州商业与职业法典》第499条，委员会可以对该资格认证人的执照采取什么措施？

options.en: Issue a public reproval only, no license action
options.cn: 仅发布公开谴责，不对执照采取措施

options.en: Only deny the applicant's license, no action against the supporter
options.cn: 仅拒绝申请人的执照，不对担保人采取措施

options.en: Place the qualifying individual on probation automatically
options.cn: 自动将资格认证人置于考察期

options.en: Revoke, suspend, or restrict the qualifying individual's license
options.cn: 吊销、暂停或限制资格认证人的执照

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 499 expressly authorizes the board to revoke, suspend, or otherwise restrict a licensee's own license when that licensee knowingly made a false statement or knowingly omitted a material fact in support of another person's license application.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第499条明确授权委员会在执照持有人在支持他人执照申请时故意作出虚假陈述或故意遗漏重要事实时，可吊销、暂停或以其他方式限制其自身的执照。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 499 (Document p. 189, PDF p. 212)

question_en: When an administrative law judge sits alone on a delegated petition for an interim order, when does the judge's decision become final?
question_cn: 当行政法法官单独审理委托的临时裁定申请时，该法官的裁定何时生效？

options.en: When the board votes to adopt the decision
options.cn: 当董事会投票通过该裁定时

options.en: After a 30-day appeal period expires
options.cn: 在30天上诉期满后

options.en: When the decision is filed with the board
options.cn: 当裁定提交给董事会备案时

options.en: When served on the licentiate by certified mail
options.cn: 当通过挂号信送达持证人时

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 494(h) states that a decision issued by an administrative law judge sitting alone shall be final when it is filed with the board -- no board vote or additional review is required.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第494(h)条规定，行政法法官单独作出的裁定在提交董事会备案时即生效——不需要董事会投票或额外审查。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 494(h) (Document p. 180, PDF p. 203)

question_en: A contractor violates an interim order issued against them before the noticed hearing on the accusation. Under B&P Code Section 494(i), what must be proven to establish the violation?
question_cn: 承包商在被通知的指控听证会之前违反了针对他们发布的临时命令。根据《加州商业与职业法典》第494(i)条，必须证明什么才能确立这种违规行为？

options.en: That the contractor caused harm to a client or the public
options.cn: 承包商对客户或公众造成了伤害

options.en: Willful intent and financial gain from the violation
options.cn: 对违规行为有故意意图并从中获利

options.en: Prior violations of the same interim order
options.cn: 之前违反了相同的临时命令

options.en: Notice of the order, its terms, and that it was in effect
options.cn: 收到该命令的通知、命令条款以及该命令正在生效

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 494(i) states that violation of the interim order is established upon proof that the licentiate was on notice of the interim order and its terms, and that the order was in effect at the time of the violation.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第494(i)条规定，一旦证明许可人已收到临时命令及其条款的通知，并且该命令在违规行为发生时有效，即可确定违规行为。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 494(i) (Document p. 180, PDF p. 203)

question_en: A contractor discovers that public information about a license suspension due to tax delinquency is displayed on the licensing entity's website. Under B&P Code Section 494.5(n), what must that disclosure specifically and prominently state?
question_cn: 一名承包商发现，由于税务拖欠而导致执照暂停的公共信息显示在发证机构的网站上。根据《加州商业与职业法典》第494.5(n)条，这种披露必须具体而显著地说明什么？

options.en: The name of the specific tax board that flagged the licensee
options.cn: 具体指出标记该持证人的税务委员会名称

options.en: The date the suspension will be lifted upon compliance
options.cn: 符合要求后解除暂停的日期

options.en: The license was suspended for unpaid taxes only
options.cn: 该执照仅因未缴税而被暂停

options.en: The amount of taxes owed and payment due date
options.cn: 所欠税款金额及支付截止日期

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 494.5(n) requires any licensing entity disclosing a tax-related suspension on its website to prominently disclose, in bold and adjacent to the license status, that the only reason the license was denied, suspended, or temporarily issued is because the licensee failed to pay taxes.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第494.5(n)条要求，任何在其网站上披露税务相关暂停情况的发证机构，必须显著地以粗体、并紧邻执照状态处披露，执照被拒、暂停或临时颁发的唯一原因是持证人未缴纳税款。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 494.5(n) (Document p. 186, PDF p. 209)

question_en: What is the highest priority for the Contractors State License Board when exercising its licensing and disciplinary functions?
question_cn: 在行使其许可和纪律职能时，加州承包商执照委员会（Contractors State License Board）的最高优先事项是什么？

options.en: Maintaining consistent enforcement of building codes
options.cn: 维持建筑规范的一致执行

options.en: Protection of the public
options.cn: 保护公众利益

options.en: Promoting growth of the construction industry
options.cn: 促进建筑行业的发展

options.en: Ensuring contractor profitability and business continuity
options.cn: 确保承包商的盈利能力和业务持续性

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7000.6 states that protection of the public shall be the highest priority for the CSLB in exercising its licensing, regulatory, and disciplinary functions.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7000.6条规定，在行使其许可、监管和纪律职能时，保护公众利益应为CSLB的最高优先事项。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7000.6 (Document p. 203, PDF p. 226)

question_en: How many members constitute a quorum at a CSLB board meeting?
question_cn: 在CSLB董事会会议上，多少成员构成法定人数？

options.en: Twelve members
options.cn: 十二名成员

options.en: Six members
options.cn: 六名成员

options.en: Eight members
options.cn: 八名成员

options.en: Ten members
options.cn: 十名成员

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7007 explicitly states that eight members constitute a quorum at a CSLB board meeting.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7007条明确规定，在CSLB董事会会议上，八名成员构成法定人数。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7007 (Document p. 205, PDF p. 228)

question_en: How many total members does the Contractors State License Board consist of?
question_cn: 承包商州许可证委员会总共有多少成员？

options.en: 18 members
options.cn: 18 名成员

options.en: 12 members
options.cn: 12 名成员

options.en: 15 members
options.cn: 15 名成员

options.en: 10 members
options.cn: 10 名成员

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7000.5(a) explicitly states the Contractors State License Board consists of 15 members.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 7000.5(a) 条明确规定，承包商州许可证委员会由 15 名成员组成。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7000.5 (Document p. 202, PDF p. 225)

question_en: A contractor has held an active CSLB board member seat for two full consecutive terms. What happens if the Governor wishes to reappoint this person to an additional term?
question_cn: 一名承包商已连续担任 CSLB 董事会成员两个完整任期。如果州长希望重新任命此人为额外任期，会发生什么？

options.en: The reappointment is prohibited by statute
options.cn: 法规禁止重新任命

options.en: The member may serve one additional partial term only
options.cn: 成员只能再服务一个额外的部分任期

options.en: The board must vote to approve the reappointment
options.cn: 董事会必须投票批准重新任命

options.en: Reappointment requires Senate confirmation first
options.cn: 重新任命须先经参议院确认

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7003 states that no person shall serve as a member of the board for more than two consecutive terms, making a third consecutive reappointment statutorily impermissible.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7003条规定，任何人不得连续担任董事会成员超过两个任期，因此连续第三次任命在法律上不允许。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7003 (Document p. 205, PDF p. 228)

question_en: Which of the following individuals would be disqualified from serving as a public member of the CSLB board?
question_cn: 以下哪一类人士将被取消资格，不能作为CSLB董事会的公众成员？

options.en: A close family member of a licensed contractor
options.cn: 持牌承包商的直系亲属

options.en: A member of a statewide senior citizen organization
options.cn: 全州老年人组织的成员

options.en: A retired teacher with no construction ties
options.cn: 与建筑无关的退休教师

options.en: A representative of a building trades labor organization
options.cn: 建筑行业工会组织的代表

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7002(b) explicitly disqualifies close family members of a licensee from serving as a public member of the CSLB board.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7002(b)条明确规定，持牌人的直系亲属不得作为CSLB董事会的公众成员。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7002(b) (Document p. 204, PDF p. 227)

question_en: A contractor member of the CSLB board retires from active contracting work mid-term. What does the law require?
question_cn: CSLB 董事会的一名承包商成员在任期中期退休，不再从事承包工作。法律有什么要求？

options.en: The member no longer meets the ongoing qualification requirement
options.cn: 该成员不再符合持续的资格要求

options.en: The board votes whether to retain the member
options.cn: 董事会投票决定是否保留该成员

options.en: The member continues until a replacement is confirmed
options.cn: 该成员将在确认替代人员之前继续任职

options.en: The member may finish the current term only
options.cn: 该成员只能完成当前任期

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7002(c) requires each contractor member to remain actively engaged in the contracting business during the entire term of membership. Retiring from active contracting removes a mandatory qualification.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 7002(c) 条规定，每位承包商成员在任期内必须持续积极从事承包业务。退休离开承包工作会导致失去强制性资格。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7002(c) (Document p. 204, PDF p. 227)

question_en: When a vacancy arises on the CSLB board due to the expiration of a contractor member's term, who must fill that seat?
question_cn: 当由于承包商成员任期届满而在CSLB董事会出现空缺时，谁必须填补该席位？

options.en: A contractor from the same branch of contracting
options.cn: 来自同一承包分支的承包商

options.en: Any licensed contractor chosen by the Governor
options.cn: 由州长选择的任何持牌承包商

options.en: A public member selected by the Senate Rules Committee
options.cn: 由参议院规则委员会选出的公众成员

options.en: Any contractor with five or more years of experience
options.cn: 具有五年或以上经验的任何承包商

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7003 states that a vacancy caused by term expiration shall be filled by a member from the same branch of the contracting business as the member whose term expired.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7003条规定，由于任期届满造成的空缺，应由与任期届满成员所属承包分支相同的成员填补。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7003 (Document p. 204, PDF p. 227)

question_en: A city refuses to issue a building permit to a licensed contractor who has not paid the city's local business tax. Is this action permissible under state law?
question_cn: 如果一名持牌承包商未缴纳本地商业税，某城市拒绝向其发放建筑许可。这一行为在州法律下是否合法？

options.en: No, only the CSLB may discipline licensed contractors
options.cn: 不，只有加州承包商州立委员会（CSLB）可以对持牌承包商进行纪律处分

options.en: Yes, but only if the tax does not exceed statutory limits
options.cn: 是的，但前提是税额不超过法定限额

options.en: Yes, with no restrictions on the tax amount charged
options.cn: 是的，对收取的税额没有限制

options.en: No, a state license supersedes local tax obligations
options.cn: 不，州执照优先于地方税务义务

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7000.2 allows cities to deny permits to licensed contractors not in compliance with local business taxes, provided the tax does not exceed the amount authorized by Government Code Section 37101 or B&P Code Section 16000.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7000.2条允许城市拒绝向未遵守地方商业税规定的持牌承包商发放许可，前提是税额不超过《政府法典》第37101条或《加州商业与职业法典》第16000条授权的金额。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7000.2 (Document p. 202, PDF p. 225)

question_en: How often is the CSLB board required to hold regularly scheduled meetings?
question_cn: CSLB委员会需要多久举行一次定期会议？

options.en: At least once per month
options.cn: 每月至少一次

options.en: Twice per year at minimum
options.cn: 每年至少两次

options.en: At least once each calendar quarter
options.cn: 每个日历季度至少一次

options.en: Once per year as determined by the board
options.cn: 由委员会决定，每年至少一次

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7006 requires the board to meet at least once each calendar quarter for the purpose of transacting business.
explanation_cn: 《商业与专业法规》第7006条要求委员会每个日历季度至少举行一次会议以处理事务。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7006 (Document p. 205, PDF p. 228)

question_en: Under what circumstances may a special meeting of the CSLB board be called without waiting for the next scheduled quarterly meeting?
question_cn: 在什么情况下可以召集CSLB董事会的特别会议，而不必等待下一个预定的季度会议？

options.en: When eight or more members submit a written request
options.cn: 当八名或更多成员提交书面请求时

options.en: When four members of the board call for one
options.cn: 当董事会的四名成员要求召开会议时

options.en: Only when authorized by the Director of Consumer Affairs
options.cn: 仅在消费者事务主任授权时

options.en: When the Registrar determines an emergency exists
options.cn: 当注册主任确定存在紧急情况时

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7006 states that four members of the board may call a special meeting at any time, in addition to the regularly scheduled quarterly meetings.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7006条规定，董事会的四名成员可以在任何时候召开特别会议，此外还有定期安排的季度会议。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7006 (Document p. 205, PDF p. 228)

question_en: A CSLB board member is removed mid-term for misconduct. How long is the replacement member's appointment?
question_cn: 一名CSLB董事会成员因不当行为在任期中被免职。替补成员的任期是多长时间？

options.en: The remainder of the unexpired term only
options.cn: 仅剩未届满的任期

options.en: One year, subject to board renewal
options.cn: 一年，须经董事会续任

options.en: A full new four-year term
options.cn: 新的完整四年任期

options.en: A two-year interim term pending confirmation
options.cn: 两年临时任期，待确认

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7003 states that vacancies occurring in board membership for any cause shall be filled by appointment for the balance of the unexpired term -- not a new full term.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7003条规定，因任何原因造成的董事会成员空缺应通过任命填补未届满的剩余任期，而非新的完整任期。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7003 (Document p. 204, PDF p. 227)

question_en: Which of the following individuals would NOT meet the minimum qualifications to serve as a contractor member of the CSLB board?
question_cn: 以下哪位个人不符合担任CSLB董事会承包商成员的最低资格？

options.en: A contractor with an active license and six years' experience
options.cn: 一位持有有效执照且有六年经验的承包商

options.en: A licensed contractor who moved to California two years ago
options.cn: 一位两年前搬到加利福尼亚州的持证承包商

options.en: A 35-year-old contractor with eight years of experience
options.cn: 一位有八年经验的35岁承包商

options.en: A 31-year-old contractor actively engaged for five years
options.cn: 一位有五年从业经验的31岁承包商

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7002(d) requires each board member to have been a citizen and resident of California for at least five years preceding appointment. Two years of residency does not satisfy this requirement.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7002(d)条要求每位董事会成员在被任命前至少成为加利福尼亚州的公民并居住五年。两年的居住时间不满足此要求。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7001; B&P Code Section 7002(c)(d) (Document p. 203, PDF p. 226)

question_en: Who has authority to remove a member of the CSLB board for neglect of duty?
question_cn: 谁有权因失职而罢免CSLB董事会成员？

options.en: The Director of the Department of Consumer Affairs
options.cn: 消费者事务部主任

options.en: The Governor, for misconduct or incompetency
options.cn: 州长，因不当行为或无能

options.en: A two-thirds vote of the board itself
options.cn: 董事会本身以三分之二多数票

options.en: The Senate Rules Committee by resolution
options.cn: 参议院规则委员会通过决议

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7005 states that the Governor may remove any member of the board for misconduct, incompetency, or neglect of duty.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7005条规定，州长可以因不当行为、无能或失职而罢免任何董事会成员。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7005 (Document p. 205, PDF p. 228)

question_en: The CSLB board wants to adopt new rules to streamline the license application process. Which procedural requirement must the board follow?
question_cn: CSLB 董事会希望采纳新规则以简化许可证申请流程。董事会必须遵循哪项程序性要求？

options.en: Rules require a unanimous board vote to be valid
options.cn: 规则要求董事会一致投票才能有效

options.en: Rules take effect only after Legislative confirmation
options.cn: 规则只有在立法确认后才生效

options.en: Rules must comply with the Administrative Procedure Act
options.cn: 规则必须符合《行政程序法》

options.en: Rules must be approved by the Governor's office first
options.cn: 规则必须首先获得州长办公室批准

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7008 states that rules and regulations made by the board shall be adopted in accordance with the provisions of the Administrative Procedure Act.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 7008 条规定，董事会制定的规则和规章应根据《行政程序法》的规定予以采纳。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7008 (Document p. 206, PDF p. 229)

question_en: A contractor serving on the CSLB board lets their contractor's license expire during their term. Which statement best describes the legal consequence?
question_cn: 一名在CSLB董事会任职的承包商在其任期内让其承包商执照过期。哪种说法最能描述其法律后果？

options.en: The board votes on whether to grant an exception
options.cn: 董事会投票决定是否批准例外

options.en: They have 30 days to renew before losing eligibility
options.cn: 他们有30天时间续证，否则将失去资格

options.en: They may remain until the next scheduled board election
options.cn: 他们可以一直任职至下次定期董事会选举

options.en: They no longer satisfy a mandatory ongoing eligibility requirement
options.cn: 他们不再满足强制的持续资格要求

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7001 requires that no one shall be eligible for appointment who does not hold an unexpired license, and Section 7002(c) requires contractor members to hold an unexpired license throughout their term. An expired license removes a mandatory qualification.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7001条规定，任何未持有有效执照的人均无资格被任命，第7002(c)条规定承包商成员在其任期内必须持有有效执照。执照过期会导致失去强制性资格。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7001; B&P Code Section 7002(c) (Document p. 203, PDF p. 226)

question_en: A licensed contractor has already been assessed a civil penalty by the Labor Commissioner for an overtime violation. Can the CSLB Registrar also assess a civil penalty for the same offense?
question_cn: 一名持牌承包商因加班违规已被劳动专员评估了民事罚款。CSLB 注册主任是否也可以针对同一违法行为评估民事罚款？

options.en: Yes, but only if the penalty amount differs
options.cn: 可以，但仅在罚款金额有所不同的情况下

options.en: No, the Registrar cannot impose a duplicate penalty
options.cn: 不可以，注册主任不能重复处以罚款

options.en: No, unless the board votes to override the Registrar
options.cn: 不可以，除非委员会投票决定推翻注册主任

options.en: Yes, each agency may impose its own penalty
options.cn: 可以，每个机构都可以自行处以罚款

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7011.3 prohibits the Registrar from assessing a civil penalty against a licensed contractor who has already been assessed a specified civil penalty by the Labor Commissioner under Labor Code Section 1020 or 1022 for the same offense.
explanation_cn: 商业与职业法典第 7011.3 条禁止注册主任对已根据劳动法第 1020 条或 1022 条因同一违法行为而被劳动专员评估过特定民事罚款的持牌承包商再次评估民事罚款。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7011.3 (Document p. 207, PDF p. 230)

question_en: Which of the following persons employed by the CSLB has the full authority of a peace officer while investigating violations of contractor licensing laws?
question_cn: 以下哪一类由CSLB雇佣的人在调查承包商执照法的违规行为时，拥有完全的治安官权力？

options.en: Special investigators authorized to issue citations only
options.cn: 仅被授权发出罚单的特别调查员

options.en: Special Investigations Unit investigators, when duly designated
options.cn: 在正式指定时的特别调查小组调查员

options.en: Any CSLB enforcement division employee
options.cn: 任何CSLB执法部门的员工

options.en: Investigators designated by the Director of Consumer Affairs
options.cn: 由消费者事务主任指定的调查员

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7011.5 grants peace officer authority specifically to persons employed as investigators of the Special Investigations Unit and designated by the Director of Consumer Affairs, while engaged in their investigative duties.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7011.5条明文授予特别调查小组的调查员，并经消费者事务主任指定的人在执行调查职务期间享有治安官权力。
code_reference: B&P Code Sections 7011.4 and 7011.5 (Document p. 208, PDF p. 231)

question_en: The CSLB board has set a goal for completing the investigation of most complaints. What is that target timeframe?
question_cn: CSLB委员会已经设定了完成大多数投诉调查的目标。那个目标时间范围是多少？

options.en: An average of no more than three months
options.cn: 平均不超过三个月

options.en: An average of no more than one year
options.cn: 平均不超过一年

options.en: An average of no more than nine months
options.cn: 平均不超过九个月

options.en: An average of no more than six months
options.cn: 平均不超过六个月

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7011.7(b) establishes a board goal that an average of no more than six months elapses from receipt of a complaint to completion of the investigation.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7011.7(b)条规定，委员会的目标是从收到投诉到完成调查的平均时间不超过六个月。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7011.7 (Document p. 208, PDF p. 231)

question_en: A complaint filed with the CSLB involves an unusually complex fraud scheme spanning multiple contracts. What is the board's goal for completing this type of investigation?
question_cn: 向 CSLB 提交的投诉涉及跨多个合同的异常复杂的欺诈计划。董事会完成此类调查的目标是什么？

options.en: No more than six months from receipt
options.cn: 自收到起不超过六个月

options.en: No more than two years from receipt
options.cn: 自收到起不超过两年

options.en: No more than one year from receipt
options.cn: 自收到起不超过一年

options.en: No more than eighteen months from receipt
options.cn: 自收到起不超过十八个月

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7011.7(c) provides that the goal for completing review and investigation of complaints involving complex fraud issues or complex contractual arrangements should be no more than one year.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 7011.7(c) 条规定，完成涉及复杂欺诈问题或复杂合同安排的投诉审查和调查的目标应不超过一年。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7011.7(c) (Document p. 208, PDF p. 231)

question_en: A licensed contractor knowingly files a false complaint with the CSLB against a competitor. Which of the following correctly describes the consequence under B&P Code Section 7011.8?
question_cn: 持牌承包商明知地向CSLB对竞争对手提出虚假投诉。根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7011.8条，下列哪项正确描述了其后果？

options.en: A civil lawsuit filed by the wrongly accused licensee
options.cn: 被错误指控的持牌人提起民事诉讼

options.en: Mandatory referral to the Attorney General only
options.cn: 仅强制提交给总检察长

options.en: A citation may be issued by the Registrar
options.cn: 注册主任可发出处罚通知

options.en: Automatic license revocation by the Registrar
options.cn: 注册主任自动吊销执照

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7011.8(a) provides that any person subject to licensure who knowingly files a false complaint against a licensee may be issued a citation by the Registrar. The board may also notify the appropriate district attorney or city attorney under subdivision (b).
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7011.8(a)条规定，任何受执照管辖的人若明知地对持牌人提出虚假投诉，注册主任可向其发出处罚通知。根据(b)款，委员会也可通知相关的地区检察官或市检察官。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7011.8 (Document p. 208, PDF p. 231)

question_en: The CSLB board disagrees with a decision made by the Registrar in a disciplinary proceeding. What authority does the board have?
question_cn: CSLB委员会不同意注册主任在纪律程序中做出的决定。委员会拥有什么权力？

options.en: The board may override by unanimous vote only
options.cn: 委员会只能通过一致投票推翻

options.en: The board may only delay, not reverse, the decision
options.cn: 委员会只能延迟，而不能推翻决定

options.en: The board may sustain or reverse by majority vote
options.cn: 委员会可以通过多数票维持或推翻

options.en: The board must refer the matter to the Director
options.cn: 委员会必须将此事提交给主任

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7013 provides that the board may in its discretion review and sustain or reverse by a majority vote any action or decision of the Registrar made in accordance with Government Code Chapter 5 proceedings.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7013条规定，委员会可自行决定以多数票审查并维持或推翻注册主任根据《政府法典》第5章程序所作的任何行为或决定。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7013 (Document p. 209, PDF p. 232)

question_en: Under B&P Code Section 7026, which of the following activities would NOT be considered contracting work requiring a license?
question_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7026条，以下哪项活动不被视为需要执照的承包工作？

options.en: A consultant who arranges work schedules for subcontractors
options.cn: 安排分包商工作时间表的顾问

options.en: Erecting scaffolding at a commercial construction site
options.cn: 在商业建筑工地搭建脚手架

options.en: A gardener pruning trees under 15 feet tall
options.cn: 修剪高度不超过15英尺的树木的园丁

options.en: Installing monitoring equipment for underground storage tanks
options.cn: 安装地下储罐监测设备

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7026.1(a)(4) expressly excludes a gardener who in the normal course of routine work performs incidental pruning of trees measuring less than 15 feet in height after planting from the definition of 'contractor.'
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7026.1(a)(4)条明确排除了在日常工作中对栽种后高度不足15英尺的树木进行偶发修剪的园丁，园丁不属于“承包商”的定义范围。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7026 and 7026.1 (Document p. 214, PDF p. 237)

question_en: A temporary labor service agency provides construction workers to a jobsite. Under what condition is the agency NOT required to hold a contractor's license?
question_cn: 临时劳务服务机构为工地提供建筑工人。在什么情况下该机构不需要持有承包商执照？

options.en: When a licensed contractor supervises and takes responsibility
options.cn: 当有持证承包商进行监督并承担责任时

options.en: When the agency has its own general liability insurance
options.cn: 当该机构有自己的综合责任保险时

options.en: When the agency employs fewer than five workers
options.cn: 当该机构雇佣的工人少于五人时

options.en: When workers perform only unskilled labor tasks
options.cn: 当工人只执行非技术劳动任务时

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7026.1(a)(3) provides that the licensing requirement does not apply to a temporary labor service agency if a properly licensed contractor exercises supervision per Section 7068.1 and is directly responsible for the final results of the work.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7026.1(a)(3)条规定，如果持证承包商按照第7068.1条进行监督并对工作最终结果直接负责，临时劳务服务机构无需遵守许可要求。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7026.1(a)(3) (Document p. 214, PDF p. 237)

question_en: A mobilehome manufacturer performs onsite construction and alterations to a mobilehome pursuant to specialized plans. Must the manufacturer hold a contractor's license?
question_cn: 一家移动房屋制造商根据专门设计的计划在现场进行移动房屋的施工和改造。该制造商是否必须持有承包商执照？

options.en: No, manufacturers are always exempt from licensing
options.cn: 不，制造商始终免于持证要求

options.en: No, warranty work exempts them from licensing requirements
options.cn: 不，保修工作使他们免于持证要求

options.en: Yes, onsite specialized work classifies them as a contractor
options.cn: 是的，现场专门工作将其分类为承包商

options.en: Yes, but only if hired directly by the homeowner
options.cn: 是的，但仅在直接受房主雇用时

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7026.2(b) provides that 'contractor' includes the manufacturer when engaged in onsite construction, alteration, or repair of a mobilehome pursuant to specialized plans, specifications, or models, or any work beyond warranty compliance.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7026.2(b)条规定，当制造商根据专门的计划、规格或模型，或进行超出保修范围的工作从事移动房屋的现场施工、改造或修理时，‘承包商’包括该制造商。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7026.2(b) (Document p. 216, PDF p. 239)

question_en: Which of the following persons is specifically defined as a 'qualifying individual' under B&P Code Section 7025?
question_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7025条，下列哪一类人被明确界定为“合格个人”？

options.en: A person who qualifies for a license under Section 7068
options.cn: 根据第7068条符合执照资格的人

options.en: Any officer or director of a licensed corporation
options.cn: 持有执照公司的任何高级职员或董事

options.en: Any individual who holds a valid CSLB license
options.cn: 持有有效CSLB执照的任何个人

options.en: Every person listed in the registrar's records
options.cn: 登记处记录中列出的每个人

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7025(c) defines 'qualifying person,' 'qualifying individual,' or 'qualifier' as a person who qualifies for a license pursuant to Section 7068.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7025(c)条将“合格人”、“合格个人”或“资格人”定义为根据第7068条获得执照资格的人。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7025(c) (Document p. 213, PDF p. 236)

question_en: The CSLB board is authorized to contract with outside licensed professionals for which of the following purposes?
question_cn: CSLB 董事会被授权与外部持牌专业人士签约，以实现以下哪种目的？

options.en: Writing examination questions for license applicants
options.cn: 为执照申请者编写考试题目

options.en: Site investigation of consumer complaints
options.cn: 对消费者投诉进行现场调查

options.en: Conducting mandatory arbitration between parties
options.cn: 在各方之间进行强制仲裁

options.en: Issuing citations directly to unlicensed contractors
options.cn: 直接向无牌承包商发出传票

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7019(a) authorizes the board to contract with licensed professionals — including engineers, architects, geologists, and accountants — for the site investigation of consumer complaints, when funding is available.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 7019(a) 条授权董事会在有资金可用时，与包括工程师、建筑师、地质学家和会计师在内的持牌专业人士签约，对消费者投诉进行现场调查。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7019 (Document p. 212, PDF p. 235)

question_en: A federally recognized tribe located in California wishes to obtain a contractor's license from the CSLB. Under B&P Code Section 7025.1, which of the following is true?
question_cn: 位于加利福尼亚的一个联邦认可部落希望从 CSLB 获得承包商执照。根据 《加州商业与职业法典》第 7025.1 条，以下哪项是正确的？

options.en: Tribal immunity waives all bond and insurance requirements
options.cn: 部落豁免免除所有保证金和保险要求

options.en: The board shall license the tribe if it meets chapter requirements
options.cn: 如果符合章节要求，委员会应给予部落执照

options.en: Tribes are exempt from all CSLB licensing requirements
options.cn: 部落免除所有 CSLB 执照要求

options.en: The board gains regulatory authority over tribal lands
options.cn: 委员会获得对部落土地的监管权

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7025.1(b) mandates that the board shall license a federally recognized tribe that applies under Section 7065 and is otherwise compliant with the provisions of the contractor licensing chapter.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 7025.1(b) 条规定，委员会应向根据第 7065 条申请且符合承包商执照章节规定的联邦认可部落发放执照。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7025.1 (Document p. 213, PDF p. 236)

question_en: A CSLB special investigator designated under Section 7011.4 discovers an unlicensed contractor actively working on a project. What authority does that investigator have on the spot?
question_cn: 根据第7011.4条款指定的CSLB特别调查员发现一名无牌承包商正在项目上工作。该调查员在现场具有何种权限？

options.en: Immediately arrest the unlicensed contractor on site
options.cn: 立即在现场逮捕无牌承包商

options.en: Issue a stop-work order and fine the contractor
options.cn: 发布停工令并对承包商罚款

options.en: Revoke the contractor's registration immediately
options.cn: 立即吊销承包商的注册

options.en: Issue a written notice to appear in court
options.cn: 发布书面出庭通知

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7011.4(b) authorizes CSLB special investigators designated by the Director of Consumer Affairs to issue a written notice to appear in court pursuant to Penal Code Chapter 5C, Section 853.5.
explanation_cn: 《工商与职业法》第7011.4(b)条授权消费者事务局局长指定的CSLB特别调查员根据《刑法》第5C章第853.5条发出书面出庭通知。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7011.4(b) (Document p. 207, PDF p. 230)

question_en: Which of the following tree-related activities would require the person performing it to hold a contractor's license under B&P Code Section 7026.1?
question_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7026.1条，以下哪项与树木相关的活动需要执行该活动的人持有承包商执照？

options.en: A nurseryperson's routine incidental tree pruning
options.cn: 苗圃工作人员的例行附带树木修剪

options.en: A gardener's routine guying of newly planted trees
options.cn: 园丁对新栽树木的例行支撑绑扎

options.en: Tree limb cabling performed as a commercial service
options.cn: 作为商业服务进行的树枝缆索固定

options.en: A gardener pruning a newly planted 12-foot tree
options.cn: 园丁修剪新栽的12英尺高树木

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7026.1(a)(4) includes any person who engages in tree or limb cabling or guying within the definition of 'contractor,' requiring a license — unless covered by the narrow nurseryperson or gardener exceptions.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7026.1(a)(4)条将从事树木或树枝缆索固定或支撑绑扎的任何人纳入“承包商”的定义，要求持有执照 —— 除非符合苗圃工作人员或园丁的狭义例外情况。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7026.1(a)(4) (Document p. 216, PDF p. 239)

question_en: The CSLB must report complaint statistics to the Legislature no later than what date each year?
question_cn: CSLB 必须在每年的什么日期之前向立法机构报告投诉统计数据？

options.en: No later than October 1 of each year
options.cn: 每年的 10 月 1 日之前

options.en: No later than January 1 of each year
options.cn: 每年的 1 月 1 日之前

options.en: No later than December 31 of each year
options.cn: 每年的 12 月 31 日之前

options.en: No later than July 1 of each year
options.cn: 每年的 7 月 1 日之前

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7017.3 requires the CSLB to report annually to the Legislature, not later than October 1 of each year, statistical information about complaints filed for the prior fiscal year.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 7017.3 条要求 CSLB 每年向立法机构报告关于前一财政年度所提交投诉的统计信息，最晚不得超过每年的 10 月 1 日。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7017.3 (Document p. 210, PDF p. 233)

question_en: An unlicensed person wants to advertise for construction work. Under what condition may they legally do so?
question_cn: 一名无执照人员想要宣传建筑工程。他们在什么情况下可以合法地这样做？

options.en: If the contract price is under $5,000 and disclosed
options.cn: 如果合同价格低于5,000美元并且已披露

options.en: If the work is purely residential in nature
options.cn: 如果工作完全是住宅性质

options.en: If the contract is under $1,000 and unlicensed status is disclosed
options.cn: 如果合同低于1,000美元并且披露了无执照身份

options.en: If a licensed subcontractor will perform all the work
options.cn: 如果所有工作将由有执照的分包商完成

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7027.2 allows an unlicensed person to advertise only if the aggregate contract price for labor, material, and all other items is less than $1,000 and the ad states the person is not licensed.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7027.2条规定，无执照人员只有在劳动、材料和所有其他项目的合同总价低于1,000美元，并且广告中说明该人无执照的情况下，才允许进行广告宣传。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7027.2 (Document p. 219, PDF p. 242)

question_en: A contractor is convicted for the first time of engaging in construction without a license. What is the maximum fine that can be imposed?
question_cn: 承包商首次因无执照从事建筑活动被定罪。最高可处多少罚款？

options.en: Up to $1,000 plus possible license suspension
options.cn: 最高1,000美元，另可能暂停执照

options.en: Up to $10,000 or 20 percent of contract price
options.cn: 最高10,000美元或合同价格的20%

options.en: 20 percent of contract price or $5,000, whichever is greater
options.cn: 合同价格的20%或5,000美元，以较高者为准

options.en: Up to $5,000 or six months in county jail
options.cn: 最高5,000美元或在县监狱服刑六个月

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7028(b) provides that a first conviction is punishable by a fine not exceeding $5,000 or by imprisonment in a county jail not exceeding six months, or both.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7028(b)条规定，首次定罪可处不超过5,000美元的罚款，或不超过六个月的县监狱监禁，或两者并罚。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7028(b) (Document p. 222, PDF p. 245)

question_en: What is the penalty range for an unlicensed person who willfully uses a fraudulent contractor's license number with intent to defraud?
question_cn: 无执照人员故意使用欺诈性的承包商执照号码以诈骗为目的，其处罚范围是什么？

options.en: Fine up to $10,000 or state prison or county jail up to one year
options.cn: 罚款最高可达10,000美元，或州监狱或县监狱不超过一年

options.en: Fine up to $3,000 and mandatory license revocation
options.cn: 罚款最高可达3,000美元，并强制吊销许可证

options.en: Fine up to $5,000 or six months in county jail
options.cn: 罚款最高可达5,000美元，或县监狱六个月

options.en: Fine up to $1,000 and license suspension only
options.cn: 仅罚款最高1,000美元并暂停执照

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7027.3 provides that willful, fraudulent use of an invalid license number is punishable by a fine not exceeding $10,000, imprisonment in state prison or county jail for not more than one year, or both.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7027.3条规定，故意欺诈使用无效许可证号码的行为，可处以最高10,000美元的罚款，或在州监狱或县监狱监禁不超过一年，或两者并罚。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7027.3 (Document p. 219, PDF p. 242)

question_en: An unlicensed contractor is convicted for the second time of operating without a license. What is the mandatory minimum jail sentence, absent unusual circumstances?
question_cn: 一名无执照的承包商因第二次无执照经营而被定罪。在没有特殊情况的情况下，强制性最低监禁刑期是多少？

options.en: Not less than 90 days in county jail
options.cn: 县监狱至少90天

options.en: Not less than six months in county jail
options.cn: 县监狱至少六个月

options.en: No mandatory minimum; court has full discretion
options.cn: 没有强制性最低刑期；法院有完全裁量权

options.en: Not less than 30 days in county jail
options.cn: 县监狱至少30天

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7028(c) requires confinement in county jail for not less than 90 days for a second conviction, except in unusual cases where the court must state its reasons on the record.
explanation_cn: 根据《商务与职业法典》第7028(c)条，第二次定罪通常要求至少在县监狱监禁90天，除非在特殊情况下，法院必须在记录中说明理由。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7028(c) (Document p. 222, PDF p. 245)

question_en: A retail furniture dealer holds a valid retail furniture dealer's license. Under what condition may the dealer sell and have carpet installed without obtaining a contractor's license?
question_cn: 零售家具经销商持有有效的零售家具经销商执照。在什么情况下，经销商可以在不获取承包商执照的情况下销售并安装地毯？

options.en: If the carpet is less than 500 square feet total
options.cn: 如果地毯总面积少于500平方英尺

options.en: If the dealer also holds a General Building contractor license
options.cn: 如果经销商还持有综合建筑承包商执照

options.en: If the total contract price is under $1,000
options.cn: 如果合同总价低于1,000美元

options.en: If installation is performed by a licensed contractor with written certification to buyer
options.cn: 如果安装由持照承包商执行，并向买方提供书面证明

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7026.3 exempts a retail furniture dealer from needing a contractor's license if installation is performed by a licensed contractor and the dealer certifies this in writing to the buyer before installation, including the contractor's name, address, and license number.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7026.3节规定，如果安装由持照承包商执行，并且经销商在安装前向买方书面证明，包括承包商的姓名、地址和执照号码，则零售家具经销商无需承包商执照。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7026.3 (Document p. 217, PDF p. 240)

question_en: Who may seek an injunction against a person who continues to act as an unlicensed contractor, without being required to prove irreparable injury?
question_cn: 谁可以对继续以无执照承包商身份行事的人申请禁令，而无需证明无法弥补的损害？

options.en: A licensed contractor, affected consumer, district attorney, or Attorney General
options.cn: 持牌承包商、受影响的消费者、地区检察官或总检察长

options.en: Any member of the public who hired the contractor
options.cn: 雇用该承包商的任何公众成员

options.en: Only the Registrar, acting through the district attorney
options.cn: 仅通过地区检察官行事的注册主任

options.en: Only the Registrar of Contractors or Attorney General
options.cn: 仅承包商注册主任或总检察长

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7028.4 grants standing to (1) a licensed contractor or contractor association, (2) a consumer affected by the violation, (3) a district attorney, or (4) the Attorney General -- and none need prove irreparable injury for continuing violations.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7028.4条授予以下主体提起诉讼的资格：(1) 持牌承包商或承包商协会，(2) 受违规行为影响的消费者，(3) 地区检察官，或 (4) 总检察长——并且任何一方都无需为持续违规行为证明无法弥补的损害。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7028.4 (Document p. 224, PDF p. 247)

question_en: How quickly must the CSLB Registrar notify a public entity after learning the entity intends to award a contract to an unlicensed contractor?
question_cn: CSLB注册主任在得知公共实体打算将合同授予无执照承包商后，必须多快通知该公共实体？

options.en: Within 10 business days of receiving notice
options.cn: 在收到通知后的10个工作日内

options.en: Within 24 hours of receiving notice
options.cn: 在收到通知后的24小时内

options.en: Within 5 calendar days of receiving notice
options.cn: 在收到通知后的5个日历日内

options.en: Within 72 hours of receiving notice
options.cn: 在收到通知后的72小时内

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7028.7(b) requires the Registrar to give written notice to the public entity within 72 hours of receiving notice that the entity intends to award or has awarded a contract to an unlicensed contractor.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7028.7(b)条款，注册主任在收到公共实体打算授予或已授予无执照承包商合同的通知后的72小时内，必须以书面形式通知该公共实体。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7028.7(b) (Document p. 225, PDF p. 248)

question_en: A person who previously served as a Responsible Managing Officer of a licensed corporation now wants to work independently as a contractor. What does the law require?
question_cn: 曾经担任持牌公司负责人（Responsible Managing Officer, RMO）的人现在想作为独立承包商工作。法律有什么要求？

options.en: They must obtain their own individual contractor's license in good standing
options.cn: 他们必须获得自己的个人承包商执照，并保持良好信誉

options.en: They are automatically licensed based on prior RMO experience
options.cn: 他们可以根据之前的RMO经验自动获得执照

options.en: They need only register with CSLB as an independent operator
options.cn: 他们只需在CSLB注册为独立经营者

options.en: They may use the corporation's license while transitioning
options.cn: 他们可以在过渡期间使用公司的执照

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7028.5 makes it unlawful for a person who was an RMO or other listed officer of a licensed entity to individually engage in contracting without holding an individual license in good standing.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7028.5条规定，曾经担任RMO或其他列入名单的持牌实体负责人，若没有持有良好信誉的个人执照，个人从事承包业务是违法的。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7028.5 (Document p. 225, PDF p. 248)

question_en: A contractor is convicted of performing asbestos-related work without the required certification for the second time. Which penalty is mandatory?
question_cn: 一名承包商因第二次在未获得所需认证的情况下进行石棉相关工作而被定罪。哪种处罚是强制性的？

options.en: Fine of $3,000 to $5,000 with mandatory license suspension or revocation
options.cn: 罚款3,000至5,000美元，并强制暂停或吊销执照

options.en: Fine up to $10,000 or state prison sentence
options.cn: 最高可罚款10,000美元或州监狱刑期

options.en: Fine of $3,000 to $5,000 and possible license revocation
options.cn: 罚款3,000至5,000美元，并可能吊销执照

options.en: Fine of $5,000 to $10,000 and 90 days minimum jail time
options.cn: 罚款5,000至10,000美元，并至少坐牢90天

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7028.1(b) requires a fine of not less than $3,000 or more than $5,000 and mandates a license suspension or revocation action for subsequent offense convictions.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7028.1(b)条要求，对于再次犯罪的定罪，罚款不得少于3,000美元且不得超过5,000美元，并强制执行暂停或吊销执照的处罚。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7028.1(b) (Document p. 223, PDF p. 246)

question_en: When may an owner-builder legally install a fire protection system in a single-family dwelling without holding a fire protection contractor classification?
question_cn: 业主-建造者在没有持有消防保护承包商资质的情况下，何时可以合法安装单户住宅的消防保护系统？

options.en: Only if the owner also holds a General Building contractor license
options.cn: 仅当业主同时持有普通建筑承包商执照时

options.en: Any owner of a single-family home may self-install at any time
options.cn: 任何单户住宅的业主随时可以自行安装

options.en: If owner-occupied, no more than two dwellings per parcel per year, with approved plans and inspection
options.cn: 如果为自用住房，每块地每年不超过两套住房，并且需经批准的方案和检查

options.en: If the dwelling is less than 1,500 square feet and not a rental
options.cn: 如果住宅面积小于1,500平方英尺且不是出租房

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7026.12(b) allows an owner-builder of an owner-occupied single-family dwelling to install fire protection if not more than two single-family dwellings on the same parcel are built within one year, plans are submitted to and approved by local authority, and the installation is inspected and approved.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7026.12(b)条允许自住单户住宅的业主-建造者安装消防保护系统，前提是同一地块在一年内建造的单户住宅不超过两套，须向地方主管部门提交并获批准方案，且安装需经过检查并获批准。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7026.12(b) (Document p. 218, PDF p. 241)

question_en: How long does the statute of limitations allow for filing charges against an unlicensed contractor for engaging in business without a license?
question_cn: 对于无执照承包商从事无执照业务的指控，诉讼时效允许多长时间提起诉讼？

options.en: Within three years from project abandonment
options.cn: 自项目放弃之日起三年内

options.en: Within four years from contract proposal, completion, or abandonment, whichever is last
options.cn: 自合同提案、完成或放弃之日起四年内，以最后发生者为准

options.en: Within two years from the date of the violation
options.cn: 自违规之日起两年内

options.en: Within one year from contract completion
options.cn: 自合同完成之日起一年内

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7028(g) states that an indictment, information, or complaint must be filed within four years from the date of the contract proposal, contract, completion, or abandonment -- whichever occurs last.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7028(g)条规定，起诉书、信息书或控告必须在合同提案、合同、完成或放弃之日起四年内提起，以最后发生者为准。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7028(g) (Document p. 223, PDF p. 246)

question_en: An unlicensed person is cited by the Registrar under B&P Code Section 7028.7. What is the minimum civil penalty that must be included in the citation?
question_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7028.7条款，注册处对无执照人员发出处罚通知。传票中必须包含的最低民事罚款是多少？

options.en: Not less than $1,000
options.cn: 不少于1,000美元

options.en: Not less than $200
options.cn: 不少于200美元

options.en: Not less than $700
options.cn: 不少于700美元

options.en: Not less than $500
options.cn: 不少于500美元

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7028.7(c) specifies that each citation must contain an assessment of a civil penalty in an amount not less than $200 nor more than $15,000.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7028.7(c)条款规定，每份传票必须包含一项民事罚款，金额不少于200美元且不超过15,000美元。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7028.7(c) (Document p. 226, PDF p. 249)

question_en: A landscape contractor with a C-27 license wants to include a swimming pool in a project. Which of the following statements is correct?
question_cn: 一位持有C-27执照的园林承包商希望在项目中包含游泳池。以下哪一项说法是正确的？

options.en: The contractor may enter a prime contract but must subcontract pool work to a C-53 licensee
options.cn: 承包商可以签订总承包合同，但必须将泳池工程分包给C-53执照持有者

options.en: The pool must be subcontracted to a General Building contractor
options.cn: 泳池必须分包给总建筑承包商

options.en: The C-27 contractor may self-perform pool construction without restriction
options.cn: C-27承包商可以无限制地自行进行泳池施工

options.en: The pool must be a separate standalone contract, not part of the landscape project
options.cn: 泳池必须作为独立合同，而不是景观项目的一部分

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7027.5(b)(1) allows a landscape contractor to enter a prime contract for a pool if it is part of the landscape project, but the pool construction must be subcontracted to a C-53 licensed contractor -- or self-performed if the landscape contractor also holds a C-53.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7027.5(b)(1)条款，如果泳池是景观项目的一部分，园林承包商可以签订泳池总承包合同，但泳池施工必须分包给持有C-53执照的承包商——或者如果园林承包商也持有C-53执照，则可以自行施工。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7027.5(b)(1) (Document p. 220, PDF p. 243)

question_en: A contractor receives a citation from the CSLB registrar. If the contractor does not notify the registrar of an intent to appeal, within what period does the citation become a final order?
question_cn: 承包商收到 CSLB 注册主任的传票。如果承包商没有在规定时间内通知注册主任有上诉意图，该传票在多久后成为最终命令？

options.en: Within 15 working days after service
options.cn: 送达后 15 个工作日内

options.en: Within 20 working days after service
options.cn: 送达后 20 个工作日内

options.en: Within 30 calendar days after service
options.cn: 送达后 30 个日历日内

options.en: Within 28 working days after service
options.cn: 送达后 28 个工作日内

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7028.11 states that if the cited person fails to notify the registrar of intent to appeal within 15 working days of service, the citation becomes a final order not subject to further review.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 7028.11 条规定，如果被传票人未能在送达后 15 个工作日内通知注册主任有上诉意图，该传票将成为最终命令，不得进一步复审。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7028.11 (Document p. 228, PDF p. 251)

question_en: Under B&P Code Section 7028.13, after a civil penalty citation is converted to a court judgment, how many years does the registrar have to enforce collection of that judgment?
question_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7028.13条，在民事罚款通知被转为法院判决后，注册主任有多少年时间来执行该判决的收取？

options.en: Ten years from the date of judgment
options.cn: 自判决之日起十年

options.en: Six years from the date of judgment
options.cn: 自判决之日起六年

options.en: Four years from the date of judgment
options.cn: 自判决之日起四年

options.en: Eight years from the date of judgment
options.cn: 自判决之日起八年

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7028.13(d) expressly provides that the registrar or assignee has 10 years from the date of judgment to enforce civil penalties that have been converted to judgments through the superior court process.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7028.13(d)条明确规定，注册主任或受让人有自判决之日起十年的时间，通过高等法院程序执行已转为判决的民事罚款。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7028.13(d) (Document p. 229, PDF p. 252)

question_en: An unlicensed contractor performs repairs on homes damaged by a governor-declared natural disaster. Which of the following best describes the homeowner's legal status under B&P Code Section 7028.16?
question_cn: 一名无执照的承包商对州长宣布的自然灾害中受损的房屋进行修理。根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7028.16条，下列哪项最能描述房主的法律地位？

options.en: An accomplice subject to civil penalties
options.cn: 如果是同谋，将受到民事处罚

options.en: A liable party if aware of unlicensed status
options.cn: 如果知道承包商无证，则为有责任的一方

options.en: A complainant only if damages exceed $10,000
options.cn: 仅在损失超过10,000美元时为投诉人

options.en: A victim of crime regardless of knowledge
options.cn: 无论是否知情，均为犯罪受害者

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7028.16 provides that a person who utilized the services of an unlicensed contractor in a declared disaster area is a victim of crime regardless of whether that person knew the contractor was unlicensed.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7028.16条规定，在宣布灾区中使用无执照承包商服务的人，无论是否知道承包商无证，均为犯罪受害者。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7028.16 (Document p. 231, PDF p. 254)

question_en: A public agency employee awards a contract to an unlicensed contractor but had previously submitted an inquiry to the CSLB to verify license status. Under what condition is the employee shielded from a CSLB citation?
question_cn: 公共机构的雇员将合同授予未持证承包商，但之前曾向 CSLB 提出查询以核实执照状态。在什么情况下，该雇员可以免于 CSLB 的处罚？

options.en: The contract amount was under $4,500
options.cn: 合同金额低于 4,500 美元

options.en: CSLB failed to respond within three business days
options.cn: CSLB 未在三个工作日内回应

options.en: CSLB failed to respond within five business days
options.cn: CSLB 未在五个工作日内回应

options.en: The agency provided written notice to CSLB
options.cn: 该机构已向 CSLB 提供书面通知

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7028.15(g) provides that a public employee is not subject to citation if they inquired about license status and the board failed to respond within three business days. A telephone response by the board is deemed sufficient.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 7028.15(g) 条规定，如果公共雇员就执照状态进行了查询且委员会未能在三个工作日内回应，则该雇员不受处罚。委员会的电话回复视为充分回应。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7028.15(g) (Document p. 230, PDF p. 253)

question_en: A previously convicted unlicensed contractor submits a bid to a public agency and is awarded the contract. The contract price is $30,000. What is the minimum fine the court shall impose upon conviction?
question_cn: 一名有前科的无执照承包商向公共机构提交投标并中标。合同价格为30,000美元。定罪后法院应处以的最低罚款是多少？

options.en: $10,000, the standard unlicensed contractor fine
options.cn: 10,000美元，标准无执照承包商罚款

options.en: $15,000, the maximum civil citation penalty
options.cn: 15,000美元，最高民事处罚

options.en: $6,000, which is 20% of the contract price
options.cn: 6,000美元，占合同价格的20%

options.en: $4,500, the minimum statutory fine
options.cn: 4,500美元，法定最低罚款

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7028.15(b) requires the court to impose a fine of 20% of the contract price OR $4,500, whichever is greater. 20% of $30,000 = $6,000, which exceeds $4,500, so $6,000 is the minimum fine.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7028.15(b)条要求法院处以合同价格20%或4,500美元，以数额较高者为准。30,000美元的20% = 6,000美元，超过4,500美元，因此最低罚款为6,000美元。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7028.15(b) (Document p. 229, PDF p. 252)

question_en: Under B&P Code Section 7028.9, what is the latest a citation may be issued after the underlying act or omission occurred?
question_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7028.9条，在基础行为或疏忽发生后，最迟可以在多久之后发出处罚通知？

options.en: Three years after the act or omission
options.cn: 行为或疏忽发生后三年

options.en: Two years after the act or omission
options.cn: 行为或疏忽发生后两年

options.en: 18 months after the complaint is filed
options.cn: 投诉提交后18个月

options.en: Four years after the act, or 18 months after complaint, whichever is later
options.cn: 行为发生后四年，或投诉提交后18个月，以时间较晚者为准

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7028.9 sets a dual deadline: the citation must be issued within four years after the act or omission, or within 18 months after the complaint is filed with the registrar, whichever deadline falls later.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7028.9条规定了双重截止期限：罚单必须在行为或疏忽发生后四年内，或者在向注册主任提交投诉后18个月内发出，以较晚的截止日期为准。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7028.9 (Document p. 227, PDF p. 250)

question_en: Two licensed contractors wish to bid jointly on a project that requires a joint venture license. Which of the following is TRUE about bidding before the joint venture license is obtained?
question_cn: 两名持证承包商希望联合投标一个需要联合企业许可证的项目。关于在获得联合企业许可证之前的投标，下列哪项是正确的？

options.en: One contractor may bid on behalf of both parties
options.cn: 一名承包商可以代表双方投标

options.en: CSLB must pre-approve the bid submission
options.cn: CSLB 必须事先批准投标提交

options.en: They may jointly bid before obtaining joint venture license
options.cn: 他们可以在获得联合企业许可证之前联合投标

options.en: Joint bidding before licensure is strictly prohibited
options.cn: 未持证前联合投标是严格禁止的

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7029.1(b) permits licensees to jointly bid for work requiring a joint venture license prior to actually obtaining that license. However, failure to later obtain the license does not excuse any penalty for failing to enter the contract.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7029.1(b)条允许持证人针对需要联合企业许可证的工作在实际获得该许可证之前联合投标。然而，未能随后获得许可证不能免除因未能签订合同而受到的任何处罚。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7029.1(b) (Document p. 232, PDF p. 255)

question_en: Which of the following actions does B&P Code Section 7028.13 expressly prohibit the registrar from delegating or assigning?
question_cn: 以下哪项行为是《加州商业与职业法典》第7028.13条明确禁止注册主任授权或委托的？

options.en: Enforcing the order of abatement
options.cn: 执行整改命令

options.en: Collecting civil penalty funds from the cited party
options.cn: 向被引用方收取民事罚款

options.en: Assigning rights to a portion of the civil penalty
options.cn: 分配部分民事罚款的权利

options.en: Applying to superior court for a judgment
options.cn: 向上级法院申请判决

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7028.13(b) and (c) both expressly state that the registrar shall NOT delegate or assign the authority to enforce the order of abatement, even though collection of civil penalties may be delegated or assigned.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7028.13条(b)和(c)款都明确规定，注册主任不得委托或授权执行整改命令的权力，尽管民事罚款的收取可以被委托或授权。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7028.13(b) and (c) (Document p. 228, PDF p. 251)

question_en: A homeowner wants to use the owner-builder exemption to avoid hiring a licensed contractor. Which condition must be met for the exemption to apply when the owner personally performs the work?
question_cn: 房主想使用自建房豁免以避免雇用持牌承包商。当房主亲自执行工作时，要适用该豁免，必须满足哪个条件？

options.en: None of the improvements are intended or offered for sale
options.cn: 没有任何改进是为了销售或提供出售

options.en: No more than four structures may be built per year
options.cn: 每年建造的建筑物不得超过四栋

options.en: The structure must be the owner's primary residence
options.cn: 该建筑必须是房主的主要住所

options.en: The owner must have resided there for 12 months
options.cn: 房主必须在该住所居住至少12个月

explanation_en: Under B&P Code Section 7044(a)(1), the owner-builder exemption requires that none of the improvements are intended or offered for sale, and that the owner personally performs all work or uses only paid employees.
explanation_cn: 根据《商业与专业法规》第7044(a)(1)条，自建房豁免要求没有任何改进是为了销售或提供出售，并且房主亲自完成所有工作或仅使用付费雇员。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7044(a)(1) (Document p. 242, PDF p. 265)

question_en: Under the owner-builder exemption, when does proof of selling structures within one year of completion create a conclusive — not merely rebuttable — presumption that the work was done for sale?
question_cn: 在业主-建造者豁免下，何时出售建筑物在完工一年内的证据会产生决定性——而不仅仅是可反驳——的推定，即工作是为了出售而进行的？

options.en: Sale of three or more structures within one year
options.cn: 一年内出售三座或以上的建筑物

options.en: Sale of four or more structures within one year
options.cn: 一年内出售四座或以上的建筑物

options.en: Sale of five or more structures within one year
options.cn: 一年内出售五座或以上的建筑物

options.en: Sale of two or more structures within one year
options.cn: 一年内出售两座或以上的建筑物

explanation_en: Under B&P Code Section 7044(b)(2), proof of sale or offering for sale of five or more structures within one year after completion creates a conclusive presumption that the work was done for purposes of sale, removing the rebuttable nature of the standard presumption.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7044(b)(2)条，证明在完工一年内出售或提供出售五座或以上建筑物的事实，会产生决定性推定，即工作是为了销售目的进行的，从而消除了标准推定的可反驳性质。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7044(b)(2) (Document p. 243, PDF p. 266)

question_en: A contractor applies for a building permit but does not hold a CSLB license. What is the maximum civil penalty for falsely signing a statement claiming to be licensed?
question_cn: 承包商申请建筑许可证，但没有持有 CSLB 许可证。如果虚假签署声明声称自己持证，最高民事罚款是多少？

options.en: Not more than $5,000
Not more than $1,000
Not more than $500
options.cn: 不超过 $500

options.en: Not more than $250
options.cn: 不超过 $250

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7031 expressly states that any violation by an applicant for a permit who falsely signs a licensing statement is subject to a civil penalty of not more than five hundred dollars ($500).
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 7031 条明确规定，任何申请许可证的人若虚假签署持证声明，最高可处以五百美元（$500）的民事罚款。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7031 (Document p. 237, PDF p. 260)

question_en: A city receives a complaint about a licensed contractor violating a local building code. Which of the following best describes the city's authority under B&P Code Section 7032?
question_cn: 一座城市收到关于一名持牌承包商违反当地建筑规范的投诉。根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7032条，下列哪项最能描述该城市的权限？

options.en: Set qualifications required to engage in contracting
options.cn: 设定从事承包所需的资格

options.en: Direct complaints to the Registrar for priority processing
options.cn: 将投诉提交给注册主任以优先处理

options.en: Suspend the contractor's license pending investigation
options.cn: 在调查期间暂停承包商的执照

options.en: Revoke the contractor's CSLB license directly
options.cn: 直接吊销承包商的CSLB执照

explanation_en: Under B&P Code Section 7032, cities and counties may direct complaints to the CSLB Registrar against licensees based on local code violations, and such complaints shall be given priority in processing to the extent determined necessary by the Registrar.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7032条，城市和县可以将有关持牌承包商违反当地规范的投诉提交给CSLB注册主任，并且这些投诉在处理时应根据注册主任认为必要的程度给予优先处理。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7032 (Document p. 237, PDF p. 260)

question_en: The Attorney General plans to file a civil action to discipline a contractor for failing to pay workers. How many days before filing must the Attorney General notify the CSLB Registrar?
question_cn: 总检察长计划提起民事诉讼，以惩戒未支付工人工资的承包商。在提起诉讼前，总检察长必须提前多少天通知 CSLB 注册主任？

options.en: At least 45 days prior to filing
options.cn: 提起诉讼前至少提前 45 天

options.en: At least 30 days prior to filing
options.cn: 提起诉讼前至少提前 30 天

options.en: At least 10 days prior to filing
options.cn: 提起诉讼前至少提前 10 天

options.en: At least 60 days prior to filing
options.cn: 提起诉讼前至少提前 60 天

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7036(b) requires the Attorney General to notify the Registrar at least 30 days prior to filing a civil complaint. Importantly, failure to provide this notice does not constitute a defense to the action.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 7036(b) 条要求总检察长在提起民事诉讼前至少提前 30 天通知注册主任。重要的是，未提供此通知并不构成对诉讼的抗辩理由。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7036(b) (Document p. 239, PDF p. 262)

question_en: Which of the following work activities is NOT exempt from CSLB licensing requirements under the contractor license law?
question_cn: 以下哪项工作活动不在承包商执照法下豁免CSLB许可要求的范围内？

options.en: Repair of irrigation ditches for a reclamation district
options.cn: 为开垦区修复灌溉沟渠

options.en: Land clearing for rural fire prevention purposes
options.cn: 为农村防火目的进行土地清理

options.en: Farming and dairying operations on agricultural land
options.cn: 农业用地上的农耕和奶牛养殖作业

options.en: Drilling and constructing a water well
options.cn: 钻探和建造水井

explanation_en: Section 7049 expressly states that the licensing chapter DOES apply to the business of drilling, digging, boring, or otherwise constructing, deepening, repairing, or abandoning water wells — making this the non-exempt activity.
explanation_cn: 第7049条明确规定，许可章节确实适用于钻探、挖掘、打眼或以其他方式建造、加深、修理或废弃水井的业务——这就是不豁免的活动。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7049 (Document p. 245, PDF p. 268)

question_en: A handyman completes a fence repair job for a neighbor. The total cost is $850 for labor and materials, no building permit is required, and the handyman does not advertise as a contractor. Is a CSLB license required?
question_cn: 一名手工艺人为邻居完成围栏维修工作。劳务和材料总费用为850美元，不需要建筑许可证，手工艺人也没有以承包商身份做广告。是否需要CSLB执照？

options.en: No, because the homeowner gave written permission
options.cn: 不需要，因为房主已书面许可

options.en: No, because the project falls under the small-project exemption
options.cn: 不需要，因为该项目属于小型项目豁免

options.en: Yes, because the work involves a structure
options.cn: 是的，因为工作涉及结构

options.en: Yes, all construction work requires a license
options.cn: 是的，所有建筑工作都需要执照

explanation_en: Under B&P Code Section 7048, no license is required when the aggregate contract price is less than $1,000, no building permit is required, and the person does not advertise as a contractor or hire helpers. All three conditions are met here.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7048条，当合同总价低于1,000美元、不需要建筑许可证、且该人未以承包商身份做广告或雇佣助手时，不需要执照。这里满足所有三个条件。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7048 (Document p. 245, PDF p. 268)

question_en: Which of the following entities is exempt from CSLB licensing requirements when acting within its official capacity?
question_cn: 以下哪一实体在其官方职能范围内不受 CSLB 执照要求的约束？

options.en: A private utility company operating statewide
options.cn: 在全州运营的私人公用事业公司

options.en: A federally recognized tribe acting within tribal jurisdiction
options.cn: 在部落管辖范围内行事的联邦认可部落

options.en: A private nonprofit hospital district contractor
options.cn: 私人非营利医院地区承包商

options.en: A licensed real estate broker managing properties
options.cn: 管理物业的持牌房地产经纪人

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7040(a) expressly exempts authorized representatives of any federally recognized tribe or participating tribe acting within tribal jurisdiction from the contractor licensing requirements.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 7040(a) 条明确规定，在部落管辖范围内行事的任何联邦认可部落或参与部落的授权代表不受承包商执照要求的约束。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7040(a) (Document p. 240, PDF p. 263)

question_en: A gas utility company wants to perform licensed contractor work inside a customer's home to restore service after an outage. Under what condition is this permitted without a contractor's license?
question_cn: 燃气公司希望在客户家中进行持牌承包商工作，以在停电后恢复服务。在哪种情况下可以在没有承包商执照的情况下进行此类工作？

options.en: The utility holds a valid CSLB contractor's license
options.cn: 公用事业公司持有有效的CSLB承包商执照

options.en: The utility obtains owner consent before entering
options.cn: 公用事业公司在进入之前获得业主同意

options.en: The work is completed by a subsidiary of the utility
options.cn: 由公用事业公司的子公司完成工作

options.en: The work beyond the meter protects public safety or avoids service interruption
options.cn: 表计之外的工作旨在保护公共安全或避免服务中断

explanation_en: Under B&P Code Section 7042.1(a)(3), a gas or electrical corporation may perform work inside a structure beyond the customer's utility meter without a license if the work is necessary to protect public safety or avoid interruption of service.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7042.1(a)(3)条款，如果为了保护公共安全或避免服务中断而进行的工作是必要的，则燃气或电力公司可以在结构物内［客户的公用事业表计之外］进行工作，而无需执照。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7042.1(a)(3) (Document p. 241, PDF p. 264)

question_en: A homeowner who has lived in her home for 14 months wants to use the principal-residence exemption to perform improvements before selling. How many times may she use this exemption within any three-year period?
question_cn: 一位在她的家中居住了14个月的房主希望在出售前利用主要住宅豁免进行改进。她在任何三年期间可以使用此豁免多少次？

options.en: Up to four times during any three-year period
options.cn: 在任何三年期间最多四次

options.en: Once on one structure during any three-year period
options.cn: 在任何三年期间在一栋建筑上使用一次

options.en: Up to three times during any three-year period
options.cn: 在任何三年期间最多三次

options.en: No more than twice during any three-year period
options.cn: 在任何三年期间不超过两次

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7044(a)(3)(C) limits use of the principal-residence exemption to no more than two structures more than once during any three-year period. Since this homeowner meets the 12-month residency requirement, she may use the exemption but is subject to this cap.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7044(a)(3)(C)条款将主要住宅豁免的使用限制为在任何三年期间对多于两栋建筑不得使用超过一次。由于该房主符合12个月的居住要求，她可以使用豁免，但受到此限制。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7044(a)(3)(C) (Document p. 243, PDF p. 266)

question_en: Which of the following persons is NOT exempt from CSLB contractor licensing requirements?
question_cn: 以下哪一类人不免于CSLB承包商执照要求？

options.en: A materials supplier who also installs home improvement goods
options.cn: 既供应材料又安装家居改进产品的材料供应商

options.en: An employee receiving wages as sole compensation
options.cn: 仅以工资为唯一报酬的雇员

options.en: A licensed alarm company operator installing alarm systems
options.cn: 安装报警系统的持牌报警公司操作员

options.en: A licensed architect acting solely in professional capacity
options.cn: 仅以专业身份执业的持牌建筑师

explanation_en: While a materials supplier who only furnishes materials is exempt under Section 7052, Section 7045 expressly states the licensing law applies to installation of home improvement goods. A supplier who also installs such goods must hold a contractor's license.
explanation_cn: 虽然仅提供材料的材料供应商根据第7052条是免税的，但第7045条明确规定执照法律适用于家居改进产品的安装。既供应又安装此类产品的供应商必须持有承包商执照。
code_reference: B&P Code Sections 7051-7054 (Document p. 246, PDF p. 269)

question_en: A contractor is found to have failed to pay required wages and a civil action is filed by the Attorney General. Within how many days of the initial complaint filing may the CSLB board intervene without needing court permission?
question_cn: 发现承包商未支付所需工资，司法总检察官提起民事诉讼。自初次投诉提交起，CSLB委员会在多少天内可以介入而无需法院许可？

options.en: Within 60 days of the complaint filing
options.cn: 自投诉提交之日起60天内

options.en: Within 30 days of the complaint filing
options.cn: 自投诉提交之日起30天内

options.en: Within 45 days of the complaint filing
options.cn: 自投诉提交之日起45天内

options.en: Within 10 days of the complaint filing
options.cn: 自投诉提交之日起10天内

explanation_en: Under B&P Code Section 7036(c), the board may intervene in court proceedings within 60 days of the filing of the initial complaint as a matter of right. After that period, intervention requires leave of court upon good cause shown.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7036(c)条，委员会可以在初次投诉提交后60天内在法院程序中介入，作为一种权利。在此期限之后，介入需要在充分理由下获得法院许可。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7036(c) (Document p. 239, PDF p. 262)

question_en: A contractor performs a $950 home repair project. After finishing, the contractor hires a helper to clean up the worksite. Does the small-project exemption still protect the contractor from the licensing requirement?
question_cn: 一名承包商进行了一项价值950美元的家庭维修项目。完成后，承包商雇用了一名助手清理施工现场。小型项目豁免是否仍能保护承包商免于持证要求？

options.en: Yes, because cleanup is not construction work
options.cn: 是的，因为清理工作不是建筑工程

options.en: No, because the work required a building permit
options.cn: 不是，因为该工作需要建筑许可

options.en: Yes, because the total cost is under $1,000
options.cn: 是的，因为总费用低于1,000美元

options.en: No, because hiring a helper voids the small-project exemption
options.cn: 不是，因为雇用助手会使小型项目豁免失效

explanation_en: Under B&P Code Section 7048(c)(2), the small-project exemption does not apply to any person who employs another person to perform or assist in performing the work. Hiring a cleanup helper disqualifies the contractor from the exemption, even if the job cost is under $1,000.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7048(c)(2)条款，任何雇用他人执行或协助执行工作的人员均不适用小型项目豁免。即使项目费用低于1,000美元，雇用清理助手也会导致承包商失去豁免资格。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7048(c)(2) (Document p. 245, PDF p. 268)

question_en: Which of the following projects would a residential remodeling contractor (B-2) be prohibited from contracting for, even with an appropriately licensed subcontractor?
question_cn: 以下哪项工程是住宅改建承包商 (B-2) 即使有适当执照的分包商，也被禁止承接的？

options.en: Adding a new roof with a C-39 subcontractor
options.cn: 与 C-39 分包商一起添加新屋顶

options.en: Replacing plumbing fixtures with a C-36 subcontractor
options.cn: 与 C-36 分包商一起更换管道设施

options.en: Installing asbestos abatement with a C-22 subcontractor
options.cn: 与 C-22 分包商一起进行石棉清除作业

options.en: Modifying load-bearing walls in an existing residence
options.cn: 修改现有住宅的承重墙

explanation_en: Section 7057.5(c)(2) expressly prohibits a B-2 residential remodeling contractor from contracting to make structural changes to load-bearing portions of an existing structure, including load-bearing walls — regardless of subcontracting arrangements.
explanation_cn: 第 7057.5(c)(2) 条明确禁止 B-2 住宅改建承包商承接对现有结构承重部分进行结构性更改的工程，包括承重墙——无论分包安排如何。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7057.5(c)(2) (Document p. 249, PDF p. 272)

question_en: A contractor passes the asbestos certification exam but fails to register with the Division of Occupational Safety and Health within the required period. What may the CSLB do?
question_cn: 承包商通过了石棉认证考试，但未在规定期限内向职业安全与健康部门注册。CSLB可能会采取什么措施？

options.en: Revoke the contractor's general license immediately
options.cn: 立即撤销承包商的一般执照

options.en: Suspend the contractor's license for 30 days
options.cn: 暂停承包商执照30天

options.en: Require the contractor to retake the certification exam
options.cn: 要求承包商重新参加认证考试

options.en: Issue a citation and assess a fine
options.cn: 发出处罚通知并处以罚款

explanation_en: Under B&P Code Section 7058.6(a), if a contractor fails to register with the Division of Occupational Safety and Health within 90 days of being notified of passing the certification exam, the board may require a reexamination, and applicable test fees must be paid.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7058.6(a)条，如果承包商在获通知通过认证考试后的90天内未向职业安全与健康部门注册，委员会可以要求重新考试，并且必须支付相应的考试费用。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7058.6(a) (Document p. 251, PDF p. 274)

question_en: How many unrelated building trades or crafts must a single contract include for a residential remodeling (B-2) contractor to legally take that contract?
question_cn: 一个住宅改造（B-2）承包商要合法地承接某个合同，该合同必须包含多少种不相关的建筑行业或工艺？

options.en: At least two unrelated building trades or crafts
options.cn: 至少两种不相关的建筑行业或工艺

options.en: At least three unrelated building trades or crafts
options.cn: 至少三种不相关的建筑行业或工艺

options.en: At least four unrelated building trades or crafts
options.cn: 至少四种不相关的建筑行业或工艺

options.en: At least one specialized trade or craft
options.cn: 至少一种专业行业或工艺

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7057.5(a) defines a residential remodeling contractor as one whose contracts require the use of at least three unrelated building trades or crafts. Section 7057.5(b)(2) reinforces this by prohibiting the B-2 from taking a contract with fewer than three trades.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7057.5(a)条将住宅改造承包商定义为其合同需至少使用三种不相关的建筑行业或工艺的人。第7057.5(b)(2)条进一步强调，B-2承包商不得承接少于三种行业的合同。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7057.5(a) (Document p. 249, PDF p. 272)

question_en: A contractor not certified for asbestos work wins a bid on a project that includes asbestos removal. Under what condition may the contractor legally proceed?
question_cn: 一名未获得环保石棉工作认证的承包商中标了一个包含石棉清除的项目。在什么情况下，该承包商可以合法进行工作？

options.en: If the asbestos work is subcontracted to a C-22 certified contractor
options.cn: 如果石棉工作分包给持有C-22认证的承包商

options.en: If the contractor completes the CSLB open book exam first
options.cn: 如果承包商先完成CSLB公开考试

options.en: If the asbestos surface area is under 100 square feet
options.cn: 如果石棉表面积低于100平方英尺

options.en: If the contractor registers with DOSH within 90 days
options.cn: 如果承包商在90天内向DOSH注册

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7058.6(c) expressly allows a contractor who is not certified for asbestos work to bid and contract for such a project, provided the asbestos-related work is performed by a contractor holding the C-22 classification or who is certified and registered under applicable law.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7058.6(c)条明确允许未获得石棉工作认证的承包商对该项目投标和签订合同，前提是石棉相关工作由持有C-22分类的承包商或根据适用法律获得认证和注册的承包商进行。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7058.6(c) (Document p. 252, PDF p. 275)

question_en: Which contractor classification must be used for a project involving the installation of carpet, linoleum, and resilient floor covering?
question_cn: 涉及地毯、油毡地板和弹性地面覆盖物安装的项目必须使用哪种承包商类别？

options.en: General engineering contractor (A license)
options.cn: 一般工程承包商（A 牌照）
