options.en: General building contractor (B license)
options.cn: 一般建筑承包商（B 牌照）

options.en: Specialty contractor
options.cn: 专业承包商

options.en: Residential remodeling contractor (B-2 license)
options.cn: 住宅改造承包商（B-2 牌照）

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7058(c) expressly states that a specialty contractor includes a contractor whose operations are concerned with the installation and laying of carpets, linoleum, and resilient floor covering.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7058(c)条明确规定，专业承包商包括从事地毯、油毡地板和弹性地面覆盖物安装和铺设的承包商。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7058(c) (Document p. 250, PDF p. 273)

question_en: A contractor performing asbestos-related work must engage in how many square feet of asbestos-containing material surface area before a C-22 classification or asbestos certification is required?
question_cn: 承包商在从事石棉相关工作时，必须处理多少平方英尺的含石棉材料表面面积才需要 C-22 分类或石棉认证？

options.en: 500 square feet or more of surface area
options.cn: 500 平方英尺或更多的表面面积

options.en: 100 square feet or more of surface area
options.cn: 100 平方英尺或更多的表面面积

options.en: 50 square feet or more of surface area
options.cn: 50 平方英尺或更多的表面面积

options.en: 200 square feet or more of surface area
options.cn: 200 平方英尺或更多的表面面积

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7058.5 states that a contractor shall not engage in asbestos-related work that involves 100 square feet or more of surface area of asbestos-containing materials unless the contractor holds a C-22 classification or the qualifier has passed an asbestos certification examination.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 7058.5 条规定，承包商不得从事涉及 100 平方英尺或更多含石棉材料表面面积的石棉相关工作，除非承包商持有 C-22 分类或相关资格已通过石棉认证考试。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7058.5 (Document p. 251, PDF p. 274)

question_en: A licensee operates a business under a name implying expertise in fire suppression systems, but holds only a B license. Which of the following best describes the violation?
question_cn: 持牌人以暗示其在灭火系统方面具有专业知识的名称经营业务，但仅持有 B 类执照。以下哪项最能描述该违规行为？

options.en: Using a business name incompatible with the issued license
options.cn: 使用与所颁发执照不符的商业名称

options.en: Contracting for fire protection work without proper certification
options.cn: 未经适当认证承接防火工程

options.en: Operating without the required specialty classification
options.cn: 未取得所需的专业类别便经营

options.en: Conducting business under more than one license name
options.cn: 使用多个执照名称开展业务

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7059.1(a) prohibits a licensee from using any business name that indicates qualification to perform work in classifications other than those issued for that license. A B licensee using a name implying fire suppression expertise violates this provision directly.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7059.1(a)条禁止持牌人使用任何表明其有资格从事其执照未颁发分类工作的商业名称。B 类持照人使用暗示具有灭火专业知识的名称，直接违反了该条规定。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7059.1(a) (Document p. 255, PDF p. 278)

question_en: A contractor successfully passes the hazardous substance certification exam. Which of the following activities would still fall OUTSIDE the scope of 'removal or remedial action' requiring that certification?
question_cn: 一名承包商成功通过了有害物质认证考试。以下哪些活动仍然属于需要该认证的“清除或修复行动”范围之外？

options.en: Excavating contaminated earth at a DTSC-listed release site
options.cn: 在 DTSC 列出的泄漏地点挖掘受污染的土壤

options.en: Cleaning up a hazardous substance spill on a state highway
options.cn: 清理州际公路上的有害物质泄漏

options.en: Removing an underground storage tank at a listed site
options.cn: 在列名地点移除地下储罐

options.en: Digging and removing contaminated soil at a Superfund site
options.cn: 在超级基金地点挖掘并移除受污染土壤

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7058.7(d) expressly excludes 'work related to a hazardous substance spill on a highway' from the definition of 'removal or remedial action.' The hazardous substance certification is therefore not required for this activity.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 7058.7(d) 条明确将“与高速公路上有害物质泄漏有关的工作”排除在“清除或修复行动”的定义之外。因此，该活动不需要有害物质认证。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7058.7(d) (Document p. 253, PDF p. 276)

question_en: A contractor applying for an additional license classification is required to pay which of the following fees?
question_cn: 申请额外执照类别的承包商需要支付以下哪项费用？

options.en: An additional license fee only, no application fee
options.cn: 仅支付额外执照费用，无需申请费

options.en: No fees, because additional classifications are free
options.cn: 无需费用，因为额外类别是免费的

options.en: The application fee only, no additional license fee
options.cn: 仅支付申请费，无需额外执照费用

options.en: Both the application fee and an additional license fee
options.cn: 同时支付申请费和额外执照费用

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7059(a) provides that an application for an additional classification must be accompanied by the application fee fixed by this chapter, but expressly states that no license fee shall be charged for an additional classification.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7059(a)条规定，申请额外类别必须附上本章规定的申请费，但明确说明额外类别不收取执照费。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7059(a) (Document p. 254, PDF p. 277)

question_en: A corporation applying for a contractor's license is required to provide which of the following to the CSLB?
question_cn: 申请承包商执照的公司需要向CSLB提供以下哪项？

options.en: Its Secretary of State identification number
options.cn: 公司的州务卿识别号码

options.en: A copy of corporate bylaws and meeting minutes
options.cn: 公司章程及会议记录的副本

options.en: A list of all shareholders owning more than 10 percent
options.cn: 所有持股超过10%的股东名单

options.en: A surety bond in the corporate entity's name
options.cn: 以公司名义的保证金

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7065(b)(2) expressly requires that a corporation or limited liability company seeking licensure shall provide its identification number issued by the Secretary of State as part of the application.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7065(b)(2)条明确规定，寻求许可的公司或有限责任公司在申请时必须提供其由州务卿签发的识别号码。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7065(b)(2) (Document p. 256, PDF p. 279)

question_en: Which of the following installation activities would exempt a person from the contractor licensing requirements of Business and Professions Code Chapter 9?
question_cn: 以下哪项安装活动可以使个人免于遵守《加州商业与职业法典》第9章的承包商许可要求？

options.en: Installing HVAC systems on commercial buildings
options.cn: 在商业建筑上安装暖通空调系统

options.en: Installing satellite antennas on residential structures only
options.cn: 仅在住宅建筑上安装卫星天线

options.en: Installing any antenna system on a residential structure
options.cn: 在住宅建筑上安装任何天线系统

options.en: Installing satellite antennas on commercial properties
options.cn: 在商业物业上安装卫星天线

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7054.5 exempts persons registered under Chapter 20 from the licensing provisions of Chapter 9, but only when their activities consist solely of installing satellite antenna systems on residential structures or property.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7054.5条规定，在第20章注册的人员，如果其活动仅限于在住宅建筑或物业上安装卫星天线系统，可以免于第9章的许可规定。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7054.5 (Document p. 247, PDF p. 270)

question_en: After passing the asbestos certification examination, within how many days must a contractor register with the Division of Occupational Safety and Health to avoid a potential reexamination requirement?
question_cn: 在通过石棉认证考试后，承包商必须在多少天内向职业安全与健康部注册，以避免可能的重新考试要求？

options.en: Within 30 days of passing the exam
options.cn: 在通过考试后的30天内

options.en: Within 60 days of passing the exam
options.cn: 在通过考试后的60天内

options.en: Within 180 days of passing the exam
options.cn: 在通过考试后的180天内

options.en: Within 90 days of passing the exam
options.cn: 在通过考试后的90天内

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7058.6(a) requires the contractor to register with the Division of Occupational Safety and Health within 90 days from the date the contractor is notified of passing the certification examination. Failure to do so may result in the board requiring a reexamination.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7058.6(a)条要求承包商在收到通过认证考试通知之日起90天内向职业安全与健康部注册。未能按时注册可能导致委员会要求重新考试。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7058.6(a) (Document p. 251, PDF p. 274)

question_en: A qualifying individual (RME) disassociates from a licensed contractor. If the licensee fails to replace the qualifier within the required period, what automatically happens to the license?
question_cn: 具有资格的个人（RME）与持证承包商解除关联。如果持证人未在规定期限内更换资格人，会自动发生什么情况？

options.en: The license is automatically suspended or classification removed.
options.cn: 许可证会自动被暂停或分类被移除。

options.en: The license is revoked permanently by the board.
options.cn: 许可证会被委员会永久吊销。

options.en: The license is placed on inactive status indefinitely.
options.cn: 许可证会被无限期置于非活跃状态。

options.en: The licensee receives a 30-day cure notice from CSLB.
options.cn: 持证人会收到来自CSLB的30天整改通知。

explanation_en: Under B&P Code §7068.2(a), if the licensee fails to replace the qualifier within 90 days of disassociation, the license is automatically suspended or the classification is removed at the end of the 90-day period.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》 §7068.2(a)，如果持证人在解除关联后的90天内未更换资格人，执照将在90天期限结束时自动被暂停或分类被移除。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7068.2(a) (Document p. 265, PDF p. 288)

question_en: Under what condition may a qualifying individual act as the qualifier for more than one licensed firm without violating B&P Code Section 7068.1?
question_cn: 在什么情况下，合格个人可以作为多个持牌公司的资格担保人而不违反 《加州商业与职业法典》第 7068.1 条？

options.en: The registrar grants written approval in advance.
options.cn: 注册主任事先书面批准。

options.en: Each firm operates in a different license classification.
options.cn: 每家公司在不同的许可证分类下运作。

options.en: There is common ownership of at least 20 percent equity in each firm.
options.cn: 每家公司至少有 20% 的股权属于共同所有。

options.en: Each firm has fewer than five total employees.
options.cn: 每家公司员工总数不足五人。

explanation_en: B&P Code §7068.1(a)(1) allows a qualifying individual to serve multiple firms when there is common ownership of at least 20 percent of the equity of each firm for which the person qualifies.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 7068.1(a)(1) 条允许当个人所担保的每家公司至少有 20% 的股权属于共同所有时，合格个人可以为多家公司服务。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7068.1(a)(1) (Document p. 264, PDF p. 287)

question_en: A qualifying individual violates B&P Code Section 7068.1 by improperly serving as qualifier for multiple firms. What is the maximum fine that can be imposed?
question_cn: 资格人员违反《加州商业与职业法典》第7068.1条款，通过不正当地为多个公司担任资格人。可以处以的最高罚款是多少？
explanation_en: B&P Code §7068.1(e) states that violations are punishable by a fine of not less than $3,000 and not to exceed $5,000, making $5,000 the maximum allowable fine.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7068.1(e)条规定，违规行为的处罚为罚款不少于3,000美元且不超过5,000美元，因此最高允许罚款为5,000美元。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7068.1(e) (Document p. 265, PDF p. 288)

question_en: A licensee's responsible managing officer (RMO) unexpectedly dies. The licensee petitions for an extension to find a replacement. What is the maximum total time the licensee has to replace the qualifier from the date of death?
question_cn: 执照持有人的负责管理官（RMO）意外去世。执照持有人申请延长时间以寻找替代人选。从去世之日起，执照持有人替换资格人的最长总时间是多少？

options.en: 270 days from the date of death.
options.cn: 从去世之日起 270 天。

options.en: 180 days from the date of death.
options.cn: 从去世之日起 180 天。

options.en: 90 days from the date of death.
options.cn: 从去世之日起 90 天。

options.en: One year from the date of death.
options.cn: 从去世之日起一年。

explanation_en: B&P Code §7068.2(e)(2) states that under circumstances including the death of a qualifier, the licensee shall have no more than a total of 180 days after the date of death in which to replace the qualifier.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》 §7068.2(e)(2) 规定，在包括资格人去世的情况下，执照持有人自去世之日起最多有 180 天的时间来替换资格人。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7068.2(e)(2) (Document p. 265, PDF p. 288)

question_en: Which of the following entities does NOT need a court-appointed guardian before a license can be issued if a minor holds a responsible official position?
question_cn: 如果未成年人担任负责人职务，下列哪种实体在发放许可证之前不需要法院指定的监护人？

options.en: A partnership where one partner is a minor.
options.cn: 一个合伙企业，其中一名合伙人为未成年人。

options.en: An LLC with a minor as responsible managing member.
options.cn: 一个有限责任公司，其负责人管理成员为未成年人。

options.en: A corporation with a minor as director.
options.cn: 一家公司的董事为未成年人。

options.en: A sole owner who is an emancipated adult.
options.cn: 一个作为已成年独立人的单独所有者。

explanation_en: B&P Code §7065.5 restricts only minors from being licensed without a guardian. An emancipated adult (18 or older) is not a minor and therefore falls outside the guardian requirement entirely.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7065.5条仅限制未成年人在没有监护人的情况下获得执照。已成年独立人（18岁或以上）不是未成年人，因此完全不受监护人要求的约束。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7065.5 (Document p. 261, PDF p. 284)

question_en: A contractor's responsible managing employee (RME) works 30 hours per week for the contractor. The contractor's business operates 40 hours per week. Does this RME meet the 'actively engaged' requirement under B&P Code Section 7068?
question_cn: 承包商的负责管理员工（RME）每周为承包商工作30小时。承包商的业务每周运营40小时。该RME是否符合《加州商业与职业法典》第7068条下的“积极参与”要求？

options.en: Yes, because 30 hours exceeds the 28-hour threshold.
options.cn: 是的，因为30小时超过了28小时的最低要求。

options.en: No, because the RME must work all 40 business hours.
options.cn: 否，因为RME必须工作所有40小时的业务时间。

options.en: No, the RME falls short of the required 32 hours.
options.cn: 否，RME未达到要求的32小时。

options.en: Yes, because 30 hours equals 75 percent of 40 hours.
options.cn: 是的，因为30小时相当于40小时的75%。

explanation_en: Under B&P Code §7068(c)(2)(B), 'actively engaged' means 32 hours per week or 80 percent of the business's operating hours, whichever is less. Here, 80% of 40 hours = 32 hours. The RME works only 30 hours and fails both tests.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7068(c)(2)(B)条，“积极参与”是指每周32小时或业务运营时间的80%，以较少者为准。这里，40小时的80% = 32小时。RME仅工作30小时，未通过两项标准。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7068(c)(2)(B) (Document p. 263, PDF p. 286)

question_en: Under what circumstance may the registrar waive the trade examination for a qualifying individual under B&P Code Section 7065.1?
question_cn: 在什么情况下，根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7065.1条，注册主任可以免除符合条件的个人的行业考试？

options.en: The individual passed a similar exam in a reciprocal state.
options.cn: 该个人在互惠州通过了类似的考试。

options.en: Listed on CSLB records for five of the prior seven years in active same-classification license.
options.cn: 在过去七年中的五年里，在同类执照下被列入 CSLB 的记录。

options.en: The qualifying individual passed the exam within the past two years.
options.cn: 符合条件的个人在过去两年内通过了考试。

options.en: The individual held a federal contractor position exempt from licensure.
options.cn: 该个人曾担任免于执照要求的联邦承包商职位。

explanation_en: B&P Code §7065.1(a) allows the registrar to waive the exam when the qualifying individual has been listed on CSLB's official records as personnel of an active, good-standing licensee in the same classification for five of the seven years preceding the application, while actively engaged in construction activities.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7065.1(a)条允许注册主任在符合条件的个人在申请前七年中的五年被列入 CSLB 官方记录，作为同类执照的人员，并且积极从事建筑活动时，免除其考试。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7065.1(a) (Document p. 258, PDF p. 281)

question_en: An applicant previously qualified for a license in good standing within the past four years under the same classification. Must they retake the qualifying examination for a new application?
question_cn: 申请人在过去四年内曾以相同类别成功获得许可，且许可状态良好。对于新的申请，他们是否必须重新参加资格考试？

options.en: No, qualifying as RME in good standing within five years exempts re-examination.
options.cn: 不，如果在五年内以良好状态获得RME资格，则无需重新考试。

options.en: Only if the registrar grants a discretionary waiver in writing.
options.cn: 只有在注册主任书面授予酌情豁免的情况下才需要。

options.en: No, if they personally passed the exam within five years.
options.cn: 不，如果他们在五年内亲自通过了考试。

options.en: Yes, a new exam is always required for original applications.
options.cn: 是的，原始申请总是需要新的考试。

explanation_en: B&P Code §7065(d) states no examination is required if, within the five-year period preceding the application, the individual served as qualifying individual for a licensee whose license was in good standing in the same classification. Four years satisfies this condition.
explanation_cn: 商业与职业法典 §7065(d) 规定，如果在申请前五年内，个人曾作为许可人合格人（qualifying individual），且该许可人的执照在相同类别下处于良好状态，则无需考试。四年的时间满足这一条件。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7065(d) (Document p. 257, PDF p. 280)

question_en: A qualifying individual currently serves as the RME for Firm A. Under B&P Code Section 7068.1, how many additional firms may this individual qualify for in a single year, assuming the ownership and structure conditions are met?
question_cn: 一名合格人员目前担任公司A的RME。根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7068.1条，如果符合所有权和结构条件，该人员在一年内最多可以为多少家其他公司担任资格认证？

options.en: An unlimited number, provided ownership conditions are satisfied.
options.cn: 只要满足所有权条件，没有数量限制。

options.en: Up to two additional firms, for a total of three.
options.cn: 最多两家额外公司，总共三家。

options.en: No additional firms; only one qualification is permitted.
options.cn: 不允许额外公司；只允许一次资格认证。

options.en: Up to four additional firms, for a total of five.
options.cn: 最多四家额外公司，总共五家。

explanation_en: B&P Code §7068.1(b) states that a qualifying individual may act as qualifier for no more than three firms in any one-year period. Since Firm A is already one, the individual may qualify for up to two additional firms.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7068.1(b)条规定，合格人员在任何一年内最多可为三家公司担任资格认证。由于公司A已为其中的一家，该人员最多可为另外两家公司担任资格认证。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7068.1(b) (Document p. 264, PDF p. 287)

question_en: Which of the following application types does NOT require signatures from both the applicant and the person qualifying on behalf of the firm?
question_cn: 以下哪种申请类型不需要申请人和代表公司资格的人双方签名？

options.en: An application to add a trade classification mid-term.
options.cn: 期中增加一个行业分类的申请。

options.en: An application for an inactive license renewal.
options.cn: 非活跃执照续期的申请。

options.en: An application for license reinstatement.
options.cn: 执照恢复的申请。

options.en: An application for an active original license.
options.cn: 新的活跃执照申请。

explanation_en: B&P Code §7067.6(a) lists original license, renewal, reinstatement, and reissuance applications as requiring dual signatures. Adding a classification mid-term is addressed under §7065.3 and is not among the four application types enumerated in §7067.6(a).
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7067.6(a)条列出了原始执照、续期、恢复和重发申请需要双签名。期中增加分类的申请适用于第7065.3条，并不在第7067.6(a)条列出的四种申请类型中。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7067.6(a) (Document p. 262, PDF p. 285)

question_en: A family member of a deceased licensee wants to take over the business and seeks an exam waiver. Under B&P Code Section 7065.1(b), which of the following must they demonstrate?
question_cn: 已故持牌人的家庭成员希望接管该业务并寻求考试豁免。根据加州商业与专业法第7065.1(b)条款，他们必须证明以下哪一项？

options.en: The family member must be the sole heir to the estate.
options.cn: 家庭成员必须是遗产的唯一继承人。

options.en: Active engagement for five of seven years preceding application.
options.cn: 在申请前的七年中有五年积极从事该业务。

options.en: The deceased licensee's license was inactive at time of death.
options.cn: 已故持牌人在去世时其执照处于不活跃状态。

options.en: Three years of active engagement in the licensee's business.
options.cn: 在持牌人的业务中积极从事三年。

explanation_en: B&P Code §7065.1(b)(1) requires the qualifying individual to have been actively engaged in the licensee's business for five of the seven years immediately preceding the application, among other conditions, to qualify for the exam waiver as an immediate family member.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与专业法》第7065.1(b)(1)条款要求符合条件的个人在申请前的七年中需有五年积极从事持牌人的业务，以及其他条件，才能作为直系家庭成员获得考试豁免。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7065.1(b) (Document p. 258, PDF p. 281)

question_en: Which entity type may use a responsible managing manager (RMM) to qualify for a contractor's license?
question_cn: 哪种实体类型可以使用负责任的管理经理（RMM）来获得承包商执照？

options.en: A limited liability company seeking a contractor's license.
options.cn: 申请承包商执照的有限责任公司。

options.en: A general partnership applying for licensure.
options.cn: 申请执照的一般合伙企业。

options.en: A corporation applying under the B license.
options.cn: 根据B类执照申请的公司。

options.en: A sole proprietor applying as an individual.
options.cn: 以个人身份申请的独资经营者。

explanation_en: B&P Code §7065(c)(4) specifically allows a limited liability company to qualify through a responsible managing officer, responsible managing manager, responsible managing member, or responsible managing employee — options not available to other entity types.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》 §7065(c)(4) 明确允许有限责任公司通过负责任的管理官员、负责任的管理经理、负责任的管理成员或负责任的管理员工来符合资格——其他实体类型不可使用这些选项。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7065(c)(4) (Document p. 257, PDF p. 280)

question_en: A qualifying individual commits a violation of B&P Code Section 7068.1. In addition to a fine, what other penalty may a court impose?
question_cn: 符合条件的个人违反了《加州商业与职业法典》第7068.1条。除了罚款，法院还可能施加什么其他处罚？

options.en: Mandatory suspension for a minimum of two years.
options.cn: 强制暂停至少两年。

options.en: State prison sentence of up to one year.
options.cn: 州监狱刑期最长一年。

options.en: Permanent revocation of all contractor licenses held.
options.cn: 永久吊销所持有的所有承包商执照。

options.en: County jail imprisonment not to exceed six months.
options.cn: 县监禁不得超过六个月。

explanation_en: B&P Code §7068.1(e) provides that violation shall be punishable as a misdemeanor by imprisonment in a county jail not to exceed six months, by a fine of $3,000 to $5,000, or by both.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7068.1(e)条规定，违反该条款应作为轻罪处罚，可处以县监狱监禁不超过六个月，罚款3,000美元至5,000美元，或者两者并罚。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7068.1(e) (Document p. 265, PDF p. 288)

question_en: A licensee's qualifier disassociates, but neither the licensee nor the qualifier notifies the registrar for 110 days. When does the license get suspended under B&P Code Section 7068.2(c)?
question_cn: 如果持牌人的资格人解除关联，但持牌人和资格人均未在110天内通知注册处，根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7068.2(c)条，执照何时会被暂停？

options.en: After a 30-day cure period following CSLB's investigation.
options.cn: 在CSLB调查后的30天补救期结束后。

options.en: On the date the board receives written notification.
options.cn: 在委员会收到书面通知之日。

options.en: Automatically on day 180 after disassociation.
options.cn: 在解除关联后第180天自动生效。

options.en: Automatically on day 90 after disassociation.
options.cn: 在解除关联后第90天自动生效。

explanation_en: B&P Code §7068.2(c) states that if neither the licensee nor the qualifier notifies CSLB within 90 days, the license shall be automatically suspended effective the date written notification is received at the board's headquarters — which in this case is day 110.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7068.2(c)条规定，如果持牌人或资格人在90天内均未通知CSLB，执照应在委员会总部收到书面通知之日自动暂停——在此情况下为第110天。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7068.2(c) (Document p. 265, PDF p. 288)

question_en: Under B&P Code Section 7065.3, to add a classification without examination, the qualifying individual must demonstrate at least how many years of experience as a journeyman, foreman, or supervisor within the past 10 years?
question_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7065.3条，要在不经过考试的情况下添加一个职业分类，符合条件的个人必须在过去10年内至少具备多少年的技工、领班或主管经验？

options.en: Three years within the last 10 years.
options.cn: 最近10年内三年。

options.en: Five years within the last 10 years.
options.cn: 最近10年内五年。

options.en: Four years within the last 10 years.
options.cn: 最近10年内四年。

options.en: Two years within the last 10 years.
options.cn: 最近10年内两年。

explanation_en: B&P Code §7065.3(b) requires the qualifying individual to have had not less than four years of experience as a journeyman, foreman, supervising employee, or contractor in the applicable classification within the last 10 years preceding the application.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7065.3(b)条要求，符合条件的个人在提交申请前的最近10年内，在适用的职业分类中，至少应有四年的技工、领班、监督员工或承包商经验。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7065.3(b) (Document p. 260, PDF p. 283)

question_en: A contractor is arrested while holding an active license. Within how many days of the disposition must the registrar receive proof of the matter's outcome?
question_cn: 承包商在持有有效执照期间被逮捕。注册主任必须在判决后的多少天内收到此事结果的证明？

options.en: Within 45 days of the disposition
options.cn: 判决后 45 天内

options.en: Within 30 days of the disposition
options.cn: 判决后 30 天内

options.en: Within 60 days of the disposition
options.cn: 判决后 60 天内

options.en: Within 90 days of the disposition
options.cn: 判决后 90 天内

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7069.1(b) states that proof of the arrest disposition shall be received by the registrar within 90 days of the date of disposition, or within 90 days of the registrar's demand if that date is later.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 7069.1(b) 条规定，注册主任应在判决之日起 90 天内收到逮捕判决的证明，或者如果注册主任要求的日期较晚，则应在收到要求之日起 90 天内收到。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7069.1 (Document p. 267, PDF p. 290)

question_en: An applicant whose license was denied reapplies the following month. What must the board inform the applicant of when denying a license application?
question_cn: 申请人的执照被拒后，下个月再次申请。拒绝执照申请时，委员会必须告知申请人哪些事项？

options.en: Whether the denial is final or appealable
options.cn: 拒绝是否为最终决定或可上诉

options.en: The specific grounds cited for denial
options.cn: 被拒绝的具体理由

options.en: The total fees owed before reapplication
options.cn: 重新申请前需缴纳的总费用

options.en: The earliest date the applicant may reapply
options.cn: 申请人可以重新申请的最早日期

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7070 requires the board, in its decision or notice, to inform the applicant of the earliest reapplication date, which is generally one year from the effective date of the decision unless the board prescribes an earlier date.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7070条要求委员会在其决定或通知中告知申请人最早可重新申请的日期，通常为从决定生效日起一年，但委员会可规定更早的日期。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7070 (Document p. 267, PDF p. 290)

question_en: A licensee enlists in the U.S. Army. Within how many days of entering the armed forces must the licensee notify the registrar of the names of designated managing persons?
question_cn: 一名持证人加入美国陆军。进入军队后，持证人必须在多少天内将指定管理人员的姓名通知注册主任？

options.en: Within 90 days of entering the armed forces
options.cn: 进入军队后 90 天内

options.en: Within 60 days of entering the armed forces
options.cn: 进入军队后 60 天内

options.en: Within 30 days of entering the armed forces
options.cn: 进入军队后 30 天内

options.en: Within 10 days of entering the armed forces
options.cn: 进入军队后 10 天内

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7071.3 states the license remains in full force for 30 days after entry into the armed forces, and the licensee must provide the registrar with designee names prior to the expiration of that 30-day period.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7071.3条规定，持证人在加入军队后30天内执照仍然有效，持证人必须在这30天期限到期前向注册主任提供指定人员的姓名。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7071.3 (Document p. 268, PDF p. 291)

question_en: A contractor's license expires and the licensee submits a renewal application within 90 days with the required fees. Which of the following correctly describes the effect of this late renewal?
question_cn: 承包商的执照到期后，持证人在 90 天内提交续期申请并支付所需费用。以下哪项正确描述了此延期续期的效果？

options.en: The registrar grants retroactive renewal to expiration date
options.cn: 登记主管授予追溯至到期日的续期

options.en: The delinquency fee is waived for on-time filers
options.cn: 对准时提交者免收拖欠费用

options.en: The license is reinstated with no gap in coverage
options.cn: 执照在未中断的情况下恢复有效

options.en: The licensee must reapply as a new applicant
options.cn: 持证人必须作为新申请人重新申请

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7141.5 provides that the registrar shall grant retroactive renewal if, within 90 days of expiration, the licensee submits a completed renewal application and pays both the renewal fee and the delinquency fee.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 7141.5 条规定，如果持证人在到期后 90 天内提交完整的续期申请并支付续期费和拖欠费，登记主管应授予追溯续期。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7141.5 (Document p. 361, PDF p. 384)

question_en: A contractor's license is revoked. What process must the contractor follow to practice again?
question_cn: 承包商的执照被吊销。承包商必须遵循什么程序才能再次执业？

options.en: Appeal to the board within 90 days of revocation
options.cn: 在吊销之日起90天内向委员会提出上诉

options.en: Renew the revoked license after paying penalties
options.cn: 支付罚款后续期被吊销的执照

options.en: Wait one year, then submit a renewal application
options.cn: 等待一年，然后提交续期申请

options.en: Apply for reinstatement meeting all original requirements
options.cn: 申请恢复执照，满足所有原始要求

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7144 states that a revoked license is treated as expired and cannot be renewed. To reinstate, the licensee must pay all fees and meet all qualifications required for an original license.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7144条规定，被吊销的执照视为已过期，不能续期。要恢复执照，持证人必须支付所有费用，并满足申请原始执照所需的所有资格。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7144 (Document p. 362, PDF p. 385)

question_en: A licensee submits a renewal application that is rejected for incompleteness. If the corrected application is not returned within how many days of the original rejection will the application and fee be deemed abandoned?
question_cn: 持证人提交的续期申请因不完整而被拒。如果在原始拒绝后的多少天内未提交更正后的申请，该申请和费用将被视为放弃？

options.en: Within 60 days of the original rejection
options.cn: 在原始拒绝后60天内

options.en: Within 45 days of the original rejection
options.cn: 在原始拒绝后45天内

options.en: Within 90 days of the original rejection
options.cn: 在原始拒绝后90天内

options.en: Within 30 days of the original rejection
options.cn: 在原始拒绝后30天内

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7145 states that if a licensee fails to return a rejected incomplete renewal application within 90 days of the original rejection date, the application and fee shall be deemed abandoned and may not be reinstated.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7145条规定，如果持证人在原始拒绝之日起90天内未提交被拒绝的不完整续期申请，申请和费用将被视为放弃，且不能恢复。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7145 (Document p. 362, PDF p. 385)

question_en: A corporation applies for a contractor's license. One of its directors has a prior criminal conviction that would be grounds for denial under Section 480. Under what condition may the corporation still receive a license?
question_cn: 一家公司申请承包商执照。其一名董事有先前的刑事定罪，根据第480条，该情况将成为拒绝发放执照的理由。在什么情况下公司仍可获得执照？

options.en: If the director resigns before the license is issued
options.cn: 如果该董事在执照发放前辞职

options.en: If the director has completed their sentence
options.cn: 如果该董事已完成刑期

options.en: The corporation cannot receive a license in this case
options.cn: 在这种情况下，公司无法获得执照

options.en: If the conviction is more than five years old
options.cn: 如果定罪超过五年

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7071 states no license shall be issued to a corporation if a responsible officer or director does not meet the qualifications required of an applicant other than those relating to knowledge and experience. A disqualifying criminal conviction bars the corporation.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7071条规定，如果负责的高管或董事不符合申请人所需的资格（不包括与知识和经验相关的资格），则不得向公司发放执照。导致不合格的刑事定罪会阻止公司获得执照。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7071 (Document p. 268, PDF p. 291)

question_en: A licensee receives an unsatisfied final judgment but notifies the CSLB registrar in writing within 90 days. What must the licensee do to maintain the license?
question_cn: 如果持牌人收到未履行的最终判决，但在90天内以书面形式通知CSLB注册主任，持牌人必须做什么以维持执照？

options.en: Request a CSLB hearing within 30 days
options.cn: 在30天内请求CSLB听证会

options.en: Pay the judgment in full immediately
options.cn: 立即全额支付判决金额

options.en: File a bond equal to the unsatisfied judgment amount
options.cn: 提交一份等于未履行判决金额的担保

options.en: Cease all contracting work until judgment is resolved
options.cn: 在判决解决之前停止所有承包工作

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7071.17(b)(3) states that if the licensee timely notifies the registrar within 90 days, the licensee must file or have on file a bond sufficient to guarantee payment equal to all unsatisfied judgments as a condition of maintaining the license.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7071.17(b)(3)条规定，如果持牌人在90天内及时通知注册主任，持牌人必须提交或已有提交一份担保，以保证支付等于所有未履行判决的金额，作为维持执照的条件。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7071.17(b)(3) (Document p. 281, PDF p. 304)

question_en: A licensee receives an unsatisfied final judgment but fails to notify the CSLB registrar in writing. When does the license become automatically suspended?
question_cn: 如果持证人收到未偿付的终局判决，但未以书面形式通知CSLB注册主任，执照何时会自动被吊销？

options.en: When the registrar is informed of the judgment
options.cn: 当注册主任被告知判决时

options.en: At the next license renewal date
options.cn: 在下次执照续期日期

options.en: On the date the judgment was entered
options.cn: 判决作出之日

options.en: 90 days after the judgment was entered
options.cn: 判决作出后90天

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7071.17(b)(1) states that if the licensee fails to notify the registrar within 90 days, the license 'shall be automatically suspended on the date that the registrar is informed, or is made aware of the unsatisfied final judgment.'
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7071.17(b)(1)条规定，如果持证人在90天内未通知注册主任，执照“应在注册主任被告知或得知未偿付的终局判决之日自动吊销。”
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7071.17(b)(1) (Document p. 281, PDF p. 304)

question_en: A licensee was convicted of a felony. Within how many days must the licensee report this conviction to the CSLB registrar in writing?
question_cn: 持证人被判犯重罪。持证人必须在多少天内以书面形式将此判决报告给CSLB注册主任？

options.en: Within 30 days of obtaining knowledge
options.cn: 在获悉后30天内

options.en: Within 60 days of obtaining knowledge
options.cn: 在获悉后60天内

options.en: Within 7 days of obtaining knowledge
options.cn: 在获悉后7天内

options.en: Within 90 days of obtaining knowledge
options.cn: 在获悉后90天内

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7071.18(a) requires a licensee to report a felony conviction — or any substantially related crime — to the registrar in writing within 90 days after the licensee obtains knowledge of the event.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7071.18(a)条规定，持证人必须在获悉重罪判决或任何实质相关的犯罪后90天内，以书面形式向注册主任报告该事件。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7071.18(a) (Document p. 283, PDF p. 306)

question_en: A licensee submits a report under B&P Code Section 7071.20 and the registrar determines that disciplinary action is unnecessary. What happens to that report?
question_cn: 持证人根据《职业与业务法典》第7071.20条提交报告，注册主任认为不需要采取纪律处分。该报告会如何处理？

options.en: It is returned and deemed resolved in the licensee's favor
options.cn: 它会被退回，并视为以持证人有利的方式解决

options.en: It is forwarded to the attorney general for review
options.cn: 它会被转交总检察长审查

options.en: It is kept on file as a formal complaint
options.cn: 它会作为正式投诉保存在档案中

options.en: It is posted publicly on the licensee's license record
options.cn: 它会公开发布在持证人的执照记录上

explanation_en: Under B&P Code §7071.20(e)(2), a report returned to the licensee after the registrar finds no grounds for action is deemed a complaint resolved in favor of the licensee, and the underlying facts cannot be re-reviewed unless an independent complaint is received.
explanation_cn: 根据《职业与业务法典》第7071.20(e)(2)条，如果注册主任认定没有采取行动的依据而将报告退还给持证人，该报告被视为以持证人有利解决的投诉，除非收到独立的投诉，否则其相关事实不得重新审查。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7071.20(e)(2) (Document p. 287, PDF p. 310)

question_en: A contractor's application for an original license is approved, but the contractor fails to pay the initial license fee after being notified. After how many days does the application become void?
question_cn: 承包商的原始执照申请已获批准，但在收到通知后未支付初始执照费。申请在多少天后失效？

options.en: 90 days from the date of notice
options.cn: 从通知之日起90天

options.en: 180 days from the date of notice
options.cn: 从通知之日起180天

options.en: 30 days from the date of notice
options.cn: 从通知之日起30天

options.en: 60 days from the date of notice
options.cn: 从通知之日起60天

explanation_en: B&P Code §7074(a)(2) states that an application becomes void if the applicant fails to pay the initial license fee within 90 days from the date of the notice to do so.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》(B&P Code) §7074(a)(2)规定，如果申请人在收到支付初始执照费的通知之日起90天内未付款，申请将失效。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7074(a)(2) (Document p. 291, PDF p. 314)

question_en: A contractor's license application is voided due to a medical emergency that prevented the applicant from appearing for the examination. What relief is available under B&P Code Section 7074?
question_cn: 承包商执照申请因医疗紧急情况而作废，该情况阻止了申请人参加考试。根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7074条，可提供哪些救济？

options.en: The void date may be extended up to 90 days
options.cn: 作废日期可以延长至最多90天

options.en: Application is automatically reinstated without conditions
options.cn: 申请会在没有条件下自动恢复

options.en: A new application must be filed with the full fee
options.cn: 必须提交新申请并支付全额费用

options.en: The exam fee is waived but no extension is granted
options.cn: 考试费用被免除，但不予延长

explanation_en: B&P Code §7074(b) allows the void date to be extended up to 90 days, or one examination to be rescheduled without a fee, upon documented evidence that failure to complete the process was due to a medical emergency or other circumstance beyond the applicant's control.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7074(b)条允许在有书面证据证明未能完成流程是由于医疗紧急情况或其他超出申请人控制的情况时，作废日期可以延长至最多90天，或可免费重新安排一次考试。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7074(b) (Document p. 291, PDF p. 314)

question_en: An individual contractor dies while holding an active license. A family member wants to continue the business. What must happen within 90 days of the contractor's death to request license continuance?
question_cn: 一名个人承包商在持有有效执照期间去世。其家庭成员希望继续经营业务。在承包商去世后的90天内，必须做什么以申请执照延续？

options.en: Submit a written request to the board's headquarters
options.cn: 向委员会总部提交书面请求

options.en: File a new license application with examination fees
options.cn: 提交新的执照申请并支付考试费用

options.en: Notify the registrar by phone within 90 days
options.cn: 在90天内通过电话通知注册主任

options.en: Post a new contractor's bond in the deceased's name
options.cn: 以已故者名义发布新的承包商保证金

explanation_en: B&P Code §7076(a) requires that the request for continuance be made in writing and received at the board's headquarters office within 90 days after the death of the individual licensee.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7076(a)条要求，在个人持证人去世后的90天内，延续请求必须以书面形式提出并送达委员会总部办公室。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7076(a) (Document p. 293, PDF p. 316)

question_en: Under what circumstances may a CSLB license number be reassigned to a different individual under B&P Code Section 7075.1?
question_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7075.1条款，在什么情况下CSLB执照号码可以分配给不同的个人？

options.en: When any employee purchases the contracting business
options.cn: 当任何员工购买承包业务时

options.en: When an immediate family member continues a deceased licensee's business
options.cn: 当直系亲属继续已故执照持有人的业务时

options.en: When the licensee relocates the business to another county
options.cn: 当执照持有人将业务迁移到另一个县时

options.en: When a partner buys out the other partners
options.cn: 当合伙人买断其他合伙人时

explanation_en: B&P Code §7075.1(c)(3) permits a license number to be reassigned to an individual who is an immediate family member of a licensed individual who is deceased or absent, when the license is required to continue an existing family contracting business.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7075.1(c)(3)条允许将执照号码重新分配给已获执照个人的直系亲属，如果执照是为了继续现有的家庭承包业务，并且该执照持有人已去世或缺席。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7075.1(c)(3) (Document p. 292, PDF p. 315)

question_en: A contractor who was denied a license due to a substantially related crime wants to know the earliest possible reapplication date. Under B&P Code Section 7073, what is the maximum time the board may set before reapplication is allowed?
question_cn: 一名因与其职业相关的犯罪而被拒发执照的承包商想知道最早可以重新申请的日期。根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7073条，董事会可以在重新申请前设定的最长时间是多少？

options.en: No more than five years from the denial date
options.cn: 从拒绝之日起不超过五年

options.en: No more than three years from the denial date
options.cn: 从拒绝之日起不超过三年

options.en: No more than ten years from the denial date
options.cn: 从拒绝之日起不超过十年

options.en: No more than two years from the denial date
options.cn: 从拒绝之日起不超过两年

explanation_en: B&P Code §7073(b) states that the reapplication date set by the registrar shall not be more than five years from the effective date of the decision or service of notice under subdivision (b) of Section 485.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7073(b)条规定，注册主任设定的重新申请日期不得超过自决定生效之日或根据第485条(b)款送达通知之日起五年。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7073(b) (Document p. 290, PDF p. 313)

question_en: After a person to whom a CSLB pocket card was issued leaves their position with a licensed company, what must happen to the card within five days?
question_cn: 当持有CSLB便携卡的人离开其持牌公司职位时，该卡在五天内必须发生什么处理？

options.en: The departing person mails it directly to the board
options.cn: 离职者将其直接邮寄给委员会

options.en: The licensee mails or delivers it to the board for cancellation
options.cn: 持牌人将其邮寄或送交委员会以取消

options.en: The card is transferred to the departing person's new employer
options.cn: 卡转移给离职者的新雇主

options.en: The card is destroyed by the departing person
options.cn: 卡由离职者销毁

explanation_en: B&P Code §7072.5(b) requires the departing person to surrender the card to the licensee, and within five days the licensee must mail or deliver the card to the board for cancellation.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7072.5(b)条要求离职者将卡交给持牌人，并且持牌人必须在五天内将卡邮寄或送交委员会以取消。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7072.5(b) (Document p. 289, PDF p. 312)

question_en: A contractor submits a report to the registrar under Section 7071.20 but the registrar needs more information before making a determination. How is that report treated pending review?
question_cn: 根据第7071.20条款，承包商向注册主任提交报告，但注册主任在做出决定前需要更多信息。该报告在审查期间如何处理？

options.en: Kept and treated as a complaint under Sections 7090 and 7091
options.cn: 根据第7090条和第7091条保留并视为投诉

options.en: Returned to the licensee pending supplemental submission
options.cn: 在补充提交期间退回给持证人

options.en: Forwarded to local law enforcement for investigation
options.cn: 转发给当地执法部门进行调查

options.en: Placed on hold with no further regulatory effect
options.cn: 暂停处理，无进一步监管效力

explanation_en: B&P Code §7071.20(e)(3) states that if additional information is needed, the registrar shall keep and regard the report as a complaint subject to Sections 7090 and 7091, which govern investigation and disciplinary proceedings.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》 §7071.20(e)(3) 规定，如果需要额外信息，注册主任应保留报告并将其视为根据第7090条和第7091条受调查和纪律处分程序管辖的投诉。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7071.20(e)(3) (Document p. 287, PDF p. 310)

question_en: A general partner in a licensed partnership dies. Within how many days must the remaining partners request a continuance of the license to undertake new work?
question_cn: 已授权合伙企业的一般合伙人去世。剩余的合伙人必须在多少天内申请执照延续以进行新工作？

options.en: Within 90 days of the death
options.cn: 在合伙人去世后的90天内

options.en: Within 30 days of the death
options.cn: 在合伙人去世后的30天内

options.en: Within 60 days of the death
options.cn: 在合伙人去世后的60天内

options.en: Within 120 days of the death
options.cn: 在合伙人去世后的120天内

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7076(b) requires the written request for a continuance to be received at the board's headquarters office within 90 days after the death of a general partner.
explanation_cn: 商业与职业法典第7076(b)条要求，书面延续申请必须在一般合伙人去世后的90天内送达委员会总部办公室。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7076(b) (Document p. 294, PDF p. 317)

question_en: A licensed partnership dissolves but the remaining partners fail to notify the CSLB registrar in writing. When is the license canceled?
question_cn: 有执照的合伙企业解散，但剩余的合伙人未能以书面形式通知 CSLB 注册员。许可证何时被取消？

options.en: 60 days after the board discovers the dissolution
options.cn: 董事会发现解散后的 60 天

options.en: On the date written notification is received
options.cn: 收到书面通知的日期

options.en: Exactly 90 days after the dissolution
options.cn: 解散后正好 90 天

options.en: On the date the dissolution occurred
options.cn: 解散发生的日期

explanation_en: Under B&P Code Section 7076(c), if partners fail to notify the registrar within 90 days, the license is canceled effective the date the written notification is actually received at the board's headquarters office.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第 7076(c) 条，如果合伙人在 90 天内未通知注册员，则许可证自书面通知实际收到董事会总部办公室之日起生效被取消。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7076(c) (Document p. 294, PDF p. 317)

question_en: A licensed partnership has only one limited partner, who dies. What must happen to keep the partnership license active?
question_cn: 一个持牌合伙企业只有一个有限合伙人，而该合伙人去世。为了保持合伙企业执照有效，必须做什么？

options.en: Add a new limited partner within 90 days
options.cn: 在90天内增加一个新的有限合伙人

options.en: Notify the registrar and apply for a new license immediately
options.cn: 通知登记员并立即申请新执照

options.en: Request a continuance within 60 days of the death
options.cn: 在死亡后60天内请求延续

options.en: Add a new limited partner within 30 days
options.cn: 在30天内增加一个新的有限合伙人

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7076(d) states that when a partnership has only one limited partner and that partner dies, the license is canceled unless a new limited partner is added to the license within 90 days of the death.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7076(d)条规定，当合伙企业只有一个有限合伙人且该合伙人去世时，除非在死亡后的90天内向执照添加新的有限合伙人，否则执照将被取消。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7076(d) (Document p. 294, PDF p. 317)

question_en: A joint venture license must be canceled when which of the following events occurs?
question_cn: 以下哪种情况发生时，合资企业许可证必须被取消？

options.en: Any entity member files for bankruptcy
options.cn: 任何实体成员申请破产

options.en: One entity's qualifier changes classification
options.cn: 某个实体的资格人改变了分类

options.en: The joint venture misses a license renewal deadline
options.cn: 合资企业错过了许可证续期截止日期

options.en: Any member entity's license is revoked or canceled
options.cn: 任何成员实体的许可证被撤销或取消

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7076(f) states that a joint venture license shall be canceled upon the cancellation, revocation, or disassociation of any of its entity licenses or upon dissolution of the joint venture.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7076(f)条规定，当任何实体的许可证被取消、吊销或解除关联，或合资企业解散时，合资企业许可证应被取消。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7076(f) (Document p. 295, PDF p. 318)

question_en: A corporation fails to notify the CSLB registrar of its dissolution. If the board later discovers the dissolution while researching corporate records, when is the license canceled?
question_cn: 如果公司未能通知 CSLB 注册员其解散情况。当董事会在研究公司记录时发现该解散，执照何时被取消？

options.en: 90 days after the board's discovery
options.cn: 董事会发现后 90 天

options.en: 30 days after the board's written notice
options.cn: 董事会书面通知后 30 天

options.en: On the date the dissolution actually occurred
options.cn: 解散实际发生的日期

options.en: 60 days after the board's discovery
options.cn: 董事会发现后 60 天

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7076(h) provides that if a corporation fails to notify the board of dissolution, merger, or surrender, the license shall be canceled 60 days after the board's discovery when researching the relevant corporate records.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 7076(h) 条规定，如果公司未能通知董事会关于解散、合并或放弃的情况，当董事会在研究相关公司记录时发现情况，执照应在 60 天后取消。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7076(h) (Document p. 296, PDF p. 319)

question_en: An LLC contractor fails to maintain good standing with the Secretary of State. After the registrar provides written notice, how long does the LLC have before its license is automatically suspended?
question_cn: 一家有限责任公司承包商未能保持与国务卿的良好信誉。在注册主任发出书面通知后，该有限责任公司在其执照被自动暂停之前有多长时间？

options.en: 30 days from the date of notice
options.cn: 自通知之日起30天

options.en: 60 days from the date of notice
options.cn: 自通知之日起60天

options.en: 90 days from the date of notice
options.cn: 自通知之日起90天

options.en: 180 days from the date of notice
options.cn: 自通知之日起180天

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7076.2(a) states the registrar shall notify the licensee in writing and that the licensee shall be suspended 30 days from the date of the notice if it does not provide proof of good standing with the Secretary of State.
explanation_cn: 《商业与专业法规》第7076.2(a)条规定，注册主任应书面通知持证人，如果持证人未能提供与国务卿的良好信誉证明，其执照将在通知之日起30天内被暂停。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7076.2(a) (Document p. 297, PDF p. 320)

question_en: A member of a suspended LLC contractor causes $1,500,000 in damages to a third party during the suspension period. What is the maximum personal liability for each responsible individual within the company?
question_cn: 在暂停期间，某个暂停的有限责任公司承包商的成员对第三方造成了1,500,000美元的损失。公司内每位责任人的最高个人责任是多少？

options.en: The full $1,500,000 in damages
options.cn: 全部1,500,000美元的损失

options.en: Up to $500,000 per individual
options.cn: 每人最高500,000美元

options.en: Up to $1,000,000 per individual
options.cn: 每人最高1,000,000美元

options.en: Up to $250,000 per individual
options.cn: 每人最高250,000美元

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7076.2(b) states that each person identified under Section 7028.5 shall be personally liable up to one million dollars ($1,000,000) each for damages to third parties resulting from work performed during the period of suspension.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7076.2(b)条规定，根据第7028.5条确定的每个人，对于在暂停期间进行的工作造成的对第三方的损害，每人应承担最高一百万美元（1,000,000美元）的个人责任。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7076.2(b) (Document p. 297, PDF p. 320)

question_en: Which of the following requirements does NOT apply to a contractor who has placed their license on inactive status?
question_cn: 以下哪项要求不适用于已将其执照置于非活动状态的承包商？

options.en: Notifying the CSLB of any change in business address
options.cn: 通知 CSLB 任何营业地址的变更

options.en: Maintaining the contractor's bond under Section 7071.6
options.cn: 根据第7071.6条维护承包商的保证金

options.en: Remaining subject to board disciplinary actions
options.cn: 仍然受委员会纪律处分的约束

options.en: Renewing the inactive license on each renewal date
options.cn: 在每个续期日期续期非活动执照

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7076.5(d) specifically exempts inactive licensees from the bonding requirement under Sections 7071.6, 7071.8, and 7071.9, as well as qualifier and workers' compensation requirements.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7076.5(d)条明确将非活动执照持有人从第7071.6、7071.8和7071.9条的保证金要求以及资格认证和工人赔偿要求中予以豁免。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7076.5(d) (Document p. 298, PDF p. 321)

question_en: A contractor wants to reactivate an inactive license. Which of the following is required to complete the reactivation?
question_cn: 承包商希望重新激活一个非活跃的执照。完成重新激活需要以下哪项？

options.en: Submit an application and pay the full active renewal fee
options.cn: 提交申请并支付全额的活跃续期费用

options.en: Pass the licensing examination again
options.cn: 再次通过执照考试

options.en: Pay the inactive renewal fee only
options.cn: 仅支付非活跃续期费用

options.en: Submit an application and pay all renewal fees owed
options.cn: 提交申请并支付所有应付的续期费用

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7076.5(g) requires an acceptable application, payment of the full renewal fee for an active license, and fulfillment of all other chapter requirements — but no examination is required.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7076.5(g)条要求提交可接受的申请，支付活跃执照的全额续期费用，并履行本章的所有其他要求——但不需要考试。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7076.5(g) (Document p. 298, PDF p. 321)

question_en: A new contractor receives an original license. Under what circumstances is this license considered probationary?
question_cn: 新承包商获得原始执照。在什么情况下该执照被视为试用期执照？

options.en: For the first six months after issuance
options.cn: 发放后的前六个月

options.en: Only if the board imposes special conditions
options.cn: 仅在委员会施加特殊条件时

options.en: Until the license is renewed for the first time
options.cn: 直到执照首次续期为止

options.en: Only if the applicant had prior disciplinary history
options.cn: 仅在申请人有既往纪律记录时

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7077 states that every original license shall be a probationary license until such time as the license is renewed, regardless of the licensee's background or conduct.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7077条规定，每一份原始执照在续期之前都应为试用期执照，无论持证人的背景或行为如何。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7077 (Document p. 298, PDF p. 321)

question_en: A licensee voluntarily surrenders their contractor's license. What happens to the renewal fee the licensee previously paid?
question_cn: 持证人自愿交回其承包商执照。之前支付的续费会发生什么情况？

options.en: No refund is made for any previously paid fees
options.cn: 之前支付的任何费用不予退还

options.en: It is applied toward a future license application
options.cn: 可用于未来的执照申请

options.en: It is prorated and partially refunded
options.cn: 按比例部分退还

options.en: It is refunded upon written request
options.cn: 提交书面请求后退还

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7076.1 explicitly states that no refund will be made of any fee which a licensee may have paid prior to the voluntary surrender of the license.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7076.1条明确规定，持证人在自愿交回执照之前支付的任何费用均不予退还。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7076.1 (Document p. 296, PDF p. 319)

question_en: A licensed contractor moves to a new business address but fails to notify the CSLB registrar within 90 days. What is the consequence regarding the effective date of the address change?
question_cn: 一名持牌承包商搬到新的营业地址，但未能在 90 天内通知 CSLB 注册员。关于地址变更生效日期，会有什么后果？

options.en: The address change is effective the date it occurred
options.cn: 地址变更自发生之日起生效

options.en: The change is never effective until a new license is issued
options.cn: 在新执照签发之前，变更永不生效

options.en: The address change is effective 90 days after moving
options.cn: 地址变更在搬迁后 90 天生效

options.en: The change is effective when written notice is received
options.cn: 变更在书面通知收到时生效

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7083(b) states that failure to notify the registrar within 90 days shall cause the change to be effective the date the written notification is received at the board's headquarters office.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 7083(b) 条规定，如果未能在 90 天内通知注册员，变更应自书面通知被收到并送达董事会总部之日起生效。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7083(b) (Document p. 300, PDF p. 323)

question_en: Under what conditions may the CSLB registrar refer a complaint to administrative arbitration rather than pursue disciplinary action?
question_cn: 在什么情况下，CSLB 注册主任可以将投诉提交给行政仲裁而不是采取纪律处分？

options.en: Only when the licensee was in good standing at the time of violation
options.cn: 仅当许可人在违规时处于良好状态

options.en: Only when the licensee has no current bond on file
options.cn: 仅当许可人当前没有备案保证金

options.en: Only when the licensee has a history of similar violations
options.cn: 仅当许可人有类似违规的历史

options.en: Only when both parties previously agreed to arbitrate
options.cn: 仅当双方之前已同意仲裁

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7085(a)(4) requires that the licensee was in good standing at the time of the alleged violation as one of the conditions for the registrar to refer a dispute to administrative arbitration.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7085(a)(4)条要求许可人在涉嫌违规时处于良好状态，这是注册主任将争议提交行政仲裁的条件之一。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7085(a) (Document p. 301, PDF p. 324)

question_en: A registrar determines that a complaint qualifies for CSLB administrative arbitration under Section 7085(a). An agreement to arbitrate is mailed to both parties. What happens if the complainant fails to return the executed notice within 30 days?
question_cn: 注册主任确定一项投诉根据第7085(a)条款符合CSLB行政仲裁的条件。仲裁协议会邮寄给双方。当投诉人未在30天内返回签署的通知时，会发生什么？

options.en: The complaint is closed by the registrar
options.cn: 投诉由注册主任关闭

options.en: The registrar proceeds to disciplinary action against the licensee
options.cn: 注册主任对持证人采取纪律处分

options.en: The registrar grants a 30-day extension automatically
options.cn: 注册主任自动授予30天的延期

options.en: Arbitration proceeds without the complainant's signature
options.cn: 仲裁在没有投诉人签名的情况下进行

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7085.4(b) specifically states that the complainant's failure to return an executed copy of the notice shall result in the closure of the complaint.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7085.4(b)条明确规定，投诉人未能返回签署的通知副本将导致投诉被关闭。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7085.4(b) (Document p. 303, PDF p. 326)

question_en: A licensee whose license has been canceled disputes the cancellation date, claiming good cause for the discrepancy. How long does the licensee have to file a petition with the registrar?
question_cn: 被取消执照的持证人对取消日期有异议，声称存在合理原因造成差异。持证人有多长时间可以向注册主任提交申请？

options.en: Within 90 days of the board's official cancellation notice
options.cn: 在委员会正式取消通知后的90天内

options.en: Within 30 days of the board's official cancellation notice
options.cn: 在委员会正式取消通知后的30天内

options.en: Within 180 days of the board's official cancellation notice
options.cn: 在委员会正式取消通知后的180天内

options.en: Within 60 days of the board's official cancellation notice
options.cn: 在委员会正式取消通知后的60天内

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7076(j) states that a licensee who disputes the cancellation date upon a showing of good cause must have the petition received within 90 days of the board's official notice of cancellation.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7076(j)条规定，持证人若对取消日期有异议并能证明合理原因，必须在收到委员会正式取消通知后的90天内提交申请。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7076(j) (Document p. 296, PDF p. 319)

question_en: A contractor fails to comply with an arbitration award. How many days after the registrar's certified mail notice does the license automatically suspend?
question_cn: 承包商未遵守仲裁裁决。在注册主任的挂号信通知发出后多少天，执照会自动被暂停？

options.en: Automatically suspends after 15 calendar days
options.cn: 15个日历日后自动暂停

options.en: Automatically suspends after 30 calendar days
options.cn: 30个日历日后自动暂停

options.en: Automatically suspends after 90 calendar days
options.cn: 90个日历日后自动暂停

options.en: Automatically suspends after 10 calendar days
options.cn: 10个日历日后自动暂停

explanation_en: B&P Code §7085.6(a)(2) states the license shall be automatically suspended 30 calendar days from the date of the registrar's certified mail notice of noncompliance.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7085.6(a)(2)条规定，自注册主任发出不合规挂号信通知之日起30个日历日，执照应自动暂停。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7085.6(a)(2) (Document p. 308, PDF p. 331)

question_en: A licensee's license was automatically suspended for failing to comply with an arbitration award. No reinstatement is made. After how many days from the suspension date does automatic revocation occur?
question_cn: 由于未能遵守仲裁裁决，某持牌人的执照被自动暂停。未进行恢复。自暂停之日起多少天后会发生自动吊销？

options.en: After 30 days from suspension date
options.cn: 自暂停之日起 30 天

options.en: After 90 days from suspension date
options.cn: 自暂停之日起 90 天

options.en: After 60 days from suspension date
options.cn: 自暂停之日起 60 天

options.en: After 45 days from suspension date
options.cn: 自暂停之日起 45 天

explanation_en: B&P Code §7085.6(a)(4) provides that if no reinstatement is made within 90 days of automatic suspension, the license and any other contractor's license issued to the licensee shall be automatically revoked by operation of law.
explanation_cn: 《商务与专业法典》第 7085.6(a)(4) 条规定，如果在自动暂停后 90 天内未进行恢复，持牌人的执照以及授予该持牌人的任何其他承包商执照将依法自动吊销。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7085.6(a)(4) (Document p. 308, PDF p. 331)

question_en: A licensee wants to appeal an automatic suspension for failing to comply with an arbitration award. Within how many days of service of the suspension notice must the appeal be filed?
question_cn: 持证人希望对因未遵守仲裁裁决而自动暂停的决定提出上诉。在收到暂停通知后，必须在多少天内提出上诉？

options.en: Within 7 calendar days of service
options.cn: 自送达之日起 7 个日历日内

options.en: Within 10 calendar days of service
options.cn: 自送达之日起 10 个日历日内

options.en: Within 15 calendar days of service
options.cn: 自送达之日起 15 个日历日内

options.en: Within 30 calendar days of service
options.cn: 自送达之日起 30 个日历日内

explanation_en: B&P Code §7085.6(a)(3) specifically requires the licensee to appeal the suspension for noncompliance within 15 calendar days after service of the notice, by written notice to the registrar.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》 §7085.6(a)(3) 明确要求持证人在收到通知后 15 个日历日内，通过书面通知注册登记员来对因不遵守而导致的暂停提出上诉。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7085.6(a)(3) (Document p. 308, PDF p. 331)

question_en: After an arbitration hearing closes, within how many calendar days must the arbitrator issue an award, absent any agreement by the parties?
question_cn: 仲裁听证会结束后，如果双方没有达成任何协议，仲裁员必须在多少日历天内做出裁决？

options.en: No later than 45 calendar days
options.cn: 不超过 45 日历天

options.en: No later than 30 calendar days
options.cn: 不超过 30 日历天

options.en: No later than 90 calendar days
options.cn: 不超过 90 日历天

options.en: No later than 60 calendar days
options.cn: 不超过 60 日历天

explanation_en: B&P Code §7085.5(q) states the award shall be made no later than 30 calendar days from the date of closing the hearing, unless otherwise agreed by the parties.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7085.5(q)条规定，除非双方另有约定，裁决应在听证会结束之日起不超过 30 日历天内作出。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7085.5(q) (Document p. 306, PDF p. 329)

question_en: A party to an arbitration discovers that a procedural rule was not followed during the hearing. How long after the hearing closes does the party have to file a written objection with the arbitrator?
question_cn: 仲裁的一方发现听证过程中未遵循程序规则。听证结束后，该方必须在多长时间内向仲裁员提交书面异议？

options.en: Within 7 calendar days of close
options.cn: 听证结束后7个日历日内

options.en: Within 30 calendar days of close
options.cn: 听证结束后30个日历日内

options.en: Within 15 calendar days of close
options.cn: 听证结束后15个日历日内

options.en: Within 10 calendar days of close
options.cn: 听证结束后10个日历日内

explanation_en: B&P Code §7085.5(o) states that a party who fails to object in writing within 10 calendar days of close of hearing to any procedural noncompliance shall be deemed to have waived their right to object.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》 §7085.5(o) 规定，如果一方未在听证结束后10个日历日内对任何程序上的不合规提交书面异议，则视为放弃其提出异议的权利。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7085.5(o) (Document p. 306, PDF p. 329)

question_en: An arbitration award is issued. Within how many days does it become final if no appeal is filed?
question_cn: 仲裁裁决已作出。如果未提出上诉，它将在多少天内生效？

options.en: 30 calendar days from issuance
options.cn: 自作出之日起 30 个日历日

options.en: 90 calendar days from issuance
options.cn: 自作出之日起 90 个日历日

options.en: 10 calendar days from issuance
options.cn: 自作出之日起 10 个日历日

options.en: 60 calendar days from issuance
options.cn: 自作出之日起 60 个日历日

explanation_en: B&P Code §7085.5(s) states the award shall become final 30 calendar days from the date the arbitration award is issued, and if no appeal is filed within that period, it becomes a final order of the registrar.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》 §7085.5(s) 规定，裁决自仲裁裁决作出之日起 30 个日历日生效，如果在此期间未提出上诉，则该裁决成为注册主任的最终命令。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7085.5(s) (Document p. 306, PDF p. 329)

question_en: A contractor's arbitration award contains an obvious mathematical error. A party wants to apply for a correction. Within how many days of service of the award must the correction application be served on the arbitrator and all parties?
question_cn: 承包商的仲裁裁决中存在明显的数学错误。一方希望申请更正。必须在裁决送达后多少天内将更正申请送达仲裁员及所有当事方？

options.en: Within 60 calendar days of service
options.cn: 裁决送达后60个日历日内

options.en: Within 15 calendar days of service
options.cn: 裁决送达后15个日历日内

options.en: Within 30 calendar days of service
options.cn: 裁决送达后30个日历日内

options.en: Within 10 calendar days of service
options.cn: 裁决送达后10个日历日内

explanation_en: B&P Code §7085.5(s) states an application for correction of the award shall be made within 10 calendar days of service of the award, and any written objection to the correction must also be served within 10 calendar days of service of the correction application.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》 §7085.5(s) 规定，裁决更正的申请应在裁决送达后10个日历日内提出，任何对更正的书面反对也必须在更正申请送达后10个日历日内送达。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7085.5(s) (Document p. 307, PDF p. 330)

question_en: During an arbitration hearing, which of the following persons does an arbitrator NOT have the power to exclude from the proceedings?
question_cn: 在仲裁听证会上，下列哪些人仲裁员没有权力将其排除在程序之外？

options.en: A fact witness during another witness's testimony
options.cn: 另一位证人作证时的事实证人

options.en: A party who has a direct interest in the arbitration
options.cn: 对仲裁有直接利益的一方当事人

options.en: A support person accompanying a witness
options.cn: 陪同证人的支持人员

options.en: An interested observer with no direct stake
options.cn: 没有直接利害关系的旁观者

explanation_en: B&P Code §7085.5(f) states that any person having a direct interest in the arbitration is entitled to attend the hearing -- the arbitrator cannot exclude a party with a direct interest.
explanation_cn: 《商业与专业法规》第7085.5(f)条规定，对仲裁有直接利益的任何人都有权出席听证会——仲裁员不能排除拥有直接利益的一方当事人。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7085.5(f) (Document p. 305, PDF p. 328)

question_en: When must parties notify the arbitrator of their convenient hearing times after the arbitrator mails the list of available dates?
question_cn: 仲裁员邮寄可用日期清单后，当事人必须在何时通知仲裁员他们方便的听证时间？

options.en: Within 14 calendar days of mailing
options.cn: 邮寄后14个日历日内

options.en: Within 10 calendar days of mailing
options.cn: 邮寄后10个日历日内

options.en: Within 7 calendar days of mailing
options.cn: 邮寄后7个日历日内

options.en: Within 30 calendar days of mailing
options.cn: 邮寄后30个日历日内

explanation_en: B&P Code §7085.5(e)(1) requires the parties to notify the arbitrator, within seven calendar days of the mailing of the list, of times and dates convenient to each party. Failure to respond allows the arbitrator to fix the hearing schedule unilaterally.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7085.5(e)(1)条规定，当事人必须在邮寄清单后的七个日历日内，将每方方便的时间和日期通知仲裁员。未及时回应将允许仲裁员单方面确定听证日程。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7085.5(e)(1) (Document p. 304, PDF p. 327)

question_en: A contractor is suspended for noncompliance with an arbitration award. Which of the following actions is the contractor also automatically prohibited from taking?
question_cn: 承包商因未遵守仲裁裁决而被停业。承包商还自动被禁止采取下列哪项行为？

options.en: Filing an appeal of the arbitration award
options.cn: 提交仲裁裁决的上诉

options.en: Obtaining a new contractor's license in a different classification
options.cn: 在不同类别中获取新的承包商执照

options.en: Performing work as an unlicensed handyman
options.cn: 以无证手工工人的身份进行工作

options.en: Serving as an officer or qualifying individual of another licensee
options.cn: 担任其他持证人的高管或合格个人

explanation_en: B&P Code §7085.6(b) states the licensee is automatically prohibited from serving as an officer, director, associate, partner, manager, or qualifying individual of another licensee during the suspension period.
explanation_cn: 《商务与职业法典》第7085.6(b)条规定，执照持有人在停业期间自动被禁止担任其他持证人的高管、董事、合伙人、经理或合格个人。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7085.6(b) (Document p. 309, PDF p. 332)

question_en: How long after a disciplinary citation is complied with will the citation remain disclosed on a contractor's public license record, assuming no additional disciplinary actions are filed?
question_cn: 在遵守纪律处分通知后，如果没有额外的纪律处分，处分将在承包商的公共执照记录上保留多久？

options.en: For five years after the compliance date
options.cn: 自遵守日期起五年

options.en: Indefinitely from the effective date
options.cn: 自生效日期起无限期

options.en: For two years after the compliance date
options.cn: 自遵守日期起两年

options.en: For seven years after the compliance date
options.cn: 自遵守日期起七年

explanation_en: B&P Code §7124.6(e)(1)(A) states that citations shall be disclosed for five years after the date of compliance, provided no additional disciplinary actions were filed during that five-year period.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》 §7124.6(e)(1)(A) 规定，如果在五年期间没有提交额外的纪律处分，处分自遵守日期起五年内应予披露。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7124.6(e)(1)(A) (Document p. 341, PDF p. 364)

question_en: A contractor's license is revoked but the revocation is NOT stayed. How long will this disciplinary action appear on the contractor's public CSLB record?
question_cn: 承包商的执照被吊销，但吊销未被暂停。此项纪律处分将在承包商的公共 CSLB 记录中显示多久？

options.en: For seven years from the effective date
options.cn: 自生效日期起七年

options.en: For ten years from the effective date
options.cn: 自生效日期起十年

options.en: For five years from the effective date
options.cn: 自生效日期起五年

options.en: Indefinitely from the effective date
options.cn: 自生效日期起无限期

explanation_en: B&P Code §7124.6(e)(3) states that all revocations that are not stayed shall be disclosed indefinitely from the effective date of the revocation.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 7124.6(e)(3) 条规定，所有未被暂停的吊销应自吊销生效日起无限期披露。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7124.6(e)(3) (Document p. 342, PDF p. 365)

question_en: A contractor ignores a final CSLB citation order and does not pay the civil penalty. How many days after noncompliance does the license automatically suspend?
question_cn: 一名承包商无视最终的CSLB指令通知，并未支付民事罚款。在不遵守规定后多少天，执照会自动暂停？

options.en: 60 days after service of written notice
options.cn: 在书面通知送达后60天

options.en: 30 days after noncompliance with the order
options.cn: 在不遵守指令后30天

options.en: 90 days after the final order
options.cn: 在最终指令后90天

options.en: 15 days after the final order
options.cn: 在最终指令后15天

explanation_en: Under B&P Code §7090.1(a)(1), failure to comply with a final order results in automatic suspension by operation of law 30 days after noncompliance.
explanation_cn: 根据商业与职业法典第7090.1(a)(1)条款，未遵守最终指令将导致根据法律规定在不遵守指令后30天自动暂停执照。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7090.1(a)(1) (Document p. 312, PDF p. 335)

question_en: A contractor's license is automatically suspended for failing to comply with a final citation order. If no reinstatement is made, when does automatic revocation occur?
question_cn: 承包商执照因未遵守最终传票命令而自动被暂停。如果未进行恢复，何时会自动吊销？

options.en: 90 days after the automatic suspension
options.cn: 自动暂停后90天

options.en: One year after the original citation
options.cn: 原始传票后一年

options.en: 30 days after the automatic suspension
options.cn: 自动暂停后30天

options.en: 60 days after the automatic suspension
options.cn: 自动暂停后60天

explanation_en: Under B&P Code §7090.1(a)(4), if no reinstatement is made within 90 days of the automatic suspension, the license and any other license issued to the same licensee shall be automatically revoked by operation of law.
explanation_cn: 根据《商业与专业法规》第7090.1(a)(4)条，如果在自动暂停后的90天内未进行恢复，执照及同一持证人持有的任何其他执照将依法自动吊销。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7090.1(a)(4) (Document p. 312, PDF p. 335)

question_en: A contractor is cited by CSLB. Within how many working days must the contractor notify the registrar of intent to contest the citation to avoid it becoming a final order?
question_cn: 承包商被 CSLB 引用。承包商必须在多少个工作日内通知注册主任他们打算对该处罚通知提出异议，以避免其成为最终命令？

options.en: 10 calendar days from service
options.cn: 自送达之日起 10 个日历日

options.en: 15 calendar days from service
options.cn: 自送达之日起 15 个日历日

options.en: 10 working days from service
options.cn: 自送达之日起 10 个工作日

options.en: 15 working days from service
options.cn: 自送达之日起 15 个工作日

explanation_en: Under B&P Code §7099.4, if the licensee or applicant fails to notify the registrar within 15 working days of service that they intend to contest the citation, it becomes a final order not subject to review.
explanation_cn: 根据 《加州商业与职业法典》 §7099.4，如果持牌人或申请人在送达之日起 15 个工作日内未通知注册主任他们打算对引用提出异议，该处罚通知将成为不予复审的最终命令。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7099.4 (Document p. 318, PDF p. 341)

question_en: A homeowner files a complaint about latent structural defects caused by a contractor's work. What is the maximum number of years after the defective work to file a complaint with the CSLB registrar?
question_cn: 房主对承包商的工作造成的潜在结构缺陷提出投诉。提交给 CSLB 注册主任的投诉，最长期限为自缺陷工作完成后多少年？

options.en: 4 years after the act or omission
options.cn: 自行为或遗漏之日起 4 年

options.en: 18 months from complaint filing date
options.cn: 自投诉提交日起 18 个月

options.en: 10 years after the act or omission
options.cn: 自行为或遗漏之日起 10 年

options.en: 2 years after discovery by the registrar
options.cn: 注册主任发现后 2 年

explanation_en: Under B&P Code §7091(b)(1), a complaint alleging latent acts or omissions regarding structural defects must be filed within 10 years after the act or omission — the longest standard complaint period in the statute.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第 7091(b)(1) 条，对于涉及结构缺陷的潜在行为或遗漏的投诉，必须在行为或遗漏之日起 10 年内提交——这是该法规中最长的标准投诉期限。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7091(b)(1) (Document p. 313, PDF p. 336)

question_en: A contractor corrects all defective work after being found to have committed a fraudulent act. Can the CSLB registrar still pursue disciplinary action?
question_cn: 承包商在被发现实施欺诈行为后纠正了所有有缺陷的工作。CSLB 注册主任仍然可以追究纪律处分吗？

options.en: Yes, correction alone does not bar discipline
options.cn: 是的，单纯的纠正并不妨碍纪律处分

options.en: Yes, but only if the fraud was repeated
options.cn: 是的，但仅当欺诈行为重复发生时

options.en: No, correction eliminates all grounds for discipline
options.cn: 不，纠正可以消除所有纪律处分的理由

options.en: No, only if the fraud involved monetary loss
options.cn: 不，仅当欺诈涉及金钱损失时

explanation_en: Under B&P Code §7090.5, correction of any condition resulting from a fraudulent act shall not in itself preclude the registrar from taking disciplinary action. The fraud remains actionable.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7090.5条，对因欺诈行为造成的任何情况进行纠正本身并不排除注册主任采取纪律处分的权利。该欺诈行为仍可作为可追究的事项。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7090.5 (Document p. 313, PDF p. 336)

question_en: A contractor receives a CSLB citation and wants to contest it informally rather than request a formal hearing. Within how many days must the contractor submit a written request for an informal citation conference?
question_cn: 承包商收到 CSLB 处罚通知，想要非正式地提出异议，而不是请求正式听证会。承包商必须在收到处罚通知后的多少天内提交书面请求，以进行非正式处罚会议？

options.en: 15 working days after citation service
options.cn: 收到处罚通知后 15 个工作日内

options.en: 10 working days after citation service
options.cn: 收到处罚通知后 10 个工作日内

options.en: 60 calendar days after citation service
options.cn: 收到处罚通知后 60 个日历日内

options.en: 30 calendar days after citation service
options.cn: 收到处罚通知后 30 个日历日内

explanation_en: Under B&P Code §7099.8(b)(1), the contractor may contest a citation by submitting a written request for an informal citation conference within 15 days after service of the citation.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第 7099.8(b)(1) 条，承包商可通过在收到处罚通知后 15 天内提交书面请求来对处罚提出非正式异议。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7099.8(b)(1) (Document p. 319, PDF p. 342)

question_en: After an informal citation conference, CSLB modifies a contractor's citation. If the contractor wants to contest the modified citation, within how many days must they request an administrative hearing?
question_cn: 在非正式传票会议之后，加州承包商执照委员会（CSLB）会修改承包商的传票。如果承包商想对修改后的传票提出异议，他们必须在多少天内请求行政听证会？

options.en: 30 days after service of modified citation
options.cn: 修改后的传票送达后30天内

options.en: 10 calendar days after service
options.cn: 送达后10个日历日内

options.en: 60 calendar days after service
options.cn: 送达后60个日历日内

options.en: 15 working days after service
options.cn: 送达后15个工作日内

explanation_en: Under B&P Code §7099.8(b)(4), a contractor wishing to contest a citation affirmed or modified after an informal conference must submit a written request for an administrative hearing within 30 days after service of the affirmed or modified citation.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7099.8(b)(4)条，承包商如希望对在非正式会议后确认或修改的传票提出异议，必须在确认或修改的传票送达后30天内提交书面行政听证申请。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7099.8(b)(4) (Document p. 320, PDF p. 343)

question_en: Under what standard of proof must CSLB establish its case in a proceeding to suspend or revoke a contractor's license?
question_cn: CSLB 在暂停或吊销承包商执照的程序中必须以何种举证标准来证明其案件？

options.en: Clear and convincing evidence
options.cn: 清楚且令人信服的证据

options.en: Probable cause to believe a violation occurred
options.cn: 有理由相信发生违法行为的可能性

options.en: Preponderance of the evidence standard
options.cn: 证据优势标准

options.en: Beyond a reasonable doubt
options.cn: 超越合理怀疑

explanation_en: Under B&P Code §7090, with respect to administrative proceedings to suspend or revoke a contractor's license, the registrar at all times shall have the burden of proof to establish by clear and convincing evidence that the relief sought is warranted.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7090条，关于暂停或吊销承包商执照的行政程序，注册主任在任何时候都负有举证责任，必须通过清楚且令人信服的证据证明所寻求的救济是合理的。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7090 (Document p. 311, PDF p. 334)

question_en: A contractor builds a room addition without pulling a required building permit. What does CSLB law presume about the nature of this violation?
question_cn: 承包商在未取得所需建筑许可证的情况下建造房间扩建。CSLB 法律对于这种违规行为的性质推定是什么？

options.en: It is presumed to require only a citation
options.cn: 推定只需要收到一张警告通知

options.en: It is presumed a clerical oversight
options.cn: 推定为文书疏忽

options.en: It is presumed a willful and deliberate violation
options.cn: 推定为故意和蓄意的违规

options.en: It is presumed an isolated first offense
options.cn: 推定为孤立的首次违规

explanation_en: Under B&P Code §7090, there is a rebuttable presumption affecting the burden of proof that construction performed without a permit is a willful and deliberate violation, subjecting the contractor to mandatory disciplinary action.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7090条，有一个可反驳的推定，影响举证责任，即未经许可进行的施工被视为故意和蓄意的违规，使承包商必须接受强制性纪律处分。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7090 (Document p. 311, PDF p. 334)

question_en: Which of the following conditions would exempt a contractor from mandatory disciplinary action for failing to obtain a permit under B&P Code Section 7090?
question_cn: 以下哪种情况可使承包商因未根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7090条获取许可而免于强制性纪律处分？

options.en: The work passed a subsequent inspection
options.cn: 该工作通过了随后的检查

options.en: Repair valued under $500 for labor or materials
options.cn: 维修价值劳务或材料少于500美元

options.en: The owner verbally authorized the work
options.cn: 所有者口头授权了该工作

options.en: The contractor has no prior disciplinary history
options.cn: 承包商没有之前的纪律处分记录

explanation_en: Under B&P Code §7090, mandatory discipline does not apply to failure to obtain a county or city permit for repair, maintenance, or adjustment of equipment where such work is valued at less than $500 for labor or materials.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7090条，对于价值劳务或材料少于500美元的设备维修、保养或调整而未获得县或市许可的情况，不适用强制性纪律处分。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7090 (Document p. 311, PDF p. 334)

question_en: CSLB's registrar suspends a contractor's license through a formal disciplinary decision. Can the registrar also suspend additional licenses held by the same contractor without further notice?
question_cn: CSLB 的注册主任通过正式的纪律处分决定暂停承包商的执照。注册主任是否也可以在不另行通知的情况下，暂停同一承包商持有的其他执照？

options.en: No, each license requires a separate hearing
options.cn: 不，每个执照都需要单独的听证会

options.en: Yes, but only if violations occurred under those licenses
options.cn: 是的，但仅在这些执照下发生违规时才可以

options.en: No, additional licenses require written notice first
options.cn: 不，其他执照首先需要书面通知

options.en: Yes, the registrar may suspend them without further notice
options.cn: 是的，注册主任可以在不另行通知的情况下暂停它们

explanation_en: Under B&P Code §7097, when a license is suspended by a registrar's decision, any additional license issued in the same name or for which the licensee furnished qualifying experience may be suspended without further notice.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7097条，当执照被注册主任决定暂停时，以同一名称签发的任何其他执照，或执照持有人提供合格经验的执照，可以在不另行通知的情况下被暂停。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7097 (Document p. 315, PDF p. 338)

question_en: What is the maximum civil penalty CSLB may assess for a violation of B&P Code Section 7110 (dishonest dealing) under the current penalty schedule?
question_cn: 根据现行处罚计划，CSLB 对违反《加州商业与职业法典》第7110条（不诚实交易）的行为可评估的最高民事罚款是多少？

options.en: $30,000 per violation
$8,000 per violation
options.cn: 每次违规 $8,000

options.en: $500 per violation
options.cn: 每次违规 $500

options.en: $15,000 per violation

explanation_en: Under B&P Code §7099.2(b), a civil penalty not to exceed $30,000 may be assessed for a violation of Section 7110, 7114, or 7118 — a higher tier than the standard $8,000 maximum.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7099.2(b)条，对于违反第7110条、第7114条或第7118条的行为，可评估的民事罚款不超过 $30,000——这比标准的 $8,000 上限更高。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7099.2(b) (Document p. 317, PDF p. 340)

question_en: A disciplinary action is filed against a contractor for an alleged breach of an express written warranty. What is the filing deadline for such an action?
question_cn: 对承包商因涉嫌违反明示书面保修而提起的纪律处分行动。此类行动的提交截止日期是什么？

options.en: Within 10 years of the warranty issuance
options.cn: 自保修发出之日起10年内

options.en: Within 18 months from warranty expiration
options.cn: 自保修到期之日起18个月内

options.en: Within 2 years of discovery by the registrar
options.cn: 自注册处发现之日起2年内

options.en: Within 4 years of the breach
options.cn: 自违约之日起4年内

explanation_en: Under B&P Code §7091(e), a disciplinary action regarding an alleged breach of an express, written warranty issued by the contractor shall be filed not later than 18 months from the expiration of the warranty.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7091(e)条，针对承包商签发的明示书面保修的涉嫌违约的纪律处分行动，应不迟于保修到期后18个月内提交。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7091(e) (Document p. 314, PDF p. 337)

question_en: When CSLB issues a disciplinary decision against a contractor, which of the following may the decision NOT include as a condition of probation?
question_cn: 当加利福尼亚州承包商执照委员会（CSLB）对承包商作出纪律处分决定时，以下哪项不得作为考察期条件纳入该决定？

options.en: Restitution to injured parties
options.cn: 向受伤方进行赔偿

options.en: Completion of specified trade coursework
options.cn: 完成指定的行业课程

options.en: Permanent bar from ever relicensing
options.cn: 永久禁止重新申请执照

options.en: Retaking the law and business examination
options.cn: 重新参加法律与商业考试

explanation_en: §7095 authorizes conditions that suspend an application for restoration until terms are met, but it does not authorize a permanent bar from relicensing as a probation condition. The registrar may set a period under §7102, but a permanent bar is not among the listed probation terms.
explanation_cn: §7095 授权在满足条件之前暂停恢复申请，但不授权将永久禁止重新申请执照作为考察期条件。注册负责人可以根据 §7102 设定期限，但永久禁止不在列入的考察期条件之中。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7095(b) (Document p. 314, PDF p. 337)

question_en: A cited contractor's qualifier is automatically prohibited from serving as a qualifying individual for another licensee. If the other licensee fails to replace the qualifier within 90 days, what happens to that licensee's license?
question_cn: 被引用的承包商资格持有者会自动被禁止作为另一执照持有者的合格个人。如果另一执照持有者未能在90天内更换资格持有者，该执照持有者的执照会发生什么情况？

options.en: The registrar issues a citation to the other licensee
options.cn: 登记处向另一执照持有者发出处罚通知
