options.en: The license is automatically suspended at 90 days
options.cn: 执照在90天时自动暂停

options.en: The license enters a 30-day cure period
options.cn: 执照进入30天的补救期

options.en: The license is permanently revoked immediately
options.cn: 执照立即被永久吊销

explanation_en: Under B&P Code §7090.1(b), upon failure to replace the qualifier within 90 days of the prohibition, the license of the other licensee shall be automatically suspended or the qualifier's classification removed at the end of the 90-day period.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7090.1(b)条，如果在被禁止后的90天内未能更换资格持有者，另一执照持有者的执照将在90天期满时自动暂停或资格持有者的分类被移除。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7090.1(b) (Document p. 313, PDF p. 336)

question_en: After an office conference regarding a letter of admonishment, within how many calendar days must the registrar send the written decision to the licensee?
question_cn: 在关于警告信的办公室会议之后，注册主任必须在多少个日历日内将书面决定发送给持证人？

options.en: Within 30 calendar days of the conference
options.cn: 在会议后的30个日历日内

options.en: Within 7 calendar days of the conference
options.cn: 在会议后的7个日历日内

options.en: Within 10 calendar days of the conference
options.cn: 在会议后的10个日历日内

options.en: Within 14 calendar days of the conference
options.cn: 在会议后的14个日历日内

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7099.2(b)(1)(D) requires the registrar to personally serve or send the written decision by certified mail within 14 calendar days from the date of the office conference.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7099.2(b)(1)(D)条要求注册主任必须在办公室会议之日起的14个日历日内亲自送达或通过挂号信发送书面决定。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7099.2(b)(1)(D) (Document p. 321, PDF p. 344)

question_en: A licensee receives a letter of admonishment and does not request an office conference. If the licensee simply complies with the letter, what is the legal effect of that compliance?
question_cn: 如果持牌人收到一封警告信但没有要求办公室会议，那么持牌人仅仅遵守该信件，这种遵守在法律上的效力是什么？

options.en: It constitutes a final disciplinary action on record
options.cn: 它构成记录上的最终纪律处分

options.en: It is not an admission of the violation
options.cn: 它不构成对违规行为的承认

options.en: It is deemed an admission of the cited violation
options.cn: 它被视为对引用违规行为的承认

options.en: It prevents the board from issuing future citations
options.cn: 它阻止委员会对未来发出引用

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7099.2(b)(2) states that if no office conference is requested, compliance with the letter of admonishment shall not constitute an admission of the violation noted in the letter.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7099.2(b)(2)条规定，如果没有申请办公室会议，遵守警告信不应构成对信中所述违规行为的承认。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7099.2(b)(2) (Document p. 321, PDF p. 344)

question_en: Which of the following circumstances would PREVENT the CSLB from issuing a letter of admonishment?
question_cn: 以下哪种情况会阻止加州承包商执照委员会（CSLB）发出警告信？

options.en: The licensee has no prior disciplinary history
options.cn: 执照持有人没有先前的纪律处分记录

options.en: The violation involved a residential project
options.cn: 违规行为涉及住宅项目

options.en: The violation resulted in financial harm to another
options.cn: 违规行为导致他人经济损失

options.en: The licensee is currently under investigation
options.cn: 执照持有人目前正在接受调查

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7099.2(g)(3) lists financial harm to another as one of the factors that prohibits the board from issuing a letter of admonishment.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7099.2(g)(3)条将导致他人经济损失列为禁止委员会发出警告信的其中一个因素。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7099.2(g) (Document p. 322, PDF p. 345)

question_en: After a contractor's license is revoked, what is the minimum waiting period before a new license can be issued to a member of the revoked licensee's personnel who participated in the acts that caused the revocation?
question_cn: 在承包商的执照被吊销后，对于参与导致吊销行为的被吊销执照持有者人员，重新颁发新执照的最短等待期是多少？

options.en: Five years after the final revocation decision
options.cn: 最终吊销决定后五年

options.en: Six months after the final revocation decision
options.cn: 最终吊销决定后六个月

options.en: One year after the final revocation decision
options.cn: 最终吊销决定后一年

options.en: Three years after the final revocation decision
options.cn: 最终吊销决定后三年

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7102 provides that after revocation, a license shall not be reissued to any personnel who participated in the grounds for revocation within a minimum of one year and a maximum of five years after the final revocation decision.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7102条规定，在吊销后，对于参与吊销理由的任何人员，新的执照不得在最终吊销决定后一年至五年的时间内重新颁发。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7102 (Document p. 324, PDF p. 347)

question_en: A contractor's license is revoked, and the contractor subsequently discharges the resulting financial judgment in bankruptcy. Which of the following is true regarding license reinstatement?
question_cn: 承包商的执照被吊销，随后该承包商通过破产解除由此产生的财务判决。关于执照恢复，下列哪项是正确的？

options.en: The license is automatically reinstated upon bankruptcy discharge
options.cn: 在破产解除时，执照会自动恢复

options.en: Full monetary satisfaction is still required before reinstatement
options.cn: 在恢复之前仍需完全满足货币义务

options.en: All conditions, monetary and non-monetary, are waived by bankruptcy
options.cn: 破产会免除所有条件，包括货币和非货币条件

options.en: Monetary conditions are waived but non-monetary conditions still apply
options.cn: 货币条件被豁免，但非货币条件仍适用

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7102 states that a monetary obligation discharged in bankruptcy need not be satisfied for reinstatement, but any nonmonetary conditions not discharged must still be complied with.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7102条规定，通过破产解除的货币义务不需要为恢复执照而履行，但任何未被解除的非货币条件仍必须遵守。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7102 (Document p. 324, PDF p. 347)

question_en: A contractor voluntarily surrenders their license while under investigation by CSLB. What effect does this have on the registrar's authority to continue the disciplinary proceedings?
question_cn: 承包商在加州承包商状态委员会（CSLB）调查期间自愿放弃其执照。这对注册主任继续进行纪律程序的权力有什么影响？

options.en: It does not deprive the registrar of jurisdiction
options.cn: 不会剥夺注册主任的管辖权

options.en: It converts the investigation to a civil matter only
options.cn: 将调查仅转为民事事务

options.en: It suspends the investigation until the license is renewed
options.cn: 调查暂停，直到执照续期

options.en: It terminates the investigation immediately
options.cn: 调查立即终止

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7106.5 states that voluntary surrender of a license shall not deprive the registrar of jurisdiction to proceed with any investigation or disciplinary proceeding against the license.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7106.5条规定，自愿放弃执照不得剥夺注册主任对执照进行任何调查或纪律程序的管辖权。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7106.5 (Document p. 325, PDF p. 348)

question_en: A licensee's California contractor license is suspended due to disciplinary action taken against a similar license held in Nevada. Under what authority does CSLB act?
question_cn: 由于在内华达州持有的类似执照受到纪律处分，持证人的加利福尼亚承包商执照被暂停。CSLB依据什么权力采取行动？

options.en: Out-of-state discipline constitutes grounds for California action
options.cn: 外州的纪律处分构成加利福尼亚采取行动的依据

options.en: CSLB must wait for a court order before acting
options.cn: CSLB必须等待法院命令后才能采取行动

options.en: The registrar has discretion but no statutory basis
options.cn: 注册主任有自由裁量权但没有法定依据

options.en: CSLB may act only if the violation occurred in California
options.cn: CSLB只有在违规发生在加利福尼亚时才可以采取行动

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7103 states that revocation, suspension, or other disciplinary action by another state constitutes grounds for disciplinary action in California if the individual is a California licensee or applicant.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7103条规定，如果个人是加利福尼亚持证人或申请人，其他州的吊销、暂停或其他纪律处分构成加利福尼亚采取纪律处分的依据。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7103 (Document p. 324, PDF p. 347)

question_en: How long must a licensee retain and keep available for inspection all records related to a completed construction project?
question_cn: 执照持有人必须保留并随时提供检查与已完成施工项目相关的所有记录的期限是多长？

options.en: Not less than five years after project completion
options.cn: 项目完成后不少于五年

options.en: Not less than three years after project completion
options.cn: 项目完成后不少于三年

options.en: Not less than two years after project completion
options.cn: 项目完成后不少于两年

options.en: Not less than four years after project completion
options.cn: 项目完成后不少于四年

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7111(a) requires a licensee to make and keep all transaction records available for inspection by the registrar for a period of not less than five years after completion of any construction project.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7111(a)条要求执照持有人制作并保留所有交易记录，以便注册主任在任何施工项目完成后至少五年内进行检查。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7111(a) (Document p. 329, PDF p. 352)

question_en: A contractor departs from the plans on a project in a material way that is prejudicial to the owner, without the owner's consent. Which of the following is true?
question_cn: 承包商在未经业主同意的情况下，在项目中以对业主有害的重大方式偏离设计图纸。以下哪项是正确的？

options.en: It constitutes a cause for disciplinary action
options.cn: 这构成了纪律处分的理由

options.en: It is permitted if the architect later approves the change
options.cn: 如果建筑师后来批准该变更，则允许

options.en: It is only actionable if the owner suffers a financial loss
options.cn: 只有在业主遭受经济损失时才可采取行动

options.en: It is only a cause for action if work is defective
options.cn: 只有在工作有缺陷时才构成诉讼理由

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7109(b) states that a willful departure from or disregard of plans or specifications in any material respect, which is prejudicial to another, without the owner's consent constitutes a cause for disciplinary action.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7109条(b)规定，未经业主同意，故意在任何重大方面偏离或忽视设计图纸或规范，且对他人有害的，构成纪律处分的理由。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7109(b) (Document p. 327, PDF p. 350)

question_en: An unlicensed contractor advertises construction services in a classified directory. If the contractor fails to comply with the registrar's correction order, which agency is notified to enforce telephone disconnection?
question_cn: 一名无执照承包商在分类目录中宣传建筑服务。如果承包商未能遵守注册主任的纠正命令，应通知哪个机构来执行电话中断？

options.en: The California Department of Consumer Affairs
options.cn: 加利福尼亚州消费者事务部

options.en: The Federal Communications Commission
options.cn: 联邦通信委员会

options.en: The California Attorney General's office
options.cn: 加利福尼亚州总检察长办公室

options.en: The California Public Utilities Commission
options.cn: 加利福尼亚州公共事业委员会

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7099.10(c) requires the registrar to inform the Public Utilities Commission of the violation, which then orders the telephone corporation to disconnect service associated with the unlawful advertising.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7099.10(c)条规定，注册主任必须将违规行为通知公共事业委员会，由其下令电话公司中断与非法广告相关的服务。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7099.10(c) (Document p. 322, PDF p. 345)

question_en: A licensee receives a letter of admonishment and must keep a copy of it readily available. For how long after the date of issuance must the licensee maintain this copy?
question_cn: 持牌人收到一封警告信，并且必须随时保留一份副本。在发出日期之后，持牌人必须保存这份副本多长时间？

options.en: For at least one year from issuance
options.cn: 自发出之日起至少一年

options.en: For at least three years from issuance
options.cn: 自发出之日起至少三年

options.en: For at least five years from issuance
options.cn: 自发出之日起至少五年

options.en: For at least two years from issuance
options.cn: 自发出之日起至少两年

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7099.2(d) requires the licensee to maintain and have readily available a copy of the letter of admonishment and corrective action plan, if any, for at least one year from the date of issuance.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7099.2(d)条要求持牌人至少自发出之日起一年内维护并随时持有警告信及纠正措施计划（如有）的副本。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7099.2(d) (Document p. 321, PDF p. 344)

question_en: A licensed contractor allows an unlicensed friend to use his license to bid and perform work on a remodel project. Which consequence does the licensed contractor face?
question_cn: 一名持证承包商允许未持证的朋友使用他的执照投标并在翻修项目中进行工作。持证承包商将面临什么后果？

options.en: A fine of up to $5,000 only
options.cn: 仅罚款最高 5,000 美元

options.en: A warning letter from the CSLB only
options.cn: 仅收到 CSLB 的警告信

options.en: Automatic license revocation without a hearing
options.cn: 无须听证会即自动吊销执照

options.en: Disciplinary action and liability for injured party payment
options.cn: 纪律处分并对受伤方的赔偿承担责任

explanation_en: Under B&P Code Section 7114, allowing one's license to be used by an unlicensed person is a cause for disciplinary action, and the registrar may order the licensee to pay a specified sum to any injured party, including for acts of the unlicensed person.
explanation_cn: 根据 《加州商业与职业法典》第 7114 条，允许未持证人员使用自己的执照是可进行纪律处分的原因，注册主任可以命令持证人向任何受害方支付指定金额，包括未持证人员的行为造成的损失。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7114 (Document p. 331, PDF p. 354)

question_en: A contractor is convicted of price gouging for repair services following a declared state of emergency. What is the minimum disciplinary action the CSLB must impose?
question_cn: 一名承包商在宣布进入紧急状态后因修理服务价格欺诈被定罪。CSLB必须施加的最低纪律处分是什么？

options.en: Suspension of at least six months or permanent revocation
options.cn: 暂停执照效力至少六个月或永久吊销

options.en: A civil fine of at least $3,000
options.cn: 至少3,000美元的民事罚款

options.en: A 90-day suspension and mandatory retraining
options.cn: 暂停执照效力90天并强制重新培训

options.en: A probationary period of at least one year
options.cn: 至少一年的缓刑期

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7123.5 explicitly requires the CSLB to take disciplinary action that includes a suspension of at least six months or permanent revocation of the contractor's license upon a conviction under Penal Code Section 396 for price gouging on repair or reconstruction services.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7123.5条明确要求CSLB在根据刑法第396条因修理或重建服务价格欺诈被定罪时，采取的纪律处分必须包括暂停执照效力至少六个月或永久吊销承包商执照。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7123.5 (Document p. 340, PDF p. 363)

question_en: A qualifying individual is disassociated from a license after acts occur that result in an arbitration award against the company. Is the former qualifying individual still responsible for complying with that award?
question_cn: 当导致仲裁裁决针对公司发生的行为发生后，有资格的个人与执照解除关联。前有资格的个人是否仍然需要遵守该裁决？

options.en: Only if the license has not yet been formally revoked
options.cn: 仅在执照尚未正式吊销的情况下

options.en: No, disassociation fully relieves all prior obligations
options.cn: 不，解除关联会完全解除之前的所有义务

options.en: Only if the individual had direct knowledge of the acts
options.cn: 仅在个人对这些行为有直接了解的情况下

options.en: Yes, disassociation does not eliminate that responsibility
options.cn: 是的，解除关联不会消除该责任

explanation_en: Under B&P Code Section 7122.2, disassociation from the license after acts or omissions occurred does not relieve the qualifying individual from complying with an arbitration award resulting from those acts. Section 7122.5 applies if the award is not complied with.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7122.2条，在行为或疏忽发生后与执照解除关联，并不解除有资格的个人遵守由这些行为产生的仲裁裁决的义务。如果未遵守裁决，则适用第7122.5条。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7122.2 (Document p. 339, PDF p. 362)

question_en: Which of the following is NOT listed as a cause for discipline under B&P Code Section 7116.5?
question_cn: 以下哪项未被列为根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7116.5条进行纪律处分的原因？

options.en: Failing to maintain required business records
options.cn: 未能维护所需的业务记录

options.en: Attempting to subvert a board investigation
options.cn: 试图破坏委员会调查

options.en: Threatening a person providing evidence in disciplinary action
options.cn: 威胁在纪律处分中提供证据的人

options.en: Firing an employee for aiding compliance with the chapter
options.cn: 因员工协助遵守本章而解雇该员工

explanation_en: Section 7116.5 lists only three causes for discipline: subverting investigations, threatening witnesses, and retaliating against employees who aid compliance. Failure to maintain business records is not enumerated in this section.
explanation_cn: 第7116.5条仅列出了三种纪律处分的原因：破坏调查、威胁证人以及对协助遵守规定的员工进行报复。未能维护业务记录不在本条款中列举。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7116.5 (Document p. 333, PDF p. 356)

question_en: A contractor is operating under a license that has been made inactive. What does this constitute under California law?
question_cn: 承包商在已被停用的执照下从事业务。这在加利福尼亚法律下构成什么？

options.en: A minor administrative violation with a small fine
options.cn: 轻微的行政违规并附带小额罚款

options.en: Permissible if the contractor self-reports within 30 days
options.cn: 如果承包商在30天内自我报告，则允许

options.en: A cause for disciplinary action
options.cn: 可作为纪律处分的原因

options.en: Allowed if the contractor has a pending renewal application
options.cn: 如果承包商有待处理的续期申请，则允许

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7117.5(a) states that acting in the capacity of a contractor under any license that has been made inactive constitutes a cause for disciplinary action.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7117.5(a)条规定，以任何已被停用的执照身份从事承包商行为构成可作为纪律处分的原因。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7117.5 (Document p. 333, PDF p. 356)

question_en: A person who was the qualifying individual on a revoked license wants to serve as a manager for a different licensed contractor. Under B&P Code Section 7121.5, is this permitted?
question_cn: 一名在被吊销的执照上担任资质个人的人希望为另一家持证承包商担任经理。根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7121.5条，这是否允许？

options.en: Yes, after a two-year waiting period
options.cn: 是的，在两年等待期后

options.en: No, and hiring them as a manager grounds the employer for discipline
options.cn: 不允许，并且雇用他们为经理会成为雇主受纪律处分的理由

options.en: Yes, as a manager but not as a qualifying individual
options.cn: 是的，可以作为经理但不能作为资质个人

options.en: Yes, if the individual had no knowledge of the violations
options.cn: 是的，如果该个人对违规行为毫不知情

explanation_en: Under B&P Code Section 7121.5, a qualifying individual from a revoked license is prohibited from serving as a manager of a licensee, regardless of knowledge or participation in the prohibited acts. Employing or associating such a person in that capacity constitutes grounds for disciplinary action against the hiring licensee.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7121.5条，来自被吊销执照的资质个人被禁止担任持证人的经理，不论是否了解或参与禁止行为。以该身份雇用或与此类人关联构成对雇用持证人的纪律处分理由。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7121.5 (Document p. 336, PDF p. 359)

question_en: A contractor hires an asbestos remediation subcontractor without verifying the subcontractor's certification, and the subcontractor turns out to be uncertified. This is the contractor's second such offense. What is the penalty?
question_cn: 一名承包商在未核实分包商资质的情况下雇佣了一名石棉治理分包商，而该分包商实际上没有资质。这是该承包商的第二次此类违规。处罚是什么？

options.en: A civil penalty and a 30-day suspension only
options.cn: 仅处以民事罚款和30天暂停执照效力

options.en: An infraction with a fine up to $3,000
options.cn: 违规行为，可处高达3,000美元的罚款

options.en: Permanent revocation with no possibility of reinstatement
options.cn: 永久吊销，无复职可能

options.en: A misdemeanor with mandatory license suspension or revocation
options.cn: 轻罪，并强制停牌或吊销执照

explanation_en: Under B&P Code Section 7118.5(b), a subsequent offense for contracting with an uncertified asbestos worker is a misdemeanor that requires revocation or suspension of the contractor's license, plus a fine of $3,000–$5,000, up to one year in county jail, or both.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7118.5(b)条款，与无资质石棉工进行签约的再次违规属于轻罪，需吊销或暂停承包商执照，并处3,000–5,000美元罚款，或最多1年县监狱监禁，或两者兼施。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7118.5 (Document p. 334, PDF p. 357)

question_en: A contractor has received full payment for a roofing project but deliberately refuses to pay the roofing materials supplier despite having the funds available. What does this constitute?
question_cn: 承包商已经为一个屋顶工程收到了全额付款，但故意拒绝支付屋顶材料供应商，即使他有可用资金。 这构成什么？

options.en: A cause for disciplinary action
options.cn: 可成为纪律处分的理由

options.en: A civil breach of contract only
options.cn: 仅构成民事违约

options.en: Permissible if the supplier has not filed a lien
options.cn: 如果供应商没有提出留置权，则允许

options.en: An infraction resulting only in a fine
options.cn: 仅导致罚款的违规行为

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7120 states that willful or deliberate failure to pay for materials when the contractor has the capacity to pay, or has received sufficient funds for that project, constitutes a cause for disciplinary action.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7120条规定，当承包商有能力支付材料费用或已经为该项目收到足够资金而故意或有意不支付材料费用时，可成为纪律处分的理由。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7120 (Document p. 335, PDF p. 358)

question_en: Under B&P Code Section 7122.5, when can a qualifying individual avoid disciplinary action for prohibited acts committed by others within their licensed entity?
question_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7122.5条，符合条件的个人在何种情况下可以避免因其持证实体中他人所犯的禁止行为而受到纪律处分？

options.en: When they were on an approved leave of absence
options.cn: 当他们处于经批准的休假期间

options.en: When they were not the qualifying individual at the time
options.cn: 当他们在当时不是符合条件的个人

options.en: When they had no knowledge of the prohibited act
options.cn: 当他们对禁止行为毫不知情

options.en: When they did not directly participate in the acts
options.cn: 当他们没有直接参与这些行为

explanation_en: Under B&P Code Section 7122.5, disciplinary action applies to the individual who 'at the time that the act or omission occurred was the qualifying individual.' If the individual was not serving as qualifying individual when the act occurred, this section does not apply to them.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7122.5条，纪律处分适用于“在行为或遗漏发生时是符合条件的个人”的个人。如果该个人在行为发生时并未担任符合条件的个人，则本条款不适用于他们。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7122.5 (Document p. 339, PDF p. 362)

question_en: A contractor signs a certificate falsely vouching for an applicant's experience qualifications to help the applicant obtain a contractor's license. What consequence does the signing contractor face?
question_cn: 承包商签署了一份证书，虚假证明申请人的经验和资格，以帮助申请人获得承包商执照。签署该证书的承包商会面临什么后果？

options.en: Criminal prosecution for fraud only
options.cn: 仅因欺诈而受到刑事起诉

options.en: A civil fine assessed against the applicant only
options.cn: 仅对申请人处以民事罚款

options.en: Disciplinary action against the signing licensee
options.cn: 对签署执照持有人的纪律处分

options.en: No liability if the applicant passed the exam independently
options.cn: 如果申请人独立通过考试，则不承担责任

explanation_en: Under B&P Code Section 7114.1, any licensee whose signature appears on a falsified certificate supporting an examinee's false experience qualifications submitted to obtain a contractor's license is subject to disciplinary action.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7114.1条，任何执照持有人的签名出现在用于支持考生虚假经验资格的伪造证书上，该证书用于申请承包商执照，将受到纪律处分。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7114.1 (Document p. 331, PDF p. 354)

question_en: A contractor is convicted under a plea of nolo contendere for a crime related to contracting. Later, the conviction is set aside under Penal Code Section 1203.4. Can the CSLB still use this conviction as a basis for disciplinary action?
question_cn: 一名承包商因与承包相关的犯罪以不抗辩方式认罪而被定罪。后来，根据《刑法》第1203.4条，该定罪被撤销。CSLB仍然可以以此定罪作为纪律处分的依据吗？

options.en: No, the set-aside eliminates any licensing consequences
options.cn: 不，可以撤销的定罪会消除任何许可方面的后果

options.en: Yes, the set-aside does not prevent CSLB disciplinary action
options.cn: 是的，定罪被撤销并不阻止CSLB采取纪律处分

options.en: Only if the crime directly involved a construction project
options.cn: 仅当犯罪直接涉及建筑项目时才适用

options.en: Only if the contractor re-offends within five years
options.cn: 仅当承包商在五年内再次犯罪时才适用

explanation_en: Under B&P Code Section 7124, a plea of nolo contendere is deemed a conviction for licensing purposes. The board may suspend or revoke the license, and a subsequent order under Penal Code Section 1203.4 setting aside the verdict does not affect the CSLB's authority to act.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7124条，对于许可目的，不抗辩认罪视为定罪。委员会可以暂停或吊销执照，而根据《刑法》第1203.4条随后作出的撤销判决的命令，不影响CSLB采取行动的权力。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7124 (Document p. 340, PDF p. 363)

question_en: An individual who was a qualifying individual on a revoked license wants to work for a new licensed contractor before starting employment. What must the individual do first?
question_cn: 一名在被吊销的执照上曾是合格个人的人想要在开始工作之前为一个新的持证承包商工作。该个人首先必须做什么？

options.en: Wait two years before seeking new contractor employment
options.cn: 在寻求新的承包商工作之前等待两年

options.en: Obtain CSLB approval before starting any work
options.cn: 在开始任何工作之前获得 CSLB 批准

options.en: Provide the prospective employer written notice of the revocation
options.cn: 向潜在雇主提供执照吊销的书面通知

options.en: File a disclosure form with the CSLB
options.cn: 向 CSLB 提交披露表格

explanation_en: Under B&P Code Section 7121.65, prior to becoming employed in any capacity by a contractor-licensed entity, an individual described in Section 7121.6(a) or (b) must provide the prospective employer with written notice of the license revocation.
explanation_cn: 根据 《加州商业与职业法典》第 7121.65 条，在以任何身份受雇于承包商持证实体之前，第 7121.6(a) 或 (b) 条所述的个人必须向潜在雇主提供执照吊销的书面通知。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7121.65 (Document p. 337, PDF p. 360)

question_en: A licensed contractor performs work under a classification they are not currently licensed to hold. What does this constitute under California law?
question_cn: 持证承包商在未获得相应执照的分类下进行工作。在加利福尼亚州法律中，这属于什么行为？

options.en: A cause for disciplinary action
options.cn: 可成为纪律处分的原因

options.en: Allowable with written owner consent on the contract
options.cn: 在合同上取得业主书面同意的情况下允许

options.en: A minor violation correctable by filing an amended application
options.cn: 可通过提交修正申请予以纠正的轻微违规行为

options.en: Permissible if closely related to a held classification
options.cn: 如果与已持有的分类密切相关，则允许

explanation_en: Under B&P Code Section 7117.6, acting in the capacity of a contractor in a classification other than that currently held by the licensee constitutes a cause for disciplinary action.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7117.6条，以承包商身份在其当前持有执照以外的分类中行事，构成可成为纪律处分的原因。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7117.6 (Document p. 333, PDF p. 356)

question_en: A licensed contractor knowingly employs an individual whose previous license was revoked, in a supervisory management role. What penalty does the contractor face under B&P Code Section 7121.7?
question_cn: 持牌承包商明知雇用一名之前执照被吊销的个人担任监督管理职务。根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7121.7条，该承包商将面临什么处罚？

options.en: Automatic license revocation with no appeal rights
options.cn: 执照自动吊销且无上诉权

options.en: A written warning and 60-day probationary period
options.cn: 书面警告和为期60天的缓刑期

options.en: An administrative fine of up to $5,000
options.cn: 最高5000美元的行政罚款

options.en: A misdemeanor with a minimum $4,500 fine or imprisonment
options.cn: 轻罪，最低罚款4500美元或监禁

explanation_en: Under B&P Code Section 7121.7(b), knowingly employing a person described in Section 7121.6 in a supervisory capacity is a misdemeanor punishable by a fine of not less than $4,500, by imprisonment in county jail for not less than 30 days nor more than one year, or both.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7121.7(b)条，明知雇用第7121.6条所述人员担任监督职务是轻罪，可处不低于4500美元的罚款，县监狱监禁不少于30天且不超过一年，或两者兼施。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7121.7 (Document p. 338, PDF p. 361)

question_en: A veteran of the U.S. Armed Forces who was honorably discharged applies for an initial contractor's license as an individual owner. What fee reduction does the board grant?
question_cn: 一名曾荣誉退伍的美国武装部队老兵以个人业主身份申请初始承包商执照。委员会授予什么样的费用减免？

options.en: A 50% reduction in the initial license fee
options.cn: 初始执照费用减免50%

options.en: A full waiver of all initial license fees
options.cn: 全额免除所有初始执照费用

options.en: A waiver of the application fee only
options.cn: 仅免除申请费

options.en: A 25% reduction in the initial license fee
options.cn: 初始执照费用减免25%

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7137(a)(3)(D)(i) grants a 50% reduction in initial license or registration fees to veterans of the U.S. Armed Forces, including the National Guard or Reserve, who were not dishonorably discharged.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7137(a)(3)(D)(i)条款，美国武装部队（包括国民警卫队或预备役）退伍军人（未被不光彩退役者）可享受初始执照或注册费用50%的减免。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7137(a)(3)(D)(i) (Document p. 352, PDF p. 375)

question_en: A contractor wants to support construction management education while renewing their license. How can they contribute to the Construction Management Education Account?
question_cn: 承包商希望在续期执照时支持建筑管理教育。他们如何向建筑管理教育账户做出贡献？

options.en: Request a grant directly from the advisory committee
options.cn: 直接向咨询委员会申请资助

options.en: Submit a separate donation to CSLB headquarters
options.cn: 向 CSLB 总部提交单独捐款

options.en: Deduct the contribution from the renewal fee
options.cn: 从续费中扣除捐款

options.en: Contribute at the time of license fee payment
options.cn: 在支付执照费用时捐款

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7139.2(b) requires CSLB to allow contractors to make a contribution to the CMEA at the time of license fee payment, with the option clearly displayed on the fee form.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 7139.2(b) 条要求 CSLB 允许承包商在支付执照费用时向 CMEA 捐款，并在费用表上清楚显示此选项。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7139.2 (Document p. 356, PDF p. 379)

question_en: Under the Construction Management Education Sponsorship Act, what is the maximum percentage of total available funds that may be awarded to a single public postsecondary educational institution?
question_cn: 根据《建设管理教育资助法》，授予单一公立高等教育机构的总可用资金的最高比例是多少？

options.en: 20 percent of available funds
options.cn: 可用资金的 20%

options.en: 10 percent of available funds
options.cn: 可用资金的 10%

options.en: 15 percent of available funds
options.cn: 可用资金的 15%

options.en: 25 percent of available funds
options.cn: 可用资金的 25%

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7139.3(b) expressly states that the total amount awarded to one public postsecondary institution may not exceed 25 percent of total funds available under the article.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 7139.3(b) 条明确规定，授予单一公立高等教育机构的总金额不得超过本条款下总可用资金的 25%。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7139.3(b) (Document p. 357, PDF p. 380)

question_en: A school develops a new construction management curriculum seeking CMEA grant funding but is not yet accredited by the American Council for Construction Education. Under Section 7139.5, what is the maximum annual grant it may receive?
question_cn: 一所学校开发了新的建筑管理课程，寻求 CMEA 资助，但尚未获得美国建筑教育委员会的认证。根据第 7139.5 条，它每年最多可以获得多少资助？

options.en: Up to $15,000 per year
options.cn: 每年最多 15,000 美元

options.en: Up to $3,000 per graduate placed
options.cn: 每位安置的毕业生最多 3,000 美元

options.en: Up to $25,000 per year
options.cn: 每年最多 25,000 美元

options.en: No grant until fully accredited
options.cn: 直到完全认证前不提供资助

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7139.5(d) allows institutions qualifying under subdivision (d) -- those developing a curriculum toward ACCE criteria -- to receive up to $25,000 per year for up to two years.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 7139.5(d) 条允许符合(d)款条件的机构——即开发符合 ACCE 标准课程的机构——每年最多获得 25,000 美元的资助，期限最多为两年。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7139.5(d) (Document p. 358, PDF p. 381)

question_en: Which of the following expenses is NOT an allowable use of a CMEA grant awarded to a qualified institution?
question_cn: 以下哪项费用不是授予合格机构的CMEA拨款的允许用途？

options.en: Visiting lecturer compensation and expenses
options.cn: 访问讲师的薪酬和费用

options.en: Faculty recruitment and development costs
options.cn: 教职员工招聘和发展费用

options.en: Faculty salary supplements
options.cn: 教职员工薪资补贴

options.en: Cooperative education and internship program support
options.cn: 合作教育和实习项目支持

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7139.6(b) explicitly states that 'support' does not include faculty salary supplements, making this the one expense that may NOT be funded by CMEA grants.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7139.6(b)条明确指出，“支持”不包括教职员工薪资补贴，因此这项费用不得由CMEA拨款资助。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7139.6 (Document p. 359, PDF p. 382)

question_en: How many members make up the Construction Management Education Account Advisory Committee?
question_cn: 建筑管理教育账户咨询委员会由多少成员组成？

options.en: 9 members representing major trades
options.cn: 9名成员，代表主要行业

options.en: 13 members including public representatives
options.cn: 13名成员，包括公众代表

options.en: 11 members from specified industry groups
options.cn: 11名成员，来自指定行业团体

options.en: 7 members appointed by the board
options.cn: 7名成员，由董事会任命

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7139.3(c) establishes the advisory committee at exactly 11 members, with at least one representative from each of the listed contractor organizations and one from the university construction management programs.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7139.3(c)条规定咨询委员会的成员数为11人，其中至少包括每个列出的承包商组织的代表各一名，以及一名来自大学建筑管理项目的代表。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7139.3(c) (Document p. 357, PDF p. 380)

question_en: An institution qualifying under Section 7139.4(c) placed 80 graduates with California licensed contractors last year. Approximately how much grant funding could it receive under the CMEA?
question_cn: 根据第7139.4(c)条款符合资格的机构去年将80名毕业生安置到加利福尼亚州持证承包商处。在CMEA下，它大约可以获得多少拨款？

options.en: $15,000 maximum administrative allocation
options.cn: 最高$15,000的管理分配

options.en: $240,000 based on total enrollment
options.cn: 基于总入学人数的$240,000

options.en: $240,000 based on graduates placed
options.cn: 基于安置毕业生人数的$240,000

options.en: $25,000 flat annual grant
options.cn: 每年固定$25,000拨款

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7139.5(c) grants $3,000 per graduate placed with California licensed contractors. 80 graduates × $3,000 = $240,000, subject to the 25 percent cap on total available funds.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7139.5(c)条款，每安置一名毕业生到加利福尼亚州持证承包商处，可获得$3,000。80名毕业生 × $3,000 = $240,000，但受总可用资金25%的上限限制。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7139.5(c) (Document p. 358, PDF p. 381)

question_en: What is the maximum amount per year that CSLB may allocate from the CMEA for administration of the Construction Management Education Sponsorship Act?
question_cn: CSLB每年可从CMEA分配用于《建筑管理教育资助法》管理的最高金额是多少？

options.en: $15,000 per year
options.cn: 每年15,000美元

options.en: $50,000 per year
options.cn: 每年50,000美元

options.en: $25,000 per year
options.cn: 每年25,000美元

options.en: $10,000 per year
options.cn: 每年10,000美元

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7139.9 expressly limits the board's administrative allocation from the CMEA to $15,000 per year.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7139.9条明确限制委员会每年从CMEA获得的管理分配为15,000美元。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7139.9 (Document p. 360, PDF p. 383)

question_en: How long does a California contractor's license last before it must be renewed?
question_cn: 加利福尼亚州承包商执照在必须续期之前的有效期是多久？

options.en: One year from the issuance date
options.cn: 自签发日期起一年

options.en: Two years from the last day of the issuance month
options.cn: 自签发月份的最后一天起两年

options.en: Four years from the last renewal date
options.cn: 自上次续期日期起四年

options.en: Three years from the issuance date
options.cn: 自签发日期起三年

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7140 specifies that licenses expire two years from the last day of the month in which the license is issued, or two years from the date the renewed license last expired.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7140条规定，执照自签发月份的最后一天起两年后到期，或者自上次续期执照到期之日起两年后到期。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7140 (Document p. 360, PDF p. 383)

question_en: A contractor's license expired 18 months ago. The contractor wants to reinstate it without taking a new exam. Under Section 7141, which of the following is TRUE?
question_cn: 承包商的执照已过期 18 个月。承包商希望在不参加新考试的情况下恢复执照。根据第 7141 条，下列哪项是正确的？

options.en: The license can still be renewed by application
options.cn: 可以通过申请续期来更新执照

options.en: Reinstatement requires board approval after 12 months
options.cn: 恢复执照需在 12 个月后经委员会批准

options.en: A new exam is required after any lapse
options.cn: 任何中断后都需要新考试

options.en: The license cannot be reinstated after 12 months
options.cn: 12 个月后无法恢复执照

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7141(a) allows a licensee to renew an expired license at any time within five years after expiration by filing a renewal application. At 18 months, the contractor is well within this window.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 7141(a) 条允许执照持有人在执照过期五年内的任何时间，通过提交续期申请来更新过期执照。18 个月时，该承包商完全在此期限内。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7141 (Document p. 360, PDF p. 383)

question_en: The CSLB board sets its fees to maintain a reserve fund. Under Section 7138.1, what is the maximum reserve fund level the board may target?
question_cn: CSLB 委员会设定其费用以维持储备资金。根据第 7138.1 条，委员会可以设定的最大储备资金水平是多少？

options.en: Approximately 12 months of annual expenditures
options.cn: 约为 12 个月的年度支出

options.en: Approximately 18 months of annual expenditures
options.cn: 约为 18 个月的年度支出

options.en: Approximately 24 months of annual expenditures
options.cn: 约为 24 个月的年度支出

options.en: Approximately 36 months of annual expenditures
options.cn: 约为 36 个月的年度支出

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7138.1 directs the board to fix fees so that revenues maintain the reserve fund at a level not to exceed approximately 12 months of annual authorized board expenditures.
explanation_cn: 《商务与专业法典》第 7138.1 条指示委员会固定费用，以使收入维持储备资金在不超过约 12 个月年度经批准的委员会支出的水平。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7138.1 (Document p. 355, PDF p. 378)

question_en: An institution receiving a CMEA grant for the second year must submit a report to the CSLB board. Which of the following is NOT a required element of that report?
question_cn: 接受第二年 CMEA 资助的机构必须向 CSLB 委员会提交报告。以下哪项不是该报告的必需内容？

options.en: Itemized budget for the next grant year
options.cn: 下一拨资助年度的明细预算

options.en: Number of graduates placed with licensed contractors
options.cn: 被持牌承包商录用的毕业生人数

options.en: Expected enrollment in upcoming construction courses
options.cn: 即将开设的建筑课程的预期注册人数

options.en: Continuing education courses offered and their enrollments
options.cn: 提供的继续教育课程及其注册情况

explanation_en: Section 7139.8 requires reporting on past grant utilization, graduates placed, expected enrollment, and continuing education offerings. A forward-looking itemized budget is not listed as a required element.
explanation_cn: 第 7139.8 节要求报告过去资助的使用情况、毕业生录用情况、预期招生情况及继续教育课程。面向未来的明细预算并未列为必需内容。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7139.8 (Document p. 359, PDF p. 382)

question_en: A contractor organization incorporated under the Corporations Code wants to direct a CMEA grant to a specific university. Under Section 7139.3, which of the following is correct?
question_cn: 根据《公司法》注册成立的承包商组织希望将 CMEA 资助定向给某个特定大学。根据第 7139.3 节，下列哪项是正确的？

options.en: It must first get advisory committee approval
options.cn: 它必须先获得咨询委员会的批准

options.en: It may award grants directly without board involvement
options.cn: 它可以在不经过董事会的情况下直接授予资助

options.en: It may fund any accredited private university of its choice
options.cn: 它可以资助任何其选择的经认证的私立大学

options.en: It may request the board to award grants to its chosen institution
options.cn: 它可以请求董事会将资助授予其选择的机构

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7139.3(b) allows a qualifying contractor organization to request that the board award grants directly to a public postsecondary institution of its choice, subject to the 25 percent cap.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 7139.3(b) 节允许符合条件的承包商组织请求董事会将资助直接授予其选择的公立高等教育机构，但须遵守 25% 上限。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7139.3(b) (Document p. 357, PDF p. 380)

question_en: Which of the following correctly describes how CMEA advisory committee members are appointed and compensated?
question_cn: 以下哪项正确描述了CMEA咨询委员会成员的任命和报酬方式？

options.en: Appointed by each group; serve one-year terms
options.cn: 由各组任命；任期为一年

options.en: Appointed by the Governor; paid per diem
options.cn: 由州长任命；按日支付津贴

options.en: Appointed by each group; no per diem or reimbursement
options.cn: 由各组任命；不支付日津贴或报销费用

options.en: Appointed by CSLB board; receive travel reimbursement
options.cn: 由CSLB董事会任命；获得差旅报销

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7139.3(c) states that representatives are appointed by each identified group and that members shall not receive per diem or reimbursement for traveling and other expenses pursuant to Section 103.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7139.3(c)条规定，代表由各指定组任命，成员不得根据第103条领取差旅及其他费用的日津贴或报销。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7139.3(c) (Document p. 357, PDF p. 380)

question_en: Under the Construction Management Education Sponsorship Act, which funding source is authorized to provide grants to qualified institutions?
question_cn: 根据《建设管理教育资助法》，哪个资金来源被授权向合格机构提供拨款？

options.en: The Contractors' License Fund only
options.cn: 仅承包商执照基金

options.en: The DCA's education and training budget
options.cn: DCA的教育和培训预算

options.en: University endowment funds matched by CSLB
options.cn: CSLB配套的大学捐赠基金

options.en: The state general fund and federal appropriations
options.cn: 州政府一般基金和联邦拨款

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7139.10 states that state funding for CMEA grants shall be provided only from the Contractors' License Fund to the extent funds are available, with no other state funding authorized.
explanation_cn: 《商业与专业法》第7139.10条规定，CMEA拨款的州资金应仅从承包商执照基金提供，资金以可用为准，不授权使用其他州资金。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7139.10 (Document p. 360, PDF p. 383)

question_en: A home improvement salesperson quits working for a contractor on March 1. By what date must the contractor notify the registrar in writing of this separation?
question_cn: 一名家庭装修销售员于3月1日辞职离开承包商工作。承包商必须在什么日期之前以书面形式通知注册主任此分离情况？

options.en: Within 90 days after the salesperson ceases employment
options.cn: 在销售员停止工作后的90天内

options.en: Within 60 days after employment ends
options.cn: 在雇佣结束后的60天内

options.en: Before the salesperson begins work elsewhere
options.cn: 在销售员开始其他工作之前

options.en: Within 30 days after the salesperson stops working
options.cn: 在销售员停止工作后的30天内

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7154(b) requires the contractor to notify the registrar within 90 days after a registered home improvement salesperson ceases to be employed.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7154(b)条要求承包商在注册家庭装修销售员停止受雇后的90天内通知注册主任。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7154(b) (Document p. 370, PDF p. 393)

question_en: Which individual is NOT required to register as a home improvement salesperson before soliciting home improvement contracts?
question_cn: 哪一位个人在招揽家庭装修合同前不需要注册为家庭装修销售员？

options.en: An outside consultant who negotiates contracts for the owner
options.cn: 为业主谈判合同的外部顾问

options.en: A subcontractor who occasionally upsells additional services
options.cn: 偶尔推销额外服务的分包商

options.en: An employee who only schedules appointments for registered salespersons
options.cn: 仅为注册销售员安排预约的员工

options.en: A part-time sales rep canvassing neighborhoods for leads
options.cn: 在社区兜售潜在客户的兼职销售代表

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7152(d)(5) expressly exempts a person who contacts prospective buyers solely for the purpose of scheduling appointments for a registered home improvement salesperson.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 7152(d)(5) 条明确豁免那些仅为了为注册家庭装修销售员安排预约而联系潜在买家的人。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7152(d) (Document p. 366, PDF p. 389)

question_en: A registered home improvement salesperson fails to disclose the license number of the contractor they represent before finalizing a contract. What is the consequence?
question_cn: 注册的家居改进销售人员在签订合同前未披露其所代表承包商的许可证号码，会有什么后果？

options.en: The salesperson must pay a fine of at least $500
options.cn: 销售人员必须支付至少 500 美元的罚款

options.en: The registration is immediately suspended by the registrar
options.cn: 注册人将立即暂停其注册

options.en: It is cause for disciplinary action against the salesperson
options.cn: 这构成对销售人员进行纪律处分的理由

options.en: The contract is automatically void and unenforceable
options.cn: 合同自动无效且不可执行

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7152(c) states that failure to identify the contractor's business name and license number prior to any sales activity 'is a cause of disciplinary action within the meaning of Section 7155.'
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 7152(c) 条规定，在任何销售活动之前未能识别承包商的商业名称和许可证号码，“构成第 7155 条所指的纪律处分理由。”
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7152(c) (Document p. 366, PDF p. 389)

question_en: A home improvement salesperson working for Contractor A commits a licensing violation without the contractor's knowledge. Which of the following is true?
question_cn: 为承包商A工作的家庭装修销售员在承包商不知情的情况下违反了执照规定。以下哪项是正确的？

options.en: The contractor's license is automatically revoked
options.cn: 承包商的执照会被自动吊销

options.en: Only the salesperson faces disciplinary action
options.cn: 只有销售员会受到纪律处分

options.en: The contractor is liable only if they directed the violation
options.cn: 只有在承包商指示违规行为时，承包商才会承担责任

options.en: The contractor may face discipline regardless of their knowledge
options.cn: 无论承包商是否知情，承包商都可能面临纪律处分

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7155.5 states that violations by a home improvement salesperson constitute cause for disciplinary action against the employing contractor 'whether or not the contractor had knowledge of or participated in' the violation.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7155.5条规定，家庭装修销售员的违规行为构成对雇佣该销售员的承包商进行纪律处分的理由，“无论承包商是否知悉或参与”该违规行为。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7155.5 (Document p. 371, PDF p. 394)

question_en: How long after expiration does a home improvement salesperson have to renew a lapsed registration before being required to file a brand-new application?
question_cn: 家居改进销售人员在注册过期后，需要在多久内续订过期注册，才无需提交全新的申请？

options.en: Within 18 months after the registration expires
options.cn: 注册过期后18个月内

options.en: Within one year after the registration expires
options.cn: 注册过期后一年内

options.en: Within three years after the registration expires
options.cn: 注册过期后三年内

options.en: Within two years after the registration expires
options.cn: 注册过期后两年内

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7153.3(b) allows a salesperson to renew a delinquent registration at any time within three years after expiration. Beyond that window, a new application under Section 7153.1 is required.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7153.3(b)条允许销售人员在注册过期后三年内的任何时间续订逾期注册。超过该期限，则需要根据第7153.1条提交新的申请。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7153.3(b) (Document p. 369, PDF p. 392)

question_en: What penalty is charged for a delinquent renewal of a home improvement salesperson registration?
question_cn: 对于家庭装修销售员注册的逾期续费，会收取什么罚款？

options.en: 75 percent of the renewal fee
options.cn: 续费费用的 75%

options.en: 50 percent of the renewal fee
options.cn: 续费费用的 50%

options.en: Equal to the full renewal fee amount
options.cn: 相当于全部续费费用

options.en: 25 percent of the renewal fee
options.cn: 续费费用的 25%

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7153.3(b) expressly states that a delinquent renewal penalty equals 50 percent of the renewal fee, in addition to the renewal fee itself.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 7153.3(b) 条明确规定，逾期续费的罚款等于续费费用的 50%，此外还需支付续费费用本身。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7153.3(b) (Document p. 369, PDF p. 392)

question_en: A contractor is found to have employed an unregistered person to sell home improvement contracts. What does the contractor face?
question_cn: 发现一名承包商雇佣未经注册的人销售家庭装修合同。该承包商将面临什么？

options.en: Disciplinary action by the registrar
options.cn: 由注册主任进行的纪律处分

options.en: A criminal misdemeanor charge against the contractor
options.cn: 针对承包商的刑事轻罪指控

options.en: Automatic license suspension by the registrar
options.cn: 由注册主任自动吊销执照

options.en: A mandatory fine of $500 per violation
options.cn: 每次违规强制罚款500美元

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7154(d) states that a contractor who employs an unregistered person to sell home improvement contracts 'is subject to disciplinary action by the registrar.'
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7154(d)条规定，雇佣未经注册的人销售家庭装修合同的承包商“将受到注册主任的纪律处分。”
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7154(d) (Document p. 370, PDF p. 393)

question_en: Under California law, which of the following best defines 'home improvement' for purposes of the home improvement contractor statutes?
question_cn: 根据加利福尼亚州法律，下列哪项最能定义“家庭装修”，以适用于家庭装修承包商法规？

options.en: Commercial and residential property improvements equally
options.cn: 商业和住宅物业的改善同等适用

options.en: Repairing, remodeling, or adding to residential property
options.cn: 修理、改建或扩建住宅物业

options.en: Only work exceeding $500 in contract value
options.cn: 合同价值超过500美元的工作才算

options.en: New residential construction only, not remodeling
options.cn: 仅限新住宅建筑，不包括改建

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7151(a) defines 'home improvement' as repairing, remodeling, altering, converting, or modernizing of, or adding to, residential property, including driveways, pools, fences, and other adjacent land improvements.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7151(a)条将“家庭装修”定义为对住宅物业的修理、改建、改变、转换、现代化或扩建，包括车道、游泳池、围栏及其他相邻土地的改进。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7151(a) (Document p. 365, PDF p. 388)

question_en: A home improvement salesperson registration that has not been renewed expires. For how long is the registration valid from its original issue date?
question_cn: 家庭装修销售员注册如果未续期则会过期。从原始发放日期起，该注册有效期是多久？

options.en: Three years from the date of issue
options.cn: 自发放日期起三年

options.en: Two years from the last day of the issuance month
options.cn: 自发放月份最后一天起两年

options.en: One year from the last day of the issuance month
options.cn: 自发放月份最后一天起一年

options.en: Four years from the date of issue
options.cn: 自发放日期起四年

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7153.2 states that all home improvement salesperson registrations expire two years from the last day of the month in which the registration was issued.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7153.2条规定，所有家庭装修销售员注册从发放月份的最后一天起两年后过期。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7153.2 (Document p. 368, PDF p. 391)

question_en: A contractor's renewal application is rejected as incomplete. The registrar returns it. If the contractor fails to respond, when is the application deemed abandoned?
question_cn: 承包商的续期申请因不完整而被拒绝。注册主任退回申请。如果承包商未作出回应，申请何时视为放弃？

options.en: After 30 days from the original rejection date
options.cn: 自原拒绝日期起30天后

options.en: After 120 days from the original rejection date
options.cn: 自原拒绝日期起120天后

options.en: After 90 days from the original rejection date
options.cn: 自原拒绝日期起90天后

options.en: After 60 days from the original rejection date
options.cn: 自原拒绝日期起60天后

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7153.3(c)(1) states that if a registrant fails to return an application rejected for insufficiency within 90 days from the original date of rejection, the application and fee are deemed abandoned.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7153.3(c)(1)条规定，如果注册人未在自原拒绝日期起90天内退回因不足而被拒的申请，则该申请及费用视为放弃。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7153.3(c)(1) (Document p. 369, PDF p. 392)

question_en: After receiving a completed asbestos consultant certification application, within how many days must the division issue a certification card to a qualifying applicant?
question_cn: 在收到完整的石棉顾问认证申请后，部门必须在多少天内向符合条件的申请人颁发认证卡？

options.en: Within 30 days of the completed application
options.cn: 在收到完整申请后的30天内

options.en: Within 60 days of the completed application
options.cn: 在收到完整申请后的60天内

options.en: Within 15 days of the completed application
options.cn: 在收到完整申请后的15天内

options.en: Within 45 days of the completed application
options.cn: 在收到完整申请后的45天内

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7183(a) requires the division to issue a certification card within 45 days of the date of filing a completed application to each person who qualifies for certification.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7183(a)条要求部门在收到完整申请之日起45天内向每位符合认证条件的人颁发认证卡。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7183(a) (Document p. 411, PDF p. 434)

question_en: A contractor fails to produce a fire alarm certification to CSLB within 30 days of a written request. What is the legal consequence?
question_cn: 承包商未能在收到书面请求后的30天内向CSLB提供消防报警认证。法律后果是什么？

options.en: The contractor's license is automatically suspended
options.cn: 承包商的执照将被自动暂停

options.en: The exemption from Section 7159 is permanently revoked
options.cn: 第7159条的豁免将被永久撤销

options.en: A presumption arises that Section 7159 was violated
options.cn: 推定违反第7159条

options.en: The contractor must pay a $1,000 administrative fine
options.cn: 承包商必须支付1000美元的行政罚款

explanation_en: Section 7159.9(f) states that failure to provide the certification or contract within 30 days of a written request creates a presumption that the licensee violated Section 7159, unless the licensee presents evidence to the contrary within the board's specified timeframe.
explanation_cn: 第7159.9(f)条规定，如果在收到书面请求后的30天内未能提供认证或合同，将推定执照持有人违反了第7159条，除非执照持有人在董事会规定的时间内提供相反证据。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7159.9(f) (Document p. 391, PDF p. 414)

question_en: A contractor convicted of a first offense for practicing as an uncertified asbestos consultant faces which penalty?
question_cn: 一名承包商因未经认证担任石棉顾问而第一次被定罪，将面临哪种处罚？

options.en: An infraction with a fine between $1,000 and $3,000
options.cn: 轻罪，罚款在1,000美元至3,000美元之间

options.en: A fine between $3,000 and $5,000
options.cn: 罚款在3,000美元至5,000美元之间

options.en: Automatic revocation of any contractor's license
options.cn: 自动吊销任何承包商执照

options.en: A misdemeanor and up to one year imprisonment
options.cn: 轻罪，最高可判一年监禁

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7189(a) states a first offense is an infraction punishable by a fine of not less than $1,000 or more than $3,000.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7189(a)条规定，首次违法为轻罪，可处不少于1,000美元且不超过3,000美元的罚款。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7189(a) (Document p. 414, PDF p. 437)

question_en: A licensed general contractor wants to use a city councilmember's name in a print advertisement. Which action is required before doing so?
question_cn: 一名持牌总承包商希望在印刷广告中使用市议员的名字。在这样做之前需要采取哪种措施？

options.en: Include the official's title in bold print only
options.cn: 仅以加粗字体包含官员的职务

options.en: Notify CSLB in writing before publication
options.cn: 在出版前以书面形式通知加州承包商州立委员会（CSLB）

options.en: Obtain verbal consent and document it internally
options.cn: 获得口头同意并在内部记录

options.en: Obtain written authorization from the official
options.cn: 获取该官员的书面授权

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7190(a) prohibits using a public official's name or position in advertising without the public official's written authorization.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7190(a)条禁止在广告中使用公职人员的名字或职位，除非获得公职人员的书面授权。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7190(a) (Document p. 415, PDF p. 438)

question_en: Which of the following activities is considered an unfair business practice for a home inspector under B&P Code Section 7197?
question_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7197条，以下哪项活动被认为是家庭检查员的不公平商业行为？

options.en: Inspecting a property owned by an unrelated third party
options.cn: 检查由无关第三方拥有的房产

options.en: Charging a fee to inspect an arm's-length sale property
options.cn: 对公平交易的房产收取检查费

options.en: Performing repairs on a property inspected 18 months ago
options.cn: 对18个月前检查的房产进行维修

options.en: Offering compensation to a real estate agent for referrals
options.cn: 向房地产经纪人提供推荐报酬

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7197(a)(3) explicitly prohibits offering or delivering compensation, inducement, or reward to a broker or agent for referral of business to the inspector.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7197(a)(3)条明确禁止为业务推荐向经纪人或代理提供或交付报酬、诱因或奖励。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7197(a) (Document p. 421, PDF p. 444)

question_en: A home inspector who is not a licensed contractor, architect, or registered engineer must perform inspections with what standard of care?
question_cn: 未持有承包商、建筑师或注册工程师执照的房屋检查员必须以何种谨慎标准进行检查？

options.en: The degree of care a reasonably prudent home inspector would exercise
options.cn: 一个谨慎的房屋检查员会采取的谨慎程度

options.en: The highest degree of professional care
options.cn: 最高的专业谨慎程度

options.en: No specific standard, as determined by the client
options.cn: 没有具体标准，由客户决定

options.en: The care of a licensed structural engineer
options.cn: 持牌结构工程师的谨慎程度

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7196 requires a home inspector not licensed as a general contractor, structural pest control operator, or architect to conduct inspections with the degree of care a reasonably prudent home inspector would exercise.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7196条规定，未持有总承包商、结构害虫控制操作员或建筑师执照的房屋检查员必须以一个谨慎的房屋检查员会采取的谨慎程度进行检查。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7196 (Document p. 419, PDF p. 442)

question_en: A home inspector's company inspected a property 10 months ago. The same company is now offered a contract to perform repairs on that same property. What does California law require?
question_cn: 一家房屋检查公司的检查员在10个月前检查了某处房产。现在，该公司被提供合同来对同一房产进行维修。加利福尼亚州法律要求什么？

options.en: Repairs are allowed with written client disclosure
options.cn: 如果有书面客户披露，则允许维修

options.en: Repairs are allowed if a different inspector performed the inspection
options.cn: 如果由不同的检查员进行检查，则允许维修

options.en: Repairs are allowed after CSLB pre-approves the contract
options.cn: 经过CSLB预先批准合同后允许维修

options.en: The company must decline; 12 months have not elapsed
options.cn: 公司必须拒绝；尚未经过12个月

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7197(a)(1) makes it an unfair business practice to perform repairs on a structure where the inspector or company prepared a home inspection report within the past 12 months. At 10 months, the restriction still applies.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7197(a)(1)条规定，在检查员或公司在过去12个月内准备房屋检查报告的建筑物上进行维修属于不正当商业行为。在10个月时，该限制仍然适用。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7197(a)(1) (Document p. 421, PDF p. 444)

question_en: A home inspector accepts a job where the fee is contingent on whether escrow closes. Which statement best describes this arrangement?
question_cn: 一名房屋检查员接受了一项工作，其费用取决于托管是否完成。哪一项陈述最能描述这种安排？

options.en: Permitted if the client agrees in writing
options.cn: 如果客户书面同意，则允许

options.en: Permitted when the fee is under $500
options.cn: 当费用低于500美元时允许

options.en: Allowed as long as the report is unbiased
options.cn: 只要报告公正即可允许

options.en: An unfair business practice under California law
options.cn: 根据加利福尼亚法律属于不公平的商业行为

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7197(a)(4) explicitly identifies as an unfair business practice accepting an engagement where the fee is contingent upon the close of escrow or preestablished findings in the report.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7197(a)(4)条明确指出，接受以托管完成或报告中预先确定的发现作为费用条件的聘用属于不公平的商业行为。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7197(a)(4) (Document p. 421, PDF p. 444)

question_en: Which professional is NOT required to be certified under the asbestos consultant article when performing activities described in Sections 7181 and 7182 for state-owned buildings?
question_cn: 在为州-owned建筑执行第7181和7182节描述的活动时，哪类专业人员不需要根据石棉顾问条款进行认证？

options.en: A private asbestos consultant hired by the state
options.cn: 由州雇佣的私人石棉顾问

options.en: An attorney providing legal advice on asbestos matters
options.cn: 提供石棉相关法律咨询的律师

options.en: A state-employed industrial hygienist on asbestos projects
options.cn: 在石棉项目中工作的州雇工职业卫生师

options.en: An uncertified site surveillance technician on state projects
options.cn: 在州项目中的未认证现场监控技术员

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7189.7(b) explicitly states that attorneys providing legal advice on asbestos-related matters to building owners or operators are not required to be certified by the division.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7189.7(b)节明确规定，为建筑所有者或运营者提供石棉相关法律咨询的律师不需要由该部门认证。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7189.7(b) (Document p. 415, PDF p. 438)

question_en: A home inspector observes what appears to be a structural deficiency during a routine inspection. Which action is within the scope of a home inspector who is not a registered engineer?
question_cn: 家庭检查员在例行检查中观察到似乎存在结构缺陷。对于非注册工程师的家庭检查员，哪些行为属于其工作范围？

options.en: Refuse to inspect and return the inspection fee
options.cn: 拒绝检查并退还检查费用

options.en: Identify the observable condition and recommend further evaluation
options.cn: 识别可观察到的状况并建议进一步评估

options.en: Perform a structural integrity analysis and report findings
options.cn: 进行结构完整性分析并报告结果

options.en: Certify in writing that the structure is safe
options.cn: 书面认证结构安全

explanation_en: Under B&P Code Section 7195(c), a home inspection report identifies material defects and makes recommendations for evaluation by appropriate persons. This is within scope; engineering analysis is not.
explanation_cn: 根据《商业与专业法》第7195(c)条，家庭检查报告识别重大缺陷并提出由相关人员进行评估的建议。这属于工作范围内；工程分析则不在此范围内。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7196.1(a) (Document p. 420, PDF p. 443)

question_en: A contractor is hired to install gypsum wallboard, apply taping compound, and texture the finished surface. Which license classification covers this scope of work?
question_cn: 承包商被雇用来安装石膏墙板、涂抹接缝膏，并为完成的表面做纹理处理。哪种许可分类涵盖此工作范围？

options.en: C-6 Cabinet, Millwork and Finish Carpentry
options.cn: C-6 橱柜、木制品及精装修木工

options.en: C-9 Drywall Contractor
options.cn: C-9 石膏板承包商

options.en: C-5 Framing and Rough Carpentry
options.cn: C-5 架构及粗木工

options.en: C-35 Lathing and Plastering
options.cn: C-35 镶板及石膏工程

explanation_en: CCR Section 832.09 defines a C-9 Drywall Contractor as one who installs gypsum wallboard assemblies including nonstructural metal framing, and performs taping and texturing operations.
explanation_cn: CCR 第832.09条将C-9石膏板承包商定义为安装石膏墙板组件（包括非结构性金属框架）并进行接缝和纹理处理的人员。
code_reference: B&P Code Sections 7058 and 7059; CCR Section 832.09 (Document p. 440, PDF p. 463)

question_en: A C-22 asbestos abatement contractor receives their license but has not yet submitted proof of DOSH registration to the Board. What automatically happens at the end of the required compliance period?
question_cn: 一名 C-22 石棉清除承包商获得了执照，但尚未向委员会提交 DOSH 注册证明。在规定的合规期限结束时，会自动发生什么情况？

options.en: The license or C-22 classification is automatically suspended
options.cn: 执照或 C-22 分类会自动被暂停

options.en: The contractor is fined and given an additional 30 days
options.cn: 承包商会被罚款并获得额外 30 天

options.en: The license is revoked by the Registrar after a hearing
options.cn: 执照将在听证会后被注册主任吊销

options.en: The contractor may continue working under a temporary exemption
options.cn: 承包商可以在临时豁免下继续工作

explanation_en: CCR Section 832.22(c) states that failure to provide proof of current DOSH registration within 90 days after license issuance results in automatic suspension of the license or removal of the C-22 classification.
explanation_cn: CCR 第 832.22(c) 条规定，如果在执照颁发后 90 天内未能提供当前 DOSH 注册证明，将导致执照自动暂停或取消 C-22 分类。
code_reference: B&P Code Sections 7058, 7058.5; CCR Section 832.22(c) (Document p. 442, PDF p. 465)

question_en: Which of the following is specifically EXCLUDED from the scope of a C-7 Low Voltage Systems Contractor?
question_cn: 以下哪一项明确不属于C-7低压系统承包商的范围？

options.en: Closed-circuit video system installation
options.cn: 闭路电视系统安装

options.en: Low voltage fire alarm systems
options.cn: 低压火灾报警系统

options.en: Satellite dish antenna installation
options.cn: 卫星天线安装

options.en: Low voltage landscape lighting
options.cn: 低压景观照明

explanation_en: CCR Section 832.07 explicitly states that low voltage fire alarm systems are specifically NOT included in the C-7 classification, even though other low voltage systems are covered.
explanation_cn: CCR第832.07条明确指出，低压火灾报警系统不包括在C-7分类中，尽管其他低压系统包括在内。
code_reference: B&P Code Sections 7058 and 7059; CCR Section 832.07 (Document p. 439, PDF p. 462)

question_en: An applicant for a C-22 asbestos abatement contractor classification must show how many years of qualifying experience within the preceding 10 years?
question_cn: C-22 石棉清除承包商分类的申请人在过去 10 年中必须展示多少年的合格经验？

options.en: Not less than two years
options.cn: 不少于两年

options.en: Not less than three years
options.cn: 不少于三年

options.en: Not less than four years
options.cn: 不少于四年

options.en: Not less than five years
options.cn: 不少于五年

explanation_en: CCR Section 832.22(d) requires that applicants have not less than four years of experience performing asbestos abatement duties within the last 10 years immediately preceding the application.
explanation_cn: CCR 第 832.22(d) 条要求申请人在申请前的最近 10 年内从事石棉清除工作的经验不得少于四年。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7058.5; CCR Section 832.22(d) (Document p. 442, PDF p. 465)

question_en: A C-13 fencing contractor is asked to build a masonry wall along a property boundary. May the contractor perform this work under the C-13 classification?
question_cn: C-13 围栏承包商被要求在物业边界上建造一面砌体墙。承包商可以在 C-13 分类下执行此工作吗？

options.en: Yes, masonry walls are incidental to fencing work
options.cn: 是的，砌体墙是围栏工作的一部分

options.en: Yes, if the wall serves as a boundary fence
options.cn: 是的，如果墙作为边界围栏使用

options.en: No, unless the wall includes an attached gate
options.cn: 否，除非墙上附有门

options.en: No, masonry walls are excluded from C-13
options.cn: 否，C-13 不包括砌体墙

explanation_en: CCR Section 832.13 explicitly excludes masonry walls from the C-13 Fencing Contractor classification. A separate masonry (C-29) license would be required.
explanation_cn: CCR 第 832.13 条明确将砌体墙排除在 C-13 围栏承包商分类之外。需要单独的砌体 (C-29) 执照。
code_reference: B&P Code Sections 7058 and 7059; CCR Section 832.13 (Document p. 441, PDF p. 464)

question_en: Which classification authorizes a contractor to use explosives to execute cuts, fills, and excavations while grading a site?
question_cn: 哪种分类授权承包商使用爆炸物来执行场地平整中的开挖、填充和挖掘？

options.en: C-8 Concrete Contractor
options.cn: C-8 混凝土承包商

options.en: C-12 Earthwork and Paving Contractor
options.cn: C-12 土方和铺路承包商

options.en: C-21 Building Moving/Demolition Contractor
options.cn: C-21 建筑搬迁/拆除承包商

options.en: C-34 Pipeline Contractor
options.cn: C-34 管道承包商

explanation_en: CCR Section 832.12 specifically includes the use of explosives for executing cuts, fills, excavations, grades, trenches, and backfills within the C-12 classification.
explanation_cn: CCR 第832.12条特别包括在C-12分类下使用爆炸物来执行开挖、填充、挖掘、平整、沟槽和回填。
code_reference: B&P Code Sections 7058 and 7059; CCR Section 832.12 (Document p. 440, PDF p. 463)

question_en: A C-15 flooring contractor is finishing a bathroom remodel and the owner asks them to install ceramic tile floors. Which of the following is correct?
question_cn: C-15 地板承包商正在完成浴室翻新，业主要求他们安装瓷砖地板。以下哪项是正确的？

options.en: C-15 permits ceramic tile in bathrooms only
options.cn: C-15 仅允许在浴室使用瓷砖

options.en: C-15 cannot install ceramic tile under any circumstance
options.cn: C-15 在任何情况下都不能安装瓷砖

options.en: C-15 covers all flooring materials including ceramic tile
options.cn: C-15 覆盖包括瓷砖在内的所有地板材料

options.en: C-15 permits ceramic tile if it is incidental work
options.cn: 如果是附带工作，C-15 允许安装瓷砖

explanation_en: CCR Section 832.15 lists carpet, resilient goods, wood floors, and other floor covering materials, but explicitly states 'except ceramic tile,' making it categorically excluded from C-15 scope.
explanation_cn: 《加州行政法规》第 832.15 节列出了地毯、弹性材料、木地板和其他地板覆盖材料，但明确指出“瓷砖除外”，这使其明确不属于 C-15 范围。
code_reference: B&P Code Sections 7058 and 7059; CCR Section 832.15 (Document p. 441, PDF p. 464)

question_en: A contractor holds a C-16 Fire Protection license and is asked to also install the electrical fire alarm system for a building. Is this within the C-16 scope?
question_cn: 一名承包商持有 C-16 消防保护执照，并被要求为一栋建筑安装电气火灾报警系统。这是否在 C-16 的范围内？

options.en: Yes, if fire alarm systems are incidental to the project
options.cn: 是的，如果火灾报警系统是项目的附带部分

options.en: Yes, all fire protection systems are within C-16 scope
options.cn: 是的，所有消防保护系统都在 C-16 的范围内

options.en: No, unless the contractor also holds a C-10 license
options.cn: 否，除非承包商也持有 C-10 执照

options.en: No, electrical alarm systems are excluded from C-16
options.cn: 否，电气报警系统不包括在 C-16 内

explanation_en: CCR Section 832.16 defines the C-16 classification as covering all types of fire protection systems but explicitly excludes electrical alarm systems from its scope.
explanation_cn: CCR 第 832.16 条定义 C-16 分类涵盖所有类型的消防保护系统，但明确排除电气报警系统的范围。
code_reference: B&P Code Sections 7058 and 7059; CCR Section 832.16 (Document p. 441, PDF p. 464)

question_en: Which of the following best describes the scope of a C-21 Building Moving/Demolition Contractor?
question_cn: 下列哪项最能描述 C-21 建筑搬迁/拆除承包商的工作范围？

options.en: Raises, moves, or demolishes structures including foundations
options.cn: 提升、移动或拆除包括地基在内的结构

options.en: Repairs and rehabilitates existing structural foundations
options.cn: 修理和翻新现有的结构地基

options.en: Demolishes and reconstructs all structural elements
options.cn: 拆除并重建所有结构元素

options.en: Excavates and grades land for new construction
options.cn: 挖掘和整平土地以进行新建设

explanation_en: CCR Section 832.21 defines C-21 as authorizing raising, lowering, cribbing, underpinning, demolishing, and moving or removing structures including their foundations.
explanation_cn: CCR 第 832.21 节将 C-21 定义为授权提升、降低、支撑、补强、拆除以及移动或移除包括其地基在内的结构。
code_reference: B&P Code Sections 7058 and 7059; CCR Section 832.21 (Document p. 442, PDF p. 465)

question_en: A property owner hires a contractor to enclose their backyard game court with chain-link fencing, install flagpoles, and add a backstop. Which license classification covers all of this work?
question_cn: 房地产所有者雇用承包商，用链环围栏封闭他们的后院运动场，安装旗杆，并添加一个挡球板。哪种执照分类涵盖所有这些工作？

options.en: C-13 Fencing Contractor
options.cn: C-13 围栏承包商

options.en: C-5 Framing and Rough Carpentry Contractor
options.cn: C-5 构架和粗木工承包商

options.en: C-27 Landscaping Contractor
options.cn: C-27 园林绿化承包商

options.en: C-32 Parking and Highway Improvement Contractor
options.cn: C-32 停车场和公路改造承包商

explanation_en: CCR Section 832.13 specifically lists game court enclosures, backstops, and flagpoles as within the C-13 Fencing Contractor classification.
explanation_cn: 加州承包商条例第832.13条明确将运动场围栏、挡球板和旗杆列为C-13围栏承包商分类的工作内容。
code_reference: B&P Code Sections 7058 and 7059; CCR Section 832.13 (Document p. 441, PDF p. 464)

question_en: Under CSLB regulations, a C-36 plumbing contractor's scope includes which of the following?
question_cn: 根据加州承包商州许可证委员会（CSLB）的规定，C-36 管道承包商的业务范围包括以下哪些内容？

options.en: Solar equipment for heating water or fluids
options.cn: 用于加热水或液体的太阳能设备

options.en: All gas appliances including forced warm air furnaces
options.cn: 所有燃气设备，包括强制暖风炉

options.en: Utility-side gas metering and distribution systems
options.cn: 公用事业侧的燃气计量和分配系统

options.en: Installation of forced warm air heating units
options.cn: 强制暖风加热装置的安装

explanation_en: CCR Section 832.36(e) includes the installation of solar equipment for heating water or fluids to a suitable temperature within the C-36 plumbing classification.
explanation_cn: CCR 第 832.36(e) 条款包含在 C-36 管道分类下安装用于将水或液体加热到适当温度的太阳能设备。
code_reference: B&P Code Sections 7058 and 7059; CCR Section 832.36 (Document p. 446, PDF p. 469)

question_en: A C-8 concrete contractor is asked to solely apply plaster coatings to an existing concrete wall surface. Is this within the C-8 scope?
question_cn: C-8 混凝土承包商被要求仅在现有混凝土墙面上施加灰泥涂层。这属于 C-8 的范围吗？

options.en: Yes, if the coating is applied over concrete only
options.cn: 是的，如果涂层仅施加在混凝土上

options.en: Yes, surface finishing is part of concrete work
options.cn: 是的，表面精饰是混凝土工作的一部分

options.en: No, only a general contractor may apply plaster coatings
options.cn: 不是的，只有总承包商可以施加灰泥涂层

options.en: No, solely applying plaster coatings is excluded from C-8
options.cn: 不是的，仅施加灰泥涂层不包括在 C-8 内

explanation_en: CCR Section 832.08 explicitly excludes from C-8 contractors whose sole contracting business is the application of plaster coatings. A C-35 license would be appropriate.
explanation_cn: CCR 第 832.08 条明确排除了那些唯一承包业务是施加灰泥涂层的 C-8 承包商。C-35 执照是适用的。
code_reference: B&P Code Sections 7058 and 7059; CCR Section 832.08 (Document p. 439, PDF p. 462)

question_en: Which of the following correctly describes a condition that must be met BEFORE a C-22 licensee may perform any asbestos abatement work?
question_cn: 以下哪项正确描述了在持有 C-22 执照的人员进行任何石棉清除工作之前必须满足的条件？

options.en: The Board must conduct a site inspection before work begins
options.cn: 委员会必须在工作开始前进行现场检查

options.en: The contractor must pass a DOSH field examination
options.cn: 承包商必须通过 DOSH 现场考试

options.en: The license must have been active for at least 90 days
options.cn: 执照必须至少保持有效 90 天

options.en: Proof of DOSH registration must be submitted to the Board
options.cn: 必须向委员会提交 DOSH 注册证明

explanation_en: CCR Section 832.22(c) states that no asbestos abatement work shall be performed until the contractor has submitted proof of DOSH registration to the Board.
explanation_cn: CCR 第 832.22(c) 条规定，承包商在向委员会提交 DOSH 注册证明之前，不得进行任何石棉清除工作。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7058.5; CCR Section 832.22(c) (Document p. 442, PDF p. 465)

question_en: Which of the following systems is specifically authorized under the C-20 Warm-Air Heating, Ventilating and Air-Conditioning classification?
question_cn: 在 C-20 暖空气供暖、通风和空调分类下，以下哪种系统是特别授权的？

options.en: Low voltage temperature control wiring and sensors
options.cn: 低压温控布线和传感器

options.en: Refrigerated rooms and cold storage insulation systems
options.cn: 冷藏室和冷藏保温系统

options.en: Solar energy warm-air heating and ventilating systems
options.cn: 太阳能暖空气供暖和通风系统

options.en: Steam fitting and power boiler installation
options.cn: 蒸汽管件和动力锅炉安装

explanation_en: CCR Section 832.20 explicitly states that the C-20 classification includes warm-air heating, ventilating, and air-conditioning systems which utilize solar energy.
explanation_cn: CCR 第 832.20 节明确规定，C-20 分类包括使用太阳能的暖空气供暖、通风和空调系统。
code_reference: B&P Code Sections 7026.1, 7058 and 7059; CCR Section 832.20 (Document p. 441, PDF p. 464)

question_en: A C-28 Lock and Security Equipment Contractor installs access control systems at a building. The owner also wants a fire alarm system installed. Which of the following is correct?
question_cn: C-28 锁具与安防设备承包商在一栋建筑中安装门禁系统。业主还希望安装火警报警系统。以下哪项是正确的？

options.en: C-28 covers fire alarms if tied to access control systems
options.cn: 如果与门禁系统相关，C-28 也涵盖火警报警系统

options.en: Fire alarm systems are excluded from the C-28 scope
options.cn: 火警报警系统不在 C-28 的范围之内

options.en: C-28 covers all security and fire safety systems
options.cn: C-28 涵盖所有安防和消防系统

options.en: C-28 can install fire alarms as incidental work only
options.cn: C-28 只能作为附带工作安装火警报警系统

explanation_en: CCR Section 832.28 explicitly states that fire alarm systems are specifically not included in the C-28 Lock and Security Equipment Contractor classification. A separate license would be required.
explanation_cn: CCR 第 832.28 条明确指出，火警报警系统不包括在 C-28 锁具与安防设备承包商分类中。需要单独的许可证。
code_reference: B&P Code Sections 7058 and 7059; CCR Section 832.28 (Document p. 444, PDF p. 467)

question_en: An applicant submits a license application that is rejected for being incomplete. The applicant does nothing for 95 days. What is the status of the application?
question_cn: 申请人提交的执照申请因不完整而被拒绝。申请人95天内未采取任何行动。该申请的状态是什么？

options.en: Deemed abandoned and cannot be reinstated
options.cn: 被视为弃置，无法恢复

options.en: Extended automatically for an additional 30 days
options.cn: 自动延长额外30天

options.en: Suspended pending a hearing before the Registrar
options.cn: 暂停，等待注册主任听证会

options.en: Automatically reinstated with a penalty fee
options.cn: 自动恢复并收取罚款

explanation_en: Under CCR 813(a), an application is deemed abandoned when an applicant fails to return a rejected application within 90 days. CCR 813(b) states it may not be reinstated; the applicant must file a new application with the required fee.
explanation_cn: 根据CCR 813(a)，当申请人在申请被拒后90天内未返还申请时，该申请被视为弃置。CCR 813(b)规定该申请不得恢复；申请人必须提交新的申请并支付所需费用。
code_reference: CCR Title 16, Section 813(a) (Document p. 430, PDF p. 453)

question_en: An applicant for a contractor's license wants to count vocational school training toward the required four years of experience. What is the maximum amount of training that can be applied?
question_cn: 一名承包商执照的申请人希望将职业学校的培训计入所需的四年工作经验。他们最多可以申请多少培训时间？

options.en: Up to two years of accredited training
options.cn: 最多两年的认证培训

options.en: Up to four years of accredited training
options.cn: 最多四年的认证培训

options.en: Up to three years of accredited training
options.cn: 最多三年的认证培训

options.en: Up to one year of accredited training
options.cn: 最多一年的认证培训

explanation_en: CCR 825(d) states that accredited school training or completion of an approved apprenticeship program counts as experience, but in no case shall such training count for more than three years of the required four-year experience.
explanation_cn: CCR 825(d) 规定，经过认证的学校培训或完成批准的学徒计划算作工作经验，但在任何情况下，该培训不得超过所需四年工作经验中的三年。
code_reference: CCR Title 16, Section 825(d) (Document p. 431, PDF p. 454)

question_en: An applicant files a complete license application requiring examination. The application also requires a field investigation. Within how many days must the Board decide if the applicant meets licensing requirements after the examination is passed?
question_cn: 申请人提交了一份需要考试的完整执照申请。该申请还需要进行现场调查。在考试通过后，委员会必须在多少天内决定申请人是否符合执照要求？

options.en: Within 115 days of the complete application
options.cn: 完整申请提交后115天内

options.en: Within 175 days of the complete application
options.cn: 完整申请提交后175天内

options.en: Within 130 days of the complete application
options.cn: 完整申请提交后130天内

options.en: Within 160 days of the complete application
options.cn: 完整申请提交后160天内

explanation_en: Under CCR 827(a)(3), the Board has 115 days after a complete application is referred for examination. CCR 827(a)(5) extends this period by 60 days if an investigation is required, for a total of 175 days.
explanation_cn: 根据CCR 827(a)(3)，委员会在将完整申请提交考试后有115天的时间。CCR 827(a)(5)如果需要进行调查，可以将此期限延长60天，总共为175天。
code_reference: CCR Title 16, Section 827(a)(3) and (a)(5) (Document p. 433, PDF p. 456)

question_en: A license applicant served in the U.S. Armed Forces during a National Emergency. How does this military service affect the ten-year experience lookback period?
question_cn: 在国家紧急状态期间，某许可证申请人在美国武装部队服役。这段军事服役如何影响十年工作经验回溯期？

options.en: Military service waives the examination requirement
options.cn: 军事服役可免除考试要求

options.en: Military service counts directly as construction experience
options.cn: 军事服役可以直接计入施工经验

options.en: The ten-year window is extended by the length of service
options.cn: 十年回溯期可按服役时长延长

options.en: The four-year experience requirement is reduced by one year
options.cn: 四年工作经验要求可减少一年

explanation_en: CCR 825(c) states that an applicant shall not be penalized for time spent in the armed forces during a National Emergency, and the length of service may be added to the 10-year lookback period.
explanation_cn: CCR 825(c)规定，申请人在国家紧急状态期间服役的时间不得受到处罚，服役时长可以计入十年回溯期。
code_reference: CCR Title 16, Section 825(c) (Document p. 431, PDF p. 454)

question_en: A specialty contractor holds a C-8 (Concrete) license only. A client wants the contractor to perform work that is outside the concrete classification but is essential to complete the concrete project. Which of the following is true?
question_cn: 一名专门承包商仅持有C-8（混凝土）许可证。客户希望承包商执行不属于混凝土分类但对于完成混凝土项目必不可少的工作。以下哪项是正确的？

options.en: The contractor may not perform or subcontract that work
options.cn: 承包商不得自行执行或分包该工作

options.en: The contractor may self-perform or subcontract the incidental work
options.cn: 承包商可以自行执行或分包附带工作

options.en: Only a Class B general building contractor may perform that work
options.cn: 只有B类总建筑承包商可以执行该工作

options.en: The contractor must obtain a separate license for that work
options.cn: 承包商必须为该工作获得单独的许可证

explanation_en: CCR 831 defines incidental and supplemental work as work essential to accomplish the classified work. A specialty contractor may use their own employees or subcontractors to complete such work without holding an additional license.
explanation_cn: CCR 831 将附带和补充工作定义为完成分类工作所必需的工作。专门承包商可以使用自己的员工或分包商完成此类工作，而无需持有额外的许可证。
code_reference: CCR Title 16, Section 831 (Document p. 436, PDF p. 459)

question_en: The Board receives a resubmitted license application that was previously rejected for deficiencies. Within how many days must the Board decide whether the corrected application is complete and accepted for filing?
question_cn: 委员会收到一份之前因缺陷而被拒绝的重新提交的执照申请。委员会必须在多少天内决定该更正后的申请是否完整并被接受备案？

options.en: Within 5 days of resubmission
options.cn: 重新提交后5天内

options.en: Within 60 days of resubmission
options.cn: 重新提交后60天内

options.en: Within 15 days of resubmission
options.cn: 重新提交后15天内

options.en: Within 30 days of resubmission
options.cn: 重新提交后30天内

explanation_en: CCR 827(a)(2) requires the Board to decide within 5 days of receipt whether a previously rejected and resubmitted application is complete and accepted for filing.
explanation_cn: CCR 827(a)(2) 要求委员会在收到后5天内决定之前被拒绝并重新提交的申请是否完整并被接受备案。
code_reference: CCR Title 16, Section 827(a)(2) (Document p. 433, PDF p. 456)

question_en: A home improvement salesperson applicant pays the registration fee by personal check. By how much can the Board extend the standard 30-day review period for the application?
question_cn: 家庭装修销售人员申请者通过个人支票支付注册费。委员会可以将申请的标准30天审核期延长多少？

options.en: No extension is allowed for a personal check
options.cn: 个人支票不允许延期

options.en: By 5 weeks for a personal check payment
options.cn: 个人支票支付可延长5周

options.en: By 60 days for a personal check payment
options.cn: 个人支票支付可延长60天

options.en: By 30 days for a personal check payment
options.cn: 个人支票支付可延长30天

explanation_en: CCR 828(c) specifically allows the time periods to be extended by 5 weeks if the fee is in the form of a personal or company check.
explanation_cn: CCR 828(c) 明确规定，如果费用以个人或公司支票形式支付，时间期限可以延长5周。
code_reference: CCR Title 16, Section 828(c) (Document p. 435, PDF p. 458)

question_en: A license application is received and field investigation is required. The Registrar is required to conduct a comprehensive field investigation on a minimum of what percentage of all license applications?
question_cn: 收到执照申请，需要进行现场调查。注册主任需要对所有执照申请中至少百分之多少进行全面的现场调查？

options.en: A minimum of 1% of all applications
options.cn: 所有申请的至少1%

options.en: A minimum of 5% of all applications
options.cn: 所有申请的至少5%

options.en: A minimum of 3% of all applications
options.cn: 所有申请的至少3%

options.en: A minimum of 10% of all applications
options.cn: 所有申请的至少10%
