explanation_en: CCR 824 requires the Registrar to conduct a comprehensive field investigation of a minimum of 3% of all license applications, covering claimed experience and other areas appropriate for public protection.
explanation_cn: CCR 824 要求注册主任对所有执照申请中至少 3% 进行全面的现场调查，涵盖所声明的经验及其他适合公众保护的方面。
code_reference: CCR Title 16, Section 824 (Document p. 431, PDF p. 454)

question_en: A corporation applying for a contractor's license must provide certification showing compliance with California Secretary of State filing requirements. Under which Corporations Code sections must this filing be demonstrated?
question_cn: 申请承包商执照的公司必须提供证明，显示其遵守加利福尼亚州国务卿备案要求。根据哪些公司法条款必须证明这种备案？

options.en: Corporations Code Sections 200 and 2105
options.cn: 公司法第200条和第2105条

options.en: B&P Code Sections 7066 and 7067
options.cn: 商业与专业法第7066条和第7067条

options.en: Corporations Code Sections 300 and 2110
options.cn: 公司法第300条和第2110条

options.en: Corporations Code Sections 100 and 2001
options.cn: 公司法第100条和第2001条

explanation_en: CCR 819 requires foreign or domestic corporations to certify compliance with California Secretary of State filing requirements as set out in Corporations Code Sections 200 and 2105.
explanation_cn: CCR 819要求外国或国内公司证明其遵守公司法第200条和第2105条所规定的加利福尼亚州国务卿备案要求。
code_reference: CCR Title 16, Section 819 (Document p. 430, PDF p. 453)

question_en: An applicant formerly qualified a license in the C-8 (Concrete) classification. They are now applying for a new C-8 license. How does the ten-year experience lookback rule apply to this applicant?
question_cn: 申请人此前曾在C-8（混凝土）类别获得过执照资格。他们现在正在申请新的C-8执照。十年经验回溯规则如何适用于该申请人？

options.en: The ten-year limit applies, same as new applicants
options.cn: 十年限制适用，与新申请人相同

options.en: The experience requirement is reduced to two years
options.cn: 经验要求减少为两年

options.en: The ten-year limit is extended by five additional years
options.cn: 十年限制延长五年

options.en: The applicant may compute experience without the ten-year limit
options.cn: 申请人可以在不考虑十年限制的情况下计算经验

explanation_en: CCR 825(b) states that an applicant who was formerly a qualifier on a license in the same classification applied for may compute experience without regard to the ten-year limitation.
explanation_cn: CCR 825(b) 规定，曾在所申请的同一类别执照上担任过资格人的申请人，可以在不受十年限制的情况下计算经验。
code_reference: CCR Title 16, Section 825(b) (Document p. 431, PDF p. 454)

question_en: Which of the following does NOT require the applicant to pay a $230 application fee to the CSLB?
question_cn: 以下哪项不需要申请人向CSLB支付230美元的申请费？

options.en: Replacing a responsible managing employee
options.cn: 更换负责的管理员工

options.en: Adding a classification under B&P Code Section 7059
options.cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7059条增加一个专业分类

options.en: Adding a classification with an original license application
options.cn: 在原始许可证申请中增加一个专业分类

options.en: Replacing a responsible managing officer
options.cn: 更换负责的管理官员

explanation_en: CCR 811(a)(2) charges only $150 — not $230 — for each additional classification applied for in connection with an original license. The $230 rate applies only to classifications added later under B&P Code 7059.
explanation_cn: CCR 811(a)(2) 对于在原始许可证申请中申请的每个新增分类只收取150美元，而不是230美元。230美元的费率仅适用于根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7059条后来增加的分类。
code_reference: CCR Title 16, Section 811(a)(3) and (a)(4) (Document p. 428, PDF p. 451)

question_en: A license application not requiring an examination is received by the Board. The applicant has filed all required bonds and documents. Within how many days must the Board decide whether the applicant meets licensure requirements?
question_cn: 董事会收到一份不需要考试的许可申请。申请人已提交所有要求的保证金和文件。董事会必须在多少天内决定申请人是否符合许可要求？

options.en: Within 15 days of receiving the application
options.cn: 在收到申请后的15天内

options.en: Within 50 days of receiving the application
options.cn: 在收到申请后的50天内

options.en: Within 30 days of receiving the application
options.cn: 在收到申请后的30天内

options.en: Within 5 days of receiving the application
options.cn: 在收到申请后的5天内

explanation_en: CCR 827(b)(3) states that once the applicant has filed acceptable bonds and other required documents, the Board shall decide within 15 days whether the applicant meets the requirements for licensure.
explanation_cn: CCR 827(b)(3) 规定，一旦申请人提交了可接受的保证金和其他所需文件，董事会应在15天内决定申请人是否符合许可要求。
code_reference: CCR Title 16, Section 827(b)(3) (Document p. 434, PDF p. 457)

question_en: A contractor applies for an original license in a single classification and also adds two additional classifications at the same time. What is the total application fee?
question_cn: 一名承包商申请单一类别的原始执照，同时还添加两个额外类别。总申请费是多少？

options.en: $750 total for all three classifications
options.cn: 三个类别总计 $750

options.en: $1,350 total for all three classifications
options.cn: 三个类别总计 $1,350

options.en: $600 total for all three classifications
options.cn: 三个类别总计 $600

options.en: $910 total for all three classifications
options.cn: 三个类别总计 $910

explanation_en: Under CCR Section 811(a)(1) and (a)(2), the original license fee is $450 and each additional classification applied for concurrently is $150. Two additional classifications = $300, so $450 + $300 = $750.
explanation_cn: 根据 CCR 第 811(a)(1) 和 (a)(2) 条款，原始执照费用为 $450，每个同时申请的额外类别费用为 $150。两个额外类别 = $300，所以 $450 + $300 = $750。
code_reference: California Code of Regulations, Title 16, Section 811(a)(1) and (a)(2) (Document p. 428, PDF p. 451)

question_en: An applicant submits a corrected application after it was rejected for deficiencies. Within how many days must the Board decide whether the resubmitted application is complete and accepted for filing?
question_cn: 申请人在其申请因缺陷被拒后提交了更正后的申请。董事会必须在多少天内决定重新提交的申请是否完整并接受备案？

options.en: Within 15 days of receipt
options.cn: 收到后15天内

options.en: Within 5 days of receipt
options.cn: 收到后5天内

options.en: Within 60 days of receipt
options.cn: 收到后60天内

options.en: Within 10 days of receipt
options.cn: 收到后10天内

explanation_en: Under CCR Section 827(a)(2), when a previously rejected application is returned with corrections, the Board must decide within 5 days of receipt whether it is complete and accepted for filing.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州行政法规则》第827(a)(2)条，当先前被拒的申请在更正后提交时，董事会必须在收到后5天内决定其是否完整并接受备案。
code_reference: California Code of Regulations, Title 16, Section 827(a)(2) (Document p. 433, PDF p. 456)

question_en: A license application is rejected for being incomplete. The applicant fails to respond. Under what circumstances will the application be deemed abandoned?
question_cn: 许可申请因不完整而被拒绝。申请人未作出回应。在什么情况下该申请将被视为放弃？

options.en: If not corrected within 60 days of rejection notice
options.cn: 如果在拒绝通知后的60天内未改正

options.en: If not corrected within 120 days of rejection notice
options.cn: 如果在拒绝通知后的120天内未改正

options.en: If not corrected within 90 days of rejection notice
options.cn: 如果在拒绝通知后的90天内未改正

options.en: If not corrected within 30 days of rejection notice
options.cn: 如果在拒绝通知后的30天内未改正

explanation_en: Under CCR Section 813(a), an application is deemed abandoned if the applicant fails to return a rejected or incomplete application within 90 days of the original notice. The Registrar may extend this for good cause.
explanation_cn: 根据CCR第813(a)条，如果申请人在原始通知后的90天内未退回被拒绝或不完整的申请，该申请将被视为放弃。注册主任可因合理原因延长此期限。
code_reference: California Code of Regulations, Title 16, Section 813(a) (Document p. 430, PDF p. 453)

question_en: An applicant's abandoned license application cannot be reinstated. What is the applicant's only option to move forward?
question_cn: 申请人已放弃的执照申请无法恢复。申请人向前推进的唯一选择是什么？

options.en: Resubmit the original application without a new fee
options.cn: 在无需支付新费用的情况下重新提交原申请

options.en: File a new application with the required fee
options.cn: 提交一份附有所需费用的新申请

options.en: Petition the Registrar for reinstatement within 30 days
options.cn: 在30天内向注册主任申请恢复

options.en: Appeal to the CSLB Board for a hearing
options.cn: 向CSLB委员会申请听证会上诉

explanation_en: Under CCR Section 813(b), an abandoned application cannot be reinstated. The applicant's only recourse is to file a brand-new application accompanied by the required fee.
explanation_cn: 根据CCR第813(b)条，已放弃的申请无法恢复。申请人的唯一办法是提交一份附有所需费用的全新申请。
code_reference: California Code of Regulations, Title 16, Section 813(b) (Document p. 430, PDF p. 453)

question_en: An applicant for a contractor's license completed an approved apprenticeship program. How many years of the required 4-year experience requirement can the apprenticeship training satisfy?
question_cn: 一名承包商执照申请人完成了一个认可的学徒培训计划。学徒培训可以满足所需的四年经验要求中的多少年？

options.en: No more than 2 years of required experience
options.cn: 不超过所需经验的2年

options.en: No more than 1 year of required experience
options.cn: 不超过所需经验的1年

options.en: No more than 3 years of required experience
options.cn: 不超过所需经验的3年

options.en: All 4 years of required experience
options.cn: 所有4年的所需经验

explanation_en: Under CCR Section 825(d), acceptable training or completion of an approved apprenticeship program counts toward the experience requirement, but in no case for more than 3 of the required 4 years.
explanation_cn: 根据加州法规第825(d)条，接受的培训或完成认可的学徒培训计划可计入经验要求，但在任何情况下不得超过所需4年中的3年。
code_reference: California Code of Regulations, Title 16, Section 825(d) (Document p. 431, PDF p. 454)

question_en: A contractor has been out of the industry for 12 years and now wants to apply for a license in the same classification he previously qualified under. How does the 10-year experience window apply to him?
question_cn: 一名承包商已经离开行业12年，现在想申请他之前曾获得资格的相同类别的执照。10年经验窗口如何适用于他？

options.en: He must retake the exam but is exempt from the experience requirement
options.cn: 他必须重新参加考试，但可免于经验要求

options.en: He qualifies for a waiver only if actively working in construction
options.cn: 仅当他在建筑行业积极工作时，他才有资格获得豁免

options.en: He must demonstrate 4 years of experience within the last 10 years
options.cn: 他必须在最近10年内证明有4年的经验

options.en: His prior experience counts without the 10-year limitation
options.cn: 他之前的经验不受10年限制的影响

explanation_en: Under CCR Section 825(b), an applicant who was formerly a qualifier on a license in the same classification may compute experience without regard to the 10-year limitation — his older experience still counts.
explanation_cn: 根据CCR第825(b)条，之前在相同分类执照上担任资格证明人的申请人，可以在计算经验时不考虑10年限制——他以前的经验仍然有效。
code_reference: California Code of Regulations, Title 16, Section 825(b) (Document p. 431, PDF p. 454)

question_en: A license applicant served 3 years in the armed forces during a National Emergency. How does this military service affect the 10-year experience window under the contractor licensing regulations?
question_cn: 一位执照申请人在国家紧急状态期间服役了3年。根据承包商许可规定，这段军事服役如何影响10年的工作经验窗口？

options.en: Military service fully substitutes for required experience
options.cn: 军事服役完全替代所需经验

options.en: The 10-year window is extended by the length of service
options.cn: 10年窗口会按服役时间延长

options.en: The applicant is automatically exempt from the experience requirement
options.cn: 申请人自动免除经验要求

options.en: The military service counts as up to 3 years of experience
options.cn: 军事服役最多算作3年的经验

explanation_en: Under CCR Section 825(c), an applicant is not penalized for time spent in the armed forces during a National Emergency, and the length of service may be added to the 10-year window — effectively extending it.
explanation_cn: 根据CCR第825(c)条，申请人在国家紧急状态期间服役的时间不会受到处罚，服役时间可以加入到10年的窗口——有效地延长了它。
code_reference: California Code of Regulations, Title 16, Section 825(c) (Document p. 431, PDF p. 454)

question_en: Which of the following does NOT constitute acceptable evidence of the required construction experience when applying for a contractor's license?
question_cn: 在申请承包商执照时，下列哪项不构成所需施工经验的可接受证据？

options.en: Experience as a supervising employee in the trade
options.cn: 作为该行业的监督员工的经验

options.en: Completion of an approved apprenticeship program
options.cn: 完成认可的学徒培训项目

options.en: Work as a licensed journeyman in the trade
options.cn: 以该行业持牌工人的身份工作

options.en: An affidavit from the applicant alone, without supporting documentation
options.cn: 申请人单独提供的宣誓书，且没有支持性文件

explanation_en: Under CCR Section 824, all claimed experience must be supportable by documentation satisfactory to the Board. A self-sworn affidavit without supporting records is insufficient — the Board may request documentation and it must be supportable.
explanation_cn: 根据加州法规第824条，所有宣称的经验必须有董事会满意的文件支持。没有支持性记录的自我宣誓书是不够的——董事会可能要求提供文件，并且必须可以得到支持。
code_reference: California Code of Regulations, Title 16, Section 824 and Section 825 (Document p. 431, PDF p. 454)

question_en: A specialty contractor licensed in the C-10 Electrical classification wants to perform some plumbing work that is essential to completing an electrical project. Under what condition is this permitted?
question_cn: 一名持有 C-10 电气类别执照的专业承包商希望进行一些对完成电气项目至关重要的管道工作。在什么情况下这是允许的？

options.en: Only if the contractor also holds a C-36 Plumbing license
options.cn: 只有在承包商同时持有 C-36 管道执照时

options.en: Only if the plumbing work is self-performed by the contractor
options.cn: 只有在管道工作由承包商自行完成时

options.en: When the plumbing work is essential to completing the electrical project
options.cn: 当管道工作对完成电气项目至关重要时

options.en: Only if the plumbing work value is less than 50% of the contract
options.cn: 只有在管道工作价值少于合同金额的 50% 时

explanation_en: Under CCR Section 831, work in another classification is 'incidental and supplemental' when it is essential to accomplish the licensed work. The contractor may perform or subcontract this work without holding the other classification.
explanation_cn: 根据 CCR 第 831 条，当某项工作对于完成持证工作是必要时，属于“附带和补充”类别。承包商可以在不持有其他类别执照的情况下执行或分包此类工作。
code_reference: California Code of Regulations, Title 16, Section 831 (Document p. 436, PDF p. 459)

question_en: The CSLB must conduct comprehensive field investigations of license applications. What is the minimum percentage of all applications that must be investigated?
question_cn: CSLB 必须对执照申请进行全面的实地调查。必须调查的申请最小百分比是多少？

options.en: At least 3% of all applications filed
options.cn: 至少提交的所有申请的 3%

options.en: At least 10% of all applications filed
options.cn: 至少提交的所有申请的 10%

options.en: At least 4% of all applications filed
options.cn: 至少提交的所有申请的 4%

options.en: At least 5% of all applications filed
options.cn: 至少提交的所有申请的 5%

explanation_en: Under CCR Section 824, the Registrar must conduct comprehensive field investigations of a minimum of 3% of all license applications, in addition to reviewing and verifying all applications.
explanation_cn: 根据 CCR 第 824 条，注册主任必须对至少 3% 的所有执照申请进行全面的实地调查，此外还需审核和核实所有申请。
code_reference: California Code of Regulations, Title 16, Section 824 (Document p. 431, PDF p. 454)

question_en: A corporation applying for a contractor's license must demonstrate it has met the filing requirements of the California Secretary of State. Which code sections govern this corporate filing requirement?
question_cn: 申请承包商执照的公司必须证明其已满足加利福尼亚州国务卿的备案要求。哪些法规条款管理这一公司备案要求？

options.en: Government Code Sections 15376 and 15378
options.cn: 政府法典第15376条和第15378条

options.en: Corporations Code Sections 200 and 2105
options.cn: 公司法典第200条和第2105条

options.en: Business and Professions Code Sections 7059 and 7068
options.cn: 商业与职业法典第7059条和第7068条

options.en: Business and Professions Code Sections 7065 and 7066
options.cn: 商业与职业法典第7065条和第7066条

explanation_en: CCR Section 819 requires both domestic and foreign corporations to certify compliance with the Secretary of State filing requirements set out in Corporations Code Sections 200 (domestic) and 2105 (foreign).
explanation_cn: 加州法典行政规章第819条要求国内公司和外国公司都必须证明其符合公司法典第200条（国内）和第2105条（外国）规定的国务卿备案要求。
code_reference: California Code of Regulations, Title 16, Section 819; Corporations Code Sections 200 and 2105 (Document p. 430, PDF p. 453)

question_en: After submitting an initial application requiring examination, an applicant passes the exam and files all required bonds and documents. Within how many days must the Board decide if the applicant meets licensure requirements?
question_cn: 在提交需要考试的初始申请后，申请人通过了考试并提交了所有必需的保证金和文件。董事会必须在多少天内决定申请人是否符合执照要求？

options.en: Within 115 days after a complete application is referred for examination
options.cn: 在完整申请被提交以进行考试后 115 天内

options.en: Within 60 days after the exam is completed
options.cn: 考试完成后 60 天内

options.en: Within 45 days after the exam is completed
options.cn: 考试完成后 45 天内

options.en: Within 90 days after a complete application is referred for examination
options.cn: 在完整申请被提交以进行考试后 90 天内

explanation_en: Under CCR Section 827(a)(3), the Board must decide within 115 days after a complete application has been referred for examination, provided the exam has been successfully completed and required bonds, fees, and documents have been filed.
explanation_cn: 根据加州法规第 CCR 第 827(a)(3) 条，董事会必须在完整申请被提交以进行考试后 115 天内做出决定，前提是考试已成功完成且已提交所需的保证金、费用和文件。
code_reference: California Code of Regulations, Title 16, Section 827(a)(3) (Document p. 433, PDF p. 456)

question_en: A corporation applying for a contractor's license must complete the CSLB certification regarding Secretary of State filings. This requirement applies to which types of corporations?
question_cn: 申请承包商执照的公司必须完成关于国务卿备案的CSLB认证。该要求适用于哪类公司？

options.en: Any corporation applying, whether domestic or foreign
options.cn: 任何申请的公司，无论是国内公司还是外国公司

options.en: Only foreign corporations doing business in California
options.cn: 仅在加利福尼亚开展业务的外国公司

options.en: Only publicly traded corporations with multiple shareholders
options.cn: 仅有多个股东的上市公司

options.en: Only domestic California corporations
options.cn: 仅加利福尼亚本地公司

explanation_en: Under CCR Section 819, both foreign and domestic corporations applying for a contractor's license must complete the certification showing compliance with the California Secretary of State filing requirements.
explanation_cn: 根据CCR第819条，申请承包商执照的外国和本地公司都必须完成显示符合加利福尼亚国务卿备案要求的认证。
code_reference: California Code of Regulations, Title 16, Section 819 (Document p. 430, PDF p. 453)

question_en: The Board must inform an applicant for a home improvement salesperson registration whether the application is deficient within how many days of receipt?
question_cn: 董事会必须在收到住宅装修销售员注册申请后多少天内通知申请人其申请是否存在缺陷？

options.en: Within 50 days of receiving the application
options.cn: 在收到申请后50天内

options.en: Within 60 days of receiving the application
options.cn: 在收到申请后60天内

options.en: Within 15 days of receiving the application
options.cn: 在收到申请后15天内

options.en: Within 30 days of receiving the application
options.cn: 在收到申请后30天内

explanation_en: Under CCR Section 828(a), the Board must inform an applicant for home improvement salesperson registration within 30 days of receipt whether the application is deficient or whether the registration has been issued.
explanation_cn: 根据CCR第828(a)条，董事会必须在收到住宅装修销售员注册申请后30天内通知申请人其申请是否存在缺陷或注册是否已颁发。
code_reference: California Code of Regulations, Title 16, Section 828(a) (Document p. 435, PDF p. 458)

question_en: A C-46 Solar Contractor installs a photovoltaic solar system and the homeowner also wants a battery energy storage system added. Under what condition may the C-46 contractor legally install the battery system?
question_cn: C-46 太阳能承包商安装光伏太阳能系统，房主还希望增加电池储能系统。在什么条件下，C-46 承包商可以合法安装电池系统？

options.en: The battery system does not exceed 100 kWh rating
options.cn: 电池系统的额定功率不超过 100 kWh

options.en: The work is performed as a standalone contract
options.cn: 作为单独合同进行的工作

options.en: The homeowner provides written authorization for the work
options.cn: 房主提供书面授权进行工作

options.en: The battery system does not exceed 80 kWh rating
options.cn: 电池系统的额定功率不超过 80 kWh

explanation_en: Per CCR Section 832.46(c), a C-46 licensee may install a battery energy storage system as 'incidental and supplemental' to a photovoltaic solar system installation only if the battery system does not exceed 80 kilowatt-hours (kWh).
explanation_cn: 根据加州法规 CCR 第 832.46(c) 条，C-46 持证人只有在电池系统不超过 80 千瓦时 (kWh) 的情况下，才能将电池储能系统作为光伏太阳能系统安装的“附带和补充”安装。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7059; CCR Title 16, Section 832.46(c) (Document p. 448, PDF p. 471)

question_en: Which contractor classification would be the correct license to hold for fabricating and erecting structural steel shapes used as members in a building frame, including riveting and welding?
question_cn: 哪种承包商类别是持有制作和安装用作建筑框架构件的结构钢形材的正确执照，包括铆接和焊接？

options.en: C-51—Structural Steel Contractor
options.cn: C-51——结构钢承包商

options.en: C-50—Reinforcing Steel Contractor
options.cn: C-50——钢筋承包商

options.en: C-43—Sheet Metal Contractor
options.cn: C-43——金属板承包商

options.en: C-60—Welding Contractor
options.cn: C-60——焊接承包商

explanation_en: Per CCR Section 832.51, a C-51 Structural Steel Contractor is specifically authorized to fabricate and erect structural steel shapes and plates used as structural members, including the riveting, welding, and rigging necessary for that work.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州法规汇编》第832.51条，C-51结构钢承包商被明确授权制作和安装用作结构构件的结构钢形材和钢板，包括完成该工作所需的铆接、焊接和吊装。
code_reference: CCR Title 16, Section 832.51 (Document p. 449, PDF p. 472)

question_en: A general building contractor is awarded a project that includes asbestos abatement work. The contractor does NOT hold a C-22 classification. Which of the following allows the contractor to proceed legally?
question_cn: 一般建筑承包商获得了一个包含石棉清除工作的项目。该承包商没有C-22分类。以下哪项允许承包商合法继续进行？

options.en: Obtain a written variance from the CSLB Registrar
options.cn: 从CSLB注册主任处获得书面豁免

options.en: Subcontract the abatement to an appropriately licensed contractor
options.cn: 将清除工作分包给持有适当执照的承包商

options.en: Complete the work using certified in-house employees only
options.cn: 仅使用经过认证的内部员工完成工作

options.en: Perform the work if the project value is under $25,000
options.cn: 如果项目价值低于25,000美元，则可以执行该工作

explanation_en: Per CCR Section 833(b), a general building contractor without a C-22 classification may contract for a project including asbestos abatement only if the contractor holds the asbestos certification and DOSH registration, OR subcontracts with an appropriately licensed contractor.
explanation_cn: 根据CCR第833(b)条规定，没有C-22分类的一般建筑承包商只有在拥有石棉认证和DOSH登记，或者与持有适当执照的承包商分包的情况下，才能承包包含石棉清除的项目。
code_reference: CCR Title 16, Section 833(b); B&P Code Section 7058.5 (Document p. 451, PDF p. 474)

question_en: Under CSLB rules, which of the following does NOT fall within the scope of a C-47 General Manufactured Housing Contractor?
question_cn: 根据加州承包商州立许可委员会（CSLB）的规定，下列哪项不属于C-47普通制造住房承包商的范围？

options.en: Preparing a mobilehome for moving
options.cn: 准备移动房屋搬迁

options.en: Connecting gas and water utilities on a single-family placement
options.cn: 在单户住宅安置中连接燃气和水务设施

options.en: Repairing or altering a multifamily manufactured home foundation
options.cn: 修理或改造多户制造住房的地基

options.en: Installing or repairing factory-built housing
options.cn: 安装或维修工厂建造的住房

explanation_en: Per CCR Section 832.47(a), factory-built housing as defined in Health and Safety Code Section 19971 is specifically excluded from the definition of manufactured home — and therefore falls outside the C-47 contractor's authorized scope.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州行政法规》第832.47(a)条，健康与安全法典第19971条定义的工厂建造住房被明确排除在制造房屋定义之外，因此不属于C-47承包商的授权范围。
code_reference: CCR Title 16, Section 832.47(a) (Document p. 448, PDF p. 471)

question_en: A licensee holds a C-61 (Swimming Pool Maintenance) license with an SC-44 supplemental solar classification. After the C-46 Solar Classification is implemented, what solar work may this licensee still perform?
question_cn: 持有 C-61（游泳池维护）执照的持证人，同时具备 SC-44 补充太阳能分类。在实施 C-46 太阳能分类后，该持证人仍可进行哪些太阳能工作？

options.en: Repair active solar heating systems for swimming pools
options.cn: 修理游泳池的主动太阳能加热系统

options.en: All solar work previously authorized by SC-44 indefinitely
options.cn: 所有此前由 SC-44 授权的太阳能工作无限期有效

options.en: No solar work of any kind after C-46 takes effect
options.cn: C-46 生效后不得进行任何类型的太阳能工作

options.en: Install photovoltaic systems as incidental to pool construction
options.cn: 在游泳池建设过程中附带安装光伏系统

explanation_en: Per CCR Section 832.62(c), after one year following C-46 implementation, the C-61 (Swimming Pool Maintenance) classification retains authorization specifically to repair active solar heating systems for swimming pools.
explanation_cn: 根据 CCR 第 832.62(c) 条，在 C-46 实施一年后，C-61（游泳池维护）分类仍保留专门修理游泳池主动太阳能加热系统的授权。
code_reference: CCR Title 16, Section 832.62(c) (Document p. 451, PDF p. 474)

question_en: A specialty contractor licensed in a specific classification wants to perform work that falls under the C-61 Limited Specialty classification. Under what condition is this permitted?
question_cn: 获得特定分类许可的专门承包商希望执行属于 C-61 限定专业分类的工作。在什么情况下这是允许的？

options.en: The contractor obtains written approval from the Registrar first
options.cn: 承包商首先获得注册主任的书面批准

options.en: The contractor holds both a C-61 and the applicable specialty license
options.cn: 承包商同时持有 C-61 和适用的专业许可证

options.en: The C-61 work is valued at less than 10% of the total contract
options.cn: C-61 的工作价值低于总合同的 10%

options.en: The work is consistent with industry usage and related to the contractor's classification
options.cn: 工作与行业惯例一致并且与承包商的分类相关

explanation_en: Per CCR Section 832.61(d), a specialty contractor other than a C-61 may perform C-61 work provided it is consistent with established usage and procedure in the construction industry and is related to the specialty contractor's own classification.
explanation_cn: 根据 CCR 第 832.61(d) 条，非 C-61 的专业承包商可以执行 C-61 工作，前提是该工作符合建筑行业的既定惯例和程序，并且与专业承包商自身的分类相关。
code_reference: CCR Title 16, Section 832.61(d) (Document p. 450, PDF p. 473)

question_en: To qualify for a waiver of the C-22 trade examination based on experience, how many years of journey-level experience in asbestos abatement must an applicant demonstrate, and within what lookback period?
question_cn: 根据经验申请C-22行业考试豁免，申请人必须展示多少年的石棉清除行业中高级工经验，并且这个经验必须在什么时间范围内？

options.en: Four years within the last 10 years
options.cn: 最近10年内的四年经验

options.en: Four years within the last 5 years
options.cn: 最近5年内的四年经验

options.en: Three years within the last 5 years
options.cn: 最近5年内的三年经验

options.en: Three years within the last 10 years
options.cn: 最近10年内的三年经验

explanation_en: Per CCR Section 833(d), the Registrar may waive the C-22 trade exam for an applicant who demonstrates not less than four years of journey-level experience in the C-22 classification within the last 10 years immediately preceding the application.
explanation_cn: 根据加州法规第833(d)条，注册主任可以对申请人予以C-22行业考试豁免，前提是申请人在申请前的最近10年内展示不少于四年的C-22分类高级工经验。
code_reference: CCR Title 16, Section 833(d); B&P Code Section 7065.3 (Document p. 451, PDF p. 474)

question_en: A contractor submits a license renewal application that contains missing information. The CSLB returns it for correction. What must the contractor do to avoid license expiration?
question_cn: 承包商提交了一份缺少信息的执照续期申请。CSLB 将其退回以进行更正。承包商必须做什么以避免执照过期？

options.en: Pay a penalty fee and resubmit at any time
options.cn: 支付罚款并随时重新提交

options.en: Request a 60-day extension from the Registrar
options.cn: 向注册主任申请 60 天延期

options.en: Resubmit within 30 days of the return date
options.cn: 在退回日期后的 30 天内重新提交

options.en: Resubmit by the original license expiration date
options.cn: 在原执照到期日前重新提交

explanation_en: Per CCR Section 853(c), after receiving a returned incomplete application, the licensee must resubmit the completed application postmarked or hand-delivered to the Board's headquarters on or before the license expiration date. Failure results in expiration under B&P Code Section 7140.
explanation_cn: 根据 CCR 第 853(c) 条，在收到退回的不完整申请后，执照持有人必须在执照到期日前将完整的申请邮寄或亲自送达委员会总部。未能按时提交将根据 《加州商业与职业法典》第 7140 条导致执照过期。
code_reference: CCR Title 16, Section 853(c); B&P Code Section 7140 (Document p. 453, PDF p. 476)

question_en: Which of the following work activities falls within the scope of a C-39 Roofing Contractor license?
question_cn: 以下哪项工作活动属于 C-39 屋顶承包商执照的范围？

options.en: Installing vitreous pipe for storm drain systems
options.cn: 安装用于暴雨排水系统的玻璃管

options.en: Installing urethane foam and roof tile to weatherproof a structure
options.cn: 安装聚氨酯泡沫和屋顶瓦以防水和防风雨建筑物

options.en: Fabricating and placing reinforcing steel mesh for concrete
options.cn: 制作并放置混凝土用钢筋网

options.en: Installing sheet metal cornices and gutters on a building
options.cn: 在建筑物上安装金属天花板和排水沟

explanation_en: Per CCR Section 832.39, a C-39 Roofing Contractor installs products to seal, waterproof, and weatherproof structures, specifically including urethane foam and roof tile among the authorized materials.
explanation_cn: 根据 CCR 第 832.39 条，C-39 屋顶承包商安装密封、防水和防风雨结构的产品，授权材料中特别包括聚氨酯泡沫和屋顶瓦。
code_reference: CCR Title 16, Section 832.39 (Document p. 447, PDF p. 470)

question_en: A C-49 Tree and Palm Contractor is working near a residential property. A gardener on the same site prunes a few low tree branches incidentally during regular yard maintenance. Which of the following is true?
question_cn: C-49 树木与棕榈树承包商正在住宅物业附近工作。同一现场的一名园丁在常规院子维护过程中顺便修剪了几根低矮的树枝。以下哪项说法是正确的？

options.en: The gardener needs a C-49 license for any tree pruning
options.cn: 园丁进行任何树木修剪都需要 C-49 许可证

options.en: The gardener's incidental pruning does not require a C-49 license
options.cn: 园丁的偶发修剪不需要 C-49 许可证

options.en: The gardener may prune only if supervised by the C-49 contractor
options.cn: 园丁只有在 C-49 承包商监督下才能修剪

options.en: The gardener must stop and defer all pruning to the C-49 contractor
options.cn: 园丁必须停止并将所有修剪工作交给 C-49 承包商

explanation_en: Per CCR Section 832.49(c), the C-49 license requirement does not apply to incidental pruning of trees by a gardener as described in B&P Code Section 7026.1. This is an express statutory exemption.
explanation_cn: 根据 CCR 第 832.49(c) 条款，如 《加州商业与职业法典》第 7026.1 条所述，园丁的偶发树木修剪不适用 C-49 许可证要求。这是一项明确的法定豁免。
code_reference: CCR Title 16, Section 832.49(c); B&P Code Section 7026.1 (Document p. 449, PDF p. 472)

question_en: A contractor applies for a C-61 Limited Specialty license. After the license is issued, where does the Registrar document the approved field and scope of operations?
question_cn: 承包商申请C-61有限专业执照。执照签发后，注册主任在哪里记录获批的领域和业务范围？

options.en: In a separate written agreement with the licensee
options.cn: 在与持证人的单独书面协议中

options.en: In a board resolution filed at CSLB headquarters
options.cn: 在提交到CSLB总部的董事会决议中

options.en: On the face of the original license certificate
options.cn: 在原始执照证书的正面

options.en: In the CSLB's public online license database only
options.cn: 仅在CSLB的公共在线执照数据库中

explanation_en: Per CCR Section 832.61(c), upon issuance of a C-61 license, the Registrar shall endorse upon the face of the original license certificate the specific field and scope of operations in which the licensee has demonstrated qualifications.
explanation_cn: 根据CCR第832.61(c)条款，C-61执照签发时，注册主任应在原始执照证书的正面注明持证人已证明其资格的具体领域和业务范围。
code_reference: CCR Title 16, Section 832.61(c) (Document p. 450, PDF p. 473)

question_en: Which of the following information is NOT required to be posted to a licensee's public license record when a blanket bond is approved by the Registrar?
question_cn: 当注册主任批准一项总担保时，下列哪项信息不需要在持证人的公共执照记录上公布？

options.en: The dollar amount of the blanket bond
options.cn: 总担保的金额

options.en: The names of all home improvement contracts covered
options.cn: 所有涵盖的家庭装修合同的名称

options.en: The bond number and approval date
options.cn: 担保编号和批准日期

options.en: The name and address of the surety company
options.cn: 担保公司的名称和地址

explanation_en: Section 858.9(a) lists five items for posting -- a statement of approval, approval date, bond number, dollar amount, and surety name/address. Individual contract names are not required to be posted.
explanation_cn: 第858.9(a)条列出了五项需要公布的内容——批准声明、批准日期、担保编号、金额及担保人名称/地址。单个合同名称不需要公布。
code_reference: 16 CCR Section 858.9(a) (Document p. 466, PDF p. 489)

question_en: After written notification of a blanket bond rescission is sent to a licensee, within what window must the Registrar post a notice on the public license record?
question_cn: 在向持证人发送关于全额保证金撤销的书面通知后，注册主任必须在多久之内在公共许可记录上发布通知？

options.en: No earlier than 5 days, no later than 10 days
options.cn: 不早于5天，不晚于10天

options.en: No earlier than 3 days, no later than 7 days
options.cn: 不早于3天，不晚于7天

options.en: No earlier than 7 days, no later than 14 days
options.cn: 不早于7天，不晚于14天

options.en: No earlier than 10 days, no later than 30 days
options.cn: 不早于10天，不晚于30天

explanation_en: The regulation expressly states the notice shall be posted no earlier than 5 calendar days and no later than 10 calendar days after written notification of the rescission is sent to the licensee.
explanation_cn: 规定明确指出，通知应在向持证人发送撤销书面通知后不早于5个日历日，不晚于10个日历日发布。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7159.5; CCR Title 16 Section 858 (Document p. 467, PDF p. 490)

question_en: After a blanket bond is rescinded or cancelled, for how long must the bond's identifying information remain on the license record?
question_cn: 当一份总保证金被撤销或取消后，该保证金的识别信息必须在执照记录上保留多久？

options.en: Not less than five years after cancellation
options.cn: 取消后不少于五年

options.en: Not less than two years after cancellation
options.cn: 取消后不少于两年

options.en: Not less than seven years after cancellation
options.cn: 取消后不少于七年

options.en: Not less than three years after cancellation
options.cn: 取消后不少于三年

explanation_en: CCR Section 858(c) specifically requires that bond information in paragraphs (2)–(5) remain on the license record for not less than five years after the date the blanket bond was rescinded or cancelled.
explanation_cn: 《加州法规汇编》第858(c)条特别要求，第(2)–(5)段的保证金信息自总保证金被撤销或取消之日起，在执照记录上至少保留五年。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7159.5; CCR Title 16 Section 858(c) (Document p. 467, PDF p. 490)

question_en: A contractor's license has a responsible managing employee (RME) who disassociates. If proper notice is given under Section 7068.2, how long does the license remain in force?
question_cn: 承包商执照有一名负责管理的员工（RME）退出。如果根据第7068.2条款提供了适当的通知，该执照保持有效的时间是多长？

options.en: Up to one year from the date of disassociation
options.cn: 自退出之日起最多一年

options.en: 30 days from the date of disassociation
options.cn: 自退出之日起30天

options.en: 60 days from the date of disassociation
options.cn: 自退出之日起60天

options.en: 90 days from the date of disassociation
options.cn: 自退出之日起90天

explanation_en: CCR Section 864 states that when a disassociation notice is given in the manner prescribed by B&P Code Section 7068.2, the license shall remain in force for a period of 90 days from the date of such disassociation.
explanation_cn: CCR第864条规定，当按照《加州商业与职业法典》第7068.2条规定的方式提交退出通知时，执照自退出之日起保持有效期为90天。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7068.2; CCR Title 16 Section 864 (Document p. 469, PDF p. 492)

question_en: A licensed partnership dissolves when one partner dies. The surviving partner wants to continue operations under the existing license. Within how many days of the death must an application be submitted to the Registrar?
question_cn: 当合伙人去世时，有执照的合伙企业将解散。幸存的合伙人希望在现有执照下继续经营。在合伙人去世后的多少天内必须向注册主任提交申请？

options.en: Within 60 days of the partner's death
options.cn: 合伙人去世后60天内

options.en: Within 30 days of the partner's death
options.cn: 合伙人去世后30天内

options.en: Within 90 days of the partner's death
options.cn: 合伙人去世后90天内

options.en: Within 180 days of the partner's death
options.cn: 合伙人去世后180天内

explanation_en: CCR Section 865(a) expressly states that an application for continuation may be submitted within 90 days of the death of a partner of a licensed partnership.
explanation_cn: CCR第865(a)条明确规定，有执照的合伙企业的合伙人去世后，可以在90天内提交继续经营的申请。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7076; CCR Title 16 Section 865(a) (Document p. 470, PDF p. 493)

question_en: If the Registrar approves a continuation application after a licensed individual dies, how long may the license remain in force from the date of death?
question_cn: 如果注册主任在持证人去世后批准继续申请，该执照自去世之日起可以维持多久？

options.en: Up to 90 days from date of death
options.cn: 自去世之日起最多90天

options.en: Up to two years from date of death
options.cn: 自去世之日起最多两年

options.en: Up to one year from date of death
options.cn: 自去世之日起最多一年

options.en: Up to 18 months from date of death
options.cn: 自去世之日起最多18个月

explanation_en: CCR Section 865(a) states that if the application is approved, the license shall remain in force for a period of up to one year from the date of death or disassociation.
explanation_cn: CCR第865(a)条规定，如果申请被批准，执照自去世或脱离之日起最多可维持一年。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7076; CCR Title 16 Section 865(a) (Document p. 470, PDF p. 493)

question_en: A contractor applies to reactivate an inactive license. The contractor pays the full active renewal fee on March 1, but requests an effective date of April 1. When does the reactivation become effective?
question_cn: 承包商申请重新激活一个非活跃的执照。承包商在3月1日支付了全额的有效续费，但请求生效日期为4月1日。重新激活何时生效？

options.en: March 1, when the fee was paid
options.cn: 3月1日，支付费用的日期

options.en: The first day of the following license period
options.cn: 下一个执照期的第一天

options.en: April 1, the requested effective date
options.cn: 4月1日，请求的生效日期

options.en: The date the form is received by the Registrar
options.cn: 表格被登记员收到的日期

explanation_en: CCR Section 867(a) states reactivation is effective on the date the form is received, the fee is paid, or the date requested by the licensee -- whichever last occurs. Since April 1 is later than March 1, it controls.
explanation_cn: CCR 第867(a)条规定，重新激活在下列日期中最后发生的那一天生效：表格收到的日期、费用支付的日期或持证人请求的日期。由于4月1日晚于3月1日，因此以4月1日为准。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7076.5; CCR Title 16 Section 867(a) (Document p. 470, PDF p. 493)

question_en: Which of the following is NOT included in the CSLB's regulatory definition of 'advertising' for purposes of the contractor advertising law?
question_cn: 以下哪项不包括在CSLB为承包商广告法规定的“广告”监管定义中？

options.en: Lettering on vehicles registered in another state
options.cn: 注册在其他州的车辆上的字母标识

options.en: Verbal word-of-mouth referrals between homeowners
options.cn: 房主之间通过口头推荐的传口信

options.en: Directory listings denoting 'Contractor'
options.cn: 标明“承包商”的目录列表

options.en: Electronic transmissions of any form
options.cn: 任何形式的电子传输

explanation_en: CCR Section 861 lists only tangible and broadcast media -- cards, signs, vehicles, brochures, newspapers, electronic transmissions, and directories. Oral word-of-mouth referrals between private individuals are not included.
explanation_cn: CCR第861条仅列出了有形和广播媒体——名片、标志、车辆、宣传册、报纸、电子传输和目录。私人之间的口头推荐不包括在内。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7030.5; CCR Title 16 Section 861 (Document p. 467, PDF p. 490)

question_en: Under CSLB regulations, which three elements must ALL be present for a defect to qualify as a 'structural defect'?
question_cn: 根据CSLB的规定，哪三个元素必须全部存在，缺陷才可被认定为“结构缺陷”？

options.en: Code violation, visible damage, and contractor negligence
options.cn: 违反规范、可见损坏以及承包商疏忽

options.en: Load-bearing failure risk, code non-compliance, and inability to use the affected portion
options.cn: 承重失效风险、违反规范以及无法使用受影响部分

options.en: Permit violation, foundation damage, and financial harm to owner
options.cn: 许可证违规、地基损坏以及对业主造成经济损失

options.en: Load-bearing failure, code violation, and uninhabitable structure
options.cn: 承重失效、违反规范以及建筑无法居住

explanation_en: CCR Section 861.5 requires all three: (1) a failure or condition likely to cause failure in load-bearing portions, (2) those portions not built to applicable codes, and (3) resulting in inability to reasonably use the affected portion for its intended purpose.
explanation_cn: CCR第861.5条要求具备三个条件：(1) 承重部分失败或存在可能导致失败的状况，(2) 这些部分未按适用规范建造，(3) 导致无法合理使用受影响部分以实现其预期用途。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7091; CCR Title 16 Section 861.5 (Document p. 468, PDF p. 491)

question_en: A member of the public asks the CSLB Registrar for complaint information about a licensed contractor. Which complaint information is the Registrar prohibited from disclosing?
question_cn: 公众成员向CSLB注册主任询问有关持牌承包商的投诉信息。注册主任被禁止披露哪些投诉信息？

options.en: Whether any citation is currently on appeal
options.cn: 任何罚单是否目前正在上诉中

options.en: Complaints currently being screened, mediated, or investigated
options.cn: 正在筛查、调解或调查的投诉

options.en: Complaints referred for legal action by the District Office
options.cn: 已由地区办公室转交法律行动的投诉

options.en: Whether the licensee is a respondent in pending disciplinary action
options.cn: 持牌人是否是待定纪律处分的答辩方

explanation_en: CCR Section 863(a)(1) expressly states that information regarding complaints which are in the process of being screened, mediated, arbitrated, or investigated shall NOT be disclosed to the public.
explanation_cn: CCR第863(a)(1)条明确规定，关于正在筛查、调解、仲裁或调查中的投诉的信息不得向公众披露。
code_reference: B&P Code Sections 7124.5, 7124.6; CCR Title 16 Section 863(a)(1) (Document p. 468, PDF p. 491)

question_en: A licensed contractor was convicted of a misdemeanor substantially related to contracting duties. Under CSLB rehabilitation criteria, how many years must pass before the Board may consider the contractor rehabilitated?
question_cn: 一名持牌承包商因与承包职责密切相关的轻罪被定罪。根据CSLB的康复标准，董事会在考虑承包商康复之前，必须经过多少年？

options.en: Five years from release or probation completion
options.cn: 从释放或考察期完成起五年

options.en: One year from release or probation completion
options.cn: 从释放或考察期完成起一年

options.en: Three years from release or probation completion
options.cn: 从释放或考察期完成起三年

options.en: Seven years from release or probation completion
options.cn: 从释放或考察期完成起七年

explanation_en: CCR Section 869(b)(1)(D) states that for misdemeanor convictions, the Board may consider the individual rehabilitated if three years have passed from release from incarceration or completion of probation without additional substantially-related criminal activity.
explanation_cn: CCR 第869(b)(1)(D)条规定，对于轻罪定罪，如果从监禁释放或考察期完成起三年且未发生额外与职责密切相关的犯罪活动，董事会可考虑该个人已康复。
code_reference: B&P Code Sections 481, 490; CCR Title 16 Section 869(b)(1)(D) (Document p. 474, PDF p. 497)

question_en: A contractor applicant was convicted of a serious felony and released from prison. Under CSLB rehabilitation criteria, how many years must pass from release before the Board may consider the applicant rehabilitated for purposes of a license denial?
question_cn: 一名承包商申请人因严重重罪被判刑并获释。根据 CSLB 的康复标准，自获释后必须经过多少年，董事会才能考虑申请人在许可证拒绝的情况下已康复？

options.en: Ten years from release from incarceration
options.cn: 自监禁获释起十年

options.en: Three years from release from incarceration
options.cn: 自监禁获释起三年

options.en: Five years from release from incarceration
options.cn: 自监禁获释起五年

options.en: Seven years from release from incarceration
options.cn: 自监禁获释起七年

explanation_en: CCR Section 869(b)(1)(B) states that for serious felonies, felonies requiring sex offender registration, or felony financial crimes, the Board may consider an applicant rehabilitated if seven years have passed from release from incarceration without additional substantially-related criminal activity.
explanation_cn: CCR 第 869(b)(1)(B) 条规定，对于严重重罪、需要注册为性犯罪者的重罪或金融重罪，如果自监禁获释后七年内没有发生其他重大相关犯罪活动，董事会可以认为申请人已康复。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 480(a)(1)(A); CCR Title 16 Section 869(b)(1)(B) (Document p. 473, PDF p. 496)

question_en: Which of the following applicants is EXEMPT from the CSLB's fingerprinting requirement?
question_cn: 以下哪类申请人可以免于 CSLB 的指纹要求？

options.en: A joint venture applicant holding a current active license
options.cn: 持有当前有效执照的合资企业申请人

options.en: A home improvement salesperson applicant
options.cn: 家庭装修销售员申请人

options.en: An out-of-state applicant submitting a new application
options.cn: 提交新申请的州外申请人

options.en: A new RME being added to an existing license
options.cn: 被添加到现有执照的新 RME

explanation_en: CCR Section 869.2(a) expressly exempts applicants for a joint venture license who already hold a current active license in good standing from the fingerprinting requirement.
explanation_cn: CCR 第 869.2(a) 条明确规定，已经持有有效良好执照的合资企业执照申请人可以免于指纹要求。
code_reference: B&P Code Sections 7069, 7153.1; CCR Title 16 Section 869.2 (Document p. 476, PDF p. 499)

question_en: When evaluating whether a crime is 'substantially related' to a contractor's qualifications, which factor does the CSLB Board consider?
question_cn: 在评估某项犯罪是否与承包商的资格“实质相关”时，CSLB委员会考虑哪个因素？

options.en: Whether the licensee has prior disciplinary history
options.cn: 持证人是否有过往纪律处分记录

options.en: The applicant's current financial solvency
options.cn: 申请人当前的财务偿付能力

options.en: Whether restitution has been paid to victims
options.cn: 是否已向受害者支付赔偿

options.en: The number of years elapsed since the offense
options.cn: 自犯罪发生以来经过的年数

explanation_en: CCR Section 868(b) lists three criteria: (1) the nature and gravity of the offense, (2) the number of years elapsed since the date of the offense, and (3) the nature and duties of a contractor or home improvement salesperson.
explanation_cn: CCR 第 868(b) 条列出了三项标准：(1) 犯罪的性质和严重性，(2) 自犯罪发生之日起经过的年数，(3) 承包商或家庭装修销售人员的性质和职责。
code_reference: B&P Code Sections 7073, 7123; CCR Title 16 Section 868(b) (Document p. 471, PDF p. 494)

question_en: A complaint was filed against a licensed contractor, investigated, and referred for legal action. The matter was later determined by the Attorney General to have no merit. What happens to the complaint?
question_cn: 针对一名持证承包商提交了一份投诉，经过调查后被转交进行法律处理。后来，总检察长认定该事项毫无依据。投诉会如何处理？

options.en: It is transferred to a non-public administrative file
options.cn: 它会被转入非公开的行政文件

options.en: It is sealed but retained for seven years
options.cn: 它会被封存，但保留七年

options.en: It remains on the record permanently as a filed complaint
options.cn: 它会作为已提交的投诉永久保留在记录上

options.en: It is deleted from the complaint disclosure system
options.cn: 它会从投诉披露系统中删除

explanation_en: CCR Section 863(b) expressly states that if a complaint results in legal action but is subsequently determined not to have merit by the Registrar, the Office of the Attorney General, or a court, it shall be deleted from the complaint disclosure system.
explanation_cn: CCR 第 863(b) 条明确指出，如果投诉导致法律行动，但随后被注册主任、总检察长办公室或法院认定毫无依据，应从投诉披露系统中删除。
code_reference: B&P Code Sections 7124.5, 7124.6; CCR Title 16 Section 863(b) (Document p. 468, PDF p. 491)

question_en: A felony financial crime conviction involves an applicant who used stolen identity information to obtain construction contracts. Under CSLB regulations, what makes this crime 'directly and adversely related' to fiduciary qualifications?
question_cn: 重罪金融犯罪定罪涉及申请人使用被盗身份信息获取建筑合同。根据CSLB规定，什么使该犯罪与信托资格“直接且不利相关”？

options.en: It caused physical harm to a member of the public
options.cn: 它对公众成员造成了身体伤害

options.en: It violated a specific provision of the Contractors License Law
options.cn: 它违反了承包商执照法的具体条款

options.en: It involved a repeated pattern of minor infractions
options.cn: 它涉及一系列反复出现的小违规行为

options.en: It resulted in direct financial benefit or harm to another
options.cn: 它导致了对他人的直接财务利益或损害

explanation_en: CCR Section 868.1 states a felony financial crime is directly and adversely related to fiduciary qualifications if it involves dishonesty, fraud, or deceit resulting in direct financial benefit to the applicant, direct financial harm to another, or an attempt to do either.
explanation_cn: CCR第868.1条规定，如果重罪金融犯罪涉及不诚实、欺诈或欺骗，导致对申请人的直接财务利益、对他人的直接财务损害，或试图做出上述行为，则该犯罪与信托资格直接且不利相关。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 480; CCR Title 16 Section 868.1(b) (Document p. 472, PDF p. 495)

question_en: A contractor's license is revoked for the very first time, and the licensee has no prior legal action history with the CSLB. What is the earliest the revoked licensee may reapply?
question_cn: 承包商的执照首次被吊销，且执照持有人以前没有与加州承包商执照委员会（CSLB）的法律诉讼记录。被吊销的执照持有人最早何时可以重新申请？

options.en: After 2 years from revocation date
options.cn: 吊销日期起2年之后

options.en: After 5 years from revocation date
options.cn: 吊销日期起5年之后

options.en: After 1 year from revocation date
options.cn: 吊销日期起1年之后

options.en: After 3 years from revocation date
options.cn: 吊销日期起3年之后

explanation_en: Under CCR Section 870, when a licensee is revoked for the first time and has no previous legal action history with the Board, the minimum reapplication waiting period is 1 year.
explanation_cn: 根据加州法规（CCR）第870条，当执照持有人首次被吊销且以前没有委员会的法律诉讼记录时，最短的重新申请等待期为1年。
code_reference: CCR Title 16, Section 870 (Document p. 480, PDF p. 503)

question_en: An applicant was denied a CSLB license due to a misdemeanor conviction substantially related to contractor duties. Assuming no further misconduct, what is the minimum clean period required before the Registrar may set a reapplication date?
question_cn: 由于与承包商职责密切相关的轻罪定罪，申请人被拒绝颁发 CSLB 执照。假设没有进一步的不当行为，注册主任在设定重新申请日期之前，所需的最低清洁期是多少？

options.en: One year after release or probation completion
options.cn: 释放或考察期完成后一年

options.en: Seven years after release or probation completion
options.cn: 释放或考察期完成后七年

options.en: Three years after release or probation completion
options.cn: 释放或考察期完成后三年

options.en: Five years after release or probation completion
options.cn: 释放或考察期完成后五年

explanation_en: Under CCR Section 869.9(a)(3), misdemeanor convictions substantially related to contractor duties require three years from release from incarceration or completion of probation, with no further substantially-related misconduct, before the Registrar sets a reapplication date.
explanation_cn: 根据 CCR 第 869.9(a)(3) 条，涉及与承包商职责密切相关的轻罪定罪，需要从释放监禁或完成考察期起算三年，并且在此期间没有进一步的与职责密切相关的不当行为，注册主任方可设定重新申请日期。
code_reference: CCR Title 16, Section 869.9(a)(3) (Document p. 477, PDF p. 500)

question_en: A contractor was denied a license due to a felony conviction listed in Section 869(b)(1)(B) that is substantially related to contractor qualifications. How many years must pass without additional related misconduct before the Registrar may set a reapplication date?
question_cn: 一名承包商因刑事重罪定罪而被拒绝发放执照，该罪行列在第869(b)(1)(B)条，并且与承包商资格有实质性关系。在注册主任可以设定重新申请日期之前，必须经过多少年且没有其他相关的不当行为？

options.en: Five years after incarceration or probation ends
options.cn: 监禁或考察期结束后五年

options.en: Seven years after incarceration or probation ends
options.cn: 监禁或考察期结束后七年

options.en: Three years after incarceration or probation ends
options.cn: 监禁或考察期结束后三年

options.en: Ten years after incarceration or probation ends
options.cn: 监禁或考察期结束后十年

explanation_en: Under CCR Section 869.9(a)(1), felony convictions listed in Section 869(b)(1)(B) that are substantially related to contractor duties require seven years from release from incarceration or completion of probation, without further substantially-related criminal activity or misconduct.
explanation_cn: 根据CCR第869.9(a)(1)条，列在第869(b)(1)(B)条的与承包商职责实质相关的重罪定罪需自释放监禁或完成考察期起算七年，且期间不得有进一步的实质相关刑事活动或不当行为。
code_reference: CCR Title 16, Section 869.9(a)(1) (Document p. 477, PDF p. 500)

question_en: A contractor's license is revoked after being found guilty of committing fraudulent acts on a project. Under CSLB disciplinary guidelines, what is the earliest reapplication date the Registrar may set?
question_cn: 一位承包商的执照在被认定在一个项目中实施欺诈行为后被吊销。根据CSLB的纪律指导方针，注册主任可能设定的最早重新申请日期是什么？

options.en: 1 year after the revocation date
options.cn: 吊销日期后的1年

options.en: 2 years after the revocation date
options.cn: 吊销日期后的2年

options.en: 5 years after the revocation date
options.cn: 吊销日期后的5年

options.en: 3 years after the revocation date
options.cn: 吊销日期后的3年

explanation_en: Under CCR Section 870, a 5-year reapplication waiting period applies when a license has been revoked for committing fraudulent acts, among other serious grounds. The Registrar sets this as the earliest allowable reapplication date.
explanation_cn: 根据CCR第870条，当执照因实施欺诈行为或其他严重原因被吊销时，适用5年的重新申请等待期。注册主任将此设为最早允许的重新申请日期。
code_reference: CCR Title 16, Section 870 (Document p. 479, PDF p. 502)

question_en: Under CSLB disciplinary guidelines, which violation carries both a minimum AND maximum penalty of outright revocation with no possibility of a stayed sentence?
question_cn: 根据CSLB的纪律指南，哪种违规行为的最低和最高处罚都是直接吊销执照，且没有缓刑的可能？

options.en: Fraudulent use of a license number
options.cn: 伪造使用执照号码

options.en: Contracting jointly without a joint venture license
options.cn: 未持有联合企业执照而进行联合承包

options.en: Failure to notify of RMO/RME disassociation
options.cn: 未通知RMO/RME解除关联

options.en: Conspiracy with an unlicensed person
options.cn: 与无执照人员合谋

explanation_en: Under Section 7027.3 disciplinary guidelines, fraudulent use of a license number carries both a minimum and maximum penalty of Revocation -- no stayed option is available, making it one of the most severe automatic penalties in the guidelines.
explanation_cn: 根据第7027.3条的纪律指南，伪造使用执照号码的行为，其最低和最高处罚都是吊销执照——没有缓刑选项，这使其成为指南中最严重的自动处罚之一。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7027.3; CCR Section 871 Disciplinary Guidelines (Document p. 484, PDF p. 507)

question_en: A contractor is placed on probation after a disciplinary action. Regardless of whether the action is stayed, which additional requirement is automatically imposed on all licensees who have had a license disciplined?
question_cn: 承包商在受到纪律处分后会被置于考察期。无论处分是否被暂停，所有受到执照纪律处理的执照持有人都会自动加以什么额外要求？

options.en: Complete community service of 5 to 21 days
options.cn: 完成5到21天的社区服务

options.en: Submit all contracts to the Registrar for review
options.cn: 将所有合同提交给注册主任审查

options.en: Post a disciplinary bond under Section 7071.8
options.cn: 根据第7071.8条规定提交纪律处分保证金

options.en: Retake and pass the CSLB trade examination
options.cn: 重新参加并通过CSLB行业考试

explanation_en: Under B&P Code Section 7071.8 and the CSLB Disciplinary Guidelines, all persons who have had a license disciplined -- whether or not the action is stayed -- are required to post a disciplinary bond. This requirement is universal and automatic.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7071.8条和CSLB纪律指南，所有受到执照纪律处理的人——无论处分是否被暂停——都需要提交纪律处分保证金。此要求是普遍且自动的。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7071.8; CCR Section 871 Disciplinary Guidelines (Document p. 480, PDF p. 503)

question_en: A contractor is convicted of a crime substantially related to contractor functions. According to CSLB disciplinary guidelines, what is the minimum actual suspension period if a suspension is warranted?
question_cn: 如果承包商因与承包商职能实质相关的犯罪被定罪，根据CSLB的纪律准则，如果需要暂停执照效力，实际暂停执照效力的最短期限是多少？

options.en: At least 60 days of actual suspension
options.cn: 至少60天的实际暂停执照效力

options.en: At least 5 days of actual suspension
options.cn: 至少5天的实际暂停执照效力

options.en: At least 90 days of actual suspension
options.cn: 至少90天的实际暂停执照效力

options.en: At least 30 days of actual suspension
options.cn: 至少30天的实际暂停执照效力

explanation_en: Under the Section 490 disciplinary guidelines for conviction of a crime substantially related to contractor functions, an actual suspension of at least 30 days is required if a suspension is warranted -- a higher threshold than most other violations.
explanation_cn: 根据第490条关于因与承包商职能实质相关的犯罪定罪的纪律准则，如果需要暂停执照效力，要求至少实际暂停执照效力30天——这一标准高于大多数其他违规行为。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 490; CCR Section 871 Disciplinary Guidelines (Document p. 482, PDF p. 505)

question_en: Under CSLB guidelines, a contractor who violated Section 7068.2 by failing to notify the Board of an RMO's disassociation faces what minimum penalty?
question_cn: 根据CSLB的指南，对于未能通知委员会RMO解除关联而违反第7068.2条的承包商，最低处罚是什么？

options.en: Revocation, stayed, 3-year probation
options.cn: 吊销，缓期，3年考察期

options.en: 5-day suspension, stayed, 1-year probation
options.cn: 5天停业，缓期，1年考察期

options.en: 60-day suspension, stayed, 1-year probation
options.cn: 60天停业，缓期，1年考察期

options.en: Outright revocation with no probation option
options.cn: 直接吊销，无考察期选项

explanation_en: Under the Section 7068.2 disciplinary guidelines, failure to notify the Board of an RMO/RME disassociation carries a minimum penalty of a 60-day suspension, stayed, with 1 year of probation -- reflecting the Board's concern about unlicensed operation.
explanation_cn: 根据第7068.2条的纪律指南，未能通知委员会RMO/RME解除关联的最低处罚是60天停业，缓期，并处1年考察期——反映出委员会对无证操作的关注。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7068.2; CCR Section 871 Disciplinary Guidelines (Document p. 485, PDF p. 508)

question_en: A contractor's license was revoked after violations on multiple separate construction projects. According to Section 870, what is the earliest reapplication date the Registrar may set?
question_cn: 在多个独立建筑项目中存在违规行为后，一名承包商的执照被吊销。根据第870条，注册主任可能设定的最早重新申请日期是什么？

options.en: 4 years after revocation
options.cn: 吊销后4年

options.en: 1 year after revocation
options.cn: 吊销后1年

options.en: 5 years after revocation
options.cn: 吊销后5年

options.en: 3 years after revocation
options.cn: 吊销后3年

explanation_en: Under CCR Section 870, a 4-year reapplication waiting period applies when a license was revoked for committing violations on multiple construction projects or for multiple violations of law -- reasons other than fraud, public endangerment, or a construction-related crime conviction.
explanation_cn: 根据加州法规第870条，当执照因在多个建筑项目中违规或多次违反法律（非欺诈、危及公众安全或与建筑相关的犯罪定罪以外的原因）被吊销时，适用4年的重新申请等待期。
code_reference: CCR Title 16, Section 870 (Document p. 479, PDF p. 502)

question_en: Which of the following factors does the CSLB Registrar NOT consider when setting a reapplication date for a denied applicant under Section 869.9?
question_cn: 根据第869.9条款，在为被拒申请人设定重新申请日期时，CSLB注册主任不会考虑以下哪个因素？

options.en: Testimony from credible individuals with personal knowledge
options.cn: 来自有个人知识的可靠人士的证词

options.en: The applicant's current net worth and financial assets
options.cn: 申请人的当前净资产和财务资产

options.en: Compliance with parole, probation, or restitution terms
options.cn: 遵守假释、考察期或赔偿条款

options.en: Consistent work history since incarceration or probation
options.cn: 自监禁或考察期以来的持续工作记录

explanation_en: Current financial net worth or assets are not listed anywhere in Section 869.9(a) as criteria for setting a reapplication date. The Registrar focuses on rehabilitation, conduct history, work history, and compliance with sanctions -- not financial standing.
explanation_cn: 当前的财务净资产或资产在第869.9(a)条款中并未被列为设定重新申请日期的标准。注册主任关注的是康复情况、行为记录、工作记录和对制裁的遵守情况——而不是财务状况。
code_reference: CCR Title 16, Section 869.9(a) (Document p. 478, PDF p. 501)

question_en: Under Section 869.9, once a denied applicant's reapplication date has been set, can the Registrar still deny the new application?
question_cn: 根据第869.9条，一旦被拒申请人的重新申请日期已确定，注册主任是否仍然可以拒绝新的申请？

options.en: No, meeting the criteria creates a right to licensure
options.cn: 不，符合条件会产生获得执照的权利

options.en: Yes, but only if a new crime has occurred
options.cn: 是的，但仅在发生新的犯罪时

options.en: No, eligibility to reapply guarantees license approval
options.cn: 不，重新申请的资格保证执照批准

options.en: Yes, meeting reapplication eligibility does not guarantee approval
options.cn: 是的，符合重新申请资格并不保证批准

explanation_en: Under CCR Section 869.9(b), nothing in the section precludes the Registrar from denying the license or registration of an applicant who was previously denied and is now eligible to reapply. Eligibility to reapply is not the same as a right to be licensed.
explanation_cn: 根据CCR第869.9(b)条，本条款中的任何内容都不排除注册主任拒绝之前被拒并现符合重新申请资格的申请人的执照或注册。重新申请资格不等同于获得执照的权利。
code_reference: CCR Title 16, Section 869.9(b) (Document p. 479, PDF p. 502)

question_en: A contractor who secured a license through knowing misrepresentation faces disciplinary action. Under CSLB guidelines for Section 498, what is the minimum penalty?
question_cn: 通过故意虚假陈述获得执照的承包商将面临纪律处分。根据CSLB第498条的指导方针，最低处罚是什么？

options.en: 5-day suspension, stayed, 1-year probation
options.cn: 5天暂停执照效力，缓期执行，1年考察期

options.en: 60-day suspension, stayed, 3-year probation
options.cn: 60天暂停执照效力，缓期执行，3年考察期

options.en: Outright revocation, no probation
options.cn: 直接吊销执照，无考察期

options.en: Revocation, stayed, 3-year probation
options.cn: 吊销执照，缓期执行，3年考察期

explanation_en: Under the Section 498 disciplinary guidelines, securing a license through fraud, deceit, or knowing misrepresentation carries both a minimum and maximum penalty of outright Revocation -- one of the few offenses with no stayed sentence at the minimum level.
explanation_cn: 根据第498条纪律指导方针，通过欺诈、欺骗或故意虚假陈述获得执照的处罚既有最低也有最高处罚，即直接吊销执照——这是少数在最低水平没有缓刑的违法行为之一。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 498; CCR Section 871 Disciplinary Guidelines (Document p. 483, PDF p. 506)

question_en: After a contractor's fingerprints are submitted to CSLB, how long does the Board maintain access to that individual's subsequent arrest history?
question_cn: 承包商的指纹提交给加州承包商执照委员会（CSLB）后，委员会可以获得该个人随后的逮捕记录的时间是多久？

options.en: For 10 years from the fingerprint date
options.cn: 自指纹日期起10年

options.en: Until the license expires or is not renewed
options.cn: 直到执照到期或未续期

options.en: Until the license is first renewed
options.cn: 直到执照首次续期

options.en: Until the license is cancelled, revoked, or no longer renewable
options.cn: 直到执照被取消、吊销或不再可续

explanation_en: Under CCR Section 869.4(a), once fingerprinted, the Board maintains access to subsequent arrest history until the individual's license is cancelled, revoked, or no longer renewable -- ensuring ongoing background monitoring throughout the license's active life.
explanation_cn: 根据CCR第869.4(a)条，一旦进行指纹采集，委员会将持续获得该个人随后的逮捕记录，直到其执照被取消、吊销或不再可续——确保在执照有效期内进行持续的背景监控。
code_reference: CCR Title 16, Section 869.4(a) (Document p. 477, PDF p. 500)

question_en: A contractor violated Section 7071.13 by referencing a contractor bond incorrectly in advertising. Under CSLB disciplinary guidelines, what is the maximum penalty the Registrar may impose?
question_cn: 一名承包商因在广告中错误引用承包商保证金而违反了第7071.13条款。根据CSLB的纪律指南，注册主任可以施加的最高处罚是什么？

options.en: 60-day suspension, 1-year probation
options.cn: 暂停60天，考察期1年

options.en: 180-day suspension, 2-year probation
options.cn: 暂停180天，考察期2年

options.en: Revocation of the contractor's license
options.cn: 吊销承包商执照

options.en: 5-day suspension, stayed, 1-year probation
options.cn: 暂停5天，缓期执行，考察期1年

explanation_en: Under the Section 7071.13 disciplinary guidelines, the maximum penalty for incorrectly referencing a contractor bond in advertising is a 60-day suspension with 1-year probation -- the same maximum tier shared by several mid-level violations.
explanation_cn: 根据第7071.13条纪律指南，对于在广告中错误引用承包商保证金的最高处罚是暂停60天，并考察期1年——与其他几个中级违规行为的最高处罚相同。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7071.13; CCR Section 871 Disciplinary Guidelines (Document p. 485, PDF p. 508)

question_en: A contractor on probation for conspiring with an unlicensed person is required to submit construction contracts to the Registrar. When must these contracts be submitted?
question_cn: 因与无证人员共谋而被处于考察期期的承包商必须向注册主任提交施工合同。这些合同应何时提交？

options.en: Upon the Registrar's demand during probation
options.cn: 在考察期期间根据注册主任的要求提交

options.en: Monthly, throughout the entire probation period
options.cn: 在整个考察期期间每月提交

options.en: Within 10 days of contract execution
options.cn: 合同签订后10天内提交

options.en: Before work begins on each project
options.cn: 在每个项目开始施工前提交

explanation_en: Under the Section 125 disciplinary guidelines, a contractor on probation for conspiring with an unlicensed person must submit copies of construction contracts to the Registrar upon demand during the probation period -- not on a fixed schedule.
explanation_cn: 根据第125条纪律指导方针，因与无证人员共谋而处于考察期期的承包商必须在考察期期间根据要求向注册主任提交施工合同副本——而不是按照固定时间表提交。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 125; CCR Section 871 Disciplinary Guidelines (Document p. 481, PDF p. 504)

question_en: A contractor is found guilty of abandoning a project midway through construction. Absent compelling mitigating circumstances, what is the minimum actual suspension period CSLB considers appropriate?
question_cn: 一名承包商在施工过程中被发现中途放弃项目。除非存在令人信服的减轻情节，CSLB认为适当的最低实际暂停期限是多少？

options.en: At least 60 days of actual suspension
options.cn: 至少60天的实际暂停

options.en: At least 5 days of actual suspension
options.cn: 至少5天的实际暂停

options.en: At least 10 days of actual suspension
options.cn: 至少10天的实际暂停

options.en: At least 30 days of actual suspension
options.cn: 至少30天的实际暂停

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7107 states that absent compelling mitigating circumstances, abandonment of a project is a serious offense that warrants an actual period of suspension of at least 30 days.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7107条规定，除非存在令人信服的减轻情节，放弃项目是一项严重违规行为，至少应处以30天的实际暂停。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7107 (Document p. 489, PDF p. 512)

question_en: A contractor placed on probation for misuse of funds is ordered to perform community service. What is the range of community service days CSLB may impose under Section 7108?
question_cn: 因资金滥用而被置于考察期的承包商，被命令执行社区服务。根据第7108条，CSLB可规定的社区服务天数范围是多少？

options.en: 5 to 30 days as determined by CSLB
options.cn: 由CSLB决定的5到30天

options.en: 5 to 21 days as determined by CSLB
options.cn: 由CSLB决定的5到21天

options.en: 10 to 30 days as determined by CSLB
options.cn: 由CSLB决定的10到30天

options.en: 1 to 10 days as determined by CSLB
options.cn: 由CSLB决定的1到10天

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7108 explicitly states community service shall be 5–21 days as determined by CSLB for misuse of funds violations.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7108条明确规定，对于资金滥用违规行为，社区服务应为由CSLB决定的5到21天。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7108 (Document p. 490, PDF p. 513)

question_en: Which CSLB violation carries a minimum penalty of revocation, stayed, with 3 years of probation — rather than a 60-day stayed suspension?
question_cn: 哪种 CSLB 违规行为的最低处罚是撤销执照但暂缓执行，并附带 3 年考察期——而不是 60 天暂缓暂停执照效力？

options.en: Failure to obtain building permits
options.cn: 未获得建筑许可

options.en: Failure to notify CSLB of address change
options.cn: 未通知 CSLB 地址变更

options.en: Failure to comply with a citation
options.cn: 未遵守罚单规定

options.en: Abandonment of a construction project
options.cn: 放弃建筑项目

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7107 establishes a minimum penalty of revocation, stayed, with 3 years probation for abandonment — a higher threshold than violations that carry only a 60-day stayed suspension.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 7107 条规定，对于放弃项目的行为，最低处罚是撤销执照但暂缓执行，并附带 3 年考察期——高于仅执行 60 天暂缓暂停执照效力的违规行为。
code_reference: B&P Code Sections 7107, 7108, 7112 (Document p. 489, PDF p. 512)

question_en: A contractor on probation for departure from accepted trade standards is ordered to submit a plan to CSLB. What must that plan address?
question_cn: 对因偏离公认的行业标准而处于考察期的承包商，要求向加州承包商执照委员会（CSLB）提交计划。该计划必须涉及什么内容？

options.en: A written safety program for all active jobsites
options.cn: 所有在建工地的书面安全计划

options.en: Procedures for obtaining required building permits
options.cn: 获取所需建筑许可的程序

options.en: Direct supervision and control by the qualifying individual
options.cn: 由资质个人进行的直接监督和控制

options.en: A list of all subcontractors used on projects
options.cn: 项目中使用的所有分包商名单

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7109(a) requires the contractor to submit to the Registrar a detailed plan setting forth the procedure for direct supervising and control by the qualifying individual.
explanation_cn: 《商业与专业法规》第7109(a)条要求承包商向注册主任提交一份详细计划，说明资质个人进行直接监督和控制的程序。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7109(a) (Document p. 491, PDF p. 514)

question_en: A contractor is disciplined under Section 7108 for diverting construction funds for personal use unrelated to construction work. What penalty does CSLB consider appropriate in this situation?
question_cn: 根据第7108条款，如果承包商将建筑资金挪用于与建筑工作无关的个人用途，将受到纪律处分。在这种情况下，CSLB认为什么处罚是适当的？

options.en: Revocation, stayed, with 1 year probation
options.cn: 吊销执照（缓期执行），附带一年考察期

options.en: Outright revocation of the contractor's license
options.cn: 直接吊销承包商执照

options.en: Revocation, stayed, with 3 years probation
options.cn: 吊销执照（缓期执行），附带三年考察期

options.en: 60-day suspension, stayed, with restitution required
options.cn: 暂停60天，附带返还款项要求

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7108 states that if diversion or misuse of funds is for personal use not related to construction work, outright revocation is appropriate.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7108条规定，如果资金被挪用或滥用用于与建筑工作无关的个人用途，则应直接吊销执照。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7108 (Document p. 490, PDF p. 513)

question_en: Under CSLB disciplinary guidelines, which offense uniquely requires the contractor to prohibit receipt of down payments as a probation condition?
question_cn: 根据加利福尼亚州承包商执照委员会（CSLB）的纪律指南，哪种违规行为特别要求承包商在考察期条件下禁止收取预付款？

options.en: Fraud and repeated acts despite corrections
options.cn: 诈骗和在纠正后仍重复违规行为

options.en: Departure from accepted trade standards
options.cn: 偏离公认的行业标准

options.en: Failure to comply with a citation
options.cn: 未遵守罚单规定

options.en: Abandonment of a project
options.cn: 放弃项目

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7090.5 lists 'Prohibit receipt of down payments' as a specific probation condition for fraud and repeated acts, as does Section 7113 for failure to complete at contract price.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 7090.5 条将“禁止收取预付款”列为对诈骗和重复违规行为的具体考察期条件，第 7113 条也将其作为未按合同价格完成工作的条件。
code_reference: B&P Code Sections 7090.5, 7113 (Document p. 488, PDF p. 511)

question_en: A contractor's license is disciplined under Section 7109(a) for substantial departure from trade standards. What actual suspension period does CSLB consider warranted in that circumstance?
question_cn: 根据第7109(a)条款，如果承包商的执照因严重偏离行业标准而受到纪律处分，CSLB在这种情况下认为实际暂停执照效力的期限是多少？

options.en: At least 5 days of actual suspension
options.cn: 至少5天的实际暂停执照效力

options.en: At least 60 days of actual suspension
options.cn: 至少60天的实际暂停执照效力

options.en: At least 15 days of actual suspension
options.cn: 至少15天的实际暂停执照效力

options.en: At least 30 days of actual suspension
options.cn: 至少30天的实际暂停执照效力

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7109(a) states that if the departure from trade standards is substantial, an actual suspension of at least 30 days is warranted.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7109(a)条规定，如果偏离行业标准的情况严重，则应至少实际暂停执照效力30天。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7109(a) (Document p. 491, PDF p. 514)

question_en: A contractor on probation for misrepresentation on a license application is required to perform community service. Under Section 7112, absent compelling circumstances, what additional penalty is also considered appropriate?
question_cn: 一名因在执照申请中提供虚假信息而被处于考察期的承包商，被要求执行社区服务。根据第7112条款，除非存在令人信服的特殊情况，还应考虑什么额外处罚？

options.en: Outright revocation without a stay
options.cn: 直接撤销执照且不予缓期

options.en: Prohibition from receiving any down payments
options.cn: 禁止收取任何预付款

options.en: Submission of copies of all building permits
options.cn: 提交所有建筑许可证的复印件

options.en: Completion of an accounting course at a college
options.cn: 在大学完成会计课程

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7112 states that absent compelling mitigating circumstances, misrepresentation is a serious offense that warrants outright revocation, along with at least 30 days of actual suspension.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7112条规定，除非存在令人信服的减轻情节，虚假陈述是一项严重违法行为，需直接撤销执照，并至少实际暂停执照效力30天。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7112 (Document p. 495, PDF p. 518)

question_en: A contractor disciplined for failure to complete a project for the contract price is placed on probation. Which probation condition is specific to this violation but NOT required for abandonment?
question_cn: 因未按合同价格完成项目而受到纪律处分的承包商将被置于考察期。哪一项考察期条件是针对此违规行为的，但对于遗弃项目并非必须？

options.en: Pass the CSLB law and business examination
options.cn: 通过 CSLB 法律与商业考试

options.en: Make full restitution to the project owner
options.cn: 向项目业主全额赔偿

options.en: Submit copies of construction contracts on demand
options.cn: 按要求提交建筑合同副本

options.en: Complete a construction cost estimating course
options.cn: 完成建筑成本估算课程

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7113 uniquely requires completion of an education course in estimating construction costs or a related construction science course — a condition not listed under Section 7107 for abandonment.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7113条明确要求完成建筑成本估算或相关建筑科学课程的教育课程——该条件在第7107条中针对遗弃项目未列出。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7113 (Document p. 496, PDF p. 519)

question_en: A contractor violates Safety Orders and is placed on probation under Section 7109.5. In addition to standard probation terms, which condition is unique to this violation?
question_cn: 承包商违反安全规定，并根据第7109.5条被置于考察期中。除了标准考察期条款外，哪一项条件是此违反行为特有的？

options.en: Submit building permits to the Registrar on demand
options.cn: 按要求向登记处提交建筑许可

options.en: Establish a safety program
options.cn: 建立安全计划

options.en: Make full restitution to the project owner
options.cn: 向项目业主全额赔偿

options.en: Complete an accounting and bookkeeping course
options.cn: 完成会计和簿记课程

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7109.5 specifically requires the contractor to establish a safety program as a probation condition — a requirement tied directly to the nature of the safety order violation.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7109.5条特别要求承包商将建立安全计划作为考察期条件——这一要求直接与安全规定的违反性质相关。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7109.5 (Document p. 493, PDF p. 516)

question_en: A contractor was disciplined by another state's licensing authority. When CSLB pursues disciplinary action under Section 7103, what is the minimum probation period if revocation is stayed?
question_cn: 一名承包商因其他州的许可机构而受到处分。当 CSLB 根据第 7103 条采取纪律处分时，如果撤销被暂缓，最低的考察期期是多少？

options.en: 5 years of probation
options.cn: 5 年考察期

options.en: 1 year of probation
options.cn: 1 年考察期

options.en: 3 years of probation
options.cn: 3 年考察期

options.en: 2 years of probation
options.cn: 2 年考察期

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7103 sets the minimum penalty at revocation, stayed, with 3 years of probation when CSLB disciplines a contractor based on disciplinary action taken by another state.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 7103 条规定，当 CSLB 基于其他州采取的纪律处分对承包商进行处分时，最低处罚为撤销，但考察期，并附带 3 年考察期期。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7103 (Document p. 489, PDF p. 512)

question_en: A contractor on probation for abandonment of a project must provide lien releases to project owners during the probation period. When must these releases be provided?
question_cn: 因项目弃工而被处于考察期的承包商必须在考察期内向项目业主提供留置权解除文件。这些解除文件应何时提供？

options.en: As soon as payment is received
options.cn: 一收到付款就提供

options.en: Within 30 days of project completion
options.cn: 项目完成后30天内提供

options.en: At the end of each calendar month
options.cn: 每个日历月末提供

options.en: Before receiving any progress payment
options.cn: 收到任何进度款前提供

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7107 requires that during the probation period, the contractor provide lien releases to project owners as soon as payment is received.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7107条要求，在考察期间，承包商应一收到付款就向项目业主提供留置权解除文件。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7107 (Document p. 490, PDF p. 513)

question_en: Under CSLB disciplinary guidelines, which violation has a minimum penalty of only a 60-day suspension, stayed, with 1 year probation — rather than revocation, stayed?
question_cn: 根据加利福尼亚州承包商许可委员会（CSLB）的纪律指导方针，哪种违规行为的最低处罚仅为暂停执照 60 天（缓行执行），同时附带 1 年考察期——而不是吊销执照，缓行执行？

options.en: Misuse of funds
options.cn: 资金滥用

options.en: Failure to pay subcontractors
options.cn: 未支付分包商费用

options.en: Departure from accepted trade standards
options.cn: 偏离公认的行业标准

options.en: Abandonment of a construction project
options.cn: 放弃建设项目

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7108.5 (Prime Contractors and Subcontractors; Payment Required) carries a minimum penalty of only 60 days suspension, stayed, with 1 year probation — unlike abandonment or misuse of funds.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7108.5条（总承包商和分包商；要求支付）只适用最低处罚为暂停执照 60 天（缓行执行），同时附带 1 年考察期——不同于放弃建设项目或资金滥用。
code_reference: B&P Code Sections 7108.5, 7107, 7109(a) (Document p. 491, PDF p. 514)

question_en: A contractor is disciplined for failing to preserve records under Section 7111. Which course is specifically required as a probation condition for this violation?
question_cn: 一名承包商因未能根据第7111条保存记录而受到纪律处分。作为对此违规行为的考察期条件，具体要求哪门课程？

options.en: Vocational course related to the contractor's trade
options.cn: 与承包商行业相关的职业课程

options.en: Course in construction cost estimating
options.cn: 建筑成本估算课程

options.en: Course in construction safety practices
options.cn: 建筑安全实践课程

options.en: Course in accounting, bookkeeping, or business management
options.cn: 会计、簿记或企业管理课程

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7111 specifically requires the contractor to take and pass a course in accounting, bookkeeping, and/or business management at an accredited community college — appropriate given the records-preservation nature of the violation.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7111条明确要求承包商在认可的社区学院学习并通过会计、簿记和/或企业管理课程——这与记录保存类违规行为的性质相适应。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7111 (Document p. 494, PDF p. 517)

question_en: A contractor is placed on probation under Section 7113.5 for failing to settle lawful obligations. What must the contractor submit to the Registrar on demand during probation?
question_cn: 根据第7113.5条款，由于未能履行合法义务，承包商被置于考察期。在考察期内，承包商必须在注册主任要求时提交什么？

options.en: A list of all subcontractors used on projects
options.cn: 所有项目中使用的分包商名单

options.en: Copies of all building permits obtained
options.cn: 获得的所有建筑许可证副本

options.en: Copies of all lien releases issued to owners
options.cn: 发给业主的所有留置权解除副本

options.en: A detailed supervision plan for the qualifying individual
options.cn: 合格个人的详细监督计划

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7113.5 requires the contractor to submit a list of all subcontractors used on construction projects to the Registrar upon demand during the probation period.
explanation_cn: 《商务与职业法典》第7113.5条要求承包商在考察期内，根据要求向注册主任提交所有建筑项目中使用的分包商名单。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7113.5 (Document p. 496, PDF p. 519)

question_en: A licensed contractor is found guilty of aiding and abetting an unlicensed person. What is the minimum penalty the CSLB may impose?
question_cn: 持牌承包商被判协助和教唆无证人员。CSLB可施加的最低处罚是什么？

options.en: Revocation, stayed, 3 years probation
options.cn: 吊销，但缓期执行，3年考察期

options.en: 5-day suspension, stayed, 1 year probation
options.cn: 暂停5天，但缓期执行，1年考察期

options.en: Revocation, stayed, 2 years probation
options.cn: 吊销，但缓期执行，2年考察期

options.en: 60-day suspension, stayed, 1 year probation
options.cn: 暂停60天，但缓期执行，1年考察期

explanation_en: Under B&P Code Section 7114, the minimum penalty for aiding and abetting an unlicensed person is revocation, stayed, with 2 years probation. The maximum penalty is outright revocation.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7114条，协助和教唆无证人员的最低处罚为吊销，但缓期执行，2年考察期。最高处罚为直接吊销。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7114 (Document p. 497, PDF p. 520)

question_en: A contractor is caught operating under a license name that no longer matches the company's actual personnel. Which of the following best describes the maximum penalty under Section 7117?
question_cn: 一位承包商被发现以不再与公司实际人员匹配的许可证名称操作。根据第7117条款，下列哪一项最能描述最高处罚？

options.en: 364-day suspension, 2 years probation
options.cn: 364天暂停执照效力，2年考察期

options.en: Outright revocation of the license
options.cn: 许可证直接吊销

options.en: 60-day suspension, stayed, 1 year probation
options.cn: 60天暂停执照效力，缓期执行，1年考察期

options.en: Revocation, stayed, 2 years probation
options.cn: 吊销，缓期执行，2年考察期

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7117 uniquely caps the maximum penalty at a 364-day suspension combined with 2 years probation -- it does not expose the contractor to outright revocation, unlike most other disciplinary sections.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7117条独特地将最高处罚限制为364天暂停执照效力加2年考察期——与大多数其他纪律条款不同，它不会让承包商面临直接吊销的风险。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7117 (Document p. 498, PDF p. 521)

question_en: A contractor is placed on probation after being disciplined under Section 7117.6 for contracting out of classification. Which reporting obligation is uniquely required during the probation period?
question_cn: 根据第7117.6条规定，由于违规承包超出自身资质，一名承包商在接受处分后被置于考察期。在考察期间，哪些报告义务是独有要求的？

options.en: Submit copies of all construction contracts on demand
options.cn: 根据要求提交所有建设合同的副本

options.en: Submit a list of all material suppliers used
options.cn: 提交所有使用的材料供应商名单

options.en: Provide lien releases to owners upon each payment
options.cn: 每次付款时向业主提供留置权解除文件

options.en: Submit a list of all subcontractors used on projects
options.cn: 提交项目中使用的所有分包商名单

explanation_en: Under B&P Code Section 7117.6, a contractor on probation for contracting out of classification must submit copies of construction contracts to the Registrar upon demand, and must also submit copies of all advertisements prior to their display or publication.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7117.6条，对于因超出资质承包而被置于考察期的承包商，必须根据要求向注册主任提交建设合同副本，并且在广告展示或发布之前，还必须提交所有广告的副本。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7117.6 (Document p. 499, PDF p. 522)

question_en: Under CSLB disciplinary guidelines, which violation carries the longest minimum suspension period before a contractor can operate again?
question_cn: 根据CSLB的纪律指南，哪种违规行为在承包商可以再次营业之前带来的最低停业期最长？

options.en: Conviction of a crime related to contractor functions
options.cn: 与承包商职能相关的犯罪定罪

options.en: Certifying false experience on a license application
options.cn: 在执照申请中证明虚假的经验

options.en: Overpricing following an emergency or disaster
options.cn: 在紧急情况或灾难后哄抬价格

options.en: Willful or fraudulent act causing substantial injury
options.cn: 故意或欺诈行为导致重大伤害

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7123.5 (Penal Code Section 396) mandates an actual suspension of 6 months as a minimum when a contractor violates anti-price-gouging laws after a disaster -- the longest mandatory actual suspension in the disciplinary schedule.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7123.5条（《刑法》第396条）规定，当承包商在灾难后违反反哄抬物价法时，实际停业至少为6个月——这是纪律处罚中最长的强制实际停业期。
