code_reference: B&P Code Section 7123.5 (Document p. 503, PDF p. 526)

question_en: A contractor on probation for failure to pay money under Section 7120 receives a new progress payment from a client. Which probation condition applies specifically to this type of violation?
question_cn: 根据第7120条款因未付款而处于考察期期的承包商，从客户那里收到新的进度款。哪一项考察期条件专门适用于这种类型的违规行为？

options.en: Submit copies of all construction contracts on demand
options.cn: 应要求提交所有建筑合同的副本

options.en: Submit a list of persons employed on projects
options.cn: 提交项目中雇用人员的名单

options.en: Perform community service for 5 to 21 days
options.cn: 从事5至21天的社区服务

options.en: Provide lien releases upon receipt of each payment
options.cn: 收到每笔付款时提供留置权解除证明

explanation_en: Section 7120 uniquely requires that a contractor on probation for failure to pay money must provide lien releases to project owners on all future construction projects upon receipt of payments -- protecting owners from future unpaid supplier or subcontractor claims.
explanation_cn: 第7120条款明确规定，对于因未付款而处于考察期期的承包商，必须在收到付款时向项目业主提供所有未来建筑项目的留置权解除证明——以保护业主免受未来供应商或分包商未付款索赔的影响。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7120 (Document p. 502, PDF p. 525)

question_en: Which of the following offenses does NOT expose a contractor to outright revocation as the maximum penalty?
question_cn: 以下哪项违规行为不会使承包商面临作为最高处罚的直接吊销？

options.en: Certifying to false experience on an application
options.cn: 在申请中证明虚假经验

options.en: Aiding and abetting an unlicensed person
options.cn: 协助和教唆无执照人员

options.en: Variance from license as to name or personnel
options.cn: 在执照名称或人员方面存在差异

options.en: Contracting with an inactive or expired license
options.cn: 与非活跃或过期执照签约

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7117 is unique in that its maximum penalty is a 364-day suspension with 2 years probation -- not revocation. Most other disciplinary sections allow for outright revocation as the maximum.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7117条的独特之处在于，其最高处罚是暂停364天并附带2年考察期，而不是吊销执照。大多数其他纪律条款允许将直接吊销作为最高处罚。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7117 (Document p. 498, PDF p. 521)

question_en: A contractor is disciplined for conducting an asbestos inspection while having an undisclosed financial relationship with the remediation company. Under Section 7118.4, what actual suspension is warranted absent compelling mitigating circumstances?
question_cn: 一名承包商因在与修复公司存在未披露的财务关系的情况下进行石棉检查而受到处分。根据第7118.4条款，在没有令人信服的减轻情节下，应实施多少实际暂停执照效力？

options.en: At least 45 days actual suspension
options.cn: 至少45天实际暂停执照效力

options.en: At least 30 days actual suspension
options.cn: 至少30天实际暂停执照效力

options.en: At least 5 days actual suspension
options.cn: 至少5天实际暂停执照效力

options.en: At least 60 days actual suspension
options.cn: 至少60天实际暂停执照效力

explanation_en: Under B&P Code Section 7118.4, conducting an asbestos inspection while maintaining an undisclosed financial relationship with a corrective-work entity warrants an actual suspension of 60 days absent compelling mitigating circumstances.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7118.4条款，在与纠正工作实体保持未披露的财务关系的情况下进行石棉检查，在没有令人信服的减轻情节下，应处以60天实际暂停执照效力。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7118.4 (Document p. 500, PDF p. 523)

question_en: A contractor convicted of a crime related to contractor functions is placed on probation instead of having their license revoked outright. What is the minimum probation period the CSLB must impose?
question_cn: 与承包商职能相关的犯罪被判有罪的承包商，如果没有被直接吊销执照，而是被处以考察期，CSLB必须施加的最低考察期期限是多少？

options.en: 1 year probation
options.cn: 考察期1年

options.en: 2 years probation
options.cn: 考察期2年

options.en: 4 years probation
options.cn: 考察期4年

options.en: 3 years probation
options.cn: 考察期3年

explanation_en: Under B&P Code Section 7123, conviction of a crime related to contractor functions carries a minimum penalty of revocation, stayed, with 3 years probation -- the same tier as willful fraud and certifying false experience.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7123条，与承包商职能相关的犯罪定罪，其最低处罚为吊销执照，但缓期执行，并附3年考察期——与故意欺诈和证明虚假经验的处罚等级相同。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7123 (Document p. 503, PDF p. 526)

question_en: A contractor on probation for filing a false workers' compensation exemption report under Section 7125(b) is subject to a special reporting requirement. What must be submitted to the Registrar upon demand?
question_cn: 根据第7125(b)条款，如果一名承包商因提交虚假的工人赔偿豁免报告而处于考察期期间，则需遵守特别报告要求。应向注册主任提交什么？

options.en: A list of all subcontractors used on projects
options.cn: 项目中使用的所有分包商名单

options.en: A list of all persons employed on construction projects
options.cn: 建筑项目中雇用的所有人员名单

options.en: Copies of all construction contracts entered into
options.cn: 所签订的所有建筑合同副本

options.en: A list of all material suppliers used on projects
options.cn: 项目中使用的所有材料供应商名单

explanation_en: Under B&P Code Section 7125(b), a contractor on probation for filing false workers' compensation exemption reports must submit a list of all persons employed on construction-related projects to the Registrar upon demand -- directly tied to the nature of the underlying offense.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7125(b)条款，对于因提交虚假的工人赔偿豁免报告而处于考察期的承包商，必须应要求向注册主任提交建筑相关项目中所有雇用人员的名单——这直接与基础违法行为的性质相关。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7125(b) (Document p. 504, PDF p. 527)

question_en: A contractor faces discipline for committing a willful and fraudulent act. Under Section 7116, when is an actual suspension of at least 60 days warranted?
question_cn: 承包商因故意和欺诈行为而面临纪律处分。根据第7116条，何时才应实施至少60天的实际暂停执照效力？

options.en: Only when financial harm to the consumer is proven
options.cn: 只有在证明对消费者造成经济损失时

options.en: Absent compelling circumstances, in all fraud cases
options.cn: 除非有特别情况，否则在所有欺诈案件中

options.en: Only when the contractor fails to make restitution
options.cn: 只有在承包商未进行赔偿时

options.en: Only when the contractor has a prior disciplinary record
options.cn: 只有在承包商有先前的纪律记录时

explanation_en: Under B&P Code Section 7116, absent compelling circumstances, fraud warrants an actual suspension of at least 60 days. If the injury is substantial, outright revocation is appropriate. The burden is on the contractor to show compelling circumstances to avoid the suspension.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7116条，除非有特别情况，欺诈行为应实施至少60天的实际暂停执照效力。如果伤害严重，则应直接吊销执照。承包商有责任证明存在特别情况以避免暂停执照效力。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7116 (Document p. 498, PDF p. 521)

question_en: A contractor employs a home improvement salesperson who is not registered with the CSLB. What is the minimum penalty the contractor faces under Section 7154?
question_cn: 承包商雇用了一名未在CSLB注册的家装销售员。根据第7154条，该承包商面临的最低处罚是什么？

options.en: 60-day suspension, stayed, 1 year probation
options.cn: 暂停执照60天（缓期执行），并接受一年考察期

options.en: Revocation, stayed, 3 years probation
options.cn: 吊销执照（缓期执行），并接受三年考察期

options.en: 5-day suspension, stayed, 1 year probation
options.cn: 暂停执照5天（缓期执行），并接受一年考察期

options.en: Revocation, stayed, 2 years probation
options.cn: 吊销执照（缓期执行），并接受两年考察期

explanation_en: Under B&P Code Section 7154, the minimum penalty for employing a nonregistered home improvement salesperson is a 60-day suspension, stayed, with 1 year probation. The maximum is revocation.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7154条，雇用未注册家装销售员的最低处罚为暂停执照60天（缓期执行），并接受一年考察期；最高处罚为吊销执照。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7154 (Document p. 504, PDF p. 527)

question_en: A contractor on probation for home improvement inducement violations under Section 7157 wants to run a new advertising campaign. What must happen before the ads are published?
question_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7157条因家庭装修诱导违规而处于考察期的承包商，想要开展新的广告活动。在广告发布之前必须做什么？

options.en: Notify the local building department before advertising
options.cn: 在广告前通知当地建筑部门

options.en: Get written approval from the project owner
options.cn: 获取项目所有者的书面批准

options.en: Submit ad copies to the Registrar before publication
options.cn: 在发布前向注册主任提交广告副本

options.en: Submit ad copies to the Registrar after publication
options.cn: 在发布后向注册主任提交广告副本

explanation_en: Under B&P Code Section 7157, a contractor on probation for home improvement inducement violations must submit copies of all advertisements relating to the contracting business to the Registrar prior to their being displayed or published during the probation period.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7157条，因家庭装修诱导违规而处于考察期的承包商必须在考察期内，将所有与承包业务有关的广告副本提交给注册主任，在广告展示或发布之前。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7157 (Document p. 506, PDF p. 529)

question_en: Under CSLB disciplinary guidelines, which group of offenses shares a minimum penalty of revocation, stayed, with 3 years probation?
question_cn: 根据加州承包商执照委员会（CSLB）的纪律指南，哪一组违规行为的最低处罚为吊销执照，但暂缓执行，并附带3年考察期？

options.en: Aiding unlicensed persons, contracting out of classification
options.cn: 协助无证人员、超出执照分类承包

options.en: Contracting with inactive license, employing unregistered salesperson
options.cn: 在执照停用期间承包、雇用未注册的销售人员

options.en: Failure to pay money, lack of reasonable diligence
options.cn: 未付款、缺乏合理勤勉

options.en: False experience, willful fraud, criminal conviction
options.cn: 虚假经验、故意欺诈、刑事定罪

explanation_en: B&P Code Sections 7114.1 (certifying false experience), 7116 (willful or fraudulent act), and 7123 (conviction of a crime) all share the same minimum penalty tier: revocation, stayed, with 3 years probation -- reflecting the CSLB's most serious disciplinary category short of outright revocation.
explanation_cn: 《加州商务与职业法典》第7114.1条（认证虚假经验）、7116条（故意或欺诈行为）和7123条（犯罪定罪）都属于相同的最低处罚等级：吊销执照但暂缓执行，并附带3年考察期——反映了CSLB除彻底吊销外最严重的纪律类别。
code_reference: B&P Code Sections 7114.1, 7116, 7123 (Document p. 497, PDF p. 520)

question_en: A contractor on probation for contracting with an unlicensed subcontractor is required to take community service. What is the allowable range of community service days under Section 7118?
question_cn: 因与无牌分包商签约而处于考察期的承包商，必须进行社区服务。根据第7118条款，社区服务允许的天数范围是多少？

options.en: 10 to 30 days of community service
options.cn: 10到30天的社区服务

options.en: 14 to 60 days of community service
options.cn: 14到60天的社区服务

options.en: 5 to 21 days of community service
options.cn: 5到21天的社区服务

options.en: 1 to 10 days of community service
options.cn: 1到10天的社区服务

explanation_en: Under B&P Code Section 7118, community service as determined by CSLB ranges from 5 to 21 days. This same range appears consistently across multiple CSLB disciplinary sections when community service is a probation condition.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7118条款，由CSLB确定的社区服务范围为5到21天。当社区服务作为考察期条件时，这一范围在多个CSLB纪律条款中始终一致。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7118 (Document p. 499, PDF p. 522)

question_en: A contractor's CSLB law and business examination was completed 6 years ago. The contractor is now being placed on probation for a violation. Must the contractor retake the CSLB law and business examination as a probation condition?
question_cn: 一名承包商的CSLB法律与商业考试已于6年前完成。该承包商因违规行为现被置于考察期期。作为考察期条件，承包商是否必须重新参加CSLB法律与商业考试？

options.en: Yes, because 6 years falls outside the 5-year lookback window
options.cn: 是的，因为6年已超出5年的回顾期

options.en: No, because the exam is only required once per license
options.cn: 不是，因为每个执照只需考试一次

options.en: Yes, the exam must always be retaken regardless of timing
options.cn: 是的，无论时间如何，考试都必须重新参加

options.en: No, because 4 years is close enough to the 5-year limit
options.cn: 不是，因为4年已接近5年限制

explanation_en: Under multiple CSLB disciplinary sections (e.g., Sections 7114, 7116, 7118), the probation condition requires taking and passing the law and business examination 'if not taken within the past 5 years.' Since 6 years ago is outside that window, the contractor must retake it.
explanation_cn: 根据多个CSLB纪律条款（如第7114、7116、7118条），考察期条件要求“如果在过去5年内未参加”，则必须参加并通过法律与商业考试。由于6年前已超出该期限，因此该承包商必须重新参加考试。
code_reference: B&P Code Sections 7114, 7116, 7118 (Document p. 497, PDF p. 520)

question_en: A contractor is found guilty of misrepresentation and false advertising under B&P Code Section 7161. What is the minimum penalty the CSLB may impose?
question_cn: 根据加利福尼亚商业和专业法典第7161条，一名承包商因虚假陈述和虚假广告被判有罪。CSLB可能施加的最低处罚是什么？

options.en: Revocation, stayed, 3 years probation
options.cn: 吊销，缓期，3年考察期

options.en: Revocation, stayed, 2 years probation
options.cn: 吊销，缓期，2年考察期

options.en: 60-day suspension, stayed, 1 year probation
options.cn: 60天停工，缓期，1年考察期

options.en: 5-day suspension, stayed, 1 year probation
options.cn: 5天停工，缓期，1年考察期

explanation_en: Section 7161 sets the minimum penalty for misrepresentation and false or deceptive advertising at revocation, stayed, with 3 years of probation -- reflecting how seriously CSLB treats consumer deception offenses.
explanation_cn: 第7161条规定，针对虚假陈述和虚假或误导性广告的最低处罚为吊销，缓期，附3年考察期 —— 反映了CSLB对消费者欺诈行为的严重态度。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7161; CSLB Rules and Regulations (Document p. 508, PDF p. 531)

question_en: A contractor on probation for using a false certificate receives a citation ordering correction within a specified timeframe. Midway through, extreme weather makes completion impossible. What must the contractor do to avoid a probation violation?
question_cn: 一名因使用虚假证书而处于考察期的承包商收到整改通知，要求在规定时间内完成。期间，极端天气使完成工作变得不可能。为了避免违反考察期规定，承包商必须做什么？

options.en: Notify the owner and resume work when weather clears
options.cn: 通知业主并在天气好转后恢复施工

options.en: Document the weather delay and file after the deadline
options.cn: 记录天气延误并在截止日期后提交

options.en: Submit a written extension request before the deadline expires
options.cn: 在截止日期之前提交书面延期请求

options.en: Hire another licensee to complete the correction immediately
options.cn: 立即聘请另一持证人员完成整改

explanation_en: Under Regulation 883, the contractor must submit a written request for extension of time prior to expiration of the correction period. Even if good cause exists, failure to request before the deadline still constitutes a violation.
explanation_cn: 根据第883条规定，承包商必须在整改期限到期前提交书面延长期限请求。即使有正当理由，如果未在截止日期前提出请求，仍构成违规。
code_reference: B&P Code Sections 7099 and 7099.1; CSLB Regulation 883 (Document p. 516, PDF p. 539)

question_en: A contractor is cited for a trademark misrepresentation violation under B&P Code Section 7162. During probation, CSLB is LEAST likely to impose which of the following conditions?
question_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7162条的规定，一名承包商因商标虚假陈述而被引用违规。在考察期期间，加州承包商州立委员会最不可能施加以下哪项条件？

options.en: Submit advertisements to the Registrar before publication
options.cn: 在发布前向注册主任提交广告

options.en: Submit construction contracts to the Registrar on demand
options.cn: 按要求向注册主任提交施工合同

options.en: Prohibition on receiving down payments
options.cn: 禁止收取定金

options.en: Community service for 5 to 21 days
options.cn: 社区服务 5 至 21 天

explanation_en: Community service (5-21 days) is NOT listed as a probation condition under Section 7162 -- it appears for violations under Sections 7161, 7183.5, and 7189, but not trademark/brand name misrepresentation.
explanation_cn: 社区服务（5-21天）未被列为第7162条下的考察期条件——它适用于第7161、7183.5和7189条的违规行为，但不适用于商标/品牌名称虚假陈述。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7162; CSLB Rules and Regulations (Document p. 508, PDF p. 531)

question_en: A contractor violates probation but has an outstanding restitution order. What authority does the Registrar have regarding that restitution?
question_cn: 承包商违反考察期但尚有未履行的赔偿令。注册主任在该赔偿事项上拥有什么权力？

options.en: Grant an automatic extension for restitution compliance
options.cn: 自动延长赔偿遵守期限

options.en: Impose the stayed order only after a formal hearing
options.cn: 仅在正式听证后执行已暂停的命令

options.en: Impose the stayed disciplinary order without a hearing
options.cn: 无需听证即可执行已暂停的纪律处分命令

options.en: Refer the restitution matter to civil court only
options.cn: 仅将赔偿事项提交民事法院处理

explanation_en: The standard terms and conditions state that if a decision contains a restitution order and the contractor fails to comply, the Registrar may impose the stayed disciplinary order without giving the respondent an opportunity to be heard.
explanation_cn: 标准条款和条件规定，如果决定中包含赔偿命令且承包商未遵守，注册主任可以在不给予当事人陈述机会的情况下执行已暂停的纪律处分命令。
code_reference: B&P Code Sections 7099 and 7099.1; CSLB Standard Terms and Conditions (Document p. 512, PDF p. 535)

question_en: A cited contractor wants to comply with a correction order by hiring a different licensed contractor to do the repair work. Which statement correctly describes the cited contractor's legal position after the repair is completed?
question_cn: 被引用的承包商希望通过雇佣另一位有执照的承包商来执行修复工作，以遵守修正命令。修复完成后，下列哪一项正确描述了被引用承包商的法律地位？

options.en: The cited contractor remains responsible for full compliance
options.cn: 被引用的承包商仍然对全面遵守负责

options.en: Liability transfers entirely to the correcting licensee
options.cn: 责任完全转移给纠正的执照持有人

options.en: CSLB must approve the replacement contractor in advance
options.cn: CSLB 必须事先批准替换承包商

options.en: The cited contractor is fully released from all responsibility
options.cn: 被引用的承包商完全解除所有责任

explanation_en: Regulation 881 allows a cited licensee to pay another licensee to perform corrective work, but states clearly that the cited contractor 'remains responsible for any failure to fully comply with the order of correction.'
explanation_cn: 881 条规定允许被引用的执照持有人支付另一名执照持有人执行纠正工作，但明确指出，被引用的承包商“仍然对未能完全遵守修正命令负责。”
code_reference: B&P Code Sections 7099 and 7099.1; CSLB Regulation 881 (Document p. 516, PDF p. 539)

question_en: A contractor is placed on probation for a home improvement contract violation under B&P Code Section 7159. During probation, injuries to a third party were involved in the original offense. What suspension condition is warranted?
question_cn: 根据《商业和专业法典》第7159条的规定，如果承包商因家庭装修合同违规而被置于考察期期。在考察期期间，原始违法行为涉及第三方伤害。应该实施什么样的停业条件？

options.en: Actual suspension of at least 30 days
options.cn: 实际停业至少30天

options.en: Actual suspension of at least 5 days
options.cn: 实际停业至少5天

options.en: No actual suspension if probation is imposed
options.cn: 如果实施考察期，则无需实际停业

options.en: Outright revocation without probation
options.cn: 直接吊销执照且不考察期

explanation_en: Under Section 7159's penalty guidelines, if any injuries are involved in the home improvement contract violation, an actual suspension of at least 30 days is warranted -- a more severe consequence tied directly to personal injury.
explanation_cn: 根据第7159条的处罚指南，如果家庭装修合同违规涉及任何伤害，则应实际停业至少30天——这是与人身伤害直接相关的更严重处罚。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7159; CSLB Rules and Regulations (Document p. 507, PDF p. 530)

question_en: Under CSLB regulations, what factor is NOT listed as a criterion for determining whether an order of correction is appropriate to include in a citation?
question_cn: 根据加州承包商州许可委员会（CSLB）的规定，以下哪一因素未被列为确定纠正命令是否适合包含在罚单中的标准？

options.en: Whether the licensee has competence to perform the correction
options.cn: 持证人是否有能力执行纠正

options.en: Whether the contractor has sufficient financial resources
options.cn: 承包商是否有足够的财务资源

options.en: Whether the owner is willing to allow correction
options.cn: 业主是否愿意允许纠正

options.en: Whether correction would destroy acceptable existing construction
options.cn: 纠正是否会破坏可接受的现有建筑

explanation_en: Financial resources of the contractor are not listed in Regulation 880. The listed criteria are: whether correction would waste existing work, whether the owner consents, and whether the licensee has the competence or ability to correct.
explanation_cn: 承包商的财务资源未列入条例880中。列出的标准是：纠正是否会浪费现有工作，业主是否同意，以及持证人是否具备纠正的能力或资格。
code_reference: B&P Code Sections 7099 and 7099.1; CSLB Regulation 880 (Document p. 515, PDF p. 538)

question_en: An asbestos consultant who holds a financial interest in an asbestos contractor's company is found in violation of B&P Code Section 7189. What is the minimum penalty the CSLB may impose?
question_cn: 一名对石棉承包商公司拥有财务利益的石棉顾问被发现违反了《加州商业与职业法典》第7189条。CSLB可施加的最低处罚是什么？

options.en: Revocation, stayed, 3 years probation
options.cn: 吊销，暂缓执行，考察期3年

options.en: 60-day suspension, stayed, 1 year probation
options.cn: 暂停60天，暂缓执行，考察期1年

options.en: Revocation, stayed, 2 years probation
options.cn: 吊销，暂缓执行，考察期2年

options.en: 5-day suspension, stayed, 1 year probation
options.cn: 暂停5天，暂缓执行，考察期1年

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7189 sets the minimum penalty for asbestos certification conflicts of interest at a 60-day suspension, stayed, with 1 year of probation -- the same minimum tier used for home improvement and pool contract violations.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7189条规定，对于石棉认证利益冲突的最低处罚为暂停60天，暂缓执行，并附一年考察期——与家居装修和游泳池合同违规使用的最低层级相同。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7189; CSLB Rules and Regulations (Document p. 510, PDF p. 533)

question_en: A contractor on probation for obtaining an asbestos certification under false pretenses requests that CSLB consider the absence of compelling mitigating circumstances in their case. Under Section 7183.5, what outcome is most likely?
question_cn: 一名因以虚假理由获取石棉认证而处于考察期的承包商请求 CSLB 考虑其案件中缺乏令人信服的减轻情节。根据第 7183.5 条，最可能的结果是什么？

options.en: A 30-day actual suspension with probation
options.cn: 实际暂停 30 天并附带考察期

options.en: An outright revocation without probation
options.cn: 直接吊销，不附带考察期

options.en: A stayed revocation with 3 years probation only
options.cn: 吊销执照（缓期执行），仅附带 3 年考察期

options.en: A 60-day stayed suspension with 1 year probation
options.cn: 暂缓暂停 60 天并附带 1 年考察期

explanation_en: Section 7183.5 states that absent compelling mitigating circumstances, obtaining an asbestos certification under false pretenses 'warrants an outright revocation' -- meaning no stayed order or probation, just immediate license revocation.
explanation_cn: 第 7183.5 条规定，若缺乏令人信服的减轻情节，以虚假理由获取石棉认证“应当直接吊销”——意味着没有暂缓令或考察期，只进行立即吊销执照。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7183.5; CSLB Rules and Regulations (Document p. 510, PDF p. 533)

question_en: Under standard CSLB probation terms, what happens when a contractor successfully completes the full probation period?
question_cn: 根据标准的CSLB考察期条款，当承包商成功完成整个考察期期时会发生什么？

options.en: The contractor must reapply for a new license
options.cn: 承包商必须重新申请新执照

options.en: The contractor's license is fully restored
options.cn: 承包商的执照将被完全恢复

options.en: The license is reinstated with conditions attached
options.cn: 执照在附加条件下恢复

options.en: The Registrar reviews the record before deciding reinstatement
options.cn: 注册主任在决定恢复执照之前会审核记录

explanation_en: Standard Term 3 of CSLB's probation conditions states: 'Upon successful completion of probation, the contractor's license will be fully restored.' No additional action is needed after all probation requirements are met.
explanation_cn: CSLB考察期条件的标准条款3规定：‘在成功完成考察期后，承包商的执照将被完全恢复。’在满足所有考察期要求后无需采取额外措施。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7099; CSLB Standard Terms and Conditions of Probation (Document p. 511, PDF p. 534)

question_en: A contractor is cited for 'all other violations' under the general CSLB penalty schedule. Which probation condition applies that does NOT appear in the specific violation categories like Section 7159 or 7161?
question_cn: 承包商因在一般 CSLB 处罚表下的“所有其他违规行为”而受到引用。哪一项考察期条件适用，但未出现在像第 7159 条或第 7161 条等具体违规类别中？

options.en: Pay CSLB investigation and enforcement costs
options.cn: 支付 CSLB 调查和执法费用

options.en: Take and pass the CSLB law and business examination
options.cn: 参加并通过 CSLB 法律与商业考试

options.en: Take and pass the CSLB trade examination
options.cn: 参加并通过 CSLB 行业考试

options.en: Submit construction contracts to the Registrar on demand
options.cn: 按要求向注册主任提交施工合同

explanation_en: Taking and passing the CSLB trade examination (if not taken within 5 years) and completing a vocational course related to the trade are conditions listed only under 'all other violations' -- they do not appear in specific violation categories like Sections 7159, 7161, or 7162.
explanation_cn: 参加并通过 CSLB 行业考试（如果在五年内未参加）并完成与行业相关的职业课程是仅在“所有其他违规行为”下列出的条件——它们未出现在像第 7159 条、第 7161 条或第 7162 条等具体违规类别中。
code_reference: B&P Code Sections 7099 and 7099.1; CSLB Rules and Regulations (Document p. 511, PDF p. 534)

question_en: A contractor on probation receives a request from the CSLB Regional Deputy to appear for an interview. Under standard probation terms, which persons must appear?
question_cn: 正在考察期期的承包商收到CSLB地区副职的要求，前去面谈。根据标准考察期条款，哪些人必须出席？

options.en: The respondent and any personnel of record
options.cn: 被告及任何备案人员

options.en: The respondent only, not other company personnel
options.cn: 仅被告，其他公司人员不包括在内

options.en: Any employee named in the original complaint
options.cn: 原投诉中提到的任何员工

options.en: The qualifying individual only
options.cn: 仅有资格的个人

explanation_en: Standard Term 2 states that 'respondent and any of respondent's personnel of record shall appear in person for interviews with the Regional Deputy or designee upon request and reasonable notice.'
explanation_cn: 标准条款2规定：“被告及被告的任何备案人员应在收到合理通知后，应地区副职或其指定人员的要求亲自参加面谈。”
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7099; CSLB Standard Terms and Conditions of Probation (Document p. 511, PDF p. 534)

question_en: A contractor receives a citation from the CSLB. How many working days does the contractor have to appeal the citation to the Registrar?
question_cn: 承包商收到 CSLB 的罚单。承包商有多少工作日可以向注册主任上诉该罚单？

options.en: Within 20 working days of receipt
options.cn: 自收到之日起 20 个工作日内

options.en: Within 10 working days of receipt
options.cn: 自收到之日起 10 个工作日内

options.en: Within 30 calendar days of receipt
options.cn: 自收到之日起 30 个日历日内

options.en: Within 15 working days of receipt
options.cn: 自收到之日起 15 个工作日内

explanation_en: Section 885 states that any person served with a citation may contest it by appealing to the Registrar within 15 working days from receipt. The period may be extended for good cause at the Registrar's discretion.
explanation_cn: 第 885 条规定，任何收到罚单的人可以在自收到之日起 15 个工作日内向注册主任提出上诉。若有正当理由，经注册主任酌情决定，可延长该期限。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7099.3; CSLB Regulation Section 885 (Document p. 519, PDF p. 542)

question_en: A contractor is cited for multiple violations on a single construction project. What is the maximum total civil penalty that can be assessed in that citation under the general rule?
question_cn: 承包商因单个建筑项目的多项违规行为被开具罚单。根据一般规定，该罚单可以评估的最高总民事罚款是多少？

options.en: $10,000 per citation issued
$8,000 per citation issued
options.cn: 每张罚单 $8,000

options.en: $15,000 per citation issued
$30,000 per citation issued

explanation_en: Section 884(c) states that where a citation lists more than one violation relating to the same construction project, the total penalty shall not exceed $8,000, except for specific enumerated sections carrying higher caps.
explanation_cn: 第884(c)条规定，如果一张罚单列出了与同一建筑项目相关的多项违规行为，总罚款不得超过 $8,000，特定列举条款除外，这些条款有更高的上限。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7099; CSLB Regulation Section 884(c) (Document p. 519, PDF p. 542)

question_en: Which of the following violations carries the highest possible maximum civil penalty under CSLB regulations?
question_cn: 以下哪种违规行为根据CSLB法规具有最高的可能民事罚款？

options.en: Violation of B&P Code Section 7110
options.cn: 违反《加州商业与职业法典》第7110条

options.en: Violation of B&P Code Section 7028.7
options.cn: 违反《加州商业与职业法典》第7028.7条

options.en: Violation of B&P Code Section 7028
options.cn: 违反《加州商业与职业法典》第7028条

options.en: Violation of B&P Code Section 7118.4
options.cn: 违反《加州商业与职业法典》第7118.4条

explanation_en: Section 884 lists Section 7110 with a maximum civil penalty of $30,000 -- the highest ceiling in the penalty table, shared with Sections 7114, 7118, and 7125.4.
explanation_cn: 第884条列出了第7110条，其最高民事罚款为30,000美元——这是罚款表中最高的上限，与第7114条、第7118条和第7125.4条共享。
code_reference: B&P Code Sections 7110, 7114, 7118, 7125.4; CSLB Regulation Section 884 (Document p. 518, PDF p. 541)

question_en: A contractor cited for multiple violations on the same project is found to have violated Section 7028.7. What is the maximum total civil penalty for that citation?
question_cn: 在同一项目中因多项违规而被处罚的承包商被发现违反了第7028.7条款。该罚单的最高总民事罚款是多少？

options.en: $30,000, same as Section 7110
$10,000, double the standard cap
options.cn: $10,000，为标准上限的两倍

options.en: $15,000, the Section 7028.7 exception cap
$8,000, the standard multi-violation cap
options.cn: $8,000，标准多项违规上限

explanation_en: Section 884(c) expressly states that violations of Section 7028.7 are an exception to the general $8,000 multi-violation cap, allowing a total penalty assessment up to $15,000 per citation.
explanation_cn: 第884(c)条明确规定，第7028.7条的违规属于一般$8,000多项违规上限的例外，每个罚单最高可处$15,000的总罚款。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7028.7; CSLB Regulation Section 884(c) (Document p. 519, PDF p. 542)

question_en: When the Registrar determines the amount of a civil penalty, which of the following circumstances would NOT be among the factors considered?
question_cn: 当注册员确定民事罚款金额时，下列哪种情况不会被考虑在内？

options.en: The contractor's current license classification
options.cn: 承包商当前的执照类别

options.en: The cited person has a history of similar violations
options.cn: 被引用的人有类似违规行为的历史

options.en: The violation involved a senior citizen or disabled person
options.cn: 违规行为涉及老年人或残疾人

options.en: The violation involved a natural disaster repair project
options.cn: 违规行为涉及自然灾害修复项目

explanation_en: Section 884(b) lists multiple aggravating factors -- prior violations, bad faith, harm, vulnerable victims, and natural disaster context -- but the contractor's license classification is not among them.
explanation_cn: 第884(b)条列出了多项加重因素——先前的违规行为、恶意、造成伤害、弱势受害者以及自然灾害背景——但承包商的执照类别不在其中。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7099; CSLB Regulation Section 884(b) (Document p. 519, PDF p. 542)

question_en: A contractor's citation lists three separate violations, each stated with its own penalty amount. Under CSLB regulations, how must the penalty be presented in the citation?
question_cn: 承包商的通知列出了三项独立的违规行为，每项违规都有各自的罚款金额。根据 CSLB 的规定，罚款在通知中必须如何呈现？

options.en: As a single combined total penalty amount
options.cn: 作为一个合并的总罚款金额

options.en: As the highest single violation penalty only
options.cn: 只列出最高的单项违规罚款

options.en: Stated separately for each section violated
options.cn: 分别注明每个违规部分的罚款

options.en: As an average of all violations cited
options.cn: 作为所有列出违规的平均罚款

explanation_en: Section 884(d) explicitly requires that where a citation lists more than one violation, the amount of assessed civil penalty shall be stated separately for each section violated.
explanation_cn: 第 884(d) 条明确要求，当通知列出多个违规行为时，应分别列出每个违规部分的民事罚款金额。
code_reference: CSLB Regulation Section 884(d) (Document p. 519, PDF p. 542)

question_en: An unlicensed person falsely claims to hold a contractor's license, collects payment, and fails to perform the work. Under Section 887, which of the following actions would the Registrar consider when evaluating the gravity of the violation?
question_cn: 一名无执照的人虚假宣称持有承包商执照，收取付款但未履行工作。根据第887条，注册主任在评估违规行为的严重性时，会考虑以下哪些行为？

options.en: Whether false documents were used to induce a contract
options.cn: 是否使用虚假文件诱使签订合同

options.en: Whether the person held a license in a different state
options.cn: 此人是否在其他州持有执照

options.en: Whether the person had a valid business license
options.cn: 此人是否拥有有效的营业执照

options.en: The number of subcontractors the person hired
options.cn: 此人雇用的分包商数量

explanation_en: Section 887(3) explicitly lists 'executed or used any false or misleading documents in order to induce a person to enter into a contract or to pay money' as a gravity factor the Registrar must consider.
explanation_cn: 第887(3)条明确列出“为诱使他人签订合同或支付款项而执行或使用任何虚假或误导性文件”为注册主任必须考虑的严重性因素。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7028.7; CSLB Regulation Section 887 (Document p. 520, PDF p. 543)

question_en: A contractor disputes the period of time allowed for correction stated in a CSLB citation. Which of the following best describes what the contractor can do?
question_cn: 承包商对CSLB通知中规定的整改时间期限提出异议。以下哪项最能描述承包商可以采取的做法？

options.en: Request a hearing before an administrative law judge
options.cn: 请求在行政法法官面前举行听证会

options.en: Dispute only the penalty amount, not the timeline
options.cn: 只对处罚金额提出异议，而不对时间表提出异议

options.en: Appeal the correction period to the Registrar
options.cn: 将整改期限上诉至注册主任

options.en: File a civil lawsuit against the CSLB immediately
options.cn: 立即对CSLB提起民事诉讼

explanation_en: Section 885(3) specifically identifies 'the period of time allowed for correction' as a contestable aspect of a citation. The appeal is directed to the Registrar within 15 working days of receipt.
explanation_cn: 第885(3)条明确指出，“允许的整改时间期限”是可对通知提出异议的方面。上诉应在收到通知后的15个工作日内提交给注册主任。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7099.3; CSLB Regulation Section 885 (Document p. 519, PDF p. 542)

question_en: To qualify as a CSLB arbitrator under the experience-as-an-attorney pathway, a candidate must have at least five years of legal experience handling a minimum of how many construction-related matters?
question_cn: 要通过律师经验途径成为 CSLB 仲裁员，候选人必须具有至少五年的法律经验，并处理至少多少建设相关事务？

options.en: A minimum of 12 construction matters
options.cn: 最少 12 个建设事务

options.en: A minimum of 5 construction matters
options.cn: 最少 5 个建设事务

options.en: A minimum of 10 construction matters
options.cn: 最少 10 个建设事务

options.en: A minimum of 8 construction matters
options.cn: 最少 8 个建设事务

explanation_en: Section 890(a)(2) requires that attorneys, judges, or administrative law judges must have handled a minimum of 8 construction-related matters during their qualifying five-year period.
explanation_cn: 第 890(a)(2) 条规定，律师、法官或行政法官在其资格认定的五年期间必须处理至少 8 个建设相关事务。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7085.5; CSLB Regulation Section 890(a)(2) (Document p. 521, PDF p. 544)

question_en: How often must a qualified CSLB arbitrator complete continuing education on construction arbitration to maintain their qualification?
question_cn: 合格的 CSLB 仲裁员必须多久完成一次建筑仲裁继续教育以保持其资格？

options.en: 8 hours every 5 years
options.cn: 每 5 年 8 小时

options.en: 16 hours every 5 years
options.cn: 每 5 年 16 小时

options.en: 8 hours every 3 years
options.cn: 每 3 年 8 小时

options.en: 8 hours every 2 years
options.cn: 每 2 年 8 小时

explanation_en: Section 890(c) requires completion of 8 hours of continuing education on construction arbitration every 5 years, covering topics including those described in subsection (b).
explanation_cn: 第 890(c) 节要求每 5 年完成 8 小时关于建筑仲裁的继续教育，涵盖包括小节 (b) 描述的主题在内的内容。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7085.5; CSLB Regulation Section 890(c) (Document p. 521, PDF p. 544)

question_en: A CSLB arbitrator candidate completed a construction arbitration training course six years ago. Which qualification requirement does this create a problem with?
question_cn: 一名CSLB仲裁员候选人在六年前完成了建筑仲裁培训课程。这会与哪个资格要求产生问题？

options.en: The 8-hour continuing education renewal requirement
options.cn: 8小时的继续教育更新要求

options.en: The board-specific arbitration training requirement
options.cn: 董事会特定的仲裁培训要求

options.en: The minimum construction industry experience requirement
options.cn: 最低建筑行业经验要求

options.en: The initial arbitrator's training course currency rule
options.cn: 初始仲裁员培训课程有效性规则

explanation_en: Section 890(b) requires completion of an arbitrator's course on construction arbitration 'within the last 5 years.' A course completed six years ago falls outside this window and must be repeated.
explanation_cn: 第890(b)条要求在“过去5年内”完成建筑仲裁仲裁员课程。六年前完成的课程超出了此时间范围，必须重新完成。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7085.5; CSLB Regulation Section 890(b) (Document p. 521, PDF p. 544)

question_en: A contractor cited for a violation of B&P Code Section 7118.4 faces which minimum civil penalty under CSLB regulations?
question_cn: 根据CSLB法规，被指违反《加州商业与职业法典》第7118.4条的承包商面临的最低民事罚款是多少？

options.en: $500 minimum civil penalty
options.cn: $500最低民事罚款

options.en: $1,000 minimum civil penalty
options.cn: $1,000最低民事罚款

options.en: $3,000 minimum civil penalty
options.cn: $3,000最低民事罚款

options.en: $100 minimum civil penalty
options.cn: $100最低民事罚款

explanation_en: The penalty table in Section 884(a) shows that Section 7118.4 carries a minimum civil penalty of $3,000 -- the highest mandatory floor in the entire penalty schedule.
explanation_cn: 第884(a)条的罚款表显示，第7118.4条的最低民事罚款为$3,000——是整个罚款表中最高的强制起点。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7118.4; CSLB Regulation Section 884(a) (Document p. 518, PDF p. 541)

question_en: A senior citizen homeowner is victimized by a contractor who performs shoddy disaster-repair work and was previously cited for similar violations. How does CSLB treat these overlapping aggravating factors when assessing a civil penalty?
question_cn: 一位老年房主成为一名承包商的受害者，该承包商进行了粗制滥造的灾后修复工作，并且此前因类似违规行为受到过处罚。CSLB在评估民事罚款时如何处理这些重叠的加重因素？

options.en: The penalty is automatically set at the maximum
options.cn: 罚款会自动设定为最高额度

options.en: Only the most severe single factor is considered
options.cn: 只考虑最严重的单一因素

options.en: Factors beyond the first are automatically ignored
options.cn: 超过第一个的因素会被自动忽略

options.en: Each applicable factor informs the penalty amount
options.cn: 每个适用因素都会影响罚款金额

explanation_en: Section 884(b) instructs the Registrar to consider whether 'one or more' of the listed circumstances apply. Multiple factors -- prior history, senior victim, natural disaster context -- can all be weighed together to justify a higher penalty within the statutory range.
explanation_cn: 第884(b)条指示注册处考虑列出的情形中是否适用“一个或多个”。多重因素——既往历史、老年受害者、自然灾害背景——都可以被综合考虑，以在法定范围内决定更高的罚款。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7099; CSLB Regulation Section 884(b) (Document p. 519, PDF p. 542)

question_en: Under CSLB regulations, how is a citation properly served on a contractor?
question_cn: 根据CSLB规定，如何正确向承包商送达传票？

options.en: By certified mail with return receipt only
options.cn: 仅通过挂号信并附回执

options.en: By email notification to the contractor's license address
options.cn: 通过电子邮件通知承包商的执照地址

options.en: By personal delivery to the contractor's jobsite
options.cn: 亲自送达至承包商的工地

options.en: Per Government Code 11505(c), plus regular mail copy
options.cn: 根据《政府法典》第11505(c)条，再加上普通邮件的副本

explanation_en: Section 886 requires service in accordance with Government Code Section 11505(c) and further specifies that a copy of the citation be sent by regular mail.
explanation_cn: 第886条要求按照《政府法典》第11505(c)条进行送达，并进一步规定应通过普通邮件发送传票副本。
code_reference: Government Code Section 11505(c); CSLB Regulation Section 886 (Document p. 520, PDF p. 543)

question_en: A contractor is cited under Section 7028 (unlicensed contracting) and also under Section 7110 on the same project. What is the maximum total civil penalty for this combined citation?
question_cn: 一名承包商因同一项目同时违反《第7028条》（无执照承包）和《第7110条》而被处罚。对此合并处罚的最高民事罚款是多少？

options.en: $38,000, the sum of both penalty ceilings
options.cn: 38,000美元，两项罚款上限的总和

options.en: $8,000, the general multi-violation cap
options.cn: 8,000美元，一般多重违规上限

options.en: $16,000, combining both sections' maximums
options.cn: 16,000美元，合并两条款的最高限额

options.en: $30,000, the Section 7110 exception cap
options.cn: 30,000美元，第7110条例外上限

explanation_en: Section 884(c) states that when the citation includes violations of Section 7110 (among others), the total penalty for the same-project citation shall not exceed $30,000 -- the elevated exception ceiling.
explanation_cn: 《第884(c)条》规定，当处罚通知包括《第7110条》（以及其他条款）的违规时，同一项目的总罚款不得超过30,000美元——即提升的例外上限。
code_reference: B&P Code Sections 7028, 7110; CSLB Regulation Section 884(c) (Document p. 519, PDF p. 542)

question_en: A home improvement contractor installs solar panels and does not actively solicit homeowners to sign assessment contracts. Under California law, this contractor is best classified as which of the following?
question_cn: 一位家庭装修承包商安装太阳能面板，并且不会主动向房主推销签署评估合同。根据加利福尼亚州法律，该承包商最适合归类为以下哪一种？

options.en: A PACE solicitor agent required to register separately
options.cn: 需要单独注册的PACE推销代理

options.en: Neither a PACE solicitor nor a PACE solicitor agent
options.cn: 既不是PACE推销员也不是PACE推销代理

options.en: A program administrator subject to licensure
options.cn: 需要获得许可的项目管理员

options.en: A PACE solicitor required to obtain written authorization
options.cn: 需要获得书面授权的PACE推销员

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22017(c)(2) expressly excludes a home improvement contractor or subcontractor who does not solicit property owners to enter assessment contracts from the definitions of PACE solicitor and PACE solicitor agent.
explanation_cn: 《金融法典》第22017(c)(2)条明确将未向业主推销签署评估合同的家庭装修承包商或分包商排除在PACE推销员和PACE推销代理的定义之外。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22017

question_en: A property listed at $900,000 is subject to a PACE program that finances improvements on residential property with four or fewer units. The program administrator also finances improvements on properties valued above $1,000,000. Under California law, is this program administrator subject to the California Financing Law?
question_cn: 一处标价为 900,000 美元的房产属于 PACE 计划，该计划为四个或更少单元的住宅房产的改进提供融资。该计划管理者也为超过 1,000,000 美元的房产提供改进融资。根据加利福尼亚州法律，该计划管理者是否受加利福尼亚融资法的约束？

options.en: No, because the property value is below one million dollars
options.cn: 不，因为房产价值低于一百万美元

options.en: Yes, only if the administrator is also a licensed broker
options.cn: 是的，只有管理员同时是持牌经纪人时才适用

options.en: No, because the administrator serves commercial properties too
options.cn: 不，因为管理员也为商业房产提供服务

options.en: Yes, because only one exemption condition must be unmet
options.cn: 是的，因为只需不满足一个豁免条件

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22018(b) states that the exemption applies only when a person meets both listed conditions. Because this administrator does finance residential property with four or fewer units, it fails to meet condition one, making it subject to the California Financing Law regardless of whether it meets condition two.
explanation_cn: 《金融法》第 22018(b) 条规定，只有在某人同时满足列出的两个条件时，豁免才适用。由于该管理员确实为四个或更少单元的住宅房产提供融资，因此未满足第一个条件，使其无论是否满足第二个条件，都受到加利福尼亚融资法的约束。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22018

question_en: A contractor who participates in a PACE program begins providing information about prospective PACE applicants to a program administrator. The information was gathered while the contractor was advertising PACE financing. Is this contractor acting as a PACE solicitor?
question_cn: 参与PACE计划的承包商开始向项目管理员提供潜在PACE申请人的信息。这些信息是在承包商宣传PACE融资期间收集的。该承包商是在担任PACE推销员吗？

options.en: Yes, because the information was gathered through advertising
options.cn: 是的，因为信息是通过广告收集的

options.en: No, because only program administrators must register
options.cn: 不是，因为只有项目管理员必须注册

options.en: No, because sharing applicant information is always a clerical act
options.cn: 不是，因为共享申请人信息总是文书工作

options.en: Yes, but only if the contractor received compensation for referrals
options.cn: 是的，但仅当承包商因推荐获得报酬时

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22017(c)(5) exempts persons who provide prospective applicant information to a program administrator only if that information was not obtained in connection with advertising or soliciting. Because this contractor gathered the information while advertising PACE, the exemption does not apply, making the contractor a PACE solicitor.
explanation_cn: 《金融法典》第22017(c)(5)条款豁免了那些向项目管理员提供潜在申请人信息的人，但前提是这些信息不是通过广告或推销获得的。由于该承包商是在宣传PACE时收集信息，因此该豁免不适用，使得该承包商成为PACE推销员。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22017

question_en: Under the California Financing Law, which entity is expressly excluded from the definition of 'program administrator'?
question_cn: 根据加利福尼亚融资法，哪一实体明确不包括在“项目管理员”的定义中？

options.en: A licensed contractor performing PACE-financed installations
options.cn: 执行 PACE 资助安装的持牌承包商

options.en: A public agency overseeing the PACE program
options.cn: 监督 PACE 计划的公共机构

options.en: A joint powers authority that sponsors a PACE program
options.cn: 推动 PACE 计划的联合权力机构

options.en: A finance lender licensed under the California Financing Law
options.cn: 根据加利福尼亚融资法获得许可的金融贷款人

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22018(a) expressly states that 'program administrator' does not include a public agency. A public agency may establish or participate in a PACE program but is not treated as the program administrator.
explanation_cn: 《金融法典》第22018(a)条明确规定，“项目管理员”不包括公共机构。公共机构可以建立或参与 PACE 计划，但不被视为项目管理员。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22018

question_en: A licensed program administrator fails to pay its annual assessment. After the commissioner issues a summary suspension order, within how many days must the licensee file a written request for a hearing to potentially have the order rescinded?
question_cn: 持牌项目管理者未支付其年度评估费用。在专员发布简易停牌命令后，持证人必须在多少天内提交书面听证请求，以可能撤销该命令？

options.en: Within 10 days of the order
options.cn: 命令发布后10天内

options.en: Within 90 days of the order
options.cn: 命令发布后90天内

options.en: Within 30 days of the order
options.cn: 命令发布后30天内

options.en: Within 60 days of the order
options.cn: 命令发布后60天内

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22107(d) states that if a request for a hearing is filed in writing within 30 days of the suspension order, and a hearing is not held within 60 days thereafter, the order is deemed rescinded.
explanation_cn: 《金融法》第22107(d)条规定，如果在停牌命令发布后30天内提交书面听证请求，并且之后60天内未举行听证，该命令视为被撤销。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22107

question_en: During a summary suspension of its certificate for nonpayment of the annual assessment, what may a program administrator licensee do regarding its PACE-related business activities?
question_cn: 在由于未支付年度评估而对其证书进行临时停牌期间，项目管理员许可持有人可以在其与PACE相关的业务活动中做什么？

options.en: Complete existing PACE contracts but accept no new ones
options.cn: 完成现有的PACE合同，但不接受新的合同

options.en: Continue business if all outstanding assessments are paid
options.cn: 如果支付了所有未付评估，则继续经营

options.en: Continue normal operations until the hearing is concluded
options.cn: 在听证会结束前继续正常运营

options.en: Only conduct business permitted by a commissioner order
options.cn: 仅开展专员命令允许的业务

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22107(d) specifies that during any period of revocation or suspension, the licensee shall not conduct business under this division except as may be permitted by order of the commissioner.
explanation_cn: 《金融法典》第22107(d)条规定，在任何吊销或停牌期间，持牌人不得根据本分部开展业务，除非专员的命令允许。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22107

question_en: A PACE program administrator wants to open a new office location and begin doing business there immediately. When must the branch office license application be submitted to the commissioner?
question_cn: PACE 项目管理员想要开设一个新的办事处并立即在该地点开始营业。分支机构许可证申请必须在什么时候提交给专员？

options.en: On the same day business begins at the new location
options.cn: 在新地点开始营业的同一天

options.en: At least 90 days before opening the new location
options.cn: 至少在新地点开业前 90 天

options.en: At least 30 days before opening the new location
options.cn: 至少在新地点开业前 30 天

options.en: At least 10 days before opening the new location
options.cn: 至少在新地点开业前 10 天

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22102(a) requires a licensee to submit a branch office application at least 10 days before engaging in business at a new location. The licensee may then begin operating 10 days after submission.
explanation_cn: 《金融法典》第 22102(a) 条要求持证人在新地点从事业务前至少 10 天提交分支机构申请。持证人可以在提交申请 10 天后开始营业。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22102

question_en: A program administrator applicant fails to respond to a written notice of a deficiency in its license application. After how many days from that notice is the application deemed withdrawn?
question_cn: 如果项目管理员申请人在收到其执照申请缺陷的书面通知后未作出回应，该申请在收到通知后多少天被视为自动撤回？

options.en: After 120 days from the deficiency notice
options.cn: 收到缺陷通知后120天

options.en: After 60 days from the deficiency notice
options.cn: 收到缺陷通知后60天

options.en: After 30 days from the deficiency notice
options.cn: 收到缺陷通知后30天

options.en: After 90 days from the deficiency notice
options.cn: 收到缺陷通知后90天

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22109(b) states that an application shall be considered withdrawn if the applicant fails to respond to a written notification of a deficiency within 90 days of the date of the notification.
explanation_cn: 《金融法典》第22109(b)条规定，如果申请人在收到缺陷书面通知后的90天内未作出回应，该申请应被视为撤回。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22109

question_en: The commissioner receives a complete program administrator license application with all required fees. Within how many days must the commissioner either issue a license or file a statement of issues?
question_cn: 委员收到包含所有所需费用的完整项目管理员许可证申请。委员会必须在多少天内颁发许可证或提交问题说明书？

options.en: Within 60 days of the complete application
options.cn: 在收到完整申请后的60天内

options.en: Within 30 days of the complete application
options.cn: 在收到完整申请后的30天内

options.en: Within 10 days of the complete application
options.cn: 在收到完整申请后的10天内

options.en: Within 90 days of the complete application
options.cn: 在收到完整申请后的90天内

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22109(c) requires the commissioner to either issue a license or file a statement of issues within 60 days from the filing of a full and complete application with the required fees.
explanation_cn: 《金融法典》第22109(c)条要求委员会必须在提交完整申请及所需费用后的60天内颁发许可证或提交问题说明书。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22109

question_en: A person who owns 15% of a PACE program administrator applicant was convicted of fraud eight years ago. On what grounds may the commissioner deny the license application?
question_cn: 一名拥有PACE项目管理申请人15%股份的人八年前因诈骗被定罪。专员可以以什么理由拒绝该许可证申请？

options.en: No grounds exist because the person is not an officer
options.cn: 没有理由，因为此人不是管理人员

options.en: Grounds exist only if the conviction was a felony, not a misdemeanor
options.cn: 只有在定罪是重罪而非轻罪时才有理由

options.en: Grounds exist because the crime involves dishonesty within 10 years
options.cn: 有理由，因为该犯罪涉及在过去10年内的不诚实行为

options.en: No grounds exist because the conviction is over five years old
options.cn: 没有理由，因为定罪已超过五年

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22109(a)(2) authorizes denial if a person owning 10 percent or more of the applicant was convicted of a crime involving dishonesty, fraud, or deceit within the last 10 years that is substantially related to the duties of a licensee under this division.
explanation_cn: 《金融法典》第22109(a)(2)条授权，如果拥有申请人10%或更多股份的人在过去10年内因涉及不诚实、欺诈或欺骗的犯罪被定罪，并且该犯罪与本部门下持证人的职责有实质关系，则可以拒绝其申请。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22109

question_en: A finance lender applies for a PACE-related license and does not currently hold any license under California's Financing Law. What must the applicant submit along with the application?
question_cn: 一位金融贷款人申请与PACE相关的许可，并且目前未持有加利福尼亚州《融资法》下的任何许可。申请人必须随申请提交哪些材料？

options.en: A surety bond and proof of errors and omissions insurance
options.cn: 保证金及差错与疏忽保险证明

options.en: A notarized statement from all majority shareholders
options.cn: 所有主要股东的公证声明

options.en: A list of all pending construction contracts with homeowners
options.cn: 与业主所有待定施工合同的清单

options.en: A full set of fingerprints and related criminal history information
options.cn: 一整套指纹及相关犯罪记录信息

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22101(b) states that an applicant who does not currently hold a license under this division must furnish a full set of fingerprints and related information for a criminal history record check with their application.
explanation_cn: 《金融法》第22101(b)条规定，未持有本章许可的申请人必须在申请时提供一整套指纹及相关信息以进行犯罪记录检查。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22101

question_en: A program administrator licensee's certificate is suspended for nonpayment of the annual assessment. Which statement best describes the impact on the PACE activities of mortgage loan originators employed by that administrator?
question_cn: 由于未支付年度评估金，项目管理员持证人的执照被暂停。哪一项最能描述这种情况对该管理员雇用的按揭贷款发起人的PACE活动的影响？

options.en: Originators may continue working independently under their own licenses
options.cn: 发起人可以在自己的执照下继续独立工作

options.en: Originators may only complete transactions already in escrow
options.cn: 发起人只能完成已经在托管中的交易

options.en: Originators are unaffected because their licenses are separate
options.cn: 发起人不受影响，因为他们的执照是单独的

options.en: Originators also cannot conduct business unless the commissioner permits it
options.cn: 除非专员允许，否则发起人也不能开展业务

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22107(d) provides that during any period of suspension, both the licensee and any mortgage loan originator licensee employed by the finance lender or broker shall not conduct business pursuant to this division except as may be permitted by order of the commissioner.
explanation_cn: 《金融法典》第22107(d)条规定，在任何暂停期间，持证人以及由金融贷款人或经纪人雇用的任何按揭贷款发起人持证人不得根据本部分开展业务，除非专员命令允许。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22107

question_en: A contractor wants to enroll as a PACE solicitor but has an active license suspension from the CSLB. What is the result of the enrollment application?
question_cn: 一名承包商希望注册成为 PACE 推销员，但其 CSLB 许可证处于有效的停牌状态。注册申请的结果是什么？

options.en: Enrollment must be denied; only good-standing licensees may enroll
options.cn: 必须拒绝注册；只有信誉良好的持证人才能注册

options.en: Enrollment may proceed if a home improvement salesperson supervises the work
options.cn: 如果由家装销售人员监督工作，注册可以继续

options.en: Enrollment is approved pending reinstatement of the license within 90 days
options.cn: 注册在许可证在 90 天内恢复有效后才被批准

options.en: Enrollment is permitted with additional bonding requirements
options.cn: 注册允许，但需额外的担保要求

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22680(d)(1) requires that a PACE solicitor maintain a CSLB license in good standing. A suspended license is not in good standing, so the program administrator must deny enrollment.
explanation_cn: 《财政法典》第 22680(d)(1) 条要求 PACE 推销员保持 CSLB 许可证的良好信誉。停牌的许可证不属于信誉良好，因此项目管理员必须拒绝注册。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22680

question_en: After a PACE solicitor agent completes the enrollment process, within what time period must the agent complete the required six hours of program administrator training?
question_cn: 在PACE招揽代理完成注册流程后，该代理必须在多长时间内完成要求的六小时项目管理员培训？

options.en: Within 30 days of completing enrollment
options.cn: 在完成注册后30天内

options.en: Within three months of completing enrollment
options.cn: 在完成注册后三个月内

options.en: Within six months of completing enrollment
options.cn: 在完成注册后六个月内

options.en: Within 12 months of completing enrollment
options.cn: 在完成注册后12个月内

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22681(c) requires each PACE solicitor agent to complete six hours of education provided by the program administrator within three months of completing the enrollment process.
explanation_cn: 《财政法》第22681(c)条要求每位PACE招揽代理在完成注册流程后三个月内完成由项目管理员提供的六小时教育。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22681

question_en: A program administrator discovers that an enrolled PACE solicitor has a clear pattern of consumer complaints about dishonesty. What action is required?
question_cn: 一位项目管理员发现一名注册的PACE推销员存在关于不诚实行为的消费者投诉的明显模式。需要采取什么措施？

options.en: Refer the complaints to CSLB for investigation only
options.cn: 仅将投诉提交给加州建筑承包商委员会(CSLB)调查

options.en: Cancel the solicitor's enrollment and notify the commissioner
options.cn: 取消推销员的注册并通知专员

options.en: Suspend new contracts but allow existing contracts to close
options.cn: 暂停新合同但允许现有合同完成

options.en: Issue the solicitor a written warning before taking further action
options.cn: 在采取进一步措施之前向推销员发出书面警告

explanation_en: Financial Code Sections 22680(e)(1) and 22680(g) together require the administrator to cancel enrollment of a solicitor with a clear pattern of consumer complaints about dishonesty, and Section 22682(b) requires timely notification to the commissioner of each enrollment cancellation.
explanation_cn: 《金融法典》第22680条(e)(1)和22680条(g)共同要求管理员取消存在明显不诚实消费者投诉模式的推销员的注册，第22682条(b)要求及时通知专员每次注册取消的情况。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22680

question_en: A PACE solicitor offers a homeowner an assessment contract that omits a disclosure required by the Streets and Highways Code. What is the consequence for the program administrator who authorized that solicitor?
question_cn: PACE 代办为房主提供评估合同时，省略了《街道与公路法典》所要求的披露内容。授权该代办的项目管理员会有什么后果？

options.en: The homeowner's contract is automatically voided by the omission
options.cn: 因省略而房主的合同自动作废

options.en: Only the solicitor is penalized, not the program administrator
options.cn: 只有代办受到惩罚，项目管理员不受影响

options.en: The violation is also treated as the program administrator's violation
options.cn: 该违规行为也被视为项目管理员的违规行为

options.en: The violation is treated as an administrative notice only
options.cn: 该违规行为仅被视为行政通知

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22689(b) and (c) establish that a violation by a PACE solicitor authorized by a program administrator, in connection with that program administrator's activity, is treated as a violation by the program administrator and subjects them to the commissioner's enforcement authority.
explanation_cn: 《金融法典》第22689(b)和(c)条规定，经项目管理员授权的PACE代办在与该项目管理员的活动相关时发生的违规行为，将被视为项目管理员的违规行为，并使其受到专员的执法权责。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22689

question_en: After the commissioner issues an order against a PACE solicitor for unsafe or injurious conduct, when does that order become effective?
question_cn: 在专员对PACE推销员的不安全或有害行为发出命令后，该命令何时生效？

options.en: The order takes effect immediately upon its issuance
options.cn: 命令在发布时立即生效

options.en: After a hearing is completed under the Administrative Procedure Act
options.cn: 在根据《行政程序法》完成听证后

options.en: After 30 days if the solicitor files no hearing request
options.cn: 如果推销员没有提交听证请求，则在30天后生效

options.en: Once the commissioner's written findings are published publicly
options.cn: 一旦专员的书面调查结果公开发布

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22690(c)(2)(B)(i) provides that if an order addresses unsafe or injurious behavior by a PACE solicitor or PACE solicitor agent, the order shall be effective immediately.
explanation_cn: 《金融法典》第22690(c)(2)(B)(i)条规定，如果命令涉及PACE推销员或PACE推销员代理人的不安全或有害行为，该命令应立即生效。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22690

question_en: A PACE solicitor receives notice of the commissioner's intention to issue a suspension order. How many days does the solicitor have to request a hearing under the Administrative Procedure Act?
question_cn: PACE 律师收到关于专员打算发布暂停令的通知。根据《行政程序法》，律师有多少天时间可以请求举行听证会？

options.en: Within 5 business days of the notice of intention
options.cn: 自意向通知起5个工作日内

options.en: Within 10 calendar days of the notice of intention
options.cn: 自意向通知起10个日历日内

options.en: Within 30 days of receiving the notice of intention
options.cn: 自收到意向通知起30日内

options.en: Within 15 days of the notice of intention
options.cn: 自意向通知起15日内

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22690(c)(2)(C)(i) provides that within 15 days from the date of a notice of intention to issue a suspension or bar order, the person may request a hearing under the Administrative Procedure Act.
explanation_cn: 《金融法》第22690(c)(2)(C)(i)条规定，自收到发布暂停或禁止令意向通知之日起15日内，当事人可以根据《行政程序法》请求举行听证会。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22690

question_en: Upon receiving a notice of intention to issue a suspension order, what immediate restriction applies to the PACE solicitor even before any hearing takes place?
question_cn: 在收到意图发布暂停令的通知后，即使在任何听证会举行之前，对PACE推销员适用的即时限制是什么？

options.en: The solicitor's existing assessment contracts are automatically canceled
options.cn: 推销员现有的评估合同将自动取消

options.en: The solicitor is immediately prohibited from soliciting property owners
options.cn: 推销员立即被禁止向房产所有者推销

options.en: The solicitor is prohibited from all business activities in California
options.cn: 推销员被禁止在加利福尼亚从事所有商业活动

options.en: The solicitor must surrender their contractor's license immediately
options.cn: 推销员必须立即交出其承包商执照

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22690(c)(2)(C)(iv) states that upon receipt of a notice of intention to issue an order, the person is immediately prohibited from directly or indirectly soliciting a property owner to enter into an assessment contract, even before a hearing.
explanation_cn: 《金融法典》第22690(c)(2)(C)(iv)条规定，在收到意图发布命令的通知时，该人即被禁止直接或间接向房产所有者推销签订评估合同，即使在听证会之前也是如此。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22690

question_en: After the commissioner surrenders, suspends, or revokes a PACE program administrator's license, which of the following best describes the commissioner's investigation authority?
question_cn: 在专员交回、暂停或吊销PACE项目管理员的执照后，以下哪项最能描述专员的调查权限？

options.en: The commissioner may only review records from the prior 30 days
options.cn: 专员只能审查过去30天的记录

options.en: The commissioner's investigation authority continues regardless of license status
options.cn: 无论执照状态如何，专员的调查权限仍然有效

options.en: Investigation authority ends when the license is formally surrendered
options.cn: 当执照正式交回时，调查权限终止

options.en: Only a court order can authorize post-revocation investigations
options.cn: 只有法院命令才能授权撤销后的调查

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22704 provides that the commissioner's power of investigation and examination is not terminated by the surrender, suspension, or revocation of any license, preserving full enforcement authority after licensing actions.
explanation_cn: 《金融法》第22704条规定，专员的调查和检查权力不会因任何执照的交回、暂停或吊销而终止，在执照处理后保持完全的执法权力。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22704

question_en: A contractor who is also enrolled as a PACE solicitor is investigated by another state for conduct related to PACE financing activities. Can the California commissioner use that out-of-state action as grounds for discipline?
question_cn: 一位同时注册为PACE推销员的承包商因与PACE融资活动相关的行为在另一个州受到调查。加州专员能否以该州的行动为依据进行纪律处分？

options.en: Yes, but only if the other state's action resulted in a criminal conviction
options.cn: 可以，但仅在该州的行动导致刑事定罪的情况下

options.en: Yes, if the conduct is substantially related to regulated activity
options.cn: 可以，如果该行为与受监管活动有实质性关系

options.en: No, out-of-state actions have no bearing on California licensure
options.cn: 不可以，州外行动对加州执照没有影响

options.en: No, only California state courts can trigger disciplinary proceedings
options.cn: 不可以，只有加州州法院才能触发纪律程序

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22705.1(a) provides that disciplinary action taken by another state for an action substantially related to the activity regulated under California's division may be grounds for disciplinary action by the California commissioner.
explanation_cn: 《金融法典》第22705.1(a)条规定，另一个州对与加州法规下受监管活动实质相关的行为采取的纪律处分，可作为加州专员进行纪律处分的依据。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22705.1

question_en: A PACE program administrator is found to have repeatedly approved assessment contracts without evaluating the property owner's ability to meet annual PACE obligations. What consequence does the law authorize?
question_cn: 如果发现 PACE 计划管理员多次在未评估物业所有者履行年度 PACE 义务能力的情况下批准评估合同，法律授权的后果是什么？

options.en: An automatic $2,500 fine for each contract approved
options.cn: 每批准一份合同自动罚款 2,500 美元

options.en: A written warning with a 90-day correction period
options.cn: 书面警告，并有 90 天整改期

options.en: A 30-day suspension pending investigation only
options.cn: 仅在调查期间暂停 30 天

options.en: Suspension or revocation of the program administrator's license
options.cn: 暂停或吊销计划管理员的执照

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22714(a)(5) expressly lists repeated failure to consider a property owner's ability to meet PACE obligations as a ground for the commissioner to suspend or revoke the administrator's license.
explanation_cn: 《金融法典》第 22714(a)(5) 条明确列出了重复未考虑物业所有者履行 PACE 义务能力作为专员暂停或吊销管理员执照的理由。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22714

question_en: If a PACE contractor surrenders their license after completing a project but before consumer complaints are resolved, what effect does surrender have on liability for prior acts?
question_cn: 如果PACE承包商在完成项目后但在消费者投诉解决之前放弃其执照，这种放弃对之前行为的责任有什么影响？

options.en: Surrender does not affect civil or criminal liability for prior acts
options.cn: 放弃不会影响之前行为的民事或刑事责任

options.en: Surrender eliminates all pending civil and criminal liability immediately
options.cn: 放弃会立即消除所有未决的民事和刑事责任

options.en: Surrender stays any ongoing investigation by the commissioner
options.cn: 放弃会暂停专员正在进行的任何调查

options.en: Surrender voids preexisting PACE assessment contracts on the property
options.cn: 放弃会作废该物业上已有的PACE评估合同

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22711 expressly provides that surrender of a license does not affect the licensee's civil or criminal liability for acts committed prior to surrender.
explanation_cn: 《金融法》第22711条明确规定，放弃执照不影响执照持有人在放弃前所实施行为的民事或刑事责任。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22711

question_en: A contractor changes its business address but does not notify the IRS. Which form should have been filed to avoid compliance issues?
question_cn: 一家承包商更改了其营业地址，但未通知美国国税局（IRS）。应提交哪种表格以避免合规问题？

options.en: Form 8822-B mailed to the IRS
options.cn: Form 8822-B 邮寄给 IRS

options.en: Form SS-4 to update the EIN record
options.cn: Form SS-4 更新 EIN 记录

options.en: Form W-9 sent to affected payees
options.cn: Form W-9 发送给受影响的收款人

options.en: Form 941 with a change notation attached
options.cn: Form 941 附加更改说明

explanation_en: Pub. 15 states that to notify the IRS of a business address or responsible party change, the employer must complete and mail Form 8822-B.
explanation_cn: 《Pub. 15》规定，要通知 IRS 营业地址或负责人变更，雇主必须填写并邮寄 Form 8822-B。
code_reference: Pub. 15, Change of Business Address or Responsible Party; Form 8822-B (Document p. 9, PDF p. 9)

question_en: A contractor acquires another company and wants to use the prior owner's EIN on employment tax returns. What is the consequence of doing so?
question_cn: 一名承包商收购了另一家公司，并希望在雇佣税申报表上使用前任所有者的雇主识别号（EIN）。这样做会有什么后果？

options.en: The IRS will automatically transfer the account balance
options.cn: 国税局（IRS）将自动转移账户余额

options.en: The IRS will reject all returns filed under that EIN
options.cn: 国税局将拒绝所有使用该EIN提交的申报表

options.en: The successor employer may use it for one tax year
options.cn: 继任雇主可以在一个税务年度内使用它

options.en: Returns may face penalties and processing delays
options.cn: 申报表可能面临罚款和处理延误

explanation_en: Pub. 15 Section 1 states that using another business's EIN may result in penalties and delays in processing returns. A successor employer must obtain and use its own EIN.
explanation_cn: 《出版物15》第1节指出，使用其他企业的EIN可能导致罚款和申报处理延误。继任雇主必须获取并使用自己的EIN。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 1 (Document p. 13, PDF p. 13)

question_en: A contractor fails to post the required Cal/OSHA 'Safety and Health Protection on the Job' notice at a job site. What is the maximum fine the employer faces for each violation?
question_cn: 承包商未能在工地张贴所需的加州职业安全与健康管理局（Cal/OSHA）“工作中的安全与健康保护”通知。雇主每次违规可能面临的最高罚款是多少？

options.en: Up to $5,000 per violation
options.cn: 每次违规最高 $5,000

options.en: Up to $250 per violation
options.cn: 每次违规最高 $250

options.en: Up to $1,000 per violation
options.cn: 每次违规最高 $1,000

options.en: Up to $15,000 per violation
options.cn: 每次违规最高 $15,000

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §340, failure to post the Cal/OSHA Notice 'Safety and Health Protection on the Job' may result in a fine of up to $1,000 upon the employer for each violation, as set forth in Labor Code §6431.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §340，未能张贴 Cal/OSHA “工作中的安全与健康保护”通知，每次违规雇主可能面临最高 $1,000 的罚款，如劳动法第 §6431 条所述。

question_en: Under California law, what accounting method is required for federal income tax purposes when a contractor uses inventories in their business?
question_cn: 根据加利福尼亚州法律，当承包商在其业务中使用存货时，联邦所得税目的要求使用哪种会计方法？

options.en: A hybrid method combining cash and accrual approaches
options.cn: 结合现金法和权责发生制的混合方法

options.en: Cash basis, to simplify tax reporting
options.cn: 现金制，以简化税务申报

options.en: Either method at the contractor's discretion
options.cn: 由承包商自行选择的任一方法

options.en: The accrual method, mandated by federal tax requirements
options.cn: 权责发生制，联邦税务要求强制使用

explanation_en: The source text states that for federal income tax purposes, the accrual method is required when inventories are utilized, because it accurately reflects both expenses and income across accounting periods.
explanation_cn: 原文指出，对于联邦所得税目的，当使用存货时，要求使用权责发生制，因为它能够准确反映各会计期间的费用和收入。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7111; Federal Tax Regulations (Document p. 27, PDF p. 50)

question_en: A contractor registers as a sole proprietor and earns $80,000 net profit from the business. How is this income taxed?
question_cn: 一名承包商注册为个体经营者，并从业务中获得 80,000 美元的净利润。该收入如何征税？

options.en: As personal income on the owner's return
options.cn: 作为业主报税表上的个人所得

options.en: As capital gains at a reduced rate
options.cn: 作为以降低税率征收的资本利得

options.en: It is exempt from federal income tax
options.cn: 免联邦所得税

options.en: As corporate income at a flat rate
options.cn: 作为按固定税率征收的公司收入

explanation_en: For tax purposes, sole proprietorship business income is reported as personal income. The owner pays individual income tax rates on the net profit.
explanation_cn: 就税务目的而言，个体经营的业务收入作为个人收入申报。业主按照净利润缴纳个人所得税率。
code_reference: Internal Revenue Code Section 1402 (Document p. 16, PDF p. 39)

question_en: A contractor using the percentage of completion method estimates that 50% of a project is done. How much of the total estimated revenue is recognized?
question_cn: 使用完工百分比法的承包商估计一个项目已经完成了50%。认列的总预计收入是多少？

options.en: 25% of estimated revenue and profit
options.cn: 预计收入和利润的25%

options.en: 75% of estimated revenue and profit
options.cn: 预计收入和利润的75%

options.en: 50% of estimated revenue and profit
options.cn: 预计收入和利润的50%

options.en: None, until the contract is fully completed
options.cn: 不认列，直到合同完全完成

explanation_en: Under the percentage of completion method, if 50% of total performance is accomplished, then 50% of total estimated revenue and profit is considered earned for that period.
explanation_cn: 在完工百分比法下，如果总绩效完成了50%，那么该期间被视为已赚取的预计总收入和利润为50%。
code_reference: IRC Section 460; accrual basis percentage of completion method (Document p. 28, PDF p. 51)

question_en: Which accounting method is generally NOT recommended for contractors because final profit cannot be determined until after a job is completed?
question_cn: 哪种会计方法通常不推荐给承包商使用，因为在工作完成之前无法确定最终利润？

options.en: The completed contract method
options.cn: 完工合同法

options.en: The cash basis of accounting
options.cn: 现金基础会计法

options.en: The percentage of completion method
options.cn: 完工百分比法

options.en: The accrual basis of accounting
options.cn: 权责发生制会计法

explanation_en: The cash basis is not recommended for contractors because progress payments arrive during a job, but final profit cannot be determined until after completion, making the cash basis misleading for evaluating performance.
explanation_cn: 现金基础会计法不推荐给承包商使用，因为在工作进行过程中会有进度款到来，但最终利润要到工作完成后才能确定，这使得现金基础在评估业绩时具有误导性。
code_reference: IRC Section 451; accrual vs. cash basis accounting (Document p. 28, PDF p. 51)

question_en: Under the completed contract method, when are gross income and related costs for a contract reported?
question_cn: 根据完成合同法，合同的总收入和相关成本在何时报告？

options.en: In the year the contract is completed
options.cn: 在合同完成的年份

options.en: When the final retention payment is released
options.cn: 当最后的保留付款发放时

options.en: When each progress payment is received
options.cn: 当收到每笔进度付款时

options.en: Proportionally each year as work is accomplished
options.cn: 随着每年工作的完成按比例分配

explanation_en: The completed contract method allows gross income and related costs to be reported in the year in which the contract is completed, deferring recognition until project closeout.
explanation_cn: 完成合同法允许在合同完成的年份报告总收入和相关成本，将确认推迟到项目结束时。
code_reference: IRC Section 460; completed contract method (Document p. 28, PDF p. 51)

question_en: A contractor's balance sheet shows current assets of $250,000 and current liabilities of $180,000. What is the company's working capital?
question_cn: 一家承包商的资产负债表显示流动资产为250,000美元，流动负债为180,000美元。公司的营运资金是多少？
explanation_en: Working capital equals current assets minus current liabilities: $250,000 – $180,000 = $70,000. This represents what remains free and clear after all current debts are paid.
explanation_cn: 营运资金等于流动资产减去流动负债：250,000美元 – 180,000美元 = 70,000美元。这表示在偿还所有流动负债后剩余的可自由支配资金。
code_reference: Business Finances; working capital calculation (Document p. 37, PDF p. 60)

question_en: Using the Typical Construction Company balance sheet, what is the quick ratio if current assets are $250,000, inventories are $110,000, and current liabilities are $180,000?
question_cn: 使用典型建筑公司的资产负债表，如果流动资产为 $250,000，存货为 $110,000，流动负债为 $180,000，速动比率是多少？

options.en: Approximately 0.78
Approximately 2.27
Approximately 0.61
Approximately 1.39

explanation_en: Quick assets = $250,000 – $110,000 = $140,000. Quick ratio = $140,000 / $180,000 = 0.78. This means $0.78 in liquid assets backs each $1 of current liabilities.
code_reference: Business Finances; quick ratio calculation (Document p. 37, PDF p. 60)

question_en: On a balance sheet, fixed assets such as construction equipment are valued at which amount?
question_cn: 在资产负债表上，固定资产如建筑设备按哪一金额计价？

options.en: Current fair market value
options.cn: 当前公平市场价值

options.en: Estimated salvage value at year-end
options.cn: 年末预计残值

options.en: Appraised replacement cost
options.cn: 评估的替换成本

options.en: Original cost less accumulated depreciation
options.cn: 原始成本减累计折旧

explanation_en: Regardless of current market value, fixed assets are valued at original cost minus accumulated depreciation. This is the book value reported on the balance sheet.
explanation_cn: 无论当前市场价值如何，固定资产按原始成本减累计折旧计价。这是资产负债表上报告的账面价值。
code_reference: IRC Section 263A; Property, Plant, and Equipment valuation (Document p. 31, PDF p. 54)

question_en: Which of the following items would be classified under 'Other Assets' on a contractor's balance sheet?
question_cn: 以下哪一项会被归类为承包商资产负债表中的“其他资产”？

options.en: Cash on hand and bank deposits
options.cn: 现金及银行存款

options.en: Construction equipment in regular use
options.cn: 常规使用的建筑设备

options.en: Equipment held for resale
options.cn: 预备出售的设备

options.en: Accounts receivable from customers
options.cn: 客户应收账款

explanation_en: Equipment held for resale does not fit under current assets or Property, Plant, and Equipment (which requires intent to use in operations). The text specifically lists it as an example of 'Other Assets.'
explanation_cn: 预备出售的设备不属于流动资产或固定资产（后者要求用于经营的意图）。文本特别将其列为“其他资产”的示例。
code_reference: Business Finances; balance sheet asset classification (Document p. 32, PDF p. 55)

question_en: A contractor reviews the income statement and wants to find the 'bottom line.' Which figure should the contractor look for?
question_cn: 一位承包商正在查看损益表，并希望找到“底线”。承包商应该查看哪个数字？

options.en: Total sales revenue for the period
options.cn: 本期总销售收入

options.en: Total operating expenses for the year
options.cn: 全年总运营支出

options.en: Net profit or net income after taxes
options.cn: 税后净利润或净收入

options.en: Income before provision for federal income tax
options.cn: 扣除联邦所得税准备前的收入

explanation_en: Net profit, also called net income, represents all revenues minus all expenses including taxes. It is the last line of the income statement and is commonly called the 'bottom line.'
explanation_cn: 净利润，也称为净收入，代表所有收入减去包括税在内的所有支出。它是损益表的最后一行，通常被称为“底线”。
code_reference: Business Finances; income statement net profit (Document p. 35, PDF p. 58)

question_en: Which component of the income statement typically represents the largest single expense item for a contracting company?
question_cn: 收入报表中的哪一项通常代表承包公司最大的单项支出？

options.en: General and administrative expenses
options.cn: 一般及行政费用

options.en: Materials used on the job
options.cn: 工程中使用的材料

options.en: Direct labor burden and benefits
options.cn: 直接人工负担和福利

options.en: Direct labor payroll costs
options.cn: 直接人工工资成本

explanation_en: The text states that materials used is 'usually the largest single expense item on the income statement,' warranting careful purchasing controls to protect profitability.
explanation_cn: 文本中指出，使用的材料“通常是收入报表中最大的单项支出”，因此需要仔细的采购控制以保护盈利能力。
code_reference: Business Finances; income statement cost components (Document p. 35, PDF p. 58)

question_en: A contractor's income statement shows total sales of $1,250,000 and total operating expenses of $1,145,000. What is the operating profit before federal income tax?
question_cn: 一家承包商的损益表显示总销售额为 $1,250,000，总营业费用为 $1,145,000。联邦所得税前的营业利润是多少？
explanation_en: $1,250,000 in sales minus $1,145,000 in total operating expenses equals $105,000. This is 'Income Before Provision for Federal Income Tax' as shown on the Typical Construction Company income statement.
explanation_cn: $1,250,000 的销售额减去 $1,145,000 的总营业费用等于 $105,000。这是典型建筑公司损益表上显示的“联邦所得税准备前收入”。
code_reference: Business Finances; income statement pretax income calculation (Document p. 34, PDF p. 57)

question_en: What does the 'Retained Earnings' account on a corporate balance sheet represent?
question_cn: 公司资产负债表上的“留存收益”账户代表什么？

options.en: Total amount invested for shares at par value
options.cn: 投入的按面值计算的股份总额

options.en: Earnings minus dividends declared since founding
options.cn: 自成立以来的收益减去已宣告的股息

options.en: Cash currently held in company bank accounts
options.cn: 公司银行账户中当前持有的现金

options.en: The current year's net profit only
options.cn: 仅当前年度的净利润

explanation_en: Retained earnings equals total corporation earnings from inception minus total dividends declared since founding. It represents earnings reinvested by owners who chose not to take full distributions.
explanation_cn: 留存收益等于公司成立以来的总收益减去自成立以来已宣告的总股息。它代表那些选择不全部分配利润而由所有者再投资的收益。
code_reference: Business Finances; stockholders' equity retained earnings (Document p. 33, PDF p. 56)

question_en: Which of the following does NOT describe a valid method for analyzing and interpreting a company's financial statements?
question_cn: 以下哪项不描述分析和解读公司财务报表的有效方法？

options.en: Comparing current data to prior years
options.cn: 将当前数据与前几年的数据进行比较

options.en: Comparing data to industry benchmarks
options.cn: 将数据与行业基准进行比较

options.en: Using ratio analysis of internal financial data
options.cn: 使用内部财务数据的比率分析

options.en: Averaging the last ten years of net profit
options.cn: 计算过去十年的净利润平均值

explanation_en: The text identifies exactly three methods: historical comparison, industry comparison, and ratio analysis. Averaging a decade of net profits is not described as a recognized financial analysis method.
explanation_cn: 文本明确指出了三种方法：历史比较、行业比较和比率分析。计算十年的净利润平均值并未被描述为公认的财务分析方法。
code_reference: Business Finances; financial analysis methods (Document p. 36, PDF p. 59)

question_en: A subcontractor is owed money for work in progress but has not yet been paid. Where would this amount appear on the general contractor's balance sheet?
question_cn: 分包商因进行中的工作应得款项，但尚未收到付款。这笔金额将在总承包商的资产负债表上出现在哪一项？

options.en: Under notes payable
options.cn: 在应付票据中

options.en: Under long-term liabilities
options.cn: 在长期负债中

options.en: Under accrued expenses payable
options.cn: 在应计费用中

options.en: Under accounts payable
options.cn: 在应付账款中

explanation_en: Accounts payable represents money owed to suppliers and subcontractors. An unpaid subcontractor invoice for work in progress is a classic accounts payable item under current liabilities.
explanation_cn: 应付账款代表欠供应商和分包商的钱。未支付的进行中工作的分包商发票是流动负债下的典型应付账款项目。
code_reference: Business Finances; balance sheet accounts payable classification (Document p. 32, PDF p. 55)

question_en: Direct labor burden on an income statement would include which of the following costs?
question_cn: 损益表上的直接人工负担将包括以下哪些成本？

options.en: General and administrative overhead costs
options.cn: 一般和行政开销

options.en: Payroll taxes, insurance, and employee benefits
options.cn: 工资税、保险和员工福利

options.en: Raw materials purchased for each project
options.cn: 每个项目购买的原材料

options.en: Equipment rental and permit fees
options.cn: 设备租赁和许可费用

explanation_en: Direct labor burden includes all payroll taxes, insurance, and employee benefits associated with the labor payroll. For union workers, it also includes benefit assessments and association fees.
explanation_cn: 直接人工负担包括与劳动工资相关的所有工资税、保险和员工福利。对于工会工人，它还包括福利评估和协会费用。
code_reference: Business Finances; direct labor burden definition (Document p. 35, PDF p. 58)

question_en: A bank loan officer reviewing a contractor's credit application would be most interested in which financial ratios?
question_cn: 银行贷款官在审核承包商的信用申请时最关心哪些财务比率？

options.en: Retained earnings ratio and pretax income ratio
options.cn: 留存收益比率和税前收入比率

options.en: Debt-to-equity ratio and net profit margin
options.cn: 负债与股本比率和净利润率

options.en: Gross margin ratio and revenue growth ratio
options.cn: 毛利率和收入增长率

options.en: Current ratio and quick ratio
options.cn: 流动比率和速动比率

explanation_en: The text states that a bank loan officer recommending a short-term line of credit would be specifically interested in the current ratio and quick ratio, as the bank expects repayment in the near term.
explanation_cn: 文本指出，银行贷款官在推荐短期信用额度时会特别关注流动比率和速动比率，因为银行期望在短期内收回贷款。
code_reference: Business Finances; current ratio and quick ratio for credit evaluation (Document p. 36, PDF p. 59)

question_en: A subcontractor finishes their phase early in a project but cannot collect retention until the entire project is accepted. What is the most likely financial consequence for that subcontractor?
question_cn: 分包商在项目中提前完成他们的阶段工作，但在整个项目被验收之前无法领取保留款。对于该分包商来说，最可能的财务后果是什么？

options.en: May need to borrow funds to cover costs
options.cn: 可能需要借款来支付成本

options.en: Must renegotiate the original contract price
options.cn: 必须重新谈判原合同价格

options.en: May demand early release from the project owner
options.cn: 可能要求项目业主提前释放款项

options.en: Can bill the general contractor for carrying costs
options.cn: 可以向总承包商开具因承担成本的账单
