explanation_en: Per the source text, since retention funds are unavailable for use elsewhere in the business, the contractor must often finance operating costs through borrowing while awaiting release of retention.
explanation_cn: 根据来源文本，由于保留款不能在企业其他地方使用，承包商通常必须在等待保留款释放期间通过借款来融资运营成本。
code_reference: California Business and Professions Code Section 7108.5; Source text p. 62 (Document p. 39, PDF p. 62)

question_en: Under a typical construction contract, what percentage of the contract amount is withheld as retention until project completion and expiration of the lien period?
question_cn: 在典型的施工合同中，在项目完成和留置权期满之前，合同金额的百分之几会被作为保留金？

options.en: 20 percent of the total contract
options.cn: 合同总额的 20%

options.en: 15 percent of the total contract
options.cn: 合同总额的 15%

options.en: 25 percent of the total contract
options.cn: 合同总额的 25%

options.en: 10 percent of the total contract
options.cn: 合同总额的 10%

explanation_en: The source text states that the typical contract provides 90 percent during the construction phase, with the final 10 percent withheld upon completion and expiration of the lien period — this is the retention.
explanation_cn: 原文说明，典型合同在施工阶段支付 90%，项目完成且留置权期满后保留最后的 10% — 这就是保留金。
code_reference: California Civil Code Section 8812; Source text p. 61 (Document p. 38, PDF p. 61)

question_en: Which of the following is the key distinction between equity financing and debt financing for a new contractor?
question_cn: 以下哪一项是新承包商股权融资与债务融资的关键区别？

options.en: Debt financing requires interest but no ownership stake
options.cn: 债务融资需要支付利息但不涉及所有权

options.en: Equity funds must be repaid within a fixed term
options.cn: 股权资金必须在固定期限内偿还

options.en: Debt funds never require repayment of principal
options.cn: 债务资金从不需要偿还本金

options.en: Equity investors have no claim on future profits
options.cn: 股权投资者对未来利润没有索取权

explanation_en: Per the source text, debt represents borrowed dollars requiring repayment of principal plus periodic interest, but the owner does not normally give up control of the business — unlike equity financing.
explanation_cn: 根据原文，债务代表需要偿还本金及定期利息的借入资金，但业主通常不会放弃对企业的控制权——这与股权融资不同。
code_reference: Source text p. 62 – Sources of Financing (Document p. 39, PDF p. 62)

question_en: A contractor is preparing a bid and receives a quote with a cash discount from a material supplier. Under what condition should the contractor include that discount in the estimate?
question_cn: 承包商正在准备投标，并从材料供应商那里收到带现金折扣的报价。在什么情况下承包商应在估算中包含该折扣？

options.en: Only when the supplier offers it in writing
options.cn: 仅当供应商以书面形式提供时

options.en: When the discount exceeds the project's overhead rate
options.cn: 当折扣超过项目的间接费用率时

options.en: Always, since cash discounts reduce the total project cost
options.cn: 始终包含，因为现金折扣可以降低项目总成本

options.en: Only if funds will be available to pay on time
options.cn: 仅在有资金可用于按时付款时

explanation_en: The source text states that cash discounts should not be included unless the contractor is certain that sufficient financial resources will be available to repay accounts payable during the discount period.
explanation_cn: 原文指出，除非承包商确定在折扣期间有足够的财务资源来偿付应付账款，否则不应包括现金折扣。
code_reference: Source text p. 64 – Bidding and Estimation (Document p. 41, PDF p. 64)

question_en: Which of the following costs is correctly classified as a direct labor cost when preparing a bid estimate?
question_cn: 在准备投标估算时，下列哪项成本被正确归类为直接人工成本？

options.en: Office rent and administrative staff wages
options.cn: 办公室租金和行政人员工资

options.en: Permits and loan commitment fees
options.cn: 许可和贷款承诺费

options.en: Fuel and lubricants for equipment
options.cn: 设备的燃料和润滑油

options.en: Payroll taxes and health and welfare benefits
options.cn: 工资税及健康和福利福利

explanation_en: The source text states that labor costs include not only the hourly wage rate but also payroll taxes, health and welfare benefits, vacation pay, and required insurance — all treated as direct labor costs.
explanation_cn: 源文本指出，人工成本不仅包括小时工资率，还包括工资税、健康和福利、带薪假期以及法定保险——所有这些都作为直接人工成本处理。
code_reference: Source text p. 64 – Bidding and Estimation (Document p. 41, PDF p. 64)

question_en: A contractor's net sales to net working capital ratio is unusually low. According to sound financial management principles, which situation could explain this ratio?
question_cn: 承包商的净销售额与净营运资金比率异常低。根据健全的财务管理原则，哪种情况可以解释这一比率？

options.en: The company has excessive long-term liabilities
options.cn: 公司长期负债过多

options.en: High profit margins compressing the ratio
options.cn: 高利润率压缩了比率

options.en: Inadequate sales or excess working capital
options.cn: 销售不足或营运资金过剩

options.en: Too many receivables relative to payables
options.cn: 应收账款相对于应付账款过多

explanation_en: The source text states that a low net sales to net working capital ratio may be attributed either to an excess of working capital or to inadequate sales — both are valid explanations management must investigate.
explanation_cn: 原文指出，净销售额与净营运资金比率低可能归因于营运资金过剩或销售不足——这两种都是管理层必须调查的有效解释。
code_reference: Source text p. 61 – Financial Management (Document p. 38, PDF p. 61)

question_en: When a bank loan officer evaluates a contractor's application for a line of credit, which of the following falls under the 'Capacity' criterion?
question_cn: 当银行贷款官评估承包商的信贷申请时，以下哪项属于“能力”标准？

options.en: Realistic completion dates and penalty risk
options.cn: 现实的完工日期和罚款风险

options.en: The contractor's reputation with subcontractors
options.cn: 承包商与分包商的声誉

options.en: Experience with similar jobs and locations
options.cn: 在类似工作和地点的经验

options.en: Current workload and available financial resources
options.cn: 当前工作量和可用的财务资源

explanation_en: The source text defines 'Capacity' as an evaluation of current workload, availability of equipment, and financial resources available to withstand any reasonable loss.
explanation_cn: 源文本将“能力”定义为对当前工作量、设备可用性以及可用于承受任何合理损失的财务资源的评估。
code_reference: Source text p. 63 – Short-Term Financing (Document p. 40, PDF p. 63)

question_en: Which scheduling method is better suited to identifying tasks whose delay will push back the entire project completion date?
question_cn: 哪种调度方法更适合识别那些延误会推迟整个项目完成日期的任务？

options.en: The bar chart scheduling method
options.cn: 条形图调度法

options.en: The unit-price estimation method
options.cn: 单价估算法

options.en: The critical path method
options.cn: 关键路径法

options.en: The cost-plus contract method
options.cn: 成本加成合同法

explanation_en: The source text states that the critical path method better interrelates tasks and identifies the key path through the network, allowing management to focus on tasks whose delay causes overall project delay.
explanation_cn: 原文指出，关键路径法可以更好地关联任务并识别网络中的关键路径，使管理能够集中关注那些延误会导致整个项目延迟的任务。
code_reference: Source text p. 65 – The Construction Process (Document p. 42, PDF p. 65)

question_en: A contractor's bid is accepted, but during construction, material costs rise significantly. The contractor did not include a contingency in the bid. Which bidding pitfall does this scenario best illustrate?
question_cn: 承包商的投标被接受，但在施工过程中，材料成本大幅上升。承包商在投标中未包含应急费用。这个情景最能说明哪种投标陷阱？

options.en: Failing to walk the job before bidding
options.cn: 投标前未实地勘察工作现场

options.en: Bidding on a low-margin job with underestimation risk
options.cn: 对低利润项目投标且存在低估风险

options.en: Bidding against competition rather than the job
options.cn: 与竞争对手竞争而非针对项目本身投标

options.en: Overextension of managerial and operational resources
options.cn: 管理和操作资源过度扩张

explanation_en: The source text warns that a contractor seriously jeopardizes the business by omitting profit allowance, especially on a low-margin bid where underestimation risk exists — matching this scenario exactly.
explanation_cn: 文本提醒，承包商在投标中省略利润预留会严重危及企业，尤其是在低利润项目且存在低估风险的情况下——这正好与此情景相符。
code_reference: Source text p. 65 – Bidding and Estimation (Document p. 42, PDF p. 65)

question_en: According to the source text, why do speculative builders require larger amounts of capital than custom builders?
question_cn: 根据原文，为什么投机性建筑商需要比定制建筑商更多的资金？

options.en: They must provide substantial resources to qualify for loans
options.cn: 他们必须提供大量资源以符合贷款资格

options.en: They carry larger permanent payrolls than custom builders
options.cn: 他们比定制建筑商拥有更大的永久薪资支出

options.en: They pay higher union labor rates on all projects
options.cn: 他们在所有项目中支付更高的工会劳务费

options.en: They cannot receive progress payments during construction
options.cn: 他们在施工期间无法收到阶段性付款

explanation_en: The source text states that speculative builders require larger amounts of capital than custom builders and consequently must provide substantial financial resources to qualify for loan commitments.
explanation_cn: 原文说明，投机性建筑商比定制建筑商需要更多的资金，因此必须提供大量财务资源以符合贷款承诺条件。
code_reference: Source text p. 62 – Capitalization (Document p. 39, PDF p. 62)

question_en: Which of the following best explains why the Small Business Administration (SBA) is described as a financing source for contractors?
question_cn: 以下哪项最能解释为什么小企业管理局（SBA）被描述为承包商的融资来源？

options.en: It provides direct low-interest loans to contractors
options.cn: 它为承包商提供直接的低息贷款

options.en: It purchases receivables to improve contractor cash flow
options.cn: 它购买应收账款以改善承包商的现金流

options.en: It grants equity funding to minority contractors
options.cn: 它向少数族裔承包商提供股权资金

options.en: It guarantees repayment of loans made by lenders
options.cn: 它担保贷款机构所发放贷款的偿还

explanation_en: The source text is explicit: the SBA does not make direct loans but guarantees repayment of a loan, which reduces lender risk and improves contractor access to financing.
explanation_cn: 原文明确指出：SBA 不提供直接贷款，而是担保贷款的偿还，这降低了贷款机构的风险并改善了承包商的融资渠道。
code_reference: Source text p. 63 – SBA Financing (Document p. 40, PDF p. 63)

question_en: Under California law, what is the maximum delinquency fee that can be charged to a licensee within the Department of Consumer Affairs for a late license renewal?
question_cn: 根据加利福尼亚法律，对于加州消费者事务部下的持牌人在延期续证时，可收取的最高逾期费用是多少？

options.en: $100, but not less than $10
$200, regardless of the renewal fee
options.cn: $200，无论续证费多少

options.en: $150, but not less than $25
$75, but not less than $25

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 163.5 sets the delinquency fee at 50% of the renewal fee, with a floor of $25 and a ceiling of $150.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 163.5 条规定，逾期费用为续证费用的 50%，下限为 $25，上限为 $150。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 163.5 (Document p. 137, PDF p. 160)

question_en: A contractor's license has lapsed and must be reinstated. The current renewal fee is $400. What is the maximum reinstatement fee the board may charge?
question_cn: 承包商执照已过期，必须恢复。当前续费为 $400。委员会可以收取的最高恢复费用是多少？

options.en: $600, which is 150% of the renewal fee
$200, which is 50% of the renewal fee
$425, which is renewal fee plus $25
$400, equal to the renewal fee only
options.cn: $400，仅等于续费

explanation_en: Under B&P Code Section 163.5, the reinstatement fee is 150% of the renewal fee ($600) but shall not exceed the renewal fee plus $25. Since $400 + $25 = $425, and that is less than $600, $425 is the maximum permissible fee.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第 163.5 条，恢复费用为续费的 150%（$600），但不得超过续费加 $25。由于 $400 + $25 = $425，而 $425 小于 $600，因此 $425 是允许的最高费用。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 163.5 (Document p. 137, PDF p. 160)

question_en: A contractor's license is on inactive status. The renewal fee for an active license in the same classification is $450. What renewal fee applies to the inactive license?
question_cn: 承包商的执照处于非活动状态。同一类别的活动执照续费为450美元。非活动执照适用的续费是多少？

options.en: No fee is required for any inactive license renewal
options.cn: 任何非活动执照续费都不需要支付费用

options.en: $225 -- exactly half the active renewal fee
options.cn: 225美元——正好是活动续费的一半

options.en: $450 -- the active fee unless the board sets less
options.cn: 450美元——活动执照的费用，除非委员会设定更少的费用

options.en: A fixed $100 administrative processing fee applies only
options.cn: 仅适用固定的100美元行政处理费

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 462(b)(3) provides that the active renewal fee shall apply to inactive renewals unless a lesser renewal fee is specified by the board. Without a board reduction, the full $450 applies.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第462(b)(3)条规定，非活动执照续费应适用活动续费，除非委员会指定较低的续费。若委员会未降低，则需支付全部450美元。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 462(b)(3) (Document p. 154, PDF p. 177)

question_en: A contractor's license is suspended because the licensee appears on the Franchise Tax Board's list of the 500 largest tax delinquencies. After receiving a release from the Franchise Tax Board, within how many business days must the licensing entity process the release?
question_cn: 承包商的执照被暂停，因为执照持有人出现在特许经营税委员会列出的500大税务拖欠名单上。在收到特许经营税委员会的解除通知后，发证机构必须在多少个工作日内处理该解除通知？

options.en: Within thirty days of receipt
options.cn: 收到后30天内

options.en: Within 15 business days of receipt
options.cn: 收到后15个工作日内

options.en: Within ten business days of receipt
options.cn: 收到后10个工作日内

options.en: Within five business days of receipt
options.cn: 收到后5个工作日内

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 494.5(j) explicitly requires that any state governmental licensing entity that receives a release from the State Board of Equalization or the Franchise Tax Board shall process the release within five business days of its receipt.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第494.5(j)条明确要求，任何州政府发证机构在收到来自州平衡委员会或特许经营税委员会的解除通知后，必须在收到后五个工作日内处理该解除通知。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 494.5(j) (Document p. 185, PDF p. 208)

question_en: A contractor's name appears on the State Board of Equalization's certified tax delinquency list, but the contractor is otherwise eligible for a new license. What is the maximum duration of the temporary license the licensing entity must issue?
question_cn: 如果承包商的名字出现在州均衡委员会的认证税款拖欠名单上，但该承包商在其他方面符合新执照的申请条件，发证机构必须颁发的临时执照的最长有效期是多少？

options.en: 180 calendar days, extendable for hardship
options.cn: 180 个日历天，可因困难情况延长

options.en: 120 calendar days, renewable once
options.cn: 120 个日历天，可续期一次

options.en: 120 calendar days, subject to review
options.cn: 120 个日历天，需复核

options.en: 90 calendar days, not extendable
options.cn: 90 个日历天，不可延长

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 494.5(e)(2)(A)-(B) requires the entity to issue a temporary license valid for 90 days if the applicant is otherwise eligible, and expressly states the 90-day period shall not be extended.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 494.5(e)(2)(A)-(B) 条款要求，如果申请人在其他方面符合条件，发证机构必须颁发有效期为 90 天的临时执照，并明确规定 90 天期限不可延长。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 494.5(e)(2)(A)-(B) (Document p. 182, PDF p. 205)

question_en: A contractor's license is suspended due to tax delinquency. The contractor later enters into an installment payment agreement with the Franchise Tax Board but then fails to comply with it. What must the licensing entity notify the contractor before suspending the license again?
question_cn: 由于欠税，承包商的执照被吊销。承包商随后与特许税务委员会达成了分期付款协议，但之后未能遵守该协议。许可机构在再次吊销执照之前必须通知承包商什么？

options.en: The license will be suspended within 10 days of the mailing
options.cn: 执照将在邮寄后10天内被吊销

options.en: The license will be suspended within 60 days
options.cn: 执照将在60天内被吊销

options.en: The license will be suspended within 30 days of the mailing
options.cn: 执照将在邮寄后30天内被吊销

options.en: The license will be suspended within 90 days
options.cn: 执照将在90天内被吊销

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 494.5(j) states that upon receiving notice of non-compliance with an installment agreement, the licensing entity shall notify the licensee that the license will be suspended on a specific date no longer than 30 days from the date the form is mailed.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第494.5(j)条规定，在收到未遵守分期付款协议的通知后，许可机构应通知执照持有人执照将在邮寄日期后的不超过30天的具体日期被吊销。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 494.5(j) (Document p. 186, PDF p. 209)

question_en: A contractor applicant whose name appears on the Franchise Tax Board's certified tax delinquency list pays the outstanding taxes in full. Which entity must send the release to the appropriate licensing entity?
question_cn: 如果一名承包商申请人的名字出现在特许税务委员会的认证欠税名单上，他已全额支付了欠税，则哪一个实体必须向相关许可实体发送解除通知？

options.en: The contractor's attorney or authorized agent
options.cn: 承包商的律师或授权代理人

options.en: The Department of Consumer Affairs directly
options.cn: 消费者事务部直接发送

options.en: The licensing entity itself, upon verification
options.cn: 许可实体本身在核实后发送

options.en: The State Board of Equalization or Franchise Tax Board
options.cn: 州平衡委员会或特许税务委员会

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 494.5(j) requires that when a contractor has complied with the tax obligation, the State Board of Equalization or the Franchise Tax Board, whichever is applicable, shall mail a release to the applicant or licensee and provide a release to the appropriate state governmental licensing entity.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第494.5(j)条规定，当承包商履行完税务义务后，适用的州平衡委员会或特许税务委员会应向申请人或持证人邮寄解除通知，并向相关的州政府许可实体提供解除通知。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 494.5(h)(1) and (j) (Document p. 184, PDF p. 207)

question_en: The registrar plans to refuse a contractor's license renewal due to outstanding tax liabilities owed to the Franchise Tax Board. What must occur before the registrar may refuse or suspend the license?
question_cn: 注册主任计划因承包商欠付特许税务委员会的未清税款而拒绝其执照续期。在注册主任可以拒绝或暂停执照之前，必须发生什么？

options.en: A 90-day written notice mailed to the licensee
options.cn: 向执照持有人邮寄90天的书面通知

options.en: A 30-day written notice mailed to the licensee
options.cn: 向执照持有人邮寄30天的书面通知

options.en: A final court judgment against the licensee
options.cn: 对执照持有人作出最终法院判决

options.en: A 60-day written notice mailed to the licensee
options.cn: 向执照持有人邮寄60天的书面通知

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7145.5(b) requires the registrar to mail a preliminary notice to the licensee at least 60 days before the date certain, indicating the license will be refused or suspended if the outstanding liabilities are not resolved.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7145.5(b)条规定，注册主任必须至少在确定日期前60天向执照持有人邮寄初步通知，表明如果未解决未清税款，执照将被拒绝或暂停。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7145.5(b) (Document p. 363, PDF p. 386)

question_en: What is the application fee for an original contractor's license in a single classification?
question_cn: 单一分类的原始承包商执照申请费是多少？

options.en: $125, up to a maximum of $157
$150, up to a maximum of $188
$450, up to a maximum of $563
$230, up to a maximum of $288

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7137(a)(1)(A) sets the base application fee for an original license in a single classification at $450, which may be increased to no more than $563.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 7137(a)(1)(A) 条规定，单一分类原始执照的基础申请费为 $450，可增加至不超过 $563。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7137(a)(1)(A) (Document p. 351, PDF p. 374)

question_en: A contractor lets their license expire without renewing on time. The renewal fee for their active individual owner license is $450. How much will they owe in total to renew?
question_cn: 承包商未及时续订其执照而导致执照过期。他们的有效个人所有者执照续费为 450 美元。他们总共需要支付多少续费？

options.en: $900 — double the renewal fee
options.cn: 900 美元 — 续费的两倍

options.en: $600 — the renewal fee plus a flat penalty
options.cn: 600 美元 — 续费加固定罚金

options.en: $675 — renewal fee plus 50% delinquency fee
options.cn: 675 美元 — 续费加 50% 逾期费用

options.en: $450 — no additional penalty applies
options.cn: 450 美元 — 不适用额外罚金

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7137(a)(5) imposes a delinquency fee of 50% of the renewal fee when a license is renewed after expiration. $450 + $225 (50% of $450) = $675 total.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 7137(a)(5) 条规定，如果执照在过期后才续订，将收取续费 50% 的逾期费用。450 美元 + 225 美元（450 美元的 50%）= 总计 675 美元。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7137(a)(5) (Document p. 353, PDF p. 376)

question_en: A contractor applies for an original license in a single classification and also wants to add two additional classifications at the same time. What is the total application fee?
question_cn: 一名承包商申请单一类别的原始执照，同时还希望一次添加两个附加类别。总申请费是多少？

options.en: $750 total for all three classifications
options.cn: 三个类别总共 $750

options.en: $600 total for all three classifications
options.cn: 三个类别总共 $600

options.en: $910 total for all three classifications
options.cn: 三个类别总共 $910

options.en: $1,350 total for all three classifications
options.cn: 三个类别总共 $1,350

explanation_en: Under CCR 811(a)(1) and (a)(2), the original license fee is $450, plus $150 for each additional classification applied for simultaneously. Two additional classifications = $300, for a total of $750.
explanation_cn: 根据 CCR 811(a)(1) 和 (a)(2)，原始执照费为 $450，每同时申请一个附加类别需加收 $150。两个附加类别 = $300，总计 $750。
code_reference: CCR Title 16, Section 811(a)(1) and (a)(2) (Document p. 428, PDF p. 451)

question_en: A sole proprietor contractor renews an active license. A partnership in the same trade renews an inactive license. Which statement correctly compares their renewal fees?
question_cn: 一名独资承包商续订有效执照。一家同行业的合伙企业续订无效执照。哪种说法正确比较了他们的续费？

options.en: The sole proprietor pays more than the partnership
options.cn: 独资承包商支付的费用比合伙企业多

options.en: The sole proprietor pays $150 less than the partnership
options.cn: 独资承包商支付的费用比合伙企业少150美元

options.en: Both pay the same $450 renewal fee
options.cn: 两者支付相同的450美元续费

options.en: The partnership pays $50 more than the sole proprietor
options.cn: 合伙企业支付的费用比独资承包商多50美元

explanation_en: Under CCR 811(d)(1), the active individual owner renewal is $450. Under 811(d)(4), the inactive partnership, corporation, LLC, or joint venture renewal is $500. The difference is $50 in favor of the partnership paying more.
explanation_cn: 根据CCR 811(d)(1)，活跃的个人业主续费为450美元。根据811(d)(4)，无效的合伙企业、公司、有限责任公司或合资企业续费为500美元。差额为50美元，说明合伙企业支付更多。
code_reference: CCR Title 16, Section 811(d)(1) and (d)(4) (Document p. 429, PDF p. 452)

question_en: A contractor wants to replace the qualifying individual on an existing license and the replacement must take an examination. What is the application fee for this change?
question_cn: 承包商希望更换现有执照上的合格个人，且更换人员必须参加考试。此更改的申请费用是多少？

options.en: $150 for the replacement application
options.cn: 更换申请费用为 $150

options.en: $125 for the replacement application
options.cn: 更换申请费用为 $125

options.en: $450 for the replacement application
options.cn: 更换申请费用为 $450

options.en: $230 for the replacement application
options.cn: 更换申请费用为 $230

explanation_en: CCR 811(a)(4) sets the fee at $230 for an application to replace a responsible managing officer, responsible managing manager, responsible managing member, or responsible managing employee under B&P Code Section 7068.2.
explanation_cn: CCR 811(a)(4) 将根据 《加州商业与职业法典》第 7068.2 节，更换负责管理官员、负责管理经理、负责管理成员或负责管理员工的申请费用设定为 $230。
code_reference: CCR Title 16, Section 811(a)(4) (Document p. 428, PDF p. 451)

question_en: A sole proprietor contractor allows his license to become inactive. What is the renewal fee he must pay?
question_cn: 一名独资承包商让他的执照变为不活跃状态。他必须支付的续费是多少？

options.en: $300 for an inactive individual license
options.cn: 不活跃的个人执照续费为 $300

options.en: $500 for an inactive individual license
options.cn: 不活跃的个人执照续费为 $500

options.en: $200 for an inactive individual license
options.cn: 不活跃的个人执照续费为 $200

options.en: $450 for an inactive individual license
options.cn: 不活跃的个人执照续费为 $450

explanation_en: Under CCR Section 811(d)(2), the renewal fee for an inactive license held by an individual owner is $300.
explanation_cn: 根据 CCR 第 811(d)(2) 条，个人持有的不活跃执照续费为 $300。
code_reference: California Code of Regulations, Title 16, Section 811(d)(2) (Document p. 429, PDF p. 452)

question_en: For blanket bond approval, what minimum quick ratio must a contractor's financial statements demonstrate?
question_cn: 对于总承包保证金的批准，承包商的财务报表必须显示的最低速动比率是多少？

options.en: Not less than 1.5:1
Not less than 2:1
options.cn: 不低于 2:1

options.en: Not less than 0.5:1
Not less than 1:1
options.cn: 不低于 1:1

explanation_en: Section 858.3(a)(1) requires the quick ratio to be not less than 1:1. Alternatively, the current ratio must be not less than 2:1 if the quick ratio standard is not met.
explanation_cn: 第 858.3(a)(1) 节要求速动比率不得低于 1:1。或者，如果未达到速动比率标准，则流动比率不得低于 2:1。
code_reference: 16 CCR Section 858.3(a)(1) (Document p. 462, PDF p. 485)

question_en: How is the quick ratio calculated for blanket bond financial statement review purposes?
question_cn: 在进行保函财务报表审查时，速动比率是如何计算的？

options.en: Current assets divided by current liabilities
options.cn: 流动资产除以流动负债

options.en: Current assets minus accounts payable, divided by liabilities
options.cn: 流动资产减去应付账款，再除以负债

options.en: Current assets minus inventory, divided by current liabilities
options.cn: 流动资产减去存货，再除以流动负债

options.en: Total assets minus total liabilities, divided by equity
options.cn: 总资产减去总负债，再除以股本

explanation_en: Section 858.2(a)(3)(B) defines the quick ratio as current assets minus inventory, divided by current liabilities -- excluding the least-liquid current asset from the numerator.
explanation_cn: 第858.2(a)(3)(B)节将速动比率定义为流动资产减去存货，再除以流动负债——分子中不包括流动性最差的流动资产。
code_reference: 16 CCR Section 858.2(a)(3)(B) (Document p. 460, PDF p. 483)

question_en: A contractor's blanket bond application includes reviewed financial statements. Which two fiscal years must those statements cover?
question_cn: 承包商的综合保证金申请包括经过审阅的财务报表。这些报表必须涵盖哪两个财政年度？

options.en: Any two years the CPA selects as representative
options.cn: 由注册会计师选择的任意两个具有代表性的年份

options.en: The two fiscal years immediately preceding the application
options.cn: 紧接申请之前的两个财政年度

options.en: The current fiscal year and the next renewal year
options.cn: 当前财政年度和下一个续期年度

options.en: The two fiscal years following the application date
options.cn: 申请日期之后的两个财政年度

explanation_en: Section 858.2(a)(3) requires the review report to cover the two fiscal years immediately preceding the application for blanket bond approval.
explanation_cn: 第 858.2(a)(3) 条要求审阅报告须涵盖紧接申请综合保证金批准之前的两个财政年度。
code_reference: 16 CCR Section 858.2(a)(3) (Document p. 460, PDF p. 483)

question_en: Under California's PACE program, a PACE assessment is repaid through which mechanism?
question_cn: 在加利福尼亚州的PACE计划下，PACE评估通过哪种机制偿还？

options.en: Property assessments collected with the property tax bill
options.cn: 随物业税账单征收的物业评估

options.en: Annual invoices billed by the installing contractor
options.cn: 由安装承包商开具的年度发票

options.en: Monthly payments directly to the program administrator
options.cn: 每月直接向项目管理方支付

options.en: A lump-sum payment at close of escrow
options.cn: 托管结束时的一次性付款

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22016 defines a PACE program as one funded through property assessments, meaning repayment runs with the property and is collected alongside property taxes.
explanation_cn: 《金融法典》第22016条将PACE计划定义为通过物业评估提供资金的计划，这意味着偿还与物业一同进行，并与物业税一起征收。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22016

question_en: A PACE improvement must have which characteristic to qualify as an 'efficiency improvement' under California law?
question_cn: 根据加利福尼亚法律，PACE 改进必须具备哪种特征才能被认定为“效率改进”？

options.en: It must be a permanent improvement fixed to real property
options.cn: 它必须是固定在不动产上的永久性改进

options.en: It must be removable without structural damage to the property
options.cn: 它必须可以在不对财产造成结构性损害的情况下拆除

options.en: It must reduce energy consumption by a measurable percentage
options.cn: 它必须能够通过可测量的百分比减少能源消耗

options.en: It must be installed on residential property only
options.cn: 它必须仅安装在住宅物业上

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22019 defines 'efficiency improvement' as one or more permanent improvements fixed to real property that are financed through a PACE assessment.
explanation_cn: 《金融法典》第 22019 条将“效率改进”定义为通过 PACE 评估融资的一项或多项固定在不动产上的永久性改进。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22019

question_en: Which of the following entities qualifies as a 'public agency' that may establish or participate in a PACE program under the California Financing Law?
question_cn: 以下哪一实体符合“公共机构”的资格，可以根据加利福尼亚融资法建立或参与PACE计划？

options.en: A private utility company operating under state franchise
options.cn: 在州特许下运营的私营公用事业公司

options.en: A state-chartered insurance company managing assessments
options.cn: 管理评估的州特许保险公司

options.en: A joint powers authority that uses a program administrator
options.cn: 使用项目管理员的联合权力机构

options.en: A federal housing authority or HUD field office
options.cn: 联邦住房管理局或HUD现场办公室

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22020 expressly lists a joint powers authority among the entities that qualify as a public agency for PACE program purposes, provided it has established or participates in a PACE program and utilizes a program administrator.
explanation_cn: 《财政法》第22020条明确列出联合权力机构作为符合PACE计划目的的公共机构实体，只要它已建立或参与PACE计划，并使用项目管理员。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22020

question_en: A contractor is hired to install a new roof under a PACE program. The contractor tells the homeowner that only energy-efficient improvements qualify for PACE financing. The homeowner asks whether a standard composition roof qualifies. Which standard should guide the contractor's answer?
question_cn: 一名承包商受雇在PACE计划下安装新屋顶。承包商告诉房主，只有节能改进才符合PACE融资资格。房主询问标准的组合屋顶是否符合资格。承包商的回答应遵循哪个标准？

options.en: Only solar, wind, or geothermal improvements qualify under PACE
options.cn: 只有太阳能、风能或地热改进符合PACE要求

options.en: The improvement must be approved by the Commissioner of DFPI
options.cn: 改进必须得到DFPI专员批准

options.en: The improvement must achieve a minimum energy savings rating
options.cn: 改进必须达到最低能效节能评级

options.en: The improvement must be permanently fixed to real property
options.cn: 改进必须永久固定在不动产上

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22019 defines 'efficiency improvement' as one or more permanent improvements fixed to real property financed through a PACE assessment. Whether a specific improvement qualifies depends on the program's scope, but the statutory baseline is that it must be permanent and fixed to real property.
explanation_cn: 金融法第22019条将“效率改进”定义为通过PACE评估融资的一项或多项永久固定在不动产上的改进。具体改进是否符合资格取决于项目范围，但法定基线是它必须是永久性并且固定在不动产上。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22019

question_en: A PACE program administrator fails to pay its annual assessment to the commissioner by October 31. What is the immediate financial consequence?
question_cn: PACE 项目管理员未能在 10 月 31 日之前向专员支付年度评估费用。立即的财政后果是什么？

options.en: A flat fine of $500 per licensed location
options.cn: 每个持证地点罚款 500 美元

options.en: An additional 1% of the assessment per month delayed
options.cn: 每延迟一月，评估费用额外加 1%

options.en: Automatic license suspension with no further notice required
options.cn: 自动暂停执照，无需另行通知

options.en: An additional 5% of the assessment per month delayed
options.cn: 每延迟一月，评估费用额外加 5%

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22107(b) expressly states that if payment is not made by October 31, the commissioner shall assess a penalty of 1 percent of the assessment for each month or part of a month that payment is delayed or withheld.
explanation_cn: 《加州金融法典》第22107(b)条明确规定，若未在10月31日前付款，专员应就每延迟或扣留付款一个月（不足一个月也按一个月计），按评估费的1%加收罚款。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22107

question_en: What is the minimum annual assessment a PACE program administrator licensee must pay per licensed location, regardless of its gross income?
question_cn: PACE 项目管理执照持有人每个许可地点每年必须支付的最低年费是多少，无论其总收入多少？

options.en: $500 per licensed location per year
options.cn: 每个许可地点每年 500 美元

options.en: $100 per licensed location per year
options.cn: 每个许可地点每年 100 美元

options.en: $250 per licensed location per year
options.cn: 每个许可地点每年 250 美元

options.en: $1,000 per licensed location per year
options.cn: 每个许可地点每年 1,000 美元

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22107(c) states that a licensee shall neither be assessed for nor be permitted to pay less than two hundred fifty dollars ($250) per licensed location per year.
explanation_cn: 《金融法典》第 22107(c) 条规定，许可持有人每个许可地点每年不得被收取或支付少于 250 美元。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22107

question_en: A program administrator applies for a license and submits financial statements showing a net worth of $20,000. What will the commissioner do with this application?
question_cn: 一名项目管理员申请执照，并提交显示净资产为20,000美元的财务报表。专员将如何处理此申请？

options.en: Issue the license with a conditional net worth waiver
options.cn: 在条件性净资产豁免下发放执照

options.en: Deny the application for insufficient net worth
options.cn: 因净资产不足而拒绝申请

options.en: Issue the license if all other requirements are satisfied
options.cn: 如果满足其他所有要求，则发放执照

options.en: Allow the applicant 90 days to increase net worth
options.cn: 允许申请人有90天时间增加净资产

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22104(a) requires a program administrator applicant to demonstrate a net worth of at least $25,000 and to maintain that net worth at all times. A $20,000 net worth falls below this minimum, warranting denial.
explanation_cn: 《财务法典》第22104(a)条要求项目管理员申请人必须证明净资产至少为25,000美元，并始终维持该净资产。20,000美元的净资产低于此最低要求，应予拒绝。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22104

question_en: A non-refundable application fee must be paid when filing for a program administrator license. If the application is later denied, what happens to the investigation fee and application fee already paid?
question_cn: 申请项目管理员执照时必须支付不可退还的申请费。如果申请后来被拒绝，已支付的调查费和申请费会怎样处理？

options.en: Only the application fee is refunded upon denial
options.cn: 拒绝时，只有申请费会被退还

options.en: Both fees are refunded minus processing costs
options.cn: 两项费用都会退还，但会扣除处理费用

options.en: Neither fee is refunded if the application is denied
options.cn: 如果申请被拒绝，两项费用都不退还

options.en: Only the investigation fee is refunded upon denial
options.cn: 拒绝时，只有调查费会被退还

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22103(a) explicitly states that the investigation fee and the application fee are not refundable if an application is denied or withdrawn.
explanation_cn: 《金融法》第22103(a)条明确规定，如果申请被拒绝或撤回，调查费和申请费均不予退还。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22103

question_en: A program administrator licensee with an office outside California refuses to make its books and records available to the commissioner's representatives in California. What exposure does this create?
question_cn: 一个在加利福尼亚州以外设有办公室的项目管理员许可持有人拒绝向加利福尼亚州专员的代表提供其账簿和记录。这会造成什么风险？

options.en: Exposure only if the commissioner travels to the out-of-state office
options.cn: 仅在专员前往州外办公室时有风险

options.en: No exposure, because out-of-state books are exempt from review
options.cn: 没有风险，因为州外账簿不需要审核

options.en: Violation of the agreement made upon filing the application
options.cn: 违反了在提交申请时达成的协议

options.en: Exposure only if the licensed loans are not separately maintained
options.cn: 仅在未单独维护许可贷款时有风险

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22106(b)(1) states that an application for a license at an out-of-state location constitutes an agreement to make the licensee's books, accounts, papers, records, and files available to the commissioner in California. Refusal breaches that agreement and exposes the licensee to enforcement action.
explanation_cn: 《财政法》第22106(b)(1)条规定，在州外地点申请许可即构成同意向加利福尼亚州专员提供许可持有人的账簿、账户、文件、记录和档案。拒绝会违反该协议，并使许可持有人面临执法行动的风险。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22106

question_en: Under California Financial Code Section 22684, what is the maximum financing amount allowed for the first $700,000 of a property's value under a PACE assessment contract?
question_cn: 根据加利福尼亚州《金融法典》第22684条，对于PACE评估合同下的物业价值前70万美元，允许的最高融资金额是多少？

options.en: Less than 20 percent of the property's value
options.cn: 少于物业价值的20%

options.en: Less than 25 percent of the property's value
options.cn: 少于物业价值的25%

options.en: Less than 15 percent of the property's value
options.cn: 少于物业价值的15%

options.en: Less than 10 percent of the property's value
options.cn: 少于物业价值的10%

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22684(h) states that PACE financing shall be less than 15 percent of property value up to the first $700,000, inclusive of existing assessments.
explanation_cn: 《金融法典》第22684(h)条规定，PACE融资金额应少于物业价值的15%，适用于前70万美元，包括现有评估。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22684

question_en: A property owner declared bankruptcy two years and six months before applying for PACE financing. Under what condition, if any, may the assessment contract still be executed?
question_cn: 房地产所有者在申请PACE融资前两年零六个月宣告破产。在什么情况下，如果有的话，该评估合同仍可以执行？

options.en: Yes, if the bankruptcy was discharged and no mortgage or non-medical debt payment has been more than 30 days late in the prior 12 months
options.cn: 是的，如果破产已解除，并且在过去12个月里没有任何抵押贷款或非医疗债务的付款超过30天未支付

options.en: Only if the bankruptcy was voluntarily dismissed by the owner
options.cn: 只有在破产由所有者自愿撤销的情况下

options.en: Never — any bankruptcy within five years is disqualifying
options.cn: 永远不——五年内的任何破产都会导致不符合条件

options.en: Yes, if the owner provides a letter of explanation to the administrator
options.cn: 是的，如果所有者向管理员提供解释信

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22684(d) permits execution of the contract when the bankruptcy was discharged or dismissed between two and four years before application and the owner has had no payments more than 30 days past due on mortgage or nonmortgage debt (excluding medical debt) in the prior 12 months.
explanation_cn: 《金融法典》第22684(d)条允许在申请前两到四年内破产已解除或撤销，并且所有者在过去12个月里没有抵押贷款或非抵押贷款债务（不包括医疗债务）的付款超过30天逾期的情况下签订合同。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22684

question_en: Under California Financial Code Section 22686, what must a program administrator establish before executing a PACE assessment contract?
question_cn: 根据加利福尼亚财政法典第22686条，在执行PACE评估合同之前，项目管理员必须建立什么？

options.en: That the contractor holds an active CSLB license in good standing
options.cn: 承包商持有有效且状态良好的CSLB执照

options.en: A reasonable good faith determination of the owner's ability to pay
options.cn: 对业主支付能力的合理诚信判断

options.en: That the property is insured for its full replacement value
options.cn: 房产已投保至其全额重置价值

options.en: That competing bids were obtained for the home improvement work
options.cn: 已为住宅改进工作获取竞争性报价

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22686 requires the program administrator to make a reasonable good faith determination that the property owner has a reasonable ability to pay the annual PACE assessment obligations before executing the contract.
explanation_cn: 财政法典第22686条要求项目管理员在签订合同之前，合理诚信地判断业主有合理能力支付年度PACE评估义务。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22686

question_en: Under California Financial Code Section 22684, how must a program administrator assess the overall affordability of a PACE assessment relative to all debt on the property?
question_cn: 根据加利福尼亚金融法第22684条，项目管理员如何评估PACE评估相对于物业所有债务的整体可负担性？

options.en: Verify that PACE financing alone is less than 10 percent of market value
options.cn: 核实PACE融资本身是否低于市场价值的10%

options.en: Confirm PACE payments do not exceed 25 percent of gross monthly income
options.cn: 确认PACE付款不超过月总收入的25%

options.en: Verify total PACE assessments and mortgage debt do not exceed 97 percent of market value
options.cn: 核实PACE评估和抵押贷款债务总额不超过市场价值的97%

options.en: Confirm total liens on the property do not exceed 80 percent of appraised value
options.cn: 确认物业上的总留置权不超过评估价值的80%

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22684(i) requires that the total of all PACE assessments and mortgage-related debt on the subject property will not exceed 97 percent of the property's market value as established by the required valuation under Section 22685.
explanation_cn: 金融法第22684(i)条要求，受影响物业上所有PACE评估和抵押相关债务的总额不得超过根据第22685条规定的所需估值确定的物业市场价值的97%。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22684

question_en: A PACE program administrator determines that a homeowner's actual financed amount exceeds what the ability-to-pay analysis supported. Who bears financial responsibility for that difference?
question_cn: PACE 项目管理员确定，房主的实际融资金额超过了支付能力分析所支持的金额。谁对这一差额承担财务责任？

options.en: The property owner who signed the assessment contract
options.cn: 签署评估合同的房产所有者

options.en: The contractor who performed the home improvement work
options.cn: 执行家庭改进工作的承包商

options.en: The PACE solicitor agent who submitted the application
options.cn: 提交申请的 PACE 推销代理人

options.en: The program administrator who approved the financing
options.cn: 批准融资的项目管理员

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22687(g)(1) states that if there is a difference between the ability-to-pay determination and the actual amount financed, and the property owner is obligated on the underlying home improvement contract, the program administrator is responsible for that difference.
explanation_cn: 财务法典第22687(g)(1)条规定，如果支付能力测定与实际融资金额之间存在差异，并且房主对基础家庭改进合同负有义务，则项目管理员对该差额负责。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22687

question_en: Under what circumstance does Financial Code Section 22687(g) NOT require the program administrator to cover the difference between ability-to-pay and actual amount financed?
question_cn: 在什么情况下，《财政法典》第22687(g)条款不要求项目管理员承担支付能力与实际融资金额之间的差额？

options.en: When the PACE solicitor failed to disclose financing terms
options.cn: 当PACE推销员未能披露融资条款时

options.en: When the property owner refinanced within the prior year
options.cn: 当房产所有人在前一年内进行了再融资时

options.en: When the property owner failed to submit tax return documentation
options.cn: 当房产所有人未提交税务申报文件时

options.en: When the property owner intentionally misrepresented their income
options.cn: 当房产所有人故意虚报收入时

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22687(g)(1) expressly states that the program administrator's responsibility for the difference does not apply in a case of intentional misrepresentation by the property owner.
explanation_cn: 《财政法典》第22687(g)(1)条明确规定，在房产所有人故意虚报的情况下，项目管理员对差额的责任不适用。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22687

question_en: When evaluating a homeowner's ability to pay a PACE assessment, which of the following sources of income is expressly prohibited from being counted?
question_cn: 在评估房主支付 PACE 评估的能力时，下列哪种收入来源明确禁止计入？

options.en: Government benefit income not subject to a means test
options.cn: 不受资产审查的政府福利收入

options.en: Most recent IRS W-2 wages from current employer
options.cn: 来自当前雇主的最近 IRS W-2 工资

options.en: Equity proceeds derived from the subject property
options.cn: 来源于该物业的股权收益

options.en: Regular employer payroll deposits verified by bank statements
options.cn: 由银行对账单验证的常规雇主工资存款

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22687(b)(2)(C) expressly prohibits counting proceeds derived from the equity of the subject property as income when evaluating ability to pay.
explanation_cn: 财务法规第 22687(b)(2)(C) 条明确禁止在评估支付能力时将来源于该物业股权的收益计入收入。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22687

question_en: A homeowner needs an emergency HVAC replacement and wants PACE financing immediately. What is the maximum assessment amount allowed under the emergency waiver provision?
question_cn: 房主需要紧急更换暖通空调，并希望立即使用PACE融资。在紧急豁免条款下，允许的最高评估金额是多少？

options.en: Fifteen thousand dollars or a monthly payment of one hundred twenty-five dollars
options.cn: 一万五千美元或每月一百二十五美元的付款

options.en: Ten thousand dollars or a monthly payment of one hundred dollars
options.cn: 一万美元或每月一百美元的付款

options.en: Twenty-five thousand dollars or a monthly payment of one hundred fifty dollars
options.cn: 二万五千美元或每月一百五十美元的付款

options.en: Twenty thousand dollars or a monthly payment of two hundred dollars
options.cn: 二万美元或每月二百美元的付款

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22687(e)(6) provides that under the emergency HVAC waiver, the assessment contract may not exceed $15,000 or a monthly equivalent payment of $125, as adjusted by the California Consumer Price Index, whichever is greater.
explanation_cn: 《金融法典》第22687(e)(6)条规定，根据紧急暖通空调豁免，评估合同不得超过15,000美元或每月等值支付125美元（按加州消费者价格指数调整），以较高者为准。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22687

question_en: When a program administrator evaluates a homeowner's PACE ability-to-pay, which of the following debt obligations must be included in the analysis?
question_cn: 当项目管理员评估房主的PACE支付能力时，必须在分析中包括以下哪些债务义务？

options.en: Only mortgage obligations directly tied to the subject property
options.cn: 仅与目标房产直接相关的抵押贷款义务

options.en: All secured and unsecured debt, alimony, and child support
options.cn: 所有有担保和无担保债务、赡养费和子女抚养费

options.en: Only debts reported voluntarily by the property owner
options.cn: 仅房主自愿报告的债务

options.en: Only the mortgage payment on the subject property
options.cn: 仅目标房产的抵押贷款付款

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22687(c) requires the program administrator to consider all secured and unsecured debt, alimony, child support, and monthly housing expenses when determining ability to pay.
explanation_cn: 财务法第22687(c)条要求项目管理员在确定支付能力时考虑所有有担保和无担保债务、赡养费、子女抚养费以及每月住房费用。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22687

question_en: A PACE program administrator's ability-to-pay calculation must ensure sufficient residual income remains after all obligations are met. Which of the following is listed as a required category of basic living expenses in the residual income analysis?
question_cn: PACE 项目管理员在进行支付能力计算时，必须确保在满足所有义务后仍有足够的剩余收入。以下哪项被列为剩余收入分析中所要求的基本生活费用类别？

options.en: Property equity and investment portfolio maintenance costs
options.cn: 房地产权益和投资组合维护费用

options.en: Food, transportation to work or school, and utility expenses
options.cn: 食物、上下班或上学的交通费用，以及水电费用

options.en: Vacation travel costs and secondary vehicle expenses
options.cn: 假期旅行费用和第二辆车的费用

options.en: Entertainment, recreation, and discretionary spending estimates
options.cn: 娱乐、休闲和自由支出估算

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22687(d)(4) defines basic household living expenses as including food and necessary consumables, transportation costs to work or school including fuel and auto insurance, and utility expenses for telecommunications, water, sewage, electricity, and gas.
explanation_cn: 《金融法典》第22687(d)(4)条将基本家庭生活费用定义为包括食物和必要的消耗品、上下班或上学的交通费用（包括燃料和汽车保险）、以及电信、水、污水、电力和燃气的公用事业费用。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22687

question_en: What is the maximum administrative fine the commissioner may assess against a PACE program contractor in a single citation for a violation?
question_cn: 专员在单次违规引用中对PACE项目承包商可评估的最高行政罚款是多少？

options.en: Up to ten thousand dollars per citation
options.cn: 每次引用最高一万美元

options.en: Up to one thousand dollars per citation
options.cn: 每次引用最高一千美元

options.en: Up to two thousand five hundred dollars per citation
options.cn: 每次引用最高二千五百美元

options.en: Up to five thousand dollars per citation
options.cn: 每次引用最高五千美元

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22707.5(a) expressly caps the administrative fine in a single citation at $2,500, deposited into the Financial Protection Fund.
explanation_cn: 《金融法典》第22707.5(a)条明确将单次引用的行政罚款上限设定为2,500美元，并存入金融保护基金。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22707.5

question_en: A contractor willfully misrepresents PACE financing terms to a homeowner, violating the California Financial Code. What is the maximum civil penalty per violation the commissioner may seek in court?
question_cn: 承包商故意向房主歪曲 PACE 融资条款，违反了加利福尼亚金融法典。专员在法庭上每次违规可寻求的最高民事罚金是多少？

options.en: $2,500 for each violation
options.cn: 每次违规 $2,500

options.en: $500 for each violation
options.cn: 每次违规 $500

options.en: $10,000 for each violation
$1,000 for each violation
options.cn: 每次违规 $1,000

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22713(c) caps the civil penalty for willful violations at $2,500 per violation, recoverable in a civil action brought by the commissioner in the name of the people of California.
explanation_cn: 金融法典第 22713(c) 条将故意违规的民事罚金上限规定为每次违规 $2,500，可由专员以加州人民的名义通过民事诉讼追讨。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22713

question_en: When the commissioner seeks to enforce an unpaid administrative fine in superior court, how many calendar days before the hearing must the contractor receive notice of the court application?
question_cn: 当专员寻求在高等法院执行未支付的行政罚款时，承包商必须在听证会前多少个日历天收到法院申请的通知？

options.en: Not less than 10 calendar days before the hearing
options.cn: 在听证会前不少于10个日历天

options.en: Not less than 30 calendar days before the hearing
options.cn: 在听证会前不少于30个日历天

options.en: Not less than 15 calendar days before the hearing
options.cn: 在听证会前不少于15个日历天

options.en: Not less than 60 calendar days before the hearing
options.cn: 在听证会前不少于60个日历天

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22707.5(e)(3) requires the commissioner to serve the contractor with a copy of the application and notice of hearing not less than 15 calendar days before the date set for the court hearing.
explanation_cn: 《财务法》第22707.5(e)(3)条要求专员在法院听证会日期前不少于15个日历天，将申请副本和听证通知送达承包商。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22707.5

question_en: A PACE program licensee fails to file a required annual report on time. For the first five business days the report is overdue, what is the maximum daily penalty the commissioner may impose?
question_cn: PACE 计划的持证人未能按时提交所需的年度报告。在报告逾期的前五个工作日中，专员可以施加的最高每日罚款是多少？

options.en: Up to five hundred dollars per business day
options.cn: 每个工作日最高五百美元

options.en: Up to two thousand five hundred dollars per business day
options.cn: 每个工作日最高二千五百美元

options.en: Up to one hundred dollars per business day
options.cn: 每个工作日最高一百美元

options.en: Up to fifty dollars per business day
options.cn: 每个工作日最高五十美元

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22715(b)(3) sets the maximum penalty at $100 for each business day for the first five business days a required report or information is overdue, escalating to $500 per day thereafter.
explanation_cn: 《金融法》第 22715(b)(3) 条规定，对于所需报告或信息逾期的前五个工作日，每个工作日的最高罚款为 100 美元，此后每日罚款上升至 500 美元。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22715

question_en: After a late-filing penalty order is served on a PACE licensee and no hearing is requested within 30 days, when must the penalty be paid?
question_cn: 在PACE持牌人收到迟交罚款令后，如果在30天内未请求听证，会什么时候必须支付罚款？

options.en: Within 30 business days after the order becomes final
options.cn: 在该命令生效后30个工作日内

options.en: Within 10 business days after the order becomes final
options.cn: 在该命令生效后10个工作日内

options.en: Within 15 business days after the order becomes final
options.cn: 在该命令生效后15个工作日内

options.en: Within five business days after the order becomes final
options.cn: 在该命令生效后五个工作日内

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22715(d) states that if the licensee fails to file a written hearing request within 30 days of service, the order is deemed final and the penalty must be paid within five business days.
explanation_cn: 《金融法》第22715(d)条规定，如果持牌人在送达后30天内未提交书面听证请求，该命令将被视为生效，罚款必须在五个工作日内支付。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22715

question_en: Which scenario would NOT allow the commissioner to impose a penalty on a PACE licensee for failing to submit newly required reporting information?
question_cn: 哪种情况不会允许专员对未提交新要求报告信息的PACE持证人处以罚款？

options.en: The licensee received notice at least 120 days before the filing deadline
options.cn: 持证人在提交截止日期前至少收到120天的通知

options.en: The licensee submitted only partial required information by the due date
options.cn: 持证人仅在截止日期前提交了部分要求的信息

options.en: Notice of the new requirement arrived under 90 days before the due date
options.cn: 新要求通知在截止日期前不到90天送达

options.en: The licensee gave the department advance notice of its intent to file late
options.cn: 持证人事先通知部门其意图晚提交

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22715(b)(2)(A) prohibits the commissioner from imposing a penalty when new reporting information is required and the licensee receives less than 90 days' notice before the information is due.
explanation_cn: 《财政法典》第22715(b)(2)(A)条规定，当需要提供新报告信息且持证人在信息到期前收到的通知少于90天时，专员不得处以罚款。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22715

question_en: A contractor wants to avoid liquidated damages after receiving a CWPA. What action must be taken within 60 days of service?
question_cn: 承包商在收到 CWPA 后希望避免支付违约金。必须在送达后 60 天内采取什么措施？

options.en: Pay only the unpaid wages directly to the workers
options.cn: 仅将未支付的工资直接支付给工人

options.en: File a written request for an administrative review hearing
options.cn: 提交书面申请请求行政复审听证会

options.en: Submit a settlement request to the Labor Commissioner
options.cn: 向劳工专员提交和解申请

options.en: Deposit the full assessment amount in escrow with DIR
options.cn: 将全额评估款存入与 DIR 的托管账户

explanation_en: Labor Code Section 1742.1(b) allows a contractor to avoid liquidated damages by depositing the full amount of the CWPA, including penalties, in escrow with the DIR within 60 days of service.
explanation_cn: 劳工法第 1742.1(b) 条允许承包商在送达后 60 天内，通过将 CWPA 全额（包括罚金）存入 DIR 托管账户来避免支付违约金。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1742.1(b) (Document p. 67, PDF p. 73)

question_en: How are liquidated damages calculated when a CWPA is issued and wages remain unpaid after 60 days?
question_cn: 当发出CWPA后，工资在60天内仍未支付时，如何计算违约金？

options.en: A fixed amount set by DIR regulation
options.cn: 由DIR法规规定的固定金额

options.en: Equal to the wages that remain unpaid after 60 days
options.cn: 等于60天后仍未支付的工资

options.en: Equal to the unpaid wages plus all Section 1813 penalties
options.cn: 等于未支付的工资加上所有第1813条的处罚

options.en: Equal to twice the unpaid wages on the assessment
options.cn: 等于评估中未支付工资的两倍

explanation_en: Labor Code Section 1742.1(a) sets liquidated damages at an amount equal to the wages, or portion thereof, that remain unpaid 60 days after service of the CWPA. They are distributed directly to the affected workers.
explanation_cn: 《劳动法》第1742.1(a)条规定，违约金的金额等于CWPA送达60天后仍未支付的工资或其部分。违约金直接分配给受影响的工人。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1742.1(a) (Document p. 67, PDF p. 73)

question_en: An employee is injured on the job on a Monday. The employer learns of the injury on Thursday. By when must the employer file an occupational injury report?
question_cn: 一名员工在周一工作时受伤。雇主在周四得知此伤情。雇主必须在什么时候提交职业伤害报告？

options.en: By the following Monday
options.cn: 到下一个周一

options.en: Within 24 hours of the injury occurring
options.cn: 在伤害发生后的24小时内

options.en: Within 10 days of the injury date
options.cn: 在伤害发生日期后的10天内

options.en: By the following Tuesday
options.cn: 到下一个周二

explanation_en: Under Labor Code §6409.1, the report must be filed within five days after the employer obtains knowledge of the injury. The employer learned on Thursday; five days later is Tuesday.
explanation_cn: 根据《劳动法》第6409.1条，报告必须在雇主获知伤害后的五天内提交。雇主在周四得知伤情；五天后是周二。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 6409.1 (Document p. 23, PDF p. 46)

question_en: A licensee fails to maintain cash transaction records for employee wage payments. What is the maximum investigative cost the board may assess against the licensee?
question_cn: 执照持有人未能保存员工工资现金交易记录。委员会可以对执照持有人评估的最高调查费用是多少？

options.en: $2,500 in investigative costs
options.cn: 2,500美元的调查费用

options.en: $15,000 in investigative costs
options.cn: 15,000美元的调查费用

options.en: $10,000 in investigative costs
options.cn: 10,000美元的调查费用

options.en: $5,000 in investigative costs
options.cn: 5,000美元的调查费用

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 140 authorizes the board to assess the licensee with actual investigative costs incurred, not to exceed $2,500, for failure to record and preserve cash wage transactions.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第140条授权委员会对未记录和保存现金工资交易的执照持有人评估实际调查费用，但不超过2,500美元。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 140 (Document p. 127, PDF p. 150)

question_en: For how many years must a licensed contractor preserve records of all cash transactions involving employee wage payments?
question_cn: 持牌承包商必须保存涉及员工工资支付的所有现金交易记录多少年？

options.en: Not less than one year
options.cn: 不少于一年

options.en: Not less than seven years
options.cn: 不少于七年

options.en: Not less than three years
options.cn: 不少于三年

options.en: Not less than five years
options.cn: 不少于五年

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 140 explicitly requires licensees to record and preserve for not less than three years any and all cash transactions involved in the payment of employee wages.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第140条明确要求持证人记录并至少保存三年所有涉及员工工资支付的现金交易。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 140 (Document p. 127, PDF p. 150)

question_en: Which of the following license types CANNOT be exempt from the workers' compensation insurance requirement even if the applicant has no employees?
question_cn: 以下哪种执照类型即使申请人没有雇员，也不能免除工伤赔偿保险要求？

options.en: A B General Building contractor with no employees
options.cn: A 无雇员的一般建筑承包商

options.en: A C-39 roofing contractor with no employees
options.cn: A C-39 无雇员的屋顶承包商

options.en: A C-27 landscaping contractor with no employees
options.cn: A C-27 无雇员的园林承包商

options.en: A C-10 electrical contractor with no employees
options.cn: A C-10 无雇员的电气承包商

explanation_en: B&P Code §7125(b)(2) specifically excludes C-39 license holders from the workers' comp exemption regardless of employee status. Even a sole proprietor with no employees must carry workers' compensation if holding a C-39 classification.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》 §7125(b)(2) 明确排除了 C-39 执照持有人享有工人赔偿豁免的资格，无论其是否有雇员。即使是没有雇员的独资经营者，如果持有 C-39 分类，也必须购买工伤赔偿保险。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7125(b)(2) (Document p. 342, PDF p. 365)

question_en: A workers' compensation insurer cancels a licensee's policy due to a material misrepresentation that caused financial harm, with no reimbursement from the insured. Which of the following must ALSO be true before the insurer is required to report the cancellation to the registrar?
question_cn: 因重大失实陈述导致经济损失且被保险人未补偿，工伤赔偿保险公司取消了持证人的保单。在保险公司必须向注册主任报告取消之前，下列哪一项也必须为真？

options.en: The registrar must have already initiated an investigation
options.cn: 注册主任必须已经开始调查

options.en: The cancellation must be reported within 30 days
options.cn: 必须在30天内报告取消

options.en: The licensee must have had at least five employees
options.cn: 持证人必须至少有五名员工

options.en: The insurer must have completed a premium audit or investigation
options.cn: 保险公司必须已经完成保费审计或调查

explanation_en: B&P Code §7125(e)(2)(A) requires all three conditions: (A) completion of a premium audit or investigation, (B) a material misrepresentation causing financial harm, and (C) no reimbursement. All three must be met before the reporting obligation applies.
explanation_cn: 商业与职业法典 §7125(e)(2)(A) 要求满足三项条件：(A) 完成保费审计或调查，(B) 重大失实陈述导致经济损失，(C) 没有补偿。在适用报告义务之前，三项条件都必须满足。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7125(e)(2) (Document p. 343, PDF p. 366)

question_en: Under what circumstance may a contractor's license remain active without a Certificate of Workers' Compensation Insurance on file with the CSLB?
question_cn: 在什么情况下，承包商的执照可以在 CSLB 没有工伤赔偿保险证书的情况下保持有效？

options.en: The licensee holds only a specialty classification
options.cn: 持证人仅持有专项分类

options.en: The license has been placed on inactive status
options.cn: 执照已被置于非活跃状态

options.en: The licensee works only on projects under $500
options.cn: 持证人仅从事低于 500 美元的项目

options.en: The licensee is a sole proprietor operating as a corporation
options.cn: 持证人作为公司运营的独资经营者

explanation_en: B&P Code §7125(d) states that a Certificate of Workers' Compensation Insurance is not required of a holder of a license that has been inactivated on the official records of the board during the period the license is inactive.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 7125(d) 条规定，在执照在董事会官方记录中处于非活跃状态期间，不要求持证人提供工伤赔偿保险证书。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7125(b)(1) (Document p. 342, PDF p. 365)

question_en: At what point does a California contractor become a subject employer required to register with EDD?
question_cn: 加利福尼亚州的承包商在什么时候成为需要向EDD注册的受雇主？

options.en: When wages over $100 are paid in any calendar quarter
options.cn: 当在任何日历季度支付的工资超过100美元时

options.en: When wages exceed $500 in any calendar quarter
options.cn: 当在任何日历季度工资超过500美元时

options.en: When the first employee is hired for any duration
options.cn: 当雇佣首位员工，无论持续时间多久

options.en: When annual payroll exceeds $1,000 for the year
options.cn: 当年度工资总额超过1,000美元时

explanation_en: DE 44 page 14 states a business becomes a subject employer when it pays wages over $100 during any calendar quarter to one or more employees.
explanation_cn: DE 44 第14页指出，当一个企业在任何日历季度向一名或多名员工支付超过100美元的工资时，该企业即成为受雇主。
code_reference: CUIC; DE 44, Page 14

question_en: Once a contractor pays wages over $100 in a calendar quarter, within how many days must the contractor register with EDD?
question_cn: 一旦承包商在一个日历季度支付工资超过100美元，承包商必须在多少天内向EDD注册？

options.en: Within 10 days after paying wages
options.cn: 支付工资后10天内

options.en: Within 30 days after paying wages
options.cn: 支付工资后30天内

options.en: Within 45 days after paying wages
options.cn: 支付工资后45天内

options.en: Within 15 days after paying wages
options.cn: 支付工资后15天内

explanation_en: DE 44 page 14 states the employer must register with EDD within 15 days after paying wages over $100 in any calendar quarter.
explanation_cn: DE 44 第14页指出，雇主必须在任何日历季度支付工资超过100美元后15天内向EDD注册。
code_reference: DE 44, Page 14

question_en: A contractor classifies all framing laborers as independent contractors. An EDD audit later determines they are employees. What is the contractor's most likely exposure?
question_cn: 承包商将所有框架工人归类为独立承包商。EDD 审计后认定他们是雇员。承包商最可能面临的风险是什么？

options.en: A written warning from EDD with no financial penalty
options.cn: EDD 发出书面警告且无财务处罚

options.en: Suspension of contractor's license by CSLB
options.cn: CSLB 暂停承包商执照

options.en: Mandatory enrollment in an EDD payroll webinar
options.cn: 强制参加 EDD 薪资网络研讨会

options.en: Liability for back taxes, penalties, and interest
options.cn: 对补缴税款、罚款和利息承担责任

explanation_en: DE 44 page 15 explicitly states that incorrectly classifying employees as independent contractors can result in liability for back taxes, penalties, and interest.
explanation_cn: DE 44 第 15 页明确指出，将员工错误归类为独立承包商可能导致对补缴税款、罚款和利息的责任。
code_reference: CUIC; DE 44, Page 15

question_en: Under the ABC test, which condition must a hiring contractor demonstrate to treat a worker as an independent contractor rather than an employee?
question_cn: 根据 ABC 测试，雇用承包商必须证明什么条件才能将工人视为独立承包商而非雇员？

options.en: The worker signed a written independent contractor agreement
options.cn: 工人签署了书面的独立承包商协议

options.en: The worker performs work outside the hiring entity's usual business
options.cn: 工人在雇佣实体的常规业务之外执行工作

options.en: The worker holds a valid contractor's license
options.cn: 工人持有有效的承包商执照

options.en: The worker was referred by a staffing agency
options.cn: 工人由人力资源公司推荐

explanation_en: ABC test condition B requires the individual to perform work outside the usual course of the hiring entity's business, as stated in DE 44 page 15.
explanation_cn: ABC 测试条件 B 要求个人在雇用实体的常规业务之外执行工作，如 DE 44 第 15 页所述。
code_reference: CUIC; DE 44, Page 15

question_en: A contractor hires a part-time laborer for occasional weekend work. Can this worker be excluded from employee status because the work is casual or part-time?
question_cn: 承包商雇用一名兼职工人来进行偶尔的周末工作。由于工作的性质是临时或兼职，该工人可以不被视为雇员吗？

options.en: Yes, only if the worker provides their own tools and materials
options.cn: 可以，前提是工人自带工具和材料

options.en: Yes, if the worker averages fewer than 20 hours per week
options.cn: 可以，如果工人每周平均工作少于20小时

options.en: Yes, casual and day laborers are always exempt from coverage
options.cn: 可以，临时工和日工总是免于适用

options.en: No, part-time and casual workers are still covered as employees
options.cn: 不可以，兼职和临时工仍然被视为雇员

explanation_en: DE 44 page 15 states the law does not exclude services from employment that are day labor, part-time help, casual labor, temporary help, probationary, or outside labor.
explanation_cn: DE 44 第15页指出，法律并不排除日工、兼职帮助、临时工、试用期员工或外部劳力的服务纳入雇佣范围。
code_reference: CUIC; DE 44, Page 15

question_en: A contractor purchases a competitor's business that has unpaid EDD payroll tax liabilities. What must the contractor do to avoid inheriting those liabilities?
question_cn: 一名承包商收购了一家有未支付EDD薪资税负债的竞争对手企业。承包商必须做什么才能避免承担这些负债？

options.en: Notify CSLB of the acquisition within 30 days of purchase
options.cn: 在购买后30天内通知CSLB收购情况

options.en: Withhold final payment to the seller until liabilities are negotiated
options.cn: 在负债谈妥之前，扣留对卖方的最终付款

options.en: File an amended return with EDD after the sale closes
options.cn: 在交易完成后向EDD提交修正申报表

options.en: Obtain a Certificate of Release of Buyer (DE 2220) from EDD
options.cn: 从EDD获得买方免责证明（DE 2220）

explanation_en: DE 44 page 18 states that without a DE 2220, the buyer may be held liable for the previous owner's EDD liability up to the purchase price of the business.
explanation_cn: DE 44第18页指出，如果没有DE 2220，买方可能要对前业主的EDD负债负责，金额最高可达企业购买价格。
code_reference: DE 44, Page 18; DE 2220

question_en: A contractor purchases a business and the seller has unpaid EDD taxes. Until the DE 2220 is issued, how must the buyer handle funds to protect against liability?
question_cn: 一名承包商购买了一家企业，而卖方尚未缴纳 EDD 税款。在 DE 2220 表格签发之前，买方必须如何处理资金以防止承担责任？

options.en: Reduce the purchase price by the estimated EDD liability
options.cn: 按估计的 EDD 负债减少购买价格

options.en: Request an EDD payment plan on behalf of the seller
options.cn: 代表卖方申请 EDD 分期付款计划

options.en: Hold sufficient funds in escrow up to the purchase price
options.cn: 在托管账户中保留足够资金，最高可达购买价格

options.en: Pay the seller's taxes directly to EDD immediately
options.cn: 立即将卖方的税款直接支付给 EDD

explanation_en: DE 44 page 18 states the buyer must hold in escrow an amount sufficient to cover all amounts owed to EDD, up to the purchase price, until the DE 2220 is issued.
explanation_cn: DE 44 第 18 页规定，买方必须在托管账户中保留足够金额以覆盖所欠 EDD 的所有款项，最高可达购买价格，直至 DE 2220 表格签发。
code_reference: DE 44, Page 18

question_en: Which payroll taxes are the contractor's direct financial obligation, as opposed to taxes the contractor withholds on behalf of employees?
question_cn: 哪些工资税是承包商的直接财务义务，而不是承包商代员工代扣的税款？

options.en: ETT and PIT are both paid directly by the employer
options.cn: ETT 和 PIT 都由雇主直接支付

options.en: UI and SDI are both direct employer obligations
options.cn: UI 和 SDI 都是雇主的直接义务

options.en: UI and ETT are direct employer-paid contributions
options.cn: UI 和 ETT 是雇主直接支付的缴款

options.en: SDI and PIT are paid directly by the employer
options.cn: SDI 和 PIT 由雇主直接支付

explanation_en: DE 44 page 16 states that UI and ETT are employer-paid contributions, while SDI and PIT are withheld from employee wages.
explanation_cn: DE 44 第16页指出，UI 和 ETT 是雇主支付的缴款，而 SDI 和 PIT 从员工工资中代扣。
code_reference: DE 44, Page 16

question_en: A contractor changes the company's legal entity from an LLC to a corporation solely to qualify for a lower UI tax rate. What consequence does California law impose?
question_cn: 一名承包商仅为了符合较低的失业保险（UI）税率，将公司的法律实体从有限责任公司（LLC）改为公司。加州法律会施加什么后果？

options.en: The contractor is assessed a flat penalty equal to one year's UI taxes
options.cn: 承包商将被评估等于一年失业保险税的固定罚款

options.en: The reserve account transfer and lower rate are denied
options.cn: 拒绝储备账户转移和较低税率

options.en: The contractor is referred to the Attorney General for prosecution
options.cn: 承包商将被移交给总检察长进行起诉

options.en: EDD denies the new entity an employer account number
options.cn: EDD拒绝为新实体分配雇主账户号码

explanation_en: CUIC Section 1052, cited in DE 44 page 18, provides that a reserve account transfer will not apply to any acquisition determined to have been made for the purpose of obtaining a more favorable UI contribution rate.
explanation_cn: DE 44第18页引用的CUIC第1052条规定，储备账户转移不适用于被认定为为获得更优惠的失业保险缴费率而进行的任何收购。
code_reference: CUIC Section 1052; DE 44, Page 18

question_en: When a contractor discharges or lays off an employee, which pamphlet must be provided to that employee at the time of separation?
question_cn: 当承包商解雇或裁员员工时，必须在员工离职时向其提供哪本小册子？

options.en: Employment Determination Guide (DE 38)
options.cn: 就业决定指南 (DE 38)

options.en: Paid Family Leave Brochure (DE 2511) only
options.cn: 带薪家庭假期小册子 (DE 2511) 仅

options.en: For Your Benefit pamphlet (DE 2320)
options.cn: 您的福利小册子 (DE 2320)

options.en: Notice to Employees (DE 1857A) posted in the workplace
options.cn: 员工通知 (DE 1857A) 张贴在工作场所

explanation_en: DE 44 page 19 states the DE 2320 must be given when an employer discharges, lays off, or places an employee on a leave of absence.
explanation_cn: DE 44 第19页说明，当雇主解雇、裁员或让员工休假时，必须提供 DE 2320。
code_reference: DE 44, Page 19

question_en: A contractor's employee voluntarily quits. Is the contractor required to provide a written Notice to Employee as to Change in Relationship?
question_cn: 承包商的员工自愿离职。承包商是否需要提供关于雇佣关系变更的书面《员工通知》？

options.en: Yes, but only if the employee requests it in writing
options.cn: 是，但仅在员工书面请求时提供

options.en: No, voluntary quit is specifically exempt from the notice requirement
options.cn: 否，自愿离职明确免于通知要求

options.en: No, but the DE 2320 pamphlet must still be provided
options.cn: 否，但仍须提供 DE 2320 小册子

options.en: Yes, written notice is always required at separation
options.cn: 是，分离时总是需要书面通知

explanation_en: DE 44 page 19 states no written notice is required if it is a voluntary quit, promotion or demotion, change in work assignment or location, or if work stopped due to a trade dispute.
explanation_cn: DE 44 第19页指出，如果是自愿离职、升职或降职、工作分配或地点变更，或因劳资纠纷停工，则无需书面通知。
code_reference: DE 44, Page 19

question_en: How long must a contractor retain payroll records under California law?
question_cn: 根据加利福尼亚州法律，承包商必须保留工资记录多长时间？

options.en: At least four years from the date of payment
options.cn: 从支付之日起至少四年

options.en: At least ten years from the end of the calendar year
options.cn: 从日历年结束之日起至少十年

options.en: At least two years from the date of payment
options.cn: 从支付之日起至少两年

options.en: At least six years from the filing date
options.cn: 从申报日期起至少六年

explanation_en: DE 44 page 20 states employers must keep payroll records for at least four years.
explanation_cn: DE 44 第20页指出，雇主必须至少保留四年的工资记录。
code_reference: DE 44, Page 20

question_en: A contractor believes all workers on a job are exempt from payroll taxes and keeps no payroll records. If EDD audits and disputes this, how long must the contractor have kept records of payments to service providers?
question_cn: 一名承包商认为在某个工作岗位上的所有工人都免于缴纳工资税，并且不保留任何工资记录。如果EDD进行审计并对此提出异议，承包商必须保存对服务提供者付款的记录多久？

options.en: At least eight years in case of an employment tax audit
options.cn: 最少八年，以便应对雇佣税审计

options.en: At least three years from the end of the tax year
options.cn: 从税务年度结束起至少三年

options.en: At least six years from the date of last payment
options.cn: 从最后付款日期起至少六年

options.en: At least four years, same as standard payroll records
options.cn: 至少四年，与标准工资记录相同

explanation_en: DE 44 page 20 states that if an employer believes workers are exempt, state law requires records of payments to service providers to be maintained for at least eight years in case of an employment tax audit.
explanation_cn: DE 44第20页指出，如果雇主认为工人免税，州法律要求对服务提供者的付款记录至少保存八年，以备雇佣税审计之用。
code_reference: DE 44, Page 20

question_en: A contractor acquires a roofing company and immediately puts the former owner's crew to work. How are wages paid by the former owner earlier in the same calendar year treated for UI tax purposes?
question_cn: 一名承包商收购了一家屋顶公司，并立即让前业主的团队开始工作。前业主在同一日历年早些时候支付的工资在失业保险（UI）税收方面如何处理？

options.en: They are split equally between the buyer and seller for tax purposes
options.cn: 为税务目的，这些工资在买方和卖方之间平均分配

options.en: They are treated as having been paid by the new contractor
options.cn: 被视为由新承包商支付

options.en: They are refunded to the seller after the acquisition closes
options.cn: 收购完成后退还给卖方

options.en: They are ignored; only wages paid after acquisition count
options.cn: 被忽略；只有收购后支付的工资才算数

explanation_en: DE 44 page 18 states that wages paid by the former owner in the current calendar year are considered as having been paid by the acquiring employer for purposes of UI and ETT taxable wage limits.
explanation_cn: DE 44 第18页指出，前业主在当前日历年支付的工资在失业保险税（UI）和就业培训税（ETT）的应税工资上限方面被视为由收购方雇主支付。
code_reference: DE 44, Page 18

question_en: Which of the following worker types is explicitly covered as an employee under California payroll tax law, regardless of hours worked?
question_cn: 根据加利福尼亚州工资税法，下列哪类工人明确被视为雇员，无论工作时间长短？

options.en: Only workers with a signed employment contract
options.cn: 仅与雇主签订了劳动合同的工人

options.en: Only full-time workers on a fixed salary
options.cn: 仅固定工资的全职工人

options.en: Corporate officers whose services are covered by law
options.cn: 法律覆盖其服务的公司高管

options.en: Only workers who have completed a probationary period
options.cn: 仅已完成试用期的工人

explanation_en: DE 44 page 15 states an employee includes any worker whose services are specifically covered by law, such as a corporate officer, regardless of hours or compensation structure.
explanation_cn: DE 44第15页指出，雇员包括任何其服务被法律明确覆盖的工人，例如公司高管，无论工作时间或薪酬结构如何。
code_reference: CUIC; DE 44, Page 15

question_en: A contractor pays a worker by the day for a single job. The worker later claims unemployment benefits. How will the contractor's payments to this worker most likely be treated?
question_cn: 承包商按天支付工人完成单个工作的报酬。后来该工人申请失业救济金。承包商对该工人的付款最可能如何处理？

options.en: As non-taxable payments because the worker is a day laborer
options.cn: 作为免税付款，因为工人是临时工

options.en: As non-reportable income below the quarterly threshold
options.cn: 作为低于季度报告门槛的非可报告收入

options.en: As contractor payments exempt from UI taxes
options.cn: 作为免除失业保险税的承包商付款

options.en: As wages, because the payment method does not change taxability
options.cn: 作为工资，因为支付方式不会改变税务性质

explanation_en: Per DE 44 page 22, payments are considered wages even if the employee is a casual worker, day laborer, or paid by the day. The method of payment does not change the taxability of wages paid to employees.
explanation_cn: 根据 DE 44 第22页，即使员工是临时工、日工或按天支付，支付也被视为工资。支付方式不会改变向员工支付工资的纳税性质。
code_reference: CUIC; DE 44 Page 22

question_en: A contractor provides free meals and lodging to field workers as part of their employment agreement. What is the tax treatment of these benefits?
question_cn: 承包商根据雇佣协议向现场工人提供免费餐饮和住宿。这些福利的税务处理方式是什么？

options.en: They are reportable only if the employee requests it
options.cn: 只有在员工提出要求时才需要报告

options.en: They are wages and subject to applicable payroll taxes
options.cn: 它们属于工资，需缴纳适用的工资税

options.en: They are exempt if the value is under the annual meal rate
options.cn: 如果价值低于年度餐费标准，则免税

options.en: They are always exempt from payroll taxes as fringe benefits
options.cn: 作为附加福利，它们始终免交工资税

explanation_en: Per DE 44 pages 22-23, meals and lodging provided free of charge or at a reduced rate are classified as wages. Their reasonable cash value is reportable and subject to payroll taxes unless an explicit exemption applies.
explanation_cn: 根据 DE 44 第 22-23 页，免费或低价提供的餐饮和住宿被归类为工资。其合理的现金价值需要报告并缴纳工资税，除非有明确的免税规定适用。
code_reference: DE 44 Page 22-23

question_en: A contractor hires the owner's 16-year-old child and pays that child wages. How are those wages treated for state payroll tax purposes?
question_cn: 承包商雇佣业主的16岁孩子，并向该孩子支付工资。这些工资在州工资税方面如何处理？

options.en: Reportable as PIT wages but possibly not as subject wages
options.cn: 作为个人所得税工资报告，但可能不作为应纳税工资

options.en: Exempt from PIT but subject to UI and SDI contributions
options.cn: 豁免个人所得税，但需缴纳失业保险和州残疾保险的贡献

options.en: Subject to both UI and PIT in the same way as any employee
options.cn: 与任何员工一样同时需缴纳失业保险和个人所得税

options.en: Exempt from all payroll taxes and reporting requirements
options.cn: 免于所有工资税和报告要求

explanation_en: Per DE 44 page 22 and DE 231 TE, wages paid by a parent to their own child under age 18 may not be required to be reported as subject wages for UI, ETT, and SDI purposes, but those wages are still reportable as PIT wages to EDD.
explanation_cn: 根据DE 44第22页和DE 231 TE，父母支付给自己未满18岁孩子的工资可能不需要作为失业保险（UI）、就业训练税（ETT）和州残疾保险（SDI）的应纳税工资进行报告，但这些工资仍需向EDD报告为个人所得税工资。
code_reference: DE 231 TE; DE 44 Page 22

question_en: A contractor withholds only California Personal Income Tax for a worker but does not collect UI, ETT, or SDI. What registration obligation does this trigger?
question_cn: 承包商仅为工人代扣加利福尼亚州个人所得税，但不收取失业保险（UI）、就业培训税（ETT）或残疾保险（SDI）。这会触发什么注册义务？

options.en: File a 1099-MISC with the IRS to satisfy registration
options.cn: 向国税局提交1099-MISC以满足注册要求

options.en: Register with the FTB instead of EDD
options.cn: 向FTB注册而不是EDD

options.en: Register with EDD using Form DE 1P
options.cn: 使用DE 1P表格向EDD注册

options.en: No registration is required for PIT-only withholding situations
options.cn: 对仅代扣个人所得税的情况无需注册

explanation_en: Per DE 44 page 22, employers required to withhold California PIT but not other payroll taxes must still register with EDD using the Employers Depositing Only Personal Income Tax Withholding Registration and Update Form (DE 1P).
explanation_cn: 根据DE 44第22页，要求代扣加利福尼亚州个人所得税但不代扣其他工资税的雇主仍必须使用《仅代扣个人所得税登记及更新表》(DE 1P) 向EDD注册。
code_reference: DE 1P; DE 44 Page 22

question_en: A contractor does not withhold California PIT from a worker's wages, believing the worker will pay it directly to the FTB through quarterly estimates. Who bears liability for the unwithheld PIT?
question_cn: 承包商没有从工人的工资中预扣加利福尼亚州个人所得税（PIT），因为认为工人会通过季度预缴直接向加州税务局（FTB）缴纳。未预扣的PIT由谁承担责任？

options.en: The employee alone, because they chose quarterly estimates
options.cn: 仅由员工承担，因为他们选择了季度预缴

options.en: Neither party, if the employee files a timely tax return
options.cn: 如果员工按时提交纳税申报表，则双方都不承担责任

options.en: The employer remains liable regardless of the employee's payments
options.cn: 无论员工是否已支付，雇主仍承担责任

options.en: The FTB, because it accepted the employee's quarterly payments
options.cn: 由FTB承担，因为它接受了员工的季度预缴

explanation_en: Per DE 44 pages 22 and 26, the employer is liable for required PIT whether or not it is withheld. Quarterly estimates paid by the employee to the FTB instead of proper wage withholding may result in an assessment to the employer.
explanation_cn: 根据DE 44表第22页和第26页的规定，雇主无论是否预扣，都对所需的PIT负有责任。员工向FTB支付的季度预缴而非通过适当工资预扣纳税，可能导致对雇主的评估。
code_reference: DE 44 Page 22; DE 44 Page 26

question_en: An employee submits a DE 4 that has words crossed out and unauthorized additions. What must the contractor do with this form?
question_cn: 一名员工提交了一份 DE 4 表格，上面有划掉的文字和未授权的添加。承包商必须如何处理此表格？

options.en: Reject it and withhold as single with zero allowances
options.cn: 拒绝该表格，并按单身且免税额为零计税

options.en: Forward it to EDD for a ruling on its validity
options.cn: 将其转交给 EDD 以裁定其有效性

options.en: Accept it if the employee's signature is still present
options.cn: 如果仍有员工签名则接受

options.en: Use it as submitted to avoid delaying payroll processing
options.cn: 按提交的内容使用，以避免延迟工资处理

explanation_en: Per DE 44 page 25, a DE 4 with major alterations is invalid. The employer must not use it for PIT withholding, must inform the employee, and if no valid replacement is provided, must withhold as if the employee is single with zero withholding allowances.
explanation_cn: 根据 DE 44 第 25 页，有重大修改的 DE 4 表格无效。雇主不得将其用于代扣个人所得税，必须通知员工，如果未提供有效替代表格，则应按员工为单身且无免税额处理代扣。
code_reference: DE 44 Page 25; California Code of Regulations Section 4340-1(b) Title 22

question_en: An employee claimed exempt status on their DE 4 last year but has not submitted a new DE 4 by February 15 of the current year. How should the contractor withhold California PIT?
question_cn: 去年一名员工在其 DE 4 表上申报了免税状态，但在当年的 2 月 15 日之前未提交新的 DE 4 表。承包商应如何扣缴加州个人所得税？

options.en: Stop withholding until the employee corrects the situation
options.cn: 在员工纠正情况之前停止扣缴

options.en: Continue to withhold as exempt until the employee files a new form
options.cn: 继续按免税扣缴，直到员工提交新的表格

options.en: Withhold as single with zero allowances
options.cn: 按单身且零免税额扣缴

options.en: Use the employee's most recent federal W-4 for state withholding
options.cn: 使用员工最近的联邦 W-4 表来进行州税扣缴

explanation_en: Per DE 44 page 25, a DE 4 claiming exempt status is valid only for the calendar year filed. If the employee does not submit a new exempt DE 4 by February 15, the employer must withhold PIT as if the employee is single with zero withholding allowances.
explanation_cn: 根据 DE 44 第 25 页，申报免税状态的 DE 4 仅在提交当年的日历年有效。如果员工未在 2 月 15 日之前提交新的免税 DE 4，雇主必须按单身且零免税额扣缴个人所得税。
code_reference: DE 44 Page 25; California Code of Regulations Section 4340-1(b) Title 22

question_en: A contractor's employee works part of the year in California and the rest in Nevada. The employee is a nonresident. What portion of wages is subject to California PIT withholding?
question_cn: 承包商的一名员工一年中部分时间在加利福尼亚工作，剩余时间在内华达工作。该员工为非居民。加利福尼亚个人所得税代扣的工资比例是多少？

options.en: All wages, because the employer is based in California
options.cn: 全部工资，因为雇主位于加利福尼亚

options.en: Only wages earned during California working days
options.cn: 仅在加利福尼亚工作日赚取的工资

options.en: Wages up to the UI taxable wage limit only
options.cn: 仅限于符合失业保险可征税工资上限的工资

options.en: No wages, because Nevada has no income tax
options.cn: 无工资，因为内华达没有所得税

explanation_en: Per DE 44 page 27, only wages earned in California are subject to California PIT withholding for a nonresident working in multiple states. The amount is calculated based on the proportion of California working days to total working days.
explanation_cn: 根据 DE 44 第 27 页，对于在多个州工作的非居民，仅在加利福尼亚赚取的工资需缴纳加利福尼亚个人所得税代扣。金额根据加利福尼亚工作日与总工作日的比例计算。
code_reference: DE 44 Page 27

question_en: A contractor submits a paper Quarterly Contribution Return and Report of Wages (DE 9) instead of filing electronically. What penalty does the contractor face?
question_cn: 如果承包商提交纸质的季度缴款申报表和工资报告（DE 9），而不是电子提交，承包商会面临什么处罚？

options.en: $20 per wage item reported on the return
options.cn: 每份申报表上报告的每项工资$20

options.en: $50 per return filed on paper
options.cn: 每份纸质申报表$50

options.en: 15% of the total payroll tax amount due
options.cn: 应缴总工资税的15%

options.en: No penalty if wages were zero for the quarter
options.cn: 如果该季度工资为零，则不处罚
