explanation_en: Under the E-file and E-pay Mandate (DE 44, page 60), submitting a paper DE 9 Quarterly Contribution Return results in a $50 penalty per return, regardless of whether wages were paid.
explanation_cn: 根据电子申报和电子支付规定（DE 44，第60页），提交纸质DE 9季度缴款申报表将导致每份申报表罚款$50，无论是否支付了工资。
code_reference: DE 44, E-file and E-pay Mandate; DE 9 Paper Filing Penalty

question_en: A contractor makes a payroll tax deposit by mailing a paper DE 88 instead of filing electronically. What is the penalty?
question_cn: 承包商通过邮寄纸质 DE 88 表格而不是电子提交来缴纳工资税存款。罚款是多少？

options.en: 10% of the total deposit amount due
options.cn: 应缴存款总额的 10%

options.en: 15% of the deposit amount due
options.cn: 应缴存款金额的 15%

options.en: $50 flat fee per deposit submitted
options.cn: 每笔提交的存款 $50 固定费用

options.en: $20 per employee included in the deposit
options.cn: 每名包含在存款中的员工 $20

explanation_en: Under DE 44's E-file and E-pay Mandate (page 60), submitting a paper Payroll Tax Deposit (DE 88) carries a penalty of 15% of the amount due.
explanation_cn: 根据 DE 44 的电子提交和电子支付要求（第 60 页），提交纸质工资税存款（DE 88）将被处以应缴金额的 15% 罚款。
code_reference: DE 44, E-file and E-pay Mandate; DE 88 Paper Filing Penalty

question_en: A contractor's office manager wants to request a waiver from the e-file and e-pay mandate after already filing paper returns for two quarters. Can the waiver be filed retroactively?
question_cn: 一家承包商的办公室经理希望在已经提交了两个季度的纸质报表后，请求免除电子申报和电子支付的规定。此豁免可以追溯提交吗？

options.en: Yes, if EDD approves based on automation issues
options.cn: 可以，如果EDD基于自动化问题批准

options.en: Yes, within 30 days of the paper submission
options.cn: 可以，在纸质提交后的30天内

options.en: Yes, if economic hardship caused the paper filings
options.cn: 可以，如果经济困难导致了纸质报表的提交

options.en: No, retroactive waiver requests are never allowed
options.cn: 不可以，追溯的豁免请求从不被允许

explanation_en: DE 44 (page 60) explicitly states that mandate waiver requests cannot be filed retroactively. Penalties already incurred cannot be eliminated by a subsequent waiver.
explanation_cn: DE 44（第60页）明确指出，规定豁免请求不能追溯提交。已产生的罚款不能通过后续豁免消除。
code_reference: DE 44, E-file and E-pay Mandate Waiver; DE 1245 W

question_en: A contractor is approved for a waiver from the e-file and e-pay mandate for one year. When the approval period ends, what must the contractor do to continue paper filing without penalty?
question_cn: 一位承包商获得了一年的电子申报和电子支付豁免批准。批准期结束时，承包商必须做什么才能继续纸质申报而不受处罚？

options.en: Notify EDD by phone that the waiver needs extending
options.cn: 通过电话通知EDD需要延长豁免

options.en: Request a federal exemption to cover state filings
options.cn: 请求联邦豁免以涵盖州申报

options.en: Continue paper filing until EDD issues a penalty notice
options.cn: 继续纸质申报直到EDD发出处罚通知

options.en: File electronically or submit a new waiver request
options.cn: 以电子方式申报或提交新的豁免请求

explanation_en: Per DE 44 (page 60), once an approved waiver period ends, the employer must either begin filing and paying electronically or submit a new waiver request to avoid noncompliance penalties.
explanation_cn: 根据DE 44（第60页），一旦获批的豁免期结束，雇主必须开始电子申报和支付，或者提交新的豁免请求，以避免不合规处罚。
code_reference: DE 44, E-file and E-pay Mandate Waiver; DE 1245 W

question_en: Which of the following is a valid reason for an employer to request a waiver from California's e-file and e-pay mandate?
question_cn: 以下哪项是雇主申请豁免加州电子申报和电子支付要求的有效理由？

options.en: Being a new business less than one year old
options.cn: 成立不到一年的新企业

options.en: Having fewer than five employees on payroll
options.cn: 工资单上员工少于五人

options.en: Preference for paper records over digital records
options.cn: 偏好纸质记录而非电子记录

options.en: Severe economic hardship preventing electronic filing
options.cn: 严重的经济困难导致无法进行电子申报

explanation_en: DE 44 (page 60) lists severe economic hardship as one of the approved grounds for requesting a waiver from the e-file and e-pay mandate.
explanation_cn: DE 44（第60页）将严重的经济困难列为申请电子申报和电子支付要求豁免的批准理由之一。
code_reference: DE 44, E-file and E-pay Mandate Waiver; DE 1245 W

question_en: A contractor submits a paper DE 9C (Quarterly Contribution Return and Report of Wages Continuation) with 15 wage items instead of filing electronically. What is the total noncompliance penalty?
question_cn: 承包商提交纸质 DE 9C（季度缴款申报及工资报告继续表），包含 15 个工资项目，而不是通过电子方式提交。总违规罚款是多少？

options.en: $300 based on $20 per wage item
options.cn: $300，按每个工资项目 $20 计算

options.en: $50 flat fee for the wage report
options.cn: 工资报告统一收费 $50

options.en: $150 based on $10 per wage item
options.cn: $150，按每个工资项目 $10 计算

options.en: $750 based on 15% of wages reported
options.cn: $750，按报告工资的 15% 计算

explanation_en: Per DE 44 (page 60), paper wage reports such as the DE 9C carry a $20 per wage item penalty. With 15 wage items, the total noncompliance penalty is 15 × $20 = $300.
explanation_cn: 根据 DE 44（第 60 页），纸质工资报告如 DE 9C 的每个工资项目罚款为 $20。共有 15 个工资项目，总违规罚款为 15 × $20 = $300。
code_reference: DE 44, E-file and E-pay Mandate; DE 9C Paper Filing Penalty

question_en: Which of the following required reporting forms must a contractor file to comply with California child support collection obligations?
question_cn: 以下哪种必填报告表格是承包商必须提交以遵守加利福尼亚州的子女抚养费征收义务？

options.en: Payroll Tax Deposit (DE 88) only
options.cn: 仅工资税存款（DE 88）

options.en: Quarterly Contribution Return and Report of Wages (DE 9)
options.cn: 季度缴款申报表及工资报告（DE 9）

options.en: Report of New Employee(s) (DE 34)
options.cn: 新员工报告表（DE 34）

options.en: Employer of Household Worker(s) Annual Return (DE 3HW)
options.cn: 家庭雇员年度申报表（DE 3HW）

explanation_en: DE 44 (page 63) states that timely filing of required forms, including the DE 34, assists the California Department of Child Support Services in collecting delinquent child support obligations.
explanation_cn: DE 44（第63页）指出，及时提交所需表格，包括DE 34，有助于加利福尼亚州子女抚养服务署收取拖欠的子女抚养费。
code_reference: DE 44, Required Forms; DE 34

question_en: A contractor hires an independent contractor and wants to stay compliant with California reporting requirements. Which form must be filed with EDD to report the new independent contractor?
question_cn: 一名承包商雇用了一名独立承包商，并希望遵守加利福尼亚州的报告要求。必须向EDD提交哪种表格以报告新的独立承包商？

options.en: Quarterly Contribution Return and Report of Wages (DE 9)
options.cn: 季度缴款及工资报告（DE 9）

options.en: Report of Independent Contractor(s) (DE 542)
options.cn: 独立承包商报告表（DE 542）

options.en: Report of New Employee(s) (DE 34)
options.cn: 新员工报告表（DE 34）

options.en: Payroll Tax Deposit (DE 88)
options.cn: 工资税存款表（DE 88）

explanation_en: DE 44 (page 63) lists the DE 542 as the required form for reporting independent contractors to EDD. Failure to file this form can result in penalties.
explanation_cn: DE 44（第63页）列出了DE 542作为向EDD报告独立承包商的必填表格。未提交此表格可能会导致罚款。
code_reference: DE 44, Required Forms; DE 542

question_en: What is the primary consequence of a contractor failing to timely file required EDD forms such as the DE 34 and DE 9?
question_cn: 承包商未能及时提交所需的EDD表格（如DE 34和DE 9）的主要后果是什么？

options.en: Mandatory audit of all open construction contracts
options.cn: 对所有未完成的建筑合同进行强制审计

options.en: Penalty and interest charges assessed by EDD
options.cn: EDD评估的罚款和利息费用

options.en: Immediate referral to the Franchise Tax Board
options.cn: 立即转交特许税务委员会

options.en: Automatic suspension of the contractor's CSLB license
options.cn: 承包商CSLB执照的自动暂停

explanation_en: DE 44 (page 63) states directly that timely filing of required forms will avoid penalty and interest charges, meaning late filings result in those financial consequences.
explanation_cn: DE 44（第63页）直接指出，按时提交所需表格将避免罚款和利息费用，这意味着延迟提交会导致这些财务后果。
code_reference: DE 44, Required Forms

question_en: A contractor's bookkeeper wants to make a payroll tax deposit but the business has not enrolled in e-Services for Business. What option does EDD provide to submit the deposit electronically?
question_cn: 一名承包商的簿记员想要缴纳工资税款，但该企业尚未注册商务电子服务。EDD 提供哪个选项以电子方式提交税款？

options.en: Use EDD's Express Pay portal without prior enrollment
options.cn: 在没有事先注册的情况下使用 EDD 的 Express Pay 门户

options.en: Call EDD's Taxpayer Assistance Center to pay by phone
options.cn: 致电 EDD 的纳税人援助中心通过电话支付

options.en: Request a 30-day extension until enrollment is complete
options.cn: 请求 30 天延期，直至注册完成

options.en: Submit a paper DE 88 with the deposit amount
options.cn: 提交纸质 DE 88 表格及缴款金额

explanation_en: DE 44 (page 62) describes Express Pay as a tool that allows employers and their representatives to make electronic tax payments without enrolling in e-Services for Business.
explanation_cn: DE 44（第 62 页）描述了 Express Pay，作为一种允许雇主及其代表在未注册商务电子服务的情况下进行电子税款支付的工具。
code_reference: DE 44, Online Services; Express Pay

question_en: Under California's e-file and e-pay mandate, which of the following actions can a contractor perform using e-Services for Business?
question_cn: 根据加利福尼亚州的电子申报和电子支付规定，下列哪项操作承包商可以通过商业电子服务（e-Services for Business）执行？

options.en: Request a CSLB license bond waiver online
options.cn: 在线申请CSLB执照保证金豁免

options.en: Apply for a CSLB contractor license online
options.cn: 在线申请CSLB承包商执照

options.en: File workers' compensation claims for injured employees
options.cn: 为受伤员工提交工伤赔偿申请

options.en: Protest Unemployment Insurance benefit charges or rates
options.cn: 对失业保险（UI）福利收费或费率提出异议

explanation_en: DE 44 (page 61) explicitly lists protesting UI benefit charges or UI rates as a feature available to employers through e-Services for Business.
explanation_cn: DE 44（第61页）明确列出，通过商业电子服务（e-Services for Business），雇主可以对失业保险福利收费或失业保险费率提出异议。
code_reference: DE 44, Online Services; e-Services for Business

question_en: A contractor discovers that a paper wage report was submitted for a quarter with 10 reported wage items and a paper tax return was also filed for the same quarter. What is the total paper filing penalty?
question_cn: 一名承包商发现某季度提交了一份纸质工资报表，共报告了10项工资，并且同一季度还提交了一份纸质纳税申报表。总的纸质申报罚款是多少？

options.en: $200 for the wage items plus $50 for the return
options.cn: 工资项目罚款 $200，加上申报表罚款 $50

options.en: $50 only because the return drives the penalty
options.cn: 仅 $50，因为申报表决定了罚款

options.en: $100 total as a combined flat-rate penalty
options.cn: 总计 $100，作为统一固定罚款

options.en: $500 based on 15% of total wages reported
options.cn: 基于报告总工资的 15%，罚款 $500

explanation_en: Per DE 44 (page 60), the paper wage report penalty is $20 per wage item (10 items × $20 = $200) and the paper tax return penalty is $50 per return, for a combined total of $250. Wait — 10 × $20 = $200, plus $50 = $250 total. This choice correctly combines both penalty structures.
explanation_cn: 根据 DE 44（第60页），纸质工资报表的罚款是每项工资 $20（10 项 × $20 = $200），纸质纳税申报表罚款是每份申报表 $50，总计 $250。等一下 — 10 × $20 = $200，再加 $50 = 总计 $250。这个选项正确地结合了两种罚款方式。
code_reference: DE 44, E-file and E-pay Mandate; DE 9 and DE 9C Penalties

question_en: A contractor hires a new employee who begins work on a jobsite. By what deadline must the contractor file the Report of New Employee (DE 34) with the EDD?
question_cn: 承包商雇用了一位新员工，该员工开始在工地工作。承包商必须在何截止日期前向EDD提交新员工报告（DE 34）？

options.en: Within 60 calendar days of the hire date
options.cn: 在雇用日期后的60个日历日内

options.en: Within 10 calendar days of start-of-work date
options.cn: 在开始工作日期后的10个日历日内

options.en: Within 20 calendar days of start-of-work date
options.cn: 在开始工作日期后的20个日历日内

options.en: Within 30 calendar days of the hire date
options.cn: 在雇用日期后的30个日历日内

explanation_en: DE 44 requires employers to report all newly hired employees to the NER within 20 calendar days of the first day services were performed for wages.
explanation_cn: DE 44要求雇主在员工开始领取工资的第一天起20个日历日内，将所有新雇员工报告给NER。
code_reference: DE 44, DE 34 reporting requirements

question_en: A contractor purchases an existing construction business and retains several of the prior owner's workers. How must the contractor classify these workers for NER reporting?
question_cn: 一名承包商购买了一个现有的建筑业务，并保留了前业主的几名工人。承包商必须如何为NER报告对这些工人进行分类？

options.en: As existing employees, no report required
options.cn: 作为现有员工，无需报告

options.en: As rehires, only if absent for 60 or more days
options.cn: 作为重新雇用的员工，仅在缺勤60天或以上的情况下

options.en: As independent contractors on the DE 542
options.cn: 在DE 542上作为独立承包商

options.en: As new hires, requiring a DE 34 report
options.cn: 作为新雇员，需要提交DE 34报告

explanation_en: DE 44 states that when a business is acquired and the new owner employs any of the former employees, those workers are considered new hires and must be reported to the NER on a DE 34.
explanation_cn: DE 44指出，当企业被收购且新所有者雇用了前员工中的任何人时，这些员工被视为新雇员，必须在DE 34上向NER报告。
code_reference: DE 44, DE 34 reporting requirements

question_en: A contractor cannot obtain a DE 34 form before the reporting deadline. What action avoids penalty and interest charges?
question_cn: 承包商在报告截止日期之前无法获得 DE 34 表格。采取什么措施可以避免罚款和利息？

options.en: Request a 30-day extension from EDD directly
options.cn: 直接向 EDD 请求 30 天延期

options.en: Wait until the next payroll cycle to report
options.cn: 等到下一个工资周期再报告

options.en: Submit the employee's federal W-4 to the IRS
options.cn: 向 IRS 提交员工的联邦 W-4 表格

options.en: File an informal report or DE 4 copy with EDD
options.cn: 向 EDD 提交非正式报告或 DE 4 表格副本

explanation_en: DE 44 allows employers to file an informal report or a copy of the employee's DE 4 containing all required information to avoid penalty and interest when the DE 34 is unavailable by the due date.
explanation_cn: 当 DE 34 在截止日期前不可用时，DE 44 允许雇主提交一份非正式报告或员工 DE 4 表格的副本，其中包含所有必需信息，以避免罚款和利息。
code_reference: DE 44, DE 34 informal report provision

question_en: When must a contractor report an independent contractor to the EDD on a DE 542?
question_cn: 承包商必须在何时向EDD报告独立承包商的DE 542？

options.en: After the close of the calendar year on Form 1099
options.cn: 在日历年结束后使用1099表格

options.en: Within 30 days of the contract start date only
options.cn: 仅在合同开始日期后的30天内

options.en: At the end of each calendar quarter with payroll taxes
options.cn: 在每个日历季度结束时与工资税一起

options.en: Within 20 days of payments totaling $600 or a $600 contract
options.cn: 在支付总额达到600美元或签订600美元合同后的20天内

explanation_en: DE 44 requires the DE 542 to be filed within 20 calendar days of making payments totaling $600 or more, or entering a contract for $600 or more, whichever occurs first.
explanation_cn: DE 44要求在支付总额达到600美元或签订600美元以上的合同时（以先发生者为准）的20个日历日内提交DE 542表格。
code_reference: DE 44, DE 542 reporting requirements; CUIC § 1088.8

question_en: A contractor fails to deposit withheld payroll taxes on time. Beyond the financial penalty, what additional legal consequence does the contractor face under California law?
question_cn: 承包商未能按时缴纳预扣的工资税。除了经济处罚之外，根据加利福尼亚州法律，承包商还会面临什么其他法律后果？

options.en: A misdemeanor: fine up to $1,000 or one year in jail
options.cn: 轻罪：最高罚款1,000美元或一年监禁

options.en: Automatic revocation of the contractor's CSLB license immediately
options.cn: 承包商的CSLB执照立即自动吊销

options.en: A civil judgment filed by the Franchise Tax Board against the contractor
options.cn: 由特许税务委员会对承包商提起的民事判决

options.en: A federal felony charge with penalties determined by the IRS
options.cn: 联邦重罪指控，处罚由国税局决定

explanation_en: DE 44 states that failing to withhold and remit payroll taxes, even by mistake, can result in a misdemeanor charge. If convicted, the penalty is up to $1,000 or up to one year in jail, or both, at the court's discretion.
explanation_cn: DE 44指出，即使是错误，未能预扣和缴纳工资税也可能导致轻罪指控。如果被定罪，处罚最高可达1,000美元或最高一年监禁，或由法院决定两者兼施。
code_reference: DE 44, Penalty for Failure to Deposit Payroll Taxes; CUIC § 1735

question_en: A contractor's late payroll tax payment goes unresolved after receiving a Statement of Account (DE 2176). What is the next enforcement action California may take?
question_cn: 承包商在收到账户报表（DE 2176）后未解决的延迟工资税付款。加利福尼亚可能采取的下一步执法行动是什么？

options.en: Suspension of the employer's EDD payroll tax account number
options.cn: 暂停雇主的EDD工资税账户编号

options.en: Garnishment of the contractor's personal wages by EDD enforcement
options.cn: EDD执法扣押承包商的个人工资

options.en: A state tax lien at the County Recorder and Secretary of State
options.cn: 在县记录官和国务卿处登记州税留置权

options.en: Referral to the IRS for a federal payroll tax assessment
options.cn: 转交IRS进行联邦工资税评估

explanation_en: DE 44 states that if the balance on the DE 2176 is not paid, EDD may issue a state tax lien recorded at the County Recorder's Office and the Secretary of State, making the delinquency a matter of public record.
explanation_cn: DE 44指出，如果DE 2176上的余额未支付，EDD可能会发出州税留置权，并在县记录官办公室和国务卿处登记，使欠税成为公开记录的一部分。
code_reference: DE 44, Late Deposit, Penalty, and Interest section; CUIC § 1703

question_en: A contractor has no employees and pays no wages during a quarter, but still has an active EDD account. What must the contractor do?
question_cn: 一名承包商在一个季度内没有雇员，也没有支付工资，但仍然拥有一个活跃的EDD账户。承包商必须做什么？

options.en: File a DE 9 electronically indicating no wages were paid
options.cn: 以电子方式提交DE 9，表明没有支付工资

options.en: Skip filing until wages are paid again
options.cn: 在再次支付工资之前跳过提交

options.en: Notify EDD by phone that no wages were paid
options.cn: 通过电话通知EDD没有支付工资

options.en: Mail a paper DE 9 noting zero wages for the quarter
options.cn: 邮寄纸质DE 9，注明本季度工资为零

explanation_en: DE 44 states that as an active employer, a DE 9 must be filed each quarter even if no wages were paid. The return must indicate no wages for that quarter and must be submitted electronically.
explanation_cn: DE 44指出，作为活跃雇主，即使没有支付工资，每个季度也必须提交DE 9。报表必须注明该季度没有工资，并且必须以电子方式提交。
code_reference: DE 44, Quarterly Contribution Return and Report of Wages (DE 9)

question_en: Which primary purpose does the New Employee Registry (NER) serve beyond verifying employment?
question_cn: 新员工登记表（NER）除了验证就业之外，还承担什么主要目的？

options.en: Enforcing workers' compensation insurance compliance statewide
options.cn: 在全州范围内执行工伤赔偿保险的合规性

options.en: Locating parents to collect delinquent child support payments
options.cn: 查找父母以收取拖欠的子女抚养费

options.en: Tracking UI benefit eligibility for laid-off workers
options.cn: 追踪被裁员工的失业保险（UI）领取资格

options.en: Verifying a worker's immigration and authorization status
options.cn: 核实员工的移民及授权状态

explanation_en: DE 44 states that the NER assists California's Department of Child Support Services and Department of Justice in locating parents to collect delinquent child support payments.
explanation_cn: DE 44 表明 NER 协助加利福尼亚州儿童抚养服务部和司法部查找父母以收取拖欠的子女抚养费。
code_reference: DE 44, DE 34 reporting requirements; CUIC § 1088.5

question_en: A contractor overpays UI taxes on a DE 88 before filing the quarterly DE 9. What is the correct way to handle the overpayment?
question_cn: 承包商在提交季度 DE 9 之前在 DE 88 上多缴了失业保险税。正确处理超额付款的方法是什么？

options.en: Show a negative credit amount on the next DE 88
options.cn: 在下一份 DE 88 上显示负数抵免金额

options.en: Reduce the next DE 88 deposit within the same quarter
options.cn: 在同一季度内减少下一份 DE 88 的存款

options.en: File an amended DE 88 for the original payroll date
options.cn: 为原始工资日期提交修正后的 DE 88

options.en: Request a refund check directly from EDD immediately
options.cn: 立即直接向 EDD 申请退款支票

explanation_en: DE 44 instructs employers who overpaid on a DE 88 to reduce the amount of taxes due on the next DE 88 within the same calendar quarter. Negative amounts must not appear on the DE 88.
explanation_cn: DE 44 指示雇主，如果在 DE 88 上多缴税款，应在同一日历季度内减少下一份 DE 88 上应缴税款的金额。DE 88 上不得出现负数金额。
code_reference: DE 44, Correcting Previously Submitted Payroll Tax Deposit (DE 88)

question_en: A contractor's employee was overwithheld for California SDI. Before the contractor can claim a credit or refund from EDD, what must first happen?
question_cn: 一名承包商的员工在加利福尼亚州的 SDI 中被多扣税。在承包商可以向 EDD 申请抵免或退款之前，首先必须发生什么？

options.en: EDD must issue approval before any adjustment is made
options.cn: 必须在进行任何调整之前获得 EDD 的批准

options.en: The contractor must file a corrected W-2C with the IRS first
options.cn: 承包商必须先向 IRS 提交更正的 W-2C 表

options.en: The employee must file a claim with the FTB directly
options.cn: 员工必须直接向 FTB 提出申诉

options.en: The overwithheld amount must be credited or refunded to the employee
options.cn: 多扣的金额必须退还或抵扣给员工

explanation_en: DE 44 states that overwithheld SDI or California PIT must be credited or refunded to the employee before the employer can take a credit or receive a refund from EDD. A receipt should be obtained from the employee.
explanation_cn: DE 44 表明，多扣的 SDI 或加利福尼亚 PIT 必须在雇主可以从 EDD 申请抵免或获得退款之前退还或抵扣给员工。应当从员工处获得收据。
code_reference: DE 44, Correcting Previously Submitted Payroll Tax Deposit (DE 88); CUIC § 1176

question_en: A multistate contractor operates in California and two other states. How may the contractor simplify new employee reporting?
question_cn: 一家跨州承包商在加利福尼亚州和另外两个州开展业务。承包商如何简化新员工报告？

options.en: File only with the IRS using a consolidated federal form
options.cn: 仅使用统一的联邦表格向国税局报送

options.en: Elect to report all new hires electronically to one state
options.cn: 选择向一个州以电子方式报告所有新员工

options.en: File paper DE 34 forms with each state separately
options.cn: 分别向每个州提交纸质 DE 34 表格

options.en: Report only to the state where the employee first worked
options.cn: 仅向员工首次工作的州报告

explanation_en: DE 44 allows multistate employers to elect to electronically report all newly hired employees to one state in which they have employees, provided they notify the Office of Child Support Services.
explanation_cn: DE 44 允许跨州雇主选择向他们有员工的一州电子报告所有新雇用的员工，前提是他们通知儿童抚养服务办公室。
code_reference: DE 44, DE 34 multistate employer provision; CUIC § 1088.5

question_en: A contractor uses Electronic Funds Transfer (EFT) to pay quarterly UI taxes. What determines whether the payment is considered timely?
question_cn: 承包商使用电子资金转账（EFT）支付季度失业保险（UI）税。什么决定了付款是否被视为及时？

options.en: The settlement date in the state's bank account
options.cn: 州银行账户中的结算日期

options.en: The postmark date on the employer's payment stub
options.cn: 雇主付款凭单上的邮戳日期

options.en: The date the contractor initiates the transaction online
options.cn: 承包商在线发起交易的日期

options.en: The date EDD processes and confirms the payment received
options.cn: EDD 处理并确认收到付款的日期

explanation_en: DE 44 states that EFT transactions must settle in the state's bank account on or before the timely settlement date. The settlement date, not the initiation date or postmark, determines timeliness.
explanation_cn: DE 44 表示，电子资金转账交易必须在或之前在州银行账户中结算，以确保及时结算。结算日期，而不是发起日期或邮戳日期，决定了是否及时。
code_reference: DE 44, Using Electronic Funds Transfer section; CUIC § 1110.5

question_en: A contractor closes his construction business on a Wednesday. By when must he submit his final DE 88, DE 9, and DE 9C to EDD?
question_cn: 一名承包商在星期三关闭了他的建筑业务。他必须在什么时候向EDD提交最终的DE 88、DE 9和DE 9C？

options.en: By the following month's last business day
options.cn: 在下个月的最后一个工作日之前

options.en: Within 10 days of closing the business
options.cn: 在关闭业务后的10天内

options.en: By the end of the current quarter
options.cn: 在本季度结束之前

options.en: Within 30 days of closing the business
options.cn: 在关闭业务后的30天内

explanation_en: DE 44 explicitly states that a final DE 88, DE 9, and DE 9C must be submitted within 10 days of closing a business, regardless of normal quarterly due dates.
explanation_cn: DE 44明确规定，无论正常的季度截止日期如何，关闭业务后必须在10天内提交最终的DE 88、DE 9和DE 9C。
code_reference: DE 44, Change to Your Business Status

question_en: A contractor currently has no employees but expects to hire again next quarter. What must the contractor do each quarter to avoid EDD presuming employees exist?
question_cn: 一名承包商目前没有员工，但预计下个季度会再次雇佣员工。承包商每个季度必须做什么以避免EDD假定存在员工？

options.en: Close and later reopen the payroll tax account
options.cn: 关闭并在以后重新开启工资税账户

options.en: File quarterly DE 9 and DE 9C showing no payroll
options.cn: 每季度提交DE 9和DE 9C，显示没有工资支付

options.en: Notify EDD by phone each quarter of inactive status
options.cn: 每季度通过电话通知EDD账户处于非活跃状态

options.en: File a written letter explaining the temporary gap
options.cn: 提交书面信函解释临时空缺

explanation_en: DE 44 requires employers who currently have no employees but may hire in the future to file DE 9 and DE 9C each quarter stating no payroll to report, or EDD may presume employees exist and assess the account.
explanation_cn: DE 44要求目前没有员工但将来可能雇佣员工的雇主每季度提交DE 9和DE 9C，声明没有工资支付，否则EDD可能假定存在员工并对账户进行评估。
code_reference: DE 44, Change to Your Business Status

question_en: What penalty does an employer face for filing a paper DE 9C instead of submitting it electronically as required?
question_cn: 雇主因提交纸质 DE 9C 而非按要求电子提交，会面临什么处罚？

options.en: A $50 penalty for each employee reported
options.cn: 每报告一名员工 $50 罚款

options.en: Suspension of the employer payroll tax account
options.cn: 暂停雇主的工资税账户

options.en: A flat $100 fine per quarter filed on paper
options.cn: 每季度提交纸质表格固定 $100 罚款

options.en: A $20 penalty for each employee reported
options.cn: 每报告一名员工 $20 罚款

explanation_en: DE 44 states that a wage noncompliance penalty of $20 per employee will be charged for filing a paper DE 9C instead of filing electronically as required.
explanation_cn: DE 44 指出，对于提交纸质 DE 9C 而非按要求电子提交，将对每名员工处以 $20 工资不合规罚款。
code_reference: DE 44, Page 73; e-file and e-pay mandate

question_en: A contractor fails to give an employee a Form W-2 by the required deadline. What is the penalty under California law for each such failure?
question_cn: 承包商未能在规定的截止日期前向员工提供 W-2 表格。根据加利福尼亚州法律，每一次此类违规的罚款是多少？

options.en: Twenty dollars per employee not receiving a W-2
options.cn: 每位未收到 W-2 的员工 20 美元

options.en: A 15% penalty on the employee's total wages
options.cn: 员工总工资的 15% 罚款

options.en: Fifty dollars for each employee not provided a W-2
options.cn: 每位未提供 W-2 的员工 50 美元

options.en: One hundred dollars for each W-2 not delivered
options.cn: 每份未交付的 W-2 100 美元

explanation_en: CUIC Section 13052 imposes a $50 penalty for each failure to provide a Form W-2 to an employee, or for providing a fraudulent statement.
explanation_cn: CUIC 第 13052 条规定，对于未向员工提供 W-2 表格或提供虚假声明的，每次违规处以 50 美元的罚款。
code_reference: CUIC Section 13052

question_en: A contractor misclassifies workers as independent contractors instead of employees and fails to file information returns for them. What determines the penalty amount under CUIC Section 13052.5?
question_cn: 承包商将工人错误地归类为独立承包商而非雇员，并未为他们提交信息申报表。根据 CUIC 第 13052.5 条，罚款金额由什么决定？

options.en: The number of quarters wages went unreported
options.cn: 工资未申报的季度数

options.en: Fifteen percent of all payroll taxes owed for the year
options.cn: 全年应缴工资税的 15%

options.en: The unreported payments multiplied by the maximum PIT rate
options.cn: 未申报的付款金额乘以最高个人所得税率

options.en: A flat $50 fine per misclassified worker
options.cn: 每位被错误归类的工人统一罚款 50 美元

explanation_en: CUIC Section 13052.5 and R&TC Section 17041 set the penalty as the unreported payments for personal services multiplied by the maximum personal income tax rate, making it proportional to the amount concealed.
explanation_cn: CUIC 第 13052.5 条和 R&TC 第 17041 条规定，罚款金额为个人服务未申报的付款金额乘以最高个人所得税率，因此与隐瞒金额成比例。
code_reference: CUIC Section 13052.5; Revenue and Taxation Code Section 17041

question_en: A contractor's construction company has been paying wages but has never changed its registered business address with EDD. The company recently moved. What is the contractor's obligation?
question_cn: 一名承包商的建筑公司一直在支付工资，但从未向EDD更改其注册营业地址。该公司最近搬迁了。承包商的义务是什么？

options.en: Notify EDD of the address change as required
options.cn: 按要求通知EDD地址变更

options.en: No action is needed; EDD updates records automatically
options.cn: 不需要采取任何行动；EDD会自动更新记录

options.en: Notify only the IRS, which forwards the update to EDD
options.cn: 仅通知IRS，由IRS将更新转发给EDD

options.en: Update the address only at the next quarterly filing
options.cn: 仅在下一个季度申报时更新地址

explanation_en: DE 44 states that registered employers are required to notify EDD of any change to business status, including a change in physical or mailing address, using e-Services for Business.
explanation_cn: DE 44指出，注册雇主必须通知EDD任何业务状态的变更，包括实际地址或邮寄地址的变更，使用企业电子服务(e-Services for Business)进行通知。
code_reference: DE 44, Change to Your Business Status

question_en: Under California and federal WARN laws, how many days of advance notice must a covered employer give employees before a mass layoff or plant closure?
question_cn: 根据加利福尼亚州和联邦 WARN 法律，受覆盖的雇主在大规模裁员或工厂关闭前必须提前多少天通知员工？

options.en: At least 30 days before the layoff occurs
options.cn: 裁员发生前至少提前 30 天

options.en: At least 10 days before the layoff occurs
options.cn: 裁员发生前至少提前 10 天

options.en: At least 60 days before the layoff occurs
options.cn: 裁员发生前至少提前 60 天

options.en: At least 90 days before the layoff occurs
options.cn: 裁员发生前至少提前 90 天

explanation_en: Both the federal WARN Act and California Labor Code Sections 1400-1408 require covered employers to provide 60 days advance written notice before a mass layoff, relocation, or termination.
explanation_cn: 联邦 WARN 法案和加利福尼亚州劳动法第 1400-1408 条均要求受覆盖的雇主在大规模裁员、搬迁或终止之前至少提前 60 天书面通知。
code_reference: California Labor Code Sections 1400-1408; Federal WARN Act

question_en: A contractor's payroll account with EDD was inactivated. The company later pays wages again. What must the contractor do before filing a wage report?
question_cn: 承包商在EDD的工资账户已被停用。公司随后再次支付工资。在提交工资报告之前，承包商必须做什么？

options.en: File the wage report under the old account number
options.cn: 使用旧账户号码提交工资报告

options.en: Apply for a new employer payroll tax account number
options.cn: 申请新的雇主工资税账户号码

options.en: Submit a paper DE 9C with a reactivation request attached
options.cn: 提交附有重新激活请求的纸质DE 9C表格

options.en: Reactivate the account, then file the wage report electronically
options.cn: 重新激活账户，然后以电子方式提交工资报告

explanation_en: DE 44 explicitly states that if wages need to be reported after an account has been inactivated or ceased, the employer must reactivate the account and file the return and wage report electronically.
explanation_cn: DE 44明确指出，如果在账户被停用或终止后需要报告工资，雇主必须重新激活账户，并以电子方式提交报表和工资报告。
code_reference: DE 44, Quarterly Contribution Return and Report of Wages (DE 9C)

question_en: For wages that remain unpaid when the quarterly DE 9C is due, how should the employer handle the employment taxes owed on those wages?
question_cn: 对于在季度 DE 9C 到期时仍未支付的工资，雇主应如何处理这些工资应缴纳的雇佣税？

options.en: Pay the taxes when wages are actually paid to the employee
options.cn: 在工资实际支付给员工时缴纳税款

options.en: Withhold tax payment until EDD issues a formal assessment
options.cn: 暂缓缴纳税款，直到 EDD 发出正式评估

options.en: Pay employment taxes immediately when the DE 9C is due
options.cn: 在 DE 9C 到期时立即缴纳雇佣税

options.en: Report wages and pay taxes in the following quarter
options.cn: 在下一个季度申报工资并缴纳税款

explanation_en: DE 44 states that unpaid wages should be reported on a DE 9ADJ to protect the employee's wage credit, but employment taxes due on those wages should be paid when the wages are actually or constructively paid to the employee.
explanation_cn: DE 44 指出，未支付的工资应在 DE 9ADJ 上报告，以保护员工的工资信用，但这些工资应缴纳的雇佣税应在工资实际或视同支付给员工时缴纳。
code_reference: DE 44, Quarterly Contribution Return and Report of Wages (DE 9C)

question_en: A contractor files 300 Form 1099-NEC information returns and is not enrolled in the IRS Combined Federal and State Filing program. How must those returns be filed with the Franchise Tax Board?
question_cn: 一名承包商提交300份1099-NEC信息申报表，并且未注册IRS联邦与州联合申报计划。必须如何向特许经营税务局提交这些申报表？

options.en: Send copies to EDD, which forwards them to FTB
options.cn: 将副本发送给EDD，由EDD转发给FTB

options.en: No separate California filing is required for 1099s
options.cn: 1099表格不需要单独在加利福尼亚州申报

options.en: Mail paper copies directly to FTB
options.cn: 将纸质副本直接邮寄给FTB

options.en: File all returns electronically and directly with FTB
options.cn: 所有申报表必须电子方式并直接向FTB提交

explanation_en: DE 44 states that employers not in the Combined Federal and State Filing program who file 250 or more information returns of one type must file electronically directly with the Franchise Tax Board.
explanation_cn: DE 44指出，未参加联邦与州联合申报计划的雇主，如果提交250份或更多同类信息申报表，必须电子方式直接向特许经营税务局提交。
code_reference: DE 44, Information Return (Forms 1099-MISC and 1099-NEC)

question_en: An employer discovers an error on a previously filed DE 9C that was submitted through a third-party electronic payroll system. How must the correction be submitted?
question_cn: 雇主发现之前通过第三方电子工资系统提交的 DE 9C 表格存在错误。应该如何提交更正？

options.en: By calling the Taxpayer Assistance Center to request a correction
options.cn: 通过致电纳税人服务中心请求更正

options.en: Through e-Services for Business regardless of original method
options.cn: 无论原来的方式如何，都通过企业电子服务提交

options.en: Through the same third-party system used originally
options.cn: 通过原先使用的相同第三方系统提交

options.en: By mailing a paper DE 9ADJ to EDD
options.cn: 通过邮寄纸质 DE 9ADJ 表格至 EDD 提交

explanation_en: DE 44 states that employers must correct a DE 9C through e-Services for Business even if it was originally filed using another electronic filing method or a paper form.
explanation_cn: DE 44 表明，即使最初使用其他电子申报方式或纸质表格提交，雇主也必须通过企业电子服务更正 DE 9C。
code_reference: DE 44, Correcting a Previously Filed DE 9C

question_en: A contractor pays wages in the second quarter but incorrectly reports them in the third quarter on the DE 9C. Why does this create a problem for the affected employee?
question_cn: 一名承包商在第二季度支付工资，但在DE 9C上错误地将其报告在第三季度。这会给受影响的员工带来什么问题？

options.en: The employee will owe back taxes for the incorrect quarter
options.cn: 员工将需要为错误的季度补交税款

options.en: The employer will owe an additional 15% penalty immediately
options.cn: 雇主将立即欠额外的15%罚款

options.en: UI and SDI benefits may be calculated using the wrong quarter
options.cn: 失业保险（UI）和残疾保险（SDI）福利可能会使用错误的季度来计算

options.en: EDD will reject the third-quarter wage report entirely
options.cn: EDD将完全拒绝第三季度的工资报告

explanation_en: DE 44 warns that UI and SDI benefits are based on the highest quarter of wages, so reporting wages in the wrong quarter can reduce the benefit amount the employee qualifies for.
explanation_cn: DE 44警告说，UI和SDI福利是基于最高工资季度计算的，因此在错误季度报告工资可能会减少员工有资格获得的福利金额。
code_reference: DE 44, Quarterly Contribution Return and Report of Wages (DE 9C)

question_en: A contractor with a federal government contract signed after December 1, 2003 must list applicable job openings with CalJOBS SM. At what contract value does this requirement first apply?
question_cn: 2003年12月1日之后签订联邦政府合同的承包商必须在CalJOBS SM上列出适用的职位空缺。此要求首次适用于的合同金额是多少？

options.en: Federal contracts valued at $100,000 or more
options.cn: 联邦合同金额为100,000美元或以上

options.en: Federal contracts valued at $50,000 or more
options.cn: 联邦合同金额为50,000美元或以上

options.en: Federal contracts valued at $25,000 or more
options.cn: 联邦合同金额为25,000美元或以上

options.en: Federal contracts valued at $150,000 or more
options.cn: 联邦合同金额为150,000美元或以上

explanation_en: Per 41 CFR 60-300.40, government contractors with a federal contract of $150,000 or more entered into or modified on or after December 1, 2003 must list applicable job openings with the state workforce agency job bank (CalJOBS SM in California).
explanation_cn: 根据41 CFR 60-300.40规定，政府承包商在2003年12月1日或之后签订或修改的联邦合同金额为150,000美元或以上，必须在州劳动力机构的职位库（加州为CalJOBS SM）上列出适用的职位空缺。

question_en: An employer disagrees with an EDD action on their payroll tax account. After escalating through an EDD representative, supervisor, and office manager, what is the next available step?
question_cn: 雇主不同意EDD对其薪资税账户的处理。在通过EDD代表、主管和办公室经理进行升级之后，下一个可用步骤是什么？

options.en: Request an impartial audit from the IRS
options.cn: 向IRS请求公正审计

options.en: Submit a written protest to the Settlements Office
options.cn: 向和解办公室提交书面抗议

options.en: File a formal lawsuit in Superior Court
options.cn: 在高等法院提起正式诉讼

options.en: Contact the EDD Taxpayer Advocate Office
options.cn: 联系EDD纳税人倡导办公室

explanation_en: Per the Employers' Bill of Rights (DE 195), if an employer cannot resolve a payroll tax problem after speaking with a representative, supervisor, and office manager, they may contact the Taxpayer Advocate Office, which reviews the issues to ensure taxpayer rights are protected.
explanation_cn: 根据雇主权利法案（DE 195），如果雇主在与代表、主管和办公室经理沟通后仍无法解决薪资税问题，他们可以联系纳税人倡导办公室，该办公室会审查问题以确保纳税人的权利得到保护。
code_reference: DE 44 - Employers' Bill of Rights; DE 195

question_en: An employer wants to request a filing extension from EDD due to circumstances beyond their control. What is the maximum extension available under standard good cause provisions?
question_cn: 雇主因不可控的情况希望向 EDD 申请提交延长。根据标准正当理由条款，可获得的最长延长时间是多少？

options.en: Up to 90 days when good cause is shown
options.cn: 当显示有正当理由时，最长可延长 90 天

options.en: Up to 60 days when good cause is shown
options.cn: 当显示有正当理由时，最长可延长 60 天

options.en: Up to 30 days for any valid reason
options.cn: 任何有效原因最长可延长 30 天

options.en: Up to two months during a declared emergency
options.cn: 在宣布紧急状态期间最长可延长两个月

explanation_en: Per the Employers' Bill of Rights, EDD may grant a filing extension of up to 60 days where good cause is shown for a delay. A separate two-month extension exists only when the governor declares a state of emergency.
explanation_cn: 根据《雇主权利法案》，若因延迟显示有正当理由，EDD 可批准最长 60 天的提交延长。只有在州长宣布紧急状态时，才存在单独的两个月延长。
code_reference: DE 44 - Employers' Bill of Rights

question_en: A contractor has a disputed payroll tax liability and wants to settle it without going through prolonged litigation. Which types of cases are generally NOT eligible for EDD's Settlements Program?
question_cn: 一名承包商有有争议的工资税负债，并希望在不经过长期诉讼的情况下解决问题。通常哪些类型的案件不符合EDD和解计划的资格？

options.en: Cases involving petitions for reassessment
options.cn: 涉及重新评估申请的案件

options.en: Cases where the employer denies a claim for refund
options.cn: 雇主否认退款申请的案件

options.en: Final tax liabilities and cases involving fraud
options.cn: 最终税务负债和涉及欺诈的案件

options.en: Cases appealed to the CUIAB
options.cn: 上诉至CUIAB的案件

explanation_en: Per the DE 44 Settlements Office section, final tax liabilities, cases still in process, cases involving fraud or criminal violations, and issues solely involving fairness or financial hardship are generally not eligible for the Settlements Program.
explanation_cn: 根据DE 44和解办公室的规定，最终税务负债、仍在处理中、涉及欺诈或刑事违规的案件，以及仅涉及公平性或财务困难的问题，通常不符合和解计划的资格。
code_reference: DE 44 - Settlements Office; DE 231 SP

question_en: A contractor wants to settle an outstanding employment tax liability through an Offer in Compromise (OIC). Which condition must be met for the applicant to qualify?
question_cn: 一名承包商希望通过妥协提议（OIC）解决未清的雇佣税负债。申请人必须满足哪一条件才能符合资格？

options.en: The employer must currently have active employees
options.cn: 雇主当前必须有在职员工

options.en: The liability must still be under active dispute
options.cn: 该负债必须仍在积极争议中

options.en: Full financial disclosure must be provided
options.cn: 必须提供完整的财务披露

options.en: The employer must request a payment plan first
options.cn: 雇主必须先申请付款计划

explanation_en: Per DE 44, full financial disclosure is explicitly required before an OIC offer can be analyzed. All four conditions — final liability, inactive account, financial requirements, and full financial disclosure — must be met.
explanation_cn: 根据 DE 44，分析 OIC 提议前明确要求提供完整财务披露。必须满足所有四个条件——最终负债、账户非活跃、财务要求和完整财务披露。
code_reference: DE 44 - Offers in Compromise; DE 631 C

question_en: Which employers in California finance Unemployment Insurance using the reimbursable method, paying dollar-for-dollar for benefits charged to their account?
question_cn: 在加利福尼亚州，哪些雇主使用可报销方式为失业保险融资，即按账户支出的福利逐美元支付？

options.en: Public entities and 501(c)(3) nonprofit organizations
options.cn: 公共实体和501(c)(3)非营利组织

options.en: New employers in their first two years of operation
options.cn: 新雇主在运营的前两年

options.en: All private employers with more than 50 employees
options.cn: 所有拥有超过50名员工的私营雇主

options.en: Employers with a federal government contract
options.cn: 拥有联邦政府合同的雇主

explanation_en: Per DE 44, public entities and nonprofits described under IRC section 501(c)(3) have the option to become reimbursable employers, paying dollar-for-dollar for all UI benefits paid to former employees charged to their account.
explanation_cn: 根据DE 44规定，公共实体和IRC第501(c)(3)节下描述的非营利组织有选择成为可报销雇主的选项，为按其账户计入的所有支付给前雇员的失业保险福利逐美元支付。
code_reference: CUIC - Reimbursable Method; DE 231NP

question_en: A nonprofit employer elects the reimbursable method for UI financing and later decides to terminate that coverage. For how long does the employer remain liable for UI benefits paid to former employees covered under the reimbursable program?
question_cn: 一个非营利雇主选择通过可报销方式来为失业保险融资，后来又决定终止该保障。雇主在多长时间内仍需对通过可报销计划覆盖的前雇员支付的失业保险福利承担责任？

options.en: One calendar year after terminating reimbursable coverage
options.cn: 终止可报销保障后的一个日历年

options.en: Two calendar years after terminating reimbursable coverage
options.cn: 终止可报销保障后的两个日历年

options.en: Five calendar years after terminating reimbursable coverage
options.cn: 终止可报销保障后的五个日历年

options.en: Three calendar years after terminating reimbursable coverage
options.cn: 终止可报销保障后的三个日历年

explanation_en: Per DE 44, employers who terminate reimbursable coverage remain liable for UI benefits paid to former employees covered under this program for a period of three calendar years after termination.
explanation_cn: 根据 DE 44，终止可报销保障的雇主在终止后三个日历年内仍需对通过该计划覆盖的前雇员支付的失业保险福利承担责任。
code_reference: DE 44 - Reimbursable Method; DE 1378F

question_en: A contractor purchases an ongoing construction business and wants to acquire the previous owner's UI reserve account balance. What is the most important immediate action the contractor should take?
question_cn: 承包商购买了一个正在运营的建筑业务，并希望获取前任所有者的失业保险储备账户余额。承包商应立即采取的最重要措施是什么？

options.en: Wait until the next annual DE 2088 notice is issued
options.cn: 等到下一次年度 DE 2088 通知发出

options.en: Apply for the reserve account transfer immediately
options.cn: 立即申请储备账户转移

options.en: Negotiate with EDD to exclude prior benefit charges
options.cn: 与 EDD 协商以排除以前的福利费用

options.en: Request reversal of the transfer if the rate increases
options.cn: 如果税率增加，申请撤销转移

explanation_en: Per DE 44, there are time limits to qualify for a reserve account transfer, and employers are advised to apply immediately after purchasing an ongoing business using the DE 4453 form.
explanation_cn: 根据 DE 44，储备账户转移有时间限制，并建议雇主在购买正在运营的业务后立即使用 DE 4453 表格申请。
code_reference: DE 44 - Reserve Account Transfers; DE 4453

question_en: A contractor wants to lower their UI tax rate. Which action, if not done promptly, can directly result in incorrect benefit charges being permanently counted against the contractor's reserve account?
question_cn: 承包商希望降低其失业保险税率。如果未及时采取哪项措施，会直接导致错误的福利费用永久计入承包商的储备账户？

options.en: Subscribing to EDD's email notification service
options.cn: 订阅EDD的电子邮件通知服务

options.en: Responding timely to UI claim and wage notices
options.cn: 及时回应失业保险索赔和工资通知

options.en: Scheduling a voluntary exit interview with departing workers
options.cn: 安排与离职员工的自愿离职面谈

options.en: Registering job openings with the CalJOBS SM system
options.cn: 在CalJOBS SM系统中注册职位空缺

explanation_en: Per DE 44, failing to respond timely to the DE 1101CZ, DE 1101ER, or DE 1545 notices forfeits the opportunity to dispute eligibility or incorrect wages, allowing charges to stand against the reserve account and potentially raising the UI tax rate permanently.
explanation_cn: 根据DE 44，如果未及时回应DE 1101CZ、DE 1101ER或DE 1545通知，将失去对资格或错误工资提出异议的机会，从而允许费用计入储备账户，并可能永久提高失业保险税率。
code_reference: DE 44 - Tips for Reducing Your UI Tax Rate; DE 1101CZ

question_en: California law requires employers to properly destroy personnel records containing personal information. What is the consequence if an employer fails to do so?
question_cn: 加利福尼亚州法律要求雇主妥善销毁包含个人信息的人员记录。如果雇主未能做到这一点，会有什么后果？

options.en: EDD may revoke the employer's payroll tax account
options.cn: EDD 可能会吊销雇主的工资税账户

options.en: The employer faces immediate criminal prosecution
options.cn: 雇主将面临立即的刑事起诉

options.en: CSLB may suspend the contractor's license
options.cn: CSLB 可能会暂停承包商的执照

options.en: Employees may sue the employer for civil damages
options.cn: 员工可以起诉雇主以获取民事赔偿

explanation_en: Per DE 44, California law requires employers to properly destroy personal information on all records under their control. Employees may sue the employer for civil damages if the employer fails to protect their confidential information.
explanation_cn: 根据 DE 44，加利福尼亚州法律要求雇主妥善销毁其控制下的所有记录中的个人信息。如果雇主未能保护其员工的机密信息，员工可以起诉雇主以获取民事赔偿。
code_reference: DE 44 - Fraud Prevention, Detection, and Reporting

question_en: An employer protests a tax rate item on the Notice of Contribution Rates and Statement of UI Reserve Account (DE 2088). Within how many days of the notice's issued date must the protest be postmarked?
question_cn: 雇主对《缴费率通知及失业保险储备账户报表》(DE 2088)上的税率项目提出异议。从通知发出日期起，异议必须在多少天内寄出？

options.en: Within 45 days of the issued date
options.cn: 自发出日期起45天内

options.en: Within 30 days of the issued date
options.cn: 自发出日期起30天内

options.en: Within 60 days of the issued date
options.cn: 自发出日期起60天内

options.en: Within 90 days of the issued date
options.cn: 自发出日期起90天内

explanation_en: Per DE 44, a written protest of items on the DE 2088 must be postmarked within 60 days of the issued date on the notice. An extension of up to 60 additional days may be granted for good cause if requested before the deadline.
explanation_cn: 根据DE 44，对DE 2088上的项目提出的书面异议必须在通知发出日期起60天内寄出。如果在截止日期前提出申请，出于正当理由可获延长期限最多60天。
code_reference: DE 44 - Notice of Tax Rates; DE 2088

question_en: A contractor creates a new corporate entity to obtain a lower UI tax rate for their business. What is the consequence of this action?
question_cn: 承包商为了获得更低的失业保险税率而创建了一个新的企业实体。这种行为的后果是什么？

options.en: Pay the lowest UI rate allowed by law
options.cn: 支付法律允许的最低失业保险税率

options.en: Pay the highest UI rate plus 2 percent penalty
options.cn: 支付最高失业保险税率加2%的罚款

options.en: Have their CSLB contractor's license immediately revoked
options.cn: 承包商的 CSLB 执照立即被吊销

options.en: Pay the standard UI rate with no penalty
options.cn: 支付标准失业保险税率，无需罚款

explanation_en: Per DE 44, employers who illegally lower their UI rates through manipulation schemes are required to pay at the highest rate provided by law plus an additional 2 percent penalty.
explanation_cn: 根据 DE 44，雇主如果通过操纵计划非法降低其失业保险税率，将被要求支付法律规定的最高税率外加额外2%的罚款。
code_reference: CUIC; DE 44 UI Rate Manipulation section

question_en: An advisor knowingly helps a contractor illegally lower their UI rate. What is the minimum penalty that advisor faces?
question_cn: 顾问明知帮助承包商非法降低他们的失业保险（UI）费率。该顾问面临的最低处罚是多少？

options.en: A flat fine of $10,000 with no percentage alternative
options.cn: 固定罚款 10,000 美元，无百分比替代

options.en: The greater of $1,000 or 5 percent of underreported contributions
options.cn: $1,000 或低报缴款的 5%，以较高者为准

options.en: A flat fine of $2,500 regardless of contributions
options.cn: 固定罚款 2,500 美元，不论缴款多少

options.en: The greater of $5,000 or 10 percent of underreported contributions
options.cn: $5,000 或低报缴款的 10%，以较高者为准

explanation_en: Per DE 44, the law provides for the greater of a $5,000 penalty or 10 percent of underreported contributions, penalty, or interest for anyone knowingly advising another to violate California's UI rate and reporting laws.
explanation_cn: 根据 DE 44，法律规定，任何明知而劝告他人违反加利福尼亚州失业保险费率和报告法律的人，罚款应为 5,000 美元或低报缴款、罚款或利息的 10%，以较高者为准。
code_reference: CUIC; DE 44 UI Rate Manipulation section

question_en: A contractor sells part of their business to another company under common ownership. What happens to the UI reserve account balance associated with the transferred portion?
question_cn: 承包商将其业务的一部分出售给另一家有共同所有权的公司。与转让部分相关的失业保险储备账户余额会发生什么？

options.en: It is forfeited and returned to the UI Fund
options.cn: 它将被没收并归还失业保险基金

options.en: It remains entirely with the original employer
options.cn: 它完全保留在原雇主处

options.en: It is split equally between both entities
options.cn: 它在两个实体之间平均分配

options.en: It transfers along with the business to the new entity
options.cn: 它随业务一起转移到新实体

explanation_en: Per DE 44, whenever a business transfers all or part of its operations to another employer under common ownership, management, or control, the UI reserve account attributable to the transferred portion also transfers.
explanation_cn: 根据 DE 44，当企业将其全部或部分业务转让给另一家在所有权、管理或控制上有共同关系的雇主时，与转让部分相关的失业保险储备账户也会随之转移。
code_reference: CUIC; DE 44 UI Rate Manipulation section

question_en: What is the maximum amount a contractor's UI reserve account can be charged for a single employee's regular UI claim?
question_cn: 承包商的失业保险储备账户在单个员工的常规失业保险索赔中最多可以被收取多少金额？

options.en: Up to $11,700 per regular claim
options.cn: 每次常规索赔最多 $11,700

options.en: Up to $9,750 per regular claim
options.cn: 每次常规索赔最多 $9,750

options.en: Up to $14,500 per regular claim
options.cn: 每次常规索赔最多 $14,500

options.en: Up to $23,400 per regular claim
options.cn: 每次常规索赔最多 $23,400

explanation_en: Per DE 44, the maximum amount charged to a tax-rated employer's reserve account for each employee on a regular UI claim is $11,700 as of 2025–2026.
explanation_cn: 根据 DE 44，截至 2025–2026 年，每名员工在常规失业保险索赔中向按税率计费的雇主储备账户收取的最高金额为 $11,700。
code_reference: DE 44, Benefit Amount section; CUIC

question_en: A former employee of a contractor files for UI benefits. The contractor believes the employee was discharged for misconduct. Who bears the burden of proof in this situation?
question_cn: 一名承包商的前雇员申请失业保险（UI）福利。承包商认为该雇员是因不当行为被解雇的。在这种情况下，谁承担举证责任？

options.en: Both parties share the burden of proof equally
options.cn: 双方平等分担举证责任

options.en: The claimant must disprove the misconduct allegation
options.cn: 申请人必须反驳不当行为的指控

options.en: EDD must independently investigate and prove misconduct
options.cn: EDD 必须独立调查并证明不当行为

options.en: The employer must prove the misconduct occurred
options.cn: 雇主必须证明不当行为确实发生

explanation_en: Per DE 44, when a claimant was discharged for misconduct connected to their work, proof of misconduct rests with the employer. The contractor must substantiate the claim.
explanation_cn: 根据 DE 44，当申请人因与工作相关的不当行为被解雇时，不当行为的举证责任在雇主。承包商必须证实该指控。
code_reference: DE 44, Benefit Qualifications section; CUIC

question_en: A contractor receives a Notice of Unemployment Insurance Claim Filed (DE 1101CZ) for a former employee. The contractor fails to respond within the protest time limit. What is the consequence?
question_cn: 承包商收到前雇员的失业保险索赔通知（DE 1101CZ）。如果承包商未在抗议时限内回应，会有什么后果？

options.en: The contractor may refile a protest within 30 days
options.cn: 承包商可以在30天内重新提交抗议

options.en: The contractor waives the right to protest reserve account liability
options.cn: 承包商放弃对储备账户责任的抗议权利

options.en: The contractor is permanently banned from future protests
options.cn: 承包商被永久禁止将来的抗议

options.en: EDD automatically denies the claimant's UI benefits
options.cn: EDD自动拒绝索赔人的失业保险福利

explanation_en: Per DE 44, if a written protest is not submitted or is submitted untimely for the DE 1101CZ, the employer waives their right to protest their UI reserve account's potential liability and their right to appeal EDD's determination.
explanation_cn: 根据DE 44，如果未提交书面抗议或提交DE 1101CZ的抗议逾期，雇主将放弃抗议其失业保险储备账户潜在责任的权利，以及上诉EDD裁定的权利。
code_reference: DE 44, Responding to Notices section; CUIC

question_en: A contractor receives a DE 1101CZ notice. Within how many calendar days must the contractor postmark a protest to preserve their appeal rights?
question_cn: 承包商收到 DE 1101CZ 通知。承包商必须在多少个日历日内寄出抗议邮件以保留其上诉权利？

options.en: Within 5 calendar days of the mail date
options.cn: 自邮件日期起 5 个日历日内

options.en: Within 15 calendar days of the mail date
options.cn: 自邮件日期起 15 个日历日内

options.en: Within 10 calendar days of the mail date
options.cn: 自邮件日期起 10 个日历日内

options.en: Within 30 calendar days of the mail date
options.cn: 自邮件日期起 30 个日历日内

explanation_en: Per DE 44's Claim Notices and Protest Time Limits table, the employer must postmark a protest within 10 calendar days of the date the DE 1101CZ was mailed to them.
explanation_cn: 根据 DE 44 的索赔通知和抗议时间限制表，雇主必须在 DE 1101CZ 邮寄给他们之日起 10 个日历日内寄出抗议邮件。
code_reference: DE 44, Claim Notices and Protest Time Limits table; CUIC

question_en: A contractor discovers that wage information on a DE 1545 notice is incorrect. How many calendar days does the contractor have to submit a correction?
question_cn: 承包商发现 DE 1545 通知上的工资信息不正确。承包商有多少个日历天提交更正？

options.en: Within 45 calendar days of the mail date
options.cn: 自邮寄日期起 45 个日历日内

options.en: Within 15 calendar days of the mail date
options.cn: 自邮寄日期起 15 个日历日内

options.en: Within 30 calendar days of the mail date
options.cn: 自邮寄日期起 30 个日历日内

options.en: Within 10 calendar days of the mail date
options.cn: 自邮寄日期起 10 个日历日内

explanation_en: Per DE 44's Claim Notices and Protest Time Limits table, if wage information on the DE 1545 is incorrect, the employer must submit the correction within 30 calendar days of the mail date.
explanation_cn: 根据 DE 44 的索赔通知和申诉时限表，如果 DE 1545 上的工资信息不正确，雇主必须在邮寄日期起 30 个日历日内提交更正。
code_reference: DE 44, Claim Notices and Protest Time Limits table; CUIC

question_en: A contractor's former employee is approved for the California Training Benefits program. Which notice informs the contractor of the maximum potential charges, including training extension benefits, to their UI reserve account?
question_cn: 承包商的前雇员已获准参加加利福尼亚培训福利计划。哪份通知会告知承包商包括培训延伸福利在内的最高潜在费用，对其失业保险储备账户产生影响？

options.en: The DE 1545TE Notice of Potential Increased Liability
options.cn: DE 1545TE 潜在增加责任通知

options.en: The DE 1101CZ Notice of Unemployment Insurance Claim Filed
options.cn: DE 1101CZ 失业保险申报已提交通知

options.en: The DE 1545 Notice of Wages Used for UI Claim
options.cn: DE 1545 关于用于失业保险申报的工资通知

options.en: The DE 1080CZ Notice of Determination
options.cn: DE 1080CZ 裁定通知

explanation_en: Per DE 44, the DE 1545TE is mailed to base-period employers specifically when a former employee is approved for the California Training Benefits program, informing them of maximum potential charges including training extension benefits.
explanation_cn: 根据 DE 44，当前雇员获准参加加利福尼亚培训福利计划时，DE 1545TE 会寄送给基期雇主，通知他们包括培训延伸福利在内的最高潜在费用。
code_reference: DE 44, Claim Notices and Protest Time Limits; CUIC §1269, §1269.1

question_en: A contractor's worker voluntarily quits their job to relocate to another city for personal reasons. Is this worker eligible for UI benefits?
question_cn: 承包商的工人因个人原因自愿辞职搬到另一个城市。这名工人有资格领取失业保险（UI）福利吗？

options.en: No, unless the contractor provides a written separation notice
options.cn: 不，除非承包商提供书面离职通知

options.en: Yes, relocation always qualifies as good cause to quit
options.cn: 是的，搬家总是被视为有正当理由的辞职

options.en: No, voluntarily quitting for personal reasons is disqualifying
options.cn: 不，为个人原因自愿辞职会导致失去资格

options.en: Yes, if the worker registers with EDD within 10 days
options.cn: 是的，如果工人能在10天内向EDD注册

explanation_en: Per DE 44, a claimant may be ineligible for UI benefits if they voluntarily quit without good cause, including quitting for personal reasons or to move. Relocation for personal reasons falls squarely within this disqualifying category.
explanation_cn: 根据DE 44，如果申请人无正当理由自愿辞职，包括为个人原因辞职或搬家，可能没有资格领取失业保险福利。为个人原因搬家完全属于这一导致失去资格的范畴。
code_reference: DE 44, Benefit Qualifications section; CUIC

question_en: A contractor suspects a competing company is paying workers in cash and not carrying workers' compensation insurance. What is the correct way to report this to EDD?
question_cn: 一位承包商怀疑竞争公司通过现金支付工人工资，并且没有购买工伤赔偿保险。向EDD举报的正确方式是什么？

options.en: File a complaint directly with the CSLB only
options.cn: 只向CSLB直接提交投诉

options.en: Complete a DE 660 form or contact EDD's UEO unit
options.cn: 完成DE 660表格或联系EDD的UEO部门

options.en: Report it to the IRS using a federal tax fraud form
options.cn: 使用联邦税务欺诈表格向IRS举报

options.en: Contact the Department of Labor directly for investigation
options.cn: 直接联系劳工部进行调查

explanation_en: Per DE 44, businesses paying workers undocumented cash or failing to carry workers' compensation should be reported by completing the Underground Economy Operations Lead Referral/Complaint Form (DE 660) or contacting EDD's UEO hotline, email, fax, or online portal.
explanation_cn: 根据DE 44，向未登记现金支付工人工资或未购买工伤赔偿保险的企业应通过填写地下经济运营线索转介/投诉表（DE 660）或联系EDD的UEO热线、电子邮件、传真或在线门户进行举报。
code_reference: DE 44, Help Us Fight Fraud section; DE 660

question_en: A contractor's protest to a DE 1101CZ is submitted late, but the contractor claims there was good cause for the delay. What does EDD do in this situation?
question_cn: 承包商对 DE 1101CZ 提出的抗议迟交，但承包商声称有正当理由导致延迟。在这种情况下，EDD 会怎么办？

options.en: Determines if good cause exists before issuing a ruling
options.cn: 在做出裁决前确定是否存在正当理由

options.en: Grants an automatic 15-day extension for any late filing
options.cn: 对任何迟交的文件自动延长 15 天

options.en: Automatically accepts the late protest without review
options.cn: 自动接受迟交抗议，而不进行审查

options.en: Rejects the protest and closes the employer's account
options.cn: 拒绝抗议并关闭雇主账户

explanation_en: Per DE 44, when a late response is received, EDD evaluates whether the employer had good cause. If good cause is found, the employer receives a determination or ruling. If not, a DE 4614 is issued, which can itself be appealed.
explanation_cn: 根据 DE 44，当收到迟交回复时，EDD 会评估雇主是否有正当理由。如果发现有正当理由，雇主将收到裁定或裁决。如果没有，则会发出 DE 4614，该决定本身也可以上诉。
code_reference: DE 44, Claim Notices and Protest Time Limits – Late Response Note; CUIC

question_en: A contractor establishes a new benefit year claim for a former employee who already had an initial claim. What must the contractor do to protect their UI reserve account for the new benefit year?
question_cn: 承包商为已经提交过初始申领的前员工建立新的福利年度申领。承包商必须做什么以保护其新的福利年度的失业保险储备账户？

options.en: Do nothing, as prior rulings apply to all future claims
options.cn: 什么也不做，因为之前的裁决适用于所有未来的申领

options.en: File a new lawsuit against the claimant to stop benefits
options.cn: 对申请人提起新诉讼以停止福利

options.en: Resubmit the original facts furnished on the initial notice
options.cn: 重新提交初始通知上提供的原始事实

options.en: Rely on the original protest already on file with EDD
options.cn: 依赖已在 EDD 档案中的原始抗议

explanation_en: Per DE 44, when a subsequent benefit year is established, the employer must resubmit any facts furnished on the initial DE 1101CZ or DE 1101ER to be entitled to a determination or ruling for the new benefit year.
explanation_cn: 根据 DE 44，当建立后续福利年度时，雇主必须重新提交在初始 DE 1101CZ 或 DE 1101ER 上提供的任何事实，才能获得新福利年度的裁定或裁决。
code_reference: DE 44, Subsequent Benefit Year section; CUIC

question_en: A contractor disagrees with a UI benefit charge to their reserve account. Within how many days must the contractor file a written appeal with EDD?
question_cn: 承包商不同意向其储备账户收取的失业保险福利费用。承包商必须在多少天内向EDD提交书面上诉？

options.en: Within 45 calendar days of the mailing date
options.cn: 自邮寄日期起45个日历日内

options.en: Within 10 calendar days of the mailing date
options.cn: 自邮寄日期起10个日历日内

options.en: Within 30 calendar days of the mailing date
options.cn: 自邮寄日期起30个日历日内

options.en: Within 60 calendar days of the mailing date
options.cn: 自邮寄日期起60个日历日内

explanation_en: DE 44 (Page 96) states the employer must send a written appeal to EDD within 30 calendar days of the date the decision was mailed.
explanation_cn: DE 44（第96页）指出，雇主必须在决定邮寄之日起30个日历日内向EDD提交书面上诉。
code_reference: DE 44, Page 96; CUIC UI Appeal Rights

question_en: A contractor's supervisor provides false information to EDD about why a worker was terminated in order to prevent a UI claim. What penalty does the contractor face?
question_cn: 承包商的主管向就业发展部（EDD）提供关于工人被解雇原因的虚假信息，以防止失业保险（UI）索赔。承包商会面临什么处罚？

options.en: Suspension of the employer's UI reserve account by EDD
options.cn: EDD暂停雇主的UI储备账户

options.en: A penalty of 2 to 10 times the weekly benefit amount
options.cn: 罚款为每周福利金额的2到10倍

options.en: Immediate cancellation of the employer's EDD account number
options.cn: 立即取消雇主的EDD账户号码

options.en: A fixed fine of $1,000 per false statement made
options.cn: 每次虚假陈述固定罚款1,000美元

explanation_en: CUIC Section 1142(a) provides that willfully making a false statement about a claimant's termination exposes the employer or agent to a cash penalty ranging from 2 to 10 times the claimant's weekly benefit amount.
explanation_cn: 《加州失业保险法典》(CUIC) 第1142(a)条规定，故意对索赔人的解雇情况作出虚假陈述，将使雇主或代理人面临现金罚款，金额为索赔人每周福利金额的2到10倍。
code_reference: CUIC Section 1142(a)

question_en: An employer receives a Notice of Determination assessing a false-statement penalty under CUIC Section 1142(a). To contest the assessment, what must the employer do within 30 calendar days?
question_cn: 雇主收到根据 CUIC 第1142(a)条款评估的虚假陈述罚款的决定通知。为了对该评估提出异议，雇主必须在30个日历日内做什么？

options.en: File a written Petition for Reassessment with the CUIAB
options.cn: 向 CUIAB 提交书面重新评估请愿书

options.en: Request an informal conference with an EDD auditor
options.cn: 请求与 EDD 审计员进行非正式会议

options.en: Submit a written protest to the Contribution Rate Group
options.cn: 向缴费率组提交书面抗议

options.en: Call EDD directly to dispute the determination by phone
options.cn: 直接致电 EDD 通过电话争议该决定

explanation_en: DE 44 (Page 97) states the employer must file a written Petition for Reassessment to an ALJ of the CUIAB within 30 calendar days from the date of assessment to be timely.
explanation_cn: DE 44（第97页）指出，雇主必须在评估日期起的30个日历日内，向 CUIAB 的行政法官提交书面重新评估请愿书，以确保及时。
code_reference: CUIC Section 1142(a); DE 3807 SEP

question_en: EDD mails a contractor a DE 1296B benefit audit form. Under California law, what is the contractor's obligation?
question_cn: EDD 向承包商发送 DE 1296B 福利审计表。根据加利福尼亚州法律，承包商的义务是什么？

options.en: Respond only if the employee worked fewer than 90 days
options.cn: 仅在员工工作时间少于 90 天时回复

options.en: Respond only if the employee earned more than $100 that quarter
options.cn: 仅在员工当季度收入超过 100 美元时回复

options.en: Respond voluntarily but face no penalty for ignoring it
options.cn: 自愿回复，但忽略不会受到处罚

options.en: Respond as required by state and federal law
options.cn: 按州和联邦法律要求回复

explanation_en: DE 44 (Page 98) states that employers are required by state and federal laws to respond to DE 1296B, DE 1296NER, IB 8605, and DE 1296NBA benefit audits.
explanation_cn: DE 44（第 98 页）指出，雇主必须根据州和联邦法律对 DE 1296B、DE 1296NER、IB 8605 和 DE 1296NBA 福利审计进行回复。
code_reference: DE 44, Page 98; CUIC UI Benefit Audit requirements

question_en: A contractor fails to respond to EDD's DE 1919 wage request within 10 days, and EDD then files a UI claim based on the claimant's self-reported wages. What is the likely consequence for the contractor?
question_cn: 如果承包商未在10天内回应EDD的DE 1919工资请求，EDD随后将根据申请人自报的工资提出失业保险申请，对承包商可能产生什么后果？

options.en: EDD will automatically deny the claimant's UI application
options.cn: EDD将自动拒绝申请人的失业保险申请

options.en: The contractor faces criminal charges for non-response
options.cn: 承包商因未回应而面临刑事指控

options.en: The contractor may incur avoidable reserve account charges
options.cn: 承包商可能会产生本可避免的储备账户费用

options.en: EDD doubles the claimant's weekly UI benefit as a penalty
options.cn: EDD将作为处罚将申请人的每周失业保险金加倍

explanation_en: DE 44 (Page 99) warns that if employers do not respond timely to the DE 1919, they may incur reserve account charges they might not have otherwise incurred, because an overpayment cannot be established unless fraud is proven.
explanation_cn: DE 44（第99页）警告，如果雇主未及时回应DE 1919，他们可能会产生原本可能不会产生的储备账户费用，因为除非证明存在欺诈，否则无法确定多付金额。
code_reference: DE 44, Page 99; Alternate Base Period provisions

question_en: An employer receives the annual Statement of Charges (DE 428T) and disagrees with a charge. How many days does the employer have to file a written protest?
question_cn: 雇主收到年度收费报表（DE 428T）并对某项费用有异议。雇主有多少天时间提交书面抗议？

options.en: Within 30 days of the issued date on the notice
options.cn: 自通知上发出日期起30天内

options.en: Within 45 days of the issued date on the notice
options.cn: 自通知上发出日期起45天内

options.en: Within 60 days of the issued date on the notice
options.cn: 自通知上发出日期起60天内

options.en: Within 90 days of the issued date on the notice
options.cn: 自通知上发出日期起90天内

explanation_en: DE 44 (Page 99) states the employer must file a written protest postmarked within 60 days of the issued date on the DE 428T notice.
explanation_cn: DE 44（第99页）说明，雇主必须在DE 428T通知发出日期起60天内邮寄书面抗议。
code_reference: DE 44, Page 99; DE 428T protest procedures

question_en: A contractor wins a back pay settlement for a worker who received UI benefits during the same period covered by the award. Within how many days must the back pay be reported to EDD?
question_cn: 承包商为一名在获得该裁决期间领取失业保险（UI）福利的工人赢得了追溯工资的和解。追溯工资必须在多少天内向EDD报告？

options.en: Within 45 days from the settlement date
options.cn: 从和解日期起45天内

options.en: Within 30 days from the settlement date
options.cn: 从和解日期起30天内

options.en: Within 10 days from the settlement date
options.cn: 从和解日期起10天内

options.en: Within 60 days from the settlement date
options.cn: 从和解日期起60天内

explanation_en: DE 44 (Page 98) states that back pay is considered wages and must be reported within 30 days from the settlement or agreement date.
explanation_cn: DE 44（第98页）指出，追溯工资被视为工资，必须在和解或协议日期起30天内报告。
code_reference: DE 44, Page 98; Back Pay Award provisions

question_en: A contractor is planning to close a jobsite office and lay off 55 employees over the next three weeks. The company has employed 80 workers over the past year. What is the contractor's notice obligation?
question_cn: 一位承包商计划在接下来的三周内关闭一个工地办公室并裁掉55名员工。该公司在过去一年中雇用了80名工人。承包商的通知义务是什么？

options.en: No written notice is required for construction layoffs
options.cn: 对于建筑行业的裁员不需要书面通知

options.en: Provide at least 60 days written notice to affected employees
options.cn: 向受影响的员工提供至少60天的书面通知

options.en: File a notice with EDD but not directly with employees
options.cn: 向EDD提交通知，但不直接发送给员工

options.en: Provide at least 30 days written notice to affected employees
options.cn: 向受影响的员工提供至少30天的书面通知

explanation_en: DE 44 (Page 100) requires employers with 75 or more employees planning layoffs of 50 or more within 30 days to provide at least 60 days written notice. This employer meets both thresholds.
explanation_cn: DE 44（第100页）规定，拥有75名或更多员工的雇主，如果计划在30天内裁员50名或以上，必须提供至少60天的书面通知。该雇主符合这两个门槛。
code_reference: DE 44, Page 100; California WARN Act notice requirements

question_en: A contractor wants to keep trained crews employed during a slow winter period by reducing their hours instead of laying them off. Which EDD program is specifically designed for this situation?
question_cn: 一家承包商希望在冬季淡季期间通过减少员工工时而不是裁员来保持受过培训的团队就业。哪一个EDD项目专门为这种情况设计？

options.en: The State Disability Insurance elective coverage program
options.cn: 州残疾保险自选覆盖计划

options.en: The Partial UI Claims program for temporarily reduced hours
options.cn: 临时减少工作时间的部分失业保险申请计划

options.en: The Work Sharing Unemployment Insurance program
options.cn: 共享工作失业保险计划

options.en: The Alternate Base Period wage-reporting program
options.cn: 替代基期工资报告计划

explanation_en: DE 44 (Page 100) describes the Work Sharing program as available to employers who reduce employee wages and hours as an alternative to layoff, requiring a signed DE 8686 plan application.
explanation_cn: DE 44（第100页）描述了共享工作计划，可供作为裁员替代而减少员工工资和工时的雇主使用，需要提交签署的DE 8686计划申请。
code_reference: DE 44, Page 100; Work Sharing Program

question_en: A contractor is enrolled in the Work Sharing program and an employee wants to certify for UI benefits using EDD's UI Online system. What should the contractor tell the employee?
question_cn: 承包商已注册参加工作共享计划，某员工希望使用 EDD 的 UI 在线系统申请失业救济金。承包商应告诉员工什么？

options.en: Use Tele-Cert to certify for weekly UI benefits instead
options.cn: 改用 Tele-Cert 进行每周失业救济金认证

options.en: Use UI Online to certify benefits as normal each week
options.cn: 每周正常使用 UI 在线系统认证福利

options.en: File directly through the employer's EDD e-Services account
options.cn: 通过雇主的 EDD 电子服务账户直接提交

options.en: Certify using a paper continued claim form by mail
options.cn: 使用纸质持续索赔表通过邮寄方式认证

explanation_en: DE 44 (Page 100) states that Work Sharing and Partial Claims participants are required to continue using the existing paper continued claim form by mail, as electronic options are not available to them.
explanation_cn: DE 44（第100页）指出，工作共享和部分索赔的参与者必须继续使用现有的纸质持续索赔表通过邮寄方式提交，因为电子选项对他们不可用。
code_reference: DE 44, Page 100; Work Sharing and Partial Claims certification rules

question_en: Under California law, when is an employer required to provide SDI coverage for employees?
question_cn: 根据加利福尼亚州法律，雇主什么时候需要为员工提供SDI保险？

options.en: When the employer has five or more full-time employees
options.cn: 当雇主拥有五名或以上全职员工时

options.en: When any employee earns wages during the calendar year
options.cn: 当任何员工在日历年度内获得工资时

options.en: When the employer's annual payroll exceeds $1,000
options.cn: 当雇主的年度工资总额超过1,000美元时

options.en: When employees earn over $100 in a calendar quarter
options.cn: 当员工在一个日历季度内赚取超过100美元时

explanation_en: DE 44 (Page 101) states California law requires employers to provide SDI coverage for employees with payroll over $100 in a calendar quarter.
explanation_cn: DE 44（第101页）指出，根据加利福尼亚州法律，雇主需要为在一个日历季度内工资超过100美元的员工提供SDI保险。
code_reference: DE 44, Page 101; CUIC SDI coverage requirement

question_en: A contractor's employee files a DI claim. When must the contractor return the Notice to Employer of Disability Insurance Claim Filed (DE 2503) to EDD?
question_cn: 承包商的员工提交了伤残保险（DI）索赔。承包商必须在何时将《已提交伤残保险索赔雇主通知》（DE 2503）交回就业发展部（EDD）？

options.en: Within two working days of receiving the notice
options.cn: 收到通知后的两个工作日内

options.en: Within five working days of receipt
options.cn: 收到后的五个工作日内

options.en: Within 30 calendar days of the claim being filed
options.cn: 索赔提交后的30个日历日内

options.en: Within 10 calendar days of receipt
options.cn: 收到后的10个日历日内

explanation_en: DE 44 (Page 101) states that employers are required to complete and return the DE 2503 or DE 2503F within two working days of receipt.
explanation_cn: DE 44 (第101页) 说明，雇主需要在收到DE 2503或DE 2503F后的两个工作日内完成并归还表格。
code_reference: DE 44, Page 101; SDI Employer Claim Notices

question_en: A contractor asks whether a DI or PFL claim filed by an employee will increase the contractor's UI reserve account rate. What is the correct answer?
question_cn: 一名承包商询问，员工提出的伤残保险（DI）或带薪家庭假（PFL）索赔是否会增加承包商的失业保险（UI）储备账户费率。正确答案是什么？

options.en: No, because employees fund DI and PFL through payroll deductions
options.cn: 不会，因为员工通过工资扣款为DI和PFL提供资金

options.en: Yes, but only if the employee has worked fewer than six months
options.cn: 会，但仅当员工工作不到六个月时

options.en: Yes, DI claims always increase the employer's UI reserve rate
options.cn: 会，DI索赔总是会增加雇主的UI储备费率

options.en: Only PFL claims affect the UI reserve account rate
options.cn: 只有PFL索赔会影响UI储备账户费率

explanation_en: DE 44 (Page 101) states the UI reserve account will not be affected by DI or PFL claims because employees pay for these programs through their own payroll deductions.
explanation_cn: DE 44（第101页）指出，UI储备账户不会因DI或PFL索赔而受到影响，因为员工通过自己的工资扣款为这些计划支付费用。
code_reference: DE 44, Page 101; SDI program UI reserve account impact

question_en: A contractor sets up a Voluntary Plan in place of SDI coverage and the plan's trust fund runs out of money before all benefit claims are paid. Who is responsible for covering the remaining benefit obligations?
question_cn: 承包商建立自愿计划以替代 SDI 覆盖，而计划的信托基金在支付完所有福利申请之前耗尽资金。谁负责支付剩余的福利义务？

options.en: The affected employees bear the unpaid benefit costs
options.cn: 受影响的员工承担未支付的福利费用

options.en: The employer covers the plan deficit until all claims are settled
options.cn: 雇主在所有申请结算之前承担计划赤字

options.en: EDD will cover the deficit from the Disability Fund
options.cn: 经济发展局（EDD）将从残障基金覆盖赤字

options.en: The employer's workers' compensation carrier covers the deficit
options.cn: 雇主的工伤赔偿保险承保赤字

explanation_en: DE 44 (Page 102) states that if a plan terminates with insufficient trust funds, the employer must assume the financial obligation until all plan liabilities have been met. The employer takes ultimate responsibility.
explanation_cn: DE 44（第 102 页）指出，如果计划终止时信托基金不足，雇主必须承担财务义务，直到所有计划负债得到满足。雇主承担最终责任。
code_reference: DE 44, Page 102; CUIC Voluntary Plan provisions

question_en: A self-employed contractor with no employees wants to obtain SDI coverage for themselves. What coverage option is available under the CUIC?
question_cn: 一名没有雇员的自雇承包商希望为自己获得 SDI 保险。在 CUIC 下有什么可用的保险选项？

options.en: Automatically qualify for SDI without electing coverage
options.cn: 自动获得 SDI 资格，无需选择保险

options.en: Elect both UI and SDI coverage for themselves
options.cn: 为自己选择 UI 和 SDI 双重保险

options.en: Elect SDI-only coverage under the elective coverage program
options.cn: 在自愿选择保险计划下，仅选择 SDI 保险

options.en: Enroll in the Voluntary Plan as a sole employer
options.cn: 以唯一雇主身份加入自愿计划

explanation_en: DE 44 (Page 102) states that self-employed individuals who are not employers may only elect SDI coverage for themselves under the CUIC elective coverage provisions.
explanation_cn: DE 44（第 102 页）指出，根据 CUIC 自愿选择保险条款，那些不是雇主的自雇个人只能为自己选择 SDI 保险。
code_reference: DE 44, Page 102; CUIC elective coverage for self-employed

question_en: A contractor hires a worker from a target group and wants to claim the Work Opportunity Tax Credit. What is the deadline for submitting the required forms to EDD?
question_cn: 承包商从目标群体中雇用了一名工人，并希望申请工作机会税收抵免。向EDD提交所需表格的截止日期是什么？

options.en: Within 28 days of the employee's start date
options.cn: 在员工入职日期后的28天内

options.en: Within 14 days of the employee's start date
options.cn: 在员工入职日期后的14天内

options.en: Within 30 days of the employee's start date
options.cn: 在员工入职日期后的30天内

options.en: Within 45 days of the employee's start date
options.cn: 在员工入职日期后的45天内

explanation_en: DE 44 states employers must submit properly completed WOTC forms to EDD within 28 days of the employee's start date to be considered for the tax credit.
explanation_cn: DE 44规定，雇主必须在员工入职日期后的28天内向EDD提交正确完成的WOTC表格，才能考虑申请税收抵免。
code_reference: DE 44, Work Opportunity Tax Credit section

question_en: A contractor's construction firm has grown and now operates jobsite offices in three counties, with at least 10 employees at each location. What reporting obligation does this trigger?
question_cn: 一家承包商的建筑公司已发展壮大，现在在三个县设有工地办公室，每个地点至少有 10 名员工。这会触发什么报告义务？

options.en: Mandatory quarterly filing of the BLS 3020 form
options.cn: BLS 3020 表格的强制性季度申报

options.en: Filing a separate DE 1 for each physical location
options.cn: 为每个实际地点单独提交 DE 1 表格

options.en: Annual filing of the Industry Verification Form BLS 3023
options.cn: 行业验证表 BLS 3023 的年度申报

options.en: Voluntary monthly reporting to the LMID
options.cn: 自愿向 LMID 提交每月报告

explanation_en: DE 44 states that filing the BLS 3020 Multiple Worksite Report is mandatory and must be done quarterly when a second location has 10 or more employees.
explanation_cn: DE 44 规定，当第二个地点有 10 名或更多员工时，必须提交 BLS 3020 多工作地点报告，且必须按季度进行。
code_reference: DE 44, Multiple Location and Function Employers section; BLS 3020

question_en: A contractor's company has a negative reserve account balance. How does this affect the employer's ETT obligation?
question_cn: 一家承包商公司的储备账户余额为负。这如何影响雇主的 ETT 义务？

options.en: ETT is suspended and no UI tax is owed
options.cn: ETT 暂停，不需要缴纳失业保险税

options.en: ETT is not owed but UI tax rate increases
options.cn: 不需要缴纳 ETT，但失业保险税率会增加

options.en: ETT and UI tax are both waived temporarily
options.cn: ETT 和失业保险税都暂时免除

options.en: ETT doubles and UI tax stays the same
options.cn: ETT 翻倍，失业保险税保持不变

explanation_en: DE 44 states employers do not pay ETT while their accounts have a negative reserve balance, but they must pay a higher rate of Unemployment Insurance tax.
explanation_cn: DE 44 表示，在账户余额为负的情况下，雇主无需支付 ETT，但必须支付更高的失业保险税率。
code_reference: DE 44, Employment Training Panel – Funding section; CUIC Section 976.6

question_en: A contractor wants to use CalJOBS to post job openings and find qualified workers. What does the employer need to register for the service?
question_cn: 一位承包商希望使用 CalJOBS 发布职位空缺并寻找合格的工人。雇主需要注册哪些服务？

options.en: A valid California contractor's license number
options.cn: 有效的加利福尼亚州承包商执照号码

options.en: An EDD employer payroll tax account number
options.cn: EDD 雇主工资税账户号码

options.en: A signed WIOA program participation agreement
options.cn: 签署的 WIOA 项目参与协议

options.en: A federal Employer Identification Number from the IRS
options.cn: 来自 IRS 的联邦雇主识别号码

explanation_en: DE 44 states that to register with CalJOBS, employers will need their EDD employer payroll tax account number.
explanation_cn: DE 44 表明，要注册 CalJOBS，雇主需要提供其 EDD 雇主工资税账户号码。
code_reference: DE 44, CalJOBS section

question_en: Under the ETP's Core Funding Program, what must occur before an employer can receive reimbursement for training costs?
question_cn: 在ETP的核心资助计划下，雇主在获得培训费用报销之前必须做些什么？

options.en: Employer submits a completed DE 1 to EDD
options.cn: 雇主向EDD提交完整的DE 1表格

options.en: Trainees complete required hours and retention period
options.cn: 培训生完成所需的培训小时数和留职期

options.en: EDD approves the employer's training curriculum in advance
options.cn: EDD事先批准雇主的培训课程

options.en: Employer pays ETT for at least two consecutive years
options.cn: 雇主支付ETT至少连续两年

explanation_en: DE 44 states that before earning reimbursement, trainees must receive a certain number of training hours and must complete the required retention period at their job, as well as meet the ETP minimum wage.
explanation_cn: DE 44指出，在获得报销之前，培训生必须接受一定小时数的培训，并完成其岗位的所需留职期，同时达到ETP的最低工资要求。
code_reference: DE 44, How Is ETP Different section

question_en: A contractor operating a construction firm with 30 employees wants to submit WOTC applications online. What is required before using the eWOTC system?
question_cn: 一位拥有30名员工的建筑公司承包商希望在线提交WOTC申请。在使用eWOTC系统之前需要做什么？

options.en: Mailing a paper application to EDD first
options.cn: 首先将纸质申请邮寄到EDD

options.en: Completing a one-time eWOTC enrollment online
options.cn: 在线完成一次性eWOTC注册

options.en: Registering separately with the U.S. Department of Labor
options.cn: 与美国劳工部单独注册

options.en: Obtaining EDD approval of each target-group hire
options.cn: 获得EDD对每位目标群体雇员的批准

explanation_en: DE 44 states that employers with 25 or more employees must complete a one-time eWOTC enrollment to submit WOTC certification applications online.
explanation_cn: DE 44规定，拥有25名或以上员工的雇主必须完成一次性eWOTC注册，以便在线提交WOTC认证申请。
code_reference: DE 44, eWOTC section

question_en: A contractor receives a Multiple Worksite Report (BLS 3020) from the LMID after the close of a quarter. By when must the form be returned to EDD?
question_cn: 承包商在一个季度结束后从 LMID 收到多工作地点报告（BLS 3020）。该表格必须在什么时候返还给 EDD？

options.en: Within 45 days of the end of the calendar year
options.cn: 在日历年结束后 45 天内

options.en: By end of the month following each quarter's close
options.cn: 在每个季度结束后的下个月月底之前

options.en: By the end of the same quarter it was mailed
options.cn: 在邮寄的同一季度结束之前

options.en: Within 15 days of the date the form is received
options.cn: 在收到表格之日起 15 天内

explanation_en: DE 44 states the LMID mails the BLS 3020 at the close of each quarter, and employers have until the end of the following month to return it to EDD.
explanation_cn: DE 44 说明 LMID 在每个季度结束时邮寄 BLS 3020，雇主必须在随后一个月月底之前将其返还给 EDD。
code_reference: DE 44, Multiple Location and Function Employers section; BLS 3020

question_en: Which of the following ETP training categories specifically supports unemployed workers who have exhausted UI benefits within 24 months?
question_cn: 以下哪一类ETP培训专门支持在过去24个月内已用尽失业保险福利的失业工人？

options.en: Special Employment Training for frontline workers
options.cn: 前线工人的特别就业培训

options.en: Retraining for companies facing out-of-state competition
options.cn: 面对州外竞争企业的再培训

options.en: Workers with Multiple Barriers to Employment category
options.cn: 具有多重就业障碍工人类别

options.en: New-Hire Training for eligible unemployed workers
options.cn: 面向符合条件的失业工人的新员工培训

explanation_en: DE 44 states New-Hire Training trains unemployed workers eligible to receive California UI benefits or who have exhausted UI benefits within 24 months of the start of training.
explanation_cn: DE 44州新员工培训面向有资格领取加利福尼亚州失业保险福利的失业工人，或在培训开始后的24个月内已用尽失业保险福利的工人。
code_reference: DE 44, ETP General Information – New-Hire Training section

question_en: A contractor operating in a high-unemployment county wants to access ETP training funds for frontline workers earning below the state average hourly wage. Which ETP funding category applies?
question_cn: 在高失业率县运营的一家承包商希望为低于州平均小时工资的一线工人获取ETP培训资金。适用哪种ETP资金类别？

options.en: ETP Core Funding Retraining for out-of-state competition
options.cn: ETP核心资金 用于应对州外竞争的再培训

options.en: New-Hire Training for UI-eligible unemployed workers
options.cn: 新聘员工培训 面向符合UI条件的失业工人

options.en: Small Business Skills funding for owners under ten employees
options.cn: 小企业技能资金 面向少于十名员工的业主

options.en: SET funding for workers in high-unemployment areas
options.cn: SET资金 用于高失业率地区的工人

explanation_en: DE 44 states SET allows training of frontline workers below the state average wage when they are in high-unemployment areas where the unemployment rate is significantly above the state average.
explanation_cn: DE 44州SET允许在高失业率且失业率显著高于州平均水平的地区，对低于州平均工资的一线工人进行培训。
code_reference: DE 44, ETP Special Employment Training – Workers in High Unemployment Areas

question_en: A contractor pays an employee $8,000 in supplemental wages during the year. What is the correct federal income tax withholding rate on those wages?
question_cn: 一名承包商在一年内向员工支付了8,000美元的补充工资。这些工资的正确联邦所得税预扣率是多少？

options.en: 24% flat backup withholding rate
options.cn: 24%的统一备份预扣税率

options.en: 37% mandatory withholding rate
options.cn: 37%的强制预扣税率
