options.en: The same rate as regular wages
options.cn: 与常规工资相同的税率

options.en: 22% flat supplemental wage rate
options.cn: 22%的统一补充工资税率

explanation_en: Pub. 15 Section 7 sets the supplemental wage withholding rate at 22% when total supplemental wages paid to an employee do not exceed $1 million in the calendar year.
explanation_cn: 《第15号出版物》第7节规定，当年度支付给员工的补充工资总额不超过100万美元时，补充工资的预扣税率为22%。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 7 (Document p. 2, PDF p. 2)

question_en: A contractor outsources all payroll tax deposits to a third-party payroll service, but the service fails to make the required deposits. Who is liable to the IRS for the unpaid taxes?
question_cn: 承包商将所有工资税存款外包给第三方工资服务公司，但该服务公司未能进行所需的存款。谁应对未支付的税款向 IRS 承担责任？

options.en: Only the employees whose taxes were not deposited
options.cn: 仅未存入税款的员工

options.en: The IRS absorbs the loss if the vendor is licensed
options.cn: 如果供应商有执照，IRS 将吸收损失

options.en: The contractor-employer remains fully liable to the IRS
options.cn: 承包商-雇主对 IRS 仍然负全部责任

options.en: Only the third-party payroll service bears all liability
options.cn: 仅第三方工资服务公司承担全部责任

explanation_en: Pub. 15 Section 16 states that the employer remains responsible for ensuring deposits and payments are made even when a third party is contracted to perform those duties. Failure by the third party does not relieve the employer.
explanation_cn: 《出版物 15》第16节指出，即使雇主将这些职责外包给第三方，雇主仍有责任确保存款和付款已完成。第三方的失误并不免除雇主的责任。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 16 (Document p. 4, PDF p. 4)

question_en: An employee's total supplemental wages for the year reach $1,050,000. What withholding rate must the contractor apply to the amount exceeding $1 million?
question_cn: 员工全年总补充工资达到 $1,050,000。承包商必须对超过 $1,000,000 的部分应用什么预扣税率？

options.en: The employee's regular Form W-4 rate
options.cn: 员工的常规 W-4 表税率

options.en: 37% mandatory withholding rate
options.cn: 37% 强制预扣税率

options.en: 22% flat supplemental wage rate
options.cn: 22% 固定补充工资税率

options.en: 24% backup withholding rate
options.cn: 24% 备用预扣税率

explanation_en: Per Pub. 15 Section 7, supplemental wages paid to an employee that exceed $1 million in a calendar year must be withheld at the mandatory 37% rate on the excess amount.
explanation_cn: 根据《出版物 15》第 7 节，对于在日历年内支付给员工且超过 $1,000,000 的补充工资，必须对超过部分按 37% 的强制税率进行预扣。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 7 (Document p. 2, PDF p. 2)

question_en: A contractor begins hiring workers but does not collect a Form W-4 from one new employee before the first paycheck is issued. What withholding obligation does the contractor have for that employee?
question_cn: 承包商开始雇佣工人，但在发放第一笔工资前未从一名新员工收集 W-4 表格。该承包商对该员工有何扣缴义务？

options.en: Withhold as if the employee is single with no adjustments
options.cn: 按员工为单身且无调整的情况扣缴

options.en: Apply the 22% supplemental wage rate temporarily
options.cn: 暂时适用 22% 的补充工资税率

options.en: Ask the employee verbally and use that information
options.cn: 口头询问员工并使用该信息

options.en: Withhold nothing until the form is received
options.cn: 在收到表格前不扣缴任何税款

explanation_en: Pub. 15 Section 9 requires employers to withhold federal income tax as if the employee is single (or married filing separately) claiming no adjustments when no valid Form W-4 has been received.
explanation_cn: 出版物 15 第 9 节要求雇主在未收到有效 W-4 表格时，应按员工为单身（或分别申报的已婚人士）且无调整的情况扣缴联邦所得税。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 9 (Document p. 7, PDF p. 7)

question_en: Which of the following taxes has no wage base limit in 2026?
question_cn: 以下哪种税在2026年没有工资基数上限？

options.en: Social security tax at 6.2% each
options.cn: 社会保障税，各占6.2%

options.en: Medicare tax at 1.45% each
options.cn: 医疗保险税，各占1.45%

options.en: Federal income tax withholding
options.cn: 联邦所得税预扣

options.en: FUTA tax on the first $7,000
options.cn: FUTA税适用于前7,000美元

explanation_en: Per Pub. 15 Section 5, Medicare tax at 1.45% each for the employer and employee applies to all covered wages with no wage base ceiling.
explanation_cn: 根据《出版物15》第5节，雇主和雇员各自缴纳的1.45%医疗保险税适用于所有应缴工资，不设工资基数上限。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 5 (Document p. 2, PDF p. 2)

question_en: A contractor's employee receives $1,500 in qualified overtime compensation in 2026. Are those overtime wages still subject to FICA taxes?
question_cn: 一名承包商的员工在2026年获得1,500美元的合格加班补偿。这些加班工资仍然需要缴纳FICA税吗？

options.en: Yes, both employer and employee owe FICA taxes
options.cn: 是的，雇主和员工都需要缴纳FICA税

options.en: No, overtime is fully exempt from all payroll taxes
options.cn: 不，加班工资完全免于所有工资税

options.en: No, only the half-time portion is exempt
options.cn: 不，只有半小时部分免税

options.en: Yes, but only the employer owes FICA taxes
options.cn: 是的，但只有雇主需要缴纳FICA税

explanation_en: Pub. 15 states that overtime compensation is still generally subject to both the employer share and the employee share of social security and Medicare taxes, regardless of the new income tax deduction.
explanation_cn: 《公告15》指出，加班补偿通常仍需缴纳社会保障税和医疗保险税，无论新的所得税扣除如何，雇主和员工双方均需缴纳。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 5 (Document p. 2, PDF p. 2)

question_en: A contractor reimbursed a non-military employee for moving expenses in 2026. How must the contractor treat that reimbursement for federal income tax purposes?
question_cn: 一名承包商在2026年为非军人雇员报销了搬家费用。承包商在联邦所得税方面必须如何处理该报销？

options.en: Exclude it from income up to $5,000
options.cn: 从收入中排除最高5,000美元

options.en: Include it in the employee's taxable wages
options.cn: 将其计入雇员的应税工资

options.en: Exclude it only if the move exceeds 50 miles
options.cn: 仅在搬迁距离超过50英里时排除

options.en: Report it on Form 1099-NEC instead of Form W-2
options.cn: 在1099-NEC表上报告，而不是在W-2表上

explanation_en: P.L. 119-21 permanently eliminates the exclusion for qualified moving expense reimbursements from gross income for non-military employees. The reimbursement must be included in the employee's taxable wages.
explanation_cn: 公法第119-21号永久取消了对非军人雇员合格搬家费用报销的总收入排除。该报销必须计入雇员的应税工资。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 5 (Document p. 2, PDF p. 2)

question_en: A contractor hires a subcontractor and pays $2,500 for services in 2026. Must the contractor file a Form 1099-NEC for that payment?
question_cn: 承包商在2026年雇佣一名分包商，并为服务支付了2,500美元。承包商是否必须为该付款提交1099-NEC表格？

options.en: Yes, but report it on Form W-2 instead
options.cn: 是的，但应在W-2表上报告

options.en: No, the threshold is $600 for all years
options.cn: 不需要，所有年份的门槛都是600美元

options.en: No, payments under $5,000 are always exempt
options.cn: 不需要，低于5,000美元的付款总是免除的

options.en: Yes, because the payment exceeds $2,000
options.cn: 是的，因为付款超过2,000美元

explanation_en: For payments made in 2026, P.L. 119-21 increased the information reporting threshold to $2,000. A $2,500 payment to a non-employee for services exceeds that threshold, requiring a Form 1099-NEC.
explanation_cn: 对于2026年的付款，P.L. 119-21将信息报告门槛提高到2,000美元。向非雇员支付2,500美元的服务费用超过该门槛，因此需要提交1099-NEC表格。
code_reference: Pub. 15 / IRC Section 6041A (Document p. 7, PDF p. 7)

question_en: A contractor hires a new employee but does not complete a Form I-9 before the employee begins work. What is the contractor's primary federal compliance risk?
question_cn: 承包商雇佣了一名新员工，但在员工开始工作前未填写I-9表格。承包商的主要联邦合规风险是什么？

options.en: The contractor loses the right to claim payroll deductions
options.cn: 承包商失去申报工资扣除的权利

options.en: The contractor must refund all wages paid
options.cn: 承包商必须退还已支付的所有工资

options.en: Penalties for hiring workers without eligibility verification
options.cn: 因雇佣未经资格验证的工人而面临的处罚

options.en: Automatic disqualification from federal contracting
options.cn: 自动取消联邦合同资格

explanation_en: Pub. 15 requires employers to verify each new employee's legal eligibility to work in the United States using USCIS Form I-9. Failure to do so exposes the contractor to federal civil and criminal penalties.
explanation_cn: 《公告15》要求雇主使用USCIS I-9表格验证每位新员工在美国工作的合法资格。不遵守此规定将使承包商面临联邦民事和刑事处罚。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 1 / USCIS Form I-9 (Document p. 7, PDF p. 7)

question_en: A contractor's quarterly FUTA tax liability accumulates to $450. When must the contractor deposit that amount?
question_cn: 承包商的季度 FUTA 税款责任累计达到 450 美元。承包商何时必须缴纳该金额？

options.en: No deposit is required; carry it to the next quarter
options.cn: 不需要缴纳；结转到下一个季度

options.en: By the last day of the quarter it was incurred
options.cn: 在发生的季度最后一天前

options.en: Pay it all annually with the Form 940 return
options.cn: 随 Form 940 年度申报表一次性支付

options.en: By the next business day after it is owed
options.cn: 在应缴后的下一个工作日支付

explanation_en: Pub. 15 states that a FUTA deposit is required only when the undeposited FUTA tax exceeds $500. An accumulated balance of $450 does not trigger a deposit obligation; it is carried forward.
explanation_cn: 《出版物 15》说明，只有当未缴 FUTA 税超过 500 美元时才需要缴纳 FUTA 预缴款。累计余额为 450 美元不会触发缴纳义务；可结转。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 14 / Form 940 (Document p. 8, PDF p. 8)

question_en: An employee asks whether the mandatory service charge added to a client's invoice qualifies as a 'qualified tip' eligible for the new income tax deduction. What is the correct answer?
question_cn: 一名员工询问，是否加在客户发票上的强制性服务费可以被视为有资格的‘小费’，从而符合新的所得税扣除资格。正确答案是什么？

options.en: No, mandatory service charges are not qualified tips
options.cn: 不，强制性服务费不是有资格的小费

options.en: Yes, if the charge exceeds $20 per month
options.cn: 是的，如果每月费用超过20美元

options.en: Yes, all tip-type payments qualify equally
options.cn: 是的，所有类型的小费支付都同样符合资格

options.en: Yes, if the employer passes the charge to the employee
options.cn: 是的，如果雇主将费用转嫁给员工

explanation_en: Pub. 15 explicitly states that mandatory service charges added to the bill are not qualified tips. Only voluntary cash or charged tips received from customers meet the definition.
explanation_cn: 《出版物15》明确指出，加在账单上的强制性服务费不是有资格的小费。只有客户自愿支付的现金或记账小费才符合定义。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 6 / P.L. 119-21 (Document p. 2, PDF p. 2)

question_en: A contractor makes all federal tax deposits by mailing paper checks to the IRS. What is the consequence of this practice?
question_cn: 一名承包商通过邮寄纸质支票向国税局缴纳所有联邦税款。这种做法的后果是什么？

options.en: The contractor may face a failure-to-deposit penalty
options.cn: 承包商可能会面临未缴存罚款

options.en: The contractor may owe a 10% excise penalty
options.cn: 承包商可能需要支付10%的消费税罚款

options.en: The deposits are automatically returned uncashed
options.cn: 存款会被自动退回而未兑现

options.en: Deposits are accepted but processed with a delay
options.cn: 存款会被接受，但处理会有所延迟

explanation_en: Pub. 15 Section 11 requires all federal tax deposits to be made by electronic funds transfer (EFT). Using paper checks instead of EFT exposes the contractor to failure-to-deposit penalties.
explanation_cn: 《出版物15》第11节要求所有联邦税款必须通过电子资金转账（EFT）缴纳。使用纸质支票而非EFT会使承包商面临未缴存罚款的风险。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 11 (Document p. 6, PDF p. 6)

question_en: A contractor discovers an error on a previously filed Form 941. Which form must be used to correct it?
question_cn: 承包商发现之前提交的 941 表格有错误。必须使用哪种表格来更正？

options.en: File Form 843 to claim a refund
options.cn: 提交 843 表格以申请退款

options.en: File Form 941-X separately from Form 941
options.cn: 提交 941-X 表格，独立于 941 表格提交

options.en: Refile the original Form 941 with corrections
options.cn: 重新提交原 941 表格并进行更正

options.en: File an amended Form 940
options.cn: 提交修正后的 940 表格

explanation_en: Pub. 15 Section 13 states that errors on a previously filed Form 941 must be corrected using Form 941-X, which is filed separately from the original Form 941.
explanation_cn: 《出版物 15》第 13 节指出，对之前提交的 941 表格的错误必须使用 941-X 表格更正，该表格需独立于原 941 表格提交。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 13 / Form 941-X (Document p. 5, PDF p. 5)

question_en: A contractor wants to report new hire information to satisfy federal requirements. To which agency must that report be submitted?
question_cn: 一名承包商希望报告新雇员的信息以满足联邦要求。该报告必须提交给哪个机构？

options.en: The Social Security Administration directly
options.cn: 社会保障局直接提交

options.en: The Department of Labor regional office
options.cn: 劳工部地区办公室

options.en: A designated state new hire registry
options.cn: 指定的州新雇员登记处

options.en: The IRS employer identification unit
options.cn: 国税局雇主识别单位

explanation_en: Pub. 15 requires employers to report any new employee to a designated state new hire registry. All 50 states maintain such a registry for this purpose.
explanation_cn: 《第15号出版物》要求雇主将任何新员工报告给指定的州新雇员登记处。所有50个州都为此目的维护这样的登记处。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 1 (Document p. 7, PDF p. 7)

question_en: A contractor's severance payments to a laid-off crew member are challenged as non-wage payments by the contractor's bookkeeper. Which taxes actually apply to those severance payments?
question_cn: 承包商支付给被裁员的员工的遣散费，被承包商的簿记员质疑为非工资性支付。哪些税实际上适用于这些遣散费？

options.en: No taxes; severance is a non-taxable separation benefit
options.cn: 没有税；遣散费是一种免税的离职福利

options.en: Federal income tax, FICA, and FUTA all apply
options.cn: 联邦所得税、FICA 和 FUTA 都适用

options.en: Social security and Medicare only; FUTA does not apply
options.cn: 仅社会保障和医疗保险；FUTA 不适用

options.en: Federal income tax only; FICA does not apply
options.cn: 仅联邦所得税；FICA 不适用

explanation_en: Pub. 15 states that severance payments are wages subject to social security and Medicare taxes, federal income tax withholding, and FUTA tax. All three categories apply.
explanation_cn: 《公共第15号》指出，遣散费属于工资，应缴纳社会保障和医疗保险税、联邦所得税预扣税以及 FUTA 税。三类税都适用。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 5 (Document p. 5, PDF p. 5)

question_en: A contractor pays a subcontractor for nonemployee compensation but the subcontractor refuses to provide a Taxpayer Identification Number. What is the contractor's withholding obligation?
question_cn: 承包商向分包商支付非雇员报酬，但分包商拒绝提供纳税人识别号。承包商的代扣义务是什么？

options.en: Withhold 22% of each payment made
options.cn: 扣留每次支付的22%

options.en: Withhold 24% of the taxable payment
options.cn: 扣留应税支付的24%

options.en: Withhold 37% because the threshold is exceeded
options.cn: 扣留37%，因为超过了阈值

options.en: Withhold nothing until the IRS issues a notice
options.cn: 在国税局发出通知之前不扣留任何款项

explanation_en: Per Pub. 15, backup withholding requires withholding 24% of certain taxable payments, including nonemployee compensation, when the payee fails to furnish a correct TIN.
explanation_cn: 根据《第15号出版物》，当收款人未提供正确的纳税人识别号(TIN)时，备份扣缴要求对某些应税支付（包括非雇员报酬）扣留24%.
code_reference: Pub. 15, Backup Withholding; IRC Section 3406 (Document p. 9, PDF p. 9)

question_en: Which of the following payments is NOT subject to backup withholding?
question_cn: 以下哪项付款不受备用扣缴的影响？

options.en: Royalties paid in the course of business
options.cn: 在业务过程中支付的特许权使用费

options.en: Nonemployee compensation for services rendered
options.cn: 为提供服务支付的非雇员报酬

options.en: Wages paid to a regular employee
options.cn: 支付给正式员工的工资

options.en: Commissions paid to a vendor
options.cn: 支付给供应商的佣金

explanation_en: Pub. 15 states that backup withholding does not apply to wages. Employee wages are subject to regular income tax withholding rules, not backup withholding.
explanation_cn: 《出版物15》指出，备用扣缴不适用于工资。员工工资适用常规所得税扣缴规则，而非备用扣缴。
code_reference: Pub. 15, Backup Withholding; IRC Section 3406 (Document p. 9, PDF p. 9)

question_en: How long must a contractor-employer retain employment tax records to satisfy the minimum IRS requirement?
question_cn: 承包商雇主必须保留雇佣税记录多长时间才能满足最低 IRS 要求？

options.en: At least 4 years after the records are created
options.cn: 记录创建后至少 4 年

options.en: At least 3 years from the due date
options.cn: 从截止日期起至少 3 年

options.en: At least 7 years after filing
options.cn: 申报后至少 7 年

options.en: At least 6 years after the tax period
options.cn: 税期结束后至少 6 年

explanation_en: Pub. 15 states that all employment tax records must be kept for at least 4 years and should be available for IRS review.
explanation_cn: 《出版物 15》规定，所有雇佣税记录必须至少保存 4 年，并应提供给 IRS 审查。
code_reference: Pub. 15, Recordkeeping (Document p. 9, PDF p. 9)

question_en: Under the common law control test, what is the key factor that determines whether a worker is an employee of a contractor?
question_cn: 根据普通法的控制测试，决定工人是否为承包商雇员的关键因素是什么？

options.en: Whether the worker is paid by the hour
options.cn: 工人是否按小时付款

options.en: Whether the employer controls how work is done
options.cn: 雇主是否控制工作的方式

options.en: Whether the worker is full-time or part-time
options.cn: 工人是全职还是兼职

options.en: Whether the worker holds a contractor's license
options.cn: 工人是否持有承包商执照

explanation_en: Per Pub. 15 Section 2, a worker is an employee if the employer has the right to control what will be done and how it will be done, regardless of actual day-to-day freedom given.
explanation_cn: 根据《出版物15》第2节，如果雇主有权控制将做什么以及如何做，那么该工人即为雇员，无论实际日常自由度如何。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 2 (Document p. 14, PDF p. 14)

question_en: A contractor intentionally disregards the requirement to withhold federal income tax from a worker's wages. Which relief provision is unavailable to this contractor?
question_cn: 如果承包商故意无视从工人工资中扣缴联邦所得税的要求，哪项救济条款不适用于该承包商？

options.en: Using Section 530 reasonable basis relief
options.cn: 使用第530条合理依据救济

options.en: Applying for the Voluntary Classification Settlement Program
options.cn: 申请自愿分类结算计划

options.en: Using Section 3509 reduced misclassification rates
options.cn: 使用第3509条降低错误分类税率

options.en: Filing Form SS-8 to request IRS determination
options.cn: 提交表格SS-8以请求国税局裁定

explanation_en: Pub. 15 states that Section 3509 rates are not available if the employer intentionally disregards the requirement to withhold taxes. Full liability applies instead.
explanation_cn: 《第15号出版物》指出，如果雇主故意无视扣缴税款的要求，第3509条的税率不可适用。相反，需承担全部责任。
code_reference: IRC Section 3509; Pub. 15 Section 2 (Document p. 15, PDF p. 15)

question_en: What is the penalty on a dishonored tax payment of $200 returned by the contractor's bank?
question_cn: 承包商银行退回的 200 美元未支付税款的罚金是多少？

options.en: $25 or 2%, whichever is more
options.cn: $25 或 2%，以较高者为准

options.en: The full amount of the payment
options.cn: 支付的全部金额

options.en: 2% of the dishonored payment amount
options.cn: 未支付金额的 2%

options.en: A flat $25 regardless of payment size
options.cn: 不论支付金额大小，固定 $25

explanation_en: Pub. 15 states the penalty on a dishonored payment is $25 or 2% of the payment, whichever is more. For a $200 payment, $25 exceeds 2% ($4), so the penalty is $25.
explanation_cn: 《Pub. 15》规定，未支付款项的罚金为 $25 或支付金额的 2%，以较高者为准。对于 200 美元的付款，$25 超过 2%（$4），因此罚金为 $25。
code_reference: Pub. 15, Dishonored Payments (Document p. 10, PDF p. 10)

question_en: An employee claimed exemption from federal income tax withholding on last year's Form W-4. The contractor has not received a new W-4 by February 16. How should the contractor proceed?
question_cn: 一名员工在去年的 W-4 表格中申请了联邦所得税免税。承包商在 2 月 16 日之前未收到新的 W-4 表格。承包商应如何处理？

options.en: Withhold at the supplemental flat rate of 22%
options.cn: 按 22% 的补充固定税率扣缴

options.en: Stop all wage payments until a new W-4 is received
options.cn: 在收到新的 W-4 表格之前停止所有工资支付

options.en: Continue honoring the prior exemption claim indefinitely
options.cn: 无期限继续执行先前的免税申请

options.en: Withhold as Single filing status with no adjustments
options.cn: 按单身申报状态且无调整进行扣缴

explanation_en: Per Pub. 15, if no new W-4 is received after February 15, the employer must withhold as if the employee checked Single or Married filing separately in Step 1(c) with no entries in Steps 2, 3, or 4.
explanation_cn: 根据《出版物 15》，如果 2 月 15 日之后未收到新的 W-4 表格，雇主必须按员工在第 1(c) 步骤中勾选单身或分开申报（未在步骤 2、3 或 4 中填写）进行扣缴。
code_reference: Pub. 15, Calendar (February 16); Pub. 15 Section 9 (Document p. 11, PDF p. 11)

question_en: Which of the following records must a contractor-employer include in employment tax records under Pub. 15?
question_cn: 根据《公共出版物15》，承包商-雇主必须在雇佣税记录中包含以下哪些记录？

options.en: EFTPS acknowledgment numbers for each tax deposit
options.cn: 每次税款存款的EFTPS确认号码

options.en: Copies of all subcontracts and change orders
options.cn: 所有分包合同和变更订单的副本

options.en: Copies of all subcontractor bid proposals received
options.cn: 收到的所有分包商投标提案的副本

options.en: Worker's compensation insurance policy numbers
options.cn: 工伤赔偿保险单号码

explanation_en: Pub. 15 explicitly lists dates and amounts of tax deposits made and acknowledgment numbers for deposits made by EFTPS as required employment tax records.
explanation_cn: 《公共出版物15》明确列出了作为所需雇佣税记录的税款存款日期和金额以及通过EFTPS进行存款的确认号码。
code_reference: Pub. 15, Recordkeeping (Document p. 9, PDF p. 9)

question_en: If a contractor's total Form 941 tax liability for the quarter is less than $2,500, when may the contractor pay those taxes without making a separate deposit?
question_cn: 如果承包商本季度的《941表格》总税款不足 2,500 美元，承包商何时可以在不单独存款的情况下支付这些税款？

options.en: At any time during the calendar quarter
options.cn: 在日历季度的任何时间

options.en: When paying with the Form 941 at filing
options.cn: 在提交《941表格》时支付

options.en: Only if the employer has filed Form 944 previously
options.cn: 仅当雇主以前提交过《944表格》

options.en: Only after receiving written IRS permission
options.cn: 仅在收到国税局书面许可后

explanation_en: Pub. 15 states that if the total tax liability for the quarter on Form 941 line 12 is less than $2,500, the employer may pay the taxes with Form 941 rather than making a prior deposit.
explanation_cn: 《出版物15》指出，如果《941表格》第12行本季度的总税款不足 2,500 美元，雇主可以随《941表格》一起支付税款，而无需提前存款。
code_reference: Pub. 15, Calendar; Form 941 (Document p. 11, PDF p. 11)

question_en: A contractor hires a worker and calls the arrangement an 'independent contractor agreement,' but controls every detail of how the work is performed. How does the IRS view this worker's status?
question_cn: 一名承包商雇佣了一名工人，并将此安排称为“独立承包商协议”，但控制工作执行的每一个细节。美国国税局如何看待该工人的身份？

options.en: As an independent contractor because of the signed agreement
options.cn: 根据签署的协议，作为独立承包商

options.en: As a statutory employee subject to limited taxes only
options.cn: 作为仅需缴纳有限税款的法定雇员

options.en: As an employee subject to full withholding requirements
options.cn: 作为需全额扣税的雇员

options.en: As a nonemployee if paid on a per-project basis
options.cn: 如果按项目支付，则作为非雇员

explanation_en: Per Pub. 15 Section 2, if the employer has the right to control what is done and how it is done, the worker is an employee regardless of what the arrangement is called.
explanation_cn: 根据《出版物 15》第2节，如果雇主有权控制工作的内容和方式，则无论安排如何称呼，该工人都被视为雇员。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 2 (Document p. 14, PDF p. 14)

question_en: A statewide legal holiday falls on the day a contractor's federal tax deposit is due. How does this affect the deposit deadline?
question_cn: 如果承包商的联邦税款存款到期日恰逢全州法定假日，会如何影响存款截止日期？

options.en: The deposit deadline is extended by two business days
options.cn: 存款截止日期延长两个工作日

options.en: The deposit is still due on the original date
options.cn: 存款仍需在原定日期缴纳

options.en: The deposit is waived if remitted within 30 days
options.cn: 如果在30天内缴纳，存款可以免除

options.en: The deposit is due the next business day automatically
options.cn: 存款自动顺延到下一个工作日

explanation_en: Pub. 15 states that a statewide legal holiday does not delay the due date of federal tax deposits, even though it may delay certain return filing deadlines.
explanation_cn: 《出版物 15》规定，全州法定假日不会延迟联邦税款存款的到期日，尽管它可能会延迟某些报税截止日期。
code_reference: Pub. 15, Calendar; Pub. 15 Section 11 (Document p. 11, PDF p. 11)

question_en: A sole proprietor contractor employs his 16-year-old child on a jobsite. Which taxes apply to those wages?
question_cn: 一位独资承包商在工地上雇用了他16岁的孩子。这些工资适用哪些税费？

options.en: Social Security, Medicare, and FUTA taxes apply
options.cn: 社会保障税、医疗保险税和FUTA税适用

options.en: Only federal income tax withholding is required
options.cn: 仅需扣缴联邦所得税

options.en: Income tax, Social Security, Medicare, and FUTA apply
options.cn: 所得税、社会保障税、医疗保险税和FUTA税都适用

options.en: Income tax, Social Security, and Medicare apply
options.cn: 所得税、社会保障税和医疗保险税适用

explanation_en: Per Pub. 15 Section 3, payments to a child under 18 working for a parent sole proprietor are exempt from Social Security, Medicare, and FUTA taxes, but are still subject to income tax withholding.
explanation_cn: 根据《第15号出版物》第3节，独资承包商父母雇用未满18岁的子女工作时，其支付工资可免征社会保障税、医疗保险税和FUTA税，但仍需扣缴所得税。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 3 (Document p. 16, PDF p. 16)

question_en: A contractor employs his spouse in the business. Which of the following correctly describes the tax treatment of those wages?
question_cn: 承包商在业务中雇用他的配偶。以下哪项正确描述了这些工资的税务处理？

options.en: Subject to income tax, Social Security, and Medicare only
options.cn: 仅需缴纳所得税、社会保障税和医疗保险税

options.en: Exempt from all employment taxes and withholding
options.cn: 免缴所有雇佣税和预扣税

options.en: Subject to income tax, Social Security, Medicare, and FUTA
options.cn: 需缴纳所得税、社会保障税、医疗保险税和FUTA税

options.en: Exempt from Social Security and Medicare only
options.cn: 仅免缴社会保障税和医疗保险税

explanation_en: Per Pub. 15 Section 3, wages paid to one spouse by another in a trade or business are subject to income tax withholding and FICA taxes, but are specifically exempt from FUTA tax.
explanation_cn: 根据《第15号出版物》第3节，由一方配偶在贸易或业务中支付给另一方配偶的工资需要缴纳所得税预扣和FICA税，但明确免缴FUTA税。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 3 (Document p. 16, PDF p. 16)

question_en: A contractor's incorporated construction company employs the owner's 17-year-old child. How are those wages taxed?
question_cn: 承包商的注册建筑公司雇用了业主的17岁孩子。这些工资如何征税？

options.en: Exempt from Social Security and Medicare only
options.cn: 仅免缴社会保障和医疗保险税

options.en: Subject to income tax withholding and FUTA only
options.cn: 仅需缴纳所得税预扣和联邦失业税（FUTA）

options.en: Subject to income tax, Social Security, Medicare, and FUTA
options.cn: 需缴纳所得税、社会保障、医疗保险和联邦失业税（FUTA）

options.en: Exempt from all four employment taxes
options.cn: 四种雇佣税均免缴

explanation_en: Per Pub. 15 Section 3, when a child works for a corporation—even one controlled by the parent—all employment taxes apply because the child is considered an employee of the corporation, not the parent.
explanation_cn: 根据《出版物15》第3节，当孩子为公司工作——即使是由父母控制的公司——所有雇佣税都适用，因为孩子被视为公司的雇员，而不是父母的雇员。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 3 (Document p. 16, PDF p. 16)

question_en: What is the consequence to a contractor-employer who fails to include a correct employee SSN on Form W-2?
question_cn: 承包商雇主如果未在 W-2 表格上填写正确的员工社会保障号，会有什么后果？

options.en: Required refiling of all prior-year W-2 forms
options.cn: 需要重新提交所有前几年的 W-2 表格

options.en: A penalty unless the employer shows reasonable cause
options.cn: 除非雇主能证明有合理原因，否则需缴纳罚款

options.en: Immediate suspension of the employer's EIN
options.cn: 雇主的 EIN 将被立即暂停

options.en: Automatic audit of all employment tax returns
options.cn: 所有雇佣税申报表将自动接受审计

explanation_en: Per Pub. 15 Section 4, if the employer fails to provide the correct employee name and SSN on Form W-2, a penalty may be owed unless the employer can demonstrate reasonable cause.
explanation_cn: 根据第 15 号出版物第 4 节，如果雇主未能在 W-2 表格上提供正确的员工姓名和社会保障号，可能需要缴纳罚款，除非雇主能够证明有合理原因。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 4 (Document p. 17, PDF p. 17)

question_en: An employee presents a social security card stamped 'Not valid for employment.' What must the contractor do?
question_cn: 一名员工出示了一张印有“不得用于就业”的社会保障卡。承包商必须做什么？

options.en: Accept it and note the restriction in payroll records
options.cn: 接受它并在工资记录中注明限制

options.en: Use it temporarily until the employee gets a new card
options.cn: 暂时使用，直到员工获得新卡

options.en: Refuse to accept it for employment purposes
options.cn: 拒绝接受它用于就业目的

options.en: Photocopy it and place it in the personnel file
options.cn: 复印并放入人事档案

explanation_en: Per Pub. 15 Section 4, an employer must not accept a social security card that says 'Not valid for employment,' as that SSN does not permit employment.
explanation_cn: 根据《出版物15》第4节，雇主不得接受标有“不得用于就业”的社会保障卡，因为该社会保障号码不允许就业。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 4 (Document p. 17, PDF p. 17)

question_en: A contractor uses an Individual Taxpayer Identification Number (ITIN) instead of an SSN on an employee's Form W-2. What is the problem with this practice?
question_cn: 一名承包商在员工的 W-2 表格上使用个人纳税人识别号码 (ITIN) 而不是社会安全号码 (SSN)。这种做法的问题是什么？

options.en: ITINs are only valid for self-employed individuals
options.cn: ITIN 仅对个体经营者有效

options.en: An ITIN cannot replace an SSN on Form W-2
options.cn: ITIN 不能替代 W-2 表格上的 SSN

options.en: An ITIN cannot be used on any federal tax form
options.cn: ITIN 不能用于任何联邦税务表格

options.en: The IRS requires a separate form when an ITIN is used
options.cn: 当使用 ITIN 时，国税局要求填写单独的表格

explanation_en: Per Pub. 15 Section 4, an ITIN is only for aliens not eligible for U.S. employment and must never be used in place of an SSN on Form W-2 for an employee.
explanation_cn: 根据《出版物 15》第 4 节，ITIN 仅适用于不符合美国就业资格的外国人，绝不能在员工的 W-2 表格上代替 SSN 使用。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 4 (Document p. 17, PDF p. 17)

question_en: A contractor reimburses field workers for travel expenses but does not require receipts or documentation. How must these payments be treated for tax purposes?
question_cn: 承包商向外勤工作人员报销差旅费用，但不要求提供收据或其他凭证。这些支付在税务上应如何处理？

options.en: Treated as wages subject to all employment taxes
options.cn: 作为工资处理，需缴纳所有雇佣税

options.en: Excluded from wages as a business expense reimbursement
options.cn: 作为业务费用报销，不计入工资收入

options.en: Treated as nontaxable fringe benefits
options.cn: 作为免税附加福利处理

options.en: Subject to income tax withholding only
options.cn: 仅需预扣所得税

explanation_en: Per Pub. 15 Section 5, payments under a nonaccountable plan—where employees are not required to substantiate expenses—are treated as supplemental wages subject to income, Social Security, Medicare, and FUTA taxes.
explanation_cn: 根据《出版物 15》第 5 节，在非责任计划下的支付——员工不需要提供费用证明——被视为补充工资，需缴纳所得税、社会保障税、医疗保险税和联邦失业税。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 5 (Document p. 19, PDF p. 19)

question_en: Under an accountable plan, an employee fails to return excess reimbursements within the reasonable period. When do those amounts become taxable wages?
question_cn: 在可核算计划下，如果员工未在合理期限内退还多余的报销款项，这些金额何时成为应税工资？

options.en: On the next quarterly employment tax filing date
options.cn: 在下一个季度的雇佣税申报日期

options.en: Immediately when the expense is incurred
options.cn: 在产生费用时立即

options.en: At the end of the calendar year in which paid
options.cn: 在支付当年的日历年末

options.en: On the first payroll period after the reasonable period ends
options.cn: 在合理期限结束后的第一个工资周期

explanation_en: Per Pub. 15 Section 5, excess amounts not returned within a reasonable period are treated as wages paid under a nonaccountable plan for the first payroll period following the end of that reasonable period.
explanation_cn: 根据《出版物 15》第 5 节，未在合理期限内退还的多余金额，在该合理期限结束后的第一个工资周期视为非核算计划下支付的工资。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 5 (Document p. 19, PDF p. 19)

question_en: A contractor provides meals to employees at the worksite so workers are available for emergencies during lunch. Under what condition are these meals excluded from taxable wages?
question_cn: 承包商在工作现场为员工提供餐食，以便工人在午餐时间也能应对紧急情况。在什么情况下这些餐食可以从应税工资中排除？

options.en: When furnished on the employer's premises for the employer's convenience
options.cn: 当在雇主场所为雇主方便而提供时

options.en: When the employer provides a written statement of convenience
options.cn: 当雇主提供书面便利说明时

options.en: When the meals are provided at least three days per week
options.cn: 当每周至少提供三天餐食时

options.en: When the total meal value is under $20 per employee per month
options.cn: 当每位员工每月餐食总价值低于20美元时

explanation_en: Per Pub. 15 Section 5, meals are excluded from wages when furnished for the employer's convenience on the employer's premises, meaning there is a substantial business reason beyond providing extra compensation.
explanation_cn: 根据《出版物15》第5节，当餐食在雇主场所为雇主方便而提供时，可以从工资中排除，这意味着存在除提供额外报酬之外的重要商业原因。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 5 (Document p. 20, PDF p. 20)

question_en: A contractor pays an employee a signing bonus when first hired. How is this bonus treated for employment tax purposes?
question_cn: 承包商在首次雇用员工时支付签约奖金。该奖金在就业税方面如何处理？

options.en: Subject to FICA, FUTA, and income tax withholding
options.cn: 需缴纳FICA、FUTA及所得税预扣

options.en: Reported on Form 1099-NEC as contractor compensation
options.cn: 在表格1099-NEC上作为承包商薪酬报告

options.en: Subject to income tax withholding only
options.cn: 仅需缴纳所得税预扣

options.en: Excluded from employment taxes as a non-wage payment
options.cn: 作为非工资支付免除就业税

explanation_en: Per Pub. 15 Section 5, amounts paid as a signing bonus for ratifying an employment contract are specifically identified as wages subject to Social Security, Medicare, FUTA, and income tax withholding.
explanation_cn: 根据《出版物15》第5节，用于批准雇佣合同而支付的签约奖金金额被明确列为需缴纳社会保障税、医疗保险税、FUTA及所得税预扣的工资。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 5 (Document p. 18, PDF p. 18)

question_en: A contractor pays for employee health insurance premiums. What is the employment tax treatment of those premium payments?
question_cn: 承包商为员工支付健康保险保费。这些保费支付在就业税方面的处理是什么？

options.en: Exempt from FUTA only, taxable for all other purposes
options.cn: 仅免征FUTA，其他用途均需纳税

options.en: Wages subject to all employment taxes
options.cn: 工资需缴纳所有就业税

options.en: Exempt from FICA, FUTA, and income tax withholding
options.cn: 免征FICA、FUTA和所得税预扣

options.en: Subject to income tax withholding only
options.cn: 仅需缴纳所得税预扣

explanation_en: Per Pub. 15 Section 5, employer payments for accident or health insurance plans are not wages and are not subject to Social Security, Medicare, FUTA, or federal income tax withholding.
explanation_cn: 根据《出版物15》第5节，雇主为事故或健康保险计划支付的费用不属于工资，不需缴纳社会保障、医疗保险、FUTA或联邦所得税预扣。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 5 (Document p. 20, PDF p. 20)

question_en: A contractor provides a company truck for an employee's personal use. The contractor chooses not to withhold income tax on this benefit. What is the contractor still required to do?
question_cn: 承包商为员工提供公司卡车用于个人用途。承包商选择不对该福利扣缴所得税。承包商仍然需要做什么？

options.en: Withhold income tax but no other taxes on vehicle use
options.cn: 扣缴所得税，但不对车辆使用征收其他税费

options.en: Report the benefit only on the annual Form 940
options.cn: 仅在年度表格 940 上报告该福利

options.en: Exclude the vehicle benefit from all tax reporting
options.cn: 在所有税务申报中排除车辆福利

options.en: Withhold Social Security and Medicare taxes on the vehicle use
options.cn: 对车辆使用扣缴社会保障和医疗保险税

explanation_en: Per Pub. 15 Section 5, an employer may elect not to withhold income tax on the personal use of an employer-provided vehicle, but must still withhold Social Security and Medicare taxes on that benefit.
explanation_cn: 根据《出版物 15》第5节，雇主可选择不对雇主提供的车辆个人使用扣缴所得税，但仍必须对该福利扣缴社会保障和医疗保险税。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 5 (Document p. 21, PDF p. 21)

question_en: A contractor employs their own parent for domestic services at the contractor's private residence. Under what specific condition do Social Security and Medicare taxes apply?
question_cn: 承包商雇用自己的父母在承包商的私人住宅提供家庭服务。在什么具体条件下，社会保障税和医疗保险税适用？

options.en: Whenever the parent earns more than $2,600 in the year
options.cn: 每当父母在一年中收入超过2,600美元时

options.en: Only when the domestic services occur in a trade or business
options.cn: 仅当家庭服务发生在商业或贸易中时

options.en: Only if the parent works more than 20 hours per week
options.cn: 仅当父母每周工作超过20小时时

options.en: When the employer has a qualifying dependent child needing care
options.cn: 当雇主有需要照顾的符合条件的子女时

explanation_en: Per Pub. 15 Section 3, Social Security and Medicare taxes apply to domestic services by a parent if the employer has a child or stepchild at home who is under 18 or requires adult care, and the employer is a surviving spouse, divorced, or has a spouse unable to provide care for at least 4 continuous weeks.
explanation_cn: 根据《出版物15》第3节，如果雇主家中有18岁以下或需要成人照料的子女或继子女，并且雇主是幸存配偶、离婚或配偶在至少连续4周内无法提供照料的情况下，父母提供的家庭服务需要缴纳社会保障税和医疗保险税。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 3 (Document p. 16, PDF p. 16)

question_en: An employee's cash tips for the month total $18. What is the employee's tip-reporting obligation to the employer?
question_cn: 员工当月收到的现金小费总额为18美元。员工对雇主的举报小费义务是什么？

options.en: File a written statement with the IRS directly
options.cn: 直接向国税局提交书面声明

options.en: Report the tips by the 10th of the following month
options.cn: 在下个月的第10天之前报告小费

options.en: Report tips on the employee's personal tax return only
options.cn: 仅在员工的个人所得税申报表上报告小费

options.en: No report is required to the employer for that month
options.cn: 该月无需向雇主报告

explanation_en: Per Pub. 15 Section 6, no tip report to the employer is required for any month when the employee's tips are less than $20.
explanation_cn: 根据《出版物15》第6节，当员工的小费少于20美元时，该月无需向雇主报告小费。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 6 (Document p. 22, PDF p. 22)

question_en: A contractor makes differential wage payments to an employee on active military duty for more than 30 days. Which taxes apply to those payments?
question_cn: 承包商向服役超过30天的现役军人支付差额工资。这些支付适用于哪些税？

options.en: Federal income tax withholding only, not FICA or FUTA
options.cn: 仅联邦所得税预扣，不适用于FICA或FUTA

options.en: Income tax withholding, Social Security, Medicare, and FUTA
options.cn: 所得税预扣、社会保障、医疗保险和FUTA

options.en: Social Security and Medicare only, no income tax withholding
options.cn: 仅社会保障和医疗保险，不预扣所得税

options.en: Exempt from all employment taxes and withholding
options.cn: 豁免所有雇佣税和预扣

explanation_en: Per Pub. 15 Section 5, differential wage payments are wages for income tax withholding purposes but are not subject to Social Security, Medicare, or FUTA tax.
explanation_cn: 根据《出版物15》第5节，差额工资支付被视为所得税预扣的工资，但不适用于社会保障、医疗保险或FUTA税。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 5 (Document p. 20, PDF p. 20)

question_en: A contractor pays a field supervisor a $5,000 bonus separately from regular wages. The contractor withheld income tax from the supervisor's regular wages earlier in the same calendar year. What is the correct flat withholding rate the contractor may apply to this bonus?
question_cn: 一名承包商向现场主管支付一笔 5,000 美元的奖金，且该奖金与常规工资分开支付。承包商在同一日历年的早些时候已从主管的常规工资中扣缴所得税。承包商可以对这笔奖金适用的正确固定扣缴税率是多少？

options.en: 37% flat rate on the entire bonus
options.cn: 对整个奖金适用 37% 的固定税率

options.en: The employee's regular wage bracket rate
options.cn: 员工常规工资的税率等级

options.en: 25% flat rate on the entire bonus
options.cn: 对整个奖金适用 25% 的固定税率

options.en: 22% flat rate on the entire bonus
options.cn: 对整个奖金适用 22% 的固定税率

explanation_en: Pub. 15 Section 7 permits a flat 22% withholding rate on separately identified supplemental wages when the employer withheld income tax from regular wages in the current or immediately preceding calendar year and total supplemental wages do not exceed $1 million.
explanation_cn: 《出版物 15》第 7 节允许对单独列明的补充工资适用 22% 的固定扣税率，当雇主在当前或直接前一个日历年已对常规工资扣缴所得税且补充工资总额不超过 100 万美元时。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 7 (Document p. 24, PDF p. 24)

question_en: A contractor's project manager receives a $1,200,000 year-end bonus, bringing his total supplemental wages for the year to $1,250,000. What withholding rate must the contractor apply to the portion of the bonus that exceeds $1 million?
question_cn: 一名承包商的项目经理收到$1,200,000的年终奖金，使他全年补充工资总额达到$1,250,000。承包商必须对超过$100万的奖金部分适用什么预扣税率？

options.en: The graduated bracket rate from the employee's Form W-4
options.cn: 员工W-4表格上的分级税率

options.en: 28%, the former top supplemental wage rate
options.cn: 28%，以前的最高补充工资税率

options.en: 22%, regardless of the employee's Form W-4
options.cn: 22%，无论员工的W-4表格如何

options.en: 37%, disregarding the employee's Form W-4
options.cn: 37%，忽略员工的W-4表格

explanation_en: Pub. 15 Section 7 requires the employer to withhold at 37% (the highest income tax rate) on supplemental wages paid to any one employee that exceed $1 million in the calendar year, and the employee's Form W-4 is irrelevant for this calculation.
explanation_cn: 《税务出版物第15号》第7节规定，雇主必须对日历年任何一名员工超过$100万的补充工资按37%（最高所得税税率）预扣税款，员工的W-4表格在该计算中无关紧要。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 7 (Document p. 24, PDF p. 24)

question_en: A contractor hires a new employee who refuses to submit a Form W-4. How must the contractor withhold federal income tax from that employee's wages?
question_cn: 一名承包商雇用了一个新员工，该员工拒绝提交 W-4 表格。承包商必须如何从该员工的工资中扣缴联邦所得税？

options.en: Withhold using the married filing jointly standard rate
options.cn: 使用已婚联合申报的标准税率扣缴

options.en: Use the prior year's withholding tables at a flat rate
options.cn: 使用上一年的扣缴表按固定税率扣缴

options.en: Withhold based on single filing status with no adjustments
options.cn: 按单身申报状态且不做任何调整扣缴

options.en: No withholding until the employee submits a valid form
options.cn: 直到员工提交有效表格前不扣缴

explanation_en: Pub. 15 Section 9 states that if a new employee hired in 2026 does not provide a completed Form W-4, the employer must treat the employee as if they checked the box for Single or Married filing separately in Step 1(c) and made no entries in Steps 2, 3, or 4.
explanation_cn: 《出版物 15》第 9 节指出，如果 2026 年雇用的新员工未提供完整的 W-4 表格，雇主必须将该员工视为在步骤 1(c) 勾选了“单身或已婚分别申报”选项，并且在步骤 2、3 或 4 中未填写任何内容。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 9 (Document p. 26, PDF p. 26)

question_en: A contractor receives an IRS lock-in letter specifying a higher withholding rate for one of its employees. The employee then submits a new Form W-4 claiming complete exemption from withholding. What must the contractor do?
question_cn: 一名承包商收到美国国税局 (IRS) 的锁定通知信，指定对其一名员工采用更高的扣缴税率。随后，该员工提交了一份新的 W-4 表格，声称完全免税。承包商必须怎么做？

options.en: Apply the lock-in letter only until the employee files a tax return
options.cn: 仅在员工提交纳税申报表之前执行锁定通知

options.en: Honor the new Form W-4 immediately as submitted
options.cn: 立即按提交的新 W-4 表格执行

options.en: Withhold based on the new W-4 after a 30-day grace period
options.cn: 在 30 天宽限期后按新 W-4 扣缴

options.en: Disregard the new W-4 and continue withholding per the lock-in letter
options.cn: 忽略新的 W-4 表格，继续根据锁定通知扣缴

explanation_en: Pub. 15 Section 9 states that after an IRS lock-in letter is issued, the employer must disregard any new Form W-4 that would result in less withholding than required by the notice. The employer must continue withholding based on the lock-in letter unless the IRS notifies otherwise.
explanation_cn: 《出版物 15》第 9 节规定，在美国国税局发出锁定通知后，雇主必须忽略任何可能导致扣缴税款少于通知要求的新 W-4 表格。除非 IRS 另行通知，雇主必须继续根据锁定通知扣缴税款。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 9 (Document p. 28, PDF p. 28)

question_en: An employee submits a Form W-4 that has unauthorized language added and clearly appears to have been altered. What is the contractor's obligation regarding this form?
question_cn: 员工提交了一份 W-4 表格，该表格上添加了未经授权的内容，并且显然已被篡改。承包商对该表格有何义务？

options.en: Report the employee to the IRS and suspend payroll
options.cn: 向国税局报告该员工并暂停工资发放

options.en: Use the single/no-adjustments default; request a valid W-4
options.cn: 使用单身/无调整默认选项；请求有效的 W-4 表格

options.en: Immediately forward the form to the IRS for review
options.cn: 立即将表格转交给国税局审核

options.en: Accept it and withhold based on the altered information
options.cn: 接受表格并按篡改的信息扣缴税款

explanation_en: Pub. 15 Section 9 states that when an invalid Form W-4 is received and no prior valid W-4 exists for that employee, the employer must withhold as if the employee had checked Single or Married filing separately with no other adjustments—the same default as having no W-4 on file.
explanation_cn: 《第 15 号出版物》第 9 节规定，当收到无效的 W-4 表格且该员工没有先前有效的 W-4 表格时，雇主必须按员工勾选“单身”或“已婚分别申报且无其他调整”的方式扣缴税款——这与你没有 W-4 表格时的默认处理相同。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 9 (Document p. 28, PDF p. 28)

question_en: A contractor's employee claimed exemption from federal income tax withholding last year but has not submitted a new Form W-4 by February 15 of the current year. What must the contractor do starting February 16?
question_cn: 去年，承包商的一名员工声称免除联邦所得税预扣，但截至本年度2月15日尚未提交新的W-4表格。自2月16日起，承包商必须怎么做？

options.en: Begin withholding based on single status with no adjustments
options.cn: 根据单身身份且无调整开始预扣

options.en: Suspend payroll until a valid Form W-4 is received
options.cn: 暂停工资发放，直到收到有效的W-4表格

options.en: Contact the IRS before making any withholding change
options.cn: 在进行任何预扣更改前联系国税局（IRS）

options.en: Continue the prior-year exemption for the rest of the year
options.cn: 在剩余年度继续使用前年的免税状态

explanation_en: Pub. 15 Section 9 states that if the employee does not provide a new exempt W-4 by February 15, the employer must begin withholding as if the employee checked the box for Single or Married filing separately with no entries in Steps 2, 3, or 4.
explanation_cn: 《出版物 15》第9节规定，如果员工在2月15日前未提供新的免税W-4表格，雇主必须开始按员工勾选“单身”或“已婚但分开申报”且步骤2、3或4为空白的方式进行预扣。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 9 (Document p. 27, PDF p. 27)

question_en: A contractor receives a lock-in letter from the IRS for a current employee. Within how many business days must the contractor furnish the employee copy of the notice to that employee?
question_cn: 承包商收到国税局关于当前雇员的锁定函。承包商必须在收到通知后的多少个工作日内向该雇员提供通知副本？

options.en: Within 30 calendar days of receiving the notice
options.cn: 在收到通知后的30个日历日内

options.en: Within 10 business days of receiving the notice
options.cn: 在收到通知后的10个工作日内

options.en: Within 15 business days of receiving the notice
options.cn: 在收到通知后的15个工作日内

options.en: Within 5 business days of receiving the notice
options.cn: 在收到通知后的5个工作日内

explanation_en: Pub. 15 Section 9 explicitly requires the employer to furnish the employee copy of the lock-in letter to the employee within 10 business days of receipt, if the employee is currently employed as of the date of the notice.
explanation_cn: 出版物15第9节明确要求，如果雇员在通知之日仍为在职员工，雇主必须在收到通知后的10个工作日内向该雇员提供锁定函的副本。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 9 (Document p. 28, PDF p. 28)

question_en: An employee hands a contractor a new replacement Form W-4. By when must the contractor begin using the new form for withholding purposes?
question_cn: 一名员工将一份新的替换 Form W-4 表格交给承包商。承包商必须在什么时候开始使用新表格进行扣缴？

options.en: By the first payroll period ending on or after the 30th day
options.cn: 在第一个工资期结束时或在第 30 天之后开始

options.en: The very next payroll period after receipt
options.cn: 收到后的下一个工资期开始

options.en: No later than 30 days after the pay period the form was submitted
options.cn: 不迟于提交表格的工资期后 30 天

options.en: The first day of the following calendar year
options.cn: 下一日历年的第一天

explanation_en: Pub. 15 Section 9 states that when a replacement Form W-4 is received, the employer must begin withholding no later than the start of the first payroll period ending on or after the 30th day from the date the form was received.
explanation_cn: 《出版物 15》第 9 节指出，当收到替换 Form W-4 表格时，雇主必须在收到表格之日起第 30 天或之后结束的第一个工资期开始扣缴税款。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 9 (Document p. 26, PDF p. 26)

question_en: A contractor pays a framing crew leader a commission on project completion but has no regular payroll period for this worker. What payroll period should the contractor use for withholding income tax?
question_cn: 承包商在项目完成时向一个框架工队长支付佣金，但没有为该工人设定固定的工资期。承包商应使用什么工资期来扣缴所得税？

options.en: A monthly payroll period for the current calendar year
options.cn: 本日历年的每月工资期

options.en: A daily or miscellaneous payroll period based on days covered
options.cn: 根据覆盖天数的每日或杂项工资期

options.en: A weekly period if the worker signs a statement of exclusivity
options.cn: 如果工人签署独家声明，则为每周工资期

options.en: The period used for other employees on the project
options.cn: 项目中其他员工使用的工资期

explanation_en: Pub. 15 Section 8 states that when there is no regular payroll period, the employer must withhold tax as if wages were paid for a daily or miscellaneous payroll period, counting back days from payment to the last wage payment, start of employment, or January 1.
explanation_cn: 《出版物15》第8节指出，当没有固定工资期时，雇主必须按照每日或杂项工资期扣缴税款，从支付日向回数天计算，直到上一次工资支付、雇佣开始日或1月1日。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 8 (Document p. 25, PDF p. 25)

question_en: A contractor's employee reports $25 in tips in writing for a given month, but the contractor does not have enough of the employee's funds to withhold all required taxes. In what order must the contractor withhold the available funds?
question_cn: 承包商的员工在书面上报告某个月的小费为25美元，但承包商没有足够的该员工资金来扣缴所有所需的税款。在这种情况下，承包商必须按什么顺序扣缴可用资金？

options.en: Regular wages first, then FICA on tips, then income tax
options.cn: 先扣常规工资，然后扣小费的FICA税，再扣所得税

options.en: Income tax on tips first, then FICA taxes on tips
options.cn: 先扣小费的所得税，再扣小费的FICA税

options.en: Allocate evenly across all outstanding taxes at once
options.cn: 将可用资金平均分配到所有未缴税款上

options.en: Social security on tips first, then regular wages, then income tax
options.cn: 先扣小费的社会保障税，然后扣常规工资，再扣所得税

explanation_en: Pub. 15 Section 6 specifies the ordering rule when insufficient funds exist: (1) withhold on regular wages and other compensation, (2) withhold social security and Medicare taxes on tips, and (3) withhold income tax on tips.
explanation_cn: 公告15第6节规定了资金不足时的扣缴顺序规则：(1) 扣除常规工资及其他报酬，(2) 扣除小费的社会保障税和医疗保险税，(3) 扣除小费的所得税。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 6 (Document p. 23, PDF p. 23)

question_en: A contractor's employee earned $150 in reported tips this month. Is the contractor required to pay FUTA tax on those tips?
question_cn: 一名承包商的员工本月报告获得了 150 美元的小费。承包商是否需要为这些小费支付 FUTA 税？

options.en: Yes, because the tips exceed the $20 monthly reporting threshold
options.cn: 是的，因为小费超过了每月 20 美元的报告门槛

options.en: No, tips are never subject to FUTA tax
options.cn: 不，小费从不需要缴纳 FUTA 税

options.en: No, FUTA applies only to allocated tips at year-end
options.cn: 不，FUTA 仅适用于年终分配的小费

options.en: Yes, but only on tips above $100 per month
options.cn: 是的，但仅对每月超过 100 美元的小费部分征税

explanation_en: Pub. 15 Section 6 states that if an employee reports $20 or more of tips in writing for a month, those tips are subject to FUTA tax. The employee's $150 reported tips clearly exceed the $20 threshold.
explanation_cn: 第 15 号出版物第 6 节指出，如果员工以书面形式报告当月 20 美元或以上的小费，则这些小费需缴纳 FUTA 税。该员工报告的 150 美元小费显然超过了 20 美元的门槛。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 6 (Document p. 23, PDF p. 23)

question_en: A contractor combines a $2,000 bonus with a $3,000 regular wage payment in a single paycheck without separately identifying the amounts. How must the contractor calculate federal income tax withholding?
question_cn: 一名承包商将2000美元奖金与3000美元常规工资合并支付在一张支票中，但没有单独标明各自金额。承包商应如何计算联邦所得税预扣？

options.en: Withhold on $3,000 regular wages and skip the bonus
options.cn: 按3000美元常规工资预扣，跳过奖金部分

options.en: Withhold based on $5,000 as a single regular payroll payment
options.cn: 按5000美元作为一次常规工资支付来预扣

options.en: Apply the 22% flat rate to the bonus portion only
options.cn: 仅对奖金部分应用22%的固定税率

options.en: Apply the 37% mandatory rate to the full combined payment
options.cn: 对整个合并支付金额应用37%的强制税率

explanation_en: Pub. 15 Section 7 states that if supplemental wages are paid with regular wages but the amount of each is not specified, the employer must withhold federal income tax as if the total ($5,000) were a single payment for a regular payroll period.
explanation_cn: 《出版物15》第7节指出，如果补充工资与常规工资一起支付，但各自金额未明确说明，雇主必须按总额（5000美元）作为一次常规工资支付来预扣联邦所得税。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 7 (Document p. 24, PDF p. 24)

question_en: A contractor employs a worker who did not file any Form W-4 before 2020 and has never submitted one since. Under Pub. 15 Section 9, what withholding method should the contractor currently be using for this employee?
question_cn: 一名承包商雇佣了一名在2020年前未提交任何W-4表格并且此后从未提交过的员工。根据《第15号出版物》第9节，承包商当前应对该员工使用哪种扣缴方法？

options.en: Stop withholding until a current W-4 form is received
options.cn: 在收到当前W-4表格之前停止扣缴

options.en: Apply the 2026 redesigned W-4 default of single, no adjustments
options.cn: 适用2026年重新设计的W-4默认单身、无调整

options.en: Treat as single with zero allowances using 2019 W-4 methods
options.cn: 使用2019年W-4方法视为单身且零免税额

options.en: Treat the employee as married filing jointly with zero adjustments
options.cn: 将员工视为已婚联合申报且零调整

explanation_en: Pub. 15 Section 9 states that an employee who was paid wages before 2020 and never submitted a valid Form W-4 should be treated as single and claiming zero allowances on a 2019 Form W-4. The redesigned W-4 default applies only to employees first hired in 2020 or later.
explanation_cn: 《第15号出版物》第9节指出，对于在2020年前已获得工资且从未提交有效W-4表格的员工，应视为单身且申报零免税额，使用2019年的W-4方法。重新设计的W-4默认只适用于2020年或之后首次雇佣的员工。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 9 (Document p. 26, PDF p. 26)

question_en: An employee claims exemption from withholding on a Form W-4 that also has the higher-withholding box in Step 2(c) checked and numbers entered in Step 3. What must the contractor do with this form?
question_cn: 一名员工在 W-4 表上申请免除预扣，同时在第 2(c) 步中勾选了高额预扣框，并在第 3 步输入了数字。承包商应如何处理此表格？

options.en: Honor the exemption claim and withhold nothing
options.cn: 尊重免税申请，不预扣任何税款

options.en: Treat the form as invalid; request a replacement W-4
options.cn: 将表格视为无效；请求更换 W-4 表格

options.en: Honor only the exemption claim and ignore the conflicting entries
options.cn: 仅尊重免税申请，忽略冲突的条目

options.en: Forward the form to the IRS for a withholding determination
options.cn: 将表格转交给税务局以进行预扣决定

explanation_en: Pub. 15 Section 9 explicitly permits the employer to treat a Form W-4 as invalid when the employee writes 'exempt' below Step 4(c) and simultaneously checks the box in Step 2(c) or enters amounts in Steps 3 or 4. The employer must reject it and ask for a valid replacement.
explanation_cn: 第 15 号出版物第 9 节明确允许雇主在员工在第 4(c) 步下方写上“免税”，同时勾选第 2(c) 步的框或在第 3 或第 4 步输入金额时，将 W-4 表视为无效。雇主必须拒绝该表格并请求有效的替换表格。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 9 (Document p. 29, PDF p. 29)

question_en: A contractor pays vacation pay as an annual lump-sum for unused leave in addition to regular wages for that period. How must the contractor treat this lump-sum vacation payment for withholding purposes?
question_cn: 承包商将假期工资作为年度一次性支付，用于未休假期，且在该期间还支付正常工资。承包商必须如何处理这笔一次性假期工资的预扣税？

options.en: Exempt it from withholding since it relates to unused time off
options.cn: 免予预扣，因为它与未休假期有关

options.en: Treat it as regular wages and withhold using the bracket tables
options.cn: 作为正常工资处理，并使用税率表预扣

options.en: Spread it equally across all remaining pay periods in the year
options.cn: 在全年剩余的所有支付期间平均分摊

options.en: Treat it as a supplemental wage payment subject to applicable rules
options.cn: 作为补充工资支付处理，并适用相关规则

explanation_en: Pub. 15 Section 7 states that when vacation pay is in addition to regular wages for the vacation period—such as an annual lump-sum for unused vacation leave—it must be treated as a supplemental wage payment, subject to the flat 22% rate or the aggregate method.
explanation_cn: 出版物 15 第 7 节指出，当假期工资是该假期期间正常工资之外的额外支付——例如未休假期的年度一次性支付——必须作为补充工资支付处理，适用 22% 的固定税率或总和方法。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 7 (Document p. 25, PDF p. 25)

question_en: A contractor accumulates $100,000 in employment tax liability on a single Monday. When must the deposit be made?
question_cn: 一位承包商在某个星期一累计了 100,000 美元的雇佣税负债。必须何时存款？

options.en: By the following Wednesday under the semiweekly schedule
options.cn: 根据半周存款时间表，在随后的星期三之前

options.en: By the 15th of the following month
options.cn: 在下个月的 15 日之前

options.en: By Friday of the same semiweekly deposit period
options.cn: 在同一半周存款期的星期五之前

options.en: By Tuesday, the next business day
options.cn: 在下一个工作日的星期二之前

explanation_en: Under the $100,000 Next-Day Deposit Rule in Pub. 15 Section 11, whenever a depositor accumulates $100,000 or more on any single day, the tax must be deposited by the next business day regardless of the normal deposit schedule.
explanation_cn: 根据《出版物 15》第 11 节的 100,000 美元隔日存款规则，如果存款人在任何单日累计了 100,000 美元或更多，税款必须在下一个工作日存入，而不论正常存款时间表如何。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 11 (Document p. 34, PDF p. 34)

question_en: A monthly schedule depositor accumulates a $100,000 tax liability on a single day. What happens to the employer's deposit schedule going forward?
question_cn: 一名按月存款的纳税人，在某一天累计了100,000美元的税务负债。此后雇主的存款计划会发生什么变化？

options.en: Switches to semiweekly permanently with no option to revert
options.cn: 永久改为半周存款，无回到原计划的选项

options.en: Switches to semiweekly for the current quarter only
options.cn: 仅在当前季度改为半周存款

options.en: Remains monthly for the current calendar year only
options.cn: 仅在当前日历年保持按月存款

options.en: Switches to semiweekly for the current and following calendar year
options.cn: 当前和下一日历年改为半周存款

explanation_en: Per Pub. 15 Section 11, a monthly schedule depositor who accumulates a $100,000 liability on any day becomes a semiweekly schedule depositor starting the next day and remains so for at least the rest of the calendar year and all of the following calendar year.
explanation_cn: 根据《出版物15》第11节，任何一天累计100,000美元负债的按月存款纳税人，从次日起开始按半周计划存款，并至少在当年剩余期间以及整个下一日历年保持此计划。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 11 (Document p. 35, PDF p. 35)

question_en: What is the penalty rate for employment tax deposits that are made 6 to 15 days late?
question_cn: 对于延迟6到15天缴纳的就业税存款，罚款率是多少？

options.en: 15% of the amount that was not deposited on time
options.cn: 未按时存入金额的15%

options.en: 2% of the amount that was not deposited on time
options.cn: 未按时存入金额的2%

options.en: 10% of the amount that was not deposited on time
options.cn: 未按时存入金额的10%

options.en: 5% of the amount that was not deposited on time
options.cn: 未按时存入金额的5%

explanation_en: Per the deposit penalty table in Pub. 15 Section 11, a 5% penalty applies when deposits are made 6 to 15 calendar days after the due date.
explanation_cn: 根据《第15号出版物》第11节的存款罚款表，当存款在到期日后6到15个日历日进行时，适用5%的罚款。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 11 (Document p. 36, PDF p. 36)

question_en: A contractor fails to withhold and deposit trust fund taxes and cannot pay the amount owed. Who can the IRS hold personally liable for 100% of those unpaid taxes?
question_cn: 一名承包商未能扣留并缴纳信托基金税款且无法支付所欠金额。IRS 可以要求谁对这些未缴税款的 100% 承担个人责任？

options.en: Any responsible person who willfully failed to pay over the taxes
options.cn: 任何故意未支付税款的责任人

options.en: Only the owner or sole proprietor of the business
options.cn: 仅企业的所有者或独资经营者

options.en: Only the payroll manager who processed the paychecks
options.cn: 仅处理工资支票的工资经理

options.en: Only corporate officers who signed payroll tax returns
options.cn: 仅签署工资税申报表的公司高管

explanation_en: Under the trust fund recovery penalty in Pub. 15 Section 11, the IRS may impose 100% personal liability on any responsible person—officer, employee, partner, accountant, or other individual—who willfully failed to collect, account for, or pay over trust fund taxes.
explanation_cn: 根据 Pub. 15 第 11 节的信托基金追缴罚款规定，IRS 可以对任何故意未收税、未核算税款或未缴纳信托基金税的责任人——包括高管、员工、合伙人、会计师或其他个人——施加 100% 的个人责任。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 11 (Document p. 36, PDF p. 36)

question_en: A contractor's lookback period shows $51,000 in total Form 941 taxes. Which deposit schedule applies for the upcoming calendar year?
question_cn: 承包商的回顾期显示总计 $51,000 的 Form 941 税款。下一个日历年适用哪种存款计划？

options.en: Monthly, because the amount is close to the threshold
options.cn: 每月，因为金额接近门槛

options.en: Either monthly or semiweekly at the employer's election
options.cn: 每月或每周两次，由雇主自行选择

options.en: Monthly, because new employers always start on monthly
options.cn: 每月，因为新雇主总是从每月开始

options.en: Semiweekly, because lookback taxes exceeded $50,000
options.cn: 每周两次，因为回顾期税款超过 $50,000

explanation_en: Per Pub. 15 Section 11, an employer whose total taxes in the lookback period exceeded $50,000 must use the semiweekly deposit schedule for the upcoming calendar year. $51,000 exceeds the threshold.
explanation_cn: 根据《出版物 15》第 11 节，总税款在回顾期超过 $50,000 的雇主，必须在下一个日历年使用每周两次存款计划。$51,000 超过了门槛。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 11 (Document p. 32, PDF p. 32)

question_en: A contractor buys a competitor's business mid-year. A transferred employee had already earned $2,000 with the predecessor. How does this affect the social security wage base calculation for that employee?
question_cn: 一家承包商在年中收购了竞争对手的业务。一名被调动的员工在前任公司已经赚取了2,000美元。这如何影响该员工的社会保障工资基数计算？

options.en: The prior wages count only for Medicare, not for Social Security
options.cn: 之前的工资只计入医疗保险，不计入社会保障

options.en: The successor applies the wage base only to the employee's first paycheck
options.cn: 继任公司只对该员工的第一张工资单应用工资基数

options.en: The prior $2,000 counts toward the wage base, reducing the taxable amount
options.cn: 之前的2,000美元计入工资基数，减少应税金额

options.en: The successor ignores prior wages and applies the full wage base
options.cn: 继任公司忽略之前的工资，按全额工资基数计算

explanation_en: Per the successor employer rules in Pub. 15 Section 9, wages paid by the predecessor are treated as if paid by the successor. The employee's $2,000 prior wages reduce the remaining social security wage base the successor must apply, and count toward the $200,000 Additional Medicare Tax threshold as well.
explanation_cn: 根据《雇主指南》第15号第9节的继任雇主规则，由前任支付的工资视同由继任雇主支付。员工之前的2,000美元工资会减少继任雇主必须应用的剩余社会保障工资基数，同时也计入200,000美元额外医疗保险税的门槛。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 9 (Document p. 30, PDF p. 30)

question_en: When must a contractor begin withholding the Additional Medicare Tax from an employee's wages?
question_cn: 承包商何时必须开始从雇员工资中扣缴额外的医疗保险税？

options.en: In the pay period when the employee's wages exceed $200,000
options.cn: 在雇员工资超过 200,000 美元的支付期间

options.en: Only when the employee requests additional withholding on Form W-4
options.cn: 仅在雇员在 W-4 表格上请求额外扣缴时

options.en: At the start of the next calendar year after wages exceed $200,000
options.cn: 在工资超过 200,000 美元后的下一个日历年开始

options.en: Once total payroll for all employees exceeds $200,000
options.cn: 一旦所有雇员的总工资超过 200,000 美元

explanation_en: Per Pub. 15 Section 9, the employer must begin withholding the 0.9% Additional Medicare Tax in the specific pay period in which wages paid to that employee first exceed $200,000 and must continue withholding for the rest of the calendar year.
explanation_cn: 根据《出版物 15》第 9 节，雇主必须在支付给某雇员的工资首次超过 200,000 美元的特定支付期间开始扣缴 0.9% 的额外医疗保险税，并且必须在本日历年的其余时间继续扣缴。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 9 (Document p. 30, PDF p. 30)

question_en: A contractor pays part-time workers on a job site. How are these workers treated for federal income tax withholding and FICA purposes?
question_cn: 承包商在工地上支付兼职工人的工资。这些工人在联邦所得税预扣和FICA方面如何处理？

options.en: Treated the same as full-time employees for all payroll taxes
options.cn: 在所有工资税方面与全职员工待遇相同

options.en: Exempt from FICA if they work fewer than 20 hours per week
options.cn: 如果每周工作少于20小时，则免缴FICA

options.en: Subject to FICA only if they work more than one job
options.cn: 仅在他们有多个工作时才需缴纳FICA

options.en: Exempt from federal income tax withholding, but subject to FICA
options.cn: 免缴联邦所得税预扣，但需缴纳FICA

explanation_en: Per the Part-Time Workers section of Pub. 15 Section 9, part-time workers and workers hired for short periods are treated identically to full-time employees for federal income tax withholding and Social Security, Medicare, and FUTA tax purposes.
explanation_cn: 根据《第15号出版物》第9节兼职工人部分，兼职工人和短期雇佣工人在联邦所得税预扣以及社会保障、医疗保险和FUTA税方面与全职员工待遇相同。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 9 (Document p. 31, PDF p. 31)

question_en: A contractor deposits employment taxes by sending a check directly to the IRS instead of using EFT. What penalty applies to that payment?
question_cn: 承包商通过直接向国税局寄送支票而不是使用电子联邦税款转账（EFT）来缴纳雇佣税。对此付款适用什么处罚？

options.en: A 5% penalty assessed on the improperly paid amount
options.cn: 对错误支付金额征收5%的罚款

options.en: A 2% penalty for using the incorrect payment method
options.cn: 因使用错误的支付方式而征收2%的罚款

options.en: A 10% penalty for paying the IRS directly instead of depositing
options.cn: 因直接向国税局付款而不是存款征收10%的罚款

options.en: No penalty if the check was received by the IRS on time
options.cn: 如果国税局按时收到支票，则无需罚款

explanation_en: Per the deposit penalty table in Pub. 15 Section 11, amounts that should have been deposited but were instead paid directly to the IRS are subject to a 10% penalty, subject to the exceptions described under Payment with return.
explanation_cn: 根据《Pub. 15》第11节的存款罚款表，本应存入但却直接支付给国税局的金额，将受到10%的罚款，按“随报表支付”下描述的例外情况除外。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 11 (Document p. 36, PDF p. 36)

question_en: A contractor's deposit shortfall is within the allowable tolerance. What is the latest a monthly schedule depositor can make up a deposit shortfall without incurring a penalty?
question_cn: 承包商的保证金不足在允许的容差范围内。每月定期缴款人最迟可以在什么时候弥补保证金不足而不受处罚？

options.en: Within 10 days of receiving an IRS penalty notice
options.cn: 在收到 IRS 罚款通知后的 10 天内

options.en: The first Wednesday after the 15th of the following month
options.cn: 次月 15 日之后的第一个星期三

options.en: By the 15th of the month following when the shortfall occurred
options.cn: 在不足发生后的次月 15 日之前

options.en: By the return due date for the period the shortfall occurred
options.cn: 在不足发生期间的申报截止日期之前

explanation_en: Per Pub. 15 Section 11, a monthly schedule depositor must deposit the shortfall or pay it with the return by the due date of the return for the return period in which the shortfall occurred. The shortfall may be paid with the return even if it is $2,500 or more.
explanation_cn: 根据《出版物 15》第 11 节，每月定期缴款人必须在税款申报截止日期之前弥补不足或随申报一并缴纳。不足金额即使达到 2,500 美元或以上，也可以随申报一并支付。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 11 (Document p. 35, PDF p. 35)

question_en: A semiweekly schedule depositor has pay dates on both Friday, September 30, and Friday, October 2. How must the deposits for these two paydays be handled?
question_cn: 半周支付计划的存款人有两个发薪日，分别是 9 月 30 日星期五和 10 月 2 日星期五。对于这两个发薪日的存款应如何处理？

options.en: Deposited separately, each by the following Friday
options.cn: 分开存款，每个在下一个星期五之前存入

options.en: Combined and deposited by the following Friday
options.cn: 合并存款，并在下一个星期五之前存入

options.en: Deposited separately, each by the following Wednesday
options.cn: 分开存款，每个在下一个星期三之前存入

options.en: Combined into one deposit due the following Wednesday
options.cn: 合并为一次存款，截止日期为下一个星期三

explanation_en: Per Pub. 15 Section 11, when a semiweekly period spans two calendar quarters, separate deposits are required for each quarter's liability. Both deposits are due Wednesday, October 7, 2026, the Wednesday following the Friday paydays.
explanation_cn: 根据《15 号出版物》第 11 节，当半周期跨越两个日历季度时，每个季度的负债需要单独存款。两个存款的截止日期均为 2026 年 10 月 7 日星期三，即紧接在星期五发薪日之后的星期三。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 11 (Document p. 33, PDF p. 33)

question_en: A contractor discovers an error and files a Form 941-X correcting an understatement from a prior lookback period. How does this correction affect the employer's deposit schedule for the current year?
question_cn: 承包商发现错误，并提交 Form 941-X 来更正先前回溯期的少报金额。这一更正如何影响雇主当年的存款时间表？

options.en: The deposit schedule changes immediately upon filing Form 941-X
options.cn: 提交 Form 941-X 后，存款时间表立即更改

options.en: The correction is counted toward the current year's tax liability instead
options.cn: 更正金额计入当年的税负

options.en: The deposit schedule is unaffected; original reported amounts control
options.cn: 存款时间表不受影响；以原报告金额为准

options.en: The corrected amount is added to the lookback period total
options.cn: 更正金额计入回溯期总额

explanation_en: Per the adjustments and lookback rule in Pub. 15 Section 11, corrections made on Form 941-X do not change the tax liability for previous periods for purposes of the lookback rule. The deposit schedule for the current year is determined solely by the amounts originally reported.
explanation_cn: 根据《出版物 15》第11节的调整及回溯规则，对 Form 941-X 的更正不会更改以前期间的税负以用于回溯规则。当年的存款时间表仅由最初报告的金额决定。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 11 (Document p. 32, PDF p. 32)

question_en: What is the maximum penalty rate that can be imposed on employment taxes that remain unpaid after the IRS issues a notice and demand for immediate payment?
question_cn: 在美国国税局（IRS）发出立即付款通知后，对仍未缴纳的就业税可施加的最高罚款率是多少？

options.en: 100% of the total unpaid employment taxes
options.cn: 未支付就业税总额的100%

options.en: 25% of the total unpaid employment taxes
options.cn: 未支付就业税总额的25%

options.en: 15% of the total unpaid employment taxes
options.cn: 未支付就业税总额的15%

options.en: 10% of the total unpaid employment taxes
options.cn: 未支付就业税总额的10%

explanation_en: Per the deposit penalty table in Pub. 15 Section 11, the 15% penalty applies to amounts still unpaid more than 10 days after the date of the first IRS notice, or on the day the employer receives a notice and demand for immediate payment, whichever is earlier.
explanation_cn: 根据《出版物15》第11节的存款罚款表，对于在首次IRS通知日期后超过10天仍未支付的款项，或在雇主收到立即付款通知的当天（以较早者为准）适用15%的罚款。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 11 (Document p. 36, PDF p. 36)

question_en: A contractor employs only one worker but pays that worker $210,000 in a calendar year. Which of the following best describes the contractor's Additional Medicare Tax obligation?
question_cn: 一名承包商只雇用了一个工人，但在一个日历年内支付该工人工资 210,000 美元。以下哪项最能描述该承包商的额外医疗保险税义务？

options.en: The employer owes 0.9% on the $10,000 above the threshold
options.cn: 雇主需按超过门槛的 10,000 美元缴纳 0.9%

options.en: The employer must withhold 0.9% only on the $10,000 above $200,000
options.cn: 雇主仅需对超过 200,000 美元的 10,000 美元代扣 0.9%

options.en: No Additional Medicare Tax applies since only one employee exists
options.cn: 由于只有一个雇员，因此不适用额外医疗保险税

options.en: Both employer and employee each owe 0.9% on all $210,000
options.cn: 雇主和雇员各自对全部 210,000 美元缴纳 0.9%

explanation_en: Per Pub. 15 Section 9, the 0.9% Additional Medicare Tax is imposed only on the employee and only on wages exceeding $200,000. The employer must withhold it beginning in the pay period the threshold is crossed, on the $10,000 excess amount.
explanation_cn: 根据《出版物 15》第 9 节，0.9% 的额外医疗保险税仅对雇员征收，并且仅适用于超过 200,000 美元的工资。雇主必须从超过门槛的支付期开始代扣该税，即针对 10,000 美元的超额金额。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 9 (Document p. 30, PDF p. 30)

question_en: A contractor knowingly allows payroll taxes to go unpaid while continuing to sign company checks. Which statement best describes the contractor's personal exposure?
question_cn: 一名承包商明知工资税未缴仍继续签发公司支票。哪个陈述最能描述该承包商的个人责任？

options.en: Liability is shared equally among all company officers
options.cn: 公司的所有高管共同承担责任

options.en: Personal liability applies only if the IRS proves fraud
options.cn: 只有在国税局证明存在欺诈行为时才适用个人责任

options.en: Full personal liability for the entire unpaid trust fund amount
options.cn: 对整个未缴信托基金金额负全部个人责任

options.en: Personal liability is capped at 50% of unpaid taxes
options.cn: 个人责任上限为未缴税款的50%

explanation_en: Pub. 15 Section 11 states that a responsible person who willfully fails to collect, account for, or pay over trust fund taxes is personally liable for 100% of the unpaid amount. Signing checks establishes responsible-person status, and knowing the taxes aren't being paid satisfies the willfulness requirement.
explanation_cn: 出版物 15 第11节指出，负责任的人如果故意未能征收、记账或缴纳信托基金税款，将对未缴金额的100%承担个人责任。签发支票确立了负责任人的身份，而明知税款未缴满足故意行为的要求。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 11 (Document p. 37, PDF p. 37)

question_en: Under Pub. 15, what is the key factor that makes a responsible person's failure to pay trust fund taxes subject to the trust fund recovery penalty?
question_cn: 根据《出版物 15》，使责任人未支付信托基金税款而需承担信托基金追缴罚款的关键因素是什么？

options.en: The amount of taxes that went unpaid exceeds $1,000
options.cn: 未支付的税款金额超过 1,000 美元

options.en: The failure must be intentional, conscious, and voluntary
options.cn: 该未支付行为必须是故意的、有意识的和自愿的

options.en: The IRS must first assess a failure-to-file penalty
options.cn: 国税局必须首先评估未提交申报的罚款

options.en: The employer must have missed at least two consecutive deposits
options.cn: 雇主必须至少错过连续两次存款

explanation_en: Pub. 15 Section 11 defines 'willfully' as acting voluntarily, consciously, and intentionally, or recklessly disregarding obvious and known risks to the government's right to receive trust fund taxes. This willfulness element is what triggers personal liability.
explanation_cn: 《出版物 15》第 11 节将“故意”定义为自愿、有意识和有意地行事，或者对政府获得信托基金税款的明显和已知风险采取鲁莽忽视的态度。这个故意性因素会触发个人责任。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 11 (Document p. 37, PDF p. 37)

question_en: A contractor fails to deposit withheld employee taxes and receives a written IRS notice requiring deposits into a special trust account. What is the consequence of ignoring that notice?
question_cn: 承包商未能存入扣留的员工税款，并收到国税局的书面通知，要求将款项存入特别信托账户。无视该通知的后果是什么？

options.en: The IRS will waive penalties if taxes are paid within 30 days
options.cn: 如果在30天内缴纳税款，国税局将免除罚款

options.en: Only civil interest charges will be added to the balance
options.cn: 仅会将民事利息计入余额

options.en: The IRS will automatically garnish the employer's bank account
options.cn: 国税局将自动扣押雇主的银行账户

options.en: Criminal penalties may be charged for failure to comply
options.cn: 未遵守规定可能会被处以刑事处罚

explanation_en: Pub. 15 Section 11 explicitly states that an employer may be charged with criminal penalties for failing to comply with the IRS's written notice requiring deposits into a special trust account for the U.S. Government.
explanation_cn: 《出版物15》第11节明确指出，如果雇主未遵守国税局要求将款项存入美国政府特别信托账户的书面通知，可能会被处以刑事处罚。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 11 (Document p. 37, PDF p. 37)

question_en: Which of the following actions by a contractor could result in criminal prosecution under Pub. 15?
question_cn: 承包商的以下哪些行为可能根据《公共法第15号》导致刑事起诉？

options.en: Furnishing fraudulent or missing Forms W-2 to employees
options.cn: 向员工提供虚假或缺失的W-2表格

options.en: Misclassifying a salaried worker as an independent contractor
options.cn: 将有薪工人错误分类为独立承包商

options.en: Underpaying the correct Social Security tax by a small amount
options.cn: 少量少缴正确的社会保障税

options.en: Filing Form 941 one day after the due date
options.cn: 在截止日期后一天提交941表格

explanation_en: Pub. 15 Section 11 expressly lists furnishing false or fraudulent Forms W-2 to employees, or failing to furnish them, as conduct subject to criminal prosecution. This applies directly to contractor-employers who prepare payroll.
explanation_cn: 《公共法第15号》第11节明确列出向员工提供虚假或欺诈性的W-2表格，或未能提供这些表格的行为，是可以受到刑事起诉的。这直接适用于准备工资单的承包商雇主。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 11 (Document p. 37, PDF p. 37)

question_en: A contractor is a monthly schedule depositor whose total quarterly tax liability exceeds $2,500 but who incorrectly reports deposits instead of liabilities on Form 941. What penalty risk does the contractor face?
question_cn: 承包商是每月缴款计划的存款人，如果其季度总税负超过 $2,500，但在 941 表上错误地报告了存款而非欠税，将面临什么处罚风险？

options.en: A failure-to-file penalty of 5% per month up to 25%
options.cn: 未按时提交的罚款为每月 5%，最高可达 25%

options.en: An averaged FTD penalty ranging from 2% to 10%
options.cn: 平均 FTD 罚金范围为 2% 到 10%

options.en: A flat 10% penalty applied to the total wages paid
options.cn: 对总工资支付的统一 10% 罚金

options.en: No penalty if taxes were fully deposited on time
options.cn: 如果税款已按时全额缴纳，则无罚金

explanation_en: Pub. 15 Section 11 states that the IRS may assess an averaged FTD penalty of 2% to 10% when a monthly schedule depositor with a tax liability of $2,500 or more fails to properly complete the tax liability section of Form 941. The IRS distributes total liability evenly and applies deposits in date order to calculate the penalty.
explanation_cn: 《出版物 15》第 11 节规定，当月缴款计划的存款人税负达到 $2,500 或以上且未能正确填写 941 表的税款负债部分时，IRS 可评估 2% 到 10% 的平均 FTD 罚金。IRS 按日期顺序分配总负债并应用存款以计算罚金。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 11 (Document p. 37, PDF p. 37)

question_en: How many times per quarter must a contractor with multiple job sites file Form 941?
question_cn: 承包商拥有多个工地的情况下，每季度必须提交多少次 Form 941？

options.en: One form total, regardless of number of locations
options.cn: 不论地点数量，总共提交一份表格

options.en: One form per active job site each quarter
options.cn: 每个季度每个活跃工地提交一份表格

options.en: One form per division if they have separate EINs
options.cn: 如果有不同的 EIN，则每个部门提交一份表格

options.en: Two forms, one for field workers and one for office staff
options.cn: 提交两份表格，一份给现场工人，一份给办公室员工

explanation_en: Pub. 15 Section 12 states that employers with multiple locations or divisions must file only one Form 941 per quarter. Filing more than one return may cause processing delays and IRS correspondence.
explanation_cn: 《出版物 15》第 12 节指出，拥有多个地点或部门的雇主每季度只需提交一份 Form 941。提交多份申报表可能导致处理延迟和 IRS 信函。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 12 (Document p. 39, PDF p. 39)

question_en: A contractor goes out of business mid-year and stops paying wages. When must the final Form 941 be filed?
question_cn: 一名承包商在年中停业并停止支付工资。最终的941表格必须何时提交？

options.en: For the last quarter in which wages were paid
options.cn: 在支付工资的最后一个季度

options.en: Only after the IRS sends a specific final-return notice
options.cn: 只有在国税局发送特定的最终申报通知后

options.en: By December 31 of the year the business closed
options.cn: 在企业关闭当年的12月31日前

options.en: Within 30 days of the last payroll date
options.cn: 在最后一次发薪日的30天内

explanation_en: Pub. 15 Section 12 states that a contractor going out of business must file a final return for the last quarter in which wages were paid. The normal quarterly due date applies to that final return.
explanation_cn: 《出版物15》第12节指出，停业的承包商必须为支付工资的最后一个季度提交最终申报表。该最终申报表适用正常的季度截止日期。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 12 (Document p. 39, PDF p. 39)

question_en: When a contractor closes the business and files a final Form 941, what additional payroll reporting obligation must also be met by the final return's due date?
question_cn: 当承包商关闭业务并提交最终的941表格时，最终申报表到期日还必须满足哪些额外的工资报告义务？

options.en: File Form 940 covering the entire calendar year immediately
options.cn: 立即提交涵盖整个日历年的940表格

options.en: Furnish Forms W-2 to employees and file W-2 and W-3 with SSA
options.cn: 向员工提供W-2表格，并将W-2和W-3表格提交给社会保障局(SSA)

options.en: Notify each employee in writing of the business closure date
options.cn: 以书面形式通知每位员工业务关闭日期

options.en: Send copies of Form 941 to the Social Security Administration
options.cn: 将941表格的副本发送给社会保障局(SSA)

explanation_en: Pub. 15 Section 12 requires an employer filing a final return to also furnish Forms W-2 to all employees and file Forms W-2 and W-3 with the SSA by the due date of the final return.
explanation_cn: 出版物15第12节要求提交最终申报表的雇主还必须向所有员工提供W-2表格，并在最终申报表的到期日之前将W-2和W-3表格提交给社会保障局(SSA)。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 12 (Document p. 39, PDF p. 39)

question_en: A contractor uses a payroll service provider but employment taxes are deposited late. Who is ultimately responsible for the late deposits?
question_cn: 承包商使用工资服务提供商，但就业税款存款延迟。谁最终对延迟存款负责？

options.en: Liability is split equally between the contractor and the service provider
options.cn: 责任在承包商和服务提供商之间平分

options.en: The IRS must first pursue the service provider before the employer
options.cn: 国税局必须先追究服务提供商，然后才是雇主

options.en: The contractor remains responsible for correct and timely deposits
options.cn: 承包商仍然负责正确及时的存款

options.en: The payroll service provider bears sole liability
options.cn: 工资服务提供商承担全部责任

explanation_en: Pub. 15 Section 12 explicitly states that the use of a third-party payer generally does not relieve an employer of the responsibility to ensure tax returns are filed and all taxes are paid or deposited correctly and on time.
explanation_cn: 《出版物15》第12节明确指出，使用第三方付款人通常不会解除雇主确保税表申报以及所有税款正确及时支付或存款的责任。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 12 (Document p. 39, PDF p. 39)

question_en: A contractor wants to switch from filing Form 941 quarterly to filing Form 944 annually. What must happen before the contractor is permitted to file Form 944?
question_cn: 承包商希望从按季度提交 941 表改为按年提交 944 表。在承包商被允许提交 944 表之前，必须发生什么？

options.en: The contractor submits a one-time fee to change filing status
options.cn: 承包商提交一次性费用以更改申报状态

options.en: Annual employment taxes must be under $500 for two prior years
options.cn: 前两年的年度雇佣税必须低于 500 美元

options.en: The contractor must simply check a box on Form 941
options.cn: 承包商只需在 941 表上勾选一个方框

options.en: The contractor must receive written notice from the IRS first
options.cn: 承包商必须先收到 IRS 的书面通知

explanation_en: Pub. 15 Section 12 states that a contractor must contact the IRS during the first calendar quarter and must receive written notice from the IRS before filing Form 944 instead of Form 941.
explanation_cn: 《出版物 15》第12节指出，承包商必须在第一个日历季度联系 IRS，并且在提交 944 表而不是 941 表之前必须收到 IRS 的书面通知。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 12 (Document p. 38, PDF p. 38)

question_en: A contractor withheld too much federal income tax from an employee's paycheck in November. By when must the excess withholding be repaid or reimbursed to the employee?
question_cn: 一位承包商在十一月从员工的工资中扣除了过多的联邦所得税。过多扣除的税款必须在什么时候归还或补偿给员工？

options.en: Within 30 days of discovering the withholding error
options.cn: 在发现扣税错误后的30天内

options.en: By January 31 of the following calendar year
options.cn: 在下一年日历年的1月31日之前

options.en: By the due date of the next Form 941 filing
options.cn: 在下一次Form 941申报的截止日期之前

options.en: Before the end of the same calendar year it was withheld
options.cn: 在扣税的同一日历年结束之前

explanation_en: Pub. 15 Section 13 states that any excess income tax or Additional Medicare Tax withholding must be repaid or reimbursed to the employee before the end of the calendar year in which it was withheld. The employer must keep the employee's written receipt of the repayment.
explanation_cn: Pub. 15 第13节规定，任何过多的所得税或额外医疗保险税的扣缴必须在扣缴的日历年结束之前归还或补偿给员工。雇主必须保留员工对归还的书面收据。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 13 (Document p. 42, PDF p. 42)

question_en: A contractor discovers it under-withheld Social Security taxes from an employee's wages during a prior quarter of the current year. What is the correct way to fix this error?
question_cn: 承包商发现当年之前某季度从雇员工资中未足额扣缴社会保障税。纠正此错误的正确方法是什么？

options.en: File a separate Form 941-X for the quarter with the error
options.cn: 针对出现错误的季度单独提交 Form 941-X

options.en: No correction is needed if the full tax was deposited by the employer
options.cn: 如果雇主已缴纳全部税款，则无需纠正

options.en: Collect the under-withheld amount from the employee immediately
options.cn: 立即向雇员收取未扣缴的金额

options.en: Adjust the error on the next regular Form 941 filing
options.cn: 在下一次常规 Form 941 报表中调整错误
