explanation_en: Pub. 15 Section 13 states that when an error is discovered on a previously filed Form 941, the contractor must correct it using Form 941-X filed separately for each quarter being corrected. It must not be attached to or combined with a current Form 941.
explanation_cn: 《出版物 15》第13节规定，当发现之前提交的 Form 941 有错误时，承包商必须使用单独为每个需更正季度提交的 Form 941-X 进行纠正。不应将其附在当前的 Form 941 上或与其合并。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 13 (Document p. 41, PDF p. 41)

question_en: A contractor's employee repays wages that were overpaid in a prior calendar year. Can the contractor adjust the prior year's income tax withholding on Form 941-X for this repayment?
question_cn: 承包商的一名员工偿还了前一个日历年多付的工资。承包商可以在 Form 941-X 上调整前一年的所得税预扣以反映这笔偿还吗？

options.en: No, income tax withholding adjustments are not allowed for prior years
options.cn: 不可以，不允许对前几年的所得税预扣进行调整

options.en: Yes, for both income tax and Social Security tax adjustments
options.cn: 是的，所得税和社会保障税都可以调整

options.en: No, no adjustments of any kind are permitted for prior-year wages
options.cn: 不可以，前一年的工资不允许进行任何调整

options.en: Yes, but only if the employee signs a waiver form
options.cn: 是的，但前提是员工签署了放弃表格

explanation_en: Pub. 15 Section 13 states that for repayments of prior-year wages, the contractor may adjust Social Security and Medicare taxes on Form 941-X but cannot make an adjustment for income tax withholding because the wages were income to the employee for the prior year.
explanation_cn: 《出版物 15》第 13 节指出，对于前一年工资的偿还，承包商可以在 Form 941-X 上调整社会保障税和医疗保险税，但不能调整所得税预扣，因为这些工资在前一年已经计入了员工收入。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 13 (Document p. 43, PDF p. 43)

question_en: Which of the following correctly describes who pays FUTA tax under the Federal Unemployment Tax Act?
question_cn: 以下哪项正确描述了根据《联邦失业税法》谁支付FUTA税？

options.en: Both the employer and employee split the FUTA tax equally
options.cn: 雇主和雇员平分FUTA税

options.en: Only the employer pays FUTA; nothing is withheld from employees
options.cn: 只有雇主支付FUTA；员工工资中没有扣除

options.en: Only the employee pays FUTA through paycheck withholding
options.cn: 只有雇员通过工资扣缴支付FUTA税

options.en: The state unemployment agency collects and remits FUTA directly
options.cn: 州失业机构直接收取并上缴FUTA税

explanation_en: Pub. 15 Section 14 states that only the employer pays FUTA tax and that it is not withheld from the employee's wages. This is a direct employer obligation funded entirely by the employer.
explanation_cn: 《出版物15》第14节指出，只有雇主支付FUTA税，并且不从员工工资中扣除。这是雇主的直接义务，由雇主全额承担。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 14 (Document p. 43, PDF p. 43)

question_en: A contractor fails to file a required Form 941 and also pays the tax late. How does the IRS apply the failure-to-file and failure-to-pay penalties in the same month?
question_cn: 承包商未提交所需的表格 941，同时也延迟缴纳税款。美国国税局在同一月份如何适用未提交与未缴税款的罚款？

options.en: Only the larger of the two penalties is assessed each month
options.cn: 每个月只会评估两种罚款中较高的一种

options.en: The failure-to-file penalty is reduced by the failure-to-pay penalty amount
options.cn: 未提交罚款可按未缴税款罚款的金额进行抵减

options.en: Both penalties are each assessed at their full rates independently
options.cn: 两种罚款各自按其全额利率独立评估

options.en: The failure-to-pay penalty is waived when a late filing also occurs
options.cn: 当发生延迟提交时，未缴税款罚款将被免除

explanation_en: Pub. 15 Section 12 states that if both the failure-to-file and failure-to-pay penalties apply in any month, the failure-to-file penalty is reduced by the amount of the failure-to-pay penalty. Both penalties have a 25% maximum, and interest also accrues on any unpaid balance.
explanation_cn: 《出版物 15》第 12 节指出，如果某个月同时适用未提交与未缴税款罚款，未提交罚款可按未缴税款罚款的金额进行抵减。两种罚款的最高限额均为 25%，且未缴余额还会产生利息。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 12 (Document p. 39, PDF p. 39)

question_en: A contractor's FUTA tax liability for the second quarter is $420. What must the contractor do with this amount?
question_cn: 承包商第二季度的 FUTA 税负为 420 美元。承包商应如何处理这笔款项？

options.en: Pay it with a credit card by June 30
options.cn: 在 6 月 30 日之前通过信用卡支付

options.en: Deposit it by July 31 via EFT immediately
options.cn: 通过电子资金转账在 7 月 31 日之前立即存入

options.en: Pay it directly with Form 940 by January 31
options.cn: 在 1 月 31 日通过 940 表格直接支付

options.en: Carry it forward to the next quarter's liability
options.cn: 将其结转到下一季度的税负

explanation_en: Per Pub. 15, if FUTA liability for any calendar quarter is $500 or less, the employer is not required to deposit. The amount is carried forward and added to the next quarter's liability to determine if a deposit is then required.
explanation_cn: 根据出版物 15，如果某一日历季度的 FUTA 税负为 500 美元或以下，雇主无需存款。该金额将结转，并加到下一季度的税负中，以确定是否需要存款。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 14 (FUTA Depositing) (Document p. 44, PDF p. 44)

question_en: What is the FUTA tax rate after a contractor claims the maximum 5.4% state unemployment credit?
question_cn: 当承包商申请最大 5.4% 的州失业保险抵免后，FUTA 税率是多少？

options.en: 6.0% on the first $7,000 per employee
options.cn: 员工每人前 $7,000 的收入适用 6.0%

options.en: 1.2% on the first $7,000 per employee
options.cn: 员工每人前 $7,000 的收入适用 1.2%

options.en: 5.4% on all wages paid to employees
options.cn: 员工支付的所有工资适用 5.4%

options.en: 0.6% on the first $7,000 per employee
options.cn: 员工每人前 $7,000 的收入适用 0.6%

explanation_en: Per Pub. 15, when a contractor is entitled to the maximum 5.4% credit (state UI paid in full, on time, on all FUTA-taxable wages, and the state is not a credit reduction state), the net FUTA rate is 6.0% minus 5.4% = 0.6%.
explanation_cn: 根据《税务出版物 15》，当承包商有资格获得最高 5.4% 抵免（州 UI 已全额按时缴纳，适用于所有 FUTA 应税工资，且该州不是抵免减少州）时，净 FUTA 税率为 6.0% 减去 5.4% = 0.6%.
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 14 (FUTA rate) (Document p. 44, PDF p. 44)

question_en: A contractor deposits FUTA taxes through a payroll service provider (PSP), and the PSP fails to remit the funds to the IRS. Who bears liability for the unpaid taxes and penalties?
question_cn: 承包商通过工资服务提供商（PSP）缴纳FUTA税款，但PSP未将资金上缴给IRS。未缴税款和罚款由谁承担责任？

options.en: The PSP, because it controlled the funds
options.cn: PSP，因为它控制了资金

options.en: The IRS absorbs the loss if payments were forwarded
options.cn: 如果付款已转发，IRS承担损失

options.en: The contractor remains fully liable for all amounts
options.cn: 承包商仍需对所有金额承担全部责任

options.en: Both the PSP and contractor share equal liability
options.cn: PSP和承包商共同承担相等责任

explanation_en: Per Pub. 15 Section 16, an employer who outsources payroll to a PSP remains liable for all federal tax deposits, taxes, penalties, and interest even if the PSP fails to make the payments. The PSP is not liable as employer or agent.
explanation_cn: 根据《出版物15》第16节，将工资外包给PSP的雇主仍然对所有联邦税款存款、税款、罚款和利息负责，即使PSP未进行支付。PSP不作为雇主或代理人承担责任。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 16 (Document p. 53, PDF p. 53)

question_en: By what date must a contractor deposit FUTA taxes for the quarter ending June 30?
question_cn: 承包商必须在何日期之前为截至6月30日的季度存入FUTA税款？

options.en: October 31 of the following quarter
options.cn: 下一季度的10月31日

options.en: July 31 of the following month
options.cn: 下一月份的7月31日

options.en: August 15 of the following month
options.cn: 下一月份的8月15日

options.en: June 30 of the same quarter
options.cn: 同季度的6月30日

explanation_en: Per Pub. 15 Table 4, FUTA taxes for the April–May–June quarter (ending June 30) must be deposited by July 31, which is the last day of the first month following the quarter end.
explanation_cn: 根据《出版物15》第4表，4月–6月季度（截至6月30日）的FUTA税款必须在7月31日存入，这是季度结束后第一个月的最后一天。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 14, Table 4 (Document p. 44, PDF p. 44)

question_en: A contractor's FUTA liability reaches $510 in the third quarter, including $95 carried forward from the second quarter. What is the contractor required to do?
question_cn: 承包商在第三季度的 FUTA 责任达到 510 美元，其中包括从第二季度结转的 95 美元。承包商需要做什么？

options.en: Pay the $510 directly with Form 940 by January 31
options.cn: 通过 940 表格直接支付 510 美元，截止日期为 1 月 31 日

options.en: Deposit only the current quarter's new liability
options.cn: 仅存入本季度的新责任

options.en: Carry the full amount to the fourth quarter
options.cn: 将全部金额结转到第四季度

options.en: Deposit the entire $510 by EFT by October 31
options.cn: 截止 10 月 31 日通过 EFT 存入全部 510 美元

explanation_en: Per Pub. 15, when FUTA liability for any quarter—including amounts carried forward—exceeds $500, the full amount must be deposited by EFT by the last day of the first month following the quarter end (October 31 for Q3).
explanation_cn: 根据第 15 号出版物，当任何季度的 FUTA 责任（包括结转金额）超过 500 美元时，必须在季度结束后的第一个月最后一天之前通过 EFT 存入全额（第三季度为 10 月 31 日）。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 14 (FUTA Depositing) (Document p. 44, PDF p. 44)

question_en: A contractor stops paying FUTA tax on a specific employee's wages mid-year. What event triggers this stop?
question_cn: 承包商在年中停止对某个特定员工的工资支付FUTA税。是什么事件导致了这种停止？

options.en: The employee's wages reach $10,000 for the year
options.cn: 员工全年工资达到10,000美元

options.en: The employee's wages reach $7,000 for the year
options.cn: 员工全年工资达到7,000美元

options.en: The employer's total FUTA liability exceeds $500
options.cn: 雇主的总FUTA负债超过500美元

options.en: The employer files Form 940 for the current quarter
options.cn: 雇主为当前季度提交了940表格

explanation_en: Per Pub. 15, FUTA tax stops accruing on an individual employee's wages once that employee's taxable wages reach the $7,000 federal wage base limit for the calendar year.
explanation_cn: 根据出版物15，一旦个别员工的应税工资达到全年7,000美元的联邦工资基数上限，FUTA税就停止在该员工工资上累积。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 14 (FUTA wage base) (Document p. 44, PDF p. 44)

question_en: A contractor hires an agent with an approved Form 2678 to handle payroll tax duties. If employment taxes go unpaid, who is liable?
question_cn: 承包商雇佣持有批准的 Form 2678 的代理人来处理工资税事务。如果未支付雇佣税，谁承担责任？

options.en: Both the agent and contractor are jointly liable
options.cn: 代理人和承包商共同承担责任

options.en: Neither party, if the IRS approved the arrangement
options.cn: 如果 IRS 批准了该安排，则双方都不承担责任

options.en: Only the contractor, because it is the employer
options.cn: 仅承包商，因为它是雇主

options.en: Only the agent, because it filed the returns
options.cn: 仅代理人，因为它提交了申报表

explanation_en: Per Pub. 15 Section 16, when an employer uses an agent authorized under Form 2678 (IRC Section 3504), both the agent and the employer are jointly liable for the employment taxes and related duties for which the agent is authorized.
explanation_cn: 根据出版物 15 第 16 节，当雇主使用根据 Form 2678（IRC 第 3504 条）授权的代理人时，代理人和雇主对代理人授权的工资税及相关责任共同承担责任。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 16; IRC Section 3504 (Document p. 53, PDF p. 53)

question_en: A contractor acquires an existing construction company mid-year. Can the contractor count the predecessor's wages already paid to continuing employees toward the $7,000 FUTA wage base?
question_cn: 一位承包商在年中收购了一家现有的建筑公司。承包商可以将前任公司已支付给继续工作的员工的工资计入$7,000 FUTA工资基数吗？

options.en: No, each employer starts a fresh wage base
options.cn: 不，每个雇主都从新的工资基数开始

options.en: No, only wages paid after acquisition count toward the base
options.cn: 不，只有收购后支付的工资才计入基数

options.en: Yes, for employees who continue working for the successor
options.cn: 是的，对于继续为继承人工作的员工

options.en: Yes, but only for salaried employees retained
options.cn: 是的，但仅限于保留的受薪员工

explanation_en: Per Pub. 15, a successor employer who acquires a business from an employer liable for FUTA tax may count the predecessor's wages paid to continuing employees when calculating the $7,000 FUTA wage base limit. See Instructions for Form 940.
explanation_cn: 根据出版物15，继承雇主在从负有FUTA税义务的雇主处收购业务时，可以在计算$7,000 FUTA工资基数限制时计入支付给继续工作的员工的前任公司工资。见Form 940说明。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 14 (Successor employer) (Document p. 44, PDF p. 44)

question_en: A contractor uses a payroll service provider and wants to verify that federal tax deposits are actually being made on the company's behalf. What is the recommended method?
question_cn: 一名承包商使用工资服务提供商，并希望核实联邦税款存款确实是以公司名义进行的。推荐的方法是什么？

options.en: Request monthly deposit confirmations from the PSP
options.cn: 向工资服务提供商请求每月存款确认

options.en: Activate the EFTPS Inquiry PIN to monitor deposits
options.cn: 激活 EFTPS 查询 PIN 以监控存款

options.en: Submit Form 2678 to authorize the PSP as agent
options.cn: 提交表格 2678 授权工资服务提供商作为代理人

options.en: File Form 8822-B to transfer deposit responsibility
options.cn: 提交表格 8822-B 转移存款责任

explanation_en: Per Pub. 15 Section 16, when a third party enrolls an employer in EFTPS, the employer receives an Inquiry PIN. The employer should activate and use this PIN to independently monitor the account and confirm that required deposits are being made.
explanation_cn: 根据《出版物 15》第16节，当第三方在 EFTPS 上为雇主注册时，雇主会收到一个查询 PIN。雇主应激活并使用该 PIN 独立监控账户，并确认所需的存款已被执行。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 16 (Document p. 53, PDF p. 53)

question_en: A contractor's state excludes certain fringe benefits from state unemployment tax, even though those wages are subject to FUTA. What is the consequence for the contractor's FUTA deposit?
question_cn: 承包商所在的州将某些附加福利从州失业税中排除，即使这些工资仍需缴纳FUTA税。对承包商的FUTA存款有什么影响？

options.en: The contractor claims a partial credit on Form 941
options.cn: 承包商在941表格上申报部分抵免

options.en: The contractor owes no FUTA on excluded wages
options.cn: 承包商对被排除的工资不欠FUTA税

options.en: The contractor may deposit more than 0.6% on those wages
options.cn: 承包商可能在这些工资上存入超过0.6%的FUTA税

options.en: The contractor is exempt until the state updates its law
options.cn: 承包商在州更新其法律之前免税

explanation_en: Per Pub. 15, when a state excludes certain wages from state unemployment tax that are still subject to FUTA, the employer cannot claim the full 5.4% state credit on those wages. As a result, the effective FUTA rate on those wages exceeds 0.6%.
explanation_cn: 根据《出版物15》，当一个州将某些工资从州失业税中排除但这些工资仍需缴纳FUTA税时，雇主不能在这些工资上申请全部5.4%的州抵免。因此，这些工资的实际FUTA税率超过0.6%。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 14 (Figuring FUTA tax) (Document p. 44, PDF p. 44)

question_en: If a contractor's fourth-quarter FUTA liability, including any undeposited prior-quarter amounts, is $480, what is the contractor permitted to do?
question_cn: 如果承包商的第四季度FUTA负债，包括任何未存入的前一季度款项，总额为480美元，承包商被允许做什么？

options.en: Deposit only the prior-quarter carryforward portion separately
options.cn: 仅单独存入前一季度的结转部分

options.en: Carry the $480 forward into the next tax year
options.cn: 将480美元结转到下一纳税年度

options.en: Deposit the full amount by October 31
options.cn: 在10月31日前存入全额

options.en: Pay via Form 940 or debit card by January 31
options.cn: 通过Form 940或借记卡在1月31日前支付

explanation_en: Per Pub. 15, if the fourth-quarter FUTA liability (plus any undeposited prior amounts) is $500 or less, the contractor may deposit it, pay by credit or debit card, or pay with Form 940—all by January 31.
explanation_cn: 根据出版物15，如果第四季度的FUTA负债（加上任何未存入的前期款项）为500美元或以下，承包商可以存入该款项，通过信用卡或借记卡支付，或通过Form 940支付——所有方式均需在1月31日前完成。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 14 (When to deposit) (Document p. 44, PDF p. 44)

question_en: A contractor outsources all payroll duties to a third-party payer but wants IRS correspondence about tax account issues sent to the contractor, not the payer. What should the contractor do?
question_cn: 一名承包商将所有工资职责外包给第三方支付方，但希望有关税务账户问题的 IRS 通讯发送给承包商，而不是支付方。承包商应该怎么做？

options.en: File Form 8655 to redirect correspondence to the contractor
options.cn: 提交表格 8655 将通讯重定向到承包商

options.en: Request an Inquiry PIN from the third-party payer
options.cn: 向第三方支付方申请查询 PIN

options.en: Maintain the contractor's own address as IRS address of record
options.cn: 保持承包商自己的地址作为 IRS 官方记录地址

options.en: Register as a CPEO to control correspondence routing
options.cn: 注册为 CPEO 以控制通讯路由

explanation_en: Per Pub. 15 Section 16, the IRS strongly recommends that employers maintain their own address as the address of record. Having correspondence sent to the third-party payer's address may significantly limit the employer's ability to stay informed about tax matters.
explanation_cn: 根据《Pub. 15》第16节，IRS 强烈建议雇主将自己的地址作为记录地址。如将通讯发送到第三方支付方的地址，可能会显著限制雇主了解税务事项的能力。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 16 (Document p. 53, PDF p. 53)

question_en: What is the annual Form 940 filing deadline for a contractor who deposited all FUTA taxes on time throughout the year?
question_cn: 对于全年按时缴纳所有FUTA税款的承包商，年度Form 940的申报截止日期是什么？

options.en: January 31 of the following year
options.cn: 次年的1月31日

options.en: February 10 of the following year
options.cn: 次年的2月10日

options.en: February 2 of the following year
options.cn: 次年的2月2日

options.en: March 31 of the following year
options.cn: 次年的3月31日

explanation_en: Per Pub. 15, if a contractor deposited all FUTA tax when due, the Form 940 filing deadline is extended to February 10 of the following year (February 10, 2026 for the 2025 form).
explanation_cn: 根据《出版物15》，如果承包商在到期时缴纳了所有FUTA税款，Form 940的申报截止日期将延长至次年的2月10日（2025年的表格为2026年2月10日）。
code_reference: Pub. 15 Section 14 (Reporting FUTA tax) (Document p. 44, PDF p. 44)

question_en: A removed employee files a workers' compensation claim for a lead-related disability. What is the employer's obligation regarding Medical Removal Protection benefits during this period?
question_cn: 被调离的员工提交了一份因铅相关残疾的工伤赔偿申请。雇主在此期间对医疗调离保护（MRP）福利的义务是什么？

options.en: Terminate MRP benefits once any workers' comp payment is received
options.cn: 一旦收到任何工伤赔偿金，即终止MRP福利

options.en: Suspend MRP benefits immediately upon the claim being filed
options.cn: 工伤赔偿申请一提交，即立即暂停MRP福利

options.en: Continue MRP benefits pending disposition of the claim
options.cn: 在申请处理期间继续提供MRP福利

options.en: Transfer MRP responsibility to the workers' compensation carrier
options.cn: 将MRP责任转移给工伤赔偿保险公司

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1532.1(k)(2)(D) requires the employer to continue providing MRP benefits while the workers' compensation claim is pending. Any earnings-loss award made to the employee reduces the employer's MRP obligation by that amount.
explanation_cn: 《加利福尼亚法规汇编》第8卷 §1532.1(k)(2)(D) 要求雇主在工伤赔偿申请待处理期间继续提供MRP福利。向员工支付的任何收入损失赔偿将按该金额减少雇主的MRP义务。

question_en: Under SB 291, what must a contractor provide before CSLB will renew or reinstate a license that had a workers' compensation violation?
question_cn: 根据SB 291，在CSLB续签或恢复因工伤赔偿违规而被暂停的执照之前，承包商必须提供什么？

options.en: Proof of WC coverage for the prior three years
options.cn: 提供过去三年的工伤赔偿保险证明

options.en: Payment of all outstanding civil penalties first
options.cn: 先支付所有未结清的民事罚款

options.en: A current and valid WC insurance certificate
options.cn: 提供当前有效的工伤赔偿保险证明

options.en: A signed affidavit of future WC compliance
options.cn: 签署未来工伤赔偿合规的宣誓书

explanation_en: SB 291 amends B&P §§7125.4 and 7125.7 to prohibit CSLB from renewing or reinstating a license in violation of WC requirements until the applicant or licensee provides a current and valid WC certificate.
explanation_cn: SB 291 修正了B&P §§7125.4和7125.7，禁止CSLB在违反工伤赔偿要求的情况下续签或恢复执照，直到申请人或执照持有人提供当前有效的工伤赔偿保险证明。
code_reference: B&P Code Sections 7125.4 and 7125.7, as amended by SB 291 (Document p. -10, PDF p. 13)

question_en: A licensed contractor willfully fails to carry workers' compensation insurance, and an employee is injured on the job. Which of the following describes the contractor's liability?
question_cn: 一名持牌承包商故意未投保工伤赔偿保险，且员工在工作中受伤。以下哪项描述了承包商的责任？

options.en: Disability compensation only, paid by the insurer
options.cn: 仅由保险公司支付的伤残赔偿

options.en: Disability compensation, 10% penalty, attorney fees, and civil damages
options.cn: 伤残赔偿、10%的罚款、律师费和民事赔偿

options.en: Criminal fines and license suspension, nothing more
options.cn: 刑事罚款和执照暂停，仅此而已

options.en: Reduced liability if employee was contributorily negligent
options.cn: 如果员工存在共同过失，责任减轻

explanation_en: Under Labor Code Sections 3706 and 3708, a contractor who willfully fails to insure and an injury results must pay disability compensation plus a 10% penalty, attorney fees, all medical treatment, and is liable for civil damages with a presumption of negligence.
explanation_cn: 根据《劳动法》第3706和3708条，故意未投保且导致伤害的承包商必须支付伤残赔偿、10%的罚款、律师费、所有医疗费用，并且对民事赔偿承担责任，推定存在过失。
code_reference: Labor Code Sections 3706, 3708, 4554, and 4555 (Document p. 26, PDF p. 49)

question_en: An uninsured contractor employs five workers for three months before being discovered. Under Labor Code Section 3722, what is the minimum penalty assessment the contractor faces?
question_cn: 一名未投保的承包商在被发现之前雇用了五名工人三个月。根据《劳动法》第3722条，该承包商面临的最低罚款评定是多少？

options.en: Twice the unpaid premiums, regardless of employee count
options.cn: 未支付保险费的两倍，无论雇员人数多少

options.en: A flat $10,000 fine per quarter uninsured
options.cn: 每个未投保季度固定罚款10,000美元

options.en: The greater of twice unpaid premiums or $5,000 per employee
options.cn: 未支付保险费的两倍或每名雇员5,000美元，以较高者为准

options.en: The greater of twice unpaid premiums or $1,000 per employee
options.cn: 未支付保险费的两倍或每名雇员1,000美元，以较高者为准

explanation_en: Labor Code Section 3722 sets the penalty as the greater of twice the amount the contractor would have paid in premiums during the uninsured period, or $1,000 per employee employed during that period.
explanation_cn: 《劳动法》第3722条规定，罚款为承包商在未投保期间应支付保险费金额的两倍，或该期间雇佣的每名雇员1,000美元，以较高者为准。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 3722 (Document p. 26, PDF p. 49)

question_en: A department issues a Stop Order against a contractor who lacks workers' compensation insurance. Under what authority is the Stop Order issued, and what does it prohibit?
question_cn: 一个部门对没有工伤赔偿保险的承包商发出停止令。停止令是依据什么权限发布的，它禁止什么？

options.en: CSLB issues it; prohibits all construction activity statewide
options.cn: CSLB 发布；禁止在全州进行所有建筑活动

options.en: Division of Workers' Compensation; freezes contractor bank accounts
options.cn: 工伤赔偿司；冻结承包商银行账户

options.en: Division of Labor Standards Enforcement; prohibits employee labor use
options.cn: 劳动标准执法司；禁止使用员工劳动

options.en: Superior court issues it; suspends the contractor's license
options.cn: 高等法院发布；暂停承包商执照

explanation_en: Under Labor Code Section 3710.1, the Division of Labor Standards Enforcement may issue a Stop Order that prohibits the use of employee labor until workers' compensation insurance is provided.
explanation_cn: 根据《劳动法》第3710.1条，劳动标准执法司可发布停止令，禁止在提供工伤赔偿保险之前使用员工劳动。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 3710.1 (Document p. 25, PDF p. 48)

question_en: An LLC licensed contractor has six people listed as members of the personnel of record. What is the minimum aggregate liability insurance required?
question_cn: 一家有限责任公司（LLC）持证承包商在备案人员中列有六名成员。所需的最低累计责任保险是多少？

options.en: $1.1 million aggregate coverage
options.cn: 110万美元累计保险

options.en: $2 million aggregate coverage
options.cn: 200万美元累计保险

options.en: $1 million aggregate coverage
options.cn: 100万美元累计保险

options.en: $1.5 million aggregate coverage
options.cn: 150万美元累计保险

explanation_en: Under B&P Code §7071.19, the minimum is $1 million for five or fewer personnel of record, plus $100,000 for each additional member. Six members = $1,000,000 + $100,000 = $1,100,000.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7071.19条，五名或更少备案人员的最低要求为100万美元，每增加一名成员需增加10万美元。六名成员 = 1,000,000美元 + 100,000美元 = 1,100,000美元。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7071.19 (Document p. 20, PDF p. 43)

question_en: Which bond type guarantees both completion of a project AND payment of all labor and materials?
question_cn: 哪种债券类型保证项目完成以及所有劳动和材料的支付？

options.en: A performance bond
options.cn: 履约保证金

options.en: A payment bond
options.cn: 付款保证金

options.en: A contract bond
options.cn: 合同保证金

options.en: A contractor license bond
options.cn: 承包商执照保证金

explanation_en: Per the source text, contract bonds guarantee both job completion and payment of all labor and materials — combining the protections of both performance and payment bonds.
explanation_cn: 根据原文，合同保证金保证工作完成和所有劳动及材料的支付——结合了履约保证金和付款保证金的保护。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7071.6 (Document p. 19, PDF p. 42)

question_en: What additional surety bond amount is required for an LLC to obtain or renew its contractor's license, beyond the standard $25,000 contractor bond?
question_cn: 对于有限责任公司（LLC）来说，除了标准的 25,000 美元承包商保证金外，要获得或续签承包商执照，还需要多少额外的保证金？

options.en: $75,000 additional surety bond
options.cn: 75,000 美元额外保证金

options.en: $100,000 additional surety bond
options.cn: 100,000 美元额外保证金

options.en: $50,000 additional surety bond
options.cn: 50,000 美元额外保证金

options.en: $25,000 additional surety bond
options.cn: 25,000 美元额外保证金

explanation_en: Under B&P Code §7071.6.5, LLCs must carry a $100,000 surety bond in addition to the standard $25,000 contractor bond to protect employees and workers damaged by the LLC's failure to pay wages or benefits.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第 7071.6.5 条，有限责任公司（LLC）必须持有 100,000 美元的保证金，作为额外的标准 25,000 美元承包商保证金，以保护因 LLC 未支付工资或福利而受到损害的员工和工人。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7071.6.5 (Document p. 19, PDF p. 42)

question_en: A home improvement contractor does not carry commercial general liability insurance. Under California law, what must the contractor do?
question_cn: 一名家居装修承包商没有购买商业综合责任保险。根据加利福尼亚州法律，该承包商必须做什么？

options.en: Post notice of no insurance at the jobsite
options.cn: 在工地张贴无保险通知

options.en: Obtain CGL insurance before starting any work
options.cn: 在开始任何工作之前获取CGL保险

options.en: Have the homeowner sign a liability waiver
options.cn: 让房主签署责任豁免书

options.en: Disclose in writing the lack of CGL insurance
options.cn: 以书面形式披露缺乏CGL保险

explanation_en: CCR §872(a) requires home improvement contractors to disclose in writing whether they do or do not carry CGL insurance, alerting homeowners who may otherwise assume coverage exists.
explanation_cn: CCR §872(a) 要求家居装修承包商以书面形式披露其是否购买了CGL保险，以提醒可能原本认为有保险覆盖的房主。
code_reference: California Code of Regulations Section 872(a) (Document p. 20, PDF p. 43)

question_en: Which license classifications are required to carry workers' compensation insurance even if the contractor has NO employees?
question_cn: 即使承包商没有雇员，哪些执照类别仍需要购买工伤赔偿保险？

options.en: All specialty contractors regardless of classification
options.cn: 所有专业承包商，无论分类如何

explanation_en: The source text specifically lists these five classifications — Concrete, HVAC, Asbestos Abatement, Roofing, and Tree Service — as exempt from the workers' comp exemption option, requiring coverage regardless of employee count.
explanation_cn: 原文特别列出了这五个类别——混凝土、暖通空调、石棉清除、屋顶和树木服务——为不能选择工伤赔偿豁免的类别，无论雇员数量如何，都需购买保险。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7125 (Document p. 22, PDF p. 45)

question_en: A worker is injured and disabled. Temporary disability payments begin after how many days of disability, assuming no hospitalization occurs?
question_cn: 一名工人受伤致残。在没有住院的情况下，暂时性残疾赔偿从残疾后多少天开始支付？

options.en: After the fifth day of disability
options.cn: 残疾后第五天

options.en: After the seventh day of disability
options.cn: 残疾后第七天

options.en: After the third day of disability
options.cn: 残疾后第三天

options.en: After the first day of disability
options.cn: 残疾后第一天

explanation_en: Under Labor Code §§4650, 4652, and 4653, weekly temporary disability payments begin after the third day of disability. If disability extends beyond 14 days or requires hospitalization, the three-day wait is eliminated.
explanation_cn: 根据《劳动法典》第4650、4652和4653条，暂时性残疾的每周赔偿从残疾后的第三天开始支付。如果残疾持续超过14天或需要住院，则不再等待三天。
code_reference: Labor Code Sections 4650, 4652, and 4653 (Document p. 24, PDF p. 47)

question_en: A worker injured on the job cannot return to work within 60 days after temporary disability ends. Which benefit may the worker be entitled to?
question_cn: 工作中受伤的工人在临时伤残结束后60天内不能重返工作岗位。工人可能有权获得哪种福利？

options.en: Supplemental job displacement benefit
options.cn: 额外职业调动补助

options.en: Permanent total disability payments
options.cn: 永久完全伤残支付

options.en: A lump-sum settlement from the employer
options.cn: 来自雇主的一次性和解金

options.en: Extended temporary disability payments
options.cn: 延长期临时伤残支付

explanation_en: Under Labor Code §4658.5, a worker unable to return to work within 60 days after the temporary disability period ends may receive a supplemental job displacement benefit for retraining, skill enhancement, or job placement.
explanation_cn: 根据《劳动法典》第4658.5条，临时伤残期结束后60天内无法重返工作岗位的工人，可以获得用于再培训、技能提升或工作安置的额外职业调动补助。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 4658.5 (Document p. 24, PDF p. 47)

question_en: An insured employer fails to report an employee injury to their insurance carrier. The Workers' Compensation Appeals Board issues an order to report within five days. What can happen if the employer ignores the order?
question_cn: 一家投保的雇主未向其保险公司报告员工受伤情况。工伤赔偿上诉委员会下达命令，要求在五天内报告。如果雇主忽略该命令，会发生什么？

options.en: The employer may be punished as contempt
options.cn: 雇主可能因藐视法庭而受到惩罚

options.en: The employer's workers' comp policy is voided
options.cn: 雇主的工伤赔偿保险将被作废

options.en: The employer faces a $10,000 administrative fine
options.cn: 雇主将面临10,000美元的行政罚款

options.en: The employer's license may be suspended
options.cn: 雇主的执照可能会被暂停

explanation_en: Under Labor Code §3760, if an insured employer fails to comply with a Workers' Compensation Appeals Board order to report an injury within five days, the failure may be punished as contempt of the board.
explanation_cn: 根据《劳动法》第3760条，如果投保的雇主未在五天内遵守工伤赔偿上诉委员会关于报告伤害的命令，该不履行行为可能会被视为藐视委员会而受到惩罚。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 3760 (Document p. 23, PDF p. 46)

question_en: Within how many working days of receiving an employee's workers' compensation claim form must an employer authorize medical treatment?
question_cn: 雇主在收到员工的工伤赔偿申请表后，必须在多少个工作日内授权医疗治疗？

options.en: Within two working days
options.cn: 在两个工作日内

options.en: Within three working days
options.cn: 在三个工作日内

options.en: Within five working days
options.cn: 在五个工作日内

options.en: Within one working day
options.cn: 在一个工作日内

explanation_en: Under Labor Code §5402, the employer must authorize medical treatment within one working day of receiving the employee's claim form, continuing until the claim is accepted or rejected, with liability capped at $10,000.
explanation_cn: 根据《劳动法》第5402条，雇主必须在收到员工的申请表后的一个工作日内授权医疗治疗，并持续到申请被接受或拒绝，责任上限为10,000美元。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 5402 (Document p. 24, PDF p. 47)

question_en: A general contractor hires a worker who is a victim of a workplace crime. What workers' compensation obligation does this trigger?
question_cn: 总承包商雇佣了一名在工作场所遭遇犯罪的工人。这会引发什么工伤赔偿义务？

options.en: Give the employee written notice of benefit eligibility
options.cn: 向员工提供有关福利资格的书面通知

options.en: Post a special notice at the workplace entry
options.cn: 在工作场所入口处张贴特别通知

options.en: Immediately authorize all medical treatment costs
options.cn: 立即批准所有医疗费用

options.en: File a crime report with local law enforcement
options.cn: 向当地执法部门提交犯罪报告

explanation_en: Under Labor Code §3553, an employer must give any employee who is a victim of a workplace crime written notification that the employee is eligible for workers' compensation benefits.
explanation_cn: 根据《劳动法》第3553条，雇主必须向任何遭遇工作场所犯罪的员工提供书面通知，说明该员工有资格获得工伤赔偿福利。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 3553 (Document p. 24, PDF p. 47)

question_en: Which of the following is NOT listed in the source text as a component of a comprehensive contractor insurance package?
question_cn: 以下哪项未在原文中列为完整承包商保险套餐的组成部分？

options.en: Key person insurance
options.cn: 关键人物保险

options.en: Professional errors and omissions insurance
options.cn: 职业差错及遗漏保险

options.en: Business interruption insurance
options.cn: 业务中断保险

options.en: Fidelity bonds
options.cn: 忠诚保证保险

explanation_en: Professional errors and omissions (E&O) insurance does not appear on the source text's list. The list includes workers' comp, fire, liability, automobile, fidelity bonds, business interruption, and health/life/key person insurance.
explanation_cn: 职业差错及遗漏 (E&O) 保险未出现在原文的列表中。列表包括工伤赔偿保险、火灾保险、责任保险、汽车保险、忠诚保证保险、业务中断保险以及健康/人寿/关键人物保险。
code_reference: Source text p. 68 – Risk Management (Document p. 45, PDF p. 68)

question_en: When a contractor with limited insurance funds must prioritize coverage, which risk management principle should guide that decision?
question_cn: 当承包商的保险资金有限，需要优先考虑保障时，应遵循哪项风险管理原则？

options.en: Cover the largest loss exposure first
options.cn: 先覆盖最大损失风险

options.en: Cover the most frequently occurring losses first
options.cn: 先覆盖最频繁发生的损失

options.en: Prioritize employee-related coverage above all others
options.cn: 将员工相关保障置于其他保障之上

options.en: Avoid deductibles to reduce out-of-pocket risk
options.cn: 避免自付额以减少自掏腰包的风险

explanation_en: The source text explicitly states that when funds are limited, the first principle of planned risk management is covering the largest loss exposure first, with property and liability insurance reviewed yearly.
explanation_cn: 原文明确指出，当资金有限时，计划性风险管理的首要原则是先覆盖最大损失风险，并且每年对财产和责任保险进行审查。
code_reference: Source text p. 68-69 – Risk Management (Document p. 45, PDF p. 68)

question_en: A subcontractor finishes work on a private project and the owner records a Notice of Completion. Within how many days must the subcontractor record a Claim of Lien?
question_cn: 分包商在一个私人项目中完成工作后，业主记录了完成通知。分包商必须在多少天内记录留置权声明？

options.en: Within 90 days of the Notice of Completion
options.cn: 在完成通知后的90天内

options.en: Within 60 days of the Notice of Completion
options.cn: 在完成通知后的60天内

options.en: Within 30 days of the Notice of Completion
options.cn: 在完成通知后的30天内

options.en: Within 15 days of the Notice of Completion
options.cn: 在完成通知后的15天内

explanation_en: Per the Mechanics Lien Checklist (Section II.B.2.a), when an owner records a Notice of Completion or Cessation, a subcontractor must record a Claim of Lien within 30 days of that recording.
explanation_cn: 根据工程留置权检查清单（第II.B.2.a节），当业主记录完成通知或终止通知时，分包商必须在该记录后的30天内记录留置权声明。
code_reference: California Civil Code Section 8414 (Mechanics Lien Checklist, Section II.B.2.a) (Document p. 53, PDF p. 76)

question_en: A prime contractor completes a project and the owner does not record a Notice of Completion. The owner begins using the improvement. Within how many days must the prime contractor record a Claim of Lien?
question_cn: 总承包商完成一个项目，而业主未记录完成通知。业主开始使用该改进。总承包商必须在多少天内记录留置权申报？

options.en: Within 45 days of the owner using the improvement
options.cn: 自业主使用改进之日起 45 天内

options.en: Within 30 days of the owner using the improvement
options.cn: 自业主使用改进之日起 30 天内

options.en: Within 90 days of the owner using the improvement
options.cn: 自业主使用改进之日起 90 天内

options.en: Within 60 days of the owner using the improvement
options.cn: 自业主使用改进之日起 60 天内

explanation_en: Per the Mechanics Lien Checklist (Section III.E), when no Notice of Completion or Cessation is recorded and the owner uses or accepts the improvement, the prime contractor must record a Claim of Lien within 90 days of that act.
explanation_cn: 根据工程留置权检查表（第 III.E 节），当未记录完成或停止通知且业主使用或接受改进时，总承包商必须在该行为发生后 90 天内记录留置权申报。
code_reference: California Civil Code Section 8412 (Mechanics Lien Checklist, Section III.E) (Document p. 54, PDF p. 77)

question_en: Which of the following is a fundamental difference between a mechanics lien and a stop notice?
question_cn: 以下哪一项是工程留置权与停止通知之间的根本区别？

options.en: A stop notice applies only to residential construction projects
options.cn: 停止通知仅适用于住宅建筑项目

options.en: Only prime contractors may file a valid stop notice
options.cn: 只有总承包商可以提交有效的停止通知

options.en: A mechanics lien attaches to property; a stop notice attaches to funds
options.cn: 工程留置权附加于财产；停止通知附加于资金

options.en: A mechanics lien is faster to enforce than a stop notice
options.cn: 工程留置权的执行速度比停止通知快

explanation_en: Per the source text, 'A mechanics lien is a lien on property. A stop notice is a lien on funds.' This is the defining distinction between the two remedies.
explanation_cn: 根据原文，‘工程留置权是针对财产的留置权。停止通知是针对资金的留置权。’ 这是两种救济措施之间的定义性区别。
code_reference: California Civil Code Section 8500 (Stop Notice provisions) (Document p. 51, PDF p. 74)

question_en: A subcontractor begins furnishing materials to a job site on March 1. By what date must the subcontractor serve the Preliminary 20-Day Notice to preserve lien rights?
question_cn: 一名分包商于3月1日开始向工地提供材料。分包商必须在何日期之前发出20天初步通知以保留留置权？

options.en: By March 15
options.cn: 3月15日之前

options.en: By April 30
options.cn: 4月30日之前

options.en: By March 31
options.cn: 3月31日之前

options.en: By March 21
options.cn: 3月21日之前

explanation_en: Per the Mechanics Lien Checklist (Section II.A), subcontractors and material suppliers must serve a Preliminary 20-Day Notice within 20 days of first furnishing labor or materials. Starting March 1, the deadline is March 21.
explanation_cn: 根据《工程留置权清单》（第二部分A节），分包商和材料供应商必须在首次提供劳务或材料后的20天内发出20天初步通知。从3月1日开始，截止日期为3月21日。
code_reference: California Civil Code Section 8204 (Preliminary 20-Day Notice) (Document p. 52, PDF p. 75)

question_en: A contractor files a Claim of Lien after a project dispute. Within how many days of recording the Claim of Lien must the contractor file a Lien Foreclosure Action?
question_cn: 承包商在项目争议后提交留置权申索。承包商必须在提交留置权申索后的多少天内提起留置权止赎诉讼？

options.en: Within 180 days of recording the Claim of Lien
options.cn: 在提交留置权申索后的180天内

options.en: Within 90 days of recording the Claim of Lien
options.cn: 在提交留置权申索后的90天内

options.en: Within 60 days of recording the Claim of Lien
options.cn: 在提交留置权申索后的60天内

options.en: Within 30 days of recording the Claim of Lien
options.cn: 在提交留置权申索后的30天内

explanation_en: Per the Mechanics Lien Checklist (Sections II.B.2.b and III.C), a Lien Foreclosure Action must be filed within 90 days of recording the Claim of Lien, and a lis pendens must be recorded at the same time.
explanation_cn: 根据工程留置权清单（第二节 II.B.2.b 和第三节 III.C），留置权止赎诉讼必须在提交留置权申索后的90天内提起，并且必须同时记录诉讼待决通知 (lis pendens)。
code_reference: California Civil Code Section 8460 (Lien Foreclosure Action deadline) (Document p. 53, PDF p. 76)

question_en: An owner discovers that their tenant has ordered construction work without the owner's direction. To avoid lien liability, what must the owner do within 10 days of discovering the work?
question_cn: 房主发现其租户在未经房主指示的情况下订购了施工工作。为了避免留置权责任，房主在发现该工作后的10天内必须做什么？

options.en: Record a Notice of Completion with the county recorder
options.cn: 向县记录员登记完工通知

options.en: File a Notice of Cessation with the county recorder
options.cn: 向县记录员提交施工终止通知

options.en: Serve a stop notice on the construction lender
options.cn: 向施工贷款人送达停止付款通知

options.en: Post and record a Notice of Non-Responsibility
options.cn: 张贴并记录不负责任通知

explanation_en: Per the source text, within 10 days of discovering the work, the owner must post the Notice of Non-Responsibility in a conspicuous place on the site AND record it with the County Recorder to disclaim liability for improvements ordered by a tenant.
explanation_cn: 根据原文，在发现施工后的10天内，房主必须在施工现场的显眼位置张贴“不负责任通知”，并将其记录在县记录员处，以声明对租户订购改进工程不承担责任。
code_reference: California Civil Code Section 8444 (Notice of Non-Responsibility) (Document p. 57, PDF p. 80)

question_en: A claimant serves a bonded stop notice on a construction lender. What amount must the accompanying bond equal?
question_cn: 申请人向建筑贷款人送达有担保的停工通知。随附的保证金必须等于多少金额？

options.en: 1¼ times the amount of the claim
options.cn: 索赔金额的1¼倍

options.en: 1½ times the amount of the claim
options.cn: 索赔金额的1½倍

options.en: Twice the amount of the claim
options.cn: 索赔金额的两倍

options.en: Equal to the full amount of the claim
options.cn: 等于索赔的全部金额

explanation_en: Per the source text's definition of Bonded Stop Notice, the bond accompanying a stop notice to a construction lender must be in a sum equal to 1¼ times the amount of the claim.
explanation_cn: 根据原文对“有担保的停工通知”的定义，向建筑贷款人送达的停工通知所附的保证金金额必须等于索赔金额的1¼倍。
code_reference: California Civil Code Section 8532 (Bonded Stop Notice) (Document p. 55, PDF p. 78)

question_en: A Notice of Completion is recorded by the owner. Within how many days must the Notice of Completion be recorded in the Office of the County Recorder after project completion?
question_cn: 完工通知由业主记录。在项目完成后，必须在多少天内将在县记录办公室记录完工通知？

options.en: Within 20 days after completion of the project
options.cn: 项目完成后 20 天内

options.en: Within 15 days after completion of the project
options.cn: 项目完成后 15 天内

options.en: Within 10 days after completion of the project
options.cn: 项目完成后 10 天内

options.en: Within 30 days after completion of the project
options.cn: 项目完成后 30 天内

explanation_en: Per the source text's definition of Notice of Completion, it must be recorded in the Office of the County Recorder within 10 days after completion of the project to be effective in shortening lien-filing deadlines.
explanation_cn: 根据原文对完工通知的定义，为了有效缩短留置权申请截止日期，必须在项目完成后 10 天内在县记录办公室记录该通知。
code_reference: California Civil Code Section 8182 (Notice of Completion recording deadline) (Document p. 56, PDF p. 79)

question_en: A material supplier's supplier wants to file a mechanics lien on a private construction project. Is this party entitled to a statutory lien?
question_cn: 材料供应商的供应商想在一个私人建设项目上申请工程留置权。该方有权享有法定留置权吗？

options.en: Yes, if a Preliminary 20-Day Notice was served timely
options.cn: 是的，如果提前20天通知已及时送达

options.en: No, they have no direct contract with the owner
options.cn: 否，他们没有与业主的直接合同

options.en: Yes, if the materials were incorporated into the structure
options.cn: 是的，如果材料已被纳入建筑结构中

options.en: No, unless they also provide labor on the project
options.cn: 否，除非他们也在项目中提供劳务

explanation_en: Per the source text, a material supplier is not an agent of the owner, and therefore a material supplier's supplier has no entitlement to a statutory mechanics lien. Lien rights require a contract with the owner or an agent of the owner.
explanation_cn: 根据原文，材料供应商不是业主的代理人，因此材料供应商的供应商没有权利享有法定工程留置权。享有留置权需要与业主或业主的代理人有合同关系。
code_reference: California Civil Code Section 8400 (Mechanics Lien entitlement) (Document p. 50, PDF p. 73)

question_en: A mechanics lien is recorded but the claimant fails to serve the Notice of Mechanics Lien on the property owner and complete a proof of service affidavit. What is the consequence?
question_cn: 已记录工程留置权，但索赔人未能向物业所有者送达工程留置权通知并完成送达证明宣誓书。其后果是什么？

options.en: The lien amount is reduced by 50%
options.cn: 留置权金额减少50%

options.en: The claimant must refile within 30 days
options.cn: 索赔人必须在30天内重新提交

options.en: The lien is valid but the foreclosure action is barred
options.cn: 留置权有效，但止赎诉讼被禁止

options.en: The entire mechanics lien becomes void and unenforceable
options.cn: 整个工程留置权无效且不可执行

explanation_en: Per AB 457 (California Civil Code Section 8416), failure to serve the Notice of Mechanics Lien on the owner and complete a proof of service affidavit will cause the mechanics lien to be unenforceable.
explanation_cn: 根据AB 457（加利福尼亚民法典第8416条），未能向业主送达工程留置权通知并完成送达证明宣誓书，将导致工程留置权不可执行。
code_reference: California Civil Code Section 8416 (AB 457 - Notice of Mechanics Lien service requirement) (Document p. 55, PDF p. 78)

question_en: An owner records a Notice of Cessation. Before recording, labor must have been stopped for at least how long?
question_cn: 业主记录停工通知。在记录之前，劳动力必须至少停止多长时间？

options.en: At least 10 days before recording
options.cn: 记录前至少10天

options.en: At least 20 days before recording
options.cn: 记录前至少20天

options.en: At least 60 days before recording
options.cn: 记录前至少60天

options.en: At least 30 days before recording
options.cn: 记录前至少30天

explanation_en: Per the source text (Mechanics Lien Checklist, Section II.B.2 and Section III.D), labor must have ceased for at least 30 days before the owner is entitled to record a Notice of Cessation.
explanation_cn: 根据原文（《工程留置权清单》，第II.B.2节和第III.D节），在业主有权记录停工通知之前，劳动力必须至少停止30天。
code_reference: California Civil Code Section 8186 (Notice of Cessation requirements) (Document p. 52, PDF p. 75)

question_en: To bind a construction lender with a stop notice, the stop notice bond must be in an amount equal to what?
question_cn: 要用停工通知约束建筑贷款人，停工通知保证金必须等于多少？

options.en: Equal to the full amount of the claim
options.cn: 等于索赔的全部金额

options.en: Equal to 1¼ times the claim amount
options.cn: 等于索赔金额的1¼倍

options.en: Equal to 1½ times the claim amount
options.cn: 等于索赔金额的1½倍

options.en: Equal to twice the amount of the claim
options.cn: 等于索赔金额的两倍

explanation_en: Per the stop notice statute, to bind a construction lender the accompanying bond must equal 1¼ times the amount of the claim. Without this bond, the stop notice does not obligate the construction lender to withhold funds.
explanation_cn: 根据停工通知法，要约束建筑贷款人，随附的保证金必须等于索赔金额的1¼倍。没有这笔保证金，停工通知不会使建筑贷款人有义务扣留资金。
code_reference: California Civil Code - Stop Notice provisions (Document p. 58, PDF p. 81)

question_en: A claimant serves a bonded stop notice on a construction lender but loses the subsequent lawsuit. What financial consequence does the claimant face?
question_cn: 申请人在建筑贷款人处提交了有担保的停工通知，但随后在诉讼中败诉。申请人将面临什么财务后果？

options.en: Forfeiture of the stop notice bond to the lender
options.cn: 停工通知保证金没收给贷款人

options.en: No financial consequence; only the bond is at risk
options.cn: 没有财务后果；只有保证金有风险

options.en: Payment of all costs awarded against the claimant
options.cn: 支付对申请人裁定的所有费用

options.en: A penalty equal to the withheld construction funds
options.cn: 等于被扣留建筑资金的处罚

explanation_en: Under the stop notice statute, if the claimant loses the action on the bond, the claimant must pay all costs that may be awarded to the owner, contractor, or construction lender. This liability exposure is the reason a bond is required.
explanation_cn: 根据停工通知法规，如果申请人在保证金诉讼中败诉，申请人必须支付可能裁定给业主、承包商或建筑贷款人的所有费用。这种责任风险就是要求提供保证金的原因。
code_reference: California Civil Code - Stop Notice provisions (Document p. 58, PDF p. 81)

question_en: A contractor advertises that they are 'bonded' in their marketing materials. Under what circumstance does this become a cause for discipline?
question_cn: 承包商在他们的宣传材料中宣称自己是“有担保的”。在什么情况下，这会成为受纪律处分的原因？

options.en: When the contractor holds no performance bond on the project
options.cn: 当承包商在项目上没有履约保证金时

options.en: When the bond amount is not stated in the advertisement
options.cn: 当广告中未说明保证金额时

options.en: When the ad references the contractor's license bond or disciplinary bond
options.cn: 当广告提到承包商的执照保证金或纪律处分保证金时

options.en: When the bond has lapsed or expired
options.cn: 当保证金已失效或过期时

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7027.4(b) makes it a cause for discipline to advertise as 'bonded' when the reference is to the contractor's license bond required under Section 7071.6 or a disciplinary bond under Section 7071.8.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7027.4(b)条规定，当广告中所提的“有担保”是指根据第7071.6条要求的承包商执照保证金或根据第7071.8条的纪律处分保证金时，这是受纪律处分的原因。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7027.4(b) (Document p. 220, PDF p. 243)

question_en: A contractor advertises that they carry 'insurance' in their print ads without specifying what kind. What rule does this violate?
question_cn: 一位承包商在其印刷广告中宣传他们有“保险”，但未说明具体类型。这违反了什么规定？

options.en: It violates the bonding disclosure requirement only
options.cn: 它仅违反保证金披露要求

options.en: It is cause for discipline for not identifying the insurance type
options.cn: 因未说明保险类型而构成纪律处分的理由

options.en: It is a misdemeanor punishable by up to $1,000 fine
options.cn: 这是一种轻罪，可处以最高1,000美元罚款

options.en: It violates the unlicensed advertising prohibition
options.cn: 它违反了无证广告禁止规定

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7027.4(a) makes it a cause for discipline to advertise as 'insured' without identifying the specific type of insurance carried, such as 'commercial general liability insurance' or 'workers' compensation insurance.'
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7027.4(a)条规定，若在广告中以“投保”宣传而未说明所持保险的具体类型（例如“商业一般责任保险”或“工伤赔偿保险”），则构成可进行纪律处分的理由。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7027.4(a) (Document p. 220, PDF p. 243)

question_en: A licensed contractor inserts a clause in a subcontract requiring the subcontractor to waive all lien rights. Which code section prohibits this?
question_cn: 一名持牌承包商在分包合同中加入条款，要求分包商放弃所有留置权。哪一条法规禁止这样做？

options.en: Public Contract Code Section 6100
options.cn: 公共合同法第6100条

options.en: B&P Code Section 7068.1
options.cn: 商业与专业法第7068.1条

options.en: Civil Code Section 8122
options.cn: 民法典第8122条

options.en: Civil Code Section 2782
options.cn: 民法典第2782条

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7034(b) expressly prohibits a contractor from requiring a waiver of lien rights from any subcontractor, employee, or supplier in violation of Civil Code Section 8122.
explanation_cn: 商业与专业法第7034(b)条明确禁止承包商要求任何分包商、雇员或供应商放弃留置权，违反民法典第8122条。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7034(b) (Document p. 238, PDF p. 261)

question_en: A licensed LLC contractor fails to pay employees wages. Which bond specifically protects those workers beyond the standard contractor's bond?
question_cn: 注册的有限责任公司（LLC）承包商未支付员工工资。除了标准承包商保证金外，哪种保证金专门保护这些工人？

options.en: A $100,000 LLC surety bond
options.cn: 10万美元有限责任公司保证金

options.en: A $25,000 disciplinary surety bond
options.cn: 2.5万美元纪律处分保证金

options.en: A $75,000 performance bond
options.cn: 7.5万美元履约保证金

options.en: A $50,000 qualifying individual bond
options.cn: 5万美元个人资格保证金

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7071.6.5(a) requires a $100,000 surety bond as a condition of licensure for LLCs, specifically to protect employees damaged by the LLC's failure to pay wages, interest, or fringe benefits.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7071.6.5(a)条要求有限责任公司作为取得执照的条件提供10万美元保证金，专门用于保护因LLC未支付工资、利息或附加福利而受损的员工。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7071.6.5 (Document p. 273, PDF p. 296)

question_en: A surety bond is filed with the CSLB registrar showing an effective date of March 1. The registrar receives the bond on June 15. Under what circumstances can the registrar still accept the bond as of March 1?
question_cn: 担保债券已向 CSLB 登记员提交，显示生效日期为 3 月 1 日。登记员在 6 月 15 日收到该债券。在什么情况下登记员仍然可以接受 3 月 1 日的债券？

options.en: If the licensee pays a late filing fee
options.cn: 如果持证人支付了迟交费用

options.en: If the surety insurer submits a written explanation
options.cn: 如果保证保险公司提交了书面说明

options.en: Only if the license was never suspended
options.cn: 仅在执照从未被暂停的情况下

options.en: If the delay was beyond the licensee's control
options.cn: 如果延迟超出了持证人的控制范围

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7071.7(b) allows the registrar to accept a bond after the 90-day window if the licensee demonstrates, on a registrar-approved form, that the failure to file timely was due to circumstances beyond the licensee's control.
explanation_cn: 《商务与职业法》第 7071.7(b) 条允许登记员在 90 天期限后接受债券，如果持证人在登记员批准的表格上证明未能按时提交是由于超出持证人控制的情况。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7071.7 (Document p. 273, PDF p. 296)

question_en: The standard contractor's bond protects a homeowner who suffered damages from a licensee's violation. However, which property owner is expressly NOT covered under the contractor's bond for single-family dwelling construction?
question_cn: 标准承包商保证金保护因持证人违规而受到损害的房主。然而，哪类房产所有者明确不在单户住宅施工承包商保证金的保障范围内？

options.en: An owner whose dwelling is offered for sale
options.cn: 其住宅已挂牌出售的所有者

options.en: A homeowner damaged by licensee fraud
options.cn: 因持证人欺诈而受损的房主

options.en: An owner building for personal family use
options.cn: 为个人家庭使用而建房的所有者

options.en: An employee owed unpaid wages
options.cn: 欠薪的员工

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7071.5(b) explicitly states that a property owner building a single-family dwelling may only recover if the dwelling is NOT intended for sale or offered for sale at the time damages were incurred. Spec-home builders are excluded.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7071.5(b)条明确规定，建造单户住宅的房产所有者仅在住宅不打算出售或在发生损害时未挂牌出售的情况下才可索赔。样板房建造者被排除在外。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7071.5 (Document p. 271, PDF p. 294)

question_en: What is the required contractor's bond amount as a condition of license issuance, reinstatement, or renewal under the standard bonding provision?
question_cn: 根据标准担保规定，作为颁发、恢复或续签执照的条件，所需的承包商保证金金额是多少？

options.en: $25,000 executed by an admitted surety
options.cn: 由认可的担保人签发的 $25,000

options.en: $100,000 executed by an admitted surety
options.cn: 由认可的担保人签发的 $100,000

options.en: $50,000 executed by an admitted surety
options.cn: 由认可的担保人签发的 $50,000

options.en: $15,000 executed by an admitted surety
options.cn: 由认可的担保人签发的 $15,000

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7071.6(a) requires each applicant or licensee to file a contractor's bond in the sum of $25,000 as a condition precedent to issuance, reinstatement, reactivation, renewal, or continued maintenance of a license.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 7071.6(a) 条要求每位申请人或持证人在颁发、恢复、重新激活、续签或持续维持执照之前，提交 $25,000 的承包商保证金。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7071.6(a) (Document p. 272, PDF p. 295)

question_en: A contractor applicant was previously cited for unlicensed contracting under Section 7028.7, and the citation became a final order. The work substantially injured the public. What bond amount may the board require until the first renewal?
question_cn: 一名承包商申请人之前因违反第7028.7条从事无牌承包工作而被罚款，该罚款已成为最终裁定。该行为对公众造成了重大伤害。在首次续约之前，委员会可能要求的保证金额是多少？

options.en: $75,000, triple the standard amount
options.cn: $75,000，标准金额的三倍

options.en: $50,000, twice the standard bond amount
options.cn: $50,000，标准保证金的两倍

options.en: $25,000, the standard bond amount
options.cn: $25,000，标准保证金额

options.en: $37,500, one and a half times the standard
options.cn: $37,500，标准金额的一倍半

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7071.6(d) authorizes the board to require a bond in twice the standard amount (2 × $25,000 = $50,000) when three conditions are met: the applicant was cited under Section 7028.7, the citation became a final order, and the violation caused substantial public injury.
explanation_cn: 《商业与专业法》第7071.6(d)条授权委员会在满足三个条件时要求保证金额为标准金额的两倍（2 × $25,000 = $50,000）：申请人因违反第7028.7条受到引用，引用已成为最终裁定，并且违规行为对公众造成了重大伤害。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7071.6(d) (Document p. 272, PDF p. 295)

question_en: A contractor's bond deposit is insufficient to pay all adjudicated claims in full. How are the available funds distributed among claimants?
question_cn: 承包商的保证金不足以全额支付所有裁定的索赔。可用资金将如何在索赔人之间分配？

options.en: Equally divided among all eligible claimants
options.cn: 平均分配给所有符合条件的索赔人

options.en: Prioritized by claimant type, employees paid first
options.cn: 按索赔人类型优先排列，员工优先支付

options.en: Proportionally, based on each claimant's share
options.cn: 按比例分配，根据每个索赔人的份额

options.en: First-come, first-served until funds are exhausted
options.cn: 先到先得，直到资金耗尽

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7071.4(c)(2) states that when the deposit is insufficient to pay all claims in full, the amount shall be distributed to all claimants in proportion to the amount of their respective claims.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7071.4(c)(2)条规定，当保证金不足以全额支付所有索赔时，应按各索赔金额的比例分配给所有索赔人。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7071.4(c)(2) (Document p. 269, PDF p. 292)

question_en: An employee files a wage claim against a contractor's bond deposit. After the Labor Commissioner finds in the employee's favor, when may the registrar release payment to the claimant if no judicial review is sought?
question_cn: 员工对承包商的保证金存款提出工资索赔。在劳工专员裁定支持员工后，如果没有寻求司法复审，注册员何时可以向索赔人支付款项？

options.en: After 60 days, if no court action is filed
options.cn: 60天后，如果未提起法院诉讼

options.en: Immediately upon the commissioner's determination
options.cn: 在专员作出裁定后立即支付

options.en: After 10 days, if no judicial review notice is filed
options.cn: 10天后，如果未提交司法复审通知

options.en: After 90 days, consistent with standard bond timelines
options.cn: 90天后，符合标准保证金时间表

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7071.4(g) provides that if no judicial review action is actually filed within 60 days following the commissioner's determination, the registrar shall make payment from the deposit to the claimant. The 10-day notice window is a prerequisite, but payment follows the 60-day action period.
explanation_cn: 商业与职业法典第7071.4(g)条规定，如果在专员作出裁定后的60天内实际上没有提起司法复审诉讼，注册员应从保证金中向索赔人支付款项。10天的通知期是前提条件，但支付发生在60天诉讼期之后。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7071.4(g) (Document p. 270, PDF p. 293)

question_en: A contractor's license was revoked due to disciplinary action. When the contractor applies for restoration, what is the minimum disciplinary bond the registrar may require?
question_cn: 承包商的执照因纪律处分被吊销。当承包商申请恢复执照时，注册主任可能要求的最低纪律处分保证金是多少？

options.en: Fifteen thousand dollars ($15,000)
options.cn: 一万五千美元（$15,000）

options.en: Ten thousand dollars ($10,000)
Fifty thousand dollars ($50,000)
Twenty-five thousand dollars ($25,000)
options.cn: 两万五千美元（$25,000）

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7071.8(b) states the disciplinary bond sum 'shall not be less than twenty-five thousand dollars ($25,000),' with the registrar setting the exact amount based on violation severity.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7071.8(b)条规定，纪律处分保证金额“不得少于两万五千美元（$25,000）”，注册主任根据违规严重程度确定具体金额。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7071.8(b) (Document p. 275, PDF p. 298)

question_en: A qualifying individual for a corporation is not the proprietor or a general partner. Under what condition is the qualifying individual NOT required to file a qualifying individual's bond?
question_cn: 公司中符合条件的个人不是业主或普通合伙人。在什么情况下，符合条件的个人不需要提交符合条件个人的保证金？

options.en: The qualifying individual has held the license for over five years
options.cn: 符合条件的个人持有执照已超过五年

options.en: The qualifying individual has no prior disciplinary history
options.cn: 符合条件的个人没有任何纪律处分记录

options.en: The qualifying individual owns 10% or more of voting stock
options.cn: 符合条件的个人拥有公司 10% 或更多的有表决权股份

options.en: The corporation has maintained active status for two years
options.cn: 公司已保持两年的有效状态

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7071.9(c) exempts a responsible managing officer of a corporation from the qualifying individual's bond if the officer owns 10 percent or more of the corporation's voting stock and certifies that fact to the registrar.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 7071.9(c) 条规定，如果公司负责任的管理人员拥有公司 10% 或更多的有表决权股份，并向注册员证明该事实，则可免除提交符合条件个人的保证金。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7071.9(c) (Document p. 276, PDF p. 299)

question_en: A surety pays a wage claim against a contractor's bond. Within how many days must the surety notify the CSLB registrar of that payment?
question_cn: 担保人在承包商的保证金下支付工资索赔。担保人必须在多少天内将该支付情况通知CSLB注册主任？

options.en: Within 30 days of the payment
options.cn: 支付后30天内

options.en: Within 45 days of the payment
options.cn: 支付后45天内

options.en: Within 60 days of the payment
options.cn: 支付后60天内

options.en: Within 90 days of the payment
options.cn: 支付后90天内

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7071.11(e) requires the surety to provide written notice to the registrar within 30 days of making any payment on a bond claim, regardless of whether the payment was made through a court action.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7071.11(e)条规定，担保人必须在对保证金索赔进行任何支付后的30天内向注册主任提供书面通知，无论该支付是否通过司法程序进行。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7071.11(e) (Document p. 278, PDF p. 301)

question_en: A licensee receives notice that a surety is about to settle a bond claim against the contractor's account. What is the minimum time the licensee must be given to file a written protest before settlement?
question_cn: 执照持有人收到通知，保证人即将对承包商的账户进行保函索赔结算。结算前，执照持有人提交书面抗议的最短时间是多少？

options.en: Not less than 30 days
options.cn: 不少于30天

options.en: Not less than 15 days
options.cn: 不少于15天

options.en: Not less than 10 days
options.cn: 不少于10天

options.en: Not less than 7 days
options.cn: 不少于7天

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7071.11(f) states that prior to a good-faith settlement by the surety, a licensee shall have not less than 15 days to provide a written protest instructing the surety not to pay.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7071.11(f)条规定，在保证人进行诚信结算之前，执照持有人应有不少于15天的时间提供书面抗议，指示保证人不要付款。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7071.11(f) (Document p. 279, PDF p. 302)

question_en: A contractor fails to file a protest after a surety makes a good-faith bond payment. How many days does the contractor have to reimburse the surety before the license is automatically suspended?
question_cn: 承包商在担保人善意支付保证金后未提交抗议。承包商必须在多少天内向担保人偿还，否则执照会自动被暂停？

options.en: 90 days from board notification
options.cn: 自委员会通知之日起90天

options.en: 10 days from board notification
options.cn: 自委员会通知之日起10天

options.en: 30 days from board notification
options.cn: 自委员会通知之日起30天

options.en: 60 days from board notification
options.cn: 自委员会通知之日起60天

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7071.11(f)(2) states that a licensee who fails to file a protest has 90 days from board notification to submit proof of payment to the surety; otherwise the license is suspended by operation of law.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7071.11(f)(2)条规定，未提交抗议的持证人在委员会通知之日起90天内必须向担保人提交支付证明；否则执照将依法被暂停。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7071.11(f)(2) (Document p. 279, PDF p. 302)

question_en: A contractor advertises to the public that they are 'bonded,' referencing the contractor's license bond required by the CSLB. What consequence does this create?
question_cn: 一名承包商向公众宣传他们是“有担保的”，指的是 CSLB 要求的承包商执照保证金。这会产生什么后果？

options.en: The contractor receives a written warning from CSLB
options.cn: 承包商会收到 CSLB 的书面警告

options.en: The contractor must increase the bond amount
options.cn: 承包商必须增加保证金金额

options.en: The contractor's license may be suspended
options.cn: 承包商的执照可能会被暂停

options.en: The contractor is subject to a civil penalty
options.cn: 承包商可能会受到民事处罚

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7071.13 states that any reference by a contractor in advertising, soliciting, or other public presentments to any bond required under this chapter is a ground for suspension of the contractor's license.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 7071.13 条规定，承包商在广告、招揽或其他公开陈述中提及本章要求的任何保证金，都是承包商执照可被暂停的理由。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7071.13 (Document p. 280, PDF p. 303)

question_en: A surety company refuses to issue a contractor's license bond to an applicant solely because of the applicant's national origin. Under California law, what is the surety liable for per offense?
question_cn: 担保公司仅因申请人的国籍而拒绝向其签发承包商执照保证金。根据加利福尼亚州法律，担保公司每次违法行为应承担什么责任？

options.en: Actual damages only, no additional penalty
options.cn: 仅实际损失，无额外罚款

options.en: Actual damages plus $250 per offense
options.cn: 实际损失外加每次违法行为 250 美元

options.en: Actual damages plus $1,000 per offense
options.cn: 实际损失外加每次违法行为 1,000 美元

options.en: Actual damages plus $500 per offense
options.cn: 实际损失外加每次违法行为 500 美元

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7071.14 provides that a party who discriminatorily denies a contractor's license bond is liable for actual damages suffered by the applicant plus two hundred fifty dollars ($250) for each offense.
explanation_cn: 《商业和职业法典》第 7071.14 条规定，歧视性拒绝承包商执照保证金的一方，应对申请人遭受的实际损失负责，并按每次违法行为支付二百五十美元（$250）。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7071.14 (Document p. 280, PDF p. 303)

question_en: Under the qualifying individual's bond rules, what is the aggregate surety liability cap on claims brought by parties OTHER than the primary beneficiaries specified in Section 7071.10(a)(1)?
question_cn: 根据符合资格个人的保证金规则，除第7071.10(a)(1)条规定的主要受益人之外，其他方提出的索赔的担保责任总额上限是多少？

options.en: Up to $4,000 for those claimants
options.cn: 对于这些索赔人，最高4,000美元

options.en: Up to $10,000 for those claimants
options.cn: 对于这些索赔人，最高10,000美元

options.en: Up to $7,500 for those claimants
options.cn: 对于这些索赔人，最高7,500美元

options.en: Up to $25,000 for those claimants
options.cn: 对于这些索赔人，最高25,000美元

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7071.9(b) states that the aggregate surety liability on claims by parties other than the primary beneficiaries under Section 7071.10(a)(1) shall not exceed $7,500; amounts above that are reserved for the primary beneficiaries.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7071.9(b)条规定，除第7071.10(a)(1)条下的主要受益人之外，其他方提出的索赔的担保责任总额不得超过7,500美元；超过该金额的部分保留给主要受益人。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7071.9(b) (Document p. 276, PDF p. 299)

question_en: A contractor files an accord with a surety to satisfy a bond debt instead of paying in full. What happens by operation of law if the contractor later fails to abide by that accord?
question_cn: 承包商与担保公司达成协议以满足保证金债务，而不是全额支付。如果承包商随后未能遵守该协议，会根据法律规定发生什么情况？

options.en: The surety files a new claim against the contractor
options.cn: 担保公司对承包商提出新的索赔

options.en: The license is automatically suspended
options.cn: 许可证会自动被暂停

options.en: The accord is voided and full payment is due immediately
options.cn: 协议被作废，需立即全额付款

options.en: CSLB issues a written citation to the contractor
options.cn: CSLB 向承包商发出书面警告

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7071.11(h) states that failure to abide by an accord with the surety shall result, by operation of law, in the automatic suspension of any license to which the section applies.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7071.11(h)条规定，未能遵守与担保公司达成的协议，将根据法律规定，导致适用该条款的任何许可证自动被暂停。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7071.11(h) (Document p. 279, PDF p. 302)

question_en: Under the qualifying individual's bond, which of the following persons is NOT listed as a beneficiary entitled to make a claim against that bond?
question_cn: 在符合条件的个人担保下，下列哪一人未被列为有权对该担保提出索赔的受益人？

options.en: An employee damaged by unpaid wages
options.cn: 因未支付工资而受损的雇员

options.en: A materials supplier owed payment for delivered goods
options.cn: 因交付货物而应支付款项的材料供应商

options.en: A homeowner damaged by a home improvement violation
options.cn: 因家庭装修违规而受损的房主

options.en: A person defrauded during contract execution by the licensee
options.cn: 在合同执行过程中被持牌人欺诈的人

explanation_en: Materials suppliers are not listed among the beneficiaries of the qualifying individual's bond under Section 7071.10. They may have other remedies (e.g., mechanic's lien), but are not covered beneficiaries of this specific bond.
explanation_cn: 根据第7071.10条，材料供应商未被列为符合条件的个人担保的受益人。他们可能有其他救济途径（例如，工程留置权），但不属于该特定担保的覆盖受益人。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7071.10 (Document p. 277, PDF p. 300)

question_en: A disciplinary bond filed under Section 7071.8 must remain on file with the registrar for at least how long, and under what license condition does the bond period run?
question_cn: 根据第7071.8条提交的纪律处分保证金必须在登记处保存至少多长时间，并且在什么许可证条件下保证金期限开始计算？

options.en: Two years while the license is current, active, and in good standing
options.cn: 两年，只要许可证是有效、激活且状态良好

options.en: One year while the license is active and in good standing
options.cn: 一年，只要许可证是激活且状态良好

options.en: Two years from the date the disciplinary action was imposed
options.cn: 自纪律处分实施之日起两年

options.en: One year regardless of license status
options.cn: 一年，无论许可证状态如何

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7071.8(c) requires the disciplinary bond to remain on file for at least two years, and specifies that the bond period runs only while the license is current, active, and in good standing — extending if necessary until those conditions are met for the required period.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7071.8(c)条要求纪律处分保证金至少保存两年，并规定保证金期限仅在许可证有效、激活且状态良好期间计算——如有必要，可延长至满足所需期限的条件为止。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7071.8(c) (Document p. 275, PDF p. 298)

question_en: A judgment is entered against a licensee for failure to pay a subcontractor. Under Section 7071.17, a qualifying person who was personnel of record at the time of the underlying activities is automatically prohibited from doing what?
question_cn: 因未支付分包商费用，被判决对持证人作出判决。根据第7071.17条，作为当时相关活动的备案人员的合格人自动被禁止做什么？

options.en: Renewing any current license held by that individual
options.cn: 续签该个人持有的任何现有执照

options.en: Serving as qualifying individual or personnel of record on any license
options.cn: 作为任何执照的合格个人或备案人员服务

options.en: Applying for a new license in their own name
options.cn: 以自己的名义申请新执照

options.en: Bidding on any new construction projects
options.cn: 参与任何新建工程项目的投标

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7071.17(j)(1) states that a qualifying person or personnel of record at the time of the activities on which the judgment is based is automatically prohibited from serving as a qualifying individual or other personnel of record on any license until the judgment is satisfied.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7071.17(j)(1)条规定，作为判决所依据活动时的合格人或备案人员，自动被禁止作为任何执照的合格个人或其他备案人员，直到判决得到履行。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7071.17(j)(1) (Document p. 282, PDF p. 305)

question_en: An LLC contractor has seven persons listed on its personnel of record. What is the minimum aggregate liability insurance limit required to maintain its license?
question_cn: 一家有限责任公司承包商的记录中列有七名人员。维持其执照所需的最低总责任保险限额是多少？

options.en: One million dollars in aggregate coverage
options.cn: 总体覆盖范围为一百万美元

options.en: One million two hundred thousand dollars in coverage
options.cn: 覆盖范围为一百二十万美元

options.en: One million seven hundred thousand dollars in coverage
options.cn: 覆盖范围为一百七十万美元

options.en: Five million dollars in aggregate coverage
options.cn: 总体覆盖范围为五百万美元

explanation_en: Under B&P Code §7071.19(b)(2), LLCs with more than five personnel start at $1,000,000 and add $100,000 per person above five. Seven personnel = $1,000,000 + (2 × $100,000) = $1,200,000.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7071.19(b)(2)条款，人员超过五人的有限责任公司起始保险额度为1,000,000美元，每超过五人增加100,000美元。七名人员 = 1,000,000美元 + (2 × 100,000美元) = 1,200,000美元。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7071.19(b) (Document p. 284, PDF p. 307)

question_en: A licensed contractor is named as a defendant in a complex construction defect case involving a multifamily rental building. The final judgment against the contractor is $1.2 million. Within how many days must the contractor report this to the registrar?
question_cn: 一名持证承包商在涉及多户出租建筑的复杂建筑缺陷案件中被列为被告。对该承包商的不利最终判决金额为120万美元。承包商必须在多少天内向注册主任报告此事？

options.en: Within 30 days of gaining knowledge
options.cn: 在获知该事件后的30天内

options.en: Within 45 days of gaining knowledge
options.cn: 在获知该事件后的45天内

options.en: Within 90 days of gaining knowledge
options.cn: 在获知该事件后的90天内

options.en: Within 60 days of gaining knowledge
options.cn: 在获知该事件后的60天内

explanation_en: B&P Code §7071.20(a) requires a licensee to report qualifying judgments, settlements, or arbitration awards to the registrar in writing within 90 days after the licensee has knowledge of the event.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》§7071.20(a)要求持证人必须在获知事件后的90天内以书面形式向注册主任报告符合条件的判决、和解或仲裁裁决。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7071.20(a) (Document p. 286, PDF p. 309)

question_en: Which of the following actions by a contractor's insurer triggers the insurer's own duty to report to the CSLB registrar under B&P Code Section 7071.21?
question_cn: 承包商的保险公司采取以下哪项行动会触发保险公司根据《商业和职业法典》第7071.21条向CSLB注册主任报告的义务？

options.en: Renewing a commercial general liability policy
options.cn: 续签商业综合责任保险

options.en: Paying all or part of a qualifying judgment or settlement
options.cn: 支付全部或部分符合条件的判决或和解

options.en: Issuing a new policy to the licensee
options.cn: 向持证人签发新保单

options.en: Canceling coverage before the policy expiration date
options.cn: 在保单到期之前取消保险

explanation_en: B&P Code §7071.21(a) requires an insurer to report to the registrar within 30 days of paying all or a portion of a civil action judgment, settlement, or arbitration award that meets the criteria of §7071.20.
explanation_cn: 《商业和职业法典》第7071.21(a)条要求保险公司在支付全部或部分符合第7071.20条标准的民事诉讼判决、和解或仲裁裁决后的30天内向注册主任报告。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7071.21(a) (Document p. 288, PDF p. 311)

question_en: A contractor's LLC is dissolved and wound up. Regarding the liability insurance policy maintained under B&P Code Section 7071.19, what must the company do at dissolution?
question_cn: 承包商的有限责任公司（LLC）已解散并完成清算。关于根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7071.19条维护的责任保险政策，公司在解散时必须做什么？

options.en: Obtain extended reporting coverage for at least three years
options.cn: 获取至少三年的延长报告保险

options.en: Maintain extended reporting coverage for one year
options.cn: 保持一年的延长报告保险

options.en: Transfer the policy to a successor entity
options.cn: 将保险转移给继承实体

options.en: Cancel the policy immediately upon dissolution
options.cn: 在解散时立即取消保险

explanation_en: B&P Code §7071.19(e) requires the dissolving LLC to maintain or obtain an extended reporting period endorsement at the maximum required coverage limit for a minimum of three years, if reasonably available from the insurer.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7071.19(e)条要求解散的有限责任公司在合理可行的情况下，从保险公司获得并保持延长报告期背书，按最大要求的保险额度维持至少三年。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7071.19(e) (Document p. 285, PDF p. 308)

question_en: Under B&P Code Section 7071.20, which of the following conditions does NOT need to be met for a licensee's settlement to be reportable to the registrar?
question_cn: 根据《建筑与专业法典》第7071.20条款，下列哪些情况不需要满足即可使持牌人的和解报告给注册主任？

options.en: The structure involved is a multifamily rental residential building
options.cn: 涉及的结构是多户租赁住宅楼

options.en: The licensee is named as a defendant or cross-defendant
options.cn: 持牌人被列为被告或交叉被告

options.en: The claimant must be a licensed contractor
options.cn: 原告必须是持牌承包商

options.en: The judgment or award is $1,000,000 or greater
options.cn: 判决或裁决金额为100万美元或以上

explanation_en: The statute imposes no requirement that the claimant or plaintiff be a licensed contractor. The reporting criteria focus on the type of structure, the amount of the judgment, and the nature of the claim — not the claimant's license status.
explanation_cn: 法规未要求原告或申诉人必须是持牌承包商。报告标准侧重于结构类型、判决金额和索赔性质，而非原告的执照状态。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7071.20(a) (Document p. 286, PDF p. 309)

question_en: In a multi-contractor lawsuit under B&P Code Section 7071.20, which contractor is exempt from the reporting requirement even if the case otherwise qualifies?
question_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7071.20条，在多承包商诉讼中，即使案件符合条件，哪位承包商可免于报告要求？

options.en: A contractor who has no prior disciplinary record
options.cn: 没有任何纪律处分记录的承包商

options.en: A contractor apportioned less than $15,000 in liability
options.cn: 在责任分配中少于15,000美元的承包商

options.en: A subcontractor with no direct client contract
options.cn: 没有直接客户合同的分包商

options.en: A contractor whose work was on single-family homes only
options.cn: 仅从事单户住宅工作的承包商

explanation_en: B&P Code §7071.20(c) exempts a contractor who is named as a defendant or cross-defendant but is assigned liability of less than $15,000 in the action from the reporting obligation.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7071.20(c)条规定，被列为被告或交叉被告但在诉讼中承担的责任少于15,000美元的承包商，可以免于报告义务。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7071.20(c) (Document p. 287, PDF p. 310)

question_en: A contractor's LLC fails to reinstate its aggregate liability insurance coverage by the start of the next designated period after the coverage was exhausted. What is the consequence under B&P Code Section 7071.19?
question_cn: 承包商的有限责任公司未能在保险覆盖额度用尽后，下一个指定期间开始前恢复其总责任保险覆盖。根据《加州《加州商业与职业法典》》第7071.19条的规定会有什么后果？

options.en: The license is suspended by operation of law
options.cn: 许可证依法被暂停

options.en: The board may pursue disciplinary action at its discretion
options.cn: 董事会可自行决定采取纪律处分行动

options.en: The registrar issues a notice to correct within 90 days
options.cn: 登记机关在90天内发出纠正通知

options.en: The licensee has 30 days to cure before suspension
options.cn: 执照持有人在暂停前有30天的期限进行补救

explanation_en: B&P Code §7071.19(d) states that the license of any licensee that fails to reinstate the required aggregate coverage limit by the start of the next designated period shall be suspended by operation of law until the licensee complies.
explanation_cn: 《加州《加州商业与职业法典》》第7071.19(d)条规定，任何未能在下一个指定期间开始前恢复所需总保险覆盖额度的执照持有人，其执照将依法被暂停，直到执照持有人遵守规定为止。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7071.19(d) (Document p. 285, PDF p. 308)

question_en: A licensed contractor fails to maintain workers' compensation insurance and the policy lapses. When does the automatic license suspension take effect?
question_cn: 持牌承包商未能维持工伤赔偿保险且保单失效。自动吊销执照何时生效？

options.en: 30 days after the registrar mails a notice
options.cn: 注册员邮寄通知后30天

options.en: 45 days after the registrar issues a pending notice
options.cn: 注册员发出待处理通知后45天

options.en: On the date the registrar posts the suspension
options.cn: 注册员发布吊销的日期

options.en: On the date the insurance coverage lapses
options.cn: 保险失效的日期

explanation_en: Under B&P Code Section 7125.2(a)(1), suspension is effective upon the earlier of the date coverage lapses or the date coverage was required to be obtained — not after any notice period.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7125.2(a)(1)条，吊销在保险失效日期或需要取得保险之日起较早者生效——而不是在任何通知期之后。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7125.2 (Document p. 346, PDF p. 369)

question_en: A sole owner contractor is found to have employed workers without maintaining workers' compensation coverage. What is the minimum civil penalty per violation?
question_cn: 发现一名独资承包商雇佣工人时未维持工伤赔偿保险。每次违规的最低民事处罚是多少？

options.en: $15,000 per violation
options.cn: 每次违规 15,000 美元

options.en: $30,000 per violation
options.cn: 每次违规 30,000 美元

options.en: $10,000 per violation
options.cn: 每次违规 10,000 美元

options.en: $20,000 per violation
options.cn: 每次违规 20,000 美元

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7125.4(a)(1) sets the minimum civil penalty at $10,000 per violation specifically for sole owner licensees who employ workers without maintaining workers' comp coverage.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7125.4(a)(1)条规定，对于未维持工伤赔偿保险而雇佣工人的独资持证人，每次违规的最低民事处罚为 10,000 美元。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7125.4(a)(1) (Document p. 347, PDF p. 370)

question_en: A corporation is caught employing workers without workers' compensation coverage. How does the minimum civil penalty compare to that of a sole owner facing the same violation?
question_cn: 一家公司被发现雇佣没有工伤赔偿保险的工人。其最低民事处罚与面临相同违规的个体所有者相比如何？

options.en: Equal — both face the same minimum penalty
options.cn: 相等 — 两者面临相同的最低处罚

options.en: The corporation's minimum is three times higher
options.cn: 公司的最低处罚高出三倍

options.en: The corporation's minimum is $5,000 more
options.cn: 公司的最低处罚高出 5,000 美元

options.en: The corporation's minimum is $10,000 more
options.cn: 公司的最低处罚高出 10,000 美元

explanation_en: Under B&P Code Section 7125.4(a), corporations face a minimum of $20,000 per violation versus $10,000 for sole owners — a difference of $10,000.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第 7125.4(a) 条，公司每次违规的最低处罚为 20,000 美元，而个体所有者为 10,000 美元 — 相差 10,000 美元。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7125.4(a)(1) and (a)(2) (Document p. 347, PDF p. 370)

question_en: An employer who ignores a stop order prohibiting the use of employee labor faces which of the following penalties?
question_cn: 忽视禁止使用雇员劳动的停工令的雇主将面临以下哪种处罚？

options.en: A fine up to $10,000 or 60 days jail, or both
options.cn: 最高可达10,000美元的罚款或监禁60天，或两者兼施

options.en: A misdemeanor with up to 6 months in state prison
options.cn: 轻罪，最高可判6个月州监狱徒刑

options.en: A civil penalty not exceeding $5,000
options.cn: 不超过5,000美元的民事处罚

options.en: Automatic license revocation and a $20,000 fine
options.cn: 自动吊销执照并罚款20,000美元

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7127(a)(2) makes failure to observe a stop order a misdemeanor punishable by up to 60 days in county jail, a fine not exceeding $10,000, or both.
explanation_cn: 《商法典》第7127(a)(2)条规定，未遵守停工令属于轻罪，最高可判60天县监，罚款不超过10,000美元，或两者兼施。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7127(a)(2) (Document p. 350, PDF p. 373)

question_en: An employer disputes a stop order for lack of workers' compensation insurance. Within how many days after service must the employer file a written request for a hearing?
question_cn: 雇主对因缺乏工伤赔偿保险而发出的停工令提出异议。在收到送达通知后，雇主必须在多少天内提交书面听证请求？

options.en: Within 45 days after service
options.cn: 收到送达通知后45天内

options.en: Within 15 working days after service
options.cn: 收到送达通知后15个工作日内

options.en: Within 5 days after service
options.cn: 收到送达通知后5天内

options.en: Within 20 days after service
options.cn: 收到送达通知后20天内

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7127(b) requires the employer to file a written request for hearing with the registrar within 20 days after service of the stop order.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7127(b)条要求雇主在收到停工令送达通知后20天内向注册主任提交书面听证请求。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7127(b) (Document p. 350, PDF p. 373)

question_en: After a stop order hearing concludes, within what time period must the registrar issue and serve the written notice of findings?
question_cn: 停工令听证会结束后，注册主任必须在多长时间内发出并送达书面裁决通知？

options.en: Within 5 days of the hearing
options.cn: 听证会后5天内

options.en: Within 24 hours of the hearing's conclusion
options.cn: 听证会结束后24小时内

options.en: Within 20 days of the hearing's conclusion
options.cn: 听证会结束后20天内

options.en: Within 48 hours of the hearing's conclusion
options.cn: 听证会结束后48小时内

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7127(b) requires the registrar to issue and serve written notice of findings and findings within 24 hours after the conclusion of the hearing.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7127(b)条要求注册主任在听证会结束后24小时内发出并送达书面裁决通知及裁决
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7127(b) (Document p. 350, PDF p. 373)

question_en: A licensee's workers' compensation insurance certificate arrives at the registrar's office 120 days after its effective date. Under what condition can the registrar still accept it as of the certificate's effective date?
question_cn: 执照持有人的工伤赔偿保险证明在生效日期后 120 天才送达注册办公室。在什么情况下注册主任仍然可以按证明的生效日期接受它？

options.en: If the licensee pays a late filing penalty fee
options.cn: 如果执照持有人支付了迟交罚款

options.en: If the insurer confirms coverage was continuous
options.cn: 如果保险公司确认保险持续有效

options.en: If the licensee shows circumstances beyond their control
options.cn: 如果执照持有人能够说明是由于其无法控制的情况

options.en: The registrar cannot accept it after 90 days
options.cn: 注册主任在90天后不能接受

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7125.1(b) allows the registrar to accept the certificate retroactively even beyond 90 days if the licensee demonstrates on a board-approved form that the delay was due to circumstances beyond their control.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7125.1(b)条允许注册主任即使超过90天，也可以追溯接受该证明，如果执照持有人在董事会批准的表格上证明延迟是由于其无法控制的情况造成的。
