code_reference: B&P Code Section 7125.1(b) (Document p. 345, PDF p. 368)

question_en: A licensee whose workers' compensation exemption certificate is on file fails to include recertification when renewing. The board rejects the renewal. How many days after rejection notice does the licensee have to still qualify for a retroactive renewal?
question_cn: 如果持牌人的工人赔偿豁免证书已在档案中，但在续证时未包含重新认证，委员会将拒绝续证。持牌人在收到拒绝通知后多少天内仍可符合追溯续证的条件？

options.en: Within 30 days after rejection notification
options.cn: 收到拒绝通知后30天内

options.en: Within 60 days after rejection notification
options.cn: 收到拒绝通知后60天内

options.en: Within 90 days after rejection notification
options.cn: 收到拒绝通知后90天内

options.en: Within 15 days after rejection notification
options.cn: 收到拒绝通知后15天内

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7125.5(c) grants the licensee 30 days after the board's rejection notice to submit missing documentation and still qualify for retroactive renewal to the postmark date.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7125.5(c)条规定，持牌人在委员会发出拒绝通知后有30天时间提交缺少的文件，仍可符合追溯至邮戳日期的续证条件。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7125.5(c) (Document p. 348, PDF p. 371)

question_en: Which of the following does NOT require a workers' compensation insurance certificate to remain on file with the CSLB?
question_cn: 以下哪项不需要将工伤赔偿保险证明保存在 CSLB 档案中？

options.en: A corporation with only officer-shareholders
options.cn: 仅有官员股东的公司

options.en: An active sole owner with no employees
options.cn: 没有雇员的在职独资经营者

options.en: A self-insured contractor certified by the state
options.cn: 由州政府认证的自保承包商

options.en: A licensee with an inactive license on record
options.cn: 记录上具有非活跃执照的持证人

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7125(c) expressly states that a Certificate of Workers' Compensation Insurance or Self-Insurance is not required of a licensee whose license has been inactivated on the board's official records during the inactive period.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 7125(c) 条明确规定，对于在非活跃期间在委员会官方记录上被列为非活跃的持证人，不要求提供工伤赔偿保险或自保证明。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7125(c) (Document p. 345, PDF p. 368)

question_en: A qualifying individual under B&P Code Section 7068.1 knowingly allows a licensee to operate without workers' compensation coverage. What personal consequence does this qualifier face?
question_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7068.1条，一名合格个人明知许可持有人在没有工伤赔偿保险的情况下运营。该合格人会面临什么个人后果？

options.en: Personal liability for employees' medical claims
options.cn: 员工医疗索赔的个人责任

options.en: Disqualification from serving as a RME for five years
options.cn: 五年内不得担任认证维修工程师（RME）

options.en: Personal misdemeanor criminal liability
options.cn: 个人轻罪刑事责任

options.en: A civil penalty of up to $10,000
options.cn: 高达10,000美元的民事罚款

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7125.4(b) makes the qualifying individual personally guilty of a misdemeanor for committing or failing to prevent acts that are cause for disciplinary action under that section, including coverage lapses.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7125.4(b)条规定，如果合格个人实施或未能阻止导致该条款下纪律处分的行为（包括保险中断），则该合格个人对轻罪行为负有个人责任。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7125.4(b) (Document p. 347, PDF p. 370)

question_en: Under what circumstances will a workers' compensation insurer report a licensee's canceled policy to the CSLB registrar beyond the standard policy reporting requirements?
question_cn: 在什么情况下，工伤赔偿保险公司会向加州承包商执照委员会（CSLB）登记员报告持牌人的已取消保单，超出标准保单报告要求？

options.en: Whenever a licensee fails to pay a premium on time
options.cn: 每当持牌人未按时支付保费时

options.en: When all three conditions — audit, misrepresentation, and nonreimbursement — are met
options.cn: 当满足所有三个条件——审计、虚假陈述和未偿还——时

options.en: Whenever the insurer cancels a policy for nonpayment
options.cn: 每当保险公司因未付款而取消保单时

options.en: Only when the licensee files a false exemption certificate
options.cn: 仅当持牌人提交虚假豁免证书时

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7125(d)(2) requires all three conditions: the insurer completed a premium audit, a material misrepresentation caused financial harm, and the insured has not reimbursed the insurer.
explanation_cn: 《商务与专业法规》（B&P）第7125(d)(2)条要求满足所有三个条件：保险公司完成了保费审计，重大虚假陈述造成了经济损失，并且被保险人尚未向保险公司偿还款项。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7125(d)(2) (Document p. 345, PDF p. 368)

question_en: A licensee renewal is rejected because workers' compensation classification codes were not reported. The licensee submits the missing codes within 30 days of rejection notice. To what date will the retroactive renewal apply?
question_cn: 由于未报告工伤赔偿分类代码，许可持有人的续证申请被拒。许可持有人在收到拒绝通知后的30天内提交了缺失的代码。追溯续证适用于哪个日期？

options.en: The date the board sent the rejection notice
options.cn: 董事会发送拒绝通知的日期

options.en: The date the board processed the correction
options.cn: 董事会处理更正的日期

options.en: The postmark date of the original renewal submission
options.cn: 原始续证提交的邮戳日期

options.en: The date the missing codes were submitted to the board
options.cn: 向董事会提交缺失代码的日期

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7125.6(b)(2) provides that if the missing classification codes are received within 30 days of rejection notice, the registrar grants a retroactive renewal back to the postmark date of the otherwise acceptable renewal.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7125.6(b)(2)条规定，如果在拒绝通知后30天内收到缺失的分类代码，登记员将授予追溯续证，追溯至原本可接受续证的邮戳日期。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7125.6(b)(2) (Document p. 348, PDF p. 371)

question_en: A door-to-door contractor offers a $3,500 home improvement contract that includes a lien on the homeowner's property as security. What is the legal consequence if the required warning notice is not provided?
question_cn: 上门承包商提供一份价值 3,500 美元的家庭装修合同，其中包括作为担保的房主财产留置权。如果未提供所需的警告通知，法律后果是什么？

options.en: The homeowner may rescind within 30 days
options.cn: 房主可以在 30 天内撤销合同

options.en: The entire contract is void and unenforceable
options.cn: 整个合同无效且无法执行

options.en: The contractor faces a $1,000 administrative penalty
options.cn: 承包商面临 1,000 美元的行政处罚

options.en: The security interest is void and unenforceable
options.cn: 担保权益无效且无法执行

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7159.1(a) states that a security interest created in a door-to-door home improvement contract that does not provide the required warning notice shall be void and unenforceable.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 7159.1(a) 条规定，如果上门家庭装修合同未提供所需的警告通知，则在该合同中创设的担保权益无效且无法执行。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7159.1(a) (Document p. 385, PDF p. 408)

question_en: Under California law, what is the maximum value of a home improvement contract for which a contractor is prohibited from taking a security interest in the homeowner's real property?
question_cn: 根据加利福尼亚州法律，承包商被禁止在房主的房地产上取得担保权益的家庭装修合同的最高金额是多少？

options.en: $1,000 or less
$2,500 or less
$500 or less
options.cn: $500 或以下

options.en: $5,000 or less

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7159.2(a) provides that no home improvement goods or services contract of a value of $5,000 or less shall provide for a security interest in real property. Any lien in violation is void and unenforceable.
explanation_cn: 《商业与专业法规》第7159.2(a)条规定，任何价值 $5,000 或以下的家庭装修商品或服务合同不得为房地产提供担保权益。任何违反该规定的留置权均无效且不可执行。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7159.2(a) (Document p. 386, PDF p. 409)

question_en: A contractor intentionally violates the security interest provisions of B&P Code Section 7159.2. In addition to actual damages, what additional penalty may be imposed?
question_cn: 承包商故意违反《加州商业与职业法典》第7159.2条的担保权益规定。除实际损害赔偿外，还可以施加哪些额外处罚？

options.en: Forfeiture of all amounts paid under the contract
options.cn: 没收合同支付的所有款项

options.en: Three times the contract price for the improvement
options.cn: 家庭装修合同价格的三倍

options.en: License revocation and a $5,000 civil penalty
options.cn: 吊销执照并处以5,000美元的民事罚款

options.en: Twice the actual damages suffered by the borrower
options.cn: 借款人实际损失的两倍

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7159.2(d) provides that any person who intentionally or as a pattern or practice violates this section shall be additionally liable for three times the contract price for the home improvement.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7159.2(d)条规定，任何故意或以惯例方式违反此条款的人，应另外承担家庭装修合同价格的三倍责任。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7159.2(d) (Document p. 386, PDF p. 409)

question_en: A Mechanics Lien Warning notice in a home improvement contract advises that a subcontractor can send a Preliminary Notice up to how many days after starting work?
question_cn: 在家庭装修合同中，工程留置权警告通知提醒分包商可以在开工后多少天内发送初步通知？

options.en: Up to 15 days after starting work
options.cn: 开工后最多 15 天内

options.en: Up to 20 days after starting work
options.cn: 开工后最多 20 天内

options.en: Up to 10 days after starting work
options.cn: 开工后最多 10 天内

options.en: Up to 30 days after starting work
options.cn: 开工后最多 30 天内

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7159(e)(4) includes the statement that the Preliminary Notice can be sent up to 20 days after the subcontractor starts work or the supplier provides material, warning owners not to pay before receiving these notices.
explanation_cn: B&P 代码第 7159(e)(4) 条包括声明，初步通知可以在分包商开始工作或供应商提供材料后最多 20 天内发送，警告业主在收到这些通知之前不要付款。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7159(e)(4) (Document p. 379, PDF p. 402)

question_en: A contractor fails to furnish a lien release to a homeowner who requested one after making a progress payment. What may the homeowner legally do?
question_cn: 承包商在收取阶段性付款后，未向要求的业主提供留置权解除声明。业主在法律上可以做什么？

options.en: Record a lien against the contractor's bond
options.cn: 对承包商的保证金登记留置权

options.en: File an immediate complaint with CSLB only
options.cn: 仅向加州承包商州许可委员会（CSLB）提交即时投诉

options.en: Withhold all further payments until releases are furnished
options.cn: 在收到解除声明前，暂停所有后续付款

options.en: Terminate the contract and seek a full refund
options.cn: 终止合同并寻求全额退款

explanation_en: Section 7159.5(a)(6) expressly states that the person contracting for home improvement may withhold all further payments until the contractor obtains and furnishes a full and unconditional lien release for the work already paid for.
explanation_cn: 第7159.5(a)(6)条明确规定，合同方可以在承包商为已付款工作获得并提供完整无条件的留置权解除声明之前，暂停所有后续付款。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7159.5(a)(6) (Document p. 387, PDF p. 410)

question_en: Under B&P Code Section 7164, a single-family dwelling construction contract must include a Mechanics Lien Warning. According to that warning, how soon after starting work may a subcontractor send a Preliminary Notice to the owner?
question_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7164条，对于单户住宅的建筑合同必须包含工程留置权警告。根据该警告，分包商在开始工作后多久可以向业主发送初步通知？

options.en: Up to 7 days after starting work
options.cn: 工作开始后最多7天

options.en: Up to 20 days after starting work
options.cn: 工作开始后最多20天

options.en: Up to 15 days after starting work
options.cn: 工作开始后最多15天

options.en: Up to 10 days after starting work
options.cn: 工作开始后最多10天

explanation_en: The Mechanics Lien Warning required by B&P Code Section 7164(b)(4) advises owners that a Preliminary Notice can be sent up to 20 days after the subcontractor starts work or the supplier provides material.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7164(b)(4)条要求的工程留置权警告建议业主，分包商在开始工作或供应商提供材料后最多可在20天内发送初步通知。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7164(b)(4) (Document p. 402, PDF p. 425)

question_en: After a homeowner makes a partial payment on a home improvement contract, they request a lien release for the portion paid. What must the contractor do?
question_cn: 当房主对房屋改进合同进行部分付款后，他们请求对已支付的部分解除留置权。承包商必须做什么？

options.en: File a conditional lien waiver with the county recorder
options.cn: 向县记录员提交有条件留置权豁免

options.en: Provide a release only after final payment is received
options.cn: 仅在收到最后付款后提供解除

options.en: Obtain and furnish a full unconditional lien release for that portion
options.cn: 获取并提供该部分工作全额无条件留置权解除

options.en: Provide the release within 30 days of the request
options.cn: 在请求后的30天内提供解除

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7159(a)(11) states that upon any payment by the buyer, the contractor shall, if requested, obtain and furnish a full and unconditional release from any potential lien claimant for the portion of work for which payment has been made.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7159(a)(11)条规定，在买方进行任何付款时，如有请求，承包商应获取并提供针对已支付部分工作的任何潜在留置权申索人的全额无条件解除。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7159(a)(11) (Document p. 397, PDF p. 420)

question_en: When bearer bonds are submitted as security in lieu of a contractor's bond, by how much must the bid price of those bonds exceed the required surety amount?
question_cn: 当票据债券作为承包商保证金的替代品提交作为担保时，这些债券的投标价格必须超过所需保证金额多少？

options.en: At least 10% in excess of the required amount
options.cn: 至少比所需金额多出10%

options.en: At least 15% in excess of the required amount
options.cn: 至少比所需金额多出15%

options.en: At least 25% in excess of the required amount
options.cn: 至少比所需金额多出25%

options.en: At least 50% in excess of the required amount
options.cn: 至少比所需金额多出50%

explanation_en: Per CCR Section 856(c)(3), the bid price of bearer bonds, as recorded on the first day of the submission month, must be at least 25% in excess of the surety bond or cash deposit amount required.
explanation_cn: 根据《CCR》第856(c)(3)条，票据债券的投标价格（按提交月份的第一天记录）必须至少比所需的保证金或现金存款金额多出25%。
code_reference: CCR Title 16, Section 856(c)(3); B&P Code Section 7071.12 (Document p. 454, PDF p. 477)

question_en: A large publicly-traded contractor classified as a 'large accelerated filer' by the U.S. SEC applies for a capped blanket performance and payment bond. What is the required bond amount?
question_cn: 一家被美国证券交易委员会（SEC）归类为“大型加速申报人”的上市大型承包商申请设有上限的综合履约和付款保函。所需的保函金额是多少？

options.en: $2 million
options.cn: 200万美元

options.en: $1 million
options.cn: 100万美元

options.en: $5 million
options.cn: 500万美元

options.en: $10 million
options.cn: 1000万美元

explanation_en: Per CCR Section 858.1(c)(1), a licensee or parent company classified as a 'large accelerated filer' by the U.S. SEC must maintain a capped blanket bond of $10 million.
explanation_cn: 根据CCR第858.1(c)(1)条，持证人或母公司若被美国证券交易委员会归类为“大型加速申报人”，必须维持1000万美元的上限综合保函。
code_reference: CCR Title 16, Section 858.1(c)(1); B&P Code Section 7159.5 (Document p. 456, PDF p. 479)

question_en: A licensee approved for a capped blanket bond submits a Form 10-K to the SEC. Within how many days must a copy also be submitted to the CSLB Registrar?
question_cn: 获准使用封顶综合保证金的持牌人向美国证券交易委员会（SEC）提交Form 10-K。副本必须在多少天内提交给加州承包商执照委员会（CSLB）注册主任？

options.en: Within 10 days of filing with the SEC
options.cn: 在向SEC提交后的10天内

options.en: Within 60 days of the fiscal year end
options.cn: 在财政年度结束后的60天内

options.en: Within 20 days of filing with the SEC
options.cn: 在向SEC提交后的20天内

options.en: Within 30 days of filing with the SEC
options.cn: 在向SEC提交后的30天内

explanation_en: Per CCR Section 858.1(b)(2), after the initial filing, a copy of any subsequent Form 10-K must be submitted to the Registrar within 10 days of filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州行政法规》第858.1(b)(2)条，在首次提交之后，任何后续Form 10-K的副本必须在向美国证券交易委员会提交后的10天内提交给注册主任。
code_reference: CCR Title 16, Section 858.1(b)(2) (Document p. 456, PDF p. 479)

question_en: A blanket bond licensee approved under the capped schedule has a net worth that must equal at least what multiple of the approved blanket bond amount?
question_cn: 在限额计划下获批的综合保证金持证人的净资产至少必须等于批准的综合保证金额的多少倍？

options.en: At least 20 times the blanket bond amount
options.cn: 至少为综合保证金额的 20 倍

options.en: At least 3 times the blanket bond amount
options.cn: 至少为综合保证金额的 3 倍

options.en: At least 10 times the blanket bond amount
options.cn: 至少为综合保证金额的 10 倍

options.en: At least 5 times the blanket bond amount
options.cn: 至少为综合保证金额的 5 倍

explanation_en: Per CCR Section 858.1(b)(3), the net worth of the applicable firm must, initially and annually thereafter, be not less than 10 times the sum of the blanket bond as determined by the Registrar.
explanation_cn: 根据 CCR 第 858.1(b)(3) 条，适用公司的净资产在初次及此后每年不得少于由登记主任确定的综合保证金总额的 10 倍。
code_reference: CCR Title 16, Section 858.1(b)(3) (Document p. 456, PDF p. 479)

question_en: A contractor applying for blanket bond approval has been actively licensed in California for 18 months. What happens to the application?
question_cn: 申请总保证金批准的承包商在加利福尼亚州已积极持照18个月。申请将如何处理？

options.en: It is accepted with a conditional approval status
options.cn: 它以有条件批准状态被接受

options.en: It is accepted after paying an additional filing fee
options.cn: 在支付额外申请费后被接受

options.en: It is rejected; active licensure of two years is required
options.cn: 被拒绝；需要至少两年的有效执照

options.en: It is accepted if the CPA financial review is satisfactory
options.cn: 如果注册会计师财务审查令人满意，则被接受

explanation_en: Section 858.2(b) states a licensee must be actively licensed for not less than two years prior to submitting the application. At 18 months, the contractor does not qualify and the application cannot be accepted.
explanation_cn: 第858.2(b)条规定，申请人提交申请前必须持有至少两年的有效执照。持照18个月的承包商不符合条件，申请无法被接受。
code_reference: 16 CCR Section 858.2(b) (Document p. 461, PDF p. 484)

question_en: When a qualifier who executed the blanket bond certification statement disassociates from a licensee, within how many days must a new qualifier file a replacement certification statement?
question_cn: 当执行了总保证书认证声明的合格人不再与持证人关联时，新合格人必须在多少天内提交替代认证声明？

options.en: Within 120 days of the disassociation date
options.cn: 在解除关联日期后的120天内

options.en: Within 30 days of the disassociation date
options.cn: 在解除关联日期后的30天内

options.en: Within 90 days of the disassociation date
options.cn: 在解除关联日期后的90天内

options.en: Within 60 days of the disassociation date
options.cn: 在解除关联日期后的60天内

explanation_en: Section 858.7(a)(3) requires the replacement qualifier's certification statement to be filed within 90 days of the date the former qualifier disassociated, as noted on the official license record.
explanation_cn: 第858.7(a)(3)条要求替代合格人的认证声明必须在前合格人解除关联之日起90天内提交，如官方许可证记录所示。
code_reference: 16 CCR Section 858.7(a)(3) (Document p. 465, PDF p. 488)

question_en: A licensee receives a Registrar's order to increase the dollar amount of its blanket bond. If the licensee ignores the order, what is the consequence after 30 days?
question_cn: 执照持有人收到注册主任的命令，要求增加其综合保证金的金额。如果执照持有人无视该命令，30天后会有何后果？

options.en: The Registrar rescinds approval of the blanket bond
options.cn: 注册主任撤销对综合保证金的批准

options.en: The Registrar imposes a fine on the licensee
options.cn: 注册主任对执照持有人处以罚款

options.en: The Registrar suspends the contractor's license immediately
options.cn: 注册主任立即暂停承包商的执照

options.en: The Registrar files a complaint with the Attorney General
options.cn: 注册主任向总检察长提交投诉

explanation_en: Section 858.6(c) states that if a licensee fails to comply within 30 days of the order, the Registrar shall rescind approval of the blanket bond under Section 858.8.
explanation_cn: 第858.6(c)条规定，如果执照持有人在收到命令后的30天内未能遵守，注册主任应根据第858.8条撤销对综合保证金的批准。
code_reference: 16 CCR Section 858.6(c) (Document p. 464, PDF p. 487)

question_en: A contractor's blanket bond is cancelled by the surety. What happens to the Registrar's approval of the bond?
question_cn: 承包商的总保证金被担保人取消。注册主任对保证金的批准会发生什么变化？

options.en: Approval is rescinded only after a hearing is held
options.cn: 仅在举行听证会后，批准才会被撤销

options.en: Approval is rescinded automatically on the cancellation date
options.cn: 批准在取消日期自动被撤销

options.en: Approval continues for 30 days after cancellation
options.cn: 取消后批准继续有效30天

options.en: The licensee must notify the Registrar within 10 days
options.cn: 持证人必须在10天内通知注册主任

explanation_en: Section 858.8(e) states that upon cancellation of the blanket bond, the Registrar's approval shall be automatically rescinded effective on the date of the cancellation.
explanation_cn: 第858.8(e)条规定，在总保证金被取消时，注册主任的批准应在取消日期自动撤销。
code_reference: 16 CCR Section 858.8(e) (Document p. 466, PDF p. 489)

question_en: A licensee's blanket bond approval is about to be rescinded by the Registrar. What is the minimum advance notice the licensee must receive before the rescission takes effect?
question_cn: 注册主任即将撤销持证人的统一保证金批准。撤销生效前，持证人必须收到的最少提前通知时间是多少？

options.en: Not less than 30 days prior notice
options.cn: 不少于 30 天的提前通知

options.en: Not less than 60 days prior notice
options.cn: 不少于 60 天的提前通知

options.en: Not less than 45 days prior notice
options.cn: 不少于 45 天的提前通知

options.en: Not less than 90 days prior notice
options.cn: 不少于 90 天的提前通知

explanation_en: Section 858.8(d) requires the licensee be given not less than 30 days notice prior to the effective date of the rescission, during which the licensee may file a written appeal.
explanation_cn: 第 858.8(d) 条要求在撤销生效日期前至少给予持证人 30 天的通知，在此期间持证人可以提交书面申诉。
code_reference: 16 CCR Section 858.8(d) (Document p. 466, PDF p. 489)

question_en: The Registrar orders an audit of a licensee's blanket bond. The licensee requests more preparation time. What is the maximum additional time the Registrar may grant?
question_cn: 注册主任下令对持证人的总保证金进行审计。持证人请求更多准备时间。注册主任最多可以批准多少额外时间？

options.en: An additional 30 days to prepare
options.cn: 额外30天准备时间

options.en: An additional 60 days to prepare
options.cn: 额外60天准备时间

options.en: An additional 15 days to prepare
options.cn: 额外15天准备时间

options.en: An additional 90 days to prepare
options.cn: 额外90天准备时间

explanation_en: Section 858.5(a)(1) states that upon written request, the Registrar may grant the licensee an additional 30 days to prepare for the audit beyond the original 30-day notice period.
explanation_cn: 第858.5(a)(1)条规定，经书面请求，注册主任可以在原本30天通知期的基础上，给予持证人额外30天的审计准备时间。
code_reference: 16 CCR Section 858.5(a)(1) (Document p. 463, PDF p. 486)

question_en: A licensee's application for blanket bond approval is submitted, but one of the home improvement salespersons registered to the licensee was recently named in a disciplinary action subject to disclosure under B&P Code Section 7124.6(e)(2). Under what condition may the application still be considered?
question_cn: 持牌人的全面保证金批准申请已提交，但最近一名注册在该持牌人名下的家庭装修销售员在纪律处分中被提及，需要根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7124.6(e)(2)条公开。在什么情况下申请仍可被考虑？

options.en: The salesperson terminates employment before the hearing
options.cn: 该销售员在听证会前终止雇佣关系

options.en: The person is listed on an active license for three consecutive violation-free years after the disciplinary order
options.cn: 在纪律处分命令后，该人员在连续三年内未有违规并保持有效执照

options.en: The licensee posts an additional individual bond
options.cn: 持牌人提交额外的个人保证金

options.en: The Board grants a waiver at its next scheduled meeting
options.cn: 委员会在下次计划会议上批准豁免

explanation_en: Section 858.2(c)(1) allows application if the affected person, after the effective date of the most recent disciplinary order, is listed on an active license for three consecutive years with no further disciplinary violations.
explanation_cn: 第858.2(c)(1)条规定，如果受影响人员在最近一次纪律处分命令生效日期之后，连续三年持有效执照且无进一步纪律违规，则申请可以被考虑。
code_reference: 16 CCR Section 858.2(c)(1); B&P Code Section 7124.6 (Document p. 461, PDF p. 484)

question_en: When must a licensee maintaining a blanket bond submit the qualifier's certification statement to the Registrar?
question_cn: 持有综合保证金的持证人必须在何时向注册主任提交资格人认证声明？

options.en: Every three years, aligned with the bond term
options.cn: 每三年一次，与保证金期限一致

options.en: Quarterly, with each financial report filing
options.cn: 每季度一次，随每次财务报告提交

options.en: Biennially, no later than the license expiration date
options.cn: 每两年一次，不迟于执照到期日

options.en: Annually, on January 1 each year
options.cn: 每年一次，每年的1月1日

explanation_en: Section 858.4(a)(1) and (b) require biennially submission of the certification statement, with the due date coinciding with each license renewal period -- no later than the license expiration date.
explanation_cn: 第858.4(a)(1)和(b)条要求每两年提交一次认证声明，提交日期与每次执照续期周期一致——不迟于执照到期日。
code_reference: 16 CCR Section 858.4(a)(1) and (b) (Document p. 462, PDF p. 485)

question_en: A licensee files a timely written appeal of the Registrar's decision to rescind blanket bond approval. What effect does the timely appeal have on the rescission's effective date?
question_cn: 持证人对注册主任撤销统一保证金批准的决定提交及时的书面上诉。及时上诉对撤销的生效日期有什么影响？

options.en: The rescission is permanently withdrawn pending a hearing
options.cn: 撤销在听证会进行期间被永久撤回

options.en: The rescission proceeds on the original effective date
options.cn: 撤销按原生效日期进行

options.en: The rescission is delayed 30 days beyond the appeal date
options.cn: 撤销自上诉日期起延迟30天

options.en: The effective date is delayed until a decision is issued
options.cn: 生效日期延迟，直到作出决定为止

explanation_en: Section 858.8(d) states that if the rescission is timely appealed, the effective date is delayed until a decision on the appeal is issued by the Registrar.
explanation_cn: 第858.8(d)条规定，如果撤销及时上诉，生效日期将延迟，直到注册主任就上诉作出决定为止。
code_reference: 16 CCR Section 858.8(d) (Document p. 466, PDF p. 489)

question_en: The blanket bond's surety aggregate liability for all contracts is described under the bond's express conditions. Which statement correctly describes this limitation?
question_cn: 担保总责任（对所有合同的担保责任总额）在保函的明确条款中有所描述。哪一项陈述正确描述了此限制？

options.en: Aggregate liability resets annually each calendar year
options.cn: 总责任每个日历年重新计算

options.en: Aggregate liability is capped at the bond's stated dollar amount
options.cn: 总责任以保函所列金额为上限

options.en: Each contract carries separate unlimited surety liability
options.cn: 每份合同的担保责任各自无限制

options.en: Surety liability is limited to the single largest contract
options.cn: 担保责任仅限于单个最大合同

explanation_en: The bond's express conditions state that even if the bond is in effect for more than one year, the surety's aggregate liability for all contracts covered shall in no event exceed the amount set forth on the bond.
explanation_cn: 保函的明确条款规定，即使保函有效期超过一年，担保方对所涵盖所有合同的总担保责任在任何情况下也不得超过保函上规定的金额。
code_reference: 16 CCR Section 858.1; B&P Code Section 7159.5 (Document p. 458, PDF p. 481)

question_en: Under CSLB regulations, is Commercial General Liability insurance required for home improvement contractors?
question_cn: 根据CSLB规定，住宅装修承包商是否需要商业综合责任保险？

options.en: Yes, but only for contracts exceeding $500
options.cn: 是的，但仅适用于合同金额超过500美元的情况

options.en: No, and no disclosure is required for bids
options.cn: 否，而且投标时无需披露

options.en: Yes, it is mandatory for all home improvement work
options.cn: 是的，所有住宅装修工作都必须有

options.en: No, but contractors must disclose their coverage status
options.cn: 否，但承包商必须披露其保险状态

explanation_en: Under B&P Code Section 7159.3 and Regulation 872, CGL insurance is not required. However, contractors must provide written disclosure of whether or not they carry it with every bid and home improvement contract.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7159.3条和第872号法规，不要求提供CGL保险。然而，承包商必须在每个投标和住宅装修合同中以书面形式披露是否持有该保险。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7159.3; CSLB Regulation 872 (Document p. 513, PDF p. 536)

question_en: Which of the following best describes the lien position of a PACE assessment relative to other liens on a property?
question_cn: 以下哪一项最能描述PACE评估在物业其他留置权中的留置权位置？

options.en: It is subordinate to all existing mortgage liens on the property
options.cn: 它从属于该物业上所有现有的抵押留置权

options.en: It is treated as a personal debt of the property owner only
options.cn: 它仅被视为物业所有人的个人债务

options.en: It is a voluntary contractual assessment that runs with the property
options.cn: 它是一种随物业转移的自愿合同评估

options.en: It has no lien status until the improvements are completed
options.cn: 在改进完成之前，它没有留置权地位

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22015 defines a PACE assessment as a voluntary contractual assessment, voluntary special tax, or special tax imposed on real property. Because it is a property assessment, it attaches to and runs with the property, giving it lien priority similar to property taxes.
explanation_cn: 《金融法》第22015条将PACE评估定义为自愿合同评估、自愿特别税或施加在不动产上的特别税。由于它是物业评估，它附着于物业并随物业转移，使其拥有类似于物业税的留置权优先权。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22015

question_en: A PACE assessment is recorded against a property. A prospective buyer's lender discovers the assessment during title review. What is the most significant risk this creates for a contractor who installed the improvement?
question_cn: 对房产进行了PACE评估。潜在买方的贷款机构在产权审查过程中发现了该评估。这对安装该改进措施的承包商造成的最重大风险是什么？

options.en: The sale may be delayed or the assessment paid off first
options.cn: 销售可能会被延迟，或者评估需要先被支付

options.en: The contractor's CSLB license is automatically and immediately revoked
options.cn: 承包商的CSLB执照会被自动且立即吊销

options.en: The contractor must refund payment already received for the work
options.cn: 承包商必须退还已收到的工程款

options.en: The contractor must re-install the improvements at no charge
options.cn: 承包商必须免费重新安装改进措施

explanation_en: Because Section 22003.5 establishes the PACE assessment as a contractual obligation running with the real property, a lender or buyer may require the assessment to be paid off at or before close of escrow, potentially delaying the sale and exposing the homeowner to unexpected costs related to the contractor's PACE-financed work.
explanation_cn: 因为第22003.5条规定PACE评估为随房地产转让的合同义务，贷款人或买方可能要求在托管结束时或之前支付评估，这可能导致销售延迟，并使房主承担与承包商通过PACE融资的工程相关的意外费用。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22003.5

question_en: Under California Financial Code Section 22684, which condition must be met before a program administrator may execute an assessment contract on a property?
question_cn: 根据加利福尼亚州《金融法》第22684条，在项目管理员可以对一处房产执行评估合约之前，必须满足哪个条件？

options.en: The homeowner has held title for more than six months
options.cn: 房主已持有房产所有权超过六个月

options.en: The property has no outstanding voluntary liens of any amount
options.cn: 房产没有任何未结清的自愿留置权

options.en: All property taxes on the subject property are current
options.cn: 该房产的所有房产税均已缴清

options.en: The homeowner has lived there for at least two years
options.cn: 房主在该房产居住至少两年

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22684(a) expressly requires that all property taxes for the property subject to the assessment contract are current before the contract may be executed.
explanation_cn: 《金融法》第22684(a)条明确要求，在可以执行评估合约之前，该合同所涉房产的所有房产税必须缴清。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22684

question_en: A property owner applying for PACE financing has an outstanding involuntary lien of $1,200 recorded against their property. What is the effect on the assessment contract?
question_cn: 申请PACE融资的房产所有者其房产上有一笔未支付的强制留置权，金额为1,200美元。对评估合同有什么影响？

options.en: Only work may commence, but the contract cannot be signed
options.cn: 只能开始施工，但不能签署合同

options.en: The contract may proceed after the owner signs a waiver
options.cn: 在所有者签署放弃书后，合同可以继续

options.en: The contract may still be executed at the administrator's discretion
options.cn: 合同仍可由管理员自行决定执行

options.en: No work may commence and the contract cannot be executed
options.cn: 不能开始施工，也不能执行合同

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22684(b) prohibits execution of the assessment contract and commencement of any work when a recorded, outstanding involuntary lien exceeds $1,000, as is the case here.
explanation_cn: 财务法典第22684(b)条禁止在已记录、未支付且超过1,000美元的强制留置权情况下执行评估合同和开始任何工作，当前情况即如此。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22684

question_en: A property owner tells the program administrator about existing PACE assessments but fails to disclose a newly authorized but unrecorded PACE assessment. What is the legal effect on the new assessment contract?
question_cn: 一位物业所有者向项目管理员报告现有的PACE评估，但未能披露新批准但未登记的PACE评估。对此新的评估合同的法律效力是什么？

options.en: The program administrator bears sole liability for the undisclosed amount
options.cn: 项目管理员对未披露的金额承担唯一责任

options.en: The undisclosed assessment automatically receives subordinate lien priority
options.cn: 未披露的评估自动获得从属留置权优先权

options.en: The contract is void and the contractor must stop all work immediately
options.cn: 合同无效，承包商必须立即停止所有工作

options.en: The contract remains valid despite exceeding financing thresholds
options.cn: 尽管超过融资阈值，合同仍然有效

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22684(k) specifically provides that the property owner's failure to disclose authorized but unrecorded PACE assessments does not invalidate the assessment contract or its obligations, even if the combined amounts exceed the thresholds in subdivisions (h) or (i).
explanation_cn: 《金融法典》第22684(k)条明确规定，物业所有者未能披露已授权但未登记的PACE评估不会使评估合同或其义务无效，即使合计金额超过(h)或(i)款中的阈值。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22684

question_en: Under California Financial Code Section 22684, a PACE assessment contract may not be executed on a property that is subject to which of the following?
question_cn: 根据加利福尼亚财务法典第22684条，PACE评估合同不得在下列哪种情况下对某物业执行？

options.en: A conventional fixed-rate first mortgage with any remaining balance
options.cn: 拥有任何未偿余额的常规固定利率第一抵押贷款

options.en: An existing PACE assessment that has been fully paid off
options.cn: 已完全偿清的现有PACE评估

options.en: A reverse mortgage as defined in Civil Code Section 1923
options.cn: 根据民法典第1923条定义的反向抵押贷款

options.en: A second mortgage originated within the prior 12 months
options.cn: 过去12个月内发起的第二抵押贷款

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22684(m) expressly prohibits execution of a PACE assessment contract on a property that is subject to a reverse mortgage as defined in Civil Code Section 1923.
explanation_cn: 财务法典第22684(m)条明确禁止在根据民法典第1923条定义的反向抵押贷款下对物业执行PACE评估合同。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22684

question_en: A PACE contractor's license is revoked after completing several assessment-financed projects. Which of the following is true regarding the homeowners' existing PACE contracts?
question_cn: 当PACE承包商在完成多个评估资助的项目后，其执照被吊销。关于业主现有的PACE合同，下列哪项是正确的？

options.en: Homeowners may cancel their assessments without penalty
options.cn: 业主可以取消他们的评估而不受处罚

options.en: Assessments are placed in escrow pending reinstatement of the license
options.cn: 在执照恢复期间，评估款将被托管

options.en: Existing PACE contracts are voided and assessments must be refunded
options.cn: 现有的PACE合同作废，评估款必须退还

options.en: Existing PACE contracts remain valid and fully enforceable
options.cn: 现有的PACE合同仍然有效并完全可执行

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22716(a) states that revocation, suspension, expiration, or surrender of a license does not impair or affect the obligation of any preexisting lawful PACE assessment contract between the licensee and a property owner.
explanation_cn: 财务法第22716(a)条规定，执照的吊销、暂停、到期或交回，不会削弱或影响执照持有人与业主之间任何已存在合法PACE评估合同的义务。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22716

question_en: An employer discovers that a subcontractor's employees may be exposed to lead in a regulated area on a multi-contractor jobsite. What must the lead compliance program specifically address regarding these workers?
question_cn: 雇主发现分包商的员工可能在一个多承包商施工现场的受管制区域中接触到铅。这些工人的铅合规计划必须具体涉及哪些内容？

options.en: Proof that subcontractors carry their own lead liability insurance
options.cn: 分包商具有自己铅责任保险的证明

options.en: Arrangements for informing affected employees of potential lead exposure
options.cn: 安排告知受影响员工潜在的铅暴露情况

options.en: Only the general contractor's employees need lead compliance documentation
options.cn: 只有总承包商的员工需要铅合规文件

options.en: Written consent from subcontractor employees before entering the area
options.cn: 分包商员工进入该区域前的书面同意

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1532.1(e)(2)(B)8. requires the written compliance program to describe arrangements made among contractors on multi-contractor sites to inform affected employees of potential lead exposure and of regulated areas, ensuring all workers are protected regardless of employer.
explanation_cn: 8 CCR §1532.1(e)(2)(B)8. 要求书面合规计划描述在多承包商现场之间为告知受影响员工潜在铅暴露和受管制区域而做的安排，确保所有工人都受到保护，无论其雇主是谁。

question_en: Under AB 1327 (effective January 1, 2026), what new cancellation right is a home improvement contract buyer granted?
question_cn: 根据 AB 1327（自 2026 年 1 月 1 日生效），家庭装修合同买方获得了什么新的取消权利？

options.en: Cancel in person at a CSLB district office
options.cn: 亲自到 CSLB 区办事处取消

options.en: Cancel verbally by calling the contractor's number
options.cn: 拨打承包商电话口头取消

options.en: Cancel via email using the contractor's address
options.cn: 使用承包商的电子邮件地址通过电子邮件取消

options.en: Cancel by certified mail within 72 hours
options.cn: 通过挂号信在 72 小时内取消

explanation_en: AB 1327 amends B&P §7159 and Civil Code §1689.6 to require the contractor's email address in the HIC and expressly allow the buyer to cancel the contract by email.
explanation_cn: AB 1327 修改了 B&P 第 7159 条和民法第 1689.6 条，要求在 HIC 中提供承包商的电子邮件地址，并明确允许买方通过电子邮件取消合同。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7159; Civil Code Sections 1689.6 and 1689.7, as amended by AB 1327 (Document p. -10, PDF p. 13)

question_en: Under SB 517, a homeowner asks a prime contractor which subcontractors will work on their kitchen remodel. Which information must the contractor provide?
question_cn: 根据 SB 517，一位房主询问总承包商他们的厨房改造中将会有哪几位分包商参与工作。承包商必须提供哪些信息？

options.en: Subcontractor name, contact info, license number, and classification
options.cn: 分包商姓名、联系方式、执照号码和执照类别

options.en: Nothing, unless it is listed in the written contract
options.cn: 不提供任何信息，除非在书面合同中有列明

options.en: Subcontractor name and license number only
options.cn: 仅提供分包商姓名和执照号码

options.en: Subcontractor name and bid amount only
options.cn: 仅提供分包商姓名和报价金额

explanation_en: B&P §7159, as amended by SB 517, requires disclosure of the subcontractor's name, contact information, license number, and license classification upon consumer request.
explanation_cn: 根据 B&P §7159（经 SB 517 修订），在消费者要求时，必须披露分包商的姓名、联系方式、执照号码和执照分类。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7159, as amended by SB 517 (Document p. -9, PDF p. 14)

question_en: A home improvement contractor receives a $15,000 signed contract. What is the maximum allowable down payment the contractor may collect before work begins?
question_cn: 一名家庭装修承包商收到了一份价值15,000美元的签署合同。承包商在开工前最多可以收取多少定金？

options.en: $1,500, which is 10% of the contract
options.cn: 1,500美元，即合同金额的10%

options.en: $2,000, as agreed upon by both parties
options.cn: 2,000美元，经双方同意

options.en: $1,000, the statutory maximum for this contract size
options.cn: 1,000美元，此合同金额的法定最高限额

options.en: 25% of the total contract price
options.cn: 合同总价的25%

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7159 limits the down payment to $1,000 or 10% of the contract price, whichever is less. For a $15,000 contract, 10% is $1,500, so $1,000 applies as the lesser amount.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7159条将定金限制为1,000美元或合同金额的10%，以较低者为准。对于15,000美元的合同，10%为1,500美元，因此适用较低的1,000美元。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7159 (Document p. 12, PDF p. 35)

question_en: A home improvement contract's salesperson is entitled to commission payments. How must these payments be structured relative to the contractor's payment schedule?
question_cn: 家居装修合同的销售员有权获得佣金支付。这些支付必须如何与承包商的付款计划相对应？

options.en: Paid at project completion per agreement with the contractor
options.cn: 根据与承包商的协议，在项目完成时支付

options.en: Paid in full upon contract signing by the buyer
options.cn: 在买方签署合同时一次性支付全额

options.en: Paid on a pro rata basis tied to owner payment schedule
options.cn: 按业主付款计划按比例支付

options.en: Paid equally in two installments regardless of contract terms
options.cn: 无论合同条款如何，均分两期支付

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7159 requires that where a commission is included in the contract price, the salesperson is paid on a pro rata basis in proportion to the schedule of payments made to the contractor by the owner.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7159条规定，如果合同价格中包含佣金，则销售员应按业主向承包商付款的比例按比例支付佣金。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7159 (Document p. 12, PDF p. 35)

question_en: What minimum print typeface size is required for body text in a printed home improvement contract form?
question_cn: 在打印的家庭装修合同表格中，正文所需的最小字体大小是多少？

options.en: 8-point type for body, 10-point for headings
options.cn: 正文 8 磅，标题 10 磅

options.en: 12-point type for body and headings alike
options.cn: 正文和标题均为 12 磅

options.en: 10-point type for body, 10-point boldface for headings
options.cn: 正文 10 磅，标题 10 磅加粗

options.en: 6-point type minimum, at the contractor's discretion
options.cn: 最小 6 磅，由承包商自行决定

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7159 requires that printed home improvement contract forms use at least 10-point typeface for body text and at least 10-point boldface type for headings, unless a larger size is specified.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7159条规定，打印的家庭装修合同表格正文至少使用 10 磅字体，标题至少使用 10 磅加粗字体，除非规定了更大字体。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7159 (Document p. 8, PDF p. 31)

question_en: A home roof warranty is created under a contract dated March 1, 2000. The original homeowner sells the house in 2010. Is the roof warranty enforceable by the new owner?
question_cn: 一份住宅屋顶保修是在2000年3月1日签订的合同下创建的。原房主在2010年出售房屋。新房主能否执行该屋顶保修？

options.en: Yes, unless the contract limits transferability clearly and conspicuously
options.cn: 可以，除非合同明确而明显地限制了可转让性

options.en: No, because the contract predates January 1, 1994
options.cn: 不可以，因为合同早于1994年1月1日

options.en: Yes, but only if the seller formally assigns it in writing
options.cn: 可以，但前提是卖方以书面形式正式转让

options.en: No, home warranties never transfer to subsequent owners
options.cn: 不可以，住宅保修从不转让给后续所有者

explanation_en: Under Civil Code Section 1797.92, for contracts entered on or after January 1, 1994, roof warranties inure to all subsequent purchasers without limitation, unless the contract contains a clear and conspicuous provision limiting transferability.
explanation_cn: 根据民法第1797.92条，对于1994年1月1日或之后签订的合同，屋顶保修对所有后续购买者均有效，除非合同包含限制转让性的明确且显著条款。
code_reference: Civil Code Section 1797.92 (Document p. 9, PDF p. 32)

question_en: Beginning January 1, 2026, what new disclosure obligation applies to home improvement contractors regarding subcontractors?
question_cn: 自2026年1月1日起，家庭装修承包商在涉及分包商方面有哪些新的披露义务？

options.en: Obtain written consent before hiring any subcontractor
options.cn: 在雇用任何分包商之前获得书面同意

options.en: Disclose subcontractor use upon consumer request
options.cn: 应消费者要求披露分包商的使用情况

options.en: Post subcontractor license numbers at the job site
options.cn: 在工作现场张贴分包商的许可证号码

options.en: List all subcontractors in the written contract automatically
options.cn: 在书面合同中自动列出所有分包商

explanation_en: SB 517, effective January 1, 2026, requires disclosure of any subcontractor use upon request by the consumer, including the subcontractor's name, contact information, license number, and classification.
explanation_cn: SB 517 自2026年1月1日起生效，要求在消费者提出请求时披露任何分包商的使用情况，包括分包商的姓名、联系方式、许可证号码和分类。
code_reference: SB 517, effective January 1, 2026 (Document p. 8, PDF p. 31)

question_en: A contractor discovers that their joint control company has offered to give them a small ownership stake as an incentive. What should the contractor do?
question_cn: 一名承包商发现，他们的联合控制公司提出给他们一小部分所有权作为激励。承包商应该怎么做？

options.en: Accept it only if the ownership stake is below 10%
options.cn: 仅在所有权份额低于10%时接受

options.en: Decline; contractors cannot have any interest in the joint control company
options.cn: 拒绝；承包商不能在联合控制公司中拥有任何权益

options.en: Accept it; CSLB must approve joint control arrangements anyway
options.cn: 接受；CSLB 无论如何都必须批准联合控制安排

options.en: Accept it only if disclosed in the home improvement contract
options.cn: 仅在家居改进合同中披露时接受

explanation_en: The B&P Code expressly prohibits contractors who furnish a joint control from having any financial or other interest in the joint control company. The contractor must decline the ownership stake to remain compliant.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》明确禁止提供联合控制的承包商在联合控制公司中拥有任何经济或其他利益。承包商必须拒绝该所有权份额以保持合规。
code_reference: B&P Code Chapter 2, Joint Control Agreements provisions (Document p. 13, PDF p. 36)

question_en: A contractor and owner dispute whether an item is a contract extra or part of the original scope. Which practice would best prevent this type of dispute?
question_cn: 承包商与业主就某项工作是合同额外工作还是原始范围的一部分发生争议。哪种做法最能避免这种类型的争议？

options.en: Resolve the dispute through binding arbitration
options.cn: 通过具有约束力的仲裁解决争议

options.en: Have a clearly written original contract defining scope
options.cn: 拥有清晰书面的原始合同以界定范围

options.en: Refuse to perform any work not in the original bid
options.cn: 拒绝执行原始报价中未包含的任何工作

options.en: Bill separately for all labor and material costs
options.cn: 对所有人工和材料费用单独计费

explanation_en: The source text states that if the original agreement is well defined and in writing, it is much easier to determine whether something is an addition or change to the original scope — preventing disputes about extras.
explanation_cn: 原文指出，如果原始协议定义明确且为书面形式，就更容易确定某项工作是原范围的新增还是变更，从而防止有关额外工作的争议。
code_reference: Source text p. 70 – Disputes: Extras (Document p. 47, PDF p. 70)

question_en: A contractor discovers mid-project that the owner's requested change will add cost and time to the schedule. What does the source text recommend the contractor do immediately?
question_cn: 承包商在项目中途发现业主要求的变更将增加成本和工期。原文建议承包商应立即做什么？

options.en: Negotiate cost and time, then get a signed change order
options.cn: 协商成本和时间，然后获得签字的变更单

options.en: Notify the surety company about the requested change
options.cn: 通知保证公司有关请求的变更

options.en: Complete the work and submit a bill later
options.cn: 完成工作后再提交账单

options.en: Stop all work until a formal amendment is signed
options.cn: 停止所有工作，直到签署正式的修订

explanation_en: The source text states the contractor should immediately negotiate the effect of the change — including cost and time — inform the customer, and ensure both parties sign a written change order before proceeding.
explanation_cn: 原文指出，承包商应立即协商变更的影响——包括成本和时间——通知客户，并确保双方在继续工作前签署书面变更单。
code_reference: Source text p. 70 – Disputes: Extras (Document p. 47, PDF p. 70)

question_en: A contractor wins a monetary judgment in small claims court. Which of the following is a limitation unique to small claims court proceedings?
question_cn: 承包商在小额索赔法庭赢得了金钱判决。以下哪一项是小额索赔法庭程序特有的限制？

options.en: Cases take longer than courts of greater jurisdiction
options.cn: 案件处理时间比更高管辖权的法院更长

options.en: The contractor cannot foreclose a mechanics lien
options.cn: 承包商不能执行工程留置权

options.en: Judgments are not binding on either party
options.cn: 判决对任何一方都不具有约束力

options.en: Neither party may appeal the judgment
options.cn: 双方都不能对判决提出上诉

explanation_en: Per the source text and CCP §116.221, you cannot foreclose on a mechanics lien in small claims court, though you may obtain a monetary judgment of up to $12,500.
explanation_cn: 根据原文和《加州民事诉讼法典》第116.221条，您不能在小额索赔法庭上执行工程留置权，但可以获得最多12,500美元的金钱判决。
code_reference: CCP Section 116.221 (Small Claims Court) (Document p. 48, PDF p. 71)

question_en: A corporation is involved in a contract dispute and wants to represent itself. In which forum may it do so without hiring an attorney?
question_cn: 一家公司卷入合同纠纷，想要自行出庭。在什么法庭上它可以无需聘请律师自行出庭？

options.en: In small claims court only
options.cn: 仅在小额索赔法庭

options.en: In any arbitration proceeding
options.cn: 在任何仲裁程序中

options.en: In CSLB's mandatory arbitration program
options.cn: 在加州承包商州立许可委员会 (CSLB) 的强制仲裁计划中

options.en: In any California Superior Court
options.cn: 在任何加州高级法院

explanation_en: Per the source text, if a contractor is a corporation or LLC, it cannot represent itself in court other than small claims court and must obtain an attorney for all other proceedings.
explanation_cn: 根据原文，如果承包商是公司或有限责任公司 (LLC)，除小额索赔法庭外，它不能自行出庭，必须在所有其他程序中聘请律师。
code_reference: CCP Section 116.540 (Corporate representation in court) (Document p. 50, PDF p. 73)

question_en: A private arbitration clause is included in a construction contract. Which statement correctly describes its effect on CSLB's arbitration program?
question_cn: 建筑合同中包含私人仲裁条款。哪项陈述正确描述了其对加州承包商执照委员会（CSLB）仲裁计划的影响？

options.en: CSLB arbitration is barred unless both parties sign a waiver
options.cn: 除非双方签署放弃权利书，否则禁止使用CSLB仲裁

options.en: CSLB may override the private clause and compel arbitration
options.cn: CSLB可以否决私人条款并强制仲裁

options.en: The parties may still use CSLB arbitration as a backup
options.cn: 双方仍可将CSLB仲裁作为备用

options.en: The private clause applies only to disputes under $25,000
options.cn: 私人条款仅适用于低于25,000美元的争议

explanation_en: Per B&P Code Section 7191, parties who have agreed to a private arbitration clause are not allowed access to CSLB's arbitration program unless both parties later sign a waiver of the contractual arbitration clause.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7191条，已经同意私人仲裁条款的双方不得使用CSLB仲裁计划，除非双方后来签署放弃合同仲裁条款的放弃书。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7191 (Private arbitration notice and CSLB program access) (Document p. 49, PDF p. 72)

question_en: A person unlicensed at the time of performing construction work sues to collect payment. Under B&P Code Section 143, what must the person prove to recover?
question_cn: 在进行施工工作时未持有执照的人提起诉讼以收取报酬。根据《加州商业与职业法典》第143条，该人必须证明什么才能获得赔偿？

options.en: That the work met industry quality standards
options.cn: 工作符合行业质量标准

options.en: That they were duly licensed throughout performance
options.cn: 在整个工作期间，他们持有合法执照

options.en: That substantial compliance with licensing rules occurred
options.cn: 实质上遵守了执照规定

options.en: That the client was aware of the unlicensed status
options.cn: 客户知晓其无执照的状态

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 143 states that no action may be maintained without alleging and proving the person was duly licensed at all times during performance, regardless of the merits of the claim.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第143条规定，无论索赔的理由如何，如果未主张并证明该人在整个工作期间均持有合法执照，则不得提起诉讼。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 143 (Document p. 128, PDF p. 151)

question_en: Under what condition is an agreement resolving a dispute through a county-funded program enforceable in court?
question_cn: 通过县资助的项目解决争议的协议在什么情况下可在法院执行？

options.en: When the neutral mediator certifies the agreement
options.cn: 当中立调解员认证该协议时

options.en: When parties consent or include an enforceability provision
options.cn: 当各方同意或协议中包含可执行条款时

options.en: Only when filed with the superior court
options.cn: 仅在向高级法院备案时

options.en: When the county program director approves it
options.cn: 当县项目主管批准时

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 467.4(a) states that a dispute resolution agreement is not enforceable in court unless the consent of the parties or the agreement itself includes a provision clearly stating the parties' intention that it be enforceable.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第467.4(a)条规定，除非各方同意或协议本身明确包含表明各方意图使其可执行的条款，否则争议解决协议在法院中不可执行。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 467.4(a) (Document p. 158, PDF p. 181)

question_en: A contractor enters a county-funded dispute resolution process but later decides the process is not working. Can the contractor withdraw before a decision is reached?
question_cn: 承包商进入了县政府资助的纠纷解决程序，但后来认为该程序不起作用。承包商可以在做出决定之前退出吗？

options.en: Yes, but only with written consent of the other party
options.cn: 可以，但必须得到另一方的书面同意

options.en: Yes, unless the parties agreed to a binding award
options.cn: 可以，除非双方同意了具有约束力的裁决

options.en: Yes, but only before the first hearing session
options.cn: 可以，但只能在第一次听证会之前

options.en: No, withdrawal is prohibited once proceedings begin
options.cn: 不可以，一旦程序开始禁止退出

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 467.7(a) states that nothing in the chapter prohibits a person who voluntarily entered the process from revoking consent, withdrawing, and seeking judicial or administrative redress — unless a binding award was agreed to.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第467.7(a)条规定，本章中的任何内容均不禁止自愿进入该程序的人撤销同意、退出并寻求司法或行政救济——除非双方同意了具有约束力的裁决。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 467.7(a) (Document p. 159, PDF p. 182)

question_en: Before a dispute resolution proceeding begins, what must a funded program provide to parties intending to participate?
question_cn: 在争议解决程序开始之前，资助的项目必须向打算参与的各方提供什么？

options.en: A written statement in easy-to-read language
options.cn: 一份易于阅读的书面说明

options.en: A copy of the advisory council's rules and regulations
options.cn: 顾问委员会规则和条例的副本

options.en: A signed waiver releasing the program from liability
options.cn: 一份免除项目责任的签署豁免书

options.en: An oral briefing by a certified mediator
options.cn: 由认证调解员进行的口头简报

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 467.3 requires programs to provide persons intending to participate with a written statement prior to the proceeding, in language easy to read and understand, covering the nature of the dispute, the process, rights and obligations, procedures, and binding nature if applicable.
explanation_cn: B&P 代码第467.3条要求，项目在程序开始前必须向打算参与的人提供一份书面说明，采用易于阅读和理解的语言，涵盖争议的性质、程序、权利和义务、流程，以及如适用的约束性。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 467.3 (Document p. 157, PDF p. 180)

question_en: A contractor had his license suspended twice within the past six years and is about to sign a contract for residential remodeling. What disclosure obligation is triggered under B&P Code Section 7030.1?
question_cn: 一名承包商在过去六年中曾两次被吊销执照，并且即将签署住宅改造合同。根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7030.1条，应触发什么披露义务？

options.en: No disclosure required for residential work under $10,000
options.cn: 对低于10,000美元的住宅工程无需披露

options.en: Disclose all violations in the contract body
options.cn: 在合同正文中披露所有违规行为

options.en: Submit a waiver request to CSLB before signing
options.cn: 在签署前向 CSLB 提交豁免申请

options.en: Disclose disciplinary actions in bold or red print
options.cn: 以粗体或红色字体披露纪律处分

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7030.1 requires a contractor with two or more license suspensions or revocations within eight years to disclose those disciplinary actions, prior to contract execution, in capital letters in 10-point bold type or contrasting red print in at least 8-point bold type.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7030.1条规定，承包商在八年内有两次或以上执照被暂停或吊销的，应在签署合同前，以10号粗体大写字母或对比鲜明的红色至少8号粗体字体披露这些纪律处分。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7030.1 (Document p. 234, PDF p. 257)

question_en: A contractor fails to include the required CSLB disclosure statement in a home improvement contract as required by B&P Code Section 7030. What is the consequence?
question_cn: 承包商未能在家庭装修合同中包括《加州商业与职业法典》第7030条所要求的CSLB披露声明。会有什么后果？

options.en: Grounds for disciplinary action against the license
options.cn: 对执照进行纪律处分的理由

options.en: A civil penalty of $1,000 is automatically assessed
options.cn: 自动评估1,000美元的民事罚款

options.en: The homeowner may cancel the contract immediately
options.cn: 房主可以立即取消合同

options.en: The contract is automatically void and unenforceable
options.cn: 合同自动无效且无法执行

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7030(c) expressly states that failure to comply with the notice requirements in subdivisions (a) or (b) is cause for disciplinary action against the contractor's license.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7030(c)条明确指出，未能遵守(a)或(b)小节中的通知要求是对承包商执照进行纪律处分的理由。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7030(c) (Document p. 234, PDF p. 257)

question_en: Under B&P Code Section 7031, an unlicensed contractor sues a homeowner to collect payment for completed work. Which of the following best describes the likely outcome?
question_cn: 根据加利福尼亚商业与职业法典第7031条规定，未经许可的承包商起诉房主以收取已完成工作的付款。以下哪一项最能描述可能的结果？

options.en: The contractor may recover up to $500 for labor costs
options.cn: 承包商可以收回最高500美元的人工费用

options.en: The contractor may recover if work quality was satisfactory
options.cn: 如果工作质量令人满意，承包商可以获得赔偿

options.en: The homeowner must prove contractor was unlicensed
options.cn: 房主必须证明承包商未取得许可

options.en: The contractor cannot recover any compensation
options.cn: 承包商不能获得任何报酬

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7031(a) bars an unlicensed contractor from bringing or maintaining any action to collect compensation, regardless of the merits of the case, if licensure was required during performance.
explanation_cn: 商业与职业法典第7031(a)条规定，如果在施工期间需要许可，未经许可的承包商不得提起或维持任何索取报酬的诉讼，无论案件实质如何。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7031(a) (Document p. 235, PDF p. 258)

question_en: Under B&P Code Section 7031(b), what remedy does a homeowner have after paying an unlicensed contractor for completed work?
question_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7031(b)条，业主在支付未持证承包商完成的工作后，可以有哪些救济措施？

options.en: File a complaint with CSLB for a refund order
options.cn: 向加州承包商州立委员会(CSLB)提交投诉以获得退款命令

options.en: Sue to recover all compensation paid
options.cn: 通过诉讼追回已支付的全部报酬

options.en: Demand the work be undone at the contractor's expense
options.cn: 要求承包商自费撤销工作

options.en: Sue to recover up to 50% of compensation paid
options.cn: 通过诉讼追回最多50%的已支付报酬

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7031(b) expressly allows a person who used an unlicensed contractor to bring a court action to recover all compensation paid for performance of any act or contract requiring a license.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7031(b)条明确允许使用未持证承包商的人提起法院诉讼，以追回为执行任何需要执照的行为或合同所支付的全部报酬。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7031(b) (Document p. 235, PDF p. 258)

question_en: A contractor's third violation of the disciplinary disclosure requirement under B&P Code Section 7030.1 results in which of the following penalties?
question_cn: 根据加州《加州商业与职业法典》第7030.1条规定，承包商第三次违反纪律披露要求将导致以下哪种处罚？

options.en: Immediate revocation of the contractor's license
options.cn: 立即吊销承包商执照

options.en: $5,000 fine and a one-year license suspension
options.cn: 5,000美元罚款并停牌一年

options.en: $5,000 fine with no additional license action
options.cn: 5,000美元罚款但不采取额外的执照措施

options.en: $2,500 fine and a 90-day suspension
options.cn: 2,500美元罚款并停牌90天

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7030.1(c)(3) provides that a third violation of the disclosure requirement results in a $5,000 penalty plus a one-year suspension of the license by operation of law.
explanation_cn: 加州《加州商业与职业法典》第7030.1(c)(3)条规定，第三次违反披露要求将导致法律自动处以5,000美元罚款并停牌一年。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7030.1(c)(3) (Document p. 234, PDF p. 257)

question_en: A specialty contractor wants to subcontract the same type of licensed specialty work to multiple subcontractors on a single project. Under what condition is this permitted?
question_cn: 专业承包商希望在同一项目中将相同类型的持牌专业工作分包给多个分包商。在哪种情况下这是允许的？

options.en: The project owner provides written authorization
options.cn: 项目所有者提供书面授权

options.en: The subcontractor classifies workers as employees, not contractors
options.cn: 分包商将工人分类为雇员，而非承包商

options.en: The general contractor on the project provides approval
options.cn: 项目的总承包商提供批准

options.en: Each subcontractor holds a valid specialty license
options.cn: 每个分包商持有有效的专业执照

explanation_en: Under B&P Code Section 7035(a)(1), a specialty contractor may use more than one same-classification subcontractor if that subcontractor employs persons classified as employees (not independent contractors) to perform the work on the project.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7035(a)(1)条，如果分包商雇用被分类为雇员（而非独立承包商）的人员在项目中执行工作，专业承包商可以使用多个相同分类的分包商。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7035(a) (Document p. 238, PDF p. 261)

question_en: A general building contractor is awarded a prime contract for a project involving only plumbing work. Under what condition may the contractor legally perform this contract?
question_cn: 一般建筑承包商获得一个仅涉及管道工程的项目的总承包合同。在什么情况下，承包商可以合法地履行该合同？

options.en: If the contractor holds a valid B license
options.cn: 如果承包商持有有效的 B 类执照

options.en: If framing or carpentry is also included in the scope
options.cn: 如果项目范围还包括框架或木工

options.en: If the project value is under the threshold requiring specialty licensing
options.cn: 如果项目价值低于需要专业执照的门槛

options.en: If the contractor holds the appropriate specialty license classification
options.cn: 如果承包商持有相应的专业执照类别

explanation_en: Under B&P Code Section 7057(b), a GBC may take a prime contract involving a single trade other than framing or carpentry only if the GBC holds the appropriate license classification for that trade, or subcontracts with an appropriately licensed contractor.
explanation_cn: 根据《商业与专业法规》第 7057(b) 条规定，GBC（一般建筑承包商）只有在持有该单项专业的相应执照，或与持有相应执照的承包商分包该工程的情况下，才能承接涉及单一行业（除框架或木工外）的总承包合同。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7057(b) (Document p. 248, PDF p. 271)

question_en: A general building contractor takes a subcontract that involves only electrical work and HVAC — two unrelated trades, with no framing or carpentry involved. Is this permissible?
question_cn: 一般建筑承包商承接一个仅涉及电气工作和暖通空调（HVAC）的分包工程——这两项是无关的行业，不涉及框架或木工工作。这允许吗？

options.en: Yes, because two unrelated non-carpentry trades are included
options.cn: 是，因为包括了两种无关的非木工行业

options.en: No, a GBC may only subcontract framing or carpentry work
options.cn: 不，一般建筑承包商只能分包框架或木工工作

options.en: No, unless the GBC holds both a C-10 and C-20 license
options.cn: 不，除非该一般建筑承包商同时持有 C-10 和 C-20 执照

options.en: Yes, because the GBC holds a general building license
options.cn: 是，因为该一般建筑承包商持有一般建筑执照

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7057(b) permits a GBC to take a subcontract involving trades other than framing or carpentry if the subcontract requires at least two unrelated trades or crafts other than framing or carpentry. Electrical and HVAC satisfy this requirement.
explanation_cn: 商业和职业法典第 7057(b) 条允许一般建筑承包商承接涉及框架或木工以外行业的分包工程，前提是该分包工程至少涉及两种与框架或木工无关的行业或工艺。电气和暖通空调（HVAC）满足此要求。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7057(b) (Document p. 248, PDF p. 271)

question_en: A prime contractor receives a progress payment on Monday. By what day must the contractor pay the applicable subcontractors their share, absent a written agreement to the contrary?
question_cn: 总承包商在星期一收到进度款。在没有相反书面协议的情况下，承包商必须在何日之前向适用的分包商支付他们的款项份额？

options.en: Within 14 days after receiving payment
options.cn: 收到款项后14天内

options.en: Within 3 days after receiving payment
options.cn: 收到款项后3天内

options.en: Within 10 days after receiving payment
options.cn: 收到款项后10天内

options.en: Within 7 days after receiving payment
options.cn: 收到款项后7天内

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7108.5(a) requires a prime contractor to pay subcontractors not later than seven days after receipt of each progress payment, unless otherwise agreed to in writing.
explanation_cn: B&P 代码第7108.5(a)条要求，总承包商必须在收到每次进度款后的七天内向分包商付款，除非另有书面约定。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7108.5(a) (Document p. 326, PDF p. 349)

question_en: A prime contractor disputes $4,000 of a $10,000 progress payment owed to a subcontractor. What is the maximum amount the contractor may lawfully withhold from the subcontractor?
question_cn: 主要承包商对分包商应付的一笔 10,000 美元的进度款中的 4,000 美元提出异议。承包商可以合法扣留的最高金额是多少？

options.en: $4,000, the full disputed amount only
options.cn: 4,000 美元，仅为争议金额全额

options.en: $3,000, the entire progress payment amount
options.cn: 3,000 美元，整个进度付款金额

options.en: $5,000, based on 50% of total payment
options.cn: 5,000 美元，基于总付款的 50%

options.en: $6,000, which is 150% of the disputed amount
options.cn: 6,000 美元，即争议金额的 150%

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7108.5(a) allows a contractor to withhold no more than 150% of the disputed amount. 150% of $4,000 equals $6,000, so that is the maximum lawful withholding.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 7108.5(a) 条允许承包商最多扣留争议金额的 150%。4,000 美元的 150% 为 6,000 美元，因此这是最高合法扣留金额。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7108.5(a) (Document p. 326, PDF p. 349)

question_en: A subcontractor does not receive a $5,000 payment that was due two months ago. What is the monthly penalty the contractor owes the subcontractor under B&P Code Section 7108.5?
question_cn: 一名分包商没有收到两个月前应支付的5,000美元款项。根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7108.5条，承包商每月应向分包商支付的罚款是多少？

options.en: $500 per month, 10% of the amount due
options.cn: 每月500美元，应支付金额的10%

options.en: $150 per month, 3% of the amount due
options.cn: 每月150美元，应支付金额的3%

options.en: $100 per month, 2% of the amount due
options.cn: 每月100美元，应支付金额的2%

options.en: $250 per month, 5% of the amount due
options.cn: 每月250美元，应支付金额的5%

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7108.5(b) imposes a penalty of 2% of the amount due per month for every month that payment is not made. 2% of $5,000 equals $100 per month.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7108.5(b)条规定，对于每个未付款的月份，罚款为应付款金额的2%每月。5,000美元的2%等于每月100美元。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7108.5(b) (Document p. 326, PDF p. 349)

question_en: A licensed contractor is sued by a subcontractor for wrongfully withheld progress payments. If the subcontractor wins the lawsuit, who is responsible for attorney's fees and costs?
question_cn: 如果一个分包商因主承包商错误扣留进度款而起诉持牌承包商，若分包商赢得诉讼，谁负责支付律师费和费用？

options.en: Each party bears its own legal costs
options.cn: 各方自行承担法律费用

options.en: CSLB covers legal costs through the bond
options.cn: CSLB通过保证金承担法律费用

options.en: The prevailing party recovers fees and costs
options.cn: 胜诉方获得律师费和费用

options.en: The contractor pays, as the losing party
options.cn: 承包商作为败诉方支付

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7108.5(c) states that in any action for collection of wrongfully withheld funds, the prevailing party is entitled to attorney's fees and costs -- regardless of which party that is.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7108.5(c)条规定，在任何为追讨错误扣留款项而提起的诉讼中，胜诉方有权获得律师费和费用——无论该方是哪一方。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7108.5(c) (Document p. 326, PDF p. 349)

question_en: An asbestos inspection contractor discovers asbestos and knows the required inspection report was requested by a lender as a loan condition. The contractor has a financial relationship with a remediation company. What must the contractor do?
question_cn: 一名石棉检查承包商发现了石棉，并且知道贷款方因贷款条件要求提供必需的检查报告。该承包商与一家修复公司有财务关系。承包商必须做什么？

options.en: Decline the inspection due to the conflict of interest
options.cn: 由于利益冲突而拒绝进行检查

options.en: Disclose the financial relationship orally and in writing
options.cn: 以口头和书面形式披露财务关系

options.en: Notify only the lender of the financial relationship
options.cn: 仅通知贷款方财务关系

options.en: Refer the inspection to the affiliated remediation company
options.cn: 将检查转介给关联的修复公司

explanation_en: Under B&P Code Section 7118.4(a), when a contractor conducts an asbestos inspection that was required by a lender as a loan condition and has any financial relationship with a remediation entity, the contractor must disclose this relationship both orally and in writing.
explanation_cn: 根据《商务与职业法典》第7118.4(a)条，当承包商进行贷款方要求的石棉检查并与任何修复实体存在财务关系时，承包商必须以口头和书面形式披露此关系。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7118.4 (Document p. 333, PDF p. 356)

question_en: A contractor offers a prospective customer a gift card worth $20 to encourage signing a home improvement contract. Which of the following best describes this practice?
question_cn: 一名承包商为鼓励潜在客户签订家庭改进合同，提供价值20美元的礼品卡。以下哪项最准确地描述了这种做法？

options.en: Permitted because it is advertising and promotion
options.cn: 允许，因为这是广告和促销

options.en: Permitted if the gift is not conditioned on signing
options.cn: 如果礼物不以签约为条件，则允许

options.en: Permitted if only one gift is given per transaction
options.cn: 如果每笔交易仅提供一份礼物，则允许

options.en: A misdemeanor and cause for disciplinary action
options.cn: 轻罪，并可能导致纪律处分

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7157 prohibits offering compensation to induce home improvement contracts. The $5 promotional-gift exemption in 7157(b) does not cover a $20 gift card. The statute states that committing such acts is a misdemeanor and grounds for discipline.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7157条禁止提供报酬以诱导家庭改进合同。7157(b) 条中5美元的促销礼物豁免不适用于20美元的礼品卡。该法规指出，实施此类行为属于轻罪，并构成纪律处分的理由。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7157(b) (Document p. 372, PDF p. 395)

question_en: A person accepts a false completion certificate knowing that the work has not been substantially finished, then uses it to obtain a loan. What is the minimum fine they may face?
question_cn: 一个人明知工程尚未实质完成，却接受了虚假的竣工证书，然后利用该证书获得贷款。他们可能面临的最低罚款是多少？
explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7158(a) states that a person guilty of this misdemeanor may be fined not less than $500, up to a maximum of $5,000.
explanation_cn: 《商业与专业法》第7158(a)条规定，犯此轻罪的人可能被处以不少于500美元、最高不超过5,000美元的罚款。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7158(a) (Document p. 373, PDF p. 396)

question_en: A contractor perpetrates a false completion certificate scheme to defraud a homeowner after a Governor-declared natural disaster. Beyond the standard misdemeanor penalties, what additional sanction may the court impose?
question_cn: 一名承包商在州长宣布的自然灾害后，实施伪造完工证书的诈骗行为以欺骗房主。除了标准的轻罪处罚外，法院可以施加哪些额外的制裁？

options.en: A fine up to $5,000 plus civil damages
options.cn: 罚款最高可达 5,000 美元，外加民事赔偿

options.en: A felony conviction and five-year prison sentence
options.cn: 重罪定罪及五年监禁

options.en: Mandatory license revocation by the CSLB
options.cn: CSLB 强制吊销执照

options.en: A fine up to $25,000 plus full restitution to the victim
options.cn: 罚款最高可达 25,000 美元，并向受害者全额赔偿

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7158(b)(2) authorizes an additional fine of up to $25,000 (based on ability to pay) and requires the court to order full restitution when the false certificate fraud occurs in connection with a declared natural disaster.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 7158(b)(2) 条授权在与已宣布的自然灾害相关的伪造证书欺诈案件中，额外处以最高 25,000 美元的罚款（根据支付能力），并要求法院下令向受害者全额赔偿。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7158(b)(2) (Document p. 373, PDF p. 396)

question_en: A home improvement salesperson collects a payment from a homeowner but keeps it rather than turning it over to the employing contractor. This act is best classified as which of the following?
question_cn: 一名家庭装修销售人员从业主那里收取付款，但没有交给雇佣的承包商而是自己保留。这种行为最好归类为以下哪一种？

options.en: A civil breach of contract only
options.cn: 仅为民事违约

options.en: Permitted if the salesperson has a contractual right to commissions
options.cn: 如果销售人员有合同规定的佣金权利，则允许

options.en: A felony subject to state prison time
options.cn: 可能导致州监禁的重罪

options.en: A misdemeanor and cause for disciplinary action
options.cn: 轻罪并可能受到纪律处分

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7156(a) states it is a misdemeanor and cause for disciplinary action for a home improvement salesperson to fail to account for or remit to their employing contractor any payment received in a home improvement transaction.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 7156(a) 条规定，家庭装修销售人员在家庭装修交易中未能将收到的任何付款结算或上交给其雇佣的承包商属于轻罪，并可能受到纪律处分。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7156(a) (Document p. 371, PDF p. 394)

question_en: A home improvement contractor employs a salesperson who uses a contract form that does not show the contractor's name. What is the legal consequence for using that form?
question_cn: 一名家庭装修承包商雇用了一名销售人员，该销售人员使用的合同表格未显示承包商的姓名。使用该表格的法律后果是什么？

options.en: No violation if the contractor's license number appears
options.cn: 如果显示了承包商的执照号码，则不构成违规

options.en: The contract is voidable at the homeowner's option
options.cn: 合同可由房主选择是否作废

options.en: A civil penalty only, not a criminal offense
options.cn: 仅为民事处罚，而非刑事犯罪

options.en: A misdemeanor and grounds for disciplinary action
options.cn: 轻罪并可作为纪律处分依据

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7156(b) makes it a misdemeanor and cause for disciplinary action for any person to use a contract form that fails to disclose the name of the contractor principal by whom the person is employed.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7156(b)条规定，任何人使用未披露其雇佣的承包商负责人姓名的合同表格，均构成轻罪，并可作为纪律处分的理由。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7156(b) (Document p. 371, PDF p. 394)

question_en: A contractor signs a home improvement contract with a homeowner. Before any work begins, what must the contractor provide to the buyer?
question_cn: 承包商与房主签订家庭装修合同。在开始任何工作之前，承包商必须向买方提供什么？

options.en: A signed copy of the contract after work starts
options.cn: 工作开始后提供一份签署的合同副本

options.en: A written estimate signed only by the contractor
options.cn: 仅由承包商签署的书面估价

options.en: A Notice of Cancellation sent by certified mail
options.cn: 通过挂号邮件发送的撤销通知

options.en: A copy of the contract signed and dated by both parties
options.cn: 由双方签署并注明日期的合同副本

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7159(c)(3)(A) requires the contractor to give the buyer a copy of the contract signed and dated by both the contractor and the buyer before any work is started.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7159(c)(3)(A)条要求承包商在开始任何工作之前，将一份由承包商和买方双方签署并注明日期的合同副本提供给买方。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7159(c)(3)(A) (Document p. 375, PDF p. 398)

question_en: Which of the following is NOT required to appear on the first page of a home improvement contract?
question_cn: 以下哪项不需要出现在家庭装修合同的首页？

options.en: The contractor's telephone number for cancellation assistance
options.cn: 承包商的取消协助电话号码

options.en: The date the buyer signed the contract
options.cn: 买方签署合同的日期

options.en: The subcontractor names and license numbers
options.cn: 分包商的姓名和执照号码

options.en: The contractor's name, address, and email address
options.cn: 承包商的姓名、地址和电子邮件地址

explanation_en: Section 7159(d)(7) requires a checkbox indicating whether subcontractors will be used and a disclaimer that a subcontractor list is available upon request -- but subcontractor names and license numbers are NOT required on the first page of the contract.
explanation_cn: 第7159(d)(7)条要求勾选是否会使用分包商，并附上分包商名单可应要求提供的免责声明——但合同首页不要求列出分包商的姓名和执照号码。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7159(c)(3)(B) (Document p. 375, PDF p. 398)

question_en: A home improvement contract requires a change order for additional work. When must the change order be signed to be valid?
question_cn: 家庭装修合同要求对额外工作进行变更单。变更单必须在什么时候签署才有效？

options.en: At any time during the project, orally or in writing
options.cn: 在项目进行的任何时间，可以口头或书面形式

options.en: Within 72 hours of the work being completed
options.cn: 在工作完成后的72小时内

options.en: By the contractor only, before work begins
options.cn: 仅由承包商签署，在工作开始之前

options.en: In writing and signed prior to work commencement
options.cn: 以书面形式并在工作开始前签署

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7159(c)(5) states a change order becomes part of the contract only if it is in writing and signed by the parties prior to the commencement of any work covered by that change order.
explanation_cn: B&P 代码第7159(c)(5)条规定，变更单只有在书面形式并由双方在任何涉及该变更单的工作开始前签署，才能成为合同的一部分。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7159(c)(5) (Document p. 376, PDF p. 399)

question_en: A contractor provides joint control on a home improvement project. What financial restriction applies to that contractor?
question_cn: 承包商在家庭装修项目中提供联合控制。对该承包商适用哪些财务限制？

options.en: The contractor must limit joint control to 10% of contract value
options.cn: 承包商必须将联合控制限制在合同价值的10%以内

options.en: Joint control fees must be disclosed in the contract
options.cn: 联合控制费用必须在合同中披露

options.en: The contractor must post a separate performance bond
options.cn: 承包商必须提供单独的履约保证金

options.en: The contractor shall have no financial interest in joint control
options.cn: 承包商不得在联合控制中拥有任何财务利益

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7159(c)(8) states that if the contract provides for the contractor to furnish joint control, the contractor shall not have any financial or other interest in the joint control.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7159(c)(8)条规定，如果合同规定承包商提供联合控制，承包商不得在联合控制中拥有任何财务或其他利益。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7159(c)(8) (Document p. 376, PDF p. 399)

question_en: A homeowner does not receive a 'Notice of Cancellation' with their home improvement contract. What is the buyer's remedy?
question_cn: 房主在签订家庭装修合同时没有收到“取消通知”。买方的救济措施是什么？

options.en: Sue the contractor for double damages in civil court
options.cn: 在民事法庭上起诉承包商以获得双倍赔偿

options.en: Demand the contractor immediately stop all work
options.cn: 要求承包商立即停止所有工作

options.en: File a complaint with the CSLB
options.cn: 向承包商州许可证委员会（CSLB）提交投诉

options.en: Withhold all payment until the notice is provided
options.cn: 在收到通知之前，扣留所有付款

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7159(a)(6) states that if the Notice of Cancellation is not included or attached as required, the buyer may file a complaint with the Contractors State License Board.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7159(a)(6)条规定，如果未按要求包含或附上取消通知，买方可以向承包商州许可证委员会提出投诉。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7159(a)(6) (Document p. 374, PDF p. 397)

question_en: Under a home improvement contract, what must the contractor furnish before receiving any further payment after a portion of the work is completed?
question_cn: 在家居改进合同下，承包商在完成部分工作后，必须提供什么才能获得进一步的付款？

options.en: A signed change order for the next phase of work
options.cn: 下一阶段工作的已签署变更单

options.en: A written notice of completion for that work phase
options.cn: 该工作阶段的书面完工通知

options.en: A subcontractor list with current insurance certificates
options.cn: 附有当前保险证明的分包商名单

options.en: A full and unconditional release from lien claimants
options.cn: 来自留置权索赔人的完全且无条件的解除权利

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7159(c)(4) requires the contractor, upon receiving satisfactory payment for any portion of work, to furnish a full and unconditional release from any potential lien claimant prior to receiving any further payment.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7159(c)(4)条规定，承包商在收到任何部分工作的满意付款后，必须在获得任何进一步付款之前，向潜在的留置权索赔人提供完全且无条件的解除权利。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7159(c)(4) (Document p. 375, PDF p. 398)

question_en: A home improvement contract covers a project valued at $450. Is a written home improvement contract required under B&P Code Section 7159?
question_cn: 一份家庭装修合同涵盖价值450美元的项目。在《加州商业与职业法典》第7159条下是否需要书面家庭装修合同？

options.en: Yes, all home improvement work requires a written contract
options.cn: 是的，所有家庭装修工作都需要书面合同

options.en: Yes, any work on a dwelling unit requires written contracts
options.cn: 是的，对住宅单元的任何工作都需要书面合同

options.en: No, only contracts over $1,000 require written agreements
options.cn: 不，仅当合同金额超过1,000美元时才需要书面协议

options.en: No, the contract price does not exceed $500
options.cn: 不，合同价格不超过500美元

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7159(b) defines a home improvement contract as one where the aggregate price exceeds $500. A $450 contract falls below that threshold, so Section 7159 requirements do not apply.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7159(b)条将家庭装修合同定义为总价格超过500美元的合同。450美元的合同低于该门槛，因此第7159条的要求不适用。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7159(b) (Document p. 374, PDF p. 397)

question_en: In a swimming pool construction dispute, the court awards judgment to the homeowner. Who is responsible for paying the attorney's fees?
question_cn: 在游泳池施工争议中，法院判决支持房主。谁负责支付律师费？

options.en: Each party pays their own attorney's fees
options.cn: 每方各自支付自己的律师费

options.en: The losing party pays the prevailing party's fees
options.cn: 输的一方支付胜诉方的律师费

options.en: The contractor, as the licensed professional
options.cn: 承包商，作为有执照的专业人士

options.en: Attorney's fees are split equally between both parties
options.cn: 律师费由双方平均分担

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7168 states the court shall award reasonable attorney's fees to the prevailing party in any action between a pool contractor and a contracting person arising from a pool construction contract.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7168条规定，在任何游泳池承包商与承包合同人之间因游泳池施工合同引起的诉讼中，法院应判给胜诉方合理的律师费。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7168 (Document p. 407, PDF p. 430)

question_en: A solar energy system disclosure document is required for a residential solar contract. Where must this document be placed within the contract?
question_cn: 住宅太阳能合同需要提供太阳能系统披露文件。该文件必须放置在合同的哪个位置？

options.en: On the front page or cover page of every solar contract
options.cn: 每份太阳能合同的首页或封面

options.en: As an attachment at the end of the contract
options.cn: 作为合同末尾的附件

options.en: On a separate page immediately following the signature page
options.cn: 紧跟签名页的单独一页上

options.en: Anywhere in the contract, as long as it is in boldface
options.cn: 合同中的任何位置，只要以加粗字体显示

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7169(b) specifically states the solar energy system disclosure document shall be printed on the front page or cover page of every solar energy contract.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 7169(b) 条明确规定，太阳能系统披露文件应印在每份太阳能合同的首页或封面上。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7169(b) (Document p. 407, PDF p. 430)

question_en: A solar energy contract is negotiated in Spanish using Spanish-language marketing materials. In what language must the contract and disclosure document be written?
question_cn: 太阳能合同是用西班牙语谈判的，并使用西班牙语营销材料。合同和披露文件必须使用哪种语言书写？

options.en: Spanish, matching the language of the sales presentation
options.cn: 西班牙语，与销售展示的语言一致

options.en: The consumer's choice of any recognized language
options.cn: 消费者选择的任何公认语言

options.en: Both English and Spanish, side by side
options.cn: 英语和西班牙语并排显示

options.en: English only, as required by California law
options.cn: 仅限英语，根据加利福尼亚州法律的要求

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7169(d) requires both the solar contract and disclosure document to be written in the same language principally used in the oral sales presentation or marketing materials -- in this case, Spanish.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7169(d)条规定，太阳能合同和披露文件必须使用在口头销售展示或营销材料中主要使用的相同语言书写——在本例中为西班牙语。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7169(d) (Document p. 408, PDF p. 431)

question_en: A homeowner cancels a home improvement contract three days after signing. How many days does the contractor have to return any payments made by the homeowner?
question_cn: 一名房主在签署家庭装修合同后三天取消了合同。承包商有多少天时间退还房主已支付的款项？

options.en: Within 3 business days of cancellation notice
options.cn: 在收到取消通知后的3个工作日内

options.en: Within 10 days of cancellation notice
options.cn: 在收到取消通知后的10天内

options.en: Within 7 business days of cancellation notice
options.cn: 在收到取消通知后的7个工作日内

options.en: Within 5 business days of cancellation notice
options.cn: 在收到取消通知后的5个工作日内

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7159(e)(6)(B)(i) states that if the buyer cancels, the contractor must return anything paid within 10 days of receiving the notice of cancellation.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7159(e)(6)(B)(i)条规定，如果买方取消合同，承包商必须在收到取消通知后的10天内退还任何已支付款项。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7159(e)(6)(B)(i) (Document p. 381, PDF p. 404)

question_en: A buyer cancels a home improvement contract and leaves delivered goods at her residence. The contractor fails to retrieve the goods within 20 days. What is the buyer's obligation regarding those goods?
question_cn: 买方取消了一份家庭装修合同，并将已送达的货物留在她的住所。承包商未能在 20 天内取回货物。买方对这些货物有什么义务？

options.en: Return the goods to the contractor immediately
