options.cn: 立即将货物归还给承包商

options.en: Deduct their value from any refund owed
options.cn: 从应退还的款项中扣除货物的价值

options.en: Store the goods and await further contractor instructions
options.cn: 存放货物并等待承包商的进一步指示

options.en: Keep the goods without any further obligation
options.cn: 保留货物而无需承担任何进一步义务

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7159(e)(6)(B)(i) explicitly states that if the contractor does not pick up the goods within 20 days of the cancellation notice, the buyer may keep them without any further obligation.
explanation_cn: 《商务和职业法》第 7159(e)(6)(B)(i) 条明确规定，如果承包商在取消通知后的 20 天内未取回货物，买方可以保留货物而无需承担任何进一步义务。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7159(e)(6)(B)(i) (Document p. 381, PDF p. 404)

question_en: A contractor enters a home improvement contract with a 70-year-old homeowner negotiated at the homeowner's residence. Which cancellation notice is required?
question_cn: 承包商与一位70岁的房主在房主住所协商后签订了家庭装修合同。需要哪种取消通知？

options.en: Seven-Day Right to Cancel notice
options.cn: 七天取消权通知

options.en: Five-Day Right to Cancel notice
options.cn: 五天取消权通知

options.en: Three-Day Right to Cancel notice
options.cn: 三天取消权通知

options.en: No cancellation notice; negotiated at owner's home
options.cn: 无取消通知；在房主住所协商

explanation_en: Under B&P Code Section 7159(e)(6)(A) and (B)(ii), a senior citizen buyer (age 65 or older) is entitled to a Five-Day Right to Cancel, replacing the standard three-day period.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7159(e)(6)(A)条和(B)(ii)条，65岁或以上的老年购房者有权享有五天取消权，取代标准的三天期限。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7159(e)(6)(A) and (B)(ii) (Document p. 380, PDF p. 403)

question_en: After a declared state of emergency, a contractor signs a contract to restore a homeowner's fire-damaged residence. Which cancellation notice must be included in the contract?
question_cn: 在宣布紧急状态后，承包商签订合同以修复业主因火灾受损的住宅。合同中必须包括哪种取消通知？

options.en: Five-Day Right to Cancel notice
options.cn: 五天取消权通知

options.en: No notice required for emergency repairs
options.cn: 紧急维修无需通知

options.en: Three-Day Right to Cancel notice
options.cn: 三天取消权通知

options.en: Seven-Day Right to Cancel notice
options.cn: 七天取消权通知

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7159(e)(7)(A) requires a Seven-Day Right to Cancel notice for any contract to repair or restore residential premises damaged by a sudden or catastrophic event for which an emergency has been declared.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7159(e)(7)(A)条要求，对于因紧急事件宣告而受到突发或灾难性事件损坏的住宅进行修复或复原的任何合同，必须提供七天取消权通知。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7159(e)(7)(A) (Document p. 383, PDF p. 406)

question_en: A home improvement contract includes a progress payment schedule. What is the legal prohibition that must be disclosed in at least 12-point boldface type in that schedule section?
question_cn: 家庭装修合同包括进度付款计划。在该计划部分中必须以至少12号粗体字披露的法律禁止事项是什么？

options.en: Charging finance fees on progress payments is illegal
options.cn: 对进度付款收取财务费用是违法的

options.en: Requiring progress payments before issuing a lien waiver
options.cn: 在签发免留置权证明前要求进度付款

options.en: Collecting payment for incomplete work or undelivered materials
options.cn: 为未完成的工作或未交付的材料收款

options.en: Collecting the full contract price at signing is illegal
options.cn: 签约时收取全部合同价款是违法的

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7159(d)(9)(C) requires a boldface statement that it is against the law for a contractor to collect payment for work not yet completed or for materials not yet delivered.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7159(d)(9)(C)条要求以粗体字声明，承包商收取尚未完成的工作或尚未交付的材料费用是违法的。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7159(d)(9)(C) (Document p. 377, PDF p. 400)

question_en: A home improvement contract requires a change order for extra work. To be enforceable against the buyer, the change order must be signed by both parties at what point?
question_cn: 家庭装修合同中，对于额外工作的变更订单需要签署。为了对买方具有可执行性，变更订单必须由双方在何时签署？

options.en: At the time the original contract is executed
options.cn: 在原合同签署时

options.en: Before final payment is issued to the contractor
options.cn: 在向承包商支付最终款项之前

options.en: Prior to commencement of the change-order work
options.cn: 在变更订单工作开始之前

options.en: Within 3 days after the extra work is completed
options.cn: 在额外工作完成后 3 天内

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7159(d)(13) and (e)(3)(B) require the change order to be prepared in writing and signed by both parties prior to the commencement of work covered by the new change order to be enforceable.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 7159(d)(13) 和 (e)(3)(B) 条要求，变更订单必须以书面形式准备，并在新变更订单所涵盖的工作开始之前由双方签署，方可具有可执行性。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7159(d)(13) and (e)(3)(B) (Document p. 378, PDF p. 401)

question_en: Which item is NOT required to be identified in a change order to make it enforceable against the buyer?
question_cn: 哪一项在变更单中不需要被识别以使其对买方具有强制执行力？

options.en: The amount added or subtracted from the contract
options.cn: 合同中增加或减少的金额

options.en: The names of subcontractors performing the extra work
options.cn: 执行额外工作的分包商名称

options.en: The scope of work covered by the order
options.cn: 该订单涵盖的工作范围

options.en: The effect on the progress payments or completion date
options.cn: 对进度付款或完成日期的影响

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7159(e)(3)(B) lists only three required elements: scope of work, cost adjustment, and effect on progress payments or completion date. Subcontractor identity is not a required element.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7159(e)(3)(B)条仅列出了三个必需要素：工作范围、成本调整以及对进度付款或完成日期的影响。分包商身份不是必需要素。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7159(e)(3)(B) (Document p. 379, PDF p. 402)

question_en: A contractor's home improvement contract includes a swimming pool installation. Beyond the standard project description, what additional item must be included for the pool?
question_cn: 承包商的家庭装修合同包括游泳池安装。除了标准的项目描述外，游泳池还必须包括哪些附加项目？

options.en: A licensed engineer's stamped structural analysis
options.cn: 有执照工程师盖章的结构分析

options.en: A copy of the local building permit application
options.cn: 当地建筑许可申请副本

options.en: A list of all subcontractors to be used
options.cn: 将要使用的所有分包商名单

options.en: A plan and scale drawing with specifications
options.cn: 含规格说明的平面图和比例图

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7159(d)(7) requires that for swimming pools, the project description also include a plan and scale drawing showing the shape, size, dimensions, and construction and equipment specifications.
explanation_cn: 根据 《加州商业与职业法典》第 7159(d)(7) 条规定，对于游泳池，项目描述还必须包括一份显示形状、大小、尺寸以及施工和设备规格的平面图和比例图。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7159(d)(7) (Document p. 377, PDF p. 400)

question_en: A home improvement contract's cancellation notice must be written in which language?
question_cn: 家庭装修合同的取消通知必须用哪种语言书写？

options.en: Both English and the buyer's native language
options.cn: 英语和买方的母语

options.en: The same language as the oral sales presentation
options.cn: 与口头销售演示相同的语言

options.en: English only, as required by state law
options.cn: 仅限英语，按州法律要求

options.en: Any language the contractor chooses
options.cn: 承包商选择的任何语言

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7159(e)(6)(C)(iv) requires the cancellation notice to be written in the same language, such as Spanish, that was principally used in any oral sales presentation.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7159(e)(6)(C)(iv)条要求取消通知必须用在任何口头销售演示中主要使用的相同语言书写，例如西班牙语。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7159(e)(6)(C)(iv) (Document p. 381, PDF p. 404)

question_en: A home improvement contract's Notice of Cancellation form must be provided in what form to be compliant?
question_cn: 家庭装修合同的取消通知表格必须以何种形式提供才能合规？

options.en: A single original attached to the contract
options.cn: 附在合同上的单份原件

options.en: An electronic copy emailed to the buyer
options.cn: 通过电子邮件发送给买方的电子副本

options.en: A completed form in duplicate, easily detachable
options.cn: 完整填写的双份表格，易于拆分

options.en: A separate mailing sent within 3 days of signing
options.cn: 在签署后三天内单独邮寄的表格

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7159(e)(6)(C)(vi)(I) requires the Notice of Cancellation to be a completed form provided in duplicate, attached to the agreement and easily detachable.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》规第7159(e)(6)(C)(vi)(I)条要求取消通知必须为完整填写的双份表格，附在合同上并且易于拆分。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7159(e)(6)(C)(vi)(I) (Document p. 382, PDF p. 405)

question_en: Which of the following insurance disclosures is a contractor permitted to include in a home improvement contract as an attachment rather than within the contract body?
question_cn: 承包商被允许在家庭装修合同中以附件形式而不是合同正文中包含以下哪种保险声明？

options.en: Both CGL and workers' compensation notices
options.cn: 包括综合责任保险（CGL）和工伤赔偿通知

options.en: CGL notice only, not workers' compensation
options.cn: 仅CGL通知，不包括工伤赔偿

options.en: Workers' compensation notice only, not CGL
options.cn: 仅工伤赔偿通知，不包括CGL

options.en: Neither CGL nor workers' compensation notice
options.cn: 既不包括CGL也不包括工伤赔偿通知

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7159(e)(1) and (e)(2) each permit their respective notice (CGL and workers' compensation) to be provided as an attachment, so long as the contract body includes a statement referencing the attached notice.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7159(e)(1)和(e)(2)条款允许各自的通知（CGL和工伤赔偿）以附件形式提供，只要合同正文中包含引用附加通知的声明。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7159(e)(1) and (e)(2) (Document p. 378, PDF p. 401)

question_en: A homeowner contacts a contractor for a plumbing repair. The contractor arrives, partially completes the work for $680, and asks for payment before finishing the job. Has the contractor complied with California law for a service and repair contract?
question_cn: 一位房主联系承包商进行管道维修。承包商到达后，部分完成了工作，收费680美元，并要求在完成工作之前支付费用。承包商是否遵守了加利福尼亚州的服务和维修合同法律？

options.en: Yes, because the amount is under $750
options.cn: 是的，因为金额低于750美元

options.en: No, because the contract was not written
options.cn: 不是，因为合同未书面形式

options.en: Yes, because the buyer initiated contact
options.cn: 是的，因为买方主动联系

options.en: No, payment is not due until work is completed
options.cn: 不是，费用在工作完成前不应支付

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7159.10(a)(1)(D) explicitly states that no payment is due, and the contractor may not accept any payment, until the work is completed. Requesting payment before completion violates this requirement regardless of contract amount.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7159.10(a)(1)(D)条明确规定，直到工作完成之前，不得收取任何付款，承包商也不得接受任何付款。在完成工作之前要求付款，无论合同金额多少，都是违反这一要求的。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7159.10(a)(1)(D) (Document p. 391, PDF p. 414)

question_en: Under California law, which of the following does NOT qualify a contract as a service and repair contract?
question_cn: 根据加利福尼亚州法律，以下哪一项不符合合同为服务和维修合同的条件？

options.en: The contract amount is $750 or less
options.cn: 合同金额为$750或以下

options.en: The buyer initiates contact requesting the work
options.cn: 由买方发起联系请求工作

options.en: The contractor provides a written three-day cancellation notice
options.cn: 承包商提供书面的三天取消通知

options.en: No payment is accepted until work is complete
options.cn: 直到工作完成前不接受付款

explanation_en: The four qualifying conditions under Section 7159.10(a)(1) are: amount $750 or less, buyer-initiated contact, no upselling beyond the problem, and no payment until completion. Providing a cancellation notice is a disclosure requirement — it is not one of the four conditions that define whether the contract qualifies as a service and repair contract.
explanation_cn: 根据第7159.10(a)(1)条款的四个合格条件是：金额$750或以下、买方发起联系、未超过问题范围进行推销、直到完成前不付款。提供取消通知是披露要求——它不是决定合同是否符合服务和维修合同条件的四个条件之一。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7159.10(a)(1) (Document p. 391, PDF p. 414)

question_en: A contractor performing home improvement work on a disaster-damaged residence violates the downpayment rules as part of a scheme to defraud the owner. In addition to restitution, what is the maximum additional fine the court may impose?
question_cn: 承包商在受灾住宅进行家庭装修工作时，违反预付款规定，并作为诈骗房主计划的一部分。除了赔偿之外，法院可能施加的最高额外罚款是多少？

options.en: $10,000, based on the defendant's ability to pay
options.cn: 10,000美元，根据被告的支付能力

options.en: $5,000, based on the defendant's ability to pay
options.cn: 5,000美元，根据被告的支付能力

options.en: $25,000, based on the defendant's ability to pay
options.cn: 25,000美元，根据被告的支付能力

options.en: $50,000, regardless of ability to pay
options.cn: 50,000美元，不论支付能力如何

explanation_en: Section 7159.5(c)(2) provides that in addition to full restitution, the court may impose a fine of not less than $500 nor more than $25,000 based on the defendant's ability to pay, when the violation is part of a scheme to defraud in connection with a declared natural disaster.
explanation_cn: 第7159.5(c)(2)条规定，当违反行为属于与宣告的自然灾害有关的诈骗计划的一部分时，除全额赔偿外，法院可根据被告的支付能力，施加不少于500美元且不超过25,000美元的罚款。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7159.5(c)(2) (Document p. 389, PDF p. 412)

question_en: A licensed contractor violates the home improvement downpayment rules. What is the statute of limitations for bringing a criminal complaint against that licensed contractor?
question_cn: 持牌承包商违反了家庭装修预付款规定。对该持牌承包商提起刑事投诉的诉讼时效是多久？

options.en: No limit; administrative actions are never time-barred
options.cn: 没有限制；行政行动永不过期

options.en: One year from the date of the contract
options.cn: 自合同日期起一年

options.en: Four years from the date of the contract
options.cn: 自合同日期起四年

options.en: Two years from the date of the contract
options.cn: 自合同日期起两年

explanation_en: Section 7159.5(b)(2)(B) specifies that an indictment or complaint against a licensed contractor must be brought within two years from the date of the contract, or from the date of the first payment if no written contract exists.
explanation_cn: 第7159.5(b)(2)(B)条规定，对持牌承包商的起诉或投诉必须在合同日期起两年内提出，如果没有书面合同，则从首次付款之日起两年内提出。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7159.5(b)(2)(B) (Document p. 389, PDF p. 412)

question_en: A home improvement contractor wants to accept payment from a lender before completing the work. Under what condition does California law allow this?
question_cn: 一名家庭装修承包商想在完成工作之前接受贷款人的付款。加利福尼亚州法律在什么情况下允许这样做？

options.en: When the contractor furnishes a qualifying performance and payment bond
options.cn: 当承包商提供合格的履约和付款保证时

options.en: When the owner provides written authorization
options.cn: 当业主提供书面授权时

options.en: When a licensed subcontractor performs the work
options.cn: 当持牌分包商执行工作时

options.en: When the contract amount exceeds $50,000
options.cn: 当合同金额超过50,000美元时

explanation_en: Section 7159.5(a)(8) exempts contractors who furnish a performance and payment bond, lien and completion bond, bond equivalent, or joint control approved by the registrar from the payment restrictions, including the prohibition on advance payments from lenders.
explanation_cn: 第7159.5(a)(8)条规定，提供履约和付款保证、留置权和完工保证、等值保证或经登记员批准的联合控制的承包商，可免于支付限制，包括贷款人预付款的禁止。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7159.5(a)(8) (Document p. 388, PDF p. 411)

question_en: What must a home improvement contract include if payments are scheduled before the work is completed?
question_cn: 如果付款在工作完成之前安排，家庭装修合同必须包含什么内容？

options.en: A schedule of payments in dollars and cents
options.cn: 以美元和美分表示的付款时间表

options.en: A lien waiver signed by all subcontractors
options.cn: 由所有分包商签署的留置权放弃书

options.en: A separate finance charge disclosure form
options.cn: 单独的融资费用披露表

options.en: Written approval from the Registrar of Contractors
options.cn: 承包商注册处的书面批准

explanation_en: Section 7159.5(a)(4) requires that if progress payments are made before completion, the contract must include a payment schedule stated in dollars and cents, specifically referencing the work, services, materials, and equipment corresponding to each payment.
explanation_cn: 第7159.5(a)(4)条规定，如果在完成工作之前进行阶段性付款，合同必须包含以美元和美分表示的付款时间表，明确参照每笔付款对应的工作、服务、材料和设备。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7159.5(a)(4) (Document p. 387, PDF p. 410)

question_en: A buyer signed a service and repair contract three days ago for $720 in plumbing work. The contractor has already started work. The buyer is a senior citizen who now wants to cancel because she believes the price is too high. How many business days does she have to cancel?
question_cn: 三天前，一位买家签署了一份价值720美元的管道维修服务合同。承包商已经开始工作。买家是一名老年人，现在希望取消合同，因为她认为价格太高。她有多少个工作日可以取消？

options.en: Three business days from signing
options.cn: 从签署之日起算三天工作日

options.en: Seven business days, due to disaster declaration
options.cn: 七个工作日，因为灾难声明

options.en: She cannot cancel once work has started
options.cn: 一旦工作开始，她无法取消

options.en: Five business days from signing
options.cn: 从签署之日起算五个工作日

explanation_en: Section 7159.10(e)(12)(A)(ii) states that references to 'three' business days in the cancellation notice are changed to 'five' for a buyer who is a senior citizen, effective for contracts entered on or after January 1, 2021.
explanation_cn: 第7159.10(e)(12)(A)(ii)条款规定，对于老年买家，取消通知中提到的“三个”工作日应改为“五个”，适用于2021年1月1日或之后签订的合同。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7159.10(e)(12)(A)(ii) (Document p. 395, PDF p. 418)

question_en: A change order for a home improvement project specifies additional work and its cost but omits the effect on the project completion date. Is this change order enforceable against the buyer?
question_cn: 一份家庭装修项目的变更订单说明了额外工作及其费用，但未说明对项目完成日期的影响。该变更订单是否可对买方强制执行？

options.en: Yes, if the buyer signed the change order
options.cn: 是的，如果买方签署了变更订单

options.en: No, all change orders require CSLB approval
options.cn: 不是的，所有变更订单都需要 CSLB 批准

options.en: Yes, cost and scope are the only requirements
options.cn: 是的，费用和范围是唯一要求

options.en: No, it is missing a required element
options.cn: 不是的，它缺少一个必需的元素

explanation_en: Section 7159.6(a)(3) requires that a change order state the effect the order will have on progress payments or the completion date. Omitting this element means the change order is not enforceable against the buyer, even if scope and cost are included.
explanation_cn: 第 7159.6(a)(3) 条规定，变更订单必须说明该订单对进度付款或完成日期的影响。即使包括了范围和费用，遗漏此元素也意味着该变更订单不能对买方强制执行。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7159.6(a) (Document p. 390, PDF p. 413)

question_en: A contractor furnishes a qualifying performance and payment bond on a home improvement job. Which of the following requirements is the contractor still obligated to meet?
question_cn: 承包商在家庭装修工程中提供了符合资格的履约和付款保证金。承包商仍然需要满足以下哪些要求？

options.en: Include a payment schedule referencing each work phase
options.cn: 包含参考每个工作阶段的付款计划

options.en: Limit the downpayment to $1,000 or 10%
options.cn: 将首付款限制为1000美元或10%

options.en: Prohibit advance payments from any lender
options.cn: 禁止任何贷款方提前付款

options.en: Hold an active California license for at least two years
options.cn: 持有至少两年的有效加利福尼亚州执照

explanation_en: Section 7159.5(a)(8) states that notwithstanding any other law, a licensee must hold an active California license for not less than two years before submitting an Application for Approval of Blanket Performance and Payment Bond. This is a prerequisite that survives the payment-rule exemptions.
explanation_cn: 第7159.5(a)(8)条规定，尽管有任何其他法律，持证人必须在提交《通用履约和付款保证金批准申请》之前，持有至少两年的有效加利福尼亚州执照。这是一项在付款规则豁免下仍然有效的先决条件。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7159.5(a)(8) (Document p. 388, PDF p. 411)

question_en: A service and repair contractor advertises plumbing tune-ups without mentioning any additional fees. The contractor charges customers a $75 trip fee on arrival. Is this permissible?
question_cn: 一位服务和维修承包商在广告管道调试服务时未提及任何额外费用。该承包商在到达客户现场时收取 75 美元的上门费。这合法吗？

options.en: No, only one service charge per job is allowed
options.cn: 不，每个工作只允许收取一次服务费

options.en: No, service charges must be disclosed in all ads
options.cn: 不，所有广告中都必须披露服务费

options.en: Yes, trip fees are always permitted without disclosure
options.cn: 是的，上门费在未披露的情况下总是允许的

options.en: Yes, if the total contract stays under $750
options.cn: 是的，如果总合同金额低于 750 美元

explanation_en: Section 7159.14(a)(9) requires a service and repair contractor who charges a service charge — which includes trip charges and inspection fees — to disclose that fact in all advertisements. Failure to do so is a violation.
explanation_cn: 第 7159.14(a)(9) 条要求收取服务费的服务和维修承包商——包括上门费和检查费——必须在所有广告中披露该费用。未披露即构成违规。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7159.14(a)(9) (Document p. 396, PDF p. 419)

question_en: A licensee installs a fire alarm system for $480 and wants to use Section 7159.9's exemption from standard home improvement contract requirements. What must the contract or separate certification document include?
question_cn: 持证人安装一个价值480美元的火警报警系统，并希望使用第7159.9条关于标准家庭装修合同要求的豁免条款。合同或单独的认证文件必须包括哪些内容？

options.en: A CSLB-approved waiver of home improvement rights
options.cn: 加州承包商州立委员会（CSLB）批准的家庭装修权利豁免

options.en: A signed statement from the alarm company operator
options.cn: 报警公司操作员签署的声明

options.en: The physical address and contractor license number
options.cn: 实际地址和承包商执照号码

options.en: A three-day cancellation notice signed by the buyer
options.cn: 由买方签署的三天取消通知

explanation_en: Section 7159.9(b) requires the contract or separate certification document to include both the physical address of the residence for which the certification applies and the contractor's name, business address, and license number as contained in CSLB's official records.
explanation_cn: 第7159.9(b)条要求合同或单独的认证文件必须包括认证适用的住宅的实际地址，以及承包商的姓名、营业地址和CSLB官方记录中的执照号码。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7159.9(b) (Document p. 390, PDF p. 413)

question_en: A contractor completes a service and repair job and asks if the customer wants the replaced parts back. The customer says nothing and initials the checkbox. The contractor takes the parts. Was this proper?
question_cn: 一名承包商完成了一项服务和维修工作，并询问客户是否希望取回更换的零件。客户未作回应，但在复选框上签了字母缩写（首字母）。承包商拿走了零件。这做法是否合适？

options.en: Yes, the initialed checkbox authorizes the contractor
options.cn: 是的，签了字母缩写的复选框授权了承包商

options.en: Yes, but only if the contract states the part's value
options.cn: 是的，但前提是合同中注明了零件的价值

options.en: No, verbal consent is required, not a checkbox
options.cn: 不，口头同意是必需的，而不是复选框

options.en: No, replaced parts always belong to the customer
options.cn: 不，更换的零件始终属于客户

explanation_en: Section 7159.10(e)(9) requires the contractor to offer replaced parts to the buyer, and Section 7159.10(e)(10) requires a checkbox labeled 'OK for contractor to take replaced parts.' The buyer's initial on that checkbox properly authorizes the contractor to keep the parts.
explanation_cn: 第7159.10(e)(9)条款要求承包商需向买方提供更换零件，第7159.10(e)(10)条款要求有一个标注“承包商可取走更换零件”的复选框。买方在该复选框上的首字母签名，正确地授权了承包商保留零件。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7159.10(e)(9)-(10) (Document p. 394, PDF p. 417)

question_en: A salesperson's commission is written into a home improvement contract. How must the commission be paid as the project progresses?
question_cn: 销售人员的佣金已写入家庭装修合同。随着项目进展，佣金必须如何支付？

options.en: On a pro rata basis matching the payment schedule
options.cn: 按与付款计划相匹配的比例分配

options.en: At whatever rate the contractor and salesperson agree
options.cn: 以承包商和销售人员商定的任何方式支付

options.en: In full upon project completion
options.cn: 项目完成时一次性支付全额

options.en: In full upon execution of the contract
options.cn: 合同签订时一次性支付全额

explanation_en: Section 7159.5(a)(7) requires that when a salesperson's commission is payable out of the contract price, it must be paid on a pro rata basis in proportion to the schedule of payments made to the contractor by the disbursing party.
explanation_cn: 第7159.5(a)(7)条要求，当销售人员的佣金从合同价格中支付时，必须按照付款方向承包商支付款项的时间表按比例支付。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7159.5(a)(7) (Document p. 388, PDF p. 411)

question_en: A contractor is found guilty of using false advertising to induce a homeowner to sign a home improvement contract. What is the minimum fine the contractor faces under B&P Code Section 7161?
question_cn: 一名承包商因使用虚假广告诱使房主签订家庭装修合同而被判有罪。根据 《加州商业与职业法典》第 7161 条，该承包商面临的最低罚款是多少？

options.en: No less than $1,000 per violation
options.cn: 每次违规不少于 $1,000

options.en: No less than $2,500 per violation
options.cn: 每次违规不少于 $2,500

options.en: No less than $100 per violation
options.cn: 每次违规不少于 $100

options.en: No less than $500 per violation
options.cn: 每次违规不少于 $500

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7159(b) provides that violations of specified subdivisions are misdemeanors punishable by a fine of not less than $100 nor more than $5,000, or imprisonment not exceeding one year, or both.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 7159(b) 条规定，违反指定条款的行为属轻罪，处不少于 $100 且不超过 $5,000 的罚款，或不超过一年的监禁，或两者并罚。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7159(b) (Document p. 397, PDF p. 420)

question_en: A licensed contractor defrauds a homeowner by misrepresenting repair costs after a Governor-declared state of emergency. In addition to restitution, what is the maximum additional fine the court may impose?
question_cn: 一名持证承包商在州长宣布的紧急状态后，通过虚报维修费用欺骗房主。除了赔偿之外，法院可以施加的最高额外罚款是多少？

options.en: $10,000 based on ability to pay
options.cn: 10000美元，根据支付能力而定

options.en: $50,000 based on ability to pay
options.cn: 50000美元，根据支付能力而定

options.en: $25,000 based on ability to pay
options.cn: 25000美元，根据支付能力而定

options.en: $5,000 based on ability to pay
options.cn: 5000美元，根据支付能力而定

explanation_en: Under B&P Code Section 7161(f)(2), in addition to full restitution and imprisonment, the court may impose a fine of not less than $500 nor more than $25,000, based on the defendant's ability to pay, for fraud related to natural disaster repairs.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7161(f)(2)条，除了全额赔偿和监禁之外，法院可以根据被告的支付能力，对与自然灾害维修相关的欺诈行为处以不少于500美元、不超过25000美元的罚款。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7161(f)(2) (Document p. 399, PDF p. 422)

question_en: A customer sues a contractor after being induced to sign a contract based on the contractor's knowingly false statements. Under B&P Code Section 7160, what penalty may the customer recover in addition to actual damages?
question_cn: 一位客户在被承包商诱导签署合同后起诉该承包商，因为承包商明知虚假陈述。根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7160条，客户除了实际损失外，还可以获得什么赔偿？

options.en: $1,000 plus reasonable attorney's fees
options.cn: 1,000美元加合理的律师费

options.en: $500 plus punitive damages
options.cn: 500美元加惩罚性赔偿

options.en: $250 plus court costs
options.cn: 250美元加法院费用

options.en: $500 plus reasonable attorney's fees
options.cn: 500美元加合理的律师费

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7160 provides that a person induced to contract based on fraudulent misrepresentation may sue and recover a penalty of $500 plus reasonable attorney's fees, in addition to any actual damages.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7160条规定，被欺诈性陈述诱导签约的人可以提起诉讼，并可获得500美元加合理律师费的赔偿，此外还可以获得任何实际损失。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7160 (Document p. 398, PDF p. 421)

question_en: A licensed contractor is charged with making a false representation in a home improvement contract. The written contract was signed on June 1. What is the last date a criminal complaint may be filed against the licensed contractor?
question_cn: 一名持证承包商因在家庭装修合同中作出虚假陈述而被控。书面合同于6月1日签署。针对该持证承包商提起刑事诉讼的最后日期是什么？

options.en: June 1, four years after contract date
options.cn: 合同签署日后四年的6月1日

options.en: June 1, three years after contract date
options.cn: 合同签署日后三年的6月1日

options.en: June 1, two years after contract date
options.cn: 合同签署日后两年的6月1日

options.en: June 1, one year after contract date
options.cn: 合同签署日后一年的6月1日

explanation_en: Under B&P Code Section 7159(b)(2), a criminal complaint against a licensed contractor must be filed within two years from the date of the written contract — here, June 1 two years later.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7159(b)(2)条，对持证承包商的刑事诉讼必须在书面合同签署日的两年内提起——在此情况下，即两年后的6月1日。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7159(b)(2) (Document p. 397, PDF p. 420)

question_en: A contractor's home improvement contract specifies a particular brand and model number of kitchen appliances. The contractor installs a different brand of equivalent value without telling the owner. Which of the following best describes the consequence?
question_cn: 承包商的家庭装修合同指定了特定品牌和型号的厨房电器。承包商在未告知业主的情况下安装了价值相等的不同品牌。以下哪项最能描述其后果？

options.en: It is grounds for disciplinary action against the contractor
options.cn: 这是对承包商采取纪律处分的理由

options.en: The contractor owes the owner a $500 penalty
options.cn: 承包商欠业主 500 美元的罚金

options.en: The contractor must refund the full contract price
options.cn: 承包商必须退还全部合同价格

options.en: The contract becomes void and unenforceable
options.cn: 合同变为无效且不可执行

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7162(b) states that failure to install the specific goods or materials as represented in the written contract constitutes cause for disciplinary action under this chapter.
explanation_cn: 《商业与专业法规》第 7162(b) 条规定，未按书面合同所述安装特定商品或材料构成本章规定的纪律处分理由。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7162(b) (Document p. 400, PDF p. 423)

question_en: A homeowner wants a contractor to begin work on a home improvement project that requires a third-party loan. The third party has agreed to make the loan, but the buyer has not yet agreed to accept it. Which of the following actions is the contractor permitted to take?
question_cn: 一位房主希望承包商开始一个需要第三方贷款的家庭改善项目。第三方已经同意提供贷款，但买方尚未同意接受贷款。承包商可以采取以下哪种行为？

options.en: Obtain building permits as a preliminary service
options.cn: 以初步服务的形式获取建筑许可

options.en: Begin all work since the lender has approved the loan
options.cn: 开始所有工作，因为贷款方已批准贷款

options.en: Represent to the buyer that the contract is binding
options.cn: 向买方表示合同具有约束力

options.en: Deliver materials to the jobsite immediately
options.cn: 立即将材料送到工地

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7163(b)(1) permits the contractor to obtain building permits or similar preliminary services for which no mechanic's lien can be claimed, even before all loan conditions are satisfied.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7163(b)(1)条允许承包商在贷款所有条件满足之前，也可获取建筑许可或类似的初步服务，但无法为此主张工程留置权。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7163(b)(1) (Document p. 400, PDF p. 423)

question_en: If a home improvement contract is unenforceable because the required loan conditions were not met, and the contractor delivered property to the buyer that cannot practically be returned, what must the contractor refund?
question_cn: 如果由于未满足所需的贷款条件而导致家居装修合同无法执行，并且承包商向买方交付了无法实际退还的财产，那么承包商必须退还什么？

options.en: The original purchase price of the property
options.cn: 财产的原始购买价格

options.en: The depreciated value of the property delivered
options.cn: 所交付财产的折旧价值

options.en: The full contract price, including labor costs
options.cn: 包含人工费用的合同总价

options.en: Fair market value or contract value, whichever is greater
options.cn: 公平市场价值或合同价值，以较高者为准

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7163(c) states that if property cannot be returned, the contractor shall immediately return the fair market value of the property or its value as designated in the contract, whichever is greater.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7163(c)条规定，如果财产无法退还，承包商应立即退还财产的公平市场价值或者合同中指定的价值，以两者中较高者为准。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7163(c) (Document p. 401, PDF p. 424)

question_en: Under B&P Code Section 7163, a buyer may waive the loan-condition requirements of subdivisions (a) and (b). When is such a waiver valid?
question_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7163条，买方可以放弃(a)和(b)分支的贷款条件要求。何时此类放弃有效？

options.en: When the contractor and buyer both agree in writing
options.cn: 当承包商和买方均以书面形式同意时

options.en: When the buyer signs a standard printed waiver form
options.cn: 当买方签署标准打印的放弃表格时

options.en: When a licensed attorney prepares and reviews the waiver
options.cn: 当持证律师准备并审核放弃书时

options.en: For emergency repairs requiring immediate protection of persons or property
options.cn: 对于需要立即保护人员或财产的紧急维修

explanation_en: Under B&P Code Section 7163(g), the buyer may waive subdivisions (a) and (b) only for emergency repairs or services necessary for immediate protection of persons or real or personal property, via a dated written statement — not a printed form — signed by each owner.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7163(g)条，买方只能在紧急维修或必要的服务以立即保护人员或不动产或动产的情况下，通过每位所有者签署的书面日期声明（而非打印表格）放弃(a)和(b)分支。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7163(g) (Document p. 402, PDF p. 425)

question_en: A single-family home construction contract under B&P Code Section 7164 must contain a notice near the signature lines stating what right the owner has?
question_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7164条，单户住宅建筑合同必须在签名栏附近包含一则通知，说明业主拥有哪些权利？

options.en: The right to inspect contractor's license records
options.cn: 检查承包商执照记录的权利

options.en: The right to withhold final payment until project is complete
options.cn: 在项目完成前扣留尾款的权利

options.en: The right to cancel within three business days
options.cn: 在三个工作日内取消的权利

options.en: The right to require a performance and payment bond
options.cn: 要求提供履约和付款保证金的权利

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7164(d) requires that every covered contract contain a notice in at least 10-point boldface type or all capitals stating that the owner has the right to require the contractor to have a performance and payment bond, and that the expense may be borne by the owner.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7164(d)条要求，每个受覆盖的合同必须包含至少10号字体加粗或全大写的通知，说明业主有权要求承包商提供履约和付款保证金，并且费用可能由业主承担。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7164(d) (Document p. 403, PDF p. 426)

question_en: A swimming pool contractor wants to begin excavation before the buyer's loan cancellation period expires. Under B&P Code Section 7165, how many business days must pass after the buyer receives all required lender writings before the buyer can sign a request to begin construction?
question_cn: 一位游泳池承包商希望在买方贷款取消期限到期前开始挖掘。根据加州《加州商业与职业法典》（B&P Code）第7165条，买方收到所有所需贷款方文件后，必须过多少个工作日后才能签署开始施工的请求？

options.en: No sooner than seven business days
options.cn: 不早于七个工作日

options.en: No sooner than one business day
options.cn: 不早于一天工作日

options.en: No sooner than five business days
options.cn: 不早于五个工作日

options.en: No sooner than three business days
options.cn: 不早于三个工作日

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7165(d) states that the buyer may request early construction start no sooner than three business days after receiving all the required lender writings described in subdivisions (a), (b), and (c).
explanation_cn: B&P Code第7165(d)条规定，买方在收到(a)、(b)和(c)分款中描述的所有所需贷款方文件后三个工作日后，方可请求提前开始施工。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7165(d) (Document p. 404, PDF p. 427)

question_en: Under B&P Code Section 7165, when a swimming pool is being financed by a third-party lender and excavation is complete, for how long must the lender's written offer of financing remain open?
question_cn: 根据《商业和专业法典》第7165条，当游泳池由第三方贷款方融资且挖掘完成后，贷款方的书面融资报价必须保持开放多长时间？

options.en: Not less than 60 days after excavation completion
options.cn: 挖掘完成后不少于60天

options.en: Not less than 30 days after excavation completion
options.cn: 挖掘完成后不少于30天

options.en: Not less than 20 days after excavation completion
options.cn: 挖掘完成后不少于20天

options.en: Not less than 15 days after excavation completion
options.cn: 挖掘完成后不少于15天

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7165(c) states that the lender's written agreement shall specify a duration of not less than 15 days following the completion of the excavation of the swimming pool.
explanation_cn: 《商业和专业法典》第7165(c)条规定，贷款方的书面协议应注明在游泳池挖掘完成后不少于15天的期限。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7165(c) (Document p. 404, PDF p. 427)

question_en: Under B&P Code Section 7166, to which of the following swimming pool construction projects do the home improvement contract requirements of Article 10 NOT apply?
question_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7166条，以下哪些游泳池建设项目不适用第10条的家庭装修合同要求？

options.en: An in-ground pool at a single-family rental home
options.cn: 单户租赁房的地下游泳池

options.en: A community pool at a condominium complex
options.cn: 一个公寓小区的社区游泳池

options.en: A pool added to an existing single-family home
options.cn: 在现有的独户住宅中增加一个游泳池

options.en: A pool financed through a third-party lender
options.cn: 通过第三方贷款人融资的资金池

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7166 exempts pools built for other than a single-family unit's use and enjoyment. A community pool serving a condominium complex is not for a single-family unit, so Article 10 does not apply.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7166条款豁免了为单户住宅使用和享受之外建造的游泳池。为公寓综合体服务的社区游泳池不是为单户住宅建造的，因此第10条不适用。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7166 (Document p. 406, PDF p. 429)

question_en: A service and repair contractor replaces a defective component in a customer's HVAC system. After the job is complete, which of the following obligations does the contractor have regarding the replaced part?
question_cn: 服务和维修承包商在客户的 HVAC 系统中更换了一个有缺陷的部件。工作完成后，承包商对已更换的部件有哪些义务？

options.en: Document the replaced part in the invoice
options.cn: 在发票中记录已更换的部件

options.en: Offer the replaced parts to the customer
options.cn: 向客户提供已更换的部件

options.en: Return the old part to the manufacturer
options.cn: 将旧部件退回制造商

options.en: Dispose of the old part as hazardous waste
options.cn: 将旧部件作为有害废物处理

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7159(a)(10) requires that service and repair contractors offer to the customer any parts that were replaced during the service call.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 7159(a)(10) 条规定，服务和维修承包商在服务过程中更换的任何部件都必须提供给客户。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7159(a)(10) (Document p. 397, PDF p. 420)

question_en: A contractor inserts an arbitration clause in a residential contract that does not comply with B&P Code Section 7191. Who can the non-compliant provision be enforced against?
question_cn: 承包商在住宅合同中插入了一项不符合《加州商业与职业法典》第7191条规定的仲裁条款。该不合规条款可以对谁强制执行？

options.en: Both parties equally, with CSLB as arbitrator
options.cn: 双方同等适用，由加州州立承包商委员会（CSLB）担任仲裁者

options.en: The homeowner only
options.cn: 仅限房主

options.en: The licensee only
options.cn: 仅限持证人

options.en: Neither party, rendering it void entirely
options.cn: 对双方均不适用，条款完全无效

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7191(c) states that a non-compliant arbitration provision may not be enforceable against any person other than the licensee, meaning it can only be used against the contractor.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7191(c)条规定，不合规的仲裁条款不得对持证人以外的任何人强制执行，这意味着该条款只能对承包商使用。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7191(c) (Document p. 417, PDF p. 440)

question_en: During a home inspection, a home inspector notices yellow corrugated stainless steel tubing. What must the inspector include in the report?
question_cn: 在房屋检查期间，房屋检查员注意到黄色波纹不锈钢管。检查员必须在报告中包括什么内容？

options.en: An estimate of repair cost for the tubing
options.cn: 管道维修费用估算

options.en: A recommendation to immediately replace the tubing
options.cn: 建议立即更换管道

options.en: A referral to a licensed plumbing contractor
options.cn: 转介给有执照的管道承包商

options.en: The observation and a required manufacturer safety notification
options.cn: 观察结果和所需的制造商安全通知

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7196.2(a) requires the home inspector to include the observation of yellow corrugated stainless steel tubing and the specified notification about bonding and grounding by a licensed electrical contractor.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》规第7196.2(a)条要求房屋检查员必须包括对黄色波纹不锈钢管的观察以及关于通过有执照电气承包商进行接地和联结的指定通知。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7196.2(a) (Document p. 420, PDF p. 443)

question_en: A homeowner wants to sue a home inspector for breach of duty based on a faulty home inspection report. What is the maximum time the homeowner has to file suit?
question_cn: 一位房主想要因房屋检查报告存在缺陷而起诉房屋检查员违反职责。房主提出诉讼的最长期限是多少？

options.en: Two years from the date of inspection
options.cn: 自检查之日起两年

options.en: One year from close of escrow
options.cn: 自托管结束之日起一年

options.en: Four years from the date of inspection
options.cn: 自检查之日起四年

options.en: Three years from discovery of the defect
options.cn: 自发现缺陷之日起三年

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7199 states that legal action for breach of duty arising from a home inspection report must commence within four years from the date of the inspection.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7199条规定，因房屋检查报告引起的职责违反法律诉讼必须在检查之日起四年内提起。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7199 (Document p. 422, PDF p. 445)

question_en: A contract clause attempts to limit a home inspector's liability to the cost of the inspection report. What is the legal status of such a clause?
question_cn: 合同条款试图将房屋检查员的责任限制在检查报告的费用范围内。这样的条款的法律地位是什么？

options.en: Valid only for inspection reports under $500
options.cn: 仅适用于低于500美元的检查报告

options.en: Contrary to public policy and invalid
options.cn: 违反公共政策且无效

options.en: Valid if disclosed in at least 10-point bold type
options.cn: 如果以至少10号加粗字体披露，则有效

options.en: Enforceable if both parties sign the contract
options.cn: 如果双方签署合同，则可执行

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7198 explicitly states that contractual provisions limiting a home inspector's liability to the cost of the home inspection report are contrary to public policy and invalid.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7198条明确规定，将房屋检查员的责任限制在房屋检查报告费用范围内的合同条款违反公共政策且无效。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7198 (Document p. 422, PDF p. 445)

question_en: After a blanket bond's approval is rescinded, which disclosure must a licensee add to all home improvement contracts?
question_cn: 在整体保证金获批后被撤销时，执照持有人必须在所有家庭装修合同中添加哪项披露？

options.en: A notice identifying the new bonding company
options.cn: 识别新保证公司的通知

options.en: A three-day right of rescission notice
options.cn: 三天撤销权通知

options.en: The Mechanics' Lien Warning disclosure
options.cn: 工程留置权警告披露

options.en: A copy of the Registrar's rescission order
options.cn: 注册主任撤销令的副本

explanation_en: Section 858.8(f) requires that upon approval rescission, the licensee include the Mechanics' Lien Warning disclosure in all home improvement contracts subject to Section 7159.
explanation_cn: 第858.8(f)条规定，在批准被撤销时，执照持有人必须在所有受第7159条约束的家庭装修合同中包含工程留置权警告披露。
code_reference: 16 CCR Section 858.8(f); B&P Code Section 7159 (Document p. 466, PDF p. 489)

question_en: A contractor building a single-family residence for an owner who intends to occupy it for at least one year must provide a CGL insurance disclosure. When must this disclosure be provided?
question_cn: 为业主建造单户住宅且意图至少居住一年的承包商必须提供综合一般责任（CGL）保险披露。该披露应何时提供？

options.en: With both the bid and the contract
options.cn: 在投标和合同阶段均提供

options.en: With the bid only, before signing the contract
options.cn: 仅在签订合同之前的投标阶段提供

options.en: With the contract, not necessarily the bid
options.cn: 在合同阶段提供，不一定在投标阶段提供

options.en: Upon the owner's written request only
options.cn: 仅在业主书面要求时提供

explanation_en: Under Regulation 872(b) and B&P Code Section 7164, the CGL insurance disclosure for single-family residences must accompany every contract -- unlike home improvement contracts, there is no requirement to include it with the bid.
explanation_cn: 根据法规872(b)和《加州商业与职业法典》第7164条，单户住宅的CGL保险披露必须随每份合同一起提供——与家庭改进合同不同，没有要求必须随投标一起提供。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7164; CSLB Regulation 872(b) (Document p. 514, PDF p. 537)

question_en: A homeowner tells a contractor that only one of the two spouses on the deed needs to sign the PACE assessment contract. Which of the following is correct?
question_cn: 一位房主告诉承包商，产权上两位配偶中只有一人需要签署PACE评估合同。以下哪项是正确的？

options.en: One signature is sufficient if that spouse holds title
options.cn: 如果该配偶持有产权，则一人签字即可

options.en: A power of attorney from one spouse is legally sufficient
options.cn: 一方配偶的授权书在法律上足够

options.en: The program administrator may waive the co-owner requirement
options.cn: 项目管理方可以免除共有人签字要求

options.en: All property owners of record must sign the assessment contract
options.cn: 所有产权登记在册的房主都必须签署评估合同

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22003.5 defines an assessment contract as one entered into between all property owners of record and the public agency, making every recorded owner's signature mandatory.
explanation_cn: 《金融法规》第22003.5条将评估合同定义为由所有产权登记在册的房主与公共机构签订的合同，因此每位登记房主的签名都是必须的。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22003.5

question_en: A contractor begins marketing PACE financing to homeowners using promotional materials that were not created or approved by the program administrator. What is the most likely consequence under California law?
question_cn: 一位承包商开始向房主推广 PACE 融资，但使用的宣传材料不是由项目管理者创建或批准的。在加利福尼亚法律下，最可能的后果是什么？

options.en: The contractor is reclassified as a program administrator
options.cn: 承包商被重新归类为项目管理者

options.en: The contractor is now acting as a PACE solicitor
options.cn: 承包商现在作为 PACE 推销员行事

options.en: No consequence arises because advertising is always exempt
options.cn: 不会产生后果，因为广告始终免除

options.en: The contractor qualifies for an exemption as a clerical agent
options.cn: 承包商符合文书代理的豁免资格

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22017(c)(4) exempts advertising only when content is created, prepared, or approved by a program administrator and complies with the division. Using unapproved materials removes the exemption, making the contractor a PACE solicitor subject to authorization and compliance requirements.
explanation_cn: 《金融法典》第 22017(c)(4) 条规定，只有在内容由项目管理者创建、准备或批准并符合本部门规定时，广告才可享有豁免。使用未经批准的材料会取消豁免，使承包商成为需获得授权和遵守规定的 PACE 推销员。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22017

question_en: Under the California Financing Law, which of the following is the primary purpose of PACE program consumer protection provisions?
question_cn: 根据《加利福尼亚融资法》，以下哪项是 PACE 计划消费者保护规定的主要目的？

options.en: To restrict competition among PACE program administrators
options.cn: 限制 PACE 计划管理者之间的竞争

options.en: To limit the types of improvements eligible for PACE financing
options.cn: 限制符合 PACE 融资的改进类型

options.en: To establish maximum interest rates on PACE assessments
options.cn: 设定 PACE 评估的最高利率

options.en: To protect property owners from deceptive and misleading practices
options.cn: 保护房主免受欺骗性和误导性行为的侵害

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22001(a)(7) expressly states that one underlying purpose of the law is to protect property owners from deceptive and misleading practices that threaten the efficacy and viability of PACE financing programs.
explanation_cn: 《金融法典》第 22001(a)(7) 条明确指出，该法律的一个基本目的是保护房主免受威胁 PACE 融资计划有效性和可行性的欺骗性和误导性行为的侵害。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22001

question_en: The California Financing Law requires that it be construed liberally to promote its underlying purposes. Which of the following contractor actions is most consistent with this directive when a dispute arises over a PACE-financed project?
question_cn: 《加利福尼亚融资法》要求对其进行自由解释，以促进其基本目的。当涉及PACE融资项目的争议时，以下哪种承包商行为最符合这一指令？

options.en: Ensure the homeowner fully understands the financing terms
options.cn: 确保房主充分理解融资条款

options.en: Proceed with work before written disclosures are complete
options.cn: 在书面披露完成之前继续施工

options.en: Interpret the contract terms in favor of the contractor's position
options.cn: 按照对承包商有利的方式解释合同条款

options.en: Defer all disputes to the program administrator for resolution
options.cn: 将所有争议推迟给项目管理员解决

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22001(a)(7) directs liberal construction to protect property owners from deceptive and misleading practices. Ensuring the homeowner understands the financing terms before proceeding aligns with this statutory purpose and protects the contractor from claims of misrepresentation.
explanation_cn: 《金融法典》第22001(a)(7)条规定，应自由解释以保护物业所有者免受欺骗和误导性行为的影响。在开始施工前确保房主理解融资条款符合这一法定目的，并保护承包商免受虚假陈述的索赔。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22001

question_en: A PACE assessment contract includes a clause charging the property owner a fee for paying off the balance early. What must the program administrator do?
question_cn: PACE评估合同包含一条条款，向房主收取提前还清余额的费用。项目管理员必须做什么？

options.en: Disclose the prepayment penalty prominently in the contract
options.cn: 在合同中显著披露提前还款罚金

options.en: Remove the clause; prepayment penalties are prohibited
options.cn: 删除该条款；禁止提前还款罚金

options.en: Limit the early repayment fee to no more than 5 percent
options.cn: 将提前还款费用限制在不超过5%

options.en: Obtain written consent from the homeowner before including it
options.cn: 在包含该条款前获得房主书面同意

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22684(l) expressly prohibits assessment contracts from containing any penalty for early repayment. The offending clause must be removed before the contract can be executed.
explanation_cn: 《金融法》第22684(l)条明确禁止评估合同中包含任何提前还款罚金。在合同执行前，必须删除违规条款。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22684

question_en: Before a PACE assessment contract is signed, what property valuation information must be disclosed to the property owner?
question_cn: 在签署PACE评估合同之前，必须向产权所有者披露哪些物业估值信息？

options.en: The contractor's own estimate of the project's added value
options.cn: 承包商自己对项目增值的估算

options.en: The program administrator's market value determination
options.cn: 计划管理员对市场价值的确定

options.en: Only the loan-to-value ratio, not the underlying value
options.cn: 仅贷款价值比，而非基础价值

options.en: The county assessor's most recent tax-assessed value
options.cn: 县政府评估员最近的税务评估价值

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22685(b) requires the program administrator to disclose its market value determination to the property owner prior to signing the assessment contract.
explanation_cn: 《金融法》第22685(b)条要求计划管理员在签署评估合同之前，将其市场价值的确定披露给产权所有者。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22685

question_en: Under California Financial Code Section 22684, a PACE assessment contract term may not exceed which of the following?
question_cn: 根据加利福尼亚金融法典第22684条，PACE评估合同期限不得超过以下哪项？

options.en: The estimated useful life of the measure receiving the most funds
options.cn: 获得最多资金的措施的预计使用寿命

options.en: The remaining term of the property owner's existing mortgage
options.cn: 房地产所有者现有抵押贷款的剩余期限

options.en: Twenty-five years, as determined by the program administrator
options.cn: 由项目管理员确定的二十五年

options.en: A fixed statutory maximum of 30 years regardless of measures installed
options.cn: 无论安装的措施如何，法定固定最高期限为三十年

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22684(j) states that the assessment contract term shall not exceed the estimated useful life of the measure to which the greatest portion of disbursed funds is attributable.
explanation_cn: 金融法典第22684(j)条规定，评估合同期限不得超过获得最大资金拨款措施的预计使用寿命。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22684

question_en: Which of the following is a required topic in the six-hour PACE solicitor agent training program under California Financial Code Section 22681?
question_cn: 根据加利福尼亚州金融法典第22681条，以下哪个是六小时PACE推销代理培训项目中的必修主题？

options.en: Property tax assessment appeal procedures
options.cn: 财产税评估上诉程序

options.en: Senior financial abuse prevention and awareness
options.cn: 老年人财务滥用预防与意识

options.en: California contractor licensing examination preparation
options.cn: 加利福尼亚州承包商执照考试准备

options.en: Construction lien release procedures and mechanics
options.cn: 施工留置权解除程序和机制

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22681(c)(7) expressly lists senior financial abuse as a required topic in the six-hour PACE solicitor agent training program.
explanation_cn: 金融法典第22681(c)(7)条明确将老年人财务滥用列为六小时PACE推销代理培训项目的必修主题。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22681

question_en: A homeowner invokes the emergency HVAC provision to waive income verification requirements. Which of the following conditions must still be satisfied before funding can proceed?
question_cn: 房主调用紧急 HVAC 条款以免除收入验证要求。在资金可继续拨付之前，仍必须满足以下哪些条件？

options.en: A licensed engineer must certify the system as beyond repair
options.cn: 必须由持证工程师证明系统无法修复

options.en: The contractor must provide a separate emergency installation bond
options.cn: 承包商必须提供单独的紧急安装保证金

options.en: The property owner must waive their right to cancel the contract
options.cn: 物业所有者必须放弃其取消合同的权利

options.en: The commissioner must approve each individual emergency funding request
options.cn: 委员必须批准每一项单独的紧急资金请求

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22687(e)(5) requires the property owner to execute a waiver of the right to cancel and to confirm the emergency or immediate necessity during the oral confirmation of key terms call before the emergency waiver can apply.
explanation_cn: 《金融法》第22687(e)(5)条要求在紧急豁免适用之前，物业所有者必须签署取消权放弃书，并在关键条款口头确认通话中确认紧急情况或即时必要性。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22687

question_en: A spouse who is NOT on title to the property has income that the program administrator wants to count toward the PACE ability-to-pay determination. What must occur before that income can be considered?
question_cn: 未在房产产权上登记的配偶，其收入被项目管理员希望计入PACE偿付能力评估。在将该收入视为有效之前，必须发生什么？

options.en: The spouse must be added to the property title before closing
options.cn: 该配偶必须在交易完成前被添加到房产产权上

options.en: The spouse must provide written consent to income inclusion and verification
options.cn: 该配偶必须提供书面同意以包含其收入并进行收入验证

options.en: The contractor must disclose the income consideration in the home improvement contract
options.cn: 承包商必须在家庭装修合同中披露收入计入事项

options.en: The program administrator must obtain court authorization to use the income
options.cn: 项目管理员必须获得法院授权才能使用该收入

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22687(a)(3)(A) requires that any spouse or domestic partner who is not on title to the property must consent in writing to the inclusion of their income and to verification of that income before it may be used in the ability-to-pay determination.
explanation_cn: 财务法第22687(a)(3)(A)条规定，任何未在房产产权上登记的配偶或伴侣，在其收入可用于偿付能力评估之前，必须书面同意收入的计入及收入的验证。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22687

question_en: A contractor enrolled in a PACE program receives a citation for a disclosure violation. If the contractor takes no action within 30 days of receiving the citation, what happens?
question_cn: 参加PACE项目的承包商因披露违规收到通知。如果承包商在收到通知后30天内未采取任何行动，会发生什么？

options.en: The commissioner must file suit in superior court
options.cn: 专员必须在上级法院提起诉讼

options.en: The citation becomes a final order against the contractor
options.cn: 通知将成为对承包商的最终命令

options.en: The fine doubles and a new hearing is scheduled
options.cn: 罚款加倍，并安排新的听证会

options.en: The citation is automatically dismissed without penalty
options.cn: 通知将自动被撤销，无需处罚

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22707.5(c) states that if a licensee fails to notify the department of intent to request a hearing within 30 days of receipt, the citation is deemed final.
explanation_cn: 财务法第22707.5(c)条规定，如果持证人在收到通知后30天内未通知部门有意申请听证会，则该通知视为最终决定。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22707.5

question_en: The commissioner issues a desist-and-refrain order against a PACE contractor. Within how many days must the contractor file a written hearing request to prevent the order from becoming final?
question_cn: 专员对PACE承包商发布停止与禁止令。承包商必须在多少天内提交书面听证请求，以防止该命令成为最终决定？

options.en: Within 10 days after the order is served
options.cn: 命令送达后10天内

options.en: Within 30 days after the order is served
options.cn: 命令送达后30天内

options.en: Within 60 days after the order is served
options.cn: 命令送达后60天内

options.en: Within 15 days after the order is served
options.cn: 命令送达后15天内

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22712(a) states that if a written request for a hearing is filed within 30 days after the order is served, and no hearing is held within 30 days thereafter, the order is rescinded.
explanation_cn: 《金融法》第22712(a)条规定，如果在命令送达后30天内提交书面听证请求，并且随后30天内未举行听证会，则该命令将被撤销。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22712

question_en: A contractor enrolled in a PACE program is cited for a consumer disclosure violation. In addition to the fine, what other relief may the commissioner include in the citation?
question_cn: 一名注册于PACE计划的承包商因未向消费者披露信息而被引用。除了罚款外，专员在引文中还可以包括哪些其他救济？

options.en: Refunds, restitution, disgorgement, or damages for injured homeowners
options.cn: 向受害房主提供退款、赔偿、返还不当收益或损害赔偿

options.en: Mandatory enrollment in a state-approved contractor training course
options.cn: 强制参加经州批准的承包商培训课程

options.en: Criminal referral to the county district attorney
options.cn: 向县地方检察官提出刑事移送

options.en: Automatic revocation of PACE program enrollment
options.cn: 自动撤销PACE计划注册资格

explanation_en: Financial Code Section 22707.5(a) expressly authorizes the commissioner to include a claim for ancillary relief in a citation, including refunds, restitution, disgorgement, or damages on behalf of persons injured by the violation.
explanation_cn: 《金融法》第22707.5(a)条明确授权专员在引文中包括辅助救济请求，包括代表因违规行为受害的人提供退款、赔偿、返还不当收益或损害赔偿。
code_reference: Financial Code Section 22707.5

question_en: A specialty contractor is awarded a public works prime contract. Under what condition does the law permit this award?
question_cn: 专业承包商被授予公共工程总承包合同。法律在何种情况下允许授予此合同？

options.en: If the awarding authority approves a waiver
options.cn: 如果授予机构批准豁免

options.en: If all non-specialty work is incidental to the prime scope
options.cn: 如果所有非专业工作都是总承包范围的附带工作

options.en: If the contractor holds at least two license classifications
options.cn: 如果承包商持有至少两个执照类别

options.en: If the specialty work constitutes a majority of the project
options.cn: 如果专业工作占项目的主要部分

explanation_en: Under B&P Code Section 7059(b)(1), an awarding authority may not award a prime public works contract to a specialty contractor unless that contractor's classification constitutes a majority of the project. Work outside the specialty must be performed by licensed subcontractors.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州商业与职业法典》第7059(b)(1)条，授予机构不得将公共工程总承包合同授予专业承包商，除非该承包商的分类构成项目的主要部分。非专业工作必须由持牌分包商完成。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7059(b)(1) (Document p. 255, PDF p. 278)

question_en: A contractor hires an independent contractor owner-operator to perform excavation work on a public works project. Must the owner-operator be paid prevailing wages?
question_cn: 承包商雇用一名独立承包商业主运营商在公共工程项目上进行挖掘工作。业主运营商必须支付普遍工资吗？

options.en: No, only direct employees must be paid prevailing wages
options.cn: 不，只有直接雇员必须支付普遍工资

options.en: Yes, if the owner-operator performs covered work on the project
options.cn: 是的，如果业主运营商在项目上执行受覆盖的工作

options.en: No, owner-operators are exempt as independent contractors
options.cn: 不，业主运营商作为独立承包商可豁免

options.en: Yes, but only if a written agreement requires it
options.cn: 是的，但仅在书面协议要求的情况下

explanation_en: Under Labor Code Section 1771 and Section 2.3 of the DIR Public Works Manual, worker title or status is irrelevant. Coverage is determined by whether the individual performs skilled or unskilled labor on a public works project, including sole proprietors and owner-operators.
explanation_cn: 根据《劳动法》第1771条以及DIR《公共工程手册》第2.3条，工人的职称或身份无关紧要。是否适用取决于个人是否在公共工程项目上执行技术或非技术劳动，包括个体经营者和业主运营商。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1771; Labor Code Section 1723 (Document p. 3, PDF p. 9)

question_en: A working foreman on a public works project spends part of each day supervising workers and part of each day performing hands-on labor. How must the contractor compensate the foreman?
question_cn: 在一个公共工程项目中，一名在职工头每天部分时间监督工人，部分时间亲自进行劳动。承包商必须如何补偿这名工头？

options.en: At the foreman's regular salary rate for all hours worked
options.cn: 按工头的常规工资率支付所有工时

options.en: At the prevailing rate only during hours of hands-on labor
options.cn: 仅在亲自劳动的时间按现行工资率支付

options.en: At the prevailing wage rate for all hours on the project
options.cn: 项目所有工时按现行工资率支付

options.en: At whichever rate is higher, applied to all hours worked
options.cn: 以较高的工资率支付所有工作时间

explanation_en: Per DIR Public Works Manual Section 2.3 and Labor Code Section 1771, a 'working' foreman is entitled to prevailing wages for the time during which labor on the project is performed. The foreman's presence alone during supervisory-only hours does not trigger prevailing wage.
explanation_cn: 根据DIR《公共工程手册》第2.3节和《劳动法》第1771条，‘在职’工头有权在其执行项目劳动的时间内获得现行工资。仅在监督时间内工头的在场，并不触发现行工资要求。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1771; DIR Public Works Manual Section 2.3 (Document p. 4, PDF p. 10)

question_en: A salaried superintendent works overtime on a public works project on a Saturday. The superintendent's regular salary covers straight-time hours. What additional compensation is required?
question_cn: 一名领固定工资的主管在一个公共工程项目的星期六加班。主管的常规工资覆盖正常工时。需要什么额外补偿？

options.en: Time-and-a-half calculated from the regular salary rate
options.cn: 按常规工资率计算的1.5倍加班费

options.en: No additional pay if salary exceeds the prevailing rate
options.cn: 如果工资超过现行工资标准，则不支付额外工资

options.en: Double-time based on the prevailing straight-time hourly rate
options.cn: 按现行正常工时小时工资的双倍支付

options.en: The prevailing premium rate for Saturday hours per DIR
options.cn: 根据DIR的星期六工时现行加成工资率

explanation_en: Under DIR Public Works Manual Section 2.3.1, a salaried employee performing labor on Saturdays, Sundays, or holidays must be paid the required prevailing premium rates set forth in the General Prevailing Wage Determination issued by the Director of Industrial Relations, in addition to the regular salary.
explanation_cn: 根据DIR《公共工程手册》第2.3.1节，领固定工资的员工在星期六、星期日或节假日进行劳动，除了常规工资外，还必须支付《工业关系局局长发布的一般现行工资确定》中规定的现行加成工资率。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1771; DIR Public Works Manual Section 2.3.1 (Document p. 4, PDF p. 10)

question_en: A general contractor attempts to avoid prevailing wage requirements by subcontracting all trade work to specialty subcontractors. What is the legal result?
question_cn: 总承包商试图通过将所有专业工作分包给专业分包商来避免遵守现行工资要求。法律结果是什么？

options.en: Prevailing wage only applies to subcontractors with direct public contracts
options.cn: 现行工资仅适用于直接签订公共合同的分包商

options.en: Prevailing wage requirements still apply to all subcontracted work
options.cn: 现行工资要求仍适用于所有分包工作

options.en: The contractor is released from liability once work is subcontracted
options.cn: 一旦工作被分包，承包商就免于责任

options.en: Subcontractors set their own wage rates independently of the prime contract
options.cn: 分包商独立于总包合同自行设定工资标准

explanation_en: In O.G. Sansone v. Department of Transportation, the court held that prevailing wage laws apply to all workers on public projects and cannot be frustrated by subcontracting. Labor Code Section 1772 expressly covers subcontractors.
explanation_cn: 在 O.G. Sansone 诉交通部 案中，法院判决现行工资法适用于所有公共项目的工人，分包不能规避法律。劳动法第1772条明确涵盖分包商。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1771; Labor Code Section 1772; DIR Public Works Manual Section 2.2 (Document p. 3, PDF p. 9)

question_en: Which of the following projects is exempt from California's prevailing wage requirements due to its dollar value?
question_cn: 以下哪类项目因其金额而免于加利福尼亚州的最低工资要求？

options.en: A public works project valued at $5,000 or less
options.cn: 价值 5,000 美元或以下的公共工程项目

options.en: A public works project valued at $1,500 or less
options.cn: 价值 1,500 美元或以下的公共工程项目

options.en: A public works project valued at $2,500 or less
options.cn: 价值 2,500 美元或以下的公共工程项目

options.en: A public works project valued at $1,000 or less
options.cn: 价值 1,000 美元或以下的公共工程项目

explanation_en: Labor Code Section 1771 expressly exempts public works projects of one thousand dollars ($1,000) or less from the prevailing wage requirement.
explanation_cn: 《劳动法》第 1771 条明确规定，价值一千美元（$1,000）或以下的公共工程项目可免于最低工资要求。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1771 (Document p. 2, PDF p. 8)

question_en: A private construction contract involves a building that is privately owned, but 60% of its usable square footage is leased to a state agency. The lease preceded the construction contract. Does California prevailing wage law apply?
question_cn: 私人建筑合同涉及一栋私人拥有的建筑，但其可用面积的60%租给了州政府机构。租赁合同早于建设合同签订。加利福尼亚州的工资标准法适用吗？

options.en: Yes, because more than 50% is leased to a state agency
options.cn: 是的，因为超过50%的面积租给了州政府机构

options.en: No, unless the public agency directly funded the construction
options.cn: 否，除非公共机构直接资助了建设

options.en: No, because the property is privately owned and built
options.cn: 否，因为该物业是私人拥有且建设的

options.en: Yes, but only if public funds were loaned for the project
options.cn: 是的，但仅在项目获得公共资金贷款的情况下

explanation_en: Under Labor Code Section 1720.2, private construction on privately owned property is covered as public works when more than 50% of assignable square feet is leased to the state or a political subdivision and the lease was entered into prior to the construction contract.
explanation_cn: 根据《劳动法典》第1720.2条，当可分配平方英尺的50%以上租给州政府或政治分支机构，并且租赁合同在建设合同签订之前达成时，私人拥有物业上的私人建设也被视为公共工程。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1720.2 (Document p. 5, PDF p. 11)

question_en: A contractor hauls dirt excavated from a public works trench to a landfill where it is used to cover garbage. Is this hauling covered as public works under Labor Code Section 1720.3?
question_cn: 一名承包商将从公共工程沟槽挖出的泥土运送到垃圾填埋场，在那里用于覆盖垃圾。这种运输是否根据《劳动法》第1720.3条被视为公共工程？

options.en: No, because hauling is never covered as public works
options.cn: 不，因为运输从不被视为公共工程

options.en: No, because the dirt is being put to a useful purpose
options.cn: 不，因为这些泥土被用作有用的用途

options.en: Yes, all hauling from a public works site is covered
options.cn: 是的，从公共工程工地运送的所有物料都算作公共工程

options.en: Yes, because the excavation occurred on a public works project
options.cn: 是的，因为挖掘发生在公共工程项目上

explanation_en: The DIR's Public Works Coverage Determination (Case No. 2001-005) interprets 'refuse' as the worthless or useless part of something. Dirt used as landfill cover serves a useful purpose and therefore is not refuse under Labor Code Section 1720.3.
explanation_cn: DIR的公共工程覆盖范围裁定（案例编号2001-005）将“垃圾”解释为某物中无价值或无用的部分。用于填埋覆盖的泥土具有实际用途，因此根据《劳动法》第1720.3条不属于垃圾。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1720.3; DIR Public Works Case No. 2001-005 (Document p. 5, PDF p. 11)

question_en: A contractor receives a fee waiver from a public agency for permitting costs on a construction project. Does this constitute 'public funds' that could trigger prevailing wage requirements?
question_cn: 承包商在一个建筑项目上因许可费用从公共机构获得费用减免。这是否构成可能触发最低工资要求的“公共资金”？

options.en: No, because the waiver does not involve a cash transfer
options.cn: 不，因为减免不涉及现金转账

options.en: No, only direct money payments by the agency qualify as public funds
options.cn: 不，只有机构直接支付的资金才被视为公共资金

options.en: Yes, but only if the waiver exceeds $1,000 in value
options.cn: 是的，但仅当减免金额超过1000美元时才算

options.en: Yes, fees waived by a public agency are a form of public funds
options.cn: 是的，公共机构减免的费用属于公共资金的一种形式

explanation_en: Labor Code Section 1720(b)(4) expressly includes fees or costs that are reduced, waived, or forgiven by the state or political subdivision within the definition of 'public funds,' triggering prevailing wage requirements.
explanation_cn: 《劳动法》第1720(b)(4)条明确将州或政治分权机构减免、豁免或免除的费用或成本纳入“公共资金”的定义，从而触发最低工资要求。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1720(b)(4) (Document p. 6, PDF p. 12)

question_en: A federally funded construction project in California is controlled and carried out by a California awarding body. Which prevailing wage rate applies?
question_cn: 由加利福尼亚州授予机构控制和执行的加利福尼亚州联邦资助建设项目。适用哪种现行工资率？

options.en: The federal Davis-Bacon rate applies to federally funded work
options.cn: 联邦戴维斯-贝肯（Davis-Bacon）工资率适用于联邦资助的工作

options.en: The lower of the state or federal prevailing wage rate
options.cn: 州或联邦现行工资率中较低者

options.en: No prevailing wage applies when federal funds are involved
options.cn: 当涉及联邦资金时，不适用现行工资

options.en: The state rate when it exceeds the federal rate
options.cn: 当州工资率高于联邦工资率时适用州工资率

explanation_en: Under 8 CCR Section 16001(b) and DIR Public Works Manual Section 2.5.2, state prevailing wage rates apply when they are higher, on federally funded or assisted projects controlled or carried out by California awarding bodies.
explanation_cn: 根据《加利福尼亚法规汇编》第8卷第16001(b)条和DIR《公共工程手册》第2.5.2节，当联邦资助或协助项目由加利福尼亚授予机构控制或执行时，如果州现行工资率较高，则适用州现行工资率。
code_reference: 8 CCR Section 16001(b); DIR Public Works Manual Section 2.5.2 (Document p. 7, PDF p. 13)

question_en: A volunteer working for a 501(c)(3) organization on a public works project receives free meals and transportation from the project sponsor. Does this person retain volunteer status?
question_cn: 一名在 501(c)(3) 组织为公共工程项目工作的志愿者，从项目赞助方那里获得免费餐食和交通。这人是否仍保持志愿者身份？

options.en: No, any benefit provided automatically eliminates volunteer status
options.cn: 不，任何提供的福利都会自动取消志愿者身份

options.en: Yes, if the benefits are not a substitute for compensation
options.cn: 是的，如果这些福利不是作为补偿的替代

options.en: Yes, volunteer status is always retained for nonprofit workers
options.cn: 是的，非营利组织工作人员始终保留志愿者身份

options.en: No, only nominal nonmonetary awards are permitted for volunteers
options.cn: 不，志愿者只能获得象征性的非货币奖励

explanation_en: Under Labor Code Section 1720.4(a)(1)(B), a volunteer may receive reasonable meals, lodging, transportation, and incidental expenses without losing volunteer status, as long as those benefits are not a substitute form of compensation in the overall context.
explanation_cn: 根据《劳动法典》第 1720.4(a)(1)(B) 条，志愿者可以获得合理的餐食、住宿、交通和杂费，而不会失去志愿者身份，只要这些福利在整体上不是作为补偿的替代形式。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1720.4(a)(1)(B) (Document p. 9, PDF p. 15)

question_en: A 501(c)(3) organization uses volunteer labor on a public works project but also employs paid workers for construction on the same project. What is the prevailing wage consequence?
question_cn: 一家501(c)(3)组织在一个公共工程项目中使用志愿者劳动力，但在同一项目中也雇佣有偿工人进行施工。这会有什么影响？

options.en: Volunteer status is unaffected as long as the work roles differ
options.cn: 只要工作角色不同，志愿者身份不受影响

options.en: The volunteers lose their exempt status and must receive prevailing wages
options.cn: 志愿者失去免税身份，必须获得普遍工资

options.en: The organization must pay prevailing wages only to paid workers
options.cn: 组织只需向有偿工人支付普遍工资

options.en: Only the paid workers must receive prevailing wages on the project
options.cn: 项目中只有有偿工人必须获得普遍工资

explanation_en: Under Labor Code Section 1720.4(a)(1)(C), a volunteer may not be employed for compensation at any time on the same project doing construction-related work. Mixing paid and volunteer roles on the same project eliminates the volunteer exemption.
explanation_cn: 根据《劳动法》第1720.4(a)(1)(C)条，志愿者在同一项目中从事与施工相关的工作时，不得领取报酬。在同一项目中混合有偿和志愿者角色会取消志愿者豁免资格。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1720.4(a)(1)(C) (Document p. 9, PDF p. 15)

question_en: A janitorial company performs routine vacuuming and litter removal at a publicly owned facility under contract. Is this work subject to California prevailing wage requirements?
question_cn: 一家清洁公司根据合同在公有设施执行日常吸尘和垃圾清理工作。此类工作是否需要遵守加利福尼亚州的最低工资规定？

options.en: Yes, all work at publicly owned facilities is covered
options.cn: 是的，所有公有设施的工作都适用

options.en: Yes, maintenance work always triggers prevailing wage obligations
options.cn: 是的，维护工作总是触发最低工资义务

options.en: No, routine recurring janitorial services are specifically excluded
options.cn: 不，日常定期的清洁服务被明确排除在外

options.en: No, only construction-related maintenance requires prevailing wages
options.cn: 不，只有与施工相关的维护才需要最低工资

explanation_en: Under 8 CCR Section 16000 and DIR Public Works Manual Section 2.8.3, routine, recurring janitorial services such as vacuuming and litter removal at a public facility are expressly excluded from prevailing wage requirements.
explanation_cn: 根据8 CCR第16000条和DIR公共工程手册第2.8.3节，像在公有设施进行的吸尘和垃圾清理等日常、定期清洁服务被明确排除在最低工资要求之外。
code_reference: 8 CCR Section 16000; DIR Public Works Manual Section 2.8.3 (Document p. 10, PDF p. 16)

question_en: A chartered city awards a public works contract entirely funded by local city funds for a project within city limits. Under what circumstances would state prevailing wage laws still apply?
question_cn: 一座特许市授予一个完全由当地市资金资助的公共工程合同，用于市界内的项目。在什么情况下州级最低工资法仍然适用？

options.en: State prevailing wage applies if the project is a statewide concern
options.cn: 如果项目涉及全州事务，则适用州级最低工资

options.en: State prevailing wage applies only when the contractor works in multiple cities
options.cn: 仅当承包商在多个城市工作时，州级最低工资才适用

options.en: State prevailing wage applies only if federal funds are used
options.cn: 仅当使用联邦资金时，州级最低工资才适用

options.en: State prevailing wage never applies to chartered city projects
options.cn: 州级最低工资永远不适用于特许市项目

explanation_en: Under DIR Public Works Manual Section 2.9 and California Constitution Article XI Section 5, a chartered city may exempt only projects that are purely municipal affairs. Courts apply a three-factor test—extra-municipal control, fund source, and project nature—and if the project is a statewide concern, state prevailing wage requirements apply.
explanation_cn: 根据DIR《公共工程手册》第2.9节和加利福尼亚宪法第XI条第5节，特许市只能豁免纯粹的市政事务项目。法院采用三因素测试——超市事务控制、资金来源和项目性质——如果项目涉及全州事务，则应适用州级最低工资要求。
code_reference: California Constitution Article XI Section 5; DIR Public Works Manual Section 2.9 (Document p. 11, PDF p. 17)

question_en: Which of the following workers performing labor on a public works project is NOT entitled to prevailing wages?
question_cn: 以下哪类在公共工程项目中劳作的工人不享有普遍工资待遇？

options.en: A sole proprietor doing excavation on a public school project
options.cn: 在公立学校项目上进行挖掘工作的独资经营者

options.en: A county employee performing work with the county's own forces
options.cn: 使用县自身劳力进行工作的县雇员

options.en: A subcontractor's employee repairing a public highway
options.cn: 修理公共公路的分包商员工

options.en: A company president doing framing on the project
options.cn: 在项目上进行框架工作的公司总裁

explanation_en: Labor Code Section 1771 and DIR Public Works Manual Section 2.8.2 expressly exempt work carried out by a public agency with its own forces. A county employee performing work under the county's own forces falls within this exclusion.
explanation_cn: 《劳动法》第1771条和DIR《公共工程手册》第2.8.2条明确豁免由公共机构使用自身劳力完成的工作。使用县自身劳力进行工作的县雇员属于此豁免范围。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1771; DIR Public Works Manual Section 2.8.2 (Document p. 10, PDF p. 16)

question_en: A private developer builds a solar energy facility on state-owned land. The state will purchase 55% of the energy generated. Is this construction subject to California prevailing wage requirements?
question_cn: 一家私人开发商在州有土地上建设太阳能设施。州政府将购买55%的发电量。这项建设是否须遵守加利福尼亚州的最低工资要求？

options.en: Yes, but only if the project also receives a public subsidy or grant
options.cn: 是的，但仅当该项目也获得公共补贴或拨款时

options.en: No, because the developer holds a private construction contract
options.cn: 不，因为开发商持有私人施工合同

options.en: Yes, on state land with state purchasing over 50% of energy
options.cn: 是的，当项目在州土地上，并且州购买超过50%的能源时

options.en: No, unless the state directly funds more than half the construction cost
options.cn: 不，除非州政府直接资助超过一半的建设费用

explanation_en: Labor Code Section 1720.6 covers private contracts for renewable energy construction on state-owned property where 50% or more of the energy generated is purchased by the state or political subdivision. Both conditions are met here.
explanation_cn: 劳动法典第1720.6条涵盖了在州有财产上进行可再生能源建设的私人合同，前提是州或政治分区购买50%或以上的发电量。这两个条件在这里都满足。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1720.6 (Document p. 6, PDF p. 12)

question_en: A public works contractor receives a written request from the Labor Commissioner for certified payroll records. Within how many days must the contractor furnish those records?
question_cn: 一名公共工程承包商收到劳动专员关于认证工资记录的书面请求。承包商必须在多少天内提供这些记录？

options.en: Within 14 calendar days of receipt
options.cn: 自收到之日起 14 个日历日内

options.en: Within 10 calendar days of receipt
options.cn: 自收到之日起 10 个日历日内

options.en: Within 30 calendar days of receipt
options.cn: 自收到之日起 30 个日历日内

options.en: Within 5 calendar days of receipt
options.cn: 自收到之日起 5 个日历日内

explanation_en: Labor Code Section 1776(d) requires contractors to furnish certified copies of payroll records within ten days after receipt of a written request. Under 8 CCR Section 16000, 'days' means calendar days unless otherwise specified.
explanation_cn: 《劳动法》第1776(d)条要求承包商在收到书面请求后的十天内提供工资记录的认证副本。根据《加州法典》第8编CCR第16000条，“天”指日历日，除非另有说明。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1776(d) (Document p. 15, PDF p. 21)

question_en: A subcontractor on a public works project has been electronically submitting eCPRs monthly as required. The Labor Commissioner then sends a written request for full certified payroll records. Must the subcontractor also respond to the written request?
question_cn: 公共工程项目的分包商已按要求每月以电子方式提交 eCPR。然后，劳动专员会发出书面请求，要求提供完整的认证工资记录。分包商是否也必须回应书面请求？

options.en: No, only the general contractor must respond to written requests
options.cn: 不，只有总承包商必须回应书面请求

options.en: Yes, both obligations apply independently and simultaneously
options.cn: 是的，这两项义务是独立且同时适用的

options.en: Yes, but only after the awarding body approves the request
options.cn: 是的，但仅在授标机构批准请求后

options.en: No, eCPR submission satisfies all payroll record obligations
options.cn: 不，eCPR 提交已满足所有工资记录义务

explanation_en: Labor Code Section 1771.4(a)(3) and Section 1776(d) create distinct obligations. The DIR Manual expressly states that a contractor furnishing eCPRs is not excused from timely furnishing full certified payroll records within ten days of a written request.
explanation_cn: 《劳动法》第 1771.4(a)(3) 条和第 1776(d) 条规定了不同的义务。DIR 手册明确指出，提供 eCPR 的承包商并不能免除在收到书面请求后十天内及时提供完整的认证工资记录的义务。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1776(d); Labor Code Section 1771.4(a)(3) (Document p. 17, PDF p. 23)

question_en: What is the maximum monetary penalty a contractor can face for failing to electronically submit certified payroll records (eCPRs) on a single public works project?
question_cn: 承包商因未能在单个公共工程项目上电子提交认证工资记录（eCPRs）可能面临的最高罚款是多少？

options.en: Up to $2,500 per project
options.cn: 每个项目最高2,500美元

options.en: Up to $5,000 per project
options.cn: 每个项目最高5,000美元

options.en: Up to $1,000 per project
options.cn: 每个项目最高1,000美元

options.en: Up to $10,000 per project
options.cn: 每个项目最高10,000美元

explanation_en: Labor Code Section 1771.4(a)(3)(B) imposes a penalty of $100 for each day of non-compliance, with a cap of $5,000 per project. Penalties accrue only against the contractor or subcontractor that failed to furnish eCPRs.
explanation_cn: 劳动法典第1771.4(a)(3)(B)条规定，对于每一天的不合规行为将处以100美元的罚款，每个项目的罚款上限为5,000美元。罚款仅针对未能提供eCPRs的承包商或分包商。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1771.4(a)(3)(B) (Document p. 17, PDF p. 23)

question_en: A contractor's payroll records list each worker's classification only as 'journeyperson' or 'apprentice' without referencing the Director's published craft classification titles. How will the Labor Commissioner treat these records?
question_cn: 承包商的工资记录仅将每位工人的分类列为“技术工人”或“学徒”，而未引用主管部门发布的工种分类名称。劳工专员将如何处理这些记录？

options.en: Adequate, if the worker's hourly rate is correct
options.cn: 适当，如果工人的小时工资正确

options.en: Inadequate, because the Director's craft titles are missing
options.cn: 不适当，因为缺少主管部门的工种名称

options.en: Adequate, if the awarding body approves the format
options.cn: 适当，如果授奖机构批准该格式

options.en: Inadequate, but no penalties apply for classification errors
options.cn: 不适当，但分类错误不适用处罚

explanation_en: Labor Code Section 1776(a) and 8 CCR Section 16203 require payroll records to identify the Director's published classification title (e.g., 'Laborer Group 1' or 'Carpenter'). Records using only status labels like 'journeyperson' are expressly deemed inadequate by the DIR Manual.
explanation_cn: 《劳动法》第1776(a)条和8 CCR 第16203条要求工资记录必须标明主管部门发布的工种名称（例如，“劳工组1”或“木匠”）。仅使用诸如“技术工人”之类状态标签的记录，被DIR手册明确视为不适当。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1776(a); 8 CCR Section 16203 (Document p. 13, PDF p. 19)

question_en: How frequently must a contractor electronically submit certified payroll records (eCPRs) while work is actively being performed on a public works project?
question_cn: 承包商在公共工程项目施工期间，必须多频率地电子提交认证工资记录（eCPR）？

options.en: At project completion, in a single submission
options.cn: 在项目完成时，单次提交

options.en: Monthly, or more often if the contract requires
options.cn: 每月提交，或者如果合同要求则更频繁

options.en: Weekly, or more often if the contract requires
options.cn: 每周提交，或者如果合同要求则更频繁

options.en: Quarterly, unless the awarding body requests otherwise
options.cn: 每季度提交，除非授予机构另有要求

explanation_en: Labor Code Section 1771.4(a)(3)(A)(i) requires eCPRs to be submitted at least monthly—meaning at least once every 30 days while work is being performed—and more frequently if the contract with the awarding body so specifies.
explanation_cn: 《劳动法》第1771.4(a)(3)(A)(i)条款要求至少每月提交一次eCPR——也就是说，在施工期间，每30天至少提交一次——如果与授予机构的合同另有规定，则需更频繁提交。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1771.4(a)(3)(A)(i) (Document p. 16, PDF p. 22)

question_en: A contractor fails to provide certified payroll records after a written Labor Commissioner request. Penalties accrue at $100 per day multiplied by the number of workers listed. When does the penalty period END if the contractor never produces the records?
question_cn: 如果承包商在收到书面劳动专员请求后未能提供认证的工资单记录，每天按每名列出的工人$100计罚。 如果承包商从未提供记录，罚款期何时结束？

options.en: When the contractor finally achieves strict compliance
options.cn: 当承包商最终完全遵守规定时

options.en: On the date the project's final payment is released
options.cn: 在项目最终付款发放的日期

options.en: On the date the CWPA is served on the contractor
options.cn: 在CWPA送达承包商的日期

options.en: On the date the written request was originally sent
options.cn: 在书面请求最初发送的日期

explanation_en: Under Labor Code Section 1776(h), if a contractor fails to comply with a CPR request—including follow-up requests for underlying payroll records—the penalty continues beyond the CWPA service date and runs until strict compliance is effectuated.
explanation_cn: 根据《劳动法》第1776(h)条，如果承包商未能遵守CPR请求——包括对底层工资记录的跟进请求——罚款将超出CWPA送达日期并持续至完全遵守为止。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1776(h) (Document p. 19, PDF p. 25)

question_en: Which specific information is required on public works certified payroll records under Labor Code Section 1776(a) but is NOT required on routine itemized wage statements under Labor Code Section 226?
question_cn: 根据《劳动法》第1776(a)条款，公共工程认证工资记录需要哪些具体信息，而《劳动法》第226条例常规明细工资单则不需要？

options.en: Straight time and overtime hours worked daily
options.cn: 每天工作的正常工时和加班工时

options.en: The actual cash wages paid each week
options.cn: 每周实际支付的现金工资

options.en: The employee's full social security number
options.cn: 员工的完整社会保障号码

options.en: The employee's name and home address
options.cn: 员工的姓名和家庭住址
