explanation_en: Labor Code Section 226(a) limits itemized statements to the last four digits of the social security number. Labor Code Section 1776(a) has not been similarly amended and still requires the full social security number on public works certified payroll records.
explanation_cn: 《劳动法》第226(a)条款将明细工资单限制为社会保障号码的最后四位。《劳动法》第1776(a)条款没有进行类似修订，仍然要求在公共工程认证工资记录中提供完整的社会保障号码。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1776(a); Labor Code Section 226(a) (Document p. 21, PDF p. 27)

question_en: A public works contractor provides certified payroll records in response to a written Labor Commissioner request, but the records are not verified under penalty of perjury. What is the consequence?
question_cn: 当公共工程承包商根据书面劳动专员的要求提供经过认证的工资记录，但这些记录未经过伪证处罚下的核实，会有什么后果？

options.en: The records are deemed inadequate and penalties may apply
options.cn: 这些记录被视为不充分，并可能会受到处罚

options.en: The contractor gets a 30-day extension to re-certify
options.cn: 承包商可获得 30 天的延期重新认证

options.en: The awarding body must cure the deficiency on the contractor's behalf
options.cn: 授标机关必须代表承包商纠正缺陷

options.en: The records are accepted with a written warning only
options.cn: 这些记录仅在书面警告下被接受

explanation_en: Labor Code Section 1776(b) requires payroll records to be certified—verified by written declaration under penalty of perjury. The DIR Manual expressly states that uncertified payroll records furnished to the Labor Commissioner are inadequate, subjecting the contractor to monetary penalties under Section 1776(h).
explanation_cn: 《劳动法》第1776(b)条要求工资记录必须经过认证——通过书面声明并在伪证处罚下进行核实。《DIR 手册》明确指出，提交给劳动专员的未经认证的工资记录被视为不充分，使承包商根据第1776(h)条面临金钱处罚。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1776(b); 8 CCR Section 16000 (Document p. 13, PDF p. 19)

question_en: When the Labor Commissioner provides certified payroll records to the public or another public agency, what personal information must be redacted before disclosure?
question_cn: 当劳工专员向公众或其他公共机构提供经认证的工资记录时，哪些个人信息必须在披露前被删除？

options.en: Social security numbers only, leaving names and addresses visible
options.cn: 仅社保号码，保留姓名和地址可见

options.en: Worker wage rates and overtime hours only
options.cn: 仅工人工资和加班小时数

options.en: Worker names, addresses, and social security numbers
options.cn: 工人的姓名、地址和社保号码

options.en: Contractor license numbers and project addresses only
options.cn: 仅承包商执照号码和项目地址

explanation_en: Labor Code Section 1776(e) and 8 CCR Section 16403 both require that CPRs be marked or obliterated to prevent disclosure of workers' names, addresses, and social security numbers before being made available to the public or other public agencies.
explanation_cn: 《劳动法》第1776(e)条和《加州法规》第8卷第16403条均要求在向公众或其他公共机构提供经济工资记录之前，必须标记或抹去工人的姓名、地址和社保号码以防止泄露。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1776(e); 8 CCR Section 16403 (Document p. 20, PDF p. 26)

question_en: A joint labor-management committee established under the Federal Labor Management Cooperation Act requests copies of certified payroll records. Which personal worker information may still appear in those copies?
question_cn: 根据《联邦劳资合作法》成立的劳资联合委员会请求获得经过认证的工资记录副本。哪些个人工人信息仍可能出现在这些副本中？

options.en: Worker names and social security numbers only
options.cn: 仅工人的姓名和社会安全号码

options.en: Full social security numbers and home addresses
options.cn: 完整的社会安全号码和家庭住址

options.en: Worker names and home addresses, but not SSNs
options.cn: 工人的姓名和家庭住址，但不包括社会安全号码

options.en: No personal information; all must be fully redacted
options.cn: 无个人信息；所有内容必须完全屏蔽

explanation_en: Labor Code Section 1776(e) creates a limited exception for joint labor-management committees: social security numbers must still be redacted, but workers' addresses need not be obliterated—unlike the general public disclosure rule that requires redacting names, addresses, and SSNs.
explanation_cn: 《劳动法》第1776(e)条为劳资联合委员会创建了有限例外：社会安全号码仍必须屏蔽，但工人的住址无需抹去——不同于一般公开披露规则，该规则要求屏蔽姓名、地址和社会安全号码。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1776(e) (Document p. 20, PDF p. 26)

question_en: A public works contractor submits payroll records using its own computer-generated printouts rather than the Labor Commissioner's official Form A-1-131. Under what condition are these printouts acceptable?
question_cn: 公共工程承包商使用自己电脑生成的打印工资记录，而不是劳工专员的官方表格 A-1-131 提交工资记录。在什么情况下这些打印件是可以接受的？

options.en: Only if the awarding body pre-approves the alternate format
options.cn: 只有在授予机构事先批准替代格式的情况下

options.en: If they contain the same information and are properly certified
options.cn: 如果它们包含相同的信息并且经过适当认证

options.en: Only if the printout is filed within five days of completion
options.cn: 只有在工程完成后五天内提交打印件的情况下

options.en: Never; only the official DIR form is acceptable
options.cn: 从不；只有官方 DIR 表格才可接受

explanation_en: Labor Code Section 1776(c) allows contractors to use payroll record printouts as an alternative to Form A-1-131, provided the documents contain the same information as the official form and are certified in the manner specified at 8 CCR Section 16000.
explanation_cn: 根据劳动法第 1776(c) 条款，承包商可以使用工资记录打印件作为 A-1-131 表格的替代，只要这些文件包含与官方表格相同的信息，并且按照 8 CCR 第 16000 条规定的方式进行认证。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1776(c); 8 CCR Section 16000 (Document p. 19, PDF p. 25)

question_en: A University of California project involves private companies building subsidized faculty housing on university-owned land. Which prevailing wage outcome is most likely based on California case law?
question_cn: 加利福尼亚大学的一个项目涉及私人公司在大学拥有的土地上建造补贴的教职工住房。根据加利福尼亚州案例法，最可能的普遍工资结果是什么？

options.en: The exemption never applies when the UC contracts out work
options.cn: 当加州大学将工作外包时，此豁免从不适用

options.en: The exemption likely applies as a core university function
options.cn: 该豁免可能适用于作为核心大学功能

options.en: Prevailing wage applies as a matter of statewide concern
options.cn: 由于涉及全州性关注事项，因此适用普遍工资

options.en: Prevailing wage applies because private employees are involved
options.cn: 由于涉及私人雇员，因此适用普遍工资

explanation_en: Under Regents v. Aubry (1996) 42 Cal.App.4th 579, cited in DIR Manual Section 2.10, the university affairs exemption was upheld for subsidized married student and faculty/staff housing on university-owned land because the project was deemed part of the university's core educational function rather than a statewide concern.
explanation_cn: 根据 Regents v. Aubry (1996) 42 Cal.App.4th 579 案（在 DIR 手册第 2.10 节中引用），大学事务豁免在大学拥有土地上的补贴已婚学生及教职工住房项目中得到维持，因为该项目被认为是大学核心教育功能的一部分，而非全州性关注事项。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1720; DIR Public Works Manual Section 2.10 (Document p. 12, PDF p. 18)

question_en: If a University of California bid document or contract expressly requires payment of prevailing wages, what conclusion will the Labor Commissioner draw about the university affairs exemption?
question_cn: 如果加利福尼亚大学的投标文件或合同明确要求支付普遍工资，劳动专员将对大学事务豁免作何结论？

options.en: The exemption is waived only for the prime contractor
options.cn: 该豁免仅对总承包商放弃

options.en: The exemption does not exist and prevailing wage is enforced
options.cn: 豁免不存在，并执行普遍工资

options.en: The exemption still applies if the UC later changes its mind
options.cn: 如果加州大学后来改变主意，豁免仍然适用

options.en: The exemption applies regardless of what the contract states
options.cn: 无论合同怎么规定，豁免都适用

explanation_en: DIR Manual Section 2.10 expressly states that if the University's bid documents or contract requires prevailing wage payment, the Labor Commissioner will conclude the exemption does not exist and will enforce prevailing wage requirements on the project.
explanation_cn: DIR手册第2.10节明确指出，如果大学的投标文件或合同要求支付普遍工资，劳动专员将认定豁免不存在，并将在该项目上执行普遍工资要求。
code_reference: DIR Public Works Manual Section 2.10 (Document p. 13, PDF p. 19)

question_en: After a public works project is completed, within how many days must a contractor submit its final electronic certified payroll records (eCPRs)?
question_cn: 公共工程项目完成后，承包商必须在多少天内提交最终的电子认证工资记录（eCPRs）？

options.en: Within 60 days after the final day of work
options.cn: 在最后工作日后的60天内

options.en: Within 10 days after the final day of work
options.cn: 在最后工作日后的10天内

options.en: Within 30 days after the final day of work
options.cn: 在最后工作日后的30天内

options.en: Within 90 days after project acceptance by the agency
options.cn: 在机构验收项目后的90天内

explanation_en: Labor Code Section 1771.4(a)(3)(A)(i) requires contractors to submit eCPRs at least once every 30 days while work is being performed and within 30 days after the final day of work performed on the project.
explanation_cn: 《劳动法》第1771.4(a)(3)(A)(i)条要求承包商在施工期间至少每30天提交一次eCPRs，并在项目最后一天工作后的30天内提交。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1771.4(a)(3)(A)(i) (Document p. 16, PDF p. 22)

question_en: A contractor is penalized for failing to timely furnish certified payroll records. The penalty is calculated at $100 per day. What two factors are multiplied by that daily rate to determine the total assessment?
question_cn: 承包商因未能及时提供经认证的工资记录而受到处罚。罚款按每天 100 美元计算。要确定总评估额，需要将哪些两个因素乘以每天的费率？

options.en: The number of subcontractors and the project duration
options.cn: 分包商数量和项目持续时间

options.en: The contract value and the number of tardy submissions
options.cn: 合同价值和逾期提交次数

options.en: The number of violations and the contractor's license classification
options.cn: 违规次数和承包商执照类别

options.en: The number of penalty days and the number of workers
options.cn: 罚款天数和工人数

explanation_en: DIR Manual Section 3.1.9 states the assessment is calculated by multiplying total penalty days times the number of workers listed on the tardy CPRs, times $100. Penalty days run from the day after the ten-day response period expires through the date the Labor Commissioner receives the records.
explanation_cn: DIR 手册第 3.1.9 节指出，总评估额的计算方法是将总罚款天数乘以逾期工资记录中列出的工人数，再乘以 100 美元。罚款天数从十天回应期到期后的第二天开始计算，直到劳动专员收到记录为止。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1776(h); DIR Public Works Manual Section 3.1.9 (Document p. 19, PDF p. 25)

question_en: A contractor knowingly fails to employ DAS-registered apprentices on a public works project. What is the maximum daily penalty for each full calendar day of noncompliance?
question_cn: 承包商在公共工程项目中明知故犯地未雇用 DAS 注册学徒。每一完整日历日的不合规行为的最高日处罚金额是多少？

options.en: Up to $300 per day of noncompliance
options.cn: 每天不合规行为最高可达 300 美元

options.en: Up to $500 per day of noncompliance
options.cn: 每天不合规行为最高可达 500 美元

options.en: Up to $100 per day of noncompliance
options.cn: 每天不合规行为最高可达 100 美元

options.en: Up to $200 per day of noncompliance
options.cn: 每天不合规行为最高可达 200 美元

explanation_en: Labor Code Section 1777.7 explicitly authorizes monetary penalties of up to $300 for each full calendar day of knowing noncompliance with apprenticeship requirements.
explanation_cn: 劳动法典第 1777.7 条明确授权，对于明知不遵守学徒要求的情况，每一完整日历日的罚款最高可达 300 美元。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1777.7 (Document p. 27, PDF p. 33)

question_en: A contractor is debarred for apprenticeship violations on a public works project. What is the maximum debarment period the contractor may face?
question_cn: 承包商因在公共工程项目中违反学徒制度而被禁止承包。承包商可能面临的最长期限是多少？

options.en: Up to three years from the violation date
options.cn: 从违规之日起最多三年

options.en: Up to two years from the violation date
options.cn: 从违规之日起最多两年

options.en: Up to five years from the violation date
options.cn: 从违规之日起最多五年

options.en: Up to one year from the violation date
options.cn: 从违规之日起最多一年

explanation_en: Labor Code Section 1777.7 provides that a contractor who knowingly violates apprenticeship requirements may be debarred from bidding on or performing public works for up to three years.
explanation_cn: 劳工法典第1777.7条规定，明知违反学徒要求的承包商可能被禁止竞标或从事公共工程最长三年。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1777.7 (Document p. 27, PDF p. 33)

question_en: Which of the following public works contracts is exempt from apprenticeship employment requirements under California law?
question_cn: 根据加利福尼亚州法律，下列哪类公共工程合同可豁免学徒就业要求？

options.en: A general contractor contract valued at $25,000 or less
options.cn: 价值 25,000 美元或以下的一般承包合同

options.en: Any subcontract on a federally funded public project
options.cn: 任意联邦资助的公共项目分包合同

options.en: A specialty subcontract valued at $50,000 or more
options.cn: 价值 50,000 美元或以上的专业分包合同

options.en: A specialty subcontract under $30,000 not bid through a GC
options.cn: 通过一般承包商未招标的、价值低于 30,000 美元的专业分包合同

explanation_en: Labor Code Section 1777.5(o) exempts specialty contractors not bidding through a general or prime contractor when their contract is less than $30,000.
explanation_cn: 劳动法典第 1777.5(o) 条规定，当合同低于 30,000 美元且未通过一般或主要承包商投标时，专业承包商可获豁免。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1777.5(o) (Document p. 27, PDF p. 33)

question_en: A contractor first employs a journey-level electrician on a public works project on June 1 but never submits DAS Form 140 for that craft. When does the first penalty day for the DAS Form 140 violation begin?
question_cn: 一名承包商在公共工程项目中于6月1日首次雇用了一名具备职业资历的电工，但从未为该工种提交DAS表格140。DAS表格140违规的首个罚款日从何时开始？

options.en: June 1, the day the journeyperson first worked
options.cn: 6月1日，即工匠首次工作之日

options.en: June 2, the calendar day after the deadline
options.cn: 6月2日，即截止日期后的日历日

options.en: June 11, ten days after the journeyperson starts
options.cn: 6月11日，即工匠开始工作的十天后

options.en: The date the Labor Commissioner opens an investigation
options.cn: 劳工专员展开调查的日期

explanation_en: Per DIR Public Works Manual Section 3.3.1.2, the first penalty day is the calendar day after the deadline — the day the journeyperson first works on the project. If the first day worked is June 1, the first penalty day is June 2.
explanation_cn: 根据DIR公共工程手册第3.3.1.2节，首个罚款日是截止日期后的日历日——即工匠首次在项目上工作的那一天。如果首个工作日是6月1日，则首个罚款日为6月2日。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1777.7(a)(1); 8 CCR Section 230 (Document p. 30, PDF p. 36)

question_en: A contractor fails to submit DAS Form 140 for the carpentry craft before any carpenter works on the project and never submits it at all. On what date does the penalty period end?
question_cn: 承包商未在任何木工开始在项目上工作之前提交木工行业的 DAS 表格 140，并且根本没有提交该表格。罚款期在何日期结束？

options.en: The last day of any apprenticeable craft work performed
options.cn: 进行任何学徒行业工作的最后一天

options.en: The last day a carpenter worked on the project
options.cn: 木工在项目上工作的最后一天

options.en: The date the public works contract is completed
options.cn: 公共工程合同完成的日期

options.en: The date the Labor Commissioner issues the assessment
options.cn: 劳工专员发布评估的日期

explanation_en: Per DIR Public Works Manual Section 3.3.1.2, if DAS Form 140 is never submitted, the penalty continues through and including the last calendar date the contractor performed any work in any apprenticeable craft on the project.
explanation_cn: 根据 DIR 《公共工程手册》第 3.3.1.2 节，如果 DAS 表格 140 从未提交，罚款将持续直到承包商在项目上进行任何学徒行业工作的最后一个日历日，包括该日。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1777.7(a)(1); DIR Public Works Manual Section 3.3.1.2 (Document p. 31, PDF p. 37)

question_en: A contractor mails DAS Form 140 to an apprenticeship program using only first-class mail and is later challenged on whether the submission was timely. What is the most reliable way to prove the mailing date?
question_cn: 承包商仅使用一类邮件将 DAS 表格 140 寄送给学徒计划，之后有人质疑提交是否及时。证明邮寄日期的最可靠方法是什么？

options.en: A certified mail receipt showing the mailing date
options.cn: 显示邮寄日期的挂号邮件收据

options.en: The apprenticeship program's acknowledgment letter
options.cn: 学徒计划的确认函

options.en: A signed statement from the project superintendent
options.cn: 项目主管签署的声明

options.en: A copy of the completed DAS Form 140 itself
options.cn: 已填写的 DAS 表格 140 的副本

explanation_en: Per DIR Public Works Manual Section 3.3.1.1, contractors using first-class mail have no inherently reliable proof of the mailing date. A certified mail receipt is specifically cited as documentary evidence that establishes when the DAS Form 140 was mailed.
explanation_cn: 根据 DIR 公共工程手册第 3.3.1.1 节，使用一类邮件的承包商没有固有可靠的邮寄日期证明。挂号邮件收据被特别列为能证明 DAS 表格 140 邮寄日期的文件证据。
code_reference: 8 CCR Section 17210(b); DIR Public Works Manual Section 3.3.1.1 (Document p. 30, PDF p. 36)

question_en: On a public works project, a worker spends four hours as a pipefitter and six hours as a laborer in the same workday, exceeding eight hours total. How must the two overtime hours be compensated?
question_cn: 在一个公共工程项目中，一名工人在同一天内担任管道工工作四小时，同时又担任工人工作六小时，总共超过八小时。这两小时的加班时间应如何补偿？

options.en: At the laborer overtime rate, as the classification worked during overtime
options.cn: 按工人加班费率支付，因为在加班期间从事的是该职业分类

options.en: At a blended rate averaging both classifications' overtime rates
options.cn: 按两种职业分类的加班费率平均计算的混合费率支付

options.en: At 1.5 times the worker's regular rate from the prior week
options.cn: 按工人前一周常规工资的1.5倍支付

options.en: At the pipefitter overtime rate, as the higher-paying classification
options.cn: 按管道工加班费率支付，因为该分类支付较高

explanation_en: Per DIR Public Works Manual Section 3.2.7.1, the worker must be paid the overtime rate for the classification being performed during the overtime hours. Since the last hours worked — and thus the overtime hours — fall in the laborer classification, the laborer overtime rate applies.
explanation_cn: 根据DIR《公共工程手册》第3.2.7.1节，工人必须按加班时间所从事的职业分类支付加班费。由于最后工作的时间——因此也是加班时间——属于工人分类，因此适用工人加班费率。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1774; DIR Public Works Manual Section 3.2.7.1 (Document p. 25, PDF p. 31)

question_en: A worker performs four hours on a public works project at $30/hour and then eight hours on a private project at $15/hour in the same workday. How must the final four hours worked on the private project be compensated?
question_cn: 一名工人在公共工程项目上工作四小时，工资为每小时30美元，然后在同一天在私人项目上工作八小时，工资为每小时15美元。私人项目的最后四小时工作应如何支付？

options.en: At 1.5 times the public works straight time rate
options.cn: 按公共工程标准工时费的1.5倍支付

options.en: At the private project straight time rate of $15/hour
options.cn: 按私人项目标准工时费每小时15美元支付

options.en: At the prevailing wage overtime rate of $45/hour
options.cn: 按现行工资加班费率每小时45美元支付

options.en: At 1.5 times the weighted average of both rates
options.cn: 按两个费率的加权平均值的1.5倍支付

explanation_en: Per DIR Public Works Manual Section 3.2.7.2, when overtime falls on the private works portion of a mixed workday, the overtime rate is calculated at 1.5 times the weighted average of all hours worked during the workday (here, $30/hour). This reflects the methodology from the Labor Commissioner's 2002 Enforcement Policies Manual sections 49.2.5–49.2.6.1.
explanation_cn: 根据DIR公共工程手册第3.2.7.2节，当加班发生在混合工作日的私人工程部分时，加班费按整个工作日所有工作时间的加权平均费率的1.5倍计算（此处为每小时30美元）。这反映了劳动专员2002年执法政策手册第49.2.5–49.2.6.1节的方法。
code_reference: DIR Public Works Manual Section 3.2.7.2; Labor Code Section 1774 (Document p. 26, PDF p. 32)

question_en: A prevailing wage determination carries a double asterisk (**) after its expiration date. What does this indicate for a contractor working under that determination?
question_cn: 一项普遍工资裁定在其到期日期后带有双星号（**）。这对根据该裁定工作的承包商意味着什么？

options.en: Higher predetermined wage rates will take effect after expiration
options.cn: 在到期后，将实施较高的预定工资率

options.en: The awarding body must re-advertise the project for bids
options.cn: 授标机构必须重新发布项目招标

options.en: The current wage rates are frozen for the project duration
options.cn: 当前的工资率在项目期间被冻结

options.en: The determination has been withdrawn and replaced
options.cn: 该裁定已被撤销并替换

explanation_en: Per DIR Public Works Manual Section 3.2.5 and 8 CCR Section 16000, a double asterisk after the expiration date means predetermined increases (generally wage rate increases) go into effect the day following the expiration date listed in the determination.
explanation_cn: 根据DIR《公共工程手册》第3.2.5节和《加利福尼亚法规典》第8 CCR 16000节，到期日期后的双星号意味着预定增加（通常是工资率的增加）将在裁定中列出的到期日期后的第二天生效。
code_reference: 8 CCR Section 16000; DIR Public Works Manual Section 3.2.5 (Document p. 24, PDF p. 30)

question_en: A prevailing wage determination carries a single asterisk (*) after its expiration date. What does this mean for a contractor on a long-running public works project?
question_cn: 一个现行工资裁定在其到期日后带有一个星号 (*)。对于一个长期的公共工程项目的承包商，这意味着什么？

options.en: New rates take effect the day after the expiration date
options.cn: 新费率自到期日次日起生效

options.en: Rates listed apply for the entire project duration
options.cn: 所列费率适用于整个项目期间

options.en: The contractor must request a new determination annually
options.cn: 承包商必须每年申请新的裁定

options.en: Rates increase automatically each July 1 thereafter
options.cn: 费率自此之后每年7月1日自动上调

explanation_en: Per DIR Public Works Manual Section 3.2.6 and 8 CCR Section 16000, a single asterisk means no predetermined changes exist and the rates on that determination apply for the full duration of the project, regardless of how long work continues.
explanation_cn: 根据DIR公共工程手册第3.2.6节和8 CCR第16000条，一个星号意味着没有预定的变动存在，且该裁定上的费率适用于整个项目期间，无论工作持续多久。
code_reference: 8 CCR Section 16000; DIR Public Works Manual Section 3.2.6 (Document p. 24, PDF p. 30)

question_en: A contractor wants to know which prevailing wage rates apply to a public works project. What date determines which wage determination governs the project?
question_cn: 一名承包商想知道哪些现行工资标准适用于公共工程项目。哪一天决定了适用于该项目的工资认定？

options.en: The date the awarding body issues the notice to proceed
options.cn: 授予机构发出开工通知的日期

options.en: The date the contractor signed the public works contract
options.cn: 承包商签署公共工程合同的日期

options.en: The date work first begins on the project site
options.cn: 项目现场实际开工的日期

options.en: The bid advertisement date, when bids were first publicly invited
options.cn: 招标公告日期，即首次公开招标的日期

explanation_en: Per DIR Public Works Manual Section 3.2.4 and 8 CCR Section 16000, the prevailing wage determination in effect on or after the bid advertisement date (and before its expiration) governs the project. This is the date the awarding body published the first notice inviting bids.
explanation_cn: 根据DIR《公共工程手册》第3.2.4节和《加利福尼亚法规典》第8 CCR 16000条，在招标公告日期当天或之后（且在其失效之前）生效的现行工资认定适用于该项目。这就是授予机构发布首次招标公告的日期。
code_reference: 8 CCR Section 16000; DIR Public Works Manual Section 3.2.4 (Document p. 23, PDF p. 29)

question_en: Who has sole authority to establish prevailing wage rates for all worker classifications on California public works projects?
question_cn: 谁有唯一权力为加利福尼亚州公共工程项目的所有工人分类设定现行工资标准？

options.en: The California Apprenticeship Council by craft trade
options.cn: 由工种贸易组成的加利福尼亚学徒委员会

options.en: The awarding body for each individual public project
options.cn: 每个单独公共项目的授予机构

options.en: The DIR Director for all worker classifications statewide
options.cn: 全州所有工人分类的DIR主任

options.en: The Labor Commissioner through individual project audits
options.cn: 劳工专员通过单独项目审计

explanation_en: Labor Code Section 1773 and DIR Public Works Manual Section 3.2.2 confirm that the Director has sole responsibility for establishing prevailing wage rates for all classifications of workers on public works projects throughout California.
explanation_cn: 《劳动法》第1773条和DIR公共工程手册第3.2.2节确认，主任对全加州公共工程项目上所有工人分类的现行工资标准负有唯一责任。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1773; DIR Public Works Manual Section 3.2.2 (Document p. 22, PDF p. 28)

question_en: A contractor has no specified retention period in prevailing wage law for certified payroll records. What standard should guide how long the contractor keeps those records?
question_cn: 承包商在现行工资法中对已认证的工资单记录没有规定的保留期限。应遵循什么标准来确定承包商应保留这些记录的时间？

options.en: Until the final payment is released by the awarding body
options.cn: 直到授予机构发放最终付款为止

options.en: Three years after the project is completed
options.cn: 项目完成后三年

options.en: Through the applicable wage underpayment limitations period
options.cn: 在适用的工资欠缴追诉时效期间内

options.en: One year after the last certified payroll is submitted
options.cn: 提交最后一份已认证工资单后一周年

explanation_en: Per DIR Public Works Manual Section 3.1.14, because prevailing wage law specifies no fixed retention period, contractors should retain CPRs for the duration of any applicable limitations period for legally recognized wage underpayment remedies.
explanation_cn: 根据DIR公共工程手册第3.1.14节，由于现行工资法未规定固定的保留期限，承包商应在任何适用的法定工资欠缴追索期限内保留已认证工资单(CPRs)。
code_reference: 8 CCR Section 16000; DIR Public Works Manual Section 3.1.14 (Document p. 22, PDF p. 28)

question_en: A contractor that is not approved by any local apprenticeship program must submit DAS Form 140 to which programs before starting work?
question_cn: 未获得任何本地学徒培训计划批准的承包商在开始工作前，必须向哪些计划提交 DAS 表格 140？

options.en: Only programs in the county where the contractor is licensed
options.cn: 仅限承包商持证所在县的计划

options.en: Only the program with the largest membership statewide
options.cn: 仅限全州会员最多的计划

options.en: All programs whose geographic area covers the project site
options.cn: 所有其地理范围覆盖项目地点的计划

options.en: Only the program closest to the project location
options.cn: 仅限距离项目地点最近的计划

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR Section 230(a) and DIR Public Works Manual Section 3.3.1.1, contractors not already approved by a local program must submit DAS Form 140 to every applicable apprenticeship program whose geographic area of operation includes the area of the public works project.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR 第 230(a) 条款和 DIR 公共工程手册第 3.3.1.1 节，尚未获得本地计划批准的承包商必须向所有其经营地理范围包括公共工程项目地点的适用学徒培训计划提交 DAS 表格 140。
code_reference: 8 CCR Section 230(a); DIR Public Works Manual Section 3.3.1.1 (Document p. 30, PDF p. 36)

question_en: New prevailing wage rates are issued on February 22. On what date do those rates first apply to work performed on public works projects?
question_cn: 新的现行工资标准于2月22日发布。该工资标准首次适用于公共工程项目的工作日期是哪一天？

options.en: March 1, eight days after the issue date
options.cn: 3月1日，即发布后的八天

options.en: February 22, the same day rates are issued
options.cn: 2月22日，即工资标准发布的当天

options.en: March 4 in a non-leap year, ten days after issuance
options.cn: 3月4日，在非闰年，即发布后的十天

options.en: April 1, the following quarter's start date
options.cn: 4月1日，即下一季度的开始日期

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR Section 16000 and DIR Public Works Manual Section 3.2.3, the effective date is ten days after the issue date. For rates issued February 22, this falls on March 4 in a non-leap year (March 3 in a leap year).
explanation_cn: 根据《8 CCR 第16000条》和《DIR 公共工程手册 第3.2.3节》，生效日期为发布后十天。对于2月22日发布的工资标准，在非闰年为3月4日（闰年为3月3日）。
code_reference: 8 CCR Section 16000; DIR Public Works Manual Section 3.2.3 (Document p. 23, PDF p. 29)

question_en: A contractor on a public works project employs journey-level carpenters who work 750 straight-time hours total. How many apprentice carpenter hours must be worked before the end of the contract to satisfy the minimum ratio requirement?
question_cn: 在一个公共工程项目中，承包商雇用了总共工作 750 小时的熟练木工。在合同结束前，需要完成多少学徒木工工时才能满足最低比例要求？

options.en: At least 200 apprentice hours
options.cn: 至少 200 小时学徒工时

options.en: At least 175 apprentice hours
options.cn: 至少 175 小时学徒工时

options.en: At least 150 apprentice hours
options.cn: 至少 150 小时学徒工时

options.en: At least 125 apprentice hours
options.cn: 至少 125 小时学徒工时

explanation_en: Labor Code Section 1777.5(h) requires one apprentice hour for every five journeyperson hours. 750 x 0.20 = 150 minimum apprentice hours before the end of the contract.
explanation_cn: 《劳动法》第 1777.5(h) 条规定，每五小时熟练工工作需要一小时学徒工工作。750 x 0.20 = 合同结束前至少需要 150 小时学徒工时。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1777.5(h) (Document p. 32, PDF p. 38)

question_en: A contractor knowingly violates apprenticeship ratio standards on a public works project and has no prior violations within the past three years. What is the maximum civil penalty per day of noncompliance?
question_cn: 承包商在一个公共工程项目中明知违反学徒比例标准，并且在过去三年内没有任何违规记录。每天违规的最高民事处罚是多少？

options.en: Up to $100 per day of noncompliance
options.cn: 每天违规最高可罚款100美元

options.en: Up to $50 per day of noncompliance
options.cn: 每天违规最高可罚款50美元

options.en: Up to $200 per day of noncompliance
options.cn: 每天违规最高可罚款200美元

options.en: Up to $300 per day of noncompliance
options.cn: 每天违规最高可罚款300美元

explanation_en: Labor Code Section 1777.7(a)(1) sets the maximum at $100 per full calendar day of noncompliance for a contractor with no prior violations within three years.
explanation_cn: 劳动法第1777.7(a)(1)条规定，对于在三年内没有违规记录的承包商，每个完整日历日的违规最高罚款为100美元。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1777.7(a)(1) (Document p. 32, PDF p. 38)

question_en: A contractor has two apprenticeship ratio violations within a three-year period on public works projects. How does this affect the maximum daily penalty compared to a first-time violator?
question_cn: 在公共工程项目中，一名承包商在三年内有两次学徒比例违规。这将如何影响与首次违规者相比的每日最高处罚？

options.en: The penalty increases to $500 per day
options.cn: 罚款提高到每天500美元

options.en: The penalty remains the same at $100
options.cn: 罚款维持不变，为每天100美元

options.en: The penalty triples to $300 per day
options.cn: 罚款增加三倍，达到每天300美元

options.en: The penalty doubles to $200 per day
options.cn: 罚款加倍，达到每天200美元

explanation_en: Labor Code Section 1777.7(a)(1) raises the maximum daily penalty to $300 per day when two or more violations occur within a three-year period, tripling the base $100 maximum.
explanation_cn: 根据《劳动法》第1777.7(a)(1)条，当三年内发生两次或以上违规时，每日最高罚款提高到每天300美元，是基本100美元最高罚款的三倍。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1777.7(a)(1) (Document p. 33, PDF p. 39)

question_en: When determining whether a contractor has violated the minimum apprentice-to-journeyperson ratio on a public works project, at what point in time is compliance assessed?
question_cn: 在确定承包商是否违反了公共工程项目中学徒与熟练工的最低比例时，何时评估合规性？

options.en: At the end of the contract or subcontract
options.cn: 在合同或分包合同结束时

options.en: At the end of each calendar month billed
options.cn: 在每个结算的日历月末

options.en: At the midpoint of the contract duration
options.cn: 在合同期限的中点

options.en: At the end of each workday on the project
options.cn: 在项目的每个工作日结束时

explanation_en: Labor Code Section 1777.5(h) explicitly states that compliance with the minimum ratio is determined before the end of the contract or, for a subcontractor, before the end of the subcontract.
explanation_cn: 《劳动法》第1777.5(h)条明确规定，最低比例的合规性是在合同结束前，或对于分包商则是在分包合同结束前确定的。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1777.5(h) (Document p. 33, PDF p. 39)

question_en: A contractor fails to meet the minimum apprentice ratio on a public works job. Under what circumstances can the contractor avoid the resulting civil penalty?
question_cn: 承包商在公共工程项目中未达到最低学徒比例。在何种情况下，承包商可以避免因此产生的民事处罚？

options.en: By showing the apprentices lacked required skills
options.cn: 证明学徒缺乏所需技能

options.en: By submitting a corrected certified payroll after the fact
options.cn: 事后提交更正的经认证工资单

options.en: By proving work was completed under budget
options.cn: 证明工作在预算范围内完成

options.en: By proving timely dispatch requests were made and satisfied
options.cn: 证明及时发出的派工请求已被满足

explanation_en: Under 8 CCR 230.1(a), a contractor avoids minimum ratio penalties by establishing that it requested dispatch from all applicable apprenticeship committees with at least 72 hours notice, provided the Labor Commissioner proof of those requests, and employed all dispatched apprentices.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR 230.1(a)，承包商通过证明已向所有适用的学徒委员会提出派工请求且提前至少 72 小时通知，向劳工专员提供这些请求的证明，并雇佣所有被派遣的学徒，从而避免最低比例处罚。
code_reference: CCR Title 8 Section 230.1(a) (Document p. 33, PDF p. 39)

question_en: A contractor requests apprentice dispatch but fails to provide the Labor Commissioner with proof that the written request was actually sent. What is the likely result?
question_cn: 承包商请求学徒派遣，但未能向劳工专员提供已实际发送书面请求的证明。可能结果是什么？

options.en: The affirmative defense fails entirely
options.cn: 肯定抗辩完全失败

options.en: The contractor may resubmit proof within 30 days
options.cn: 承包商可在30天内重新提交证明

options.en: The awarding body absorbs the penalty instead
options.cn: 授予机构承担罚款

options.en: The contractor receives a reduced penalty only
options.cn: 承包商仅收到减轻的罚款

explanation_en: Under 8 CCR 230.1(a), every element of the dispatch request procedure must be satisfied. Failure to provide the Labor Commissioner with proof of the written request is independently sufficient to defeat the affirmative defense.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR 230.1(a)，必须满足派遣请求程序的每一个要素。未能向劳工专员提供书面请求的证明，本身就足以使肯定抗辩失败。
code_reference: CCR Title 8 Section 230.1(a) (Document p. 34, PDF p. 40)

question_en: A worker is paid at the lower apprentice prevailing wage rate on a public works project, but is not enrolled in a DAS-approved apprenticeship training program. What wage rate must the contractor pay that worker?
question_cn: 在公共工程项目中，如果一名工人按较低的学徒普遍工资率支付，但未注册在DAS批准的学徒培训项目中，则承包商必须支付该工人什么工资率？

options.en: The full journeyperson prevailing wage rate
options.cn: 全职工匠普遍工资率

options.en: A blended rate between apprentice and journeyperson
options.cn: 学徒和工匠之间的混合工资率

options.en: The apprentice rate if the worker is skilled enough
options.cn: 如果工人技能足够，则按学徒工资率

options.en: The minimum wage set by the state
options.cn: 由州政府设定的最低工资

explanation_en: Under Labor Code Section 1777.5(b) and (c), only a worker registered under a DAS-approved apprenticeship agreement may be paid at apprentice rates. An unregistered worker must receive the higher journeyperson prevailing wage rate.
explanation_cn: 根据《劳动法》第1777.5(b)和(c)条款，只有注册在DAS批准的学徒协议下的工人才能按学徒工资支付。未注册的工人必须获得较高的工匠普遍工资率。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1777.5(b) and (c) (Document p. 35, PDF p. 41)

question_en: A public works contractor employs workers in an apprenticeable craft but pays the required hourly training contribution directly to the individual workers instead of to a DAS-approved apprenticeship program. What is the consequence?
question_cn: 一家公共工程承包商雇用可学徒工的工人，但将所需的小时培训费用直接支付给工人个人，而不是支付给DAS批准的学徒计划。其后果是什么？

options.en: The contractor owes the workers additional overtime pay
options.cn: 承包商欠工人额外的加班工资

options.en: The Labor Commissioner may issue a CWPA
options.cn: 劳工专员可能会发布CWPA

options.en: The contractor satisfies the training fund obligation fully
options.cn: 承包商完全履行了培训基金义务

options.en: The awarding body must withhold progress payments immediately
options.cn: 授奖机构必须立即扣留进度付款

explanation_en: Under Labor Code Section 1777.5(m)(1), training contributions must be paid to the CAC or a DAS-approved program, not directly to workers. Failure to do so exposes the contractor to a Civil Wage and Penalty Assessment.
explanation_cn: 根据《劳动法》第1777.5(m)(1)条，培训费用必须支付给CAC或DAS批准的项目，而不能直接支付给工人。未按规定支付将使承包商面临民事工资和罚款评估。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1777.5(m)(1) (Document p. 36, PDF p. 42)

question_en: A contractor elects to employ apprentices under CAC rules on a public works project. An apprentice is found working without a journeyperson present in the same classification. What is the required remedy?
question_cn: 一名承包商选择根据CAC规定在一个公共工程项目中雇用学徒。发现一名学徒在没有同类行业技术工人陪同的情况下工作。所需的补救措施是什么？

options.en: The contractor is exempt if the apprentice is DAS-registered
options.cn: 如果学徒已在DAS注册，承包商可免除责任

options.en: The contractor must pay the journeyperson rate for those hours
options.cn: 承包商必须按技术工人的工资支付这些工时

options.en: The contractor must terminate the unaccompanied apprentice
options.cn: 承包商必须终止没有陪同的学徒

options.en: The contractor must provide additional apprentice training hours
options.cn: 承包商必须提供额外的学徒培训时间

explanation_en: Under 8 CCR 230.1(c), apprentices employed under CAC rules must work with or under the direct supervision of a journeyperson at all times. When that condition is not met, the lower apprentice rate is unavailable and journeyperson prevailing wages are owed for those hours.
explanation_cn: 根据8 CCR 230.1(c)条款，根据CAC规则雇用的学徒必须始终与技术工人一起工作或在其直接监督下工作。当这一条件未得到满足时，学徒的低工资率将不可用，需要按技术工人的现行工资支付这些工时。
code_reference: CCR Title 8 Section 230.1(c) (Document p. 37, PDF p. 43)

question_en: A contractor disputes the prevailing wage classification assigned to a worker on a public works project. Which agency makes the final determination on the correct classification?
question_cn: 承包商对分配给公共工程项目工人的现行工资分类提出异议。哪个机构对正确的分类作出最终决定？

options.en: The contractor who performed the work
options.cn: 执行工作的承包商

options.en: The applicable union whose CBA covers the craft
options.cn: 适用的涵盖该工种的工会

options.en: The Director of the DIR
options.cn: 劳动事务局（DIR）局长

options.en: The awarding body that issued the contract
options.cn: 发布合同的授予机构

explanation_en: Per DLSE v. Ericsson Information Services, Inc. (1990) 221 Cal.App.3d 114, the Director of the DIR makes the final determination on the correct classification for prevailing wage purposes.
explanation_cn: 根据 DLSE 诉 Ericsson Information Services, Inc. (1990) 221 Cal.App.3d 114，DIR 局长对现行工资用途的正确分类作出最终决定。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1771; DLSE v. Ericsson Information Services, Inc. (1990) 221 Cal.App.3d 114 (Document p. 40, PDF p. 46)

question_en: A journeyperson on a public works project performs two different types of work during the same day under two different wage determinations. How must the contractor handle prevailing wage payments for that worker?
question_cn: 在一个公共工程项目中，一名熟练工人在同一天内根据两个不同的工资决定执行两种不同类型的工作。承包商必须如何处理该工人的现行工资支付？

options.en: Pay an average of the two applicable rates
options.cn: 支付两个适用工资率的平均值

options.en: Pay each rate only for the hours worked in that classification
options.cn: 仅根据在该工种工作的小时数支付相应工资率

options.en: Pay the lower rate and submit an explanation to the DIR
options.cn: 支付较低的工资率并向DIR提交说明

options.en: Pay the higher rate for the entire workday
options.cn: 整天支付较高的工资率

explanation_en: Labor Code Sections 1771 and 1774 require prevailing wages based on the work actually performed. A single worker may be paid at different classification rates for different hours when different types of work are performed during the same project.
explanation_cn: 劳动法第1771条和1774条要求根据实际执行的工作支付现行工资。当在同一项目中进行不同类型的工作时，同一名工人可以按照不同工种的小时数支付不同的工资率。
code_reference: Labor Code Sections 1771 and 1774 (Document p. 41, PDF p. 47)

question_en: Travel and subsistence payments on a public works project are required only when specific conditions are met. Where must a contractor look to determine if those conditions apply to a particular craft?
question_cn: 只有在满足特定条件时，公共工程项目才需要支付差旅和食宿费用。承包商必须在哪里查找，以确定这些条件是否适用于特定工种？

options.en: CBA provisions posted on the DIR website via footnote reference
options.cn: 通过脚注引用在DIR网站上发布的集体谈判协议（CBA）条款

options.en: The project's general conditions and bid specifications
options.cn: 项目的通用条件和招标规范

options.en: The awarding body's contract general requirements section
options.cn: 颁奖机构合同的一般要求部分

options.en: The body of the Director's published wage determination
options.cn: 劳工局发布的工资裁定正文

explanation_en: Under Labor Code Section 1773.1, travel and subsistence requirements are found in collective bargaining agreement provisions posted by OD-Research on the DIR website. The wage determination references them through bold footnote language directing contractors to that site.
explanation_cn: 根据《劳动法典》第1773.1条，差旅和食宿要求可在OD-Research在DIR网站上发布的集体谈判协议条款中找到。工资裁定通过加粗的脚注语言引用这些条款，并指引承包商访问该网站。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1773.1 (Document p. 39, PDF p. 45)

question_en: A contractor on a public works project argues that a worker should not be paid the carpenter prevailing wage because the contractor is not signatory to the carpenters' union CBA. Is this argument valid?
question_cn: 一名公共工程项目的承包商认为，由于该承包商没有加入木工工会的集体谈判协议（CBA），因此不应支付工人木工的现行工资。这种论点有效吗？

options.en: Yes, only signatory contractors must pay CBA wage rates
options.cn: 是的，只有签约承包商必须支付CBA工资标准

options.en: Yes, non-union contractors may use a lower rate
options.cn: 是的，非工会承包商可以使用较低的工资标准

options.en: No, but the contractor may request an exemption from DIR
options.cn: 不，但承包商可以向DIR申请豁免

options.en: No, the rate is based on work performed, not CBA membership
options.cn: 不，工资标准基于所执行的工作，而不是CBA会员资格

explanation_en: Under Labor Code Section 1771 and the DIR Public Works Manual, prevailing wage rates are determined by the classification of work actually performed. CBA membership or signatory status is irrelevant to the contractor's prevailing wage obligation.
explanation_cn: 根据《劳动法》第1771条和DIR公共工程手册，现行工资标准由实际执行工作的分类确定。CBA会员资格或签约状态与承包商的现行工资义务无关。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1771; DIR Public Works Manual Chapter 4.1.2 (Document p. 40, PDF p. 46)

question_en: A contractor on a public works project has journeyperson-level carpenters employed on the jobsite for 50 calendar days and falls short of the minimum apprentice ratio. What is the maximum total penalty the contractor faces for this first-time violation?
question_cn: 一名公共工程项目的承包商在工地上雇用了有技工水平的木匠共50个日历日，但未达到最低学徒比例。对于首次违规，该承包商面临的最高总罚款是多少？

options.en: $15,000 total for the entire project
options.cn: 整个项目总共 $15,000

options.en: $2,500 total for the entire project
options.cn: 整个项目总共 $2,500

options.en: $5,000 total for the entire project
options.cn: 整个项目总共 $5,000

options.en: $10,000 total for the entire project
options.cn: 整个项目总共 $10,000

explanation_en: Under Labor Code Section 1777.7(a)(1), a first-time violator is subject to up to $100 per calendar day of noncompliance. With 50 days of journeyperson employment, the maximum penalty is $100 x 50 = $5,000.
explanation_cn: 根据《劳动法》第1777.7(a)(1)条，首次违规者可能面临每个不合规日最多$100的罚款。对于50天的技工雇用，最高罚款为 $100 x 50 = $5,000。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1777.7(a)(1) (Document p. 33, PDF p. 39)

question_en: When calculating the minimum ratio of apprentice to journeyperson hours on a public works project, which hours worked by journeypersons are excluded from the calculation?
question_cn: 在计算公共工程项目中学徒与熟练工的最低小时比率时，哪些熟练工的工作小时数不包括在计算中？

options.en: Hours worked on weekends and holidays
options.cn: 在周末和节假日工作的小时数

options.en: Hours worked during the first week of the project
options.cn: 项目第一周工作的小时数

options.en: Hours exceeding 8 per day or 40 per week
options.cn: 超过每日8小时或每周40小时的小时数

options.en: Hours worked by foremen in a supervisory capacity
options.cn: 以监督身份工作的工头的小时数

explanation_en: Labor Code Section 1777.5(h) expressly excludes journeyperson hours worked in excess of 8 per day or 40 per week from the total used to calculate the minimum apprentice ratio.
explanation_cn: 劳动法典第1777.5(h)条明确规定，用于计算最低学徒比率的总小时数中排除超过每天8小时或每周40小时的熟练工工作小时数。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1777.5(h) (Document p. 32, PDF p. 38)

question_en: A pipefitter on a public works project spends part of a day performing tasks that overlap with Laborer Group 1 duties. Which rate must the contractor pay for all hours worked that day?
question_cn: 一名在公共工程项目上的管道工在一天中有部分时间执行与工人组1职责重叠的任务。承包商必须为当天工作的所有小时支付哪种工资？

options.en: A blended average of both classification rates
options.cn: 两种分类工资的混合平均值

options.en: The lower Laborer Group 1 rate for those hours
options.cn: 这些小时的较低工人组1工资

options.en: Each rate applied separately to each task's hours
options.cn: 每个任务的工作小时分别适用各自的工资

options.en: The higher Pipefitter rate for all hours worked
options.cn: 所有工作小时适用较高的管道工工资

explanation_en: Under the In re Corley analysis adopted by the DIR, when both types of work are part of the overall task assigned under the higher-paying classification, the higher rate applies to all hours. This is consistent with Labor Code Section 1771 and DIR Public Works Manual Section 4.1.
explanation_cn: 根据DIR采纳的In re Corley分析，当两种类型的工作都是在高薪分类下分配的总体任务的一部分时，高工资适用于所有小时。这与《劳动法》第1771条和DIR《公共工程手册》第4.1节一致。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1771; DIR Public Works Manual Section 4.1 (Document p. 42, PDF p. 48)

question_en: A contractor fails to maintain proper records distinguishing which duties a worker performed on a public works project. How will the Labor Commissioner likely resolve any classification dispute?
question_cn: 承包商未能保持适当记录以区分工人在公共工程项目上执行的具体职责。劳动专员可能将如何解决任何分类争议？

options.en: In favor of the contractor based on certified payroll records
options.cn: 根据经过认证的工资记录有利于承包商

options.en: By requesting records from the awarding body instead
options.cn: 而是通过向授予机关请求记录

options.en: In favor of the worker's own testimony about duties performed
options.cn: 有利于工人关于所执行职责的自身证词

options.en: By applying the lower classification rate by default
options.cn: 默认应用较低的分类费率

explanation_en: Per Hernandez v. Mendoza and DIR Manual Section 4.1, uncertainties caused by a contractor's failure to maintain required records are resolved in favor of worker testimony and against the contractor.
explanation_cn: 根据 Hernandez 诉 Mendoza 案及 DIR 手册第 4.1 节，由于承包商未维护所需记录而引起的不确定性将以有利于工人的证词而不利于承包商的方式解决。
code_reference: DIR Public Works Manual Section 4.1; Hernandez v. Mendoza (1988) 199 Cal.App.3d 721 (Document p. 42, PDF p. 48)

question_en: A worker on a public works project travels from the contractor's yard to the job site each morning. How must that travel time be compensated?
question_cn: 一名公共工程项目的工人每天早上从承包商的工地仓库前往工作现场。该出行时间应如何支付？

options.en: Only if the worker is transporting tools or supplies
options.cn: 仅当工人运送工具或物资时

options.en: At the prevailing wage rate for the worker's classification
options.cn: 按照该工人所属分类的现行工资标准支付

options.en: At straight time only, never at overtime rates
options.cn: 仅按正常工作时间支付，绝不按加班费率支付

options.en: At the minimum wage rate regardless of classification
options.cn: 不论工人分类如何，均按最低工资支付

explanation_en: Under DIR Manual Section 4.1.5 and Morillion v. Royal Packing Co., travel time from the employer's yard to a public works site constitutes hours worked and must be paid at the prevailing rate for the worker's classification, unless the wage determination specifies a lesser travel time rate.
explanation_cn: 根据 DIR 手册第 4.1.5 节及 Morillion 诉 Royal Packing Co. 案，从雇主仓库到公共工程现场的出行时间视为工作时间，必须按工人所属分类的现行工资标准支付，除非工资裁定另有规定需支付较低的出行时间费率。
code_reference: DIR Public Works Manual Section 4.1.5; Morillion v. Royal Packing Co. (2000) 22 Cal.4th 575 (Document p. 43, PDF p. 49)

question_en: On a public works project, a worker is employed for 10 hours on a Saturday. The applicable wage determination specifies a Saturday premium rate but no special Saturday exception applies. What overtime obligation exists?
question_cn: 在一个公共工程项目中，一名工人在星期六工作了10小时。适用的工资决定规定了星期六的额外工资率，但没有适用特殊的星期六例外。存在什么加班义务？

options.en: No overtime is owed because Saturday premium already applies
options.cn: 不需要支付加班费，因为已经适用星期六的额外工资

options.en: Overtime applies only if the weekly total exceeds 40 hours
options.cn: 只有当每周总工时超过40小时时才适用加班费

options.en: Overtime rates apply to the 2 hours exceeding 8 on Saturday
options.cn: 加班费适用于星期六超过8小时的2小时

options.en: Double time applies to all Saturday hours worked
options.cn: 星期六工作的所有工时都适用双倍工资

explanation_en: Under Labor Code Section 1815 and DIR Manual Section 4.1.6, when more than 8 hours are worked on a Saturday, overtime rates (calculated from the Saturday premium rate) apply to the hours beyond 8, and the contractor is subject to penalties under Labor Code Section 1813.
explanation_cn: 根据《劳动法》第1815条和DIR手册第4.1.6节，当星期六工作超过8小时时，超过8小时的部分适用从星期六额外工资率计算的加班费，承包商须承担《劳动法》第1813条规定的处罚。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1815; Labor Code Section 1813; DIR Public Works Manual Section 4.1.6 (Document p. 43, PDF p. 49)

question_en: A contractor on a public works project fails to pay overtime for hours worked in excess of 7 hours per day, as required by the applicable wage determination. Which penalty provision applies?
question_cn: 在一个公共工程项目中，承包商未按照适用的工资裁定支付每天超过7小时的加班费。适用哪项处罚条款？

options.en: No penalty if the weekly 40-hour limit was not exceeded
options.cn: 如果每周40小时的限制未被超过，则不处罚

options.en: Penalties under Labor Code Section 1775 plus unpaid wages
options.cn: 根据《劳动法》第1775条的处罚加上未支付的工资

options.en: Penalties under Labor Code Section 1813 only
options.cn: 仅根据《劳动法》第1813条的处罚

options.en: Automatic debarment from future public works contracts
options.cn: 自动取消未来公共工程合同的资格

explanation_en: DIR Manual Section 4.1.6.1 states that contractors failing to comply with a wage determination that requires overtime below the standard 8-hour/40-hour threshold are subject to penalties under Labor Code Section 1775 in addition to any wages owed.
explanation_cn: 《DIR手册》第4.1.6.1节指出，未遵守要求在低于标准8小时/40小时阈值下支付加班工资的工资裁定的承包商，除了应支付的工资外，还将面临《劳动法》第1775条规定的处罚。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1775; CCR Title 8 Section 16200(a)(3)(F); DIR Public Works Manual Section 4.1.6.1 (Document p. 44, PDF p. 50)

question_en: A contractor wants to use a 4-day, 10-hour-per-day alternative workweek schedule on a public works project. Workers would receive no overtime for the 2 daily hours beyond 8. Is this arrangement permissible?
question_cn: 承包商想在公共工程项目中采用每周工作4天、每天工作10小时的替代工作周安排。对于每天超过8小时的2小时，工人将不会获得加班费。这种安排允许吗？

options.en: Yes, if a majority of workers vote to adopt it
options.cn: 是的，如果大多数工人投票通过采用该安排

options.en: Yes, for workers covered by a collective bargaining agreement
options.cn: 是的，对于受集体谈判协议约束的工人

options.en: Yes, if the awarding body grants written approval in advance
options.cn: 是的，如果发包方事先书面批准

options.en: No, overtime must be paid for all hours beyond 8 per day
options.cn: 不可以，超过每天8小时的所有工时必须支付加班费

explanation_en: Under Labor Code Sections 1810, 1811, and 1815 and DIR Manual Section 4.1.8, no worker may be employed on a public works project for more than 8 hours per day without overtime compensation. Alternative workweek schedules under Labor Code Section 511 or Wage Order 16 do not apply to public works.
explanation_cn: 根据《劳动法》第1810、1811和1815条以及DIR手册第4.1.8节，任何工人不得在公共工程项目上每天工作超过8小时而不支付加班费。根据《劳动法》第511条或工资令第16条的替代工作周安排不适用于公共工程。
code_reference: Labor Code Sections 1810, 1811, 1815; DIR Public Works Manual Section 4.1.8 (Document p. 45, PDF p. 51)

question_en: Which of the following is a valid exception to the overtime requirement on a California public works project?
question_cn: 以下哪项是加利福尼亚州公共工程项目加班要求的有效例外？

options.en: The project is funded with federal Davis-Bacon Act funds
options.cn: 项目由联邦戴维斯-贝肯法案（Davis-Bacon Act）资金资助

options.en: The contractor's project manager authorizes extended shifts
options.cn: 承包商的项目经理批准延长班次

options.en: Worker voluntarily agrees in writing to waive overtime
options.cn: 工人自愿书面同意放弃加班

options.en: Work cannot be performed during normal hours due to danger
options.cn: 由于危险原因无法在正常工作时间进行工作

explanation_en: Under CCR Title 8 Section 16200(a)(3)(F) Exception 3 and DIR Manual Section 4.1.7.3, if the awarding body determines work cannot be performed during normal hours or is necessary off-hours to avoid danger to life or property, no overtime is required for the first 8 hours in a day or 40 hours in a week.
explanation_cn: 根据《加利福尼亚法规汇编》（CCR）第8卷第16200(a)(3)(F)节例外条款3以及DIR手册第4.1.7.3节，如果授奖机构决定由于无法在正常工作时间进行工作或为了避免对生命或财产的危险而必须在非工作时间进行工作，则每日前8小时或每周前40小时不需要支付加班费。
code_reference: CCR Title 8 Section 16200(a)(3)(F); DIR Public Works Manual Section 4.1.7 (Document p. 44, PDF p. 50)

question_en: A contractor claims that a Saturday make-up day exception in its collective bargaining agreement entitles workers to straight-time pay on Saturdays. The exception is not included in the Director's prevailing wage determination. Does the exception apply?
question_cn: 一名承包商声称，其集体谈判协议中的周六补班例外规定赋予工人在周六获得正常工资的权利。该例外未包含在主管的现行工资裁定中。该例外适用吗？

options.en: Yes, because the CBA controls working conditions for union workers
options.cn: 是的，因为CBA控制了工会工人的工作条件

options.en: Yes, if the contractor provides a certified copy of the CBA
options.cn: 是的，如果承包商提供CBA的认证副本

options.en: No, the exception must appear in the wage determination
options.cn: 不是，例外必须出现在工资裁定中

options.en: No, Saturday make-up days are never permitted on public works
options.cn: 不是，公共工程中从不允许周六补班

explanation_en: Under DIR Manual Section 4.1.9, the Labor Commissioner will not recognize Saturday make-up day exceptions that exist only in underlying CBAs. The Director must adopt and include the exception in the prevailing wage determination for it to apply.
explanation_cn: 根据DIR手册第4.1.9节，劳工专员不会承认仅存在于基础CBA中的周六补班例外。主管必须采纳并将例外列入现行工资裁定中，该例外才适用。
code_reference: DIR Public Works Manual Section 4.1.9 (Document p. 46, PDF p. 52)

question_en: A contractor pays an Iron Worker $20.00 per hour to a private medical insurance plan and the remaining $9.735 per hour directly to the worker as a cash wage, in addition to the Basic Hourly Rate. How does the Labor Commissioner treat this arrangement?
question_cn: 承包商向一名钢铁工支付每小时 20.00 美元到私人医疗保险计划，其余每小时 9.735 美元直接支付给工人作为现金工资，此外还有基本小时工资率。劳动专员如何处理这种安排？

options.en: Compliant, provided the Basic Hourly Rate minimum is still met
options.cn: 合规，前提是仍然满足基本小时工资率的最低要求

options.en: Compliant only if the awarding body pre-approves the benefit plan
options.cn: 仅在授予机构事先批准福利计划时才合规

options.en: Non-compliant because cash wages must equal the full Total Hourly Rate
options.cn: 不合规，因为现金工资必须等于总小时工资率

options.en: Non-compliant because benefits cannot substitute for any wages
options.cn: 不合规，因为福利不能替代任何工资

explanation_en: Under Labor Code Section 1773.1 and DIR Manual Section 4.2.1 (citing WSB Electric v. Curry), a contractor may split the employer payment between qualifying benefit plans and direct wages in any combination, as long as the Basic Hourly Rate is paid in wages and the Total Hourly Rate is met in the aggregate.
explanation_cn: 根据《劳动法》第1773.1条和DIR手册第4.2.1节（引用WSB Electric诉Curry案），承包商可以在合格的福利计划和直接工资之间以任何组合分配雇主支付，只要基本小时工资按工资支付并且总小时工资率在总体上得到满足。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1773.1; 8 CCR Section 16200(a)(3)(I); DIR Public Works Manual Section 4.2.1 (Document p. 47, PDF p. 53)

question_en: Which benefit payment may a contractor NOT credit against its prevailing wage obligation on a California public works project?
question_cn: 承包商在加利福尼亚公共工程项目中，哪项福利支付不得抵扣其最低工资义务？

options.en: Workers' compensation insurance premiums paid by the employer
options.cn: 由雇主支付的工伤赔偿保险费

options.en: Employer contributions to a pension plan
options.cn: 雇主对养老金计划的缴款

options.en: Contributions to an apprenticeship training program
options.cn: 对学徒培训项目的缴款

options.en: Payments into a health and welfare fund
options.cn: 向健康与福利基金的缴款

explanation_en: Under Labor Code Section 1773.1(c) and DIR Manual Section 4.2.1, no credit may be taken for benefits required by other state or federal law, including workers' compensation, unemployment insurance, and Social Security contributions.
explanation_cn: 根据《劳动法》第1773.1(c)条和DIR手册第4.2.1节，对于其他州或联邦法律要求的福利（包括工伤赔偿、失业保险和社会保障缴款），不得计入抵扣。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1773.1(c); DIR Public Works Manual Section 4.2.1 (Document p. 48, PDF p. 54)

question_en: A contractor uses employer payments (benefits) to reduce the amount paid to workers below the Basic Hourly Rate listed in the prevailing wage determination. What does California law say about this practice?
question_cn: 承包商使用雇主支付（福利）来降低支付给工人的金额，使其低于现行工资认定中列出的基本时薪。加利福尼亚州法律对此做法有何规定？

options.en: It is permitted if a collective bargaining agreement authorizes it
options.cn: 如果集体谈判协议允许，则可以

options.en: It is prohibited under California prevailing wage law
options.cn: 根据加利福尼亚现行工资法，这是被禁止的

options.en: It is permitted if the awarding body grants written approval
options.cn: 如果授予机构给予书面批准，则可以

options.en: It is permitted on federally funded projects under Davis-Bacon
options.cn: 在根据Davis-Bacon法案资助的联邦项目中可以

explanation_en: Labor Code Section 1773.1(c) and 8 CCR Section 16200(a)(3)(I) prohibit using employer payment credits to reduce the Basic Hourly Rate obligation. The total of wages paid in cash must never fall below the Basic Hourly Rate specified in the wage determination.
explanation_cn: 劳工法典第1773.1(c)条和加利福尼亚法规典第8卷CCR第16200(a)(3)(I)条禁止使用雇主付款抵扣来降低基本时薪义务。以现金支付的工资总额不得低于工资认定中规定的基本时薪。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1773.1(c); 8 CCR Section 16200(a)(3)(I); DIR Public Works Manual Section 4.2.2 (Document p. 48, PDF p. 54)

question_en: On a public works project, a worker works 12 hours in a single day. How is the overtime premium rate calculated for the hours exceeding the basic 8-hour threshold?
question_cn: 在一个公共工程项目中，一名工人在单日工作了12小时。超出基本8小时阈值的加班费率如何计算？

options.en: One and one-half times the Total Hourly Rate including benefits
options.cn: 含福利的总小时工资的1.5倍

options.en: The Basic Hourly Rate only, with no employer payment addition
options.cn: 仅基本小时工资，无雇主支付附加

options.en: Double time based on the Total Hourly Rate for all overtime hours
options.cn: 所有加班小时按总小时工资的双倍计算

options.en: One and one-half times the Basic Hourly Rate, plus employer payments
options.cn: 基本小时工资的1.5倍，加上雇主支付

explanation_en: Under DIR Manual Section 4.2.3, overtime is calculated as 1.5 times the Basic Hourly Rate only; employer payments are excluded from the multiplier calculation but are still added to each overtime hour, consistent with Labor Code Section 1815.
explanation_cn: 根据DIR手册第4.2.3节，加班费仅按基本小时工资的1.5倍计算；雇主支付不计入乘数计算，但仍会添加到每小时加班费中，这与《劳动法》第1815条一致。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1815; DIR Public Works Manual Section 4.2.3 (Document p. 49, PDF p. 55)

question_en: A California public works project receives both federal and state funding. The federal Davis-Bacon prevailing wage rate is lower than California's rate. Which rate must the contractor pay?
question_cn: 一个加利福尼亚州的公共工程项目同时获得联邦和州的资助。联邦戴维斯-贝肯（Davis-Bacon）最低工资标准低于加利福尼亚州的标准。承包商必须支付哪个工资标准？

options.en: The federal Davis-Bacon rate because federal law preempts state law
options.cn: 联邦戴维斯-贝肯标准，因为联邦法律优先于州法律

options.en: The California prevailing wage rate, as it is higher
options.cn: 加利福尼亚州的最低工资标准，因为它更高

options.en: The rate chosen by the awarding body at project outset
options.cn: 项目开始时授予机构选择的标准

options.en: An average of the federal and state prevailing wage rates
options.cn: 联邦和州最低工资标准的平均值

explanation_en: Under 8 CCR Section 16001(b) and DIR Manual Section 4.2.2.2, when a project is subject to both California prevailing wage law and Davis-Bacon, the higher of the two rates applies. The contractor must comply with California requirements to be in compliance with state law.
explanation_cn: 根据《加利福尼亚法规汇编》第8卷第16001(b)条和DIR手册第4.2.2.2节，当一个项目同时适用加利福尼亚最低工资法和戴维斯-贝肯法时，应采用两者中较高的工资标准。承包商必须遵守加利福尼亚州的要求，以符合州法律。
code_reference: 8 CCR Section 16001(b); DIR Public Works Manual Section 4.2.2.2 (Document p. 49, PDF p. 55)

question_en: Which of the following employer-provided items does NOT qualify as a creditable employer payment under California prevailing wage law?
question_cn: 以下哪一项雇主提供的项目不符合加利福尼亚州优先工资法下可抵扣的雇主付款资格？

options.en: Payments into a health and welfare benefit plan
options.cn: 支付至健康和福利计划

options.en: Contributions to a pension fund on behalf of the worker
options.cn: 代表工人向养老金基金的缴款

options.en: Gas reimbursement provided to workers on the project
options.cn: 向项目工人提供的汽油报销

options.en: Vacation pay contributions listed in the wage determination
options.cn: 工资裁定中列出的休假工资缴款

explanation_en: DIR Manual Section 4.2.4.1 expressly identifies gas reimbursement, use of a company vehicle, and Christmas bonuses as examples of benefits that do not constitute creditable employer payments under Labor Code Section 1773.1.
explanation_cn: DIR 手册第 4.2.4.1 节明确指出，汽油报销、公司车辆使用和圣诞奖金被列为《劳动法》第 1773.1 节下不构成可抵扣雇主付款的福利示例。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1773.1; DIR Public Works Manual Section 4.2.4.1 (Document p. 51, PDF p. 57)

question_en: A prime contractor claims it had no knowledge that its subcontractor was underpaying prevailing wages. Is the prime contractor automatically relieved of penalty liability under Labor Code Section 1775?
question_cn: 一般承包商声称其不知道其分包商未支付法定工资。根据《劳动法》第1775条，一般承包商会自动免除罚款责任吗？

options.en: No, unless the prime contractor meets safe harbor requirements
options.cn: 不，除非一般承包商满足安全港条款的要求

options.en: Yes, if the subcontractor pays the penalty first
options.cn: 是的，如果分包商先支付罚款

options.en: Yes, ignorance is always a complete defense
options.cn: 是的，无知总是完全的抗辩理由

options.en: No, the prime contractor always bears full sole liability
options.cn: 不，一般承包商始终承担全部责任

explanation_en: Under Labor Code Section 1775, ignorance alone is not a defense. A prime contractor may avoid liability only by satisfying the specific safe harbor requirements under Section 1775(b), such as including required code provisions in the subcontract and monitoring certified payroll records.
explanation_cn: 根据《劳动法》第1775条，仅凭无知不能作为抗辩理由。一般承包商只有通过满足第1775(b)条规定的具体安全港要求，才能避免承担责任，例如在分包合同中包含所需的法典条款，并监控经认证的工资记录。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1775 (Document p. 60, PDF p. 66)

question_en: What is the maximum penalty per worker per calendar day that can be assessed against a contractor or subcontractor for paying less than the required prevailing wage?
question_cn: 对于支付低于规定的现行工资的承包商或分包商，每名工人每个日历日可以处以的最高罚款是多少？

options.en: Not more than $120 per calendar day
options.cn: 每个日历日不超过120美元

options.en: Not more than $200 per calendar day
options.cn: 每个日历日不超过200美元

options.en: Not more than $80 per calendar day
options.cn: 每个日历日不超过80美元

options.en: Not more than $40 per calendar day
options.cn: 每个日历日不超过40美元

explanation_en: Labor Code Section 1775 sets the maximum forfeiture at $200 per calendar day, or portion thereof, for each worker paid less than the required prevailing wage rate.
explanation_cn: 《劳动法》第1775条规定，每名工人每个日历日或其部分支付低于规定的现行工资的情况下，最高没收金额为200美元。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1775 (Document p. 60, PDF p. 66)

question_en: A subcontractor on a public works project has been assessed prevailing wage penalties on a separate contract within the last three years. What is the minimum penalty the Labor Commissioner must assess per worker per day for a new violation?
question_cn: 在一个公共工程项目中，如果一个分包商在过去三年内在另一个合同上被评估了最低工资处罚，那么劳动专员对新违规行为每名工人每天必须评估的最低罚款是多少？

options.en: Not less than $40 per calendar day
options.cn: 每个日历日不少于40美元

options.en: Not less than $200 per calendar day
options.cn: 每个日历日不少于200美元

options.en: Not less than $80 per calendar day
options.cn: 每个日历日不少于80美元

options.en: Not less than $120 per calendar day
options.cn: 每个日历日不少于120美元

explanation_en: Under Labor Code Section 1775, a contractor or subcontractor previously assessed penalties within the prior three years on a separate contract must pay a minimum of $80 per worker per day, unless those prior penalties were withdrawn or overturned.
explanation_cn: 根据《劳动法典》第1775条，如果承包商或分包商在前一个三年内在另一个合同上已被评估过处罚，必须支付每名工人每天至少80美元，除非之前的处罚被撤回或推翻。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1775 (Document p. 60, PDF p. 66)

question_en: A contractor's prevailing wage violation is found to be willful as defined under Labor Code Section 1777.1(c). What is the minimum penalty the Labor Commissioner must assess per worker per day?
question_cn: 承包商的工资标准违规行为被认定为故意违规，根据劳动法第1777.1(c)条的定义。劳动专员必须对每名工人每天至少处以多少罚款？

options.en: Not less than $80 per calendar day
options.cn: 每日不低于 $80

options.en: Not less than $200 per calendar day
options.cn: 每日不低于 $200

options.en: Not less than $120 per calendar day
options.cn: 每日不低于 $120

options.en: Not less than $40 per calendar day
options.cn: 每日不低于 $40

explanation_en: Under Labor Code Section 1775, when the Labor Commissioner determines the violation was willful as defined in Section 1777.1(c), the minimum penalty is $120 per worker per calendar day.
explanation_cn: 根据劳动法第1775条，当劳动专员认定违规行为为第1777.1(c)条定义的故意违规时，每名工人每天的最低罚款为 $120。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1775; Labor Code Section 1777.1(c) (Document p. 60, PDF p. 66)

question_en: To qualify for the prime contractor safe harbor under Labor Code Section 1775(b), which of the following must the prime contractor include in its subcontract?
question_cn: 根据《劳动法》第1775(b)条款，要符合总承包商的安全港条款，总承包商必须在其分包合同中包括以下哪些内容？

options.en: A copy of the awarding body's project specifications and notices
options.cn: 奖发机构的项目规格和通知的复印件

options.en: Copies of Labor Code Sections 1771, 1775, 1776, 1777.5, 1813, and 1815
A copy of the applicable DIR prevailing wage determination only
options.cn: 仅适用的DIR工资标准认定的复印件

options.en: A certified copy of the project's submitted payroll records
options.cn: 项目提交的工资记录的认证复印件

explanation_en: Under Labor Code Section 1775(b)(1), the prime contractor must include copies of these specific prevailing wage code sections in its subcontract to qualify for safe harbor protection from subcontractor violations.
explanation_cn: 根据《劳动法》第1775(b)(1)条款，总承包商必须在其分包合同中包括这些特定的最低工资法规条款的复印件，才能获得因分包商违规而提供的安全港保护。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1775(b) (Document p. 61, PDF p. 67)

question_en: Under the prime contractor safe harbor, what ongoing obligation must the prime contractor fulfill regarding its subcontractor's workers?
question_cn: 根据总承包商的安全港条款，总承包商必须履行哪些持续义务以确保其分包商的工人获得保障？

options.en: Submit weekly payroll reports to the Labor Commissioner
options.cn: 向劳动专员提交每周工资报告

options.en: Obtain the subcontractor's DIR registration number quarterly
options.cn: 每季度获取分包商的DIR注册号码

options.en: Conduct random site interviews of subcontractor employees
options.cn: 对分包商员工进行随机现场访谈

options.en: Periodically review the subcontractor's certified payroll records
options.cn: 定期审查分包商的认证工资记录

explanation_en: Labor Code Section 1775(b)(2) requires the prime contractor to monitor the subcontractor's payment of prevailing wages by periodically reviewing the subcontractor's certified payroll records as a condition of safe harbor protection.
explanation_cn: 《劳动法》第1775(b)(2)条要求，总承包商必须定期审查分包商的认证工资记录，以监控分包商是否支付了现行工资，这是获得安全港保护的条件。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1775(b) (Document p. 61, PDF p. 67)

question_en: A contractor wants to take credit for employer payments toward fringe benefits to offset its prevailing wage obligation. How frequently must those contributions be made to qualify for credit?
question_cn: 承包商希望将雇主对附加福利的支付计入抵消其现行工资义务的积分。为了获得积分，这些缴款必须多久进行一次？

options.en: On no less than a monthly basis
options.cn: 不少于每月一次

options.en: On no less than a quarterly basis
options.cn: 不少于每季度一次

options.en: On no less than a weekly basis
options.cn: 不少于每周一次

options.en: On no less than an annual basis
options.cn: 不少于每年一次

explanation_en: Under Labor Code Section 1773.1(d), an employer may take credit for fringe benefit contributions only if they are made regularly on no less than a quarterly basis.
explanation_cn: 根据《劳动法》第1773.1(d)条的规定，雇主只有在附加福利缴款至少每季度定期进行时，才可以计入积分。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1773.1(d) (Document p. 53, PDF p. 59)

question_en: A contractor pays different rates of fringe benefit contributions for workers on public works projects versus private projects. Under California prevailing wage law, how must the credit for those contributions be calculated?
question_cn: 承包商在公共工程项目与私人项目中为工人支付不同的附加福利费率。根据加州现行工资法，这些缴费的抵免应如何计算？

options.en: Using an annualized calculation across all hours worked
options.cn: 使用所有工作小时的年度化计算

options.en: At the full public works rate for each hour claimed
options.cn: 按每小时申报时的完整公共工程费率

options.en: Averaged across all workers on the project
options.cn: 在项目的所有工人之间平均

options.en: Based only on hours worked on public works projects
options.cn: 仅基于公共工程项目的工作小时

explanation_en: Under Labor Code Section 1773.1(e), when a contractor pays higher fringe benefit rates on public works than on private projects, the credit must be computed on an annualized basis using total hours worked on all projects, preventing inflation of the per-hour credit.
explanation_cn: 根据《劳动法》第1773.1(e)条，当承包商在公共工程项目上支付的附加福利费率高于私人项目时，抵免必须基于所有项目的总工作小时进行年度化计算，以防止每小时抵免额膨胀。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1773.1(e) (Document p. 55, PDF p. 61)

question_en: When a contractor cannot determine actual hours worked in the current year for annualization purposes, what is the standard full-year equivalent hours figure the Labor Commissioner permits for computing the prevailing wage credit?
question_cn: 当承包商无法确定当年的实际工作小时数以进行年度化时，劳工专员允许用于计算现行工资信用的标准全年等效小时数是多少？

options.en: 2,500 hours per year
options.cn: 每年 2,500 小时

options.en: 1,800 hours per year
options.cn: 每年 1,800 小时

options.en: 1,500 hours per year
options.cn: 每年 1,500 小时

options.en: 2,080 hours per year
options.cn: 每年 2,080 小时

explanation_en: Per DIR Public Works Manual Section 4.2.6.3, it is not considered a violation for a contractor to use 2,080 hours (40 hours × 52 weeks) as the full-year equivalent when actual hours are not yet determinable, provided the employee did not work more than 2,080 hours that year.
explanation_cn: 根据 DIR 公共工程手册第 4.2.6.3 节，如果实际小时数尚无法确定，承包商使用 2,080 小时（40 小时 × 52 周）作为全年等效工时不被视为违规，前提是该员工当年的工作时间未超过 2,080 小时。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1773.1(d); DIR Public Works Manual Section 4.2.6.3 (Document p. 57, PDF p. 63)

question_en: A contractor takes a fringe benefit credit based on the average contribution made across a group of workers rather than calculating it individually for each worker. What is the consequence of this practice?
question_cn: 承包商基于一组工人的平均贡献而不是为每个工人单独计算附加福利抵免。这种做法的后果是什么？

options.en: The awarding body must approve the averaging method
options.cn: 颁发机构必须批准平均方法

options.en: The credit is invalid; it must be calculated per worker
options.cn: 抵免无效；必须按每个工人计算

options.en: The credit is disallowed entirely for all workers
options.cn: 所有工人的抵免全部被拒绝

options.en: The credit is valid if the average is reasonable
options.cn: 如果平均值合理，则抵免有效

explanation_en: Under DIR Public Works Manual Section 4.2.5.2.2, credit may only be taken toward the prevailing wage requirement for each applicable worker individually. Using a group average is expressly impermissible, making the credit invalid as calculated.
explanation_cn: 根据DIR《公共工程手册》第4.2.5.2.2条款，抵免只能针对每个适用工人的最低工资要求单独计算。使用群体平均值是明确禁止的，因此按此计算的抵免无效。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1773.1; DIR Public Works Manual Section 4.2.5.2.2 (Document p. 53, PDF p. 59)

question_en: A contractor works on both public and private projects and makes CAC apprenticeship training contributions only for the public works projects. Must these payments be annualized across all hours worked?
question_cn: 承包商从事公共和私人项目工作，并且仅为公共工程项目缴纳CAC学徒培训费用。这些付款是否必须按所有工作小时进行年度化处理？

options.en: No, only if contributions exceed the wage determination amount
options.cn: 不，只有当缴费超过工资认定金额时才需年度化

options.en: Yes, all fringe benefit contributions must be annualized
options.cn: 是的，所有附加福利缴费都必须年度化

options.en: No, CAC training contributions are exempt from annualization
options.cn: 不，CAC培训缴费豁免年度化处理

options.en: Yes, unless the contractor is a union signatory employer
options.cn: 是的，除非承包商是工会签约雇主

explanation_en: Under Labor Code Section 1773.1(e)(3), payments made to the CAC or an approved apprenticeship program pursuant to Section 1777.5(m)(1) are expressly exempt from the annualization requirement, up to the amount listed in the applicable prevailing wage determination.
explanation_cn: 根据《劳动法》第1773.1(e)(3)条，根据第1777.5(m)(1)条向CAC或经批准的学徒项目支付的款项明确豁免年度化要求，金额最多可达到适用的工资认定中列出的数额。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1773.1(e)(3); Labor Code Section 1777.5(m)(1) (Document p. 59, PDF p. 65)

question_en: A contractor pays training contributions for a craft that is NOT identified as an apprenticeable craft on the prevailing wage determination. How must those training contributions be handled?
question_cn: 承包商为一项在现行工资裁定中未被认定为可学徒工种的工艺支付培训费用。这些培训费用应如何处理？

options.en: Paid to the worker as wages, not to the CAC
options.cn: 支付给工人作为工资，而不是支付给CAC

options.en: Paid to the California Apprenticeship Council directly
options.cn: 直接支付给加州学徒委员会

options.en: Held in trust until the project is complete
options.cn: 信托保管，直到项目完成

options.en: Credited against the contractor's prevailing wage obligation
options.cn: 抵扣承包商的现行工资义务

explanation_en: Under DIR Public Works Manual Section 4.2.5.4.3, for crafts not identified with an apprenticeable craft symbol on the wage determination, any training contribution listed must be paid directly to the worker as wages, not remitted to the CAC, unless a CBA obligates the contractor to pay an applicable training program.
explanation_cn: 根据DIR《公共工程手册》第4.2.5.4.3条，对于在工资裁定中未标识为可学徒工种符号的工艺，任何列出的培训费用必须直接支付给工人作为工资，而不是上缴给CAC，除非集体劳动协议要求承包商支付适用的培训项目。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1777.5; DIR Public Works Manual Section 4.2.5.4.3 (Document p. 55, PDF p. 61)

question_en: When a pension plan contains vesting requirements, how does the vesting schedule affect the amount of fringe benefit credit a contractor may take against its prevailing wage obligation?
question_cn: 当养老计划包含归属要求时，归属计划如何影响承包商可抵扣其法定工资义务的附加福利金额？

options.en: No credit is allowed until the worker is fully vested
options.cn: 在工人完全归属之前，不允许享有任何抵扣

options.en: The credit is limited to the vested portion only
options.cn: 抵扣仅限于已归属的部分

options.en: Vesting delays proportionally reduce the employer's credit amount
options.cn: 归属延迟会按比例减少雇主的抵扣金额

options.en: Vesting does not normally affect the allowable credit amount
options.cn: 归属通常不会影响允许的抵扣金额

explanation_en: Per DIR Public Works Manual Section 4.2.5.2.3, vesting requirements do not affect the employer's credit, provided the pension plan is a bona fide plan meeting ERISA minimum vesting requirements, and forfeited contributions cannot revert to the employer.
explanation_cn: 根据DIR《公共工程手册》第4.2.5.2.3节，只要养老计划是真实有效、符合ERISA最低归属要求的计划，并且被没收的供款不得返还给雇主，归属要求不会影响雇主的抵扣。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1773.1; DIR Public Works Manual Section 4.2.5.2.3 (Document p. 53, PDF p. 59)

question_en: For an employer payment toward fringe benefits to qualify as a valid credit against prevailing wage obligations, how many of the three conditions listed in Labor Code Section 1773.1 must be satisfied?
question_cn: 为了使雇主对附加福利的付款能够作为遵守最低工资义务的有效抵免，《劳动法》第1773.1条列出的三个条件中必须满足多少个条件？

options.en: Any one of the three conditions is sufficient
options.cn: 满足三个条件中的任何一个即可

options.en: The conditions apply only to union-signatory contractors
options.cn: 这些条件仅适用于工会签约承包商

options.en: At least two of the three conditions must be met
options.cn: 必须满足三个条件中的至少两个

options.en: All three conditions must be satisfied simultaneously
options.cn: 必须同时满足所有三个条件

explanation_en: Under DIR Public Works Manual Section 4.2.5.1 interpreting Labor Code Section 1773.1, it is sufficient that the employer payment satisfies any one of the three specified conditions for the credit against the prevailing wage obligation to be valid.
explanation_cn: 根据DIR公共工程手册第4.2.5.1节对《劳动法》第1773.1条的解释，只要雇主支付满足三个指定条件中的任何一个，该抵免对遵守最低工资义务即为有效。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1773.1; DIR Public Works Manual Section 4.2.5.1 (Document p. 52, PDF p. 58)

question_en: Before applying assessed penalties, what must a contractor first satisfy under Labor Code Section 1775?
question_cn: 在适用评估的罚款之前，根据《劳动法》第1775条，承包商必须首先满足什么条件？

options.en: File a corrected certified payroll with the awarding body
options.cn: 向授予机构提交更正后的认证工资单

options.en: Pay all outstanding wages owed to affected workers
options.cn: 支付欠付给受影响工人的所有未付工资

options.en: Obtain approval from the awarding body to pay penalties
options.cn: 获得授予机构批准支付罚款

options.en: Post a notice of the violation on the jobsite
options.cn: 在工地张贴违规通知

explanation_en: Under Labor Code Section 1775, any outstanding wages must be satisfied before applying the assessed penalty amount. This sequencing ensures workers receive owed compensation before penalty funds are distributed.
explanation_cn: 根据《劳动法》第1775条，任何未付工资必须在适用评估罚款金额之前解决。这种顺序确保工人在罚款资金发放之前收到应得的报酬。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1775 (Document p. 60, PDF p. 66)

question_en: A prime contractor discovers that its subcontractor has been underpaying workers on a public works project. What must the contractor do with funds still owed to the subcontractor?
question_cn: 总承包商发现其分包商在公共工程项目中未按规定支付工人工资。承包商必须如何处理仍应支付给分包商的款项？

options.en: Retain sufficient funds due the subcontractor
options.cn: 保留应支付给分包商的足够款项

options.en: Notify the awarding body and wait for instructions
options.cn: 通知授予机构并等待指示

options.en: Release all funds immediately to avoid project delays
options.cn: 立即释放所有款项以避免项目延误

options.en: File a stop payment notice with the county recorder
options.cn: 向县记录员提交停止付款通知

explanation_en: Labor Code Section 1775(b)(3) requires the contractor to diligently take corrective action, including retaining sufficient funds due the subcontractor, to halt or rectify the prevailing wage failure.
explanation_cn: 《劳动法》第1775(b)(3)条要求承包商勤勉采取纠正措施，包括保留应支付给分包商的足够款项，以阻止或纠正工资标准违规行为。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1775(b)(3) (Document p. 62, PDF p. 68)

question_en: Before making final payment to a subcontractor on a public works project, what document must the prime contractor obtain?
question_cn: 在向公共工程项目的分包商支付最终款项之前，总承包商必须获取哪份文件？

options.en: A completed certified payroll record for all weeks
options.cn: 所有周的完整认证工资记录

options.en: A release signed by every worker on the project
options.cn: 项目中每位工人签署的解除文件

options.en: A signed affidavit under penalty of perjury
options.cn: 在作伪证罪处罚下签署的宣誓书

options.en: A certified copy of the subcontractor's DIR registration
options.cn: 分包商 DIR 注册的认证副本

explanation_en: Labor Code Section 1775(b)(4) requires the prime contractor to obtain an affidavit signed under penalty of perjury from the subcontractor confirming that all prevailing wages and Section 1813 amounts have been paid before releasing final payment.
explanation_cn: 《劳动法》第 1775(b)(4) 条要求总承包商在支付最终款项之前，从分包商处获取一份在作伪证罪处罚下签署的宣誓书，确认已支付所有普遍工资和第 1813 条款规定的金额。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1775(b)(4) (Document p. 62, PDF p. 68)

question_en: A prime contractor satisfies all four conditions of Labor Code Section 1775(b) and avoids Section 1775 penalties. Is the contractor still liable for its subcontractor's wage underpayments?
question_cn: 如果总承包商满足《劳动法》第1775(b)条的所有四个条件，并且避免了第1775条的处罚，该承包商是否仍然对其分包商的工资欠付负责？

options.en: Yes, for wage underpayments and certain other penalties
options.cn: 是的，对工资欠付和某些其他处罚负责

options.en: No, liability transfers entirely to the subcontractor
options.cn: 否，责任完全转移给分包商

options.en: Yes, but only for penalties, not for back wages
options.cn: 是的，但仅对处罚负责，不对拖欠工资负责

options.en: No, meeting all four conditions eliminates all liability
options.cn: 否，满足所有四个条件即可消除所有责任

explanation_en: Even when a prime contractor avoids Section 1775 penalties under subsection (b)(1)-(4), it remains jointly and severally liable for all wage underpayments and penalties available under Labor Code Sections 1813 and 1742.1.
explanation_cn: 即使总承包商根据第(b)(1)-(4)款避免了第1775条的处罚，它仍然对《劳动法》第1813条和第1742.1条规定的所有工资欠付和处罚承担连带责任。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1775(b); Labor Code Sections 1813 and 1742.1 (Document p. 62, PDF p. 68)

question_en: What is the fixed penalty per worker per calendar day for requiring a worker to work more than eight hours in a single day on a public works project?
question_cn: 在公共工程项目中，如果要求工人单日工作超过八小时，每个工人每天的固定罚款是多少？

options.en: $10 per worker per calendar day
options.cn: 每个工人每天 10 美元

options.en: $25 per worker per calendar day
options.cn: 每个工人每天 25 美元

options.en: $50 per worker per calendar day
options.cn: 每个工人每天 50 美元

options.en: $200 per worker per calendar day
options.cn: 每个工人每天 200 美元

explanation_en: Labor Code Section 1813 fixes the penalty at exactly $25 per worker for each calendar day during which the worker is required or permitted to work more than eight hours in a day or 40 hours in a week. The Labor Commissioner has no discretion to reduce or waive this amount.
explanation_cn: 《劳动法》第1813条将罚款固定为每个工人每个日历日 25 美元，如果工人被要求或允许在一天内工作超过八小时或在一周内工作超过40小时。劳动专员无权减少或免除此金额。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1813 (Document p. 62, PDF p. 68)

question_en: How does the Labor Code Section 1813 overtime penalty differ from the Section 1775 prevailing wage penalty?
question_cn: 劳工法典第1813条的加班处罚与第1775条的现行工资处罚有何不同？

options.en: Section 1813 penalties are assessed weekly, not daily
options.cn: 第1813条的处罚是按周计算的，而不是按天计算的

options.en: Section 1813 penalties can be reduced by the Labor Commissioner
options.cn: 劳工专员可以减少第1813条的处罚

options.en: Section 1813 penalties cannot be assessed against subcontractors
options.cn: 第1813条的处罚不能对分包商施加

options.en: Section 1813 penalties cannot be reduced or waived at all
options.cn: 第1813条的处罚完全不能减少或免除

explanation_en: Labor Code Section 1813 fixes the penalty amount at $25 per worker per day, and unlike Section 1775, the Labor Commissioner has no discretion to not assess, reduce, or modify the penalty.
explanation_cn: 劳工法典第1813条将每名工人每天的处罚金额固定为25美元，与第1775条不同，劳工专员无权不评估、减少或修改该处罚。
code_reference: Labor Code Sections 1775 and 1813 (Document p. 62, PDF p. 68)

question_en: A contractor submits worker release forms signed by employees as proof that all prevailing wages were paid. How will the Labor Commissioner treat these releases?
question_cn: 承包商提交由员工签署的工人释放表格，作为支付所有普遍工资的证明。劳工专员将如何处理这些释放表格？

options.en: They are accepted if the awarding body also signs them
options.cn: 如果授奖机构也签署，它们将被接受

options.en: They are conclusive proof if signed under penalty of perjury
options.cn: 如果在伪证处罚下签署，它们是决定性证据

options.en: They require independent proof to be given weight
options.cn: 它们需要独立证据才能被重视

options.en: They are rejected outright and never considered
options.cn: 它们将被直接拒绝，永不考虑

explanation_en: Under DIR Public Works Manual Section 4.6.1 and Labor Code Section 206.5, the Labor Commissioner will not accept releases as conclusive proof standing alone. They must be supported by independent evidence such as cancelled checks and worker confirmation.
explanation_cn: 根据《DIR 公共工程手册》第4.6.1节和《劳动法》第206.5节，劳工专员不会仅凭释放表格作为决定性证据。它们必须辅以独立证据，例如已注销的支票和工人确认。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 206.5; DIR Public Works Manual Section 4.6.1 (Document p. 63, PDF p. 69)

question_en: A Civil Wage and Penalty Assessment (CWPA) is served on a contractor. How long does the contractor have to request an administrative review hearing before the assessment becomes final?
question_cn: 民事工资和罚款评估（CWPA）送达承包商后，承包商有多久时间可以请求行政复审听证会，评估才能生效？

options.en: Within 90 days after service of the CWPA
options.cn: CWPA送达后90天内
