options.en: Within 45 days after service of the CWPA
options.cn: CWPA送达后45天内

options.en: Within 60 days after service of the CWPA
options.cn: CWPA送达后60天内

options.en: Within 30 days after service of the CWPA
options.cn: CWPA送达后30天内

explanation_en: Labor Code Section 1742(a) provides that a CWPA becomes final if no review hearing is requested within 60 days after service. Once final, the Labor Commissioner may collect from the awarding body or seek a court judgment.
explanation_cn: 劳工法第1742(a)条规定，如果在送达后60天内未请求复审听证会，CWPA将成为最终决定。一旦最终确定，劳动专员可以向授予机构索取款项或寻求法院判决。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1742(a) (Document p. 65, PDF p. 71)

question_en: A contractor is served with a CWPA and wants to request a settlement meeting. What is the deadline to make this request?
question_cn: 承包商收到 CWPA 并想要请求和解会议。提出此请求的截止日期是什么？

options.en: Within 60 days following service of the CWPA
options.cn: CWPA 送达后 60 天内

options.en: Within 45 days following service of the CWPA
options.cn: CWPA 送达后 45 天内

options.en: Within 15 days following service of the CWPA
options.cn: CWPA 送达后 15 天内

options.en: Within 30 days following service of the CWPA
options.cn: CWPA 送达后 30 天内

explanation_en: Labor Code Section 1742.1 requires that the contractor request a settlement meeting within 30 days following service of the CWPA. The Labor Commissioner must then afford the contractor an opportunity to meet and attempt resolution.
explanation_cn: 劳工法第 1742.1 条规定，承包商必须在 CWPA 送达后 30 天内请求和解会议。劳工专员随后必须给予承包商会面和尝试解决的机会。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1742.1 (Document p. 66, PDF p. 72)

question_en: Which of the following actions can trigger debarment under Labor Code Section 1777.1?
question_cn: 根据《劳动法》第1777.1条，下列哪些行为可能导致被禁止参与投标？

options.en: Two or more willful violations within a three-year period
options.cn: 在三年内两次或以上的故意违规

options.en: A single late certified payroll submission on one project
options.cn: 在一个项目上一次延迟提交认证工资单

options.en: Failure to register with DIR before project completion
options.cn: 在项目完成前未在DIR注册

options.en: One accidental underpayment corrected before audit completion
options.cn: 一次意外的少付工资在审计完成前已更正

explanation_en: Labor Code Section 1777.1(b) authorizes debarment when a contractor commits two or more separate willful violations of the Public Works Chapter within any three-year period.
explanation_cn: 《劳动法》第1777.1(b)条授权在承包商在任何三年期间对公共工程章节犯有两次或以上独立的故意违规时施加禁止参与投标的处罚。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1777.1(c) (Document p. 68, PDF p. 74)

question_en: A contractor is debarred for a first serious violation of Labor Code Section 1777.5 regarding apprenticeship requirements. What is the maximum debarment period?
question_cn: 承包商因首次严重违反劳动法第1777.5条（关于学徒要求）而被禁止执业。最长的禁止期是多久？

options.en: Up to three years for the first violation
options.cn: 首次违规最多三年

options.en: Up to two years for the first violation
options.cn: 首次违规最多两年

options.en: Up to one year for the first violation
options.cn: 首次违规最多一年

options.en: Up to five years for the first violation
options.cn: 首次违规最多五年

explanation_en: Labor Code Section 1777.1(d) limits debarment to up to one year for a first serious violation of Section 1777.5 (apprenticeship), and up to three years for a second or subsequent serious violation.
explanation_cn: 劳动法第1777.1(d)条规定，首次严重违反第1777.5条（学徒制）时，禁止期最长为一年；第二次或随后严重违规时，禁止期最长为三年。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1777.1(d) (Document p. 68, PDF p. 74)

question_en: What practical effect does a debarment order have on the named contractor?
question_cn: 公共工程禁业处分对被点名的承包商有什么实际影响？

options.en: Limits the contractor to projects under $25,000
options.cn: 将承包商限制在25,000美元以下的项目

options.en: Temporarily suspends the contractor's CSLB license
options.cn: 暂时吊销承包商的CSLB执照

options.en: Requires the contractor to post an additional bond
options.cn: 要求承包商提供额外的保证金

options.en: Prohibits the contractor from all public works work
options.cn: 禁止承包商从事所有公共工程工作

explanation_en: Labor Code Section 1777.1 provides that a debarment order prohibits the named contractor from bidding on, being awarded, or performing work as a subcontractor on any public works project during the debarment period.
explanation_cn: 《加州劳动法典》第1777.1条规定，在公共工程禁业期内，被点名的承包商不得竞标或获授任何公共工程项目，也不得以分包商身份承接此类项目。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1777.1 (Document p. 68, PDF p. 74)

question_en: A CWPA is served on a contractor who does not request a hearing within 60 days. What can the Labor Commissioner do to collect if the awarding body has no retained funds?
question_cn: CWPA 已送达给一个在 60 天内未请求听证会的承包商。如果授奖机构没有保留资金，劳工专员可以采取什么措施进行追缴？

options.en: Re-issue the CWPA with additional penalties attached
options.cn: 重新签发 CWPA 并附加额外罚款

options.en: Refer the matter to the CSLB for license revocation
options.cn: 将此事提交给 CSLB 以吊销许可证

options.en: Request entry of judgment in Superior Court
options.cn: 请求在高等法院登记判决

options.en: Place a mechanic's lien on the contractor's property
options.cn: 在承包商的财产上设立工程留置权

explanation_en: Labor Code Section 1742(d) authorizes the Labor Commissioner to request entry of judgment against the contractor in the Superior Court in any county where the contractor has property or a place of business when awarding body funds are insufficient.
explanation_cn: 劳工法第 1742(d) 条授权劳工专员在授奖机构资金不足时，可请求在承包商拥有财产或营业地点的任何县的高等法院对承包商登记判决。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1742(d) (Document p. 68, PDF p. 74)

question_en: Within how many months after a valid notice of completion is filed must the Labor Commissioner serve a Civil Wage and Penalty Assessment?
question_cn: 在提交有效的竣工通知后多少个月内，劳工专员必须送达民事工资和罚款评估？

options.en: Within 12 months after filing of the notice
options.cn: 在提交通知后12个月内

options.en: Within 36 months after filing of the notice
options.cn: 在提交通知后36个月内

options.en: Within 18 months after filing of the notice
options.cn: 在提交通知后18个月内

options.en: Within 24 months after filing of the notice
options.cn: 在提交通知后24个月内

explanation_en: Labor Code Section 1741 requires that a CWPA be served not later than 18 months after the filing of a valid notice of completion with the county recorder, or 18 months after acceptance of the public work, whichever occurs last.
explanation_cn: 劳工法第1741条规定，CWPA必须在向县登记处提交有效竣工通知后不迟于18个月送达，或在公共工程被接受后不迟于18个月送达，以较晚者为准。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1741 (Document p. 64, PDF p. 70)

question_en: A subcontractor on a public works project has never registered with DIR and performs work for 45 days. What is the maximum daily penalty the unregistered subcontractor faces?
question_cn: 一名公共工程项目的分包商从未在 DIR 注册，并进行了 45 天的工作。未注册的分包商面临的最高每日罚款是多少？

options.en: $500 per day for each violation day
options.cn: 每违规一天 500 美元

options.en: $50 per day for each violation day
options.cn: 每违规一天 50 美元

options.en: $200 per day for each violation day
options.cn: 每违规一天 200 美元

options.en: $100 per day for each violation day
options.cn: 每违规一天 100 美元

explanation_en: Labor Code Section 1771.1(g) expressly imposes $100 per day for each day an unregistered contractor performs work, not to exceed a total of $8,000.
explanation_cn: 《劳动法》第 1771.1(g) 条明确规定，未注册承包商每工作一天应缴纳 100 美元的罚款，总罚款不超过 8,000 美元。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1771.1(g) (Document p. 76, PDF p. 82)

question_en: What is the maximum total penalty an unregistered contractor can be assessed for performing public works without registration?
question_cn: 未注册的承包商因在未注册的情况下从事公共工程活动，最高可被处以的总罚款是多少？

options.en: $8,000 total in daily penalties
options.cn: 每日罚款总计8,000美元

options.en: $2,000 total regardless of days worked
options.cn: 无论工作天数，总计2,000美元

options.en: $10,000 total for the entire project
options.cn: 整个项目总计10,000美元

options.en: $5,000 total regardless of days worked
options.cn: 无论工作天数，总计5,000美元

explanation_en: Labor Code Section 1771.1(g) caps the daily penalty at $8,000 total, separate from the $2,000 registration qualification fee the contractor must also pay.
explanation_cn: 《劳动法》第1771.1(g)条将每日罚款上限规定为总计8,000美元，与承包商还必须支付的2,000美元注册资格费分开。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1771.1(g) (Document p. 76, PDF p. 82)

question_en: A general contractor unknowingly subcontracts work to a lower-tier subcontractor whose registration was later revoked by DIR. Is the general contractor liable for the penalties associated with the unregistered subcontractor?
question_cn: 一般承包商在不知情的情况下将工作分包给注册后被 DIR 吊销的低层分包商。该一般承包商是否需要对与未注册分包商相关的处罚负责？

options.en: Yes, but only for the first 30 days of work
options.cn: 是的，但仅限于前 30 天的工作

options.en: No, because the revocation exception applies here
options.cn: 不是，因为此处适用吊销例外

options.en: Yes, liability applies with no exceptions allowed
options.cn: 是的，责任适用且不允许任何例外

options.en: No, because the subcontractor indemnified the contractor
options.cn: 不是，因为分包商已对承包商提供赔偿

explanation_en: Labor Code Section 1771.1(h) creates an exception for higher-tiered contractors when a lower-tiered subcontractor's registration violation results from a revocation rather than a failure to register in the first place.
explanation_cn: 劳工法典第 1771.1(h) 条规定，当低层分包商的注册违规是由于吊销而非最初未注册时，高层承包商有例外。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1771.1(h) (Document p. 77, PDF p. 83)

question_en: What is the maximum penalty a general contractor faces for each day it allows an unregistered subcontractor to perform work on a public works project?
question_cn: 总承包商如果允许未注册的分包商在公共工程项目上工作，每天可能面临的最高罚款是多少？

options.en: $100 per day, not to exceed $8,000
options.cn: 每天100美元，但不超过8,000美元

options.en: $200 per day, not to exceed $10,000
options.cn: 每天200美元，但不超过10,000美元

options.en: $100 per day, not to exceed $10,000
options.cn: 每天100美元，但不超过10,000美元

options.en: $500 per day, not to exceed $10,000
options.cn: 每天500美元，但不超过10,000美元

explanation_en: Labor Code Section 1771.1(h) imposes $100 per day on a higher-tiered contractor that subcontracts with an unregistered lower-tier contractor, capped at $10,000.
explanation_cn: 《劳动法》第1771.1(h)条规定，高层承包商与未注册的下层承包商分包时，每天罚款100美元，最高不超过10,000美元。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1771.1(h) (Document p. 77, PDF p. 83)

question_en: A general contractor wants to include a clause in its subcontracts requiring subcontractors to indemnify it against DIR registration penalties. Is this allowed?
question_cn: 总承包商希望在分包合同中加入一条条款，要求分包商赔偿其因 DIR 注册罚款而产生的损失。这允许吗？

options.en: No, unless the subcontractor is a sole proprietor
options.cn: 不允许，除非分包商是个体经营者

options.en: Yes, but only for projects exceeding $25,000
options.cn: 允许，但仅限于项目超过 25,000 美元的情况

options.en: No, this type of indemnification is prohibited
options.cn: 不允许，这种类型的赔偿是被禁止的

options.en: Yes, if both parties sign the agreement voluntarily
options.cn: 允许，如果双方自愿签署协议

explanation_en: Labor Code Section 1771.1(h) expressly prohibits higher-tiered contractors from requiring subcontractors to indemnify them for penalties arising from a lower-tier subcontractor's registration violation.
explanation_cn: 劳工法典第 1771.1(h) 条明确禁止高层承包商要求分包商赔偿因低层分包商登记违规而产生的罚款。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1771.1(h) (Document p. 77, PDF p. 83)

question_en: An unregistered subcontractor is found working on a public works project. What action must the Labor Commissioner take?
question_cn: 在公共工程项目中发现一名未注册的分包商正在工作。劳动专员必须采取什么行动？

options.en: Suspend the contractor's license immediately
options.cn: 立即暂停承包商的执照

options.en: Issue a stop order on all public works
options.cn: 对所有公共工程发出停工令

options.en: Refer the matter to CSLB for investigation
options.cn: 将此事提交给加州承包商州许可委员会（CSLB）调查

options.en: Issue a civil wage and penalty assessment
options.cn: 发出民事工资和处罚评估

explanation_en: Labor Code Section 1771.1(j) requires the Labor Commissioner to issue a stop order prohibiting the unregistered contractor from performing work on all public works projects until registration is obtained.
explanation_cn: 《劳动法》第1771.1(j)条规定，劳动专员必须发出停工令，禁止未注册承包商在所有公共工程项目上施工，直到获得注册为止。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1771.1(j) (Document p. 77, PDF p. 83)

question_en: A contractor ignores a stop order issued by the Labor Commissioner for performing public works while unregistered. What is the maximum criminal penalty?
question_cn: 承包商在未注册的情况下进行公共工程，忽视劳动专员发出的停止令。最高刑事处罚是什么？

options.en: Up to 1 year in jail or $50,000 fine
options.cn: 最高1年监禁或5万美元罚款

options.en: Up to 6 months in jail or $25,000 fine
options.cn: 最高6个月监禁或2.5万美元罚款

options.en: Up to 60 days in jail or $10,000 fine
options.cn: 最高60天监禁或1万美元罚款

options.en: Up to 30 days in jail or $5,000 fine
options.cn: 最高30天监禁或5,000美元罚款

explanation_en: Labor Code Section 1771.1(j) makes violation of a stop order a misdemeanor punishable by up to 60 days in county jail, a fine up to $10,000, or both.
explanation_cn: 《劳动法》第1771.1(j)条规定，违反停止令属于轻罪，可处以最多60天县监狱监禁、最高1万美元罚款，或两者并罚。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1771.1(j) (Document p. 77, PDF p. 83)

question_en: Within how many days of a public works contract award must an awarding body electronically notify DIR using the PWC-100 form?
question_cn: 在公共工程合同授予后多少天内，授予机构必须使用 PWC-100 表格电子通知 DIR？

options.en: Within 30 days, but before work starts
options.cn: 在 30 天内，但在工作开始之前

options.en: Within 45 days of the contract award
options.cn: 在合同授予后 45 天内

options.en: Within 60 days of the contract award
options.cn: 在合同授予后 60 天内

options.en: Within 10 days of the contract award
options.cn: 在合同授予后 10 天内

explanation_en: Labor Code Section 1773.3 requires awarding bodies to file the PWC-100 within 30 days of contract award, but in no event later than the first day work is performed under the contract.
explanation_cn: 《劳动法》第 1773.3 条要求授予机构在合同授予后 30 天内提交 PWC-100，但无论如何不得晚于合同项下工作的第一天。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1773.3 (Document p. 76, PDF p. 82)

question_en: A sole proprietor with no employees contracts to perform a portion of a public works project. Must this person be registered with DIR?
question_cn: 一个没有员工的个体经营者承包执行公共工程项目的一部分。此人必须在DIR注册吗？

options.en: Yes, registration applies to all public works performers
options.cn: 是的，注册适用于所有公共工程执行者

options.en: No, sole proprietors are permanently exempt from registration
options.cn: 不，个体经营者永久免于注册

options.en: No, registration only applies to employers with employees
options.cn: 不，注册仅适用于有员工的雇主

options.en: Yes, but only if the project exceeds $25,000
options.cn: 是的，但仅当项目超过25,000美元时

explanation_en: Labor Code Sections 1725.5 and 1777.1 require registration by all contractors and subcontractors bidding on or performing public works, including sole proprietors and brokers, regardless of whether they have employees.
explanation_cn: 《劳动法》第1725.5和1777.1条款要求所有投标或执行公共工程的承包商和分包商注册，包括个体经营者和经纪人，无论他们是否有员工。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1725.5; Labor Code Section 1777.1 (Document p. 76, PDF p. 82)

question_en: An awarding body allows an unregistered contractor to perform public works, and final payment has already been made when the violation is discovered. What penalty applies to the awarding body?
question_cn: 如果一个授奖机构允许未注册的承包商进行公共工程，而在发现违规行为时，最终付款已经完成。那么授奖机构适用什么处罚？

options.en: $200 per day up to a 60-day maximum
options.cn: 每天200美元，最高不超过60天

options.en: $100 per day for up to 100 days each
options.cn: 每天100美元，最多100天

options.en: $100 per day up to $10,000 per project
options.cn: 每天100美元，每个项目最多10,000美元

options.en: No penalty applies once final payment is made
options.cn: 一旦最终付款完成，则不适用任何处罚

explanation_en: Labor Code Section 1773.3(d) imposes $100 for each calendar day of noncompliance, up to 100 days, for each unregistered contractor or subcontractor discovered after final payment has been made.
explanation_cn: 《劳动法》第1773.3(d)条规定，对于在最终付款后发现的每个未注册的承包商或分包商，每不合规的日历天处以100美元，最多100天。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1773.3(d) (Document p. 78, PDF p. 84)

question_en: An awarding agency commits two willful violations of public works laws within a one-year period. What consequence does the Labor Commissioner impose?
question_cn: 一个授奖机构在一年内犯了两次严重违反公共工程法律的行为。劳工专员会施加什么后果？

options.en: It is fined $50,000 per violation found
options.cn: 每发现一次违规行为，罚款50,000美元

options.en: It loses state funding eligibility for one year
options.cn: 在一年内失去州政府资金资格

options.en: It is permanently barred from public contracting
options.cn: 永久禁止参与公共合同

options.en: Its director is personally fined and debarred
options.cn: 其主管个人被罚款并被取消资格

explanation_en: Labor Code Section 1773.3(f) provides that an awarding agency with two or more willful violations within one year is ineligible to receive state funding or financial assistance for any construction project for one year.
explanation_cn: 劳工法典第1773.3(f)条规定，授奖机构在一年内有两次或以上严重违规行为的，将在一年内失去获得任何建设项目州政府资金或经济援助的资格。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1773.3(f) (Document p. 78, PDF p. 84)

question_en: Under the small project exception created by SB 96, which project value threshold exempts contractors from certain DIR registration requirements for new construction?
question_cn: 根据 SB 96 创建的小型项目例外，哪一项目价值门槛可以免除承包商在新建工程中某些 DIR 注册要求？

options.en: Projects that do not exceed $25,000
options.cn: 项目不超过 $25,000

options.en: Projects that do not exceed $10,000
options.cn: 项目不超过 $10,000

options.en: Projects that do not exceed $50,000
options.cn: 项目不超过 $50,000

options.en: Projects that do not exceed $15,000
options.cn: 项目不超过 $15,000

explanation_en: SB 96 created a small project exception for new construction, alteration, installation, demolition, or repair projects that do not exceed $25,000, per DIR Public Works Manual Section 6.6.
explanation_cn: 根据 DIR 公共工程手册第 6.6 节，SB 96 为新建、改建、安装、拆除或修理项目创建了小型项目例外，这些项目的价值不超过 $25,000。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1771.1; DIR Public Works Manual Chapter 6.6 (Document p. 78, PDF p. 84)

question_en: A Labor Compliance Program (LCP) wishes to withhold $1,500 from a contractor for prevailing wage violations. What must the LCP do before implementing the withholding?
question_cn: 劳动合规计划 (LCP) 希望因违反现行工资规定从承包商处扣留 1,500 美元。在实施扣留之前，LCP 必须做什么？

options.en: File a complaint directly with the contractor
options.cn: 直接向承包商提出投诉

options.en: Send the contractor a 30-day cure notice
options.cn: 向承包商发送 30 天整改通知

options.en: Notify the awarding body and withhold immediately
options.cn: 通知授予机构并立即扣留

options.en: Submit the forfeiture for Labor Commissioner approval
options.cn: 将罚没提交给劳动专员批准

explanation_en: Under 8 CCR Section 16436, any forfeiture exceeding $1,000 must be submitted to and approved by the Labor Commissioner before the LCP can issue a Notice of Withholding Contract Payments.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR 第 16436 条，任何超过 1,000 美元的罚没必须提交劳动专员批准，然后 LCP 才能发出扣留合同付款通知。
code_reference: CCR Title 8 Section 16436 (Document p. 73, PDF p. 79)

question_en: A Labor Compliance Program submits a forfeiture request to the Labor Commissioner. Within how many days must the Labor Commissioner respond?
question_cn: 劳动合规计划向劳动专员提交没收申请。劳动专员必须在多少天内回应？

options.en: Within 10 days of receiving the request
options.cn: 收到申请后的10天内

options.en: Within 45 days of receiving the request
options.cn: 收到申请后的45天内

options.en: Within 30 days of receiving the request
options.cn: 收到申请后的30天内

options.en: Within 60 days of receiving the request
options.cn: 收到申请后的60天内

explanation_en: Under 8 CCR Section 16437, the Labor Commissioner is required to respond to an LCP forfeiture request within 30 days of receipt of the proposed forfeiture submission.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州法规典》第8卷第16437条，劳动专员必须在收到拟定没收申请后的30天内回应劳动合规计划的没收请求。
code_reference: CCR Title 8 Section 16437 (Document p. 74, PDF p. 80)

question_en: A contractor bids on a public works project but is not currently registered with DIR. What disqualification applies?
question_cn: 承包商对一项公共工程项目投标，但目前未在 DIR 注册。适用的取消资格是什么？

options.en: The bid is accepted but flagged for later review
options.cn: 投标被接受，但标记为稍后审查

options.en: The contractor's CSLB license is automatically suspended
options.cn: 承包商的 CSLB 执照自动被暂停

options.en: The contractor is disqualified from bidding on the project
options.cn: 承包商被取消该项目的投标资格

options.en: The contractor must pay a $500 late registration fee
options.cn: 承包商必须支付 500 美元的迟注册费

explanation_en: Labor Code Section 1777.1 prohibits a contractor that is not registered under Labor Code Section 1725.5 from bidding on, being listed in a bid proposal, or performing work on a public works contract.
explanation_cn: 《劳动法》第 1777.1 条禁止未根据《劳动法》第 1725.5 条注册的承包商参与公共工程合同的投标、列在投标提案中或执行工作。
code_reference: Labor Code Section 1777.1; Labor Code Section 1725.5 (Document p. 76, PDF p. 82)

question_en: A construction employer with 8 employees holds a weekly safety meeting where the foreman verbally explains jobsite hazards. Under 8 CCR §3203, does this satisfy the IIPP communication requirement?
question_cn: 一家有 8 名员工的建筑雇主每周召开一次安全会议，工长在会上口头讲解工地危险。根据 8 CCR 第 3203 条，这是否满足 IIPP 的沟通要求？

options.en: No, all employers must use written communications only
options.cn: 不，所有雇主必须仅使用书面沟通

options.en: Yes, oral instruction is permitted for employers under 10 employees
options.cn: 是的，对于员工少于 10 人的雇主允许口头指导

options.en: Yes, but only if a written log of meetings is maintained
options.cn: 是的，但前提是必须记录会议的书面日志

options.en: No, a labor/management safety committee is always required
options.cn: 不，总是需要设立劳资安全委员会

explanation_en: Under 8 CCR §3203(a)(3) Exception, employers with fewer than 10 employees may communicate to and instruct employees orally in general safe work practices, satisfying the IIPP communication requirement.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州法规汇编》第8篇第3203(a)(3)条例外规定，员工少于10人的雇主可以口头传达并指导一般安全作业规范，从而满足IIPP的沟通要求。

question_en: An employee suffers a serious injury on a construction site at 7:00 AM. The employer learns of the injury at 8:00 AM. By what time must the employer report it to Cal/OSHA?
question_cn: 一名员工在早上7:00于施工现场遭受严重伤害。雇主在上午8:00得知此伤害。雇主必须在什么时候向加州职业安全与健康局（Cal/OSHA）报告？

options.en: By the end of the same business day
options.cn: 在同一个工作日结束之前

options.en: Within 72 hours of the employer learning of it
options.cn: 在雇主得知伤害后的72小时内

options.en: No later than 4:00 PM the same day
options.cn: 不晚于当天下午4:00

options.en: Within 24 hours of the injury occurring
options.cn: 在伤害发生后的24小时内

explanation_en: Under 8 CCR §342(a), 'immediately' means no longer than 8 hours after the employer knows or should have known of the injury. Learning at 8:00 AM means the report is due by 4:00 PM.
explanation_cn: 根据8 CCR §342(a)，‘立即’的意思是雇主在知道或应当知道伤害后不超过8小时。若在上午8:00得知，则报告截止时间为下午4:00。

question_en: Under 8 CCR §342, which of the following would allow a contractor to delay a serious injury report beyond 8 hours but no longer than 24 hours?
question_cn: 根据 8 CCR §342，以下哪种情况允许承包商将严重伤害报告的提交时间延迟超过 8 小时但不超过 24 小时？

options.en: The injured employee has not yet been transported to a hospital
options.cn: 受伤员工尚未被送往医院

options.en: A police agency was already called and notified the Division
options.cn: 已经致电警方机构并通知了部门

options.en: The employer can demonstrate that exigent circumstances exist
options.cn: 雇主可以证明存在紧急情况

options.en: The employer has fewer than 10 employees at the worksite
options.cn: 工作现场的雇员少于 10 人

explanation_en: Under 8 CCR §342(a), the only basis for extending the report to 24 hours is if the employer can demonstrate that exigent circumstances exist. No other condition is cited in the regulation.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §342(a)，将报告延长至 24 小时的唯一依据是雇主能够证明存在紧急情况。法规中未提及其他条件。

question_en: A contractor's IIPP has been in place for two years. A new type of adhesive solvent with inhalation hazards is introduced to the jobsite. What does 8 CCR §3203 require the employer to do?
question_cn: 承包商的 IIPP 已实施两年。引入一种具有吸入危害的新型粘合剂溶剂到工作现场。8 CCR §3203 要求雇主做什么？

options.en: Update the IIPP document and file it with Cal/OSHA for approval
options.cn: 更新 IIPP 文件并提交给 Cal/OSHA 审批

options.en: Post a hazard notice at the jobsite within 24 hours of introduction
options.cn: 在引入后的 24 小时内在工作现场张贴危险通知

options.en: Conduct a new worksite inspection and provide employee training on the new hazard
options.cn: 进行新的工作现场检查，并为员工提供有关新危险的培训

options.en: Rewrite the entire IIPP and redistribute it to all employees
options.cn: 重新编写整个 IIPP 并分发给所有员工

explanation_en: Under 8 CCR §3203(a)(4)(B) and (a)(7)(D), introducing a new substance representing a new hazard triggers both a workplace hazard inspection and new employee training on that specific hazard.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §3203(a)(4)(B) 和 (a)(7)(D)，引入一种代表新危险的新物质会触发工作场所危险检查和针对该具体危险的新员工培训。

question_en: Under 8 CCR §1509, how frequently must supervisory employees conduct toolbox or tailgate safety meetings with their crews on a construction site?
question_cn: 根据《加利福尼亚法规》第8篇 CCR §1509，监督员工必须多频繁地与他们的施工队在工地上进行工具箱或尾部安全会议？

options.en: At least once per week on every active project
options.cn: 每个活跃项目至少每周一次

options.en: At least once every 10 working days
options.cn: 至少每10个工作日一次

options.en: At least quarterly, as noted in the labor/management guidelines
options.cn: 至少每季度一次，如劳动/管理指南中所示

options.en: At least once every 30 calendar days
options.cn: 至少每30个日历日一次

explanation_en: Under 8 CCR §1509(e), supervisory employees shall conduct toolbox or tailgate safety meetings, or equivalent, with their crews at least every 10 working days to emphasize safety.
explanation_cn: 根据《加利福尼亚法规》第8篇 CCR §1509(e)，监督员工应至少每10个工作日与他们的施工队进行工具箱或尾部安全会议，或同等形式的会议，以强调安全。

question_en: A construction employer's IIPP identifies an imminent hazard that cannot be corrected immediately without endangering workers. What must the employer do according to 8 CCR §3203?
question_cn: 建筑雇主的 IIPP 识别出无法立即消除且会危及工人的迫在眉睫的危险。根据 8 CCR §3203，雇主必须怎么做？

options.en: Tag the hazard and document it within 24 hours for review
options.cn: 对危险进行标记并在 24 小时内记录以供审查

options.en: Notify Cal/OSHA immediately before any corrective action is taken
options.cn: 在采取任何纠正措施之前立即通知 Cal/OSHA

options.en: Remove exposed workers and provide safeguards for those who remain
options.cn: 移走暴露的工人，并为仍然留下的工人提供安全防护措施

options.en: Shut down the entire project until the hazard is fully abated
options.cn: 在危险完全消除之前关闭整个项目

explanation_en: Under 8 CCR §3203(a)(6)(B), when an imminent hazard cannot be immediately abated, the employer must remove all exposed personnel except those necessary to correct the condition, and those employees must be provided the necessary safeguards.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §3203(a)(6)(B)，当迫在眉睫的危险无法立即消除时，雇主必须移走所有暴露的人员，除非是为纠正该情况所必需的人员，并且这些员工必须提供必要的安全防护措施。

question_en: A new hire at a construction company with 25 employees requests access to the employer's IIPP. Under 8 CCR §3203(a)(8), what is the maximum time the employer has to provide it?
question_cn: 一名在拥有25名员工的建筑公司新入职的员工请求访问雇主的《伤害与疾病预防计划》(IIPP)。根据 8 CCR §3203(a)(8)，雇主提供访问权限的最长时间是多少？

options.en: Within 3 business days of the written request
options.cn: 在书面请求后的3个工作日内

options.en: Within 30 calendar days, consistent with CSLB arbitration timelines
options.cn: 在30个日历日内，与CSLB仲裁时间表一致

options.en: Within 10 calendar days of the employee's request
options.cn: 在员工请求后的10个日历日内

options.en: Within 5 business days of the request being received
options.cn: 在收到请求后的5个工作日内

explanation_en: Under 8 CCR §3203(a)(8)(B)(1), the employer must provide access to the IIPP in no event later than five (5) business days after the request for access is received from an employee or designated representative.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §3203(a)(8)(B)(1)，雇主必须在收到员工或指定代表的访问请求后的五（5）个工作日内提供对IIPP的访问。

question_en: An employer with 6 employees keeps no inspection records once a hazard is corrected, instead of retaining them for one year. Is this a violation of 8 CCR §3203?
question_cn: 一家有6名员工的雇主在危险被纠正后不保留检查记录，而不是保留一年。这是否违反了 8 CCR §3203？

options.en: Yes, all employers must retain inspection records for one full year
options.cn: 是的，所有雇主必须保留检查记录完整一年

options.en: Yes, records must be kept until a Cal/OSHA audit is completed
options.cn: 是的，记录必须保留，直到完成 Cal/OSHA 审计

options.en: No, but only if the employer has a Workers' Compensation EMR below 1.0
options.cn: 否，但仅当雇主的工人赔偿 EMR 低于1.0时

options.en: No, under-10-employee employers may discard records once the hazard is corrected
options.cn: 否，少于10名员工的雇主在危险被纠正后可以丢弃记录

explanation_en: Under the Exception to 8 CCR §3203(b)(1), employers with fewer than 10 employees may elect to maintain inspection records only until the hazard is corrected, rather than the standard one-year period.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §3203(b)(1) 的例外情况，少于10名员工的雇主可以选择只在危险被纠正前保留检查记录，而不是标准的一年期限。

question_en: A general contractor has 18 employees, is in a non-high-hazard industry, and has a Workers' Compensation Experience Modification Rate of 1.05. What IIPP documentation exemption may apply under 8 CCR §3203?
question_cn: 一家总承包商有18名员工，属于非高危行业，工人赔偿经验修正率（EMR）为1.05。在8 CCR §3203下可能适用的IIPP文件豁免是什么？

options.en: Oral instruction replaces all written documentation requirements
options.cn: 口头指导取代所有书面文件要求

options.en: Written documentation may be limited to three specific elements only
options.cn: 书面文件可仅限于三个特定要素

options.en: Training records need not be kept if the EMR stays below 1.1
options.cn: 如果EMR保持低于1.1，则无需保存培训记录

options.en: No written IIPP documentation is required at all
options.cn: 完全不需要书面IIPP文件

explanation_en: Under 8 CCR §3203(b)(2) Exception No. 3, employers with fewer than 20 employees in non-high-hazard industries with an EMR of 1.1 or less may limit written documentation to: the responsible person's identity, scheduled inspections, and training records.
explanation_cn: 根据8 CCR §3203(b)(2) 第三项例外条款，员工少于20人的非高危行业，并且EMR为1.1或以下的雇主，可以将书面文件限制为：负责人的身份、计划检查和培训记录。
code_reference: 8 CCR §3203(b)(2) Exception No. 3

question_en: Under 8 CCR §1509, where must the Code of Safe Practices be located on a construction jobsite?
question_cn: 根据 8 CCR §1509，安全操作规范应放置在建筑工地的什么位置？

options.en: Submitted to the Cal/OSHA district office before each project starts
options.cn: 每个项目开始前提交给 Cal/OSHA 区域办公室

options.en: Posted at the jobsite office or given to each supervisory employee
options.cn: 张贴在工地办公室或提供给每位主管员工

options.en: Distributed to every individual worker on the crew before work begins
options.cn: 在工作开始前分发给工组的每位工人

options.en: Filed and maintained only in the main contractor's primary corporate office
options.cn: 仅归档并保存在总承包商的主要公司办公室

explanation_en: Under 8 CCR §1509(c), the Code of Safe Practices shall be posted at a conspicuous location at each job site office, or be provided to each supervisory employee who shall have it readily available.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §1509(c)，安全操作规范应张贴在每个工地办公室的显眼位置，或提供给每位主管员工，并确保他们随时可用。

question_en: A construction company had 9 employees for ten months of the year and 12 employees for two months. Must this employer keep Cal/OSHA Log 300 injury and illness records?
question_cn: 一家建筑公司在一年中的十个月有9名员工，在两个月有12名员工。该雇主是否必须保留加州职业安全与健康局（Cal/OSHA）Log 300的工伤和疾病记录？

options.en: No, because the average employee count was under 10 for the year
options.cn: 不需要，因为全年平均员工数不足10人

options.en: Yes, because the company exceeded 10 employees at some point during the year
options.cn: 需要，因为公司在一年中的某个时间超过了10名员工

options.en: No, because construction is a partially exempt industry under Table 1
options.cn: 不需要，因为建筑行业根据表1部分豁免

options.en: Yes, but only for the two months when headcount exceeded 10
options.cn: 需要，但仅限于员工数超过10人的两个月

explanation_en: Under 8 CCR §14300.1(a)(2) and (b)(2), the size exemption is determined by peak employment. Because this employer had more than 10 employees at any time during the year, Log 300 recordkeeping is required.
explanation_cn: 根据加州法规（8 CCR §14300.1(a)(2) 和 (b)(2)），规模豁免以员工最高人数为准。由于该雇主在一年中的任何时间超过10名员工，因此需要进行Log 300记录保存。

question_en: A worker is seriously injured on a jobsite and a local fire department responds. What obligation does the responding fire agency have under 8 CCR §342?
question_cn: 一名工人在工地上严重受伤，当地消防部门进行了响应。根据 8 CCR §342，响应的消防机构有哪些义务？

options.en: Complete a written Cal/OSHA accident report within 24 hours
options.cn: 在 24 小时内完成书面 Cal/OSHA 事故报告

options.en: Notify the nearest Cal/OSHA office by telephone immediately
options.cn: 立即通过电话通知最近的 Cal/OSHA 办公室

options.en: File a written incident report with the employer's insurer
options.cn: 向雇主的保险公司提交书面事故报告

options.en: Notify the employer's designated safety officer before leaving the scene
options.cn: 离开现场前通知雇主指定的安全官员

explanation_en: Under 8 CCR §342(b), whenever a state, county, or local fire or police agency responds to an accident involving a serious injury or death of an employee, the nearest office of Cal/OSHA shall be notified by telephone immediately by the responding agency.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §342(b)，每当州、县或地方消防或警察机构响应涉及员工严重伤害或死亡的事故时，响应机构应立即通过电话通知最近的 Cal/OSHA 办公室。

question_en: Under 8 CCR §3203, which of the following is NOT a trigger requiring a new workplace hazard inspection?
question_cn: 根据 8 CCR §3203，以下哪一项不是需要进行新的工作场所危险检查的触发条件？

options.en: When the IIPP is first established at the company
options.cn: 当公司首次建立 IIPP 时

options.en: When the employer hires a new supervisory employee
options.cn: 当雇主雇用新的监督员工时

options.en: When new equipment representing a new hazard is introduced
options.cn: 当引入代表新危险的新设备时

options.en: When the employer learns of a previously unrecognized hazard
options.cn: 当雇主发现以前未被识别的危险时

explanation_en: Hiring a new supervisor is not listed as a trigger for a new workplace hazard inspection under §3203(a)(4). The triggers are: program establishment, introduction of new hazards, and employer awareness of previously unrecognized hazards.
explanation_cn: 根据 §3203(a)(4)，雇用新的主管未列为新的工作场所危险检查的触发条件。触发条件包括：程序建立、引入新危险以及雇主意识到以前未被识别的危险。

question_en: A training record for an employee who worked for 8 months and then quit was not retained by the employer after termination. The employer did not provide it to the employee. Is the employer in violation of 8 CCR §3203?
question_cn: 一名员工工作了8个月后辞职，其培训记录在终止雇佣关系后未被雇主保留。雇主也未将其提供给员工。这是否违反了8 CCR §3203？

options.en: Yes, because all training records must be kept for at least one year
options.cn: 是的，因为所有培训记录必须至少保存一年

options.en: No, training records for any terminated employee need not be retained
options.cn: 否，对于任何已离职的员工无需保留培训记录

options.en: No, because the employee worked fewer than 12 months and waived record rights
options.cn: 否，因为员工工作时间不足12个月且放弃了记录权利

options.en: Yes, because the records should have been provided to the employee upon termination
options.cn: 是的，因为记录应在终止雇佣关系时提供给员工

explanation_en: Under 8 CCR §3203(b)(2) Exception No. 2, training records for employees who worked less than one year need not be retained beyond the term of employment, but only if they are provided to the employee upon termination. Failing to do so is a violation.
explanation_cn: 根据8 CCR §3203(b)(2) 第2项例外，工作时间不足一年的员工的培训记录在其离职后无需保留，但前提是必须在终止雇佣关系时提供给员工。未能提供属于违规行为。
code_reference: 8 CCR §3203(b)(2) Exception No. 2

question_en: A labor/management safety committee is used to comply with the IIPP communication requirement under 8 CCR §3203(c). How often must the committee meet at a minimum?
question_cn: 劳资安全委员会用于遵守 8 CCR §3203(c) 下的 IIPP 沟通要求。该委员会至少多久必须召开一次会议？

options.en: At least once every month
options.cn: 至少每月一次

options.en: At least once every three months (quarterly)
options.cn: 至少每三个月一次（季度）

options.en: At least once every six months
options.cn: 至少每六个月一次

options.en: At least once every two weeks
options.cn: 至少每两周一次

explanation_en: Under 8 CCR §3203(c)(1), a labor/management safety committee used to comply with the IIPP communication requirement must meet regularly, but not less than quarterly, to be presumed in substantial compliance.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §3203(c)(1)，用于遵守 IIPP 沟通要求的劳资安全委员会必须定期召开会议，但不得少于每季度一次，以被视为实质符合要求。

question_en: A worker injures his back on a Friday and is not scheduled to work the weekend. His doctor recommends he not return until Monday. How many days away from work must the contractor record on the Cal/OSHA Form 300?
question_cn: 一名工人在星期五背部受伤，并且周末没有安排上班。医生建议他直到周一才返回工作岗位。承包商在 Cal/OSHA 表格 300 上必须记录多少天的缺勤？

options.en: Three days, including the day of the injury itself
options.cn: 三天，包括受伤当天

options.en: Two days, counting Saturday and Sunday as restricted
options.cn: 两天，将星期六和星期日计为限制性工作日

options.en: Zero days, since the employee was not scheduled to work
options.cn: 零天，因为员工没有安排上班

options.en: One day, counting only the first unscheduled day
options.cn: 一天，只计算第一个未安排的工作日

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §14300.7(b)(3)(E), if a physician indicates the worker should not have worked over the weekend, those two calendar days must be recorded as days away from work.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §14300.7(b)(3)(E)，如果医生表示工人周末不应工作，这两个日历日必须记录为缺勤天数。

question_en: A contractor employs workers at a retail clothing store job site. The store's NAICS code is 4481. Which recording obligation applies to this employer?
question_cn: 一名承包商在一个零售服装店的工作现场雇佣工人。该商店的NAICS代码是4481。哪种记录义务适用于该雇主？

options.en: No recordkeeping or reporting obligations apply at all
options.cn: 完全不适用任何记录或报告义务

options.en: Recordkeeping is only required if OSHA requests it in writing
options.cn: 仅在OSHA书面要求时才需要记录

options.en: Full injury and illness recordkeeping is always required
options.cn: 始终需要完整的伤害和疾病记录

options.en: Routine recordkeeping is exempt, but serious injuries must still be reported
options.cn: 常规记录可以免除，但严重伤害仍必须报告

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §14300.2 Appendix A, NAICS 4481 establishments are exempt from routine records unless directed by OSHA or BLS, but must still report serious injuries or deaths under Title 8 §342.
explanation_cn: 根据8 CCR §14300.2 附录A，NAICS 4481机构通常免于常规记录，除非OSHA或BLS指示，但仍必须根据第8章 §342报告严重伤害或死亡。
code_reference: 8 CCR §14300.2, Appendix A

question_en: An employee on a business trip checks into a hotel and later slips in the hotel bathroom while getting ready for bed. Is this injury work-related and recordable?
question_cn: 出差的员工办理酒店入住手续后，在准备上床睡觉时在酒店浴室滑倒受伤。这种伤害是否与工作相关且需要记录？

options.en: Yes, because all travel-status injuries are automatically work-related
options.cn: 是的，因为所有出差期间的伤害都自动视为与工作相关

options.en: No, because the employee had left the work environment at check-in
options.cn: 不是，因为员工在办理入住时已离开工作环境

options.en: Yes, because the employer arranged and paid for the hotel stay
options.cn: 是的，因为雇主安排并支付了酒店住宿

options.en: No, because hotel injuries are always excluded from recordkeeping
options.cn: 不是，因为酒店伤害总是被排除在记录之外

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §14300.5(b)(6) Exception 1, once an employee checks into a hotel they establish a 'home away from home' and are considered to have left the work environment; personal activities there are not work-related.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §14300.5(b)(6) 第1条例外，一旦员工办理酒店入住手续，他们就建立了“异地之家”，并被视为已离开工作环境；在那里进行的个人活动不被视为与工作相关。

question_en: A work-related injury results in an employee being away from work for more than 180 calendar days. What is the maximum number of days a contractor is required to enter on the Cal/OSHA Form 300?
question_cn: 因工伤导致员工离开工作岗位超过 180 个日历日。承包商在填写 Cal/OSHA 表格 300 时，最多需要记录多少天？

options.en: 365 days if the employee is still absent at year-end
options.cn: 如果员工年末仍未上班，则为 365 天

options.en: 180 calendar days maximum, which the regulation considers adequate
options.cn: 最高 180 个日历日，法规认为这是足够的

options.en: The actual total days, however long the absence lasts
options.cn: 实际总天数，无论缺勤持续多久

options.en: Exactly 90 calendar days as a regulatory cap
options.cn: 正好 90 个日历日作为法规上限

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §14300.7(b)(3)(G), employers may cap the total days away at 180 calendar days and are not required to track beyond that point.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §14300.7(b)(3)(G)，雇主可以将总离岗天数上限设为 180 个日历日，无需超过这一点进行跟踪。

question_en: An employee working from home drops a box of company files and fractures his foot. How should the contractor treat this injury for recordkeeping purposes?
question_cn: 一名在家工作的员工掉落了一箱公司的文件并导致脚部骨折。承包商在记录保存方面应如何处理此伤害？

options.en: Not recordable, because the home is not an employer's establishment
options.cn: 不可记录，因为家中不是雇主的场所

options.en: Recordable only if the employer directed the employee to work at home
options.cn: 只有在雇主指示员工在家工作时才可记录

options.en: Recordable, because it occurred while performing work for the employer
options.cn: 可记录，因为发生在为雇主工作的过程中

options.en: Not recordable, since home injuries are always excluded
options.cn: 不可记录，因为家庭伤害总是被排除在外

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §14300.5(b)(7), an injury while working at home is work-related if it occurs during work for compensation and is directly related to work performance, such as dropping work documents.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §14300.5(b)(7)，在家工作时发生的伤害，如果是在有偿工作期间发生并且与工作执行直接相关（例如掉落工作文件），则属于与工作相关的伤害。

question_en: A contractor receives conflicting physician recommendations about whether an employee's shoulder condition is a new injury or a recurrence of an old one. What must the employer do?
question_cn: 承包商收到关于员工肩部状况是新伤还是旧伤复发的相互矛盾的医生建议。雇主必须做什么？

options.en: Choose the most authoritative recommendation and record accordingly
options.cn: 选择最具权威性的建议并作相应记录

options.en: Automatically record it as a new case to avoid liability
options.cn: 自动记录为新病例以避免责任

options.en: Ignore both recommendations and make an independent determination
options.cn: 忽略两份建议并自行做出决定

options.en: Wait for both physicians to agree before recording anything
options.cn: 等待两位医生达成一致后再记录任何内容

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §14300.6(b)(3), when conflicting physician opinions are received, the employer must determine which recommendation is best documented or most authoritative and record based on that decision.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §14300.6(b)(3)，当收到相互矛盾的医生意见时，雇主必须确定哪份建议有最充分的文件支持或最具权威性，并根据该决定进行记录。

question_en: An employee experiences a recurrence of occupational asthma symptoms triggered by a workplace chemical exposure. How must the contractor treat this episode for recordkeeping?
question_cn: 一名员工因工作场所的化学品暴露而再次出现职业性哮喘症状。承包商在记录保存方面必须如何处理此事件？

options.en: Recordable only once per employee over their entire career
options.cn: 在整个职业生涯中，每位员工仅记录一次

options.en: Recordable as a new case because a workplace exposure triggered it
options.cn: 记录为新病例，因为是工作场所暴露引发的

options.en: Not recordable, since it is a recurrence of an existing condition
options.cn: 不记录，因为这是现有疾病的复发

options.en: Not recordable unless the employee misses at least one workday
options.cn: 除非员工至少缺勤一天，否则不记录

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §14300.6(b)(2), when signs or symptoms of an illness recur due to a workplace event or exposure, such as an asthma episode from a workplace chemical, the employer must treat and record it as a new case.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR 第14300.6(b)(2)条，当疾病的体征或症状由于工作场所事件或暴露而复发（例如工作场所化学品引发的哮喘发作）时，雇主必须将其视为新病例进行处理和记录。

question_en: A worker suffers a work-related injury that requires medical treatment beyond first aid but does not miss any days of work. Must the contractor record this injury on the Cal/OSHA Form 300?
question_cn: 一名工人因工作受伤，需要医疗处理（超过急救范围），但没有缺勤。这种伤害是否必须在 Cal/OSHA 表格 300 上记录？

options.en: No, only injuries with days away from work are recorded
options.cn: 不，只有导致缺勤的伤害才需要记录

options.en: No, if the employee returns to the same job without restriction
options.cn: 不，如果员工在不受限制的情况下返回同一工作岗位

options.en: Yes, medical treatment beyond first aid requires recording
options.cn: 是的，超过急救范围的医疗处理需要记录

options.en: Yes, but only if a physician submits a written report
options.cn: 是的，但只有在医生提交书面报告时

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §14300.7(b)(1)(D), any work-related injury requiring medical treatment beyond first aid must be recorded on the Cal/OSHA Form 300, regardless of days away from work.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §14300.7(b)(1)(D)，任何需要超过急救范围的医疗处理的工作相关伤害都必须在 Cal/OSHA 表格 300 上记录，无论是否缺勤。

question_en: A contractor's employee is commuting to work and has a car accident in the company's parking lot. Is this injury considered work-related under Cal/OSHA recordkeeping rules?
question_cn: 一名承包商的员工在通勤上班途中，在公司停车场发生了车祸。根据加州职业安全与健康管理局（Cal/OSHA）的记录规则，这种伤害是否被认为与工作相关？

options.en: Yes, because it occurred on company property
options.cn: 是的，因为它发生在公司财产内

options.en: Yes, because the employer controls the parking lot
options.cn: 是的，因为雇主控制停车场

options.en: No, commuting accidents on company lots are explicitly excluded
options.cn: 不是，公司停车场的通勤事故被明确排除在外

options.en: No, only if the employee was using a personal vehicle
options.cn: 不是，除非员工使用的是个人车辆

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §14300.5(b)(2)(G), a motor vehicle accident that occurs on a company parking lot or access road while the employee is commuting to or from work is explicitly excluded from work-relatedness.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §14300.5(b)(2)(G) 的规定，员工在通勤上下班途中，在公司停车场或通道上发生的机动车事故被明确排除为工作相关。

question_en: During a work-related injury investigation, a contractor learns the employee aggravated a pre-existing knee condition. The aggravation required medical treatment the employee had not previously needed. What is the correct recordkeeping treatment?
question_cn: 在一起与工作相关的伤害调查中，承包商了解到员工加重了先前存在的膝关节疾病。加重情况需要之前员工未曾需要的医疗治疗。正确的记录处理方式是什么？

options.en: Recordable only if a physician certifies the aggravation in writing
options.cn: 只有在医生书面证明加重时才需记录

options.en: Not recordable unless the employee missed at least three days
options.cn: 除非员工至少缺勤三天，否则不需记录

options.en: Not recordable, since the underlying condition predates employment
options.cn: 不需记录，因为基础病症早于雇佣日期

options.en: Recordable, because the workplace event caused new medical treatment
options.cn: 需记录，因为工作场所事件导致新的医疗治疗

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §14300.5(b)(4)(D), significant aggravation of a pre-existing condition is work-related and recordable when the workplace event necessitates medical treatment where none was needed before.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §14300.5(b)(4)(D)，当工作场所事件导致之前不需要的医疗治疗时，显著加重的先前存在病症与工作相关且需记录。

question_en: An injured worker is ordered by her doctor to stay home, but she comes to work anyway. How must the contractor record the days on the Cal/OSHA Form 300?
question_cn: 一名受伤的工人被医生要求留在家中，但她仍然来上班。承包商在 Cal/OSHA 表格 300 上必须如何记录这些天数？

options.en: Record days only after a second physician confirms the first
options.cn: 只有在第二位医生确认第一位医生的建议后才记录天数

options.en: Record zero days since the employee chose to work
options.cn: 由于员工选择工作，因此记录零天

options.en: Record only the days the employee actually missed from work
options.cn: 仅记录员工实际缺勤的天数

options.en: Record the number of days recommended by the physician
options.cn: 记录医生建议的天数

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §14300.7(b)(3)(B), the contractor must record the number of calendar days away recommended by the physician, whether or not the employee actually follows that recommendation.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §14300.7(b)(3)(B)，承包商必须记录医生建议的日历缺勤天数，无论员工是否实际遵循该建议。

question_en: A contractor's employee contracts hepatitis A while working on a job site where sanitation is poor. Under Cal/OSHA recordkeeping rules, how is this illness classified?
question_cn: 承包商的一名员工在工作现场卫生条件差的情况下感染了甲型肝炎。根据加州职业安全与健康管理局（Cal/OSHA）的记录规则，这种疾病如何分类？

options.en: Work-related and recordable if contracted at the work site
options.cn: 如果在工作现场感染，则属于与工作相关且可记录

options.en: Work-related only if the employer is proven directly negligent
options.cn: 只有在证明雇主直接疏忽的情况下，才属于与工作相关

options.en: Not work-related, as only the flu and colds are excluded
options.cn: 不属于与工作相关，因为只有流感和感冒被排除在外

options.en: Not work-related, because it is an infectious disease
options.cn: 不属于与工作相关，因为它是一种传染病

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §14300.5(b)(2)(H), contagious diseases such as tuberculosis, brucellosis, hepatitis A, and plague are considered work-related if the employee is infected at work.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §14300.5(b)(2)(H)，如果员工在工作中感染结核病、布鲁氏菌病、甲型肝炎和鼠疫等传染病，这些疾病被视为与工作相关。

question_en: An employee with a documented mental illness claims it was caused by workplace stress. Under Cal/OSHA, what must occur before the employer is required to treat it as work-related?
question_cn: 一名有官方记录的精神疾病的员工声称这是由工作压力引起的。根据加州职业安全与健康管理局（Cal/OSHA）的规定，在雇主被要求将其视为与工作相关之前，必须发生什么？

options.en: A workers' compensation claim must first be filed and accepted
options.cn: 必须首先提交并被接受工伤赔偿申请

options.en: Two or more licensed professionals must agree on the diagnosis
options.cn: 两名或以上具有执照的专业人士必须同意诊断结果

options.en: The employee must voluntarily provide a qualified professional's work-related opinion
options.cn: 员工必须自愿提供合格专业人士关于工作相关性的意见

options.en: The employer must conduct an independent workplace stress investigation
options.cn: 雇主必须进行独立的工作场所压力调查

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §14300.5(b)(2)(I), mental illness is only considered work-related if the employee voluntarily provides an opinion from a licensed health care professional with appropriate training stating the illness is work-related.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §14300.5(b)(2)(I)，精神疾病只有在员工自愿提供具有适当培训的持牌医疗专业人士认为该疾病与工作相关的意见时，才被视为与工作相关。

question_en: A contractor's employee retires while still on a medical leave caused by a work injury. What is the employer's obligation regarding the day count on the Cal/OSHA Form 300?
question_cn: 当承包商的员工在因工伤而请病假期间退休时，雇主在 Cal/OSHA 表格 300 上有关天数的义务是什么？

options.en: Stop counting on retirement date and record days up to that point
options.cn: 在退休日期停止计算，并记录截至该日期的天数

options.en: Continue counting days until the employee would have returned to work
options.cn: 继续计算天数，直到员工本应返回工作为止

options.en: Estimate total days and record assuming full recovery would not occur
options.cn: 估算总天数并记录，假设无法完全康复

options.en: Automatically apply the 180-day cap upon learning of the employee's retirement
options.cn: 在得知员工退休时自动应用180天上限

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §14300.7(b)(3)(H), if an employee leaves the company for a reason unrelated to the injury, such as retirement, the employer may stop counting days and record the total to that point.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §14300.7(b)(3)(H)，如果员工因与伤害无关的原因离开公司，例如退休，雇主可以停止计算天数，并记录截至该日期的总天数。

question_en: An employee is injured on December 28th but remains out of work into the following calendar year. When preparing the annual summary, the exact return date is still unknown. What must the contractor do?
question_cn: 一名员工在12月28日受伤，但在接下来的日历年仍未回到工作岗位。在准备年度汇总时，确切的返回日期尚不清楚。承包商必须做什么？

options.en: Record the case in both calendar years on Form 300
options.cn: 在两年日历年中都在300表上记录此案例

options.en: Wait until the employee returns before making any entry
options.cn: 等到员工返回后再进行任何记录

options.en: Estimate days away and update the log when the count is confirmed
options.cn: 估算缺勤天数，并在确认天数后更新日志

options.en: Record zero days until the employee formally returns to work
options.cn: 在员工正式返回工作之前记录零天

explanation_en: Correct. Per 8 CCR §14300.7(b)(3)(I), the employer records the case in the year the injury occurred, uses an estimated day count for the annual summary, and updates the entry when the actual count is known or reaches the 180-day cap.
explanation_cn: 正确。根据8 CCR §14300.7(b)(3)(I)，雇主在受伤发生的那一年记录该案例，在年度汇总中使用估算的天数，并在实际天数已知或达到180天上限时更新记录。

question_en: A worker returns from a doctor visit with a note saying only to do 'light duty.' The physician does not specify which job functions are restricted. What is the contractor's correct course of action?
question_cn: 一名工人从医生处回来，带着一张便条，上面写着只能进行“轻度工作”。医生没有具体说明哪些工作职能受到限制。承包商的正确做法是什么？

options.en: Assume no restriction applies since it is too vague to act on
options.cn: 假设没有限制，因为太模糊无法采取行动

options.en: Allow the employee to self-determine which tasks to avoid
options.cn: 允许员工自行决定避免哪些任务

options.en: Ask the physician whether all routine functions can be performed
options.cn: 询问医生是否可以执行所有常规职能

options.en: Record it immediately as a days-away-from-work case on Form 300
options.cn: 立即在表格300上登记为缺勤案例

explanation_en: Correct. Per 8 CCR §14300.7(b)(4)(G), when a restriction is vague, the employer must ask the physician whether the employee can perform all routine job functions and work a full shift. If clarification cannot be obtained, the case must be recorded as restricted work.
explanation_cn: 正确。根据 8 CCR §14300.7(b)(4)(G)，当限制模糊时，雇主必须询问医生员工是否可以执行所有常规工作职能并完成全部班次。如果无法获得明确说明，该案例必须记录为受限工作。

question_en: A physician recommends that an injured employee avoid overhead lifting, but the employee performs all overhead tasks anyway without complaint. How must the contractor record this case on the Cal/OSHA Form 300?
question_cn: 医生建议受伤员工避免进行头顶作业，但该员工仍然执行所有头顶作业且没有抱怨。承包商必须如何在 Cal/OSHA 表格 300 上记录此情况？

options.en: Record it as a medical-treatment-only case on the Form 300
options.cn: 在表格 300 上将其记录为仅限医疗处理的病例

options.en: No recording is required since the employee worked without restriction
options.cn: 由于员工在工作中没有受到限制，因此无需记录

options.en: Record it as a restricted work case regardless of what the employee did
options.cn: 无论员工做了什么，都记录为受限制工作病例

options.en: Record it only if the employee later files a workers' compensation claim
options.cn: 仅在员工后来提出工伤赔偿申请时才记录

explanation_en: Correct. Per 8 CCR §14300.7(b)(4)(H), if a physician recommends a restriction that affects routine job functions, the employer must record it as a restricted work case even if the employee performs those functions anyway.
explanation_cn: 正确。根据 8 CCR §14300.7(b)(4)(H)，如果医生建议的限制影响了常规工作职能，即使员工仍然执行这些职能，雇主也必须将其记录为受限制工作病例。

question_en: Which of the following treatments, when provided by a physician, is still considered 'first aid' for Cal/OSHA recordkeeping purposes and does NOT trigger a recordable entry?
question_cn: 以下哪种由医生提供的治疗仍被视为加州职业安全与健康管理局（Cal/OSHA）记录目的下的“急救”，并且不会触发可记录条目？

options.en: Administering a Hepatitis B vaccination post-exposure
options.cn: 暴露后接种乙型肝炎疫苗

options.en: Using an eye patch to cover an injured eye
options.cn: 使用眼罩遮盖受伤的眼睛

options.en: Applying a rigid immobilization brace to the wrist
options.cn: 对手腕施加刚性固定支架

options.en: Suturing a laceration to close a wound
options.cn: 缝合裂伤以闭合伤口

explanation_en: Correct. Per 8 CCR §14300.7(b)(5)(B), using an eye patch is explicitly listed as first aid regardless of the professional status of the provider, so it does not create a recordable entry.
explanation_cn: 正确。根据 8 CCR §14300.7(b)(5)(B)，使用眼罩明确列为急救，无论提供者的专业身份如何，因此不会创建可记录条目。

question_en: A worker is diagnosed with a fractured rib by a physician after a workplace incident. The doctor does not recommend medical treatment or work restrictions. Must the contractor record this case on the Cal/OSHA Form 300?
question_cn: 一名工人在工作场所事故后被医生诊断为肋骨骨折。医生不建议进行医疗治疗或限制工作。承包商是否必须在 Cal/OSHA 表格 300 上记录此病例？

options.en: Only after a second physician confirms the fracture diagnosis
options.cn: 仅在第二位医生确认骨折诊断后

options.en: Only if the employee misses at least one day of work
options.cn: 仅在员工至少缺勤一天工作时

options.en: No, because no medical treatment or restriction was recommended
options.cn: 不，因为没有建议进行医疗治疗或工作限制

options.en: Yes, because a fractured bone is always a recordable significant injury
options.cn: 是的，因为骨折总是可记录的重大伤害

explanation_en: Correct. Per 8 CCR §14300.7(b)(7), fractured or cracked bones must always be recorded on the Cal/OSHA Form 300 at the time of diagnosis, even if no medical treatment or work restriction is recommended.
explanation_cn: 正确。根据 8 CCR §14300.7(b)(7)，骨折或裂骨在诊断时必须始终在 Cal/OSHA 表格 300 上记录，即使未建议进行医疗治疗或工作限制。

question_en: Under what circumstance is a work-related loss of consciousness NOT required to be recorded on the Cal/OSHA Form 300?
question_cn: 在什么情况下，与工作相关的意识丧失不需要记录在Cal/OSHA表格300上？

options.en: When a physician attributes it to a pre-existing personal condition
options.cn: 当医生将其归因于既有的个人疾病

options.en: When the employee does not seek medical attention afterward
options.cn: 当员工事后没有寻求医疗救助

options.en: When the employee regains consciousness within a few minutes
options.cn: 当员工在几分钟内恢复意识

options.en: There is no such circumstance; all work-related cases are recordable
options.cn: 没有这样的情况；所有与工作相关的案例都必须记录

explanation_en: Correct. Per 8 CCR §14300.7(b)(6), every work-related injury or illness involving any loss of consciousness must be recorded on the Cal/OSHA Form 300, regardless of how brief the episode was.
explanation_cn: 正确。根据8 CCR §14300.7(b)(6)，每起涉及任何意识丧失的与工作相关的伤害或疾病都必须记录在Cal/OSHA表格300上，无论事件持续多短时间。

question_en: A contractor receives a completed incident report confirming a recordable injury on a Monday. By what day must the contractor enter the case on both the Cal/OSHA Form 300 and Form 301?
question_cn: 一家承包商在星期一收到一份完整的事件报告，确认发生了可记录的伤害。承包商必须在什么时候将该案例录入 Cal/OSHA 表格 300 和表格 301？

options.en: Within 24 hours of receiving the incident report
options.cn: 在收到事件报告后的 24 小时内

options.en: Within 30 calendar days of the incident occurring
options.cn: 在事件发生后的 30 个日历日内

options.en: Within 7 calendar days of receiving the recordable case information
options.cn: 在收到可记录案例信息后的 7 个日历日内

options.en: By the end of the calendar quarter in which it occurred
options.cn: 在事件发生的日历季度结束前

explanation_en: Correct. Per 8 CCR §14300.29(b)(3), the employer must enter each recordable injury or illness on the Cal/OSHA Form 300 and Form 301 Incident Report within seven (7) calendar days of receiving information that a recordable case has occurred.
explanation_cn: 正确。根据 8 CCR §14300.29(b)(3)，雇主必须在收到可记录案例信息后的七（7）个日历日内将每一起可记录的伤害或疾病录入 Cal/OSHA 表格 300 和表格 301 事件报告。

question_en: A contractor hires workers through a temporary staffing agency and provides them with all day-to-day supervision on the job site. An injury occurs. Who must record it on their Cal/OSHA Form 300?
question_cn: 承包商通过临时人力资源公司雇用工人，并在工地上提供他们的日常监督。一名工人受伤。谁必须在其 Cal/OSHA 表格 300 上记录？

options.en: Neither party, since temporary workers are not covered employees
options.cn: 双方都不需要，因为临时工不属于受保护的员工

options.en: Only the temporary staffing agency, as the employer of record
options.cn: 只有临时人力资源公司，作为名义上的雇主

options.en: The contractor, because it provides day-to-day supervision
options.cn: 承包商，因为它提供日常监督

options.en: Both the contractor and the staffing agency must record it
options.cn: 承包商和人力资源公司都必须记录

explanation_en: Correct. Per 8 CCR §14300.31(b)(2) and (b)(4), the employer who provides day-to-day supervision is responsible for recording the injury; each case is recorded only once to prevent duplication.
explanation_cn: 正确。根据《加州职业安全与健康条例》（8 CCR §14300.31(b)(2) 和 (b)(4)），提供日常监督的雇主负责记录伤害；每个案例只记录一次，以防重复。

question_en: A contractor's sole proprietor is injured while working alongside employees on a job site. Must this injury be recorded on the Cal/OSHA Form 300?
question_cn: 承包商的个体经营者在与员工一起在工地工作时受伤。该受伤是否必须在 Cal/OSHA 表格 300 上记录？

options.en: No, but only if the injury occurs off the primary job site
options.cn: 不需要，但仅当伤害发生在主要工作现场之外时

options.en: Yes, but only if the injury results in days away from work
options.cn: 是的，但仅在伤害导致缺勤天数时

options.en: No, sole proprietor owners are not considered employees under this rule
options.cn: 不需要，根据此规则，个体经营者业主不被视为员工

options.en: Yes, the owner is always treated as an employee for recordkeeping
options.cn: 是的，业主在记录保存中始终被视为员工

explanation_en: Correct. Per 8 CCR §14300.31(a), if the establishment is organized as a sole proprietorship, the owner is not considered an employee for recordkeeping purposes and therefore the injury need not be recorded on Form 300.
explanation_cn: 正确。根据 8 CCR §14300.31(a)，如果企业组织形式为个体经营，业主在记录保存中不被视为员工，因此该伤害无需在表格 300 上记录。

question_en: An employee suffers a work-related injury involving a sensitive reproductive-system condition. How must the contractor handle this employee's name on the Cal/OSHA Form 300?
question_cn: 一名员工因涉及敏感生殖系统状况的工伤受伤。承包商在 Cal/OSHA 表格 300 上应如何处理该员工的姓名？

options.en: Omit the case entirely from Form 300 to protect the employee
options.cn: 为保护员工，将此案件完全从表格 300 中省略

options.en: Enter the full name, as all employees must be identified on the log
options.cn: 输入全名，因为所有员工都必须在日志中被识别

options.en: Leave the name field entirely blank and make no separate notation
options.cn: 完全留空姓名栏，不做单独记录

options.en: Write 'privacy case' and keep a separate confidential name list
options.cn: 写上“隐私案件”，并保留单独的机密姓名列表

explanation_en: Correct. Per 8 CCR §14300.29(b)(6) and (b)(7)(A), injuries to intimate body parts are privacy concern cases. The employer must write 'privacy case' on Form 300 and maintain a confidential list of case numbers and employee names for government access.
explanation_cn: 正确。根据 8 CCR §14300.29(b)(6) 和 (b)(7)(A)，涉及隐私部位的伤害属于隐私关注案件。雇主必须在表格 300 上写“隐私案件”，并保留案件编号和员工姓名的机密列表以供政府查阅。

question_en: A worker has an audiogram showing a Standard Threshold Shift. The employer schedules a retest within 30 days, and the retest does NOT confirm the STS. What is the employer's recording obligation?
question_cn: 一名工人的听力图显示标准阈值变化（STS）。雇主安排在30天内进行复测，但复测未确认STS。雇主的记录义务是什么？

options.en: Record it as a hearing loss case within 7 days of the retest
options.cn: 在复测后7天内将其记录为听力损失案例

options.en: Record the STS immediately after the first test results are received
options.cn: 在收到第一次测试结果后立即记录STS

options.en: No recording is required since the retest did not confirm the STS
options.cn: 不需要记录，因为复测未确认STS

options.en: Record it only if a third audiogram is ordered by a physician
options.cn: 只有在医生要求进行第三次听力测验时才记录

explanation_en: Correct. Per 8 CCR §14300.10(b)(4), if the employer retests within 30 days and the retest does not confirm the recordable STS, the employer is not required to record the hearing loss case on the Cal/OSHA Form 300.
explanation_cn: 正确。根据8 CCR §14300.10(b)(4)，如果雇主在30天内进行复测且复测未确认可记录的STS，雇主不需要在Cal/OSHA表格300上记录听力损失案例。

question_en: A contractor uses a company-developed injury tracking spreadsheet instead of the official Cal/OSHA Form 300. Under what condition is this acceptable?
question_cn: 承包商使用公司自行开发的伤害追踪电子表格，而不是官方的 Cal/OSHA 300 表格。在什么情况下这是可以接受的？

options.en: Never; only the official printed Cal/OSHA forms are acceptable
options.cn: 永远不行；只有官方印刷的 Cal/OSHA 表格才被接受

options.en: Only if the contractor employs fewer than 10 workers on-site
options.cn: 仅当承包商现场雇佣少于 10 名工人时

options.en: Only after written approval is granted by Cal/OSHA
options.cn: 仅在获得 Cal/OSHA 书面批准后

options.en: If it contains the same information and is equally understandable
options.cn: 如果它包含相同的信息并且同样易于理解

explanation_en: Correct. Per 8 CCR §14300.29(b)(4) and (b)(5), an equivalent form—whether paper or computer-generated—is acceptable if it contains the same information, is as readable, and is completed using the same instructions as the official Cal/OSHA form.
explanation_cn: 正确。根据 8 CCR §14300.29(b)(4) 和 (b)(5)，如果等效表格——无论是纸质还是计算机生成——包含相同的信息、同样容易阅读，并且按照与官方 Cal/OSHA 表格相同的指示填写，则是可以接受的。

question_en: Which of the following work-related conditions must be recorded on the Cal/OSHA Form 300 at the time of diagnosis, even when no treatment or work restriction is recommended by a physician?
question_cn: 以下哪些与工作相关的情况必须在诊断时记录在 Cal/OSHA Form 300 表格上，即使医生没有建议任何治疗或工作限制？

options.en: A work-aggravated common cold requiring a sick day
options.cn: 因工作加重的普通感冒，需要请病假

options.en: A definitively diagnosed case of occupational silicosis
options.cn: 已明确诊断的职业性硅肺病例

options.en: A deep laceration closed with butterfly bandages by the nurse
options.cn: 护士用蝴蝶贴处理的深层割伤

options.en: A severe sprain requiring ice and over-the-counter pain relievers
options.cn: 需要冰敷和非处方止痛药的严重扭伤

explanation_en: Correct. Per 8 CCR §14300.7(b)(7), chronic irreversible diseases—including silicosis—must be recorded at the time of initial diagnosis even if no treatment or work restriction is recommended at that time.
explanation_cn: 正确。根据 8 CCR §14300.7(b)(7)，慢性不可逆疾病——包括硅肺——必须在初次诊断时记录，即使当时未建议任何治疗或工作限制。

question_en: An employer wants to voluntarily share Cal/OSHA Form 300 records with an outside safety consultant hired to evaluate the company's safety program. What privacy requirement applies?
question_cn: 雇主希望自愿将 Cal/OSHA 表格 300 记录与受雇于评估公司安全计划的外部安全顾问分享。适用什么隐私要求？

options.en: Written consent from each affected employee is required first
options.cn: 首先需要每位受影响员工的书面同意

options.en: All employee names must be removed before sharing the records
options.cn: 在分享记录之前必须删除所有员工姓名

options.en: Records may include employee names since this is a permitted exception
options.cn: 记录可以包含员工姓名，因为这是允许的例外情况

options.en: The consultant must be a government-authorized representative to access names
options.cn: 顾问必须是政府授权代表才能访问姓名

explanation_en: Correct. Per 8 CCR §14300.29(b)(10)(A), an employer may disclose Form 300 records with personally identifying information to an auditor or consultant hired by the employer to evaluate the safety and health program.
explanation_cn: 正确。根据 8 CCR §14300.29(b)(10)(A)，雇主可以向受雇于评估安全与健康计划的审计员或顾问披露包含个人识别信息的表格 300 记录。

question_en: An injured employee does not follow a physician's recommendation for medical treatment. What effect does this have on the contractor's Cal/OSHA recordkeeping obligation?
question_cn: 受伤的员工未遵循医生关于医疗治疗的建议。这对承包商的加利福尼亚职业安全与健康管理局（Cal/OSHA）记录义务有什么影响？

options.en: The contractor may omit the case since treatment was refused
options.cn: 承包商可以省略该案例，因为治疗被拒绝

options.en: The case is downgraded to a first-aid-only entry on the log
options.cn: 该案例被降级为日志中的仅限急救条目

options.en: Recording is delayed until the employee accepts treatment
options.cn: 记录将延迟，直到员工接受治疗

options.en: The contractor must still record the case on the Form 300
options.cn: 承包商仍必须在表格300上记录该案例

explanation_en: Correct. Per 8 CCR §14300.7(b)(5)(E), the employer must record the case even if the injured or ill employee does not follow the physician's recommendation for medical treatment.
explanation_cn: 正确。根据8 CCR §14300.7(b)(5)(E)，即使受伤或患病员工不遵循医生的医疗建议，雇主仍必须记录该案例。

question_en: A contractor's annual summary of work-related injuries on the Cal/OSHA Form 300A must be posted no later than which date?
question_cn: 承包商必须在 Cal/OSHA 表格 300A 上公布的年度工作相关伤害总结最晚应在何日期公布？

options.en: December 31 of the year covered
options.cn: 所涵盖年度的 12 月 31 日

options.en: February 1 of the following year
options.cn: 次年的 2 月 1 日

options.en: March 1 of the following year
options.cn: 次年的 3 月 1 日

options.en: January 1 of the following year
options.cn: 次年的 1 月 1 日

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §14300.32(b)(6), the annual summary must be posted no later than February 1 of the year following the year covered by the records and kept posted until April 30.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §14300.32(b)(6)，年度总结必须在记录所涵盖年度的次年最迟 2 月 1 日公布，并保持张贴至 4 月 30 日。

question_en: A contractor posts the Cal/OSHA Form 300A annual summary on February 1. Through what date must this posting remain in place?
question_cn: 承包商于2月1日张贴Cal/OSHA表格300A年度摘要。该张贴必须保持到什么日期？

options.en: Through June 30 of that year
options.cn: 当年的6月30日

options.en: Through April 30 of that year
options.cn: 当年的4月30日

options.en: Through March 31 of that year
options.cn: 当年的3月31日

options.en: Through May 31 of that year
options.cn: 当年的5月31日

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §14300.32(b)(6), the annual summary must remain posted from February 1 through April 30 of the year following the year covered by the records.
explanation_cn: 根据8 CCR §14300.32(b)(6)，年度摘要必须从2月1日张贴至记录所覆盖年份的次年的4月30日。

question_en: A field employee works at remote job sites and never visits the main office during the February–April posting period. What must the contractor do to comply with annual summary requirements for this worker?
question_cn: 现场员工在偏远工作地点工作，在二月至四月的张贴期间从未访问过主办公室。承包商必须做什么以符合该员工的年度总结要求？

options.en: Present or mail the annual summary to the employee
options.cn: 向员工当面呈现或邮寄年度总结

options.en: Waive the requirement since the employee is field-based
options.cn: 由于员工在现场工作而免除该要求

options.en: Post the summary only at the main office location
options.cn: 仅在主办公室张贴总结

options.en: Have the employee sign a waiver acknowledging remote status
options.cn: 让员工签署一份承认远程状态的放弃书

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §14300.32(b)(7), if an employee does not normally report at least weekly to a posted location, the employer must present or mail the annual summary to that employee during the February–April posting period.
explanation_cn: 根据《加利福尼亚法规典》第8卷 §14300.32(b)(7)，如果员工通常不每周至少到张贴地点报到一次，雇主必须在二月至四月的张贴期间向该员工当面呈现或邮寄年度总结。

question_en: For how many years must a contractor retain the Cal/OSHA Form 300 Log, Form 300A Annual Summary, and Form 301 Incident Reports?
question_cn: 承包商必须保存 Cal/OSHA 300 表格日志、300A 年度摘要和 301 事件报告多少年？

options.en: Three years following the end of the calendar year
options.cn: 自日历年结束后三年

options.en: Ten years following the end of the calendar year
options.cn: 自日历年结束后十年

options.en: Five years following the end of the calendar year
options.cn: 自日历年结束后五年

options.en: Seven years following the end of the calendar year
options.cn: 自日历年结束后七年

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §14300.33(a), Cal/OSHA Forms 300, 300A, and 301 must be saved for five years following the end of the calendar year that the records cover.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §14300.33(a)，Cal/OSHA 的 300 表格、300A 表格和 301 表格必须自记录所覆盖的日历年结束后保存五年。

question_en: During the five-year storage period, a contractor discovers that a previously recorded injury has been reclassified to a more serious outcome. What is the contractor required to do with the stored Cal/OSHA Form 300?
question_cn: 在五年的存储期间，一名承包商发现先前记录的伤害已被重新分类为更严重的结果。承包商需要对已存储的 Cal/OSHA 表格 300 做什么？

options.en: File a supplemental Form 301 Incident Report only
options.cn: 仅提交补充表格 301 事故报告

options.en: Create a new Form 300 and discard the old one
options.cn: 创建一个新的表格 300 并丢弃旧的

options.en: Update the stored Form 300 with the new information
options.cn: 使用新的信息更新已存储的表格 300

options.en: Update the Form 300A Annual Summary to reflect the change
options.cn: 更新表格 300A 年度总结以反映更改

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §14300.33(b)(1), during the five-year storage period, stored Cal/OSHA 300 forms must be updated to reflect newly discovered recordable cases and any changes in classification, removing the original entry and entering the new information.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §14300.33(b)(1)，在五年的存储期内，已存储的 Cal/OSHA 300 表格必须更新以反映新发现的可记录案例及任何分类变更，删除原始条目并输入新信息。

question_en: A contractor is required to update stored Cal/OSHA Form 300 records during the five-year retention period. Which of the following documents is explicitly NOT required to be updated during this same period?
question_cn: 承包商在五年的保留期内需要更新存储的 Cal/OSHA 表格 300 记录。以下哪种文件在同一期间明确不需要更新？

options.en: The privacy case list associated with the Form 300
options.cn: 与表格 300 相关的隐私案件列表

options.en: The Cal/OSHA Form 300 Log of injuries and illnesses
options.cn: Cal/OSHA 表格 300 伤害和疾病记录日志

options.en: Newly discovered recordable cases on the Form 300
options.cn: 表格 300 上新发现的可记录病例

options.en: The Cal/OSHA Form 300A Annual Summary
options.cn: Cal/OSHA 表格 300A 年度摘要

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §14300.33(b)(2), employers are not required to update the Cal/OSHA 300A Annual Summary during the storage period, though they may choose to do so voluntarily.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §14300.33(b)(2)，雇主在存储期间不需要更新 Cal/OSHA 300A 年度摘要，但他们可以自愿选择更新。

question_en: An employee asks to see the Cal/OSHA Form 300 log for the establishment where they work. By when must the contractor provide a copy?
question_cn: 员工要求查看他们工作场所的 Cal/OSHA 300 表格记录。承包商必须在什么时候提供副本？

options.en: Within 30 calendar days of the request
options.cn: 在请求后的 30 个日历日内

options.en: Within three business days of the request
options.cn: 在请求后的三个工作日内

options.en: By the end of the next business day
options.cn: 在下一个工作日结束前

options.en: Within seven calendar days of the request
options.cn: 在请求后的七个日历日内

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §14300.35(b)(2)(C), when an employee or representative requests copies of the Cal/OSHA Form 300 or annual summary, the employer must provide them by the end of the next business day.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §14300.35(b)(2)(C)，当员工或代表请求 Cal/OSHA 300 表或年度摘要的副本时，雇主必须在下一个工作日结束前提供。

question_en: A union representative requests copies of Cal/OSHA Form 301 Incident Reports for workers covered under a collective bargaining agreement at a job site. The contractor must provide these records within what timeframe?
question_cn: 工会代表要求提供在某工地受集体谈判协议保护的工人的 Cal/OSHA 301 事件报告副本。承包商必须在什么时间范围内提供这些记录？

options.en: Within fourteen calendar days
options.cn: 在十四个日历日内

options.en: By the end of the next business day
options.cn: 在下一个工作日结束前

options.en: Within seven calendar days
options.cn: 在七个日历日内

options.en: Within thirty calendar days
options.cn: 在三十个日历日内

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §14300.35(b)(2)(E)2, when an authorized employee representative (union agent) requests Form 301 records for employees under a collective bargaining agreement, the employer must provide them within seven calendar days, with personal identifying information removed.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §14300.35(b)(2)(E)2，当授权的员工代表（工会代理人）请求受集体谈判协议保护员工的 301 表格记录时，雇主必须在七个日历日内提供这些记录，并去除个人身份信息。

question_en: When providing Cal/OSHA Form 301 Incident Reports to an authorized union representative, which of the following employee details must the contractor remove before handing over the records?
question_cn: 向授权的工会代表提供 Cal/OSHA 表格 301 事故报告时，承包商在交付记录之前必须删除以下哪些员工详细信息？

options.en: The department, job title, and date of hire only
options.cn: 仅部门、职位和入职日期

options.en: The employee's name, address, and date of birth
options.cn: 员工的姓名、地址和出生日期

options.en: Only information about emergency room treatment
options.cn: 仅有关急诊治疗的信息

options.en: The date of injury and the type of incident
options.cn: 受伤日期和事故类型

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §14300.35(b)(2)(E)2, when providing Form 301 records to an authorized employee representative, personally identifying information including name, address, date of birth, date of hire, gender, and medical treatment details must be deleted.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §14300.35(b)(2)(E)2，在向授权的员工代表提供表格 301 记录时，必须删除包括姓名、地址、出生日期、入职日期、性别和医疗治疗详情在内的个人识别信息。

question_en: A contractor provides an employee with a copy of the Cal/OSHA Form 300 log at no charge. The same employee requests a second copy two weeks later. How may the contractor respond?
question_cn: 承包商向员工免费提供一份加州职业安全与健康管理局（Cal/OSHA）Form 300 登记表的复印件。两周后，同一员工请求第二份复印件。承包商可以如何回应？

options.en: Assess a reasonable charge for the additional copy
options.cn: 对额外复印件收取合理费用

options.en: Require a written formal records request before complying
options.cn: 在遵守之前要求书面正式记录请求

options.en: Deny the second request to protect privacy
options.cn: 拒绝第二次请求以保护隐私

options.en: Provide the second copy at no charge as required
options.cn: 按要求免费提供第二份复印件

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §14300.35(b)(2)(F), the first copy of records must be provided free of charge. However, for subsequent requests, the employer may assess a reasonable charge for retrieving and copying the records.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §14300.35(b)(2)(F)，首次提供的记录必须免费提供。然而，对于后续请求，雇主可以对获取和复印记录收取合理费用。

question_en: A contractor terminates an employee who had previously filed a safety complaint with Cal/OSHA. Under California law, what is the contractor's greatest liability exposure in this situation?
question_cn: 一名承包商解雇了一名之前向加利福尼亚州职业安全与健康管理局（Cal/OSHA）提出安全投诉的员工。根据加州法律，在这种情况下，承包商面临的最大责任是什么？

options.en: Failure to maintain required injury and illness records
options.cn: 未能维护所需的伤害和疾病记录

options.en: Violation of mandatory IIPP documentation requirements
options.cn: 违反强制性《伤害防护计划》（IIPP）文件要求

options.en: Discrimination against a protected whistleblower activity
options.cn: 对受保护的举报行为进行歧视

options.en: Violation of the annual summary posting requirements
options.cn: 违反年度总结张贴要求

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §14300.36 and Labor Code §§6310–6311, terminating an employee for filing a safety complaint constitutes prohibited discrimination. Employers are barred from retaliating against employees who exercise safety-related rights.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §14300.36 和《劳动法》 §§6310–6311，因员工提交安全投诉而解雇员工属于禁止的歧视行为。雇主不得对行使安全相关权利的员工进行报复。

question_en: A company executive is required to certify the Cal/OSHA Form 300A Annual Summary. Which of the following individuals would NOT be an acceptable certifier for a corporation?
question_cn: 公司高管需要对 Cal/OSHA 表格 300A 年度汇总进行认证。以下哪一位人士 **不** 能作为公司的认证人？

options.en: The highest ranking official at the establishment
options.cn: 公司内部的最高级别官员

options.en: An owner of the corporation
options.cn: 公司的所有者

options.en: The immediate supervisor of the highest ranking official
options.cn: 最高级别官员的直接主管

options.en: An officer of the corporation
options.cn: 公司的管理人员

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §14300.32(b)(4)(A), an owner is only required—and specifically listed—as a certifier for sole proprietorships or partnerships. For corporations, the certifier must be an officer, the highest ranking official at the establishment, or their immediate supervisor.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §14300.32(b)(4)(A)，所有者仅在独资企业或合伙企业中被要求且明确列为认证人。对于公司来说，认证人必须是公司管理人员、公司内部的最高级别官员或其直接主管。

question_en: A general contractor with fewer than 10 employees asks whether they must keep Cal/OSHA injury and illness records. Under what condition would they still be required to maintain these records?
question_cn: 一家员工少于10人的总承包商询问他们是否必须保留Cal/OSHA伤害和疾病记录。在什么情况下他们仍然需要保留这些记录？

options.en: Only when asked in writing by OSHA, BLS, or a state agency
options.cn: 只有在收到OSHA、劳工统计局或州机构的书面要求时

options.en: Only if their workers' compensation insurance carrier requires it
options.cn: 只有在其工伤赔偿保险承保人要求时

options.en: Only if they employ subcontractors on any of their projects
options.cn: 只有在他们在任何项目中雇用分包商时

options.en: Only if they have had a recordable injury in the past year
options.cn: 只有在过去一年中有可记录的伤害时

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §14300, employers with 10 or fewer employees are partially exempt from keeping Cal/OSHA records unless asked in writing to do so by OSHA, the Bureau of Labor Statistics, or a state agency operating under their authority.
explanation_cn: 根据8 CCR §14300，拥有10名或更少员工的雇主在保留Cal/OSHA记录方面部分豁免，除非收到OSHA、劳工统计局或任何在其职权下运营的州机构的书面要求。

question_en: A construction contractor operates job sites across multiple cities managed from a single main office. For recordkeeping purposes, how is each remote job site classified under Cal/OSHA regulations?
question_cn: 一家建筑承包商在多个城市运营施工现场，由一个主办公室管理。为了记录保存的目的，根据加州职业安全与健康局 (Cal/OSHA) 的规定，每个远程施工现场如何分类？

options.en: Each crew of five or more workers forms a separate establishment
options.cn: 每队五名或更多工人组成一个单独的单位

options.en: Each job site is its own establishment requiring a separate Form 300
options.cn: 每个施工现场是独立的单位，需要单独填写 Form 300

options.en: The main or branch office supervising the work is the establishment
options.cn: 监督工作的主办公室或分支办公室即为该单位

options.en: Each job site is an independent company requiring separate licensing
options.cn: 每个施工现场是独立公司，需要单独许可

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §14300.46, for construction and similar operations where employees do not work at a single physical location, the establishment is represented by the main or branch office, terminal, or station that supervises the activities or serves as the personnel base.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §14300.46，对于员工不在单一物理位置工作的建筑及类似作业，单位由监督活动或作为人员基地的主办公室、分支办公室、终端或站点代表。

question_en: A general contractor has eight employees and has never exceeded that number in the past calendar year. Which of the following Cal/OSHA recordkeeping obligations still applies to this employer?
question_cn: 一家总承包商有八名员工，并且在过去的日历年中从未超过这个人数。以下哪项 Cal/OSHA 记录保存义务仍适用于该雇主？

options.en: Maintaining a full Cal/OSHA injury and illness log
options.cn: 保持完整的 Cal/OSHA 伤害和疾病日志

options.en: Posting injury rate data at each jobsite
options.cn: 在每个工地张贴伤害率数据

options.en: Submitting annual summary reports to Cal/OSHA
options.cn: 向 Cal/OSHA 提交年度总结报告

options.en: Reporting serious injuries, illnesses, or deaths immediately
options.cn: 立即报告严重伤害、疾病或死亡

explanation_en: Under 8 CCR §14300.1(a)(1), even employers exempt from recordkeeping must immediately report any workplace incident resulting in serious injury, illness, or death to Cal/OSHA as required by Title 8 Section 342.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §14300.1(a)(1)，即使是免于记录保存的雇主，也必须按照第 8 章第 342 条的要求，立即向 Cal/OSHA 报告任何导致严重伤害、疾病或死亡的工作场所事件。

question_en: A contracting company normally employs eight workers but hired four additional seasonal laborers for two months last year, briefly exceeding ten total employees. How does this affect the company's Cal/OSHA recordkeeping requirements?
question_cn: 一家承包公司通常雇佣八名工人，但去年雇用了四名额外的季节性工人，为期两个月，因此员工总数短暂超过十人。这如何影响公司的加州职业安全与健康管理局(Cal/OSHA)记录保存要求？

options.en: The company is exempt because seasonal workers are not counted as employees
options.cn: 公司免于记录要求，因为季节性工人不被计入员工人数

options.en: The company only needs records for the two months it exceeded ten employees
options.cn: 公司只需要保存超过十名员工的两个月的记录

options.en: The company qualifies for the exemption because its average was under ten employees
options.cn: 公司符合豁免资格，因为其平均员工人数不到十人

options.en: The company must maintain full Cal/OSHA injury and illness records for the year
options.cn: 公司必须全年保持完整的Cal/OSHA伤害和疾病记录

explanation_en: Under 8 CCR §14300.1(a)(2) and (b)(2), the size exemption is based on peak employment. Because the company exceeded ten employees at any point during the calendar year, it must maintain full Cal/OSHA injury and illness records.
explanation_cn: 根据8 CCR §14300.1(a)(2)和(b)(2)，员工规模豁免是基于最高就业人数。由于公司在日历年的某一时间超过十名员工，必须保持完整的Cal/OSHA伤害和疾病记录。

question_en: The partial exemption from Cal/OSHA injury and illness recordkeeping based on company size is determined by looking at which of the following?
question_cn: 根据公司规模对 Cal/OSHA 伤害和疾病记录部分豁免的判断依据是什么？

options.en: The number of employees at the largest single jobsite
options.cn: 最大单个工地的员工人数

options.en: The peak number of employees company-wide during the prior calendar year
options.cn: 前一个日历年公司范围内的员工高峰人数

options.en: The average number of employees over the past three years
options.cn: 过去三年的员工平均人数
