options.en: The number of full-time equivalent employees at year-end
options.cn: 年末全职等效员工人数

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §14300.1(b)(1) and (b)(2), the exemption is based on the entire company's peak employment during the last calendar year. If 10 or fewer employees were employed at all times, the exemption applies.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §14300.1(b)(1) 和 (b)(2)，豁免是基于整个公司在上一日历年的员工高峰。如果始终雇佣的员工人数为 10 人或更少，则适用豁免。

question_en: A contractor's business is classified under a NAICS code listed in Cal/OSHA's Table 1 partially exempt industries. A serious workplace injury occurs on a jobsite. What must the contractor do?
question_cn: 承包商的业务根据 Cal/OSHA 的表 1 中列出的部分豁免行业分类到 NAICS 代码下。工作现场发生严重的职业伤害。承包商必须做什么？

options.en: Take no action, as the industry exemption covers all reporting obligations
options.cn: 不采取任何行动，因为行业豁免涵盖所有报告义务

options.en: Report the serious injury to Cal/OSHA as required by Title 8 Section 342
options.cn: 按照第 8 条第 342 节的要求将严重伤害报告给 Cal/OSHA

options.en: File a written report with the BLS within 30 days of the incident
options.cn: 在事故发生后 30 天内向 BLS 提交书面报告

options.en: Document the incident internally and skip all required external reporting
options.cn: 在内部记录事故，并跳过所有必需的外部报告

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §14300.2(a)(1), all employers — even those in partially exempt industries — must report any workplace incident resulting in a serious injury, illness, or death to Cal/OSHA as required by Title 8 Section 342.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §14300.2(a)(1)，所有雇主——即使是部分豁免行业——都必须按照第 8 条第 342 节的要求，将任何造成严重伤害、疾病或死亡的工作场所事件报告给 Cal/OSHA。

question_en: A construction company operates two separate business establishments: one performs general contracting and the other handles architectural design services. The architectural branch falls under a partially exempt NAICS industry code. Which recordkeeping rule applies?
question_cn: 一家建筑公司经营两个独立的业务机构：一个从事总承包，另一个提供建筑设计服务。建筑分支属于部分豁免的 NAICS 行业代码。适用哪条备案规则？

options.en: Neither establishment must keep records since one branch is exempt
options.cn: 两个机构都不需要保存记录，因为一个分支是豁免的

options.en: The general contracting branch must keep records; the architectural branch may be exempt
options.cn: 总承包分支必须保存记录；建筑分支可以豁免

options.en: Both establishments must keep records because the company is in construction
options.cn: 两个机构都必须保存记录，因为公司属于建筑业

options.en: The company must choose one exemption status to apply to all establishments
options.cn: 公司必须选择一个豁免状态以适用于所有机构

explanation_en: Under 8 CCR §14300.2(b)(1), the industry classification exemption applies to individual establishments. The non-exempt general contracting establishment must keep records, while the establishment classified under an exempt NAICS code may qualify for the partial exemption.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §14300.2(b)(1)，行业分类豁免适用于单个机构。非豁免的总承包机构必须保存记录，而归类于豁免 NAICS 代码的机构可能有资格获得部分豁免。

question_en: Under Cal/OSHA's Hazard Communication standard, which of the following chemicals present in a workplace is NOT required to have a label under 8 CCR §5194?
question_cn: 根据加州职业安全与健康管理局（Cal/OSHA）的危险化学品沟通标准，下列哪种在工作场所存在的化学品根据8 CCR §5194不需要贴标签？

options.en: A corrosive cleaning agent used by maintenance staff
options.cn: 由维护人员使用的腐蚀性清洁剂

options.en: A flammable adhesive stored in a warehouse work area
options.cn: 存储在仓库工作区的易燃胶水

options.en: A solvent used daily in a surface preparation process
options.cn: 每天在表面准备过程中使用的溶剂

options.en: A pesticide regulated and labeled under federal FIFRA requirements
options.cn: 根据联邦《杀虫剂、杀真菌剂和灭鼠剂法案》（FIFRA）受管制并贴有标签的杀虫剂

explanation_en: Under 8 CCR §5194(b)(4)(A), pesticides subject to the labeling requirements of the Federal Insecticide, Fungicide, and Rodenticide Act (FIFRA) are exempt from the Hazard Communication labeling requirements of §5194.
explanation_cn: 根据8 CCR §5194(b)(4)(A)，受联邦《杀虫剂、杀真菌剂和灭鼠剂法案》（FIFRA）标签要求约束的杀虫剂，可免于遵守§5194的危险化学品沟通标签要求。

question_en: An employer receives sealed containers of a hazardous chemical for storage and never opens them under normal work conditions. Which Hazard Communication obligation still applies to this employer under 8 CCR §5194?
question_cn: 雇主接收密封容器的危险化学品用于储存，并且在正常工作条件下从不打开它们。根据 8 CCR §5194，该雇主仍然需要遵守哪项危险沟通义务？

options.en: Conduct a full chemical hazard classification for all stored chemicals
options.cn: 对所有储存的化学品进行完整的化学危害分类

options.en: No obligations apply since the containers are never opened
options.cn: 不适用任何义务，因为容器从未打开

options.en: Post a written hazard communication program at each storage location
options.cn: 在每个储存地点张贴书面危险沟通计划

options.en: Maintain available SDSs and preserve container labels for employees
options.cn: 保持可用的安全数据表 (SDS) 并保留容器标签以供员工查阅

explanation_en: Under 8 CCR §5194(b)(5)(I), employers handling sealed containers must: preserve incoming labels, maintain copies of SDSs received with shipments, and ensure employees are trained to respond in the event of a spill or leak.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §5194(b)(5)(I)，处理密封容器的雇主必须：保留进货标签、保留随货物收到的 SDS 副本，并确保员工接受培训以应对溢出或泄漏事件。

question_en: Under California's Hazard Communication standard, who bears the responsibility of classifying the hazards of chemicals that are produced or imported?
question_cn: 根据加利福尼亚州的危险沟通标准，谁负责对生产或进口的化学品进行危险分类？

options.en: The employer who purchases and uses the chemicals on site
options.cn: 在现场购买和使用化学品的雇主

options.en: The manufacturers or importers who produce those chemicals
options.cn: 生产这些化学品的制造商或进口商

options.en: The Cal/OSHA Division upon inspection of the workplace
options.cn: 加州职业安全与健康局（Cal/OSHA）在检查工作场所时

options.en: The distributor that delivers chemicals to the worksite
options.cn: 向工作场所配送化学品的分销商

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §5194(b)(1), manufacturers or importers are required to classify the hazards of chemicals they produce or import, and then communicate that information down the supply chain through labels and SDSs.
explanation_cn: 根据8 CCR §5194(b)(1)，制造商或进口商需要对其生产或进口的化学品进行危险分类，然后通过标签和安全数据表（SDS）将信息传递到供应链下游。

question_en: A contractor knowingly exposes employees to a chemical listed under Proposition 65 as a reproductive toxin. The chemical is not otherwise covered by the Hazard Communication standard. What is the employer's minimum obligation under 8 CCR §5194(b)(6)(C)?
question_cn: 承包商明知会让员工接触加利福尼亚州65号提案列为生殖毒物的化学品。该化学品未被《危险沟通标准》涵盖。根据 8 CCR §5194(b)(6)(C)，雇主的最低义务是什么？

options.en: No obligation exists since the chemical is outside the standard's scope
options.cn: 没有义务，因为该化学品不在标准范围内

options.en: Provide employees a Proposition 65 warning before exposure occurs
options.cn: 在接触发生之前向员工提供65号提案警告

options.en: Substitute the chemical with a non-listed alternative within 30 days
options.cn: 在30天内用未列入清单的替代化学品替换该化学品

options.en: File an exemption request with the Department of Industrial Relations
options.cn: 向工业关系部提交豁免请求

explanation_en: Under 8 CCR §5194(b)(6)(C), before knowingly and intentionally exposing any employee to a Proposition 65-listed chemical that falls outside the main scope of §5194, the employer must provide a warning compliant with 22 CCR §12601(c) or comply with the full hazard communication requirements.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §5194(b)(6)(C)，在明知并故意让任何员工接触65号提案列出的、属于 §5194 主范围之外的化学品之前，雇主必须提供符合 22 CCR §12601(c) 的警告，或遵守完整的危险沟通要求。

question_en: Under 8 CCR §5194, wood products that will not be processed are excluded from Hazard Communication labeling requirements EXCEPT in which situation?
question_cn: 根据 8 CCR §5194，未经过加工的木制品通常不需要符合危险化学品沟通标签要求，但在以下哪种情况下除外？

options.en: When the wood is stored alongside non-hazardous materials on the jobsite
options.cn: 当木材与非危险材料一起存放在工地时

options.en: When the wood is delivered by a third-party distributor
options.cn: 当木材由第三方分销商交付时

options.en: When treated with a preservative chemical known to be hazardous
options.cn: 当木材经过已知有害的防腐化学处理时

options.en: When the wood is stored outdoors at a construction staging area
options.cn: 当木材存放在建筑工地的户外区域时

explanation_en: Under 8 CCR §5194(b)(5)(C), wood products are exempt only when the sole hazard is flammability or combustibility. If non-excluded hazardous chemicals such as preservative treatments are present as impurities or used in conjunction with the wood, the exemption does not apply and Hazard Communication requirements must be met.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §5194(b)(5)(C)，仅当唯一的危险是易燃性或可燃性时，木制品才可免除。如果存在未被排除的危险化学品，如作为杂质存在的防腐处理或与木材一起使用的化学品，则此豁免不适用，必须遵守危险化学品沟通要求。

question_en: A contractor employs nine workers and operates in a NAICS-listed partially exempt industry. A worker suffers a serious injury on the jobsite. Which statement correctly describes the contractor's reporting obligations?
question_cn: 一家承包商雇佣九名工人，并在一个 NAICS 列出的部分豁免行业中运营。一名工人在工地上遭受严重伤害。哪项陈述正确描述了承包商的报告义务？

options.en: The employer must immediately report the serious injury to Cal/OSHA
options.cn: 雇主必须立即将严重伤害报告给 Cal/OSHA

options.en: The employer must report only if the BLS requests it in writing
options.cn: 只有在 BLS 书面要求时，雇主才必须报告

options.en: The employer must file an annual summary but not a serious injury report
options.cn: 雇主必须提交年度总结，但不提交严重伤害报告

options.en: Both exemptions eliminate all reporting duties for this employer
options.cn: 这两项豁免都免除了该雇主的所有报告义务

explanation_en: Both 8 CCR §14300.1(a)(1) and §14300.2(a)(1) make clear that all employers — regardless of size or industry exemption status — must immediately report any workplace incident resulting in serious injury, illness, or death to Cal/OSHA under Title 8 Section 342.
explanation_cn: 《加州法典》第 8 篇 CCR §14300.1(a)(1) 和 §14300.2(a)(1) 明确规定，所有雇主——无论规模或行业豁免状态——都必须根据第 8 篇第 342 条的规定，立即向 Cal/OSHA 报告任何导致严重伤害、疾病或死亡的工作场所事件。

question_en: A California contractor's establishment is classified under NAICS code 5413 (Architectural, Engineering, and Related Services). What is true about this establishment's Cal/OSHA injury recordkeeping obligations?
question_cn: 加利福尼亚州的一家承包商机构按 NAICS 代码 5413（建筑、工程及相关服务）分类。关于该机构的 Cal/OSHA 伤害记录保存义务，下列哪项是正确的？

options.en: Full recordkeeping is required regardless of any industry classification
options.cn: 无论行业分类如何，都需要完整记录

options.en: The establishment is partially exempt from routine injury recordkeeping
options.cn: 该机构在日常伤害记录保存方面部分豁免

options.en: The establishment must keep records only for field employees, not office staff
options.cn: 该机构仅需为现场员工保留记录，不包括办公人员

options.en: The establishment is exempt because it employs fewer than 25 workers
options.cn: 该机构因员工少于25人而获得豁免

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §14300.2(a)(1) and Appendix A, establishments classified under NAICS 5413 are listed in Table 1 and are therefore partially exempt from the Cal/OSHA injury and illness recordkeeping requirements unless directed by OSHA, BLS, or Cal/OSHA.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §14300.2(a)(1) 及附录 A，按 NAICS 5413 分类的机构列在表 1 中，因此除非 OSHA、BLS 或 Cal/OSHA 指示，否则部分豁免 Cal/OSHA 伤害与疾病记录保存要求。
code_reference: 8 CCR §14300.2(a)(1) and Appendix A

question_en: Under 8 CCR §5194, an employer subject to Proposition 65 can demonstrate that no warning is required if the employer can show what about the chemical exposure?
question_cn: 根据 8 CCR §5194，受《加州65号提案》约束的雇主可以通过证明关于化学物质暴露的哪些情况来表明不需要警告？

options.en: The chemical was listed under Proposition 65 fewer than 12 months ago
options.cn: 该化学物质在《加州65号提案》下列出不满12个月

options.en: Fewer than ten employees are exposed to the chemical at any one time
options.cn: 同一时间暴露于该化学物质的员工少于十人

options.en: The exposure occurs in a confined space with adequate ventilation installed
options.cn: 暴露发生在安装了足够通风设备的密闭空间内

options.en: The exposure poses no significant risk assuming lifetime exposure levels
options.cn: 假设终生暴露水平，暴露不会造成显著风险

explanation_en: Under 8 CCR §5194(b)(6)(D)(3), an employer may demonstrate no warning is needed by showing the exposure poses no significant risk at lifetime exposure levels for carcinogens, or has no observable effect at 1,000 times the exposure level for reproductive toxins. The burden of proof rests with the employer.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §5194(b)(6)(D)(3)，雇主可以通过证明在终生暴露水平下对致癌物质不造成显著风险，或对生殖毒素在暴露水平的1000倍下没有可观察到的影响，来表明不需要警告。举证责任在雇主。

question_en: A contractor's crew is working with a hazardous chemical that was transferred from a labeled container into a portable container at the start of the shift. By the end of the shift, the portable container still has chemical remaining. What labeling requirement applies?
question_cn: 承包商的工作人员正在使用一种危险化学品，该化学品在班次开始时从标记的容器转移到便携式容器中。到班次结束时，便携式容器中仍有化学品剩余。适用什么标签要求？

options.en: The container requires only a product identifier tag
options.cn: 容器只需要产品标识标签

options.en: The container must be labeled with required hazard information
options.cn: 容器必须贴有所需的危险信息标签

options.en: The original labeled container must be used instead
options.cn: 必须使用原来的标记容器

options.en: No label is needed if the container is sealed
options.cn: 如果容器密封，则不需要标签

explanation_en: Correct. Per 8 CCR §5194(f)(8), the label exemption for portable containers applies only when the chemical is intended for the immediate use of the employee who performed the transfer within the same work shift. Once that shift ends, the immediate-use exemption no longer applies and the container must be properly labeled.
explanation_cn: 正确。根据 8 CCR §5194(f)(8)，便携式容器的标签豁免仅适用于化学品供进行转移的员工在同一工作班次内立即使用的情况。一旦班次结束，即时使用豁免不再适用，容器必须正确贴标。

question_en: A contractor's foreman removes the label from an incoming drum of solvent to apply a new company-specific label, but the new label has not yet been printed. Which of the following best describes the contractor's liability?
question_cn: 一名承包商的工头从一桶到货的溶剂上移除了标签，以便贴上新的公司特定标签，但新的标签尚未打印出来。以下哪项最能描述承包商的责任？

options.en: The foreman is solely liable, not the contractor
options.cn: 工头单独承担责任，而不是承包商

options.en: No violation exists if the SDS is posted nearby
options.cn: 如果安全数据表（SDS）贴在附近，则不存在违规

options.en: The employer is in violation and subject to Cal/OSHA citation
options.cn: 雇主违规并可能受到加州职业安全与健康管理局（Cal/OSHA）处罚

options.en: A violation only occurs if an employee is actually exposed
options.cn: 只有在员工实际接触时才会发生违规

explanation_en: Correct. Per 8 CCR §5194(f)(9), an employer shall not remove or intentionally deface existing labels on incoming containers of hazardous chemicals unless the container is immediately marked with the required information. Removing the label before the replacement is ready is a direct violation.
explanation_cn: 正确。根据 8 CCR §5194(f)(9)，雇主不得移除或故意损坏到货危险化学品容器上的现有标签，除非容器立即标明所需信息。在替换标签准备好之前移除标签属于直接违规行为。

question_en: On a multi-employer construction site, a subcontractor introduces a hazardous chemical that other trades' employees may encounter. What is the general contractor's primary obligation under the Hazard Communication standard?
question_cn: 在多雇主施工现场，分包商引入一种其他工种员工可能接触到的危险化学品。根据《危险沟通标准》，总承包商的主要义务是什么？

options.en: Prohibit the subcontractor from using hazardous chemicals on site
options.cn: 禁止分包商在现场使用危险化学品

options.en: Post a complete chemical inventory at the project entrance
options.cn: 在项目入口处张贴完整的化学品清单

options.en: Inform other employers of chemical hazards and provide SDS access
options.cn: 通知其他雇主有关化学品的危险并提供SDS的访问权限

options.en: Ensure the subcontractor trains all workers on the site
options.cn: 确保分包商对现场所有工人进行培训

explanation_en: Correct. Per 8 CCR §5194(e)(2), in multi-employer workplaces the written hazard communication program must describe how employers will inform other employers sharing the work area of hazardous chemicals, provide access to safety data sheets, communicate precautionary measures, and explain the labeling system in use.
explanation_cn: 正确。根据8 CCR §5194(e)(2)，在多雇主工作场所，书面的危险沟通计划必须说明雇主如何通知共享工作区的其他雇主有关危险化学品的情况，提供安全数据表的访问权限，传达预防措施，并解释所使用的标签系统。

question_en: An employer's written hazard communication program must specifically address which of the following situations unique to construction sites?
question_cn: 雇主的书面危险沟通程序必须具体说明在建筑工地独有的以下哪些情况？

options.en: Hazards of non-routine tasks and unlabeled pipes in the work area
options.cn: 工作区域中非例行任务和未标记管道的危害

options.en: A Project Permit, as the subcontractor is the Project Administrator
options.cn: 一个项目许可，因为分包商是项目管理员

options.en: Hazards of chemicals used in adjoining facilities off-site
options.cn: 在工地附近设施使用的化学品的危害

options.en: A county building permit is the only permit required here
options.cn: 本县建筑许可是此处唯一需要的许可

explanation_en: Correct. Per 8 CCR §5194(e)(1)(B), the written hazard communication program must describe the methods the employer will use to inform employees of hazards of non-routine tasks and hazards associated with chemicals in unlabeled pipes in their work areas.
explanation_cn: 正确。根据 8 CCR §5194(e)(1)(B)，书面危险沟通程序必须描述雇主用于告知员工有关非例行任务的危害以及他们工作区域中未标记管道中化学品的危害的方法。

question_en: A contractor receives a new Safety Data Sheet revealing significantly increased health risks from a chemical already in use on a job site. Within how many days must this updated information be communicated to affected employees?
question_cn: 一名承包商收到一份新的安全数据表，显示施工现场已经使用的一种化学品的健康风险显著增加。必须在多少天内将这一更新信息传达给受影响的员工？

options.en: Within 15 days of receiving the updated SDS
options.cn: 在收到更新的 SDS 后 15 天内

options.en: Within 60 days of receiving the updated SDS
options.cn: 在收到更新的 SDS 后 60 天内

options.en: Within 30 days of receiving the updated SDS
options.cn: 在收到更新的 SDS 后 30 天内

options.en: Within 7 days of receiving the updated SDS
options.cn: 在收到更新的 SDS 后 7 天内

explanation_en: Correct. Per 8 CCR §5194(h)(3), whenever an employer receives a new or revised SDS, the updated information must be provided to employees on a timely basis not to exceed 30 days after receipt, if the new information indicates significantly increased risks or measures necessary to protect employee health.
explanation_cn: 正确。根据 8 CCR §5194(h)(3)，每当雇主收到新的或修订的 SDS 时，如果新信息表明风险显著增加或需要采取措施保护员工健康，必须及时向员工提供更新信息，且不得超过收到后的 30 天。

question_en: A contractor's employee requests the specific chemical identity of a trade secret ingredient in a chemical they work with daily, citing health concerns. Under what condition is the manufacturer required to disclose the trade secret identity in a non-emergency situation?
question_cn: 一名承包商的员工要求提供他们每天使用的化学品中一种商业秘密成分的具体化学身份，理由是健康问题。在非紧急情况下，制造商在什么条件下必须披露商业秘密身份？

options.en: When a written request, stated health need, and confidentiality agreement are provided
options.cn: 当提供书面请求、说明健康需求并签署保密协议时

options.en: Upon any verbal request from the employee or their supervisor
options.cn: 在员工或其主管提出任何口头请求时

options.en: Only when ordered by a California superior court judge
options.cn: 仅在加利福尼亚州高级法院法官下令时

options.en: Whenever Cal/OSHA conducts a formal inspection of the worksite
options.cn: 每当 Cal/OSHA 对工作场所进行正式检查时

explanation_en: Correct. Per 8 CCR §5194(i)(3), in non-emergency situations a manufacturer must disclose trade secret chemical identity when the requester provides a written request describing the occupational health need, explains why disclosure is essential, and agrees to a written confidentiality agreement restricting use of the information.
explanation_cn: 正确。根据 8 CCR §5194(i)(3) 的规定，在非紧急情况下，当请求者提供书面请求说明职业健康需求、解释为何披露至关重要，并同意签署限制信息使用的书面保密协议时，制造商必须披露商业秘密化学身份。

question_en: During a medical emergency, a treating nurse states she needs the specific chemical identity of a trade secret substance to provide first-aid treatment. The employer states they need a confidentiality agreement first. Which statement correctly describes the employer's legal obligation?
question_cn: 在医疗紧急情况下，主管护士表示她需要一种商业秘密物质的具体化学成分以提供急救治疗。雇主表示他们首先需要一个保密协议。哪项陈述正确描述了雇主的法律义务？

options.en: The employer may withhold identity until a signed agreement is received
options.cn: 雇主可以在收到签署的协议之前保留身份信息

options.en: The employer must disclose immediately, without requiring prior documentation
options.cn: 雇主必须立即披露，无需事先提交文件

options.en: The employer must disclose only to a licensed physician, not a nurse
options.cn: 雇主必须仅向有执照的医生披露，而非护士

options.en: The employer must notify Cal/OSHA before disclosing any trade secret
options.cn: 雇主必须在披露任何商业秘密之前通知加州职业安全与健康管理局（Cal/OSHA）

explanation_en: Correct. Per 8 CCR §5194(i)(2), when a treating physician or nurse determines a medical emergency exists and the chemical identity is necessary for treatment, the employer must immediately disclose the specific chemical identity regardless of whether a written statement of need or confidentiality agreement exists. The employer may require those documents after the emergency as soon as circumstances permit.
explanation_cn: 正确。根据8 CCR §5194(i)(2)，当主管医生或护士确定存在医疗紧急情况且治疗需要化学物质的具体成分时，雇主必须立即披露具体化学成分，无论是否存在书面需求声明或保密协议。雇主可以在紧急情况结束后，在情况允许的情况下要求提供这些文件。

question_en: An employer discovers that a Safety Data Sheet for a chemical currently in use is missing required information. Within how many working days must the employer make a written inquiry to the manufacturer requesting the complete SDS?
question_cn: 雇主发现正在使用的化学品的安全数据表缺少必要信息。雇主必须在多少个工作日内向制造商提出书面询问，要求提供完整的安全数据表？

options.en: Within 25 working days of noting the missing information
options.cn: 注意到信息缺失后25个工作日内

options.en: Within 7 working days of noting the missing information
options.cn: 注意到信息缺失后7个工作日内

options.en: Within 3 working days of noting the missing information
options.cn: 注意到信息缺失后3个工作日内

options.en: Within 15 working days of noting the missing information
options.cn: 注意到信息缺失后15个工作日内

explanation_en: Correct. Per 8 CCR §5194(g)(12)(A), within 7 working days of noting missing SDS information, the employer must make a written inquiry to the manufacturer or importer requesting that the complete safety data sheet be provided.
explanation_cn: 正确。根据 8 CCR §5194(g)(12)(A)，注意到安全数据表缺失信息后，雇主必须在7个工作日内向制造商或进口商提出书面询问，要求提供完整的安全数据表。

question_en: If a manufacturer fails to respond to an employer's written inquiry for a missing Safety Data Sheet, how many working days after the inquiry must the employer send a copy of that inquiry to the Director?
question_cn: 如果制造商未能回应雇主关于缺失安全数据表的书面询问，雇主必须在询问后多少个工作日内将该询问的副本发送给主管？

options.en: If no response is received within 25 working days
options.cn: 如果在 25 个工作日内未收到回复

options.en: If no response is received within 30 working days
options.cn: 如果在 30 个工作日内未收到回复

options.en: If no response is received within 7 working days
options.cn: 如果在 7 个工作日内未收到回复

options.en: If no response is received within 15 working days
options.cn: 如果在 15 个工作日内未收到回复

explanation_en: Correct. Per 8 CCR §5194(g)(12)(D), if the employer has not received a response from the manufacturer, importer, or distributor within 25 working days of the written inquiry, the employer must send a copy of that written inquiry to the Director.
explanation_cn: 正确。根据 8 CCR §5194(g)(12)(D)，如果雇主在书面询问后的 25 个工作日内尚未收到制造商、进口商或分销商的回复，雇主必须将该书面询问的副本发送给主管。

question_en: A contractor uses a stationary chemical mixing tank on a job site. Instead of affixing individual labels to the tank, the foreman posts a process sheet near the tank describing the chemical hazards. Under what condition is this an acceptable alternative?
question_cn: 承包商在工地上使用一个固定的化学混合罐。工头没有在罐子上贴上单独的标签，而是在罐子附近张贴了一张流程表，说明化学品危害。在什么条件下，这种做法是可以接受的替代方案？

options.en: Only if no employees work within 10 feet of the tank
options.cn: 仅当没有员工在罐子周围 10 英尺范围内工作时

options.en: Only if the alternative is pre-approved in writing by Cal/OSHA
options.cn: 仅当该替代方案获得 Cal/OSHA 书面预先批准时

options.en: Only if the tank is used exclusively by one designated employee
options.cn: 仅当罐子仅由一名指定员工使用时

options.en: If the process sheet identifies the container and conveys required hazard information
options.cn: 如果流程表能够识别容器并传达所需的危害信息

explanation_en: Correct. Per 8 CCR §5194(f)(7), employers may use signs, placards, process sheets, or other written materials in lieu of affixing labels to stationary process containers, as long as the alternative method identifies the containers and conveys all required hazard information. In construction, such materials must also accompany the containers.
explanation_cn: 正确。根据 8 CCR §5194(f)(7)，只要替代方法能够识别容器并传达所有所需的危害信息，雇主可以使用标志、告示、流程表或其他书面材料来替代在固定工艺容器上粘贴标签。在建筑行业，这类材料还必须随容器一起使用。

question_en: A manufacturer discovers significant new information about a hazardous chemical's health risks. Within what timeframe must the Safety Data Sheet be updated to reflect this new information?
question_cn: 如果制造商发现关于一种危险化学品健康风险的重大新信息，需要在多长时间内更新安全数据表以反映该新信息？

options.en: Within one month of becoming aware of the information
options.cn: 自获悉该信息之日起一个月内

options.en: Within six months of becoming aware of the information
options.cn: 自获悉该信息之日起六个月内

options.en: Within twelve months of becoming aware of the information
options.cn: 自获悉该信息之日起十二个月内

options.en: Within three months of becoming aware of the information
options.cn: 自获悉该信息之日起三个月内

explanation_en: Correct. Per 8 CCR §5194(g)(5), if a manufacturer, importer, or employer becomes aware of significant new information regarding the hazards of a chemical or ways to protect against them, this information must be added to the SDS within three months of becoming aware of it.
explanation_cn: 正确。根据 8 CCR §5194(g)(5)，如果制造商、进口商或雇主获悉有关化学品危害或防护措施的重大新信息，该信息必须在获悉后三个月内添加到 SDS 中。

question_en: Which of the following employees has the right to receive information about hazardous chemicals to which a worker may be exposed, according to the Hazard Communication standard?
question_cn: 根据《危险化学品通讯标准》，下列哪位员工有权获得有关工人可能接触到的危险化学品的信息？

options.en: Only licensed safety professionals hired by the employer
options.cn: 仅雇主聘用的有执照的安全专业人员

options.en: Only the employee directly exposed to the chemical
options.cn: 仅直接接触化学品的员工

options.en: The employee, their physician, and their collective bargaining agent
options.cn: 员工、本人的医生及其集体谈判代理人

options.en: Only supervisors with direct oversight of the exposed employee
options.cn: 仅直接监督接触化学品的员工的主管

explanation_en: Correct. Per 8 CCR §5194(h)(2)(G), employers must inform employees of their right to personally receive hazard information, their physician's right to receive that information, and their collective bargaining agent's right to receive that information. Employees are also protected against discharge or discrimination for exercising these rights.
explanation_cn: 正确。根据8 CCR §5194(h)(2)(G)，雇主必须告知员工其有权亲自接收危害信息，其医生有权接收这些信息，以及其集体谈判代理人有权接收这些信息。员工行使这些权利时，也受到免于遭受解雇或歧视的保护。

question_en: A contractor classifies a chemical mixture used on a job site. A hazardous chemical is present in the mixture as an impurity. At what minimum concentration must this impurity be listed on the Safety Data Sheet?
question_cn: 一名承包商对工地上使用的一种化学混合物进行分类。混合物中以杂质形式存在一种危险化学品。该杂质在安全数据表上至少需要列出到什么浓度？

options.en: When present at one percent or more of the mixture
options.cn: 当在混合物中含量达到1%或更多时

options.en: When present at two percent or more of the mixture
options.cn: 当在混合物中含量达到2%或更多时

options.en: When present at any detectable concentration in the mixture
options.cn: 当在混合物中任何可检测浓度时

options.en: When present at five percent or more of the mixture
options.cn: 当在混合物中含量达到5%或更多时

explanation_en: Correct. Per 8 CCR §5194(d)(5)(B), a hazardous chemical known to be present in a mixture must be listed on the SDS when it is either one percent or more of the mixture generally, or two percent or more when the hazardous chemical exists as an impurity in the mixture, provided the concentration is below the cut-off level in Appendix A.
explanation_cn: 正确。根据 8 CCR §5194(d)(5)(B)，已知存在于混合物中的危险化学品在安全数据表中必须列出，当其在混合物中的含量一般达到1%或更多，或当危险化学品作为杂质存在于混合物中且其浓度低于附录A所列的截止水平时达到2%或更多。

question_en: A contractor's employee who works at multiple job sites throughout the day needs access to Safety Data Sheets. Under what condition may the employer keep SDSs at a central location rather than at each individual work site?
question_cn: 在一天内在多个工地工作的承包商员工需要获取安全数据表（SDS）。在什么情况下，雇主可以将SDS保存在中央位置，而不是在每个单独的工地保存？

options.en: Only when electronic SDS access devices are provided at each location
options.cn: 只有在每个地点提供电子SDS访问设备时

options.en: Only if the employer first obtains prior written approval from Cal/OSHA
options.cn: 只有在雇主首先获得Cal/OSHA的书面批准时

options.en: When employees travel between sites and can immediately access SDSs
options.cn: 当员工在不同工地之间出差并能立即获取SDS时

options.en: Whenever the employer determines that centralized storage is more convenient
options.cn: 任何时候，只要雇主认为集中存放更方便

explanation_en: Correct. Per 8 CCR §5194(g)(9), when employees must travel between workplaces during a workshift, SDSs may be kept at a central location at the primary facility, provided the employer ensures employees can immediately obtain the required information in an emergency.
explanation_cn: 正确。根据8 CCR §5194(g)(9)，当员工在工作班次中必须在多个工作场所之间出差时，SDS可以保存在主要设施的中央位置，前提是雇主确保员工在紧急情况下能够立即获取所需信息。

question_en: A contractor requires employees to be trained on hazardous chemicals before beginning work. According to the Hazard Communication standard, when must training on a new chemical hazard also be provided to existing employees?
question_cn: 承包商要求员工在开始工作前接受有关危险化学品的培训。根据《危险化学品通信标准》，何时必须向现有员工提供有关新的化学危害的培训？

options.en: Whenever a new chemical hazard is introduced into the work area
options.cn: 每当工作区引入新的化学危害时

options.en: Only when an employee files a formal hazard complaint
options.cn: 仅当员工提出正式的危害投诉时

options.en: Only at annual refresher training sessions for all employees
options.cn: 仅在所有员工的年度复训课程中进行

options.en: Whenever an employee transfers to a different shift or crew
options.cn: 每当员工调到不同的班次或工作组时

explanation_en: Correct. Per 8 CCR §5194(h)(1), employers shall provide effective information and training on hazardous chemicals at the time of initial assignment and whenever a new chemical hazard is introduced into employees' work area, ensuring workers are informed of all current exposures.
explanation_cn: 正确。根据 8 CCR §5194(h)(1)，雇主应在初次分配时以及每当在员工的工作区引入新的化学危害时提供有关危险化学品的有效信息和培训，确保工人了解所有当前的暴露情况。

question_en: On a multi-employer construction worksite, Cal/OSHA issues a citation to a subcontractor even though none of that subcontractor's own employees were exposed to the hazard. Under what role could this citation be justified?
question_cn: 在一个多雇主的建筑工地上，即使分包商自己的员工没有接触到危险，Cal/OSHA 也会向该分包商发出违规通知。根据什么角色可以合理地发出此类通知？

options.en: Only if the subcontractor had supervisory authority over all workers
options.cn: 只有当分包商对所有工人拥有监督权时

options.en: Only as an employer with a written safety contract clause
options.cn: 仅作为拥有书面安全合同条款的雇主

options.en: As the creating, controlling, or correcting employer
options.cn: 作为生成、控制或纠正的雇主

options.en: Only as the employer whose workers were exposed
options.cn: 仅作为其工人暴露于危险的雇主

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §336.10, Note: employers in the creating (b), controlling (c), or correcting (d) roles may be cited regardless of whether their own employees were exposed to the hazard.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州职业安全与健康条例》（8 CCR §336.10），注意：处于生成 (b)、控制 (c) 或纠正 (d) 角色的雇主，无论其自身员工是否接触到危险，都可能被处以违规通知。

question_en: A general contractor oversees a large commercial project but did not directly create a fall hazard. A subcontractor's employee is injured. Under Cal/OSHA's multi-employer worksite rule, the GC could be cited if it held which role?
question_cn: 总承包商监督一个大型商业项目，但并未直接造成跌落危险。分包商的员工受伤。根据加州职业安全与健康署 (Cal/OSHA) 的多雇主工作场所规则，如果总承包商承担哪个角色，可能会被处罚？

options.en: The creating employer who built the faulty structure
options.cn: 制造雇主：建造有缺陷结构的雇主

options.en: The controlling employer responsible for site safety conditions
options.cn: 控制雇主：负责现场安全条件的雇主

options.en: The correcting employer who fixed the hazard on site
options.cn: 纠正雇主：现场修复危险的雇主

options.en: The exposing employer whose workers were injured
options.cn: 暴露雇主：其员工受伤的雇主

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §336.10(c), the controlling employer — the one responsible by contract or actual practice for ensuring hazardous conditions are corrected — may be cited even if its own employees were not exposed.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §336.10(c)，控制雇主——根据合同或实际操作负责确保危险条件得到纠正的雇主——即使其自身员工未受暴露，也可能被处罚。

question_en: Before beginning demolition of a building that stands 40 feet tall, what Cal/OSHA permit must the Project Administrator obtain?
question_cn: 在开始拆除一栋高40英尺的建筑之前，项目管理员必须获取哪种Cal/OSHA许可证？

options.en: No permit is required for structures under 50 feet
options.cn: 高度低于50英尺的结构不需要许可证

options.en: A special demolition license from CSLB only
options.cn: 仅需从CSLB获得特殊拆除执照

options.en: A Project Permit issued before demolition begins
options.cn: 拆除前颁发的项目许可证

options.en: An Annual Permit is sufficient for the Project Administrator
options.cn: 年度许可证对项目管理员来说已足够

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §341(d)(3), demolition or dismantling of any building more than 36 feet in height requires the Project Administrator to hold a Project Permit before work begins.
explanation_cn: 根据8 CCR §341(d)(3)，拆除或拆卸任何高度超过36英尺的建筑物，项目管理员在工作开始前必须持有项目许可证。

question_en: A subcontractor is hired to erect structural steel on a building intended to be 45 feet tall when complete. What permit is the subcontractor required to hold before beginning work?
question_cn: 一名分包商被雇佣在一栋计划完工高度为45英尺的建筑上安装钢结构。在开始工作之前，分包商需要持有什么许可？

options.en: An Annual Permit before engaging in the activity
options.cn: 在从事该活动之前需要持有年度许可证

options.en: A Project Permit, as the Project Administrator
options.cn: 作为项目管理员需要持有项目许可证

options.en: A county building permit only
options.cn: 仅需县建筑许可证

options.en: No permit is needed for steel erection alone
options.cn: 仅进行钢结构安装无需许可

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §341(d)(4)(A), employers other than the Project Administrator who directly engage in structural steel erection on structures intended to exceed 36 feet must hold a current Annual Permit.
explanation_cn: 根据8 CCR §341(d)(4)(A)，除项目管理员外，直接参与计划高度超过36英尺结构的钢结构安装的雇主必须持有有效的年度许可证。

question_en: A contractor plans to dig a trench that will be 6 feet deep and require workers to enter. Which of the following permit scenarios is correct?
question_cn: 承包商计划挖掘一条6英尺深的沟槽，并且需要工人进入。以下哪种许可情况是正确的？

options.en: Emergency excavation permits are automatically granted by the city
options.cn: 紧急开挖许可由市政府自动授予

options.en: No permit is needed if the trench is under 10 feet deep
options.cn: 如果沟槽深度不足10英尺，则无需许可

options.en: An Annual or Project Permit is required before work begins
options.cn: 在开始工作之前需要获得年度许可或项目许可

options.en: Only a Project Permit is acceptable for trenching work
options.cn: 对于开挖沟槽工作，只接受项目许可

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §341(d)(5)(A), construction of trenches 5 feet or deeper into which any person descends requires the employer to hold either an Annual or Project Permit before beginning work.
explanation_cn: 根据8 CCR §341(d)(5)(A)，建设深度为5英尺或更深且有人会进入的沟槽时，雇主在开始工作前必须持有年度许可或项目许可之一。

question_en: Which of the following trenching or excavation scenarios is specifically EXEMPT from Cal/OSHA permit requirements under 8 CCR §341?
question_cn: 根据加州职业安全与健康管理局 (Cal/OSHA) 8 CCR §341 的规定，以下哪种开挖或挖沟情况是明确免于许可要求的？

options.en: Excavations performed by a city-hired private contractor
options.cn: 由城市雇佣的私人承包商进行的开挖

options.en: A 6-foot trench dug by a licensed general contractor
options.cn: 由持证总承包商挖掘的 6 英尺沟槽

options.en: Emergency repair work on existing underground facilities
options.cn: 对现有地下设施进行的紧急维修工作

options.en: A 7-foot trench for a new residential water main
options.cn: 为新住宅供水管道铺设挖掘的 7 英尺沟槽

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §341(e)(3), construction of trenches for the purpose of performing emergency repair work to underground facilities is explicitly exempt from permit requirements.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §341(e)(3)，为进行地下设施的紧急维修而施工挖沟明确免于许可要求。

question_en: If a Project Permit holder on a multi-employer project stops acting as the Project Administrator, what must happen before any project work can continue?
question_cn: 如果一个多雇主项目的项目许可持有人停止担任项目管理员，在任何项目工作可以继续之前必须发生什么？

options.en: The existing permit transfers automatically to the next employer
options.cn: 现有许可会自动转移给下一个雇主

options.en: Work may continue if a supervisor documents the change
options.cn: 如果主管记录了变更，工作可以继续

options.en: Work may resume after a 24-hour waiting period only
options.cn: 仅在等待 24 小时后工作可以恢复

options.en: A new Project Permit must be issued before work resumes
options.cn: 在工作恢复之前必须签发新的项目许可

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §341(c)(1)(B), if the current Project Permit holder no longer acts as Project Administrator, that permit becomes invalid and no project work shall continue until a new Project Permit has been issued.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §341(c)(1)(B)，如果当前项目许可持有人不再担任项目管理员，该许可将失效，在签发新的项目许可之前，任何项目工作不得继续。

question_en: Where must a contractor post the Cal/OSHA 'Safety and Health Protection on the Job' notice when employees work at multiple dispersed construction sites rather than reporting to a central office?
question_cn: 当员工在多个分散的建筑工地工作而不是到中央办公室报到时，承包商必须将加州职业安全与健康管理局（Cal/OSHA）的“工作场所安全与健康保护”通知张贴在哪里？

options.en: Posted once per county where work is being performed
options.cn: 在每个从事工作的县各张贴一次

options.en: At the nearest Cal/OSHA district office location
options.cn: 在最近的加州职业安全与健康管理局地区办公室位置

options.en: At each location where employees report each day
options.cn: 在员工每天报到的每个地点

options.en: Only at the company's main administrative headquarters
options.cn: 仅在公司的主要行政总部

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §340, where employers are engaged in physically dispersed activities such as construction, the Cal/OSHA Notice must be posted at each location to which employees report each day.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州法规第8卷》第340条，当雇主从事诸如建筑等物理分散的活动时，Cal/OSHA 通知必须张贴在员工每天报到的每个地点。

question_en: The Cal/OSHA posting notice must inform employees of their right to do which of the following without fear of retaliation?
question_cn: Cal/OSHA 公示通知必须告知员工他们有权在不担心报复的情况下执行以下哪项操作？

options.en: Demand immediate job reassignment for any safety concern
options.cn: 对任何安全问题要求立即调岗

options.en: Refuse work that would create a real and apparent hazard
options.cn: 拒绝可能造成实际和明显危险的工作

options.en: File a wage claim with the Labor Commissioner
options.cn: 向劳工专员提交工资申诉

options.en: Negotiate their own personal protective equipment standards
options.cn: 协商他们自己的个人防护设备标准

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §340, the notice must inform employees that no employee shall be laid off or discharged for refusing to perform work where a violation of safety law would create a real and apparent hazard.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §340，该通知必须告知员工，任何员工因拒绝执行可能违反安全法规并造成实际和明显危险的工作，都不得被解雇或开除。

question_en: When must a first-aid trained person be available on a construction job site, according to Cal/OSHA requirements?
question_cn: 根据加州职业安全与健康管理局（Cal/OSHA）的要求，建筑工地上何时必须有经过急救培训的人员在场？

options.en: Whenever more than 25 employees work on a single shift
options.cn: 当单班有超过25名员工工作时

options.en: Only when hazardous chemicals are actively being used
options.cn: 仅在正在使用危险化学品时

options.en: When no nearby infirmary, clinic, or hospital is available
options.cn: 当附近没有医务室、诊所或医院可用时

options.en: Only on projects exceeding six months in duration
options.cn: 仅在项目持续时间超过六个月时

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §3400(b), in the absence of an infirmary, clinic, or hospital in near proximity to the workplace used for treatment of all injured employees, a person shall be adequately trained to render first aid.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州法规》第8卷 §3400(b)条款，如果工作场所附近没有可用于治疗所有受伤员工的医务室、诊所或医院，则应有经过充分培训的人员提供急救。

question_en: A worker on a job site gets a corrosive chemical splashed in their eyes. What specific facility must the employer have already provided to comply with Cal/OSHA requirements?
question_cn: 一名工地工人的眼睛被腐蚀性化学品溅到。雇主必须提前提供哪种具体设施以符合加州职业安全与健康管理局（Cal/OSHA）的要求？

options.en: A stretcher and blankets stored within 50 feet of the work area
options.cn: 在工作区50英尺范围内存放的担架和毛毯

options.en: A written emergency plan posted near the chemical containers
options.cn: 张贴在化学品容器附近的书面应急计划

options.en: A fully stocked first-aid kit near the chemical storage area
options.cn: 化学品储存区附近配备齐全的急救箱

options.en: An eyewash and body drenching station within the work area
options.cn: 在工作区内设置的洗眼和全身冲洗站

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §3400(d), where eyes or body may be exposed to injurious corrosive materials, suitable facilities for quick drenching or flushing of the eyes and body shall be provided within the work area for immediate emergency use.
explanation_cn: 根据8 CCR §3400(d)规定，如果眼睛或身体可能接触有害腐蚀性物质，应在工作区内提供适当的设施以迅速冲洗眼睛和身体，供立即紧急使用。

question_en: Which of the following construction activities triggers Cal/OSHA asbestos regulations under 8 CCR §1529, even if no asbestos is visibly present?
question_cn: 根据 8 CCR §1529，即使没有明显的石棉存在，下列哪项施工活动会触发 Cal/OSHA 的石棉法规？

options.en: Erection of new wood-framed residential structures only
options.cn: 仅限新建木框架住宅结构

options.en: Excavation where asbestos may exist as a natural soil constituent
options.cn: 可能含有天然土壤成分石棉的挖掘

options.en: Painting the exterior of an existing commercial building
options.cn: 对现有商业建筑外墙进行油漆施工

options.en: Grading work on a property with no prior industrial use
options.cn: 在无工业使用历史的地块上进行平整工作

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §1529(a)(1)(G), excavation which may involve exposure to asbestos as a natural constituent of the soil — not related to mining activities — is covered under the asbestos construction standard.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §1529(a)(1)(G)，可能涉及接触土壤天然成分石棉的挖掘——与采矿活动无关——属于石棉施工标准的范围。

question_en: Under Cal/OSHA's Hazard Communication standard, if an employer denies a health professional's request for a specific chemical identity claiming trade secret status, within how many days must the written denial be provided?
question_cn: 根据加州职业安全与健康管理局（Cal/OSHA）的危险化学品沟通标准，如果雇主以商业机密身份为由拒绝健康专业人士对特定化学物质的请求，必须在多少天内提供书面拒绝？

options.en: Within 30 calendar days of the request
options.cn: 在请求后的 30 个日历日内

options.en: Within 60 calendar days of the request
options.cn: 在请求后的 60 个日历日内

options.en: Within 15 calendar days of the request
options.cn: 在请求后的 15 个日历日内

options.en: Within 10 calendar days of the request
options.cn: 在请求后的 10 个日历日内

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §5194(i)(6)(A), when an employer denies a trade secret request, the written denial must be provided to the health or safety professional, employee, or designated representative within 30 days of the request.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §5194(i)(6)(A)，当雇主拒绝商业机密请求时，必须在请求后的 30 天内向健康或安全专业人士、员工或指定代表提供书面拒绝。

question_en: After receiving Cal/OSHA notification that a chemical identity claim may not qualify as a trade secret, how many days does an employer have to submit a written justification by certified mail?
question_cn: 在收到加州职业安全与健康管理局（Cal/OSHA）通知，表明某化学品身份声明可能不符合商业机密资格后，雇主有多少天时间通过挂号信提交书面理由？

options.en: 30 days after the initial trade secret claim was submitted
options.cn: 自最初提交商业机密声明之日起30天内

options.en: 15 days after receipt of the Director's notification
options.cn: 自收到主任通知之日起15天内

options.en: 30 days after receiving the Director's notification
options.cn: 自收到主任通知之日起30天内

options.en: 15 days after the initial trade secret claim was submitted
options.cn: 自最初提交商业机密声明之日起15天内

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §5194(i)(11), the manufacturer, importer, or employer shall have 15 days after receipt of notification to provide the Director with a complete justification submitted by certified mail.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州法规典》第8 CCR §5194(i)(11)条，制造商、进口商或雇主在收到通知后有15天时间，通过挂号信向主任提供完整的书面理由。

question_en: A general contractor supervises a project where a subcontractor is performing Class I asbestos removal. The general contractor is not a certified asbestos competent person. Under Cal/OSHA regulations, what is the general contractor's primary obligation regarding the asbestos work?
question_cn: 总承包商监督一项由分包商进行I类石棉清除的工程。总承包商不是经过认证的石棉合格人员。根据加州职业安全与健康管理局（Cal/OSHA）法规，总承包商在石棉工作方面的主要义务是什么？

options.en: Conduct daily air monitoring within the regulated area
options.cn: 在受管制区域进行每日空气监测

options.en: Verify the asbestos contractor complies and require corrective action
options.cn: 验证石棉承包商是否遵守规定并要求采取纠正措施

options.en: Hire a CIH to supervise all asbestos operations daily
options.cn: 雇用注册工业卫生师（CIH）每天监督所有石棉操作

options.en: Remove all employees from the project site until work is done
options.cn: 直到工作完成前，将所有员工撤离项目现场

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §1529(d)(5), general contractors exercise general supervisory authority over asbestos work on the project and must ascertain whether the asbestos contractor is in compliance and require compliance when necessary, even if not qualified as the asbestos competent person.
explanation_cn: 根据8 CCR §1529(d)(5)条款，总承包商对项目中的石棉工作行使一般监督权，并且必须确定石棉承包商是否遵守规定，并在必要时要求其遵守，即使总承包商未被认证为石棉合格人员。

question_en: On a multi-employer worksite, a significant breach occurs in the enclosure containing Class I asbestos work. Which employer is responsible for immediately repairing the breach?
question_cn: 在一个多雇主的工作现场，包含一级石棉作业的封闭区发生重大破损。哪位雇主负责立即修复该破损？

options.en: The building or facility owner of record
options.cn: 建筑物或设施的登记业主

options.en: The employer of workers nearest to the breach
options.cn: 离破损最近的工人的雇主

options.en: The employer who erected and controls the enclosure
options.cn: 建立并控制封闭区的雇主

options.en: The general contractor overseeing the entire project
options.cn: 监管整个项目的总承包商

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §1529(d)(2), asbestos hazards shall be abated by the contractor who created or controls the source of contamination. The employer responsible for the enclosure must repair the breach immediately.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §1529(d)(2)，石棉危害应由造成或控制污染源的承包商进行消除。负责封闭区的雇主必须立即修复破损。

question_en: A contractor is performing Class I asbestos removal on a project. Exposure monitoring has not yet been completed and no negative exposure assessment exists. What must the employer assume about employee asbestos exposure?
question_cn: 一名承包商正在某项目上进行 I 类石棉清除工作。暴露监测尚未完成，也没有负面暴露评估存在。雇主必须对员工的石棉暴露假设什么？

options.en: Exposures are likely at background levels only
options.cn: 暴露可能仅在背景水平

options.en: Exposures exceed both the TWA and the excursion limit
options.cn: 暴露超过 TWA 和短时间暴露限值

options.en: Exposures need not be assessed until work is complete
options.cn: 工作完成之前无需评估暴露

options.en: Exposures are at or below the excursion limit only
options.cn: 暴露仅在短时间暴露限值或以下

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §1529(f)(2)(B), for Class I asbestos work, until monitoring confirms exposures are below PELs or a negative exposure assessment is made, the employer shall presume employees are exposed in excess of both the TWA and the excursion limit.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §1529(f)(2)(B)，对于 I 类石棉工作，在监测确认暴露低于允许暴露限值 (PEL) 或进行负面暴露评估之前，雇主应假定员工的暴露超过 TWA 和短时间暴露限值。

question_en: An asbestos contractor receives air monitoring results showing employee exposures exceed the PEL during Class II work. Within how many working days must affected employees be notified of these results?
question_cn: 一家石棉承包商收到空气监测结果，显示员工在二类作业期间的暴露超过PEL。必须在多少个工作日内将这些结果通知受影响的员工？

options.en: Within 10 working days of receiving results
options.cn: 在收到结果后的10个工作日内

options.en: Within 3 working days of receiving results
options.cn: 在收到结果后的3个工作日内

options.en: Within 5 working days of receiving results
options.cn: 在收到结果后的5个工作日内

options.en: Within 15 working days of receiving results
options.cn: 在收到结果后的15个工作日内

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §1529(f)(5)(A), the employer must notify affected employees of monitoring results as soon as possible but no later than 5 working days following receipt of the results.
explanation_cn: 根据8 CCR §1529(f)(5)(A)，雇主必须尽快通知受影响的员工监测结果，但不得晚于收到结果后的5个工作日。

question_en: Which of the following work practices is explicitly prohibited when working with asbestos-containing materials, regardless of measured exposure levels?
question_cn: 在处理含石棉材料时，无论测量的暴露水平如何，下列哪种工作做法是明确禁止的？

options.en: Dry sweeping or shoveling dust and debris containing ACM
options.cn: 干扫或铲除含有石棉材料（ACM）的灰尘和碎屑

options.en: Applying wet methods during removal and cleanup
options.cn: 在拆除和清理过程中使用湿法

options.en: Rotating employees to reduce individual exposure time
options.cn: 轮换员工以减少个人暴露时间

options.en: Using HEPA vacuums to collect debris and dust
options.cn: 使用HEPA吸尘器收集碎屑和灰尘

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §1529(g)(3)(C), dry sweeping, shoveling, or other dry cleanup of dust and debris containing ACM or PACM is explicitly prohibited regardless of measured exposure levels.
explanation_cn: 根据加州职业安全健康条例第8章 §1529(g)(3)(C)，无论测量的暴露水平如何，干扫、铲除或其他干清理含ACM或PACM的灰尘和碎屑是明确禁止的。

question_en: A contractor plans to use employee rotation as a strategy to keep individual asbestos exposures below the PEL during Class II work. This approach is:
question_cn: 一位承包商计划在第二类工作期间使用员工轮换作为策略，以使个人石棉暴露低于允许的职业暴露极限（PEL）。这种做法是：

options.en: Prohibited under all circumstances as a means of reducing exposure
options.cn: 在任何情况下都禁止作为降低暴露的手段

options.en: Allowed when combined with supplied-air respirator use
options.cn: 当与供气呼吸器使用结合时允许

options.en: Acceptable if daily monitoring confirms exposures remain below PELs
options.cn: 如果每日监测确认暴露仍低于PEL，则可接受

options.en: Permitted only for Class III and Class IV work activities
options.cn: 仅允许用于第三类和第四类工作活动

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §1529(g)(3)(D), employee rotation as a means of reducing employee exposure to asbestos is explicitly prohibited, regardless of the class of work or measured exposure levels.
explanation_cn: 根据《加利福尼亚法规第8卷》第1529条(g)(3)(D)款，作为降低员工石棉暴露手段的员工轮换明确被禁止，无论工作类别或测量的暴露水平如何。

question_en: When must a contractor conducting Class I asbestos work perform exposure monitoring for employees in the regulated area, assuming no negative exposure assessment has been produced?
question_cn: 当承包商进行一级石棉作业时，如果尚未生成负面暴露评估，何时必须对受规管区域内的员工进行暴露监测？

options.en: Daily, for each employee assigned to the regulated area
options.cn: 每天，对分配到受规管区域的每位员工进行

options.en: At the start and end of the entire project only
options.cn: 仅在整个项目开始和结束时

options.en: Every shift, only if visible asbestos dust is observed
options.cn: 每个班次，仅在观察到可见石棉灰尘时

options.en: Weekly, unless visual inspection shows no visible dust
options.cn: 每周一次，除非目视检查显示无可见灰尘

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §1529(f)(3)(A), the employer shall conduct daily monitoring representative of the exposure of each employee assigned to work within a regulated area performing Class I or II work, unless a negative exposure assessment has been made for the entire operation.
explanation_cn: 根据8 CCR §1529(f)(3)(A)，雇主应对在受规管区域内进行一级或二级作业的每位员工进行每日监测，以代表其暴露情况，除非整个作业已进行了负面暴露评估。

question_en: Under Cal/OSHA asbestos regulations, which circumstance requires a contractor to reinstate exposure monitoring even after monitoring had been previously discontinued?
question_cn: 根据加州职业安全与健康管理局（Cal/OSHA）石棉法规，在哪种情况下，即使之前已停止监测，也需要承包商重新进行暴露监测？

options.en: The employer hires a new certified industrial hygienist
options.cn: 雇主雇用了新的认证工业卫生师

options.en: A new employee joins the crew during the same operation
options.cn: 在同一操作期间有新员工加入队伍

options.en: A change in control equipment that may increase exposures above PELs
options.cn: 控制设备发生变化，可能导致暴露超过允许暴露限值（PEL）

options.en: The project moves from indoors to an outdoor work area
options.cn: 项目从室内搬迁到室外工作区

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §1529(f)(4)(B), additional monitoring is required whenever there is a change in process, control equipment, personnel, or work practices that may result in new or additional exposures above the PEL or excursion limit, even if a negative exposure assessment was previously produced.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §1529(f)(4)(B) 的规定，每当工艺、控制设备、人员或工作惯例发生变化，可能导致新的或额外的暴露超过允许暴露限值（PEL）或逸出限值时，即使之前出具了负面暴露评估，也需要进行额外监测。

question_en: A contractor is using a glovebag system to remove asbestos-containing pipe insulation. Which of the following requirements applies to the glovebags used in this operation?
question_cn: 承包商正在使用手套袋系统拆除含石棉的管道保温材料。以下哪项要求适用于此次操作中使用的手套袋？

options.en: Glovebags may be used only once and must not be moved
options.cn: 手套袋只能使用一次，且不得移动

options.en: Glovebags may be repositioned along the pipe between uses
options.cn: 手套袋可以在使用时沿管道重新定位

options.en: Glovebags may be used on pipe surfaces up to 200°F
options.cn: 手套袋可以用于温度高达200°F的管道表面

options.en: Glovebags may be reused after being HEPA-vacuumed and wiped clean
options.cn: 手套袋在经过HEPA吸尘和擦拭清洁后可以重复使用

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §1529(g)(5)(B)2.c, glovebags may be used only once and may not be moved. This prevents recontamination risks and maintains containment integrity.
explanation_cn: 根据8 CCR §1529(g)(5)(B)2.c，手套袋只能使用一次，且不得移动。这可以防止再次污染风险并保持封闭完整性。

question_en: A contractor performing Class I asbestos work proposes using an alternative control method not listed in the standard. Who must certify in writing that the method will keep exposures below PELs under worst-case conditions?
question_cn: 一名承包商在进行 I 类石棉作业时提出使用标准中未列出的替代控制方法。谁必须书面证明该方法可以在最恶劣的条件下将暴露降至职业暴露限值以下？

options.en: A Cal/OSHA compliance officer assigned to that specific project
options.cn: 指派到该特定项目的 Cal/OSHA 合规官

options.en: The building owner or facility manager of official record
options.cn: 正式记录在案的建筑业主或设施经理

options.en: The employer's designated competent person assigned to the project
options.cn: 雇主指派到该项目的指定胜任人员

options.en: A CIH or licensed PE who is also a qualified project designer
options.cn: 既是注册工业卫生师(CIH)又是合格项目设计师的持证工程师(PE)

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §1529(g)(6)(B), a CIH or licensed professional engineer who is also qualified as a project designer must evaluate the work area and certify in writing that the alternative control method will reduce exposures below PELs under worst-case conditions.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §1529(g)(6)(B)，既是注册工业卫生师(CIH)又合格为项目设计师的持证专业工程师必须评估工作区，并书面证明替代控制方法可以在最恶劣的条件下将暴露降至职业暴露限值以下。

question_en: During Class I asbestos removal, which of the following actions must be taken regarding HVAC systems located in the regulated area?
question_cn: 在进行一级石棉拆除时，对于位于受控区域内的暖通空调（HVAC）系统，必须采取以下哪些措施？

options.en: Increase HVAC airflow to dilute and disperse asbestos fibers
options.cn: 增加暖通空调气流以稀释并分散石棉纤维

options.en: Operate HVAC in exhaust mode to create negative pressure
options.cn: 将暖通空调设为排气模式以产生负压

options.en: Filter the HVAC system air through HEPA units during removal
options.cn: 在拆除过程中通过HEPA装置过滤暖通空调系统的空气

options.en: Isolate and seal the HVAC system with double 6-mil plastic
options.cn: 用双层6密尔塑料隔离并密封暖通空调系统

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §1529(g)(4)(C), for all Class I jobs, HVAC systems shall be isolated in the regulated area by sealing with a double layer of 6 mil plastic or the equivalent to prevent migration of asbestos fibers.
explanation_cn: 根据《加利福尼亚法规典》第8卷 CCR §1529(g)(4)(C)，对于所有一级作业，暖通空调系统应在受控区域内通过使用双层6密尔塑料或等效材料进行密封，以防止石棉纤维扩散。

question_en: An employer observing asbestos air monitoring on behalf of an employee must enter an area requiring protective clothing and equipment. What is the employer's obligation regarding that observer?
question_cn: 代表员工进行石棉空气监测的雇主必须进入需要防护服和设备的区域。雇主对该观察员的义务是什么？

options.en: Provide the observer with required protective clothing and equipment
options.cn: 为观察员提供所需的防护服和设备

options.en: Permit the observer to monitor only from outside the regulated area
options.cn: 允许观察员仅在受管制区域外进行监测

options.en: The observer may enter without PPE if they sign a waiver
options.cn: 如果观察员签署豁免书，可以在没有个人防护装备的情况下进入

options.en: Postpone monitoring until the observer can provide their own PPE
options.cn: 推迟监测直到观察员能够提供自己的个人防护装备

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §1529(f)(6)(B), when monitoring observation requires entry into a protected area, the observer must be provided with and required to use appropriate protective clothing and equipment.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §1529(f)(6)(B)，当监测观察需要进入受保护区域时，必须为观察员提供并要求其使用适当的防护服和设备。

question_en: A worker performing Class I asbestos removal is equipped with a supplied-air respirator in positive pressure mode. Which statement is TRUE regarding daily exposure monitoring under this condition?
question_cn: 一名工人正在执行一级石棉清除作业，并佩戴正压供气呼吸器。关于这种情况下的每日暴露监测，哪种说法是正确的？

options.en: Daily monitoring may be waived if a positive pressure respirator is used
options.cn: 如果使用正压呼吸器，每日监测可以免除

options.en: Daily monitoring is always required regardless of respirator type used
options.cn: 无论使用何种呼吸器类型，每日监测始终是必需的

options.en: Monitoring frequency is reduced to weekly when positive pressure respirators are used
options.cn: 使用正压呼吸器时，监测频率可减少为每周一次

options.en: Daily monitoring is still required if a non-listed control method is in use
options.cn: 如果使用的控制方法未列出，每日监测仍然是必需的

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §1529(f)(3)(C), while daily monitoring may be waived when all employees use supplied-air respirators in positive pressure mode, employees performing Class I work using a control method not listed in subsection (g)(4) or a modification thereof must continue to be monitored daily even with positive pressure respirators.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §1529(f)(3)(C)，虽然当所有员工使用正压供气呼吸器时，每日监测可以免除，但使用子条款 (g)(4) 中未列出的控制方法或其修改方法进行一级作业的员工，即使佩戴正压呼吸器，也必须继续进行每日监测。

question_en: Which of the following materials is classified as 'Presumed Asbestos Containing Material' (PACM) and therefore subject to asbestos regulations without requiring initial testing?
question_cn: 以下哪种材料被归类为“推定含石棉材料”（PACM），因此无需初步检测即可受石棉法规管制？

options.en: Thermal system insulation in buildings built no later than 1980
options.cn: 1980年之前建造建筑物中的热系统绝缘材料

options.en: All insulation materials regardless of building construction date
options.cn: 所有绝缘材料，无论建筑物建造日期如何

options.en: Surfacing material found in buildings constructed in 1985
options.cn: 1985年建造建筑物中的表面材料

options.en: Any building material that contains fiberglass insulation
options.cn: 任何含有玻璃纤维绝缘材料的建筑材料

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §1529(b), PACM means thermal system insulation and surfacing material found in buildings constructed no later than 1980. This presumption may be rebutted by testing per subsection (k)(5).
explanation_cn: 根据8 CCR §1529(b)，PACM指1980年之前建造建筑物中的热系统绝缘材料和表面材料。根据第(k)(5)款，可通过检测来推翻这种推定。

question_en: A contractor performing Class I asbestos removal receives written notification from an employee's designated representative requesting to observe exposure monitoring. What must the employer do?
question_cn: 执行I类石棉清除的承包商收到员工指定代表的书面通知，要求观察暴露监测。雇主必须怎么做？

options.en: Provide the designated representative an opportunity to observe monitoring
options.cn: 给指定代表提供观察监测的机会

options.en: Deny access if the representative is not an authorized employee
options.cn: 如果代表不是授权员工，则拒绝访问

options.en: Allow observation only after the employer reviews monitoring data first
options.cn: 仅在雇主先审查监测数据后允许观察

options.en: Provide monitoring results in writing in lieu of observation access
options.cn: 提供书面监测结果以替代观察访问

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §1529(f)(6)(A), the employer shall provide affected employees and their designated representatives an opportunity to observe any monitoring of employee exposure to asbestos conducted under this section.
explanation_cn: 根据8 CCR §1529(f)(6)(A)，雇主应为受影响的员工及其指定代表提供机会，观察根据本条进行的任何员工石棉暴露监测。

question_en: During Class II asbestos work involving vinyl floor tile removal, a worker proposes dry sweeping the area to speed up cleanup. What must the employer do?
question_cn: 在进行涉及乙烯基地板瓦片拆除的二类石棉作业时，一名工人建议干扫区域以加快清理速度。雇主必须做什么？

options.en: Permit dry sweeping only when tiles are heated and intact
options.cn: 仅在瓦片加热且完整时允许干扫

options.en: Require HEPA vacuuming with a metal floor tool instead
options.cn: 改为要求使用带金属地板工具的HEPA吸尘器

options.en: Allow dry sweeping if the area is well ventilated
options.cn: 如果区域通风良好，允许干扫

options.en: Permit dry sweeping only at the end of the shift
options.cn: 仅在班次结束时允许干扫

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1529(g)(8)(A)5 explicitly prohibits dry sweeping. Floors must be cleaned using a HEPA-filter vacuum with a disposable dust bag and metal floor tool (no brush).
explanation_cn: 8 CCR §1529(g)(8)(A)5 明确禁止干扫。地板必须使用带一次性尘袋和金属地板工具（不使用刷子）的HEPA过滤吸尘器进行清洁。

question_en: A contractor is removing asbestos-containing roofing felt using a power roof cutter on a built-up roof with an aggregate surface. What is required to control the dust produced along the cut line?
question_cn: 一名承包商正在使用动力屋顶切割机在带骨料表面的积层屋顶上移除含石棉的屋顶毡。要控制沿切割线产生的灰尘，需要做什么？

options.en: Wet-wipe the cut line and immediately bag all loose debris
options.cn: 用湿布擦拭切割线，并立即将所有松散的碎片装袋

options.en: Continuously mist the cut line with diluted amended water
options.cn: 持续用稀释的改良水喷洒切割线

options.en: Sweep debris into covered containers at shift end
options.cn: 在轮班结束时将碎片扫入有盖容器中

options.en: Use a HEPA vacuum or dust collector along the cut line
options.cn: 沿切割线使用 HEPA 吸尘器或集尘器

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1529(g)(8)(B)4 requires that on aggregate-surface built-up roofs, all dust from the cutting operation be collected by a HEPA dust collector or HEPA vacuumed along the cut line.
explanation_cn: 8 CCR §1529(g)(8)(B)4 要求，在带骨料表面的积层屋顶上，切割操作产生的所有灰尘必须通过 HEPA 集尘器收集或沿切割线使用 HEPA 吸尘器清理。

question_en: After completing asbestos abatement work in a building, within how many days must the employer notify the building owner of the current location and quantity of any remaining ACM and final monitoring results?
question_cn: 在完成建筑物的石棉清除工作后，雇主必须在多少天内通知建筑物所有者任何剩余石棉包含材料（ACM）的当前位置和数量以及最终监测结果？

options.en: Within 24 hours of the work being completed
options.cn: 在工作完成后的24小时内

options.en: Within 10 days of the work being completed
options.cn: 在工作完成后的10天内

options.en: Within 5 days of the work being completed
options.cn: 在工作完成后的5天内

options.en: Within 30 days of the work being completed
options.cn: 在工作完成后的30天内

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1529(k)(3)(C) requires the employer to inform the building/facility owner and adjacent-area employers of remaining ACM/PACM and final monitoring results within 10 days of completing the work.
explanation_cn: 8 CCR §1529(k)(3)(C) 要求雇主在完成工作后的10天内通知建筑物/设施所有者及邻近区域的雇主剩余的ACM/PACM及最终监测结果。

question_en: A contractor's crew discovers previously unknown asbestos-containing material while working in a building. When must the employer notify the building owner and other on-site employers?
question_cn: 承包商的团队在建筑物内工作时发现了先前未知的含石棉材料。雇主必须在什么时候通知建筑物所有者及其他现场雇主？

options.en: Within 10 days of the discovery
options.cn: 发现后10天内

options.en: Within 24 hours of the discovery
options.cn: 发现后24小时内

options.en: By the end of the current work shift
options.cn: 当前工作班次结束前

options.en: Within 3 business days of the discovery
options.cn: 发现后3个工作日内

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1529(k)(4) requires that all employers who discover ACM or PACM on a worksite convey information about its presence, location, and quantity to the owner and other employers within 24 hours.
explanation_cn: 8 CCR §1529(k)(4) 要求，所有在工作现场发现 ACM 或 PACM 的雇主必须在24小时内将其存在、位置和数量的信息传达给业主和其他雇主。

question_en: Before a contractor bids on renovation work in a building suspected to contain asbestos, what obligation does the building owner have regarding prospective bidding contractors?
question_cn: 在承包商对怀疑含有石棉的建筑进行翻新投标之前，建筑所有者对潜在投标承包商有哪些义务？

options.en: Notify prospective bidders of ACM and PACM presence, location, and quantity
options.cn: 通知潜在投标人关于 ACM 和 PACM 的存在、位置和数量

options.en: Hire a certified industrial hygienist to test all suspect materials
options.cn: 雇佣认证的工业卫生师对所有可疑材料进行检测

options.en: Post asbestos warning signs at all building entrances
options.cn: 在所有建筑入口处张贴石棉警告标志

options.en: Provide a written asbestos abatement plan to all bidders
options.cn: 向所有投标人提供书面的石棉清除计划

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1529(k)(2)(B)1 requires building owners to notify prospective employers applying or bidding for work of the presence, location, and quantity of ACM or PACM at the worksite.
explanation_cn: 加利福尼亚法规 8 CCR §1529(k)(2)(B)1 要求建筑所有者在工作场所存在 ACM 或 PACM 时，通知申请或投标工作的潜在雇主其存在、位置和数量。

question_en: During a Class I asbestos abatement job, a competent person inspects a worker's protective coveralls and finds a tear. What must happen immediately?
question_cn: 在进行一级石棉清除作业期间，一名合格人员检查工人的防护连体服时发现有撕裂。必须立即采取什么措施？

options.en: The rip or tear must be immediately mended or the suit replaced
options.cn: 撕裂或裂口必须立即修补，或更换连体服

options.en: The employee must apply duct tape to the torn area
options.cn: 员工必须在破损处贴上胶带

options.en: The employee may continue working until the shift ends
options.cn: 员工可以继续工作直到班次结束

options.en: The employee must exit and shower before the suit is repaired
options.cn: 员工必须退出并淋浴，然后才能修复连体服

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1529(i)(4)(B) states that when rips or tears are detected while an employee is working, they shall be immediately mended or the worksuit shall be immediately replaced.
explanation_cn: 8 CCR §1529(i)(4)(B) 规定，当员工工作时发现撕裂或裂口，应立即修补或立即更换工作服。

question_en: An employee performing Class I asbestos abatement removes their contaminated worksuit in the equipment room. At what point in the decontamination sequence may the employee remove their respirator?
question_cn: 执行一级石棉清除的员工在设备室脱下他们受污染的工作服。在去污过程中，员工可以在什么时候摘掉呼吸器？

options.en: After depositing the worksuit in an impermeable bag
options.cn: 将工作服放入不透气袋后

options.en: After showering and entering the clean room
options.cn: 洗澡并进入净化室后

options.en: Immediately upon entering the equipment room
options.cn: 一进设备室就立即摘掉

options.en: While still inside the regulated work area
options.cn: 仍在受控工作区内时

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1529(j)(1)(C)3 states employees shall not remove respirators in the equipment room. The safe point for removal is after showering, once the employee has entered the clean room.
explanation_cn: 8 CCR §1529(j)(1)(C)3 规定，员工不得在设备室内摘下呼吸器。安全的摘除时间是在洗澡后，一旦员工进入净化室。

question_en: A contractor performing Class II asbestos removal wants to use a different engineering control method not listed in the standard. What must the employer provide before using this alternative approach?
question_cn: 一名承包商在进行二级石棉清除时，想使用标准中未列出的不同工程控制方法。在使用这种替代方法之前，雇主必须提供什么？

options.en: Written approval from the building owner and general contractor
options.cn: 建筑业主和总承包商的书面批准

options.en: A formal Cal/OSHA variance approval granted before any work begins
options.cn: 在任何工作开始之前获得正式的加州职业安全与健康管理局（Cal/OSHA）变更许可

options.en: A negative exposure assessment conducted by a certified industrial hygienist
options.cn: 由认证工业卫生师进行的负面暴露评估

options.en: Employee exposure data and written competent person PEL certification
options.cn: 员工暴露数据和书面合格人员职业暴露限值（PEL）认证

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1529(g)(8)(F) requires the employer to demonstrate by exposure data that employee exposure will not exceed PELs, and a competent person must certify in writing that the modified controls are adequate under all expected conditions.
explanation_cn: 《加利福尼亚法规典章》第8卷 §1529(g)(8)(F) 要求雇主通过暴露数据证明员工暴露不会超过PEL，并且合格人员必须以书面形式证明，在所有预期条件下，修改后的控制措施是足够的。

question_en: A building owner installs a new HVAC system in a mechanical room that contains thermal system insulation identified as PACM. What must the owner post at the entrance to that mechanical room?
question_cn: 建筑物所有者在一个机械设备室中安装了新的暖通空调系统，该机械设备室内含有被识别为 PACM 的热系统绝缘材料。业主必须在该机械设备室的入口处张贴什么？

options.en: Signs identifying the material, its location, and appropriate work practices
options.cn: 标识材料、其位置及适当工作方法的标志

options.en: A Cal/OSHA permit authorizing entry into the space
options.cn: 授权进入该空间的 Cal/OSHA 许可

options.en: An asbestos abatement plan approved by an industrial hygienist
options.cn: 由工业卫生师批准的石棉清除计划

options.en: Standard 'Authorized Personnel Only' signs matching the regulated area format
options.cn: 符合受管制区域格式的标准“仅限授权人员”标志

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1529(k)(6) requires building owners to post signs at mechanical room entrances that identify the ACM/PACM present, its location, and the work practices that will prevent disturbance.
explanation_cn: 8 CCR §1529(k)(6) 要求建筑物所有者在机械设备室入口处张贴标志，标明存在的 ACM/PACM、其位置以及防止干扰的工作方法。

question_en: A contractor removes asbestos-containing gaskets from a pipe fitting. The gaskets are visibly deteriorated and cannot be removed intact. Which method is required?
question_cn: 一名承包商正在从管道配件上拆除含石棉的垫片。垫片明显已损坏，无法完整拆除。需要使用哪种方法？

options.en: Remove the gasket using wet methods and a HEPA vacuum
options.cn: 使用湿法和HEPA吸尘器拆除垫片

options.en: Apply amended water and scrape the gasket off mechanically
options.cn: 施加改良水并机械刮除垫片

options.en: Establish a full negative-pressure enclosure around the fitting
options.cn: 在配件周围建立完整的负压封闭空间

options.en: Remove the gasket inside a glovebag as described in the standard
options.cn: 按标准在手套袋内拆除垫片

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1529(g)(8)(D)1 requires that if a gasket is visibly deteriorated and unlikely to be removed intact, removal shall be undertaken within a glovebag as described in subsection (g)(5)(B).
explanation_cn: 《加利福尼亚共和国法规》第8卷 §1529(g)(8)(D)1规定，如果垫片明显损坏且不可能完整拆除，则应按小节(g)(5)(B)的描述在手套袋内进行拆除。

question_en: Which of the following respirator types is explicitly PROHIBITED for use against asbestos fibers under California asbestos regulations?
question_cn: 根据加利福尼亚州的石棉法规，下列哪种呼吸器类型在对抗石棉纤维时明确被禁止使用？

options.en: Filtering facepiece (disposable dust mask) respirator
options.cn: 过滤式面罩（一次性防尘口罩）呼吸器

options.en: Full facepiece supplied-air respirator in pressure-demand mode
options.cn: 压力供气模式下的全面罩供气呼吸器

options.en: Half-mask air-purifying respirator with HEPA filters
options.cn: 配备HEPA滤芯的半面罩空气净化呼吸器

options.en: Tight-fitting powered air-purifying respirator with HEPA filters
options.cn: 配备HEPA滤芯的紧密型动力空气净化呼吸器

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1529(h)(3)(A) explicitly states that employers shall not select or use filtering facepiece respirators for use against asbestos fibers. Only HEPA-equipped respirators are permitted.
explanation_cn: 8 CCR §1529(h)(3)(A) 明确规定，雇主不得选择或使用过滤式面罩呼吸器对抗石棉纤维。仅允许使用配备HEPA滤芯的呼吸器。

question_en: A contractor is removing intact asbestos-containing siding panels from a building exterior. How must the panels be lowered from the work level to the ground?
question_cn: 一名承包商正在从建筑外墙拆除完整的含石棉墙板。必须如何将这些墙板从工作层降到地面？

options.en: Dropped directly to the ground onto impermeable drop cloths
options.cn: 直接丢到地面上的防水防尘布上

options.en: Lowered by hand, covered dust-tight chute, crane, or hoist
options.cn: 用手搬下，通过覆盖的密封防尘槽、起重机或提升机

options.en: Placed in a roll-off dumpster positioned directly below the work area
options.cn: 放置在直接位于工作区域下方的可开盖垃圾箱中

options.en: Stacked on the roof and removed at the end of the project
options.cn: 堆放在屋顶上，并在项目结束时移除

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1529(g)(8)(C)3 prohibits dropping or throwing panels and requires that unwrapped panels be immediately lowered via covered dust-tight chute, crane, hoist, or placed in impervious waste bags and lowered by end of shift.
explanation_cn: 8 CCR §1529(g)(8)(C)3 禁止投掷或抛掷墙板，并要求未包装的墙板必须立即通过覆盖的密封防尘槽、起重机、提升机搬下，或放入不渗透的废料袋中并在班次结束前降下。

question_en: Under what condition may a roofing contractor performing ACM removal omit the use of wet methods or HEPA vacuuming on an intact roof section?
question_cn: 在什么情况下，进行 ACM 拆除的屋面承包商可以在完整的屋面区域省略使用湿法或 HEPA 吸尘？

options.en: When the roofing material has been encapsulated with a bituminous coating
options.cn: 当屋面材料已经用沥青涂层封装时

options.en: When removal occurs on a non-residential exterior building surface
options.cn: 当拆除发生在非住宅的建筑外表面时

options.en: When a negative exposure assessment has been produced for the job
options.cn: 当为该工作产生了负暴露评估时

options.en: When that day's total roof removal area is under 25 square feet
options.cn: 当当天屋面拆除总面积低于 25 平方英尺时

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1529(g)(8)(B)8 allows omission of wet methods and HEPA vacuuming when less than 25 square feet of intact roofing is being removed or repaired on the same roof in one day, using manual methods that do not render the material nonintact and create no visible dust.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §1529(g)(8)(B)8，当在同一屋面上使用不会破坏材料完整性且不会产生可见灰尘的手工方法移除或修复不到 25 平方英尺的完整屋面时，可以省略湿法和 HEPA 吸尘。

question_en: A building owner installs asbestos-containing roofing products on a non-residential roof. When must the owner notify the building's tenants or occupants of the presence and location of these materials?
question_cn: 建筑业主在非住宅屋顶上安装含石棉的屋顶产品。业主必须在何时通知建筑的租户或居住者这些材料的存在及位置？

options.en: Before the roofing contractor begins any work on the building
options.cn: 在屋顶承包商开始任何建筑工作之前

options.en: Within 24 hours of the roofing material being installed
options.cn: 在屋顶材料安装后的24小时内

options.en: No later than the end of the roofing job
options.cn: 不晚于屋顶工程完成

options.en: Within 10 days after the roofing job is completed
options.cn: 在屋顶工程完成后的10天内

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1529(g)(11)(E) requires the employer/owner to notify the building owner of the presence and location of labeled ACM roofing materials no later than the end of the job, ensuring the record is established before workers leave the site.
explanation_cn: 8 CCR §1529(g)(11)(E) 要求雇主/业主在工程结束前通知建筑业主标记的含石棉屋顶材料的存在及位置，确保在工人离开工地之前建立记录。

question_en: A supervisor catches an employee smoking in a work area where asbestos exposure is possible. What does California asbestos regulation require the employer to do?
question_cn: 主管抓到一名员工在可能接触石棉的工作区域内吸烟。加利福尼亚州的石棉法规要求雇主做什么？

options.en: Require the employee to wear a respirator while smoking
options.cn: 要求员工在吸烟时佩戴呼吸器

options.en: Ensure employees do not smoke in asbestos-exposure work areas
options.cn: 确保员工不在石棉暴露的工作区域吸烟

options.en: Designate a separate smoking area within the regulated zone
options.cn: 在受管制区域内指定独立的吸烟区

options.en: Allow smoking only after the employee uses a HEPA vacuum on their clothing
options.cn: 仅在员工使用高效空气过滤（HEPA）吸尘器清理衣物后允许吸烟

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1529(j)(4) requires the employer to ensure that employees do not smoke in work areas where they are occupationally exposed to asbestos because of activities in that work area.
explanation_cn: 加州法典第8章 CCR §1529(j)(4) 要求雇主确保员工不在因工作活动而职业性暴露于石棉的工作区域内吸烟。

question_en: A contractor employs workers who perform Class I asbestos abatement. When must initial asbestos training be provided to these employees?
question_cn: 承包商雇佣从事一级石棉清除工作的员工。必须在何时为这些员工提供初始石棉培训？

options.en: Within 90 days of hire to the company
options.cn: 在入职公司后的90天内

options.en: Prior to or at the time of initial assignment
options.cn: 在初次分配任务之前或当时

options.en: Within 10 working days after exposure begins
options.cn: 在接触开始后的10个工作日内

options.en: Within 30 days after starting asbestos work
options.cn: 在开始石棉工作后的30天内

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1529(k)(9)(B) requires that training be provided prior to or at the time of initial assignment and at least annually thereafter.
explanation_cn: 8 CCR §1529(k)(9)(B) 要求培训必须在初次分配任务之前或当时提供，并且此后至少每年一次。

question_en: A contractor assigns a worker to perform Class II asbestos operations involving roofing materials. What is the MINIMUM required length of the hands-on training course?
question_cn: 承包商指派一名工人执行涉及屋顶材料的二类石棉作业。动手培训课程的最低所需时长是多少？

options.en: At least 24 hours of EPA-accredited coursework
options.cn: 至少 24 小时的 EPA 认证课程

options.en: At least 2 hours of formal instruction
options.cn: 至少 2 小时的正式讲授

options.en: At least 16 hours including hands-on training
options.cn: 至少 16 小时，包括动手培训

options.en: At least 8 hours including hands-on training
options.cn: 至少 8 小时，包括动手培训

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1529(k)(9)(D)1. requires that training for Class II work involving roofing, flooring, siding, ceiling tiles, or transite panels include hands-on training and take at least 8 hours.
explanation_cn: 8 CCR §1529(k)(9)(D)1. 要求涉及屋顶、地板、墙板、天花板瓷砖或水泥板的二类作业培训必须包括动手培训，且至少需要 8 小时。

question_en: During a building renovation, a contractor's workers are performing Class III asbestos operations. What is the minimum required training duration for these employees?
question_cn: 在建筑翻新期间，承包商的工人正在执行三级石棉操作。这些员工的最低培训时长要求是多少？

options.en: At least 8 hours with hands-on instruction
options.cn: 至少8小时，包括实际操作指导

options.en: At least 40 hours per EPA MAP standards
options.cn: 根据EPA MAP标准至少40小时

options.en: At least 2 hours of awareness training
options.cn: 至少2小时的意识培训

options.en: At least 16 hours including hands-on training
options.cn: 至少16小时，包括实际操作培训

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1529(k)(9)(E) requires that Class III training be consistent with EPA requirements at 40 CFR 763.92(a)(2), include hands-on training, and take at least 16 hours.
explanation_cn: 8 CCR §1529(k)(9)(E)要求三级培训需符合EPA在40 CFR 763.92(a)(2)中的要求，包括实际操作培训，且至少需要16小时。

question_en: A janitor works in a building where asbestos-containing materials are present but performs only Class IV cleanup duties. What is the minimum asbestos training duration required for this employee?
question_cn: 一名清洁工在含石棉材料的建筑物中工作，但仅执行四类清洁任务。该员工所需的最少石棉培训时间是多少？

options.en: At least 4 hours of awareness training annually
options.cn: 每年至少4小时的意识培训

options.en: At least 16 hours of EPA-consistent training
options.cn: 至少16小时符合EPA标准的培训

options.en: At least 2 hours of awareness-level training
options.cn: 至少2小时的意识级别培训

options.en: At least 8 hours including hands-on exercises
options.cn: 至少8小时，包括实际操作练习

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1529(k)(9)(F) requires Class IV training consistent with EPA 40 CFR 763.92(a)(1) for custodial staff, which takes at least 2 hours.
explanation_cn: 8 CCR §1529(k)(9)(F)要求清洁人员接受与EPA 40 CFR 763.92(a)(1)一致的四类培训，该培训至少需要2小时。

question_en: A contractor charges employees for their required asbestos training program. Under Cal/OSHA regulations, this practice is:
question_cn: 承包商向员工收取所需的石棉培训费用。根据加州职业安全与健康局（Cal/OSHA）规定，这种做法是：

options.en: Prohibited; training must be provided at no cost
options.cn: 禁止的；培训必须免费提供

options.en: Permitted for employees who fail initial training
options.cn: 允许针对未通过初次培训的员工

options.en: Allowed only for voluntary refresher training courses
options.cn: 仅允许自愿的复训课程

options.en: Allowed if costs are reimbursed within 30 days
options.cn: 允许，如果费用在30天内报销

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1529(k)(9)(A) explicitly requires the employer to institute the training program at no cost to the employee for all workers likely to be exposed above the PEL.
explanation_cn: 8 CCR §1529(k)(9)(A) 明确要求雇主为所有可能暴露于PEL以上的工作人员提供免费培训计划。

question_en: An employer conducting asbestos abatement work ceases operations and no successor employer exists. What must the employer do with required records?
question_cn: 从事石棉清除工作的雇主停止运营且没有继任雇主时，必须如何处理所需的记录？

options.en: Immediately destroy all confidential medical records
options.cn: 立即销毁所有机密的医疗记录

options.en: Transfer all records to the last jobsite owner
options.cn: 将所有记录移交给最后的工作现场业主

options.en: File all records with the county health department
options.cn: 将所有记录提交给县卫生部门

options.en: Notify the Director at least 90 days before disposal
options.cn: 在处理前至少提前90天通知主管

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1529(n)(8)(B) requires the employer to notify the Director at least 90 days prior to disposal and transmit records to the Director upon request when no successor employer exists.
explanation_cn: 8 CCR §1529(n)(8)(B) 要求在没有继任雇主的情况下，雇主必须在销毁记录前至少提前90天通知主管，并在主管要求时将记录传送给主管。

question_en: How long must an employer retain employee asbestos medical surveillance records after the employee's employment ends?
question_cn: 雇主在员工离职后必须保留员工石棉健康监测记录多久？

options.en: For the duration of employment plus 30 years
options.cn: 雇佣期间加上30年

options.en: For the duration of employment plus 5 years
options.cn: 雇佣期间加上5年

options.en: For at least 10 years after employment ends
options.cn: 员工离职后至少10年

options.en: For at least 1 year beyond the last day of employment
options.cn: 离职最后一天起至少1年

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1529(n)(3)(C) requires the employer to maintain asbestos medical surveillance records for the duration of employment plus thirty (30) years, in accordance with Section 3204 of the General Industry Safety Orders.
explanation_cn: 8 CCR §1529(n)(3)(C) 要求雇主按照《通用工业安全条例》第3204条的规定，保留石棉健康监测记录，期限为雇佣期间加三十（30）年。

question_en: How long must an employer retain asbestos employee training records after the last date of employment?
question_cn: 雇主必须在员工最后工作日期之后保留石棉员工培训记录多久？

options.en: For 3 years after the training date
options.cn: 培训日期之后3年

options.en: For 1 year beyond the last date of employment
options.cn: 员工最后工作日期之后1年

options.en: For 30 years after employment ends
options.cn: 雇佣结束后30年

options.en: For 5 years after the last date of employment
options.cn: 员工最后工作日期之后5年

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1529(n)(4) specifically requires the employer to maintain all employee asbestos training records for one year beyond the last date of employment by that employer.
explanation_cn: 8 CCR §1529(n)(4) 明确要求雇主将所有员工的石棉培训记录保留至该员工离职后一年的时间。

question_en: A contractor is performing Class I asbestos abatement on a renovation project. How frequently must the designated competent person conduct on-site inspections at minimum?
question_cn: 承包商正在进行翻新工程的I类石棉清除。指定的合格人员至少应多久进行一次现场检查？

options.en: At least once each day before work begins
options.cn: 每天工作开始前至少一次

options.en: At intervals sufficient to assess changed conditions
options.cn: 以足够的间隔评估变化的情况

options.en: At least once during each work shift
options.cn: 每个工作班次至少一次

options.en: At least once per week during active abatement
options.cn: 在积极清除期间每周至少一次

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1529(o)(3) requires that for Class I jobs, on-site inspections by the competent person be made at least once during each work shift and at any time at employee request.
explanation_cn: 8 CCR §1529(o)(3) 要求，对于I类工作，合格人员必须在每个工作班次至少进行一次现场检查，并在员工提出请求时进行。

question_en: A contractor hires an asbestos consultant for a project involving 150 square feet of asbestos-containing construction material. What must the contractor verify before engaging that consultant?
question_cn: 一名承包商为涉及150平方英尺含石棉建筑材料的项目雇佣了一名石棉顾问。在聘用该顾问之前，承包商必须核实什么？

options.en: That the consultant has at least 4 years of experience
options.cn: 顾问至少有4年的经验

options.en: That the consultant carries general liability insurance
options.cn: 顾问拥有一般责任保险

options.en: That the consultant is registered with the EPA directly
options.cn: 顾问直接在EPA注册

options.en: That the consultant provides proof of Division certification
