options.cn: 顾问提供部门认证的证明

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1529(q)(4) states that no employer shall engage the services of an asbestos consultant or site surveillance technician unless that person provides proof of certification by the Division.
explanation_cn: 8 CCR §1529(q)(4) 规定，除非该人提供部门认证证明，否则雇主不得聘用石棉顾问或现场监督技术人员的服务。

question_en: An employer receives the physician's written opinion from an employee's asbestos medical examination. Within how many days must the employer provide a copy to the affected employee?
question_cn: 雇主收到员工石棉体检医生的书面意见后，必须在多少天内向受影响的员工提供副本？

options.en: Within 30 days from its receipt by the employer
options.cn: 从雇主收到之日起30天内

options.en: Within 90 days of the medical examination date
options.cn: 从体检日期起90天内

options.en: Within 10 working days of receipt
options.cn: 收到后10个工作日内

options.en: Within 14 calendar days of receipt
options.cn: 收到后14个日历日内

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1529(m)(4)(C) requires the employer to provide a copy of the physician's written opinion to the affected employee within 30 days from its receipt.
explanation_cn: 《加州法规》(8 CCR §1529(m)(4)(C)) 要求雇主在收到医生书面意见后30天内向受影响的员工提供副本。

question_en: Under Cal/OSHA asbestos regulations, which of the following must an employer include when providing information to the examining physician?
question_cn: 根据加州职业安全与健康管理局（Cal/OSHA）的石棉法规，在向检查医生提供信息时，雇主必须包括下列哪项内容？

options.en: A description of PPE used and representative exposure level
options.cn: 使用的个人防护装备（PPE）描述及代表性暴露水平

options.en: The employee's workers' compensation claims history
options.cn: 员工的工伤赔偿索赔历史

options.en: The employee's wage rate and hours worked annually
options.cn: 员工的工资水平及年度工作时间

options.en: The employee's complete personnel and disciplinary file
options.cn: 员工的完整人事及处分档案

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1529(m)(3) requires the employer to provide the physician with the employee's job duties, representative exposure level, a description of PPE used, and information from prior medical examinations.
explanation_cn: 8 CCR §1529(m)(3) 要求雇主向医生提供员工的工作职责、代表性暴露水平、使用的PPE描述以及先前体检的信息。

question_en: A contractor's workers vacuum debris in an area containing deteriorated asbestos-containing material. Which type of vacuum equipment is required?
question_cn: 承包商的工人在含有已劣化石棉材料的区域中使用吸尘设备清理碎片。需要哪种类型的吸尘设备？

options.en: Industrial vacuums with disposable paper filters
options.cn: 配有一次性纸质过滤器的工业吸尘器

options.en: Any commercial wet-dry shop vacuum available on-site
options.cn: 现场可用的任何商用干湿两用吸尘器

options.en: Any vacuum rated at least 99% filtration efficiency
options.cn: 任何过滤效率至少为99%的吸尘器

options.en: HEPA filtered vacuuming equipment only
options.cn: 仅使用HEPA过滤吸尘设备

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1529(l)(1) requires that where vacuuming methods are selected, HEPA filtered vacuuming equipment must be used and emptied in a manner that minimizes reentry of asbestos into the workplace.
explanation_cn: 根据8 CCR §1529(l)(1) 的规定，在选择吸尘方法时，必须使用HEPA过滤吸尘设备，并且清空方式应尽量减少石棉重新进入工作场所。

question_en: An employer is disposing of asbestos-contaminated clothing and waste debris from a renovation project. What containment method is required?
question_cn: 雇主正在处理来自翻新项目的石棉污染服装和废弃物碎片。需要使用什么样的封闭方法？

options.en: Wrapped in plastic sheeting and taped securely closed
options.cn: 用塑料薄膜包裹并牢固封口

options.en: Sealed in labeled, impermeable bags or closed containers
options.cn: 密封在带标签的、不透水的袋子或封闭容器中

options.en: Double-bagged in standard contractor garbage bags
options.cn: 用标准承包商垃圾袋双层包装

options.en: Placed in open containers clearly marked 'Asbestos'
options.cn: 放入标有“石棉”的敞口容器中

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1529(l)(2) requires that asbestos waste, scrap, debris, containers, equipment, and contaminated clothing be collected and disposed of in sealed, labeled, impermeable bags or other closed, labeled, impermeable containers.
explanation_cn: 8 CCR §1529(l)(2) 要求石棉废物、废料、碎片、容器、设备和受污染的衣物必须收集并处置在密封、带标签、不透水的袋子或其他封闭、带标签、不透水的容器中。

question_en: A worker is assigned to an area where asbestos exposure may be at or above the PEL for 30 or more days per year. Within how many working days after the thirtieth day of exposure must the employer provide a medical examination?
question_cn: 一名工人被分配到石棉暴露可能达到或超过PEL的区域，每年暴露30天或更多天。雇主必须在石棉暴露的第30天之后多少个工作日内提供体检？

options.en: Within 30 calendar days after the thirtieth exposure day
options.cn: 石棉暴露第30天之后的30个日历日内

options.en: Within 60 calendar days of initial assignment to the area
options.cn: 分配到该区域的最初60个日历日内

options.en: Within 10 working days after the thirtieth exposure day
options.cn: 石棉暴露第30天之后的10个工作日内

options.en: Within 5 working days after the thirtieth exposure day
options.cn: 石棉暴露第30天之后的5个工作日内

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1529(m)(2)(A)2. requires that when an employee is exposed at or above the PEL for 30 or more days per year, a medical examination must be given within 10 working days following the thirtieth day of exposure.
explanation_cn: 8 CCR §1529(m)(2)(A)2. 要求，当员工每年暴露达到或超过PEL 30天或更多时，必须在暴露的第30天之后的10个工作日内进行体检。

question_en: A general industry employer receives asbestos air monitoring results showing exposure above the TWA limit. Within how many working days must affected employees be notified in writing?
question_cn: 一般工业雇主收到石棉空气监测结果显示暴露超过TWA限值。必须在多少个工作日内以书面形式通知受影响的员工？

options.en: Within 5 working days of receiving results
options.cn: 在收到结果后的5个工作日内

options.en: Within 10 working days of receiving results
options.cn: 在收到结果后的10个工作日内

options.en: Within 15 working days of receiving results
options.cn: 在收到结果后的15个工作日内

options.en: Within 30 calendar days of receiving results
options.cn: 在收到结果后的30个日历日内

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §5208(d)(7)(A), the employer must notify affected employees within 15 working days after receipt of monitoring results, either individually in writing or by posting in an accessible location.
explanation_cn: 根据8 CCR §5208(d)(7)(A)，雇主必须在收到监测结果后的15个工作日内，以书面形式单独通知受影响的员工，或在可访问的位置张贴通知。

question_en: A building constructed in 1978 has thermal system insulation on its boiler pipes that has never been tested. How must an employer treat this material under Cal/OSHA's asbestos standard?
question_cn: 一栋建于1978年的建筑，其锅炉管道上的热系统保温材料从未经过测试。根据加州职业安全与健康管理局（Cal/OSHA）的石棉标准，雇主必须如何处理这种材料？

options.en: Treat it as presumed asbestos-containing material
options.cn: 将其视为推定含石棉材料

options.en: Treat it as non-hazardous until air sampling confirms exposure
options.cn: 在空气取样确认暴露前，将其视为无害

options.en: Post a general hazard notice without further action
options.cn: 张贴一般危险通知，无需进一步措施

options.en: Test a sample before assigning any work classification
options.cn: 在分配任何工作分类前测试样本

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §5208(j)(2), thermal system insulation in buildings constructed no later than 1980 is designated as 'Presumed ACM' (PACM) and must be treated as asbestos-containing unless the employer demonstrates otherwise.
explanation_cn: 根据8 CCR §5208(j)(2)，建于1980年或之前的建筑中的热系统保温材料被指定为“推定含石棉材料”（PACM），除非雇主能够证明否则，否则必须将其视为含石棉材料。

question_en: An employee working in a regulated asbestos area wishes to eat lunch. What must the employer ensure before the employee enters the lunchroom?
question_cn: 一名在受管控石棉区域工作的员工希望吃午餐。雇主在员工进入午餐室之前必须确保什么？

options.en: The employee washes hands and face before entering
options.cn: 员工在进入前洗手和洗脸

options.en: The employee has completed a full shift shower
options.cn: 员工已完成整个班次的淋浴

options.en: The employee submits a hazard communication form first
options.cn: 员工首先提交危险沟通表格

options.en: The employee changes into non-contaminated street clothes
options.cn: 员工换上未被污染的便服

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §5208(i)(3)(C), employees exposed above the PEL must wash hands and face before eating. Additionally, §5208(i)(3)(D) requires that protective clothing have surface fibers removed before entering the lunchroom.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §5208(i)(3)(C) 的规定，暴露超过PEL的员工在进食前必须洗手和洗脸。此外，§5208(i)(3)(D) 要求在进入午餐室之前，应去除防护服表面的纤维。

question_en: Which of the following types of respirator is specifically PROHIBITED for use as protection against asbestos fibers?
question_cn: 以下哪种类型的呼吸器特别禁止用于防护石棉纤维？

options.en: Supplied-air respirator in positive-pressure mode
options.cn: 正压模式的供气呼吸器

options.en: Non-powered air-purifying respirator with HEPA filters
options.cn: 配备 HEPA 过滤器的非动力空气净化呼吸器

options.en: Powered air-purifying respirator with HEPA filters
options.cn: 配备 HEPA 过滤器的动力空气净化呼吸器

options.en: Filtering facepiece (dust mask) respirator
options.cn: 过滤型面具（防尘口罩）呼吸器

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §5208(g)(3)(A), employers must not select or use filtering facepiece respirators for protection against asbestos fibers. Only HEPA-equipped or supplied-air respirators are acceptable.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §5208(g)(3)(A)，雇主不得选择或使用过滤型面具呼吸器来防护石棉纤维。只有配备 HEPA 过滤器或供气的呼吸器是可接受的。

question_en: A contractor performing asbestos brake and clutch repair work inspects four pairs of brakes per week. Which compliance method is the employer permitted to use?
question_cn: 承包商进行石棉刹车和离合器维修工作，每周检查四对刹车。雇主允许使用哪种合规方法？

options.en: Negative pressure enclosure with HEPA vacuum system only
options.cn: 仅使用带 HEPA 真空系统的负压隔离装置

options.en: The low-volume method described in Appendix F, subsection D
options.cn: 《附录 F》第 D 小节中描述的低体积方法

options.en: Any equivalent method with documented monitoring data
options.cn: 任何具有记录监测数据的等效方法

options.en: Wet wipe method only, with no alternatives allowed
options.cn: 仅使用湿擦拭方法，不允许其他替代方法

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §5208(f)(3)(A), facilities inspecting, disassembling, or repairing no more than 5 pairs of brakes or 5 clutches per week may use the simplified method set forth in subsection [D] of Appendix F.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR 第 §5208(f)(3)(A) 条，每周检查、拆卸或维修不超过 5 对刹车或 5 个离合器的设施，可使用附录 F 第 [D] 小节规定的简化方法。

question_en: An employer's engineering controls reduce asbestos exposure but cannot bring it below the TWA limit. What is the employer's next required action?
question_cn: 雇主的工程控制可以减少石棉暴露，但无法将其降低到TWA限值以下。雇主接下来必须采取的行动是什么？

options.en: Supplement controls with required respiratory protection
options.cn: 补充要求的呼吸防护

options.en: Rotate employees to reduce individual exposure time
options.cn: 轮换员工以减少个人暴露时间

options.en: Halt all work until exposure levels are confirmed safe
options.cn: 停止所有工作，直到确认暴露水平安全

options.en: Request a variance from the Chief before continuing work
options.cn: 在继续工作前向主管申请豁免

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §5208(f)(1)(B), where feasible engineering and work practice controls cannot achieve the TWA limit, the employer shall use them to reduce exposure as much as possible and supplement them with respiratory protection that complies with §5208(g).
explanation_cn: 根据8 CCR §5208(f)(1)(B)条款，如果可行的工程和工作操作控制无法达到TWA限值，雇主应尽可能使用它们来降低暴露，并辅以符合§5208(g)条款的呼吸防护。

question_en: Under California's asbestos standard, which activity involving asbestos is ABSOLUTELY prohibited regardless of engineering controls or protective measures?
question_cn: 根据加利福尼亚州的石棉标准，涉及石棉的哪种活动无论采取何种工程控制或防护措施都是绝对禁止的？

options.en: Sanding and abrading asbestos-containing flooring materials
options.cn: 打磨和研磨含石棉的地板材料

options.en: Spraying any substance containing asbestos on a structure
options.cn: 在建筑物上喷涂任何含石棉的物质

options.en: Handling asbestos pipe insulation without HEPA vacuum
options.cn: 在没有HEPA吸尘器的情况下处理石棉管道隔热材料

options.en: Using compressed air to clean asbestos-containing dust
options.cn: 使用压缩空气清理含石棉的灰尘

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §5208(f)(1)(J), spraying of any substance containing any amount of asbestos in or upon a building or structure during construction, alteration, or repair is absolutely prohibited, with limited narrow exceptions.
explanation_cn: 根据8 CCR §5208(f)(1)(J)，在建筑物或结构的施工、改造或维修过程中，喷涂任何含石棉的物质是绝对禁止的，仅有有限的狭窄例外。

question_en: A building owner is selling a facility that contains documented ACM. What obligation does the regulation place on the owner regarding those records?
question_cn: 建筑物所有者正在出售一处包含已记录 ACM 的设施。法规对所有者关于这些记录有什么义务？

options.en: Destroy all records upon completing the property sale
options.cn: 在完成房产出售后销毁所有记录

options.en: Retain records for five years after the sale is final
options.cn: 在出售完成后五年内保留记录

options.en: Submit all records to DOSH prior to the sale date
options.cn: 在出售日期之前将所有记录提交给 DOSH

options.en: Transfer all ACM records to the successive owner
options.cn: 将所有 ACM 记录转交给继任所有者

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §5208(j)(3)(B), building owners must maintain ACM/PACM records for the duration of ownership and transfer them to successive owners when the property changes hands.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §5208(j)(3)(B)，建筑物所有者必须在拥有期间保持 ACM/PACM 记录，并在房产易手时将其转交给继任所有者。

question_en: An employer discovers that an employee medically cannot tolerate wearing a respirator required for asbestos work. What must the employer do?
question_cn: 雇主发现某名员工因健康原因无法佩戴用于石棉作业的呼吸器。雇主必须做什么？

options.en: Terminate the employee for inability to perform required duties
options.cn: 因员工无法执行所需职责而解雇该员工

options.en: Allow the employee to work in the regulated area unprotected
options.cn: 允许员工在受管制的区域内无需防护工作

options.en: Provide a powered air-purifying respirator as the only alternative
options.cn: 提供动力空气净化呼吸器作为唯一替代方案

options.en: Assign the employee to another job without respiratory requirements
options.cn: 将员工分配到没有呼吸防护要求的其他工作岗位

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §5208(g)(2)(C), if a physician determines an employee cannot safely use a respirator, the employer must assign them to another job or offer a transfer to a different position with the same seniority, status, and pay in the same geographic area.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §5208(g)(2)(C)，如果医生确定某名员工无法安全使用呼吸器，雇主必须将其分配到其他工作岗位，或者提供转岗到同一地区具有相同资历、职位和薪酬的不同职位。

question_en: How frequently must an employer at minimum conduct periodic asbestos air monitoring for employees whose exposures may reasonably exceed the TWA permissible exposure limit?
question_cn: 对于那些其接触物可能合理地超过时间加权平均允许暴露限值（TWA PEL）的员工，雇主至少应多频繁地进行定期石棉空气监测？

options.en: At least once every six months
options.cn: 至少每六个月一次

options.en: At least once every eighteen months
options.cn: 至少每十八个月一次

options.en: At least once every three months
options.cn: 至少每三个月一次

options.en: At least once every twelve months
options.cn: 至少每十二个月一次

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §5208(d)(3), periodic monitoring shall occur at intervals no greater than six months for employees whose exposures may reasonably be foreseen to exceed the TWA and/or excursion limit.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州法规第8章第5208条(d)(3)款》，对于那些其接触物可能合理预见超过时间加权平均和/或突发暴露限值的员工，定期监测的间隔不得超过六个月。

question_en: An employer wants to use employee rotation to keep individual asbestos exposures below the TWA permissible exposure limit. Is this strategy permitted?
question_cn: 雇主希望通过员工轮换来将个人石棉暴露保持在TWA允许暴露限值以下。这种策略允许吗？

options.en: No, unless approved in writing by a certified industrial hygienist
options.cn: 不允许，除非经过注册工业卫生师的书面批准

options.en: No, employee rotation is explicitly prohibited as a compliance method
options.cn: 不允许，员工轮换明确禁止作为合规方法

options.en: Yes, but only when combined with respiratory protection
options.cn: 允许，但仅在结合呼吸防护时使用

options.en: Yes, if all employees are medically cleared for asbestos work
options.cn: 允许，如果所有员工都通过了从事石棉工作的医疗审核

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §5208(f)(2)(D), the employer shall not use employee rotation as a means of compliance with the TWA and/or excursion limit. Engineering controls and respiratory protection must be used instead.
explanation_cn: 根据8 CCR §5208(f)(2)(D)，雇主不得使用员工轮换作为遵守TWA和/或突发限值的手段。必须改为使用工程控制和呼吸防护。

question_en: When a warning sign is posted at the entrance to a regulated asbestos area, what additional information must be included if respirators and protective clothing are required inside?
question_cn: 当在受管制的石棉区域入口处张贴警告标志时，如果该区域内需要呼吸器和防护服，还必须包含哪些附加信息？

options.en: A statement requiring respirators and protective clothing in the area
options.cn: 要求在该区域内使用呼吸器和防护服的声明

options.en: The name of the certified industrial hygienist responsible for the area
options.cn: 负责该区域的认证工业卫生师的姓名

options.en: The specific type of asbestos fiber present in the work area
options.cn: 工作区域内存在的石棉纤维的具体类型

options.en: The measured fiber concentration inside the regulated area
options.cn: 受管制区域内测得的纤维浓度

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §5208(j)(4)(B)2, when respirators and protective clothing are required, the sign must additionally state: 'WEAR RESPIRATORS AND PROTECTIVE CLOTHING IN THIS AREA.'
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §5208(j)(4)(B)2，当需要使用呼吸器和防护服时，标志还必须注明：'在此区域内佩戴呼吸器和防护服。'

question_en: A supervisor discovers that an employee's asbestos monitoring results from a prior sampling event fell below the TWA limit. Under what circumstance must the employer reinstate monitoring for that employee?
question_cn: 一名主管发现某员工之前一次采样的石棉监测结果低于TWA限值。在什么情况下雇主必须为该员工恢复监测？

options.en: When the employee is assigned to a new supervisor
options.cn: 当员工被分配到新的主管时

options.en: When a process, control, or work practice change may increase exposure
options.cn: 当某个工艺、控制或工作做法的变化可能导致暴露增加时

options.en: When six months have passed since the last sampling event
options.cn: 当距离上一次采样事件已过去六个月时

options.en: When the affected employee specifically requests monitoring in writing
options.cn: 当受影响的员工书面提出监测要求时

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §5208(d)(5), the employer must reinstate monitoring whenever there has been a change in production, process, control equipment, personnel, or work practices that may result in new or additional exposures above the PEL or excursion limit.
explanation_cn: 根据8 CCR §5208(d)(5)，每当生产、工艺、控制设备、人员或工作做法发生变化，可能导致新的或额外的暴露超过PEL或偏离限值时，雇主必须恢复监测。

question_en: An employer provides contaminated asbestos protective clothing to an outside laundry service. What is the employer's obligation to the laundering company?
question_cn: 雇主向外部洗衣服务提供受污染的石棉防护服。雇主对洗衣公司有什么义务？

options.en: Inform the laundering service of the hazards and exposure prevention requirements
options.cn: 通知洗衣服务有关危害和暴露预防的要求

options.en: Have a certified industrial hygienist inspect the laundry facility first
options.cn: 先让认证工业卫生师检查洗衣设施

options.en: Obtain a written waiver from the laundering service before delivery
options.cn: 在交付前从洗衣服务处获得书面豁免

options.en: Pre-clean all clothing with a HEPA vacuum before transport
options.cn: 运输前使用 HEPA 真空吸尘器预先清洁所有服装

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §5208(h)(3)(E) and (F), the employer must inform the laundering service of the requirement to prevent release of airborne fibers above the PEL and of the potentially harmful effects of asbestos exposure.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §5208(h)(3)(E) 和 (F)，雇主必须通知洗衣服务，防止空气中的纤维浓度超过允许暴露限值（PEL）的要求，以及石棉暴露的潜在有害影响。

question_en: A general industry employer establishes a written compliance program to reduce asbestos exposures. Who has the right to request and receive a copy of that written program?
question_cn: 一般行业雇主制定书面合规计划以降低石棉暴露。谁有权请求并获得该书面计划的副本？

options.en: Any member of the public who submits a written request
options.cn: 任何提交书面请求的公众成员

options.en: Only certified industrial hygienists retained by the employer
options.cn: 仅由雇主聘请的认证工业卫生师

options.en: Only the Chief of Cal/OSHA upon formal written demand
options.cn: 仅加州职业安全与健康局局长在正式书面要求下

options.en: The Chief, affected employees, and designated employee representatives
options.cn: 局长、受影响的员工及指定的员工代表

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §5208(f)(2)(C), written compliance programs must be submitted upon request for examination and copying to the Chief, the Director, affected employees, and designated employee representatives.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §5208(f)(2)(C)，书面合规计划必须在请求时提交，以供局长、主管、受影响员工及指定员工代表检查和复印。

question_en: Under California's asbestos standard, how long must an employer retain employee medical surveillance records for workers exposed to asbestos at or above the TWA?
question_cn: 根据加州石棉标准，雇主必须保存接触达到或超过TWA的工人的医疗监测记录多长时间？

options.en: For the duration of employment only
options.cn: 仅在雇佣期间

options.en: For 10 years beyond the last date of employment
options.cn: 离职日期后10年

options.en: For 1 year beyond the last date of employment
options.cn: 离职日期后1年

options.en: For the duration of employment plus 30 years
options.cn: 雇佣期间加30年

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §5208(m)(3)(C), asbestos medical surveillance records must be maintained for the duration of employment plus 30 years in accordance with Section 3204.
explanation_cn: 根据8 CCR §5208(m)(3)(C)，石棉医疗监测记录必须按照第3204条的规定保存至雇佣期间加30年。

question_en: A housekeeping employee regularly cleans a facility where asbestos-containing material (ACM) is present. Under Cal/OSHA regulations, how often must this employee receive asbestos awareness training?
question_cn: 一名清洁员工定期打扫含石棉材料（ACM）的设施。根据加州职业安全与健康管理局（Cal/OSHA）规定，该员工多久必须接受一次石棉意识培训？

options.en: Every 6 months for high-exposure environments
options.cn: 高暴露环境每6个月一次

options.en: Every 3 years, per the medical surveillance schedule
options.cn: 根据医疗监测计划每3年一次

options.en: Once, at the time of initial assignment only
options.cn: 仅在初次分配时进行一次

options.en: At least once every year
options.cn: 每年至少一次

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §5208(j)(7)(D), employers must provide asbestos awareness training to housekeeping employees in areas containing ACM or PACM at least once annually.
explanation_cn: 根据8 CCR §5208(j)(7)(D)，雇主必须至少每年为在含ACM或可能含ACM（PACM）区域工作的清洁员工提供一次石棉意识培训。

question_en: A contractor discovers that an employee's asbestos exposure monitoring record does not include the employee's social security number. Which additional required element is the contractor MOST likely also missing from this record?
question_cn: 一名承包商发现，某员工的石棉暴露监测记录中未包含该员工的社会安全号码。承包商最可能还缺少该记录中的哪个额外必需内容？

options.en: The employee's training completion certificate
options.cn: 员工的培训完成证书

options.en: The employee's pre-placement medical questionnaire
options.cn: 员工的入职前健康问卷

options.en: The type of respiratory protective device worn
options.cn: 所佩戴的呼吸防护装置类型

options.en: The physician's written opinion for that employee
options.cn: 该员工的医生书面意见

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §5208(m)(1)(B), exposure monitoring records must include the employee's name, social security number, type of respiratory protection worn, sampling methods, and results. Both elements are mandatory.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §5208(m)(1)(B)，暴露监测记录必须包括员工姓名、社会安全号码、所佩戴的呼吸防护类型、采样方法以及结果。这两个元素都是强制性的。

question_en: After receiving a physician's written opinion from the asbestos medical examination, within how many days must the employer provide a copy to the affected employee?
question_cn: 在收到石棉体检医生书面意见后，雇主必须在多少天内将副本提供给受影响的员工？

options.en: Within 90 days of the examination date
options.cn: 体检日期起 90 天内

options.en: Within 30 days of its receipt
options.cn: 收到后 30 天内

options.en: Within 7 days of receipt
options.cn: 收到后 7 天内

options.en: Within 45 working days of receipt
options.cn: 收到后 45 个工作日内

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §5208(l)(7)(C), the employer must provide a copy of the physician's written opinion to the affected employee within 30 days from its receipt.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §5208(l)(7)(C)，雇主必须在收到医生书面意见后 30 天内将副本提供给受影响的员工。

question_en: A contractor plans to dispose of clothing and equipment contaminated with asbestos from a demolition project. What does Cal/OSHA require for proper disposal?
question_cn: 承包商计划处理因拆除项目而被石棉污染的衣物和设备。加州职业安全与健康管理局（Cal/OSHA）对正确处理有哪些要求？

options.en: Label containers and leave unsealed for inspection
options.cn: 给容器贴标签并保持未封口以供检查

options.en: Dry sweep the area and bag loose material separately
options.cn: 干扫区域并将松散材料单独装袋

options.en: Use compressed air to clear debris before bagging
options.cn: 使用压缩空气清理碎片后再装袋

options.en: Seal items in impermeable bags or closed containers
options.cn: 将物品密封在不透水的袋子或封闭容器中

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §5208(k)(6), waste, debris, equipment, and clothing contaminated with asbestos must be collected and disposed of in sealed impermeable bags or other closed, impermeable containers.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州法规汇编》第8章 §5208(k)(6)，被石棉污染的废物、碎片、设备和衣物必须收集并装入密封的不透水袋或其他封闭的不透水容器中处置。

question_en: A superintendent discovers that asbestos-containing flooring needs refinishing. Which of the following practices is expressly PROHIBITED by Cal/OSHA?
question_cn: 一名主管发现含石棉的地板需要重新整理。根据加州职业安全与健康管理局（Cal/OSHA），以下哪种做法是明确禁止的？

options.en: Stripping finishes using wet methods at low speed
options.cn: 使用低速湿法去除地板表面涂层

options.en: Wet mopping to clean up surrounding debris
options.cn: 用湿拖把清理周围的碎屑

options.en: Sanding the asbestos-containing floor material
options.cn: 打磨含石棉的地板材料

options.en: Burnishing with sufficient finish protecting the material
options.cn: 抛光并使用足够的涂层保护材料

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §5208(k)(7)(A), sanding of asbestos-containing floor material is expressly prohibited because it releases asbestos fibers into the air.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §5208(k)(7)(A)，打磨含石棉的地板材料是明确禁止的，因为这样会释放石棉纤维到空气中。

question_en: An employee requests access to their own asbestos medical surveillance records. Under Cal/OSHA, who is authorized to access those records?
question_cn: 一名员工请求访问自己的石棉医疗监测记录。根据加州职业安全与健康条例（Cal/OSHA），谁有权访问这些记录？

options.en: Only the examining physician and the employer
options.cn: 只有检查医生和雇主

options.en: Any coworker who can demonstrate a safety need
options.cn: 任何能够证明有安全需要的同事

options.en: The employee, the Chief, and authorized representatives
options.cn: 员工、主管及授权代表

options.en: Only the Cal/OSHA Chief upon written request
options.cn: 只有在书面请求下的 Cal/OSHA 主管

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §5208(m)(5)(C), medical records are accessible to the subject employee, anyone with that employee's specific written consent, and the Cal/OSHA Chief.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §5208(m)(5)(C)，医疗记录可供当事员工、本员工明确书面同意的任何人，以及 Cal/OSHA 主管访问。

question_en: A contractor ceases operations and has no successor employer. When must the contractor notify the Director before disposing of asbestos records?
question_cn: 如果承包商停止运营且没有继任雇主，承包商在处置石棉记录之前必须什么时候通知主管？

options.en: At least 30 days before disposal of records
options.cn: 至少在处置记录前 30 天

options.en: At least 90 days before disposal of records
options.cn: 至少在处置记录前 90 天

options.en: At least 1 year before disposal of records
options.cn: 至少在处置记录前 1 年

options.en: At least 180 days before disposal of records
options.cn: 至少在处置记录前 180 天

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §5208(m)(6)(B), when a business ceases with no successor, the employer must notify the Director at least 90 days prior to disposing of records and must transmit them to the Director upon request.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §5208(m)(6)(B)，当企业停止运营且没有继任者时，雇主必须在处置记录前至少 90 天通知主管，并且在主管要求时将记录传送给主管。

question_en: During a termination of employment, a Cal/OSHA-covered employee was last exposed to airborne asbestos above the TWA. When must the employer make the termination medical examination available?
question_cn: 在雇佣终止期间，一名受加州职业安全健康管理局（Cal/OSHA）覆盖的员工最后一次暴露于空气中石棉水平超过TWA。雇主必须在何时提供终止体检？

options.en: Within 30 calendar days before or after termination
options.cn: 雇佣终止前或后30个日历日内

options.en: Within 90 days of the last documented exposure
options.cn: 在最后一次记录的暴露后90天内

options.en: Within 1 year of the employee's last workday
options.cn: 员工最后工作日一年内

options.en: Within 45 working days after the final day of employment
options.cn: 雇佣终止的最后一天后45个工作日内

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §5208(l)(4)(B), the termination medical examination must be provided within 30 calendar days before or after the date of termination of employment.
explanation_cn: 根据8 CCR §5208(l)(4)(B)，终止体检必须在雇佣终止日期前或后30个日历日内提供。

question_en: A building owner wants to prove that presumed asbestos-containing material (PACM) on the jobsite does not actually contain asbestos. Who must collect and evaluate the bulk samples used for this determination?
question_cn: 建筑物所有者希望证明工地上假定含石棉材料（PACM）实际上不含石棉。谁必须收集和评估用于此判定的散装样品？

options.en: Cal/OSHA compliance officers assigned to the site
options.cn: 分配到现场的加州职业安全与卫生管理局（Cal/OSHA）合规官员

options.en: A licensed contractor with an asbestos removal certification
options.cn: 拥有石棉拆除认证的持证承包商

options.en: Any trained employee designated by the building owner
options.cn: 由建筑物所有者指定的任何受过培训的员工

options.en: An accredited inspector or a Certified Industrial Hygienist
options.cn: 获认证的检查员或注册工业卫生师（CIH）

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §5208(j)(8)(B), bulk sample tests to rebut PACM designation must be conducted by an accredited inspector or a CIH, with analysis by NVLAP or equivalent accredited laboratories.
explanation_cn: 根据8 CCR §5208(j)(8)(B)，用于推翻PACM指定的散装样品测试必须由获认证的检查员或CIH进行，并由NVLAP或同等认证实验室进行分析。

question_en: An employer's asbestos training program is conducted in English, but several workers only speak Spanish. Which Cal/OSHA requirement has the employer most likely violated?
question_cn: 雇主的石棉培训项目以英语进行，但有几个工人只讲西班牙语。雇主最有可能违反了哪项加州职业安全与健康管理局（Cal/OSHA）要求？

options.en: Failing to distribute the NIH smoking cessation materials
options.cn: 未能分发 NIH 戒烟材料

options.en: Conducting training in a manner employees cannot understand
options.cn: 以员工无法理解的方式进行培训

options.en: Failing to post required asbestos warning signs in two languages
options.cn: 未能以两种语言张贴所需的石棉警告标志

options.en: Not providing training at least every 6 months
options.cn: 未能至少每 6 个月提供一次培训

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §5208(j)(7)(C), the training program must be conducted in a manner the employee is able to understand. Providing English-only training to Spanish-only speakers violates this requirement.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §5208(j)(7)(C)，培训项目必须以员工能够理解的方式进行。仅向只讲西班牙语的员工提供英语培训违反了此要求。

question_en: For an employee newly assigned to work with asbestos exposure above the TWA, when must the employer obtain the physician's opinion regarding the employee's fitness to use respiratory protective equipment?
question_cn: 对于新分配到接触石棉浓度高于TWA工作的员工，雇主必须在何时获得医生关于员工使用呼吸防护设备适应能力的意见？

options.en: Annually, at the same time as the periodic exam
options.cn: 每年一次，与定期体检同时进行

options.en: Within 30 calendar days of assignment to the job
options.cn: 在分配到该岗位后的30个日历天内

options.en: Before the employee begins any work requiring respirators
options.cn: 在员工开始任何需要呼吸器的工作之前

options.en: Within 45 working days of the assignment start date
options.cn: 在分配开始日期后的45个工作日内

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §5208(l)(2)(B), the employer must obtain the physician's opinion on PPE and respirator use before the employee is assigned to any job requiring such equipment.
explanation_cn: 根据8 CCR §5208(l)(2)(B)，雇主必须在员工被分配到任何需要此类设备的岗位之前，获得医生关于个人防护装备和呼吸器使用的意见。

question_en: A Cal/OSHA inspector requests all records related to an employer's asbestos employee training program. How long must the employer have retained those training records to be in compliance?
question_cn: 一名加利福尼亚职业安全与健康局（Cal/OSHA）检查员要求提供与雇主石棉员工培训计划相关的所有记录。为了遵守规定，雇主必须保留这些培训记录多长时间？

options.en: For 3 years following the training session date
options.cn: 自培训课程日期起3年

options.en: 30 years beyond the employee's last date of employment
options.cn: 员工最后工作日期起30年

options.en: For 1 year beyond the last date of employment
options.cn: 超过员工最后工作日期1年

options.en: For the duration of employment only
options.cn: 仅在雇佣期间保留

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §5208(m)(4), employee asbestos training records must be maintained for one year beyond the last date of employment of that employee.
explanation_cn: 根据8 CCR §5208(m)(4)，员工石棉培训记录必须保留至该员工离职日期之后一年。

question_en: A contractor is performing lead-related work on a renovation project where lead-containing materials are present. Under Cal/OSHA, which of the following tasks is covered by the construction lead standard?
question_cn: 一位承包商正在进行一个装修项目中涉及铅的工作，该项目中存在含铅材料。根据加州职业安全与健康管理局（Cal/OSHA）的规定，下列哪些任务受到建筑铅标准的约束？

options.en: Office administration work at a lead-remediation project site
options.cn: 在铅清理项目现场进行办公室管理工作

options.en: Demolition of structures where lead materials are present
options.cn: 拆除存在铅材料的结构

options.en: Retail sale and warehousing of products containing lead
options.cn: 含铅产品的零售销售和仓储

options.en: Transportation of sealed lead products between job sites
options.cn: 在工作现场之间运输密封的含铅产品

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §1532.1(a)(1), demolition or salvage of structures where lead or lead-containing materials are present is explicitly listed as covered construction work under the lead standard.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州法规典》第8卷 §1532.1(a)(1)，拆除或回收存在铅或含铅材料的结构被明确列为铅标准涵盖的建筑工作。

question_en: A contractor's asbestos training program covers health effects but omits the relationship between smoking and asbestos exposure. Which specific required training element has been left out?
question_cn: 承包商的石棉培训计划涵盖了健康影响，但未涉及吸烟与石棉暴露之间的关系。缺少了具体哪一项必修培训内容？

options.en: The relationship between smoking and asbestos-related lung cancer
options.cn: 吸烟与石棉相关肺癌之间的关系

options.en: The content of the standard and its appendices
options.cn: 标准及其附录的内容

options.en: The purpose and description of air monitoring
options.cn: 空气监测的目的和说明

options.en: The location and availability of smoking cessation programs
options.cn: 戒烟项目的位置和可获取性

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §5208(j)(7)(C)2, training must inform employees of the relationship between smoking and asbestos exposure in producing lung cancer. Omitting this element violates the regulation.
explanation_cn: 根据8 CCR §5208(j)(7)(C)2，培训必须告知员工吸烟与石棉暴露在导致肺癌中的关系。省略此内容违反了规定。

question_en: A contractor begins demolition of drywall on a structure known to contain lead-based paint. No exposure assessment has been completed yet. Under California lead regulations, how must the employer treat these workers?
question_cn: 承包商开始拆除已知含有含铅油漆的建筑物上的石膏板。尚未完成暴露评估。根据加利福尼亚州的铅法规，雇主必须如何对待这些工人？

options.en: As if exposed below the PEL until monitoring data proves otherwise
options.cn: 在监测数据证明相反之前，视为低于PEL的暴露

options.en: As if exposed above the PEL, but not over 10 times the PEL
options.cn: 视为超过PEL的暴露，但不超过PEL的10倍

options.en: As if exposed above 50 times the PEL, matching Level 3 requirements
options.cn: 视为超过PEL的50倍暴露，符合三级要求

options.en: As if exposed above 100 times the PEL, requiring maximum protection
options.cn: 视为超过PEL的100倍暴露，需要最大防护

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1532.1(d)(2)(A) classifies manual demolition of structures with lead-containing paint as a Level 1 trigger task. Until an exposure assessment is completed, the employer must treat workers as exposed above the PEL but not exceeding 10 times the PEL, and must implement interim protection.
explanation_cn: 《8 CCR §1532.1(d)(2)(A)》将含铅油漆建筑的手工拆除列为一级触发任务。在完成暴露评估之前，雇主必须将工人视为暴露超过PEL但不超过PEL的10倍，并必须实施临时防护。

question_en: An employee is performing abrasive blasting on a surface containing lead paint, and no exposure assessment has been completed. Under Cal/OSHA lead standards, which interim protection is required specifically for this Level 3 trigger task that is NOT required for Level 1 trigger tasks?
question_cn: 一名员工正在对含铅油漆的表面进行磨料喷砂作业，并且未进行任何暴露评估。根据加州职业安全健康管理局（Cal/OSHA）的铅标准，对于此三级触发任务，需要哪些临时防护措施，而这些措施对于一级触发任务则不要求？

options.en: Providing workers with appropriate PPE clothing and equipment
options.cn: 为工人提供适当的个人防护服和设备

options.en: Providing adequate respiratory protection for all employees
options.cn: 为所有员工提供适当的呼吸防护

options.en: Providing shower facilities at the end of the work shift
options.cn: 在工作班次结束时提供淋浴设施

options.en: Providing access to regulated areas for the work activity
options.cn: 为工作活动提供受管制区域的通道

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1532.1(d)(2)(E)(4) specifies that shower facilities are required as interim protection specifically for employees performing Level 3 trigger tasks. This requirement does not apply to Level 1 or Level 2 tasks as an interim measure.
explanation_cn: 8 CCR §1532.1(d)(2)(E)(4) 明确规定，淋浴设施作为临时防护措施，专门要求从事三级触发任务的员工使用。此项要求作为临时措施不适用于一级或二级任务。

question_en: A contractor's air monitoring results show an employee's lead exposure is 35 µg/m³ as an 8-hour TWA. Under Cal/OSHA regulations, how often must the employer conduct follow-up air monitoring?
question_cn: 承包商的空气监测结果显示，一名员工的铅暴露量为 35 µg/m³（作为 8 小时 TWA）。根据加州职业安全与健康管理局（Cal/OSHA）法规，雇主需要多久进行一次后续空气监测？

options.en: Every 6 months until two results consecutively drop below 30 µg/m³
options.cn: 每 6 个月一次，直到连续两次结果低于 30 µg/m³

options.en: No further monitoring is required at this exposure level
options.cn: 在此暴露水平下无需进一步监测

options.en: At least every 3 months on a quarterly schedule
options.cn: 至少每 3 个月一次，按季度进行

options.en: At least every 12 months as a standard annual requirement
options.cn: 至少每 12 个月一次，作为年度标准要求

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1532.1(d)(6)(C) requires monitoring at least every 6 months when employee exposure is at or above 30 µg/m³ but at or below 50 µg/m³ as an 8-hour TWA. Monitoring continues until two consecutive readings taken at least 7 days apart fall below 30 µg/m³.
explanation_cn: 8 CCR §1532.1(d)(6)(C) 要求，当员工暴露量在 30 µg/m³ 或更高，但不超过 50 µg/m³（作为 8 小时 TWA）时，至少每 6 个月进行一次监测。监测将持续，直到连续两次间隔至少 7 天的读数低于 30 µg/m³。

question_en: After completing a lead exposure assessment, within how many working days must an employer notify each employee in writing of their individual exposure results?
question_cn: 在完成铅暴露评估后，雇主必须在多少个工作日内以书面形式通知每位员工其个人暴露结果？

options.en: Within 30 calendar days of completing the assessment
options.cn: 在完成评估后的30个日历日内

options.en: Within 10 working days of completing the assessment
options.cn: 在完成评估后的10个工作日内

options.en: Within 3 working days of completing the assessment
options.cn: 在完成评估后的3个工作日内

options.en: Within 5 working days of completing the assessment
options.cn: 在完成评估后的5个工作日内

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1532.1(d)(8)(A) requires the employer to notify each employee in writing of their exposure results within 5 working days after completion of the exposure assessment.
explanation_cn: 8 CCR §1532.1(d)(8)(A) 要求雇主在完成暴露评估后的5个工作日内以书面形式通知每位员工其暴露结果。

question_en: A contractor uses job rotation to manage employees' lead exposure. What specific documentation must be included in the written job rotation schedule?
question_cn: 承包商使用工作轮换来管理员工的铅暴露。书面工作轮换计划必须包含哪些具体文档？

options.en: Medical clearance records for each rotated employee
options.cn: 每位轮换员工的体检记录

options.en: Employee wage rates and union classification for each rotated worker
options.cn: 每位轮换工人的工资和工会分类

options.en: A supervisor's signature and OSHA inspector approval for the schedule
options.cn: 计划的主管签名和 OSHA 检查员批准

options.en: Each employee's name, duration at each station, and exposure levels
options.cn: 每位员工的姓名、在每个工作岗位的持续时间以及暴露水平

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1532.1(e)(4) requires the written job rotation schedule to include each affected employee's name and unique identifier, duration and exposure levels at each job or workstation, and any other information useful in assessing the reliability of administrative controls.
explanation_cn: 《加州行政法规》第 8 编 §1532.1(e)(4) 要求书面工作轮换计划包括每位受影响员工的姓名和唯一标识符、在每个工作岗位的持续时间和暴露水平，以及任何有助于评估管理控制可靠性的其他信息。

question_en: A worker's lead exposure monitoring results show 60 µg/m³ as an 8-hour TWA. Which of the following hygiene facility requirements is triggered at this specific exposure level?
question_cn: 一名工人的铅暴露监测结果显示 8 小时 TWA 为 60 µg/m³。在这个特定的暴露水平下，会触发以下哪项卫生设施要求？

options.en: Shower facilities for use at the end of each work shift
options.cn: 每个工作班次结束时使用的淋浴设施

options.en: Change areas with separate storage for work and street clothing
options.cn: 具有工作服和街服分别储存的更衣区

options.en: Eating areas only, with no additional hygiene facilities required
options.cn: 仅限用餐区，不需要额外的卫生设施

options.en: Handwashing facilities only, consistent with general hygiene rules
options.cn: 仅限洗手设施，符合一般卫生规则

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1532.1(i)(3)(A) requires the employer to provide shower facilities when airborne lead exposure exceeds 50 µg/m³, without regard to respirator use. At 60 µg/m³, this threshold is exceeded and end-of-shift showering is required.
explanation_cn: 8 CCR §1532.1(i)(3)(A) 要求，当空气中铅暴露超过 50 µg/m³ 时，雇主必须提供淋浴设施，无论是否使用呼吸防护。在 60 µg/m³ 时，该阈值已超过，因此需要在班次结束时淋浴。

question_en: An employee working in a lead-regulated area finishes a shift and is ready to leave. According to Cal/OSHA lead regulations, where must the employee remove their protective clothing?
question_cn: 在受铅监管区域工作的员工在完成班次并准备离开时，根据加利福尼亚州职业安全与健康管理局（Cal/OSHA）的铅法规，员工必须在哪里脱下防护服？

options.en: In the employee's personal vehicle before driving home
options.cn: 在员工的私家车里，下班回家前

options.en: At the entrance of the general worksite before leaving
options.cn: 在离开前工地的一般入口处

options.en: Only in the change area provided for that purpose
options.cn: 只能在为此目的提供的更衣区内

options.en: Anywhere on the jobsite that is away from other workers
options.cn: 在远离其他工人的工地任何地方

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1532.1(g)(2)(D) requires that all protective clothing be removed at the completion of a work shift only in change areas provided for that purpose. This prevents spreading lead contamination beyond the regulated area.
explanation_cn: 《加利福尼亚法规汇编》第8卷 §1532.1(g)(2)(D) 要求，所有防护服在工作班次结束时必须仅在为此提供的更衣区脱下。这可防止铅污染扩散到受监管区域之外。

question_en: A contractor is cleaning a work area after lead abatement operations. Which of the following cleaning methods is prohibited under Cal/OSHA lead standards unless other effective methods have been tried and found ineffective?
question_cn: 承包商正在铅清除作业后清理工作区域。根据加州职业安全与健康标准（Cal/OSHA）关于铅的规定，除非已尝试其他有效的方法并证明无效，下列哪种清洁方法是被禁止的？

options.en: Dry sweeping or brushing accumulations of lead dust
options.cn: 干扫或刷去积聚的铅尘

options.en: Using a HEPA vacuum with disposable filter bags
options.cn: 使用带一次性过滤袋的 HEPA 吸尘器

options.en: Wet mopping lead-contaminated surfaces with water
options.cn: 用水湿抹含铅污染的表面

options.en: HEPA vacuuming the floor and horizontal surfaces
options.cn: 用 HEPA 吸尘器清洁地面和水平表面

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1532.1(h)(3) prohibits shoveling, dry or wet sweeping, and brushing unless the employer demonstrates that vacuuming or equally effective methods have been tried and found ineffective. Dry sweeping disperses lead into the air.
explanation_cn: 8 CCR §1532.1(h)(3) 禁止用铲子、干扫、湿扫和刷子，除非雇主能够证明已尝试吸尘或同样有效的方法且无效。干扫会将铅粉尘散布到空气中。

question_en: An employer's written lead compliance program must be revised and updated at what minimum frequency to reflect current program status?
question_cn: 雇主的书面铅合规计划必须以何种最低频率进行修订和更新，以反映当前的计划状态？

options.en: At least every 12 months as part of annual program review
options.cn: 至少每12个月作为年度计划审查的一部分

options.en: At least every 6 months with documented written revisions
options.cn: 至少每6个月进行书面修订并记录在案

options.en: At least every 3 months during active lead work
options.cn: 在进行活跃的铅作业期间至少每3个月更新一次

options.en: Only when Cal/OSHA requests a review of the program
options.cn: 仅在加州职业安全与健康管理局（Cal/OSHA）要求审查计划时

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1532.1(e)(2)(E) requires that written lead compliance programs be revised and updated at least every 6 months to reflect current program status, and all revisions must be documented in writing.
explanation_cn: 8 CCR §1532.1(e)(2)(E) 要求书面铅合规计划至少每6个月修订和更新一次，以反映当前计划状态，且所有修订必须以书面形式记录。

question_en: Before allowing an employee to perform lead-related trigger tasks, an employer must ensure that initial blood lead testing is made available. Which circumstance creates an exception that eliminates this requirement?
question_cn: 在允许员工执行与铅相关的触发性任务之前，雇主必须确保提供初始血铅检测。哪种情况会创造一个例外，从而免除此要求？

options.en: The employee is an experienced worker with more than five years in the trade
options.cn: 员工是具有五年以上工龄的经验工人

options.en: The employer holds objective data showing exposure is below 600 ppm
options.cn: 雇主持有显示暴露低于600 ppm的客观数据

options.en: The employer has provided the employee with respiratory protection
options.cn: 雇主已为员工提供呼吸防护

options.en: The employee has had a blood lead test within the preceding two months
options.cn: 员工在前两个月内已经进行过血铅检测

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1532.1(j)(1)(A) Exception 3 states that initial blood lead testing is not required for an employee who has already had a blood lead test within the preceding two months. This prevents redundant testing when recent data already exists.
explanation_cn: 8 CCR §1532.1(j)(1)(A) 例外3规定，对于在前两个月内已经进行过血铅检测的员工，不需要进行初始血铅检测。这可以在已有近期数据时防止重复检测。

question_en: A contractor is performing torch cutting on steel coated with lead-based paint. No exposure assessment has been done. Under California lead regulations, what is the maximum airborne concentration the employer must presume the employee is exposed to for interim protection purposes?
question_cn: 一名承包商正在对涂有含铅油漆的钢材进行火焰切割。尚未进行暴露评估。根据加利福尼亚州的铅法规，为了临时保护目的，雇主必须假定员工暴露的空气中铅浓度的最高值是多少？

options.en: Above 10 µg/m³, matching the standard PEL for lead
options.cn: 高于 10 µg/m³，与铅的标准允许暴露极限 (PEL) 一致

options.en: Above 50 µg/m³, which triggers the shower facility requirement
options.cn: 高于 50 µg/m³，会触发淋浴设施要求

options.en: Above 100 µg/m³, consistent with Level 2 trigger task requirements
options.cn: 高于 100 µg/m³，与二级触发任务要求一致

options.en: Above 500 µg/m³, consistent with Level 3 trigger task requirements
options.cn: 高于 500 µg/m³，与三级触发任务要求一致

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1532.1(d)(2)(D) classifies torch cutting as a Level 3 trigger task. Until an exposure assessment is completed, the employer must presume exposure above 500 µg/m³ (50 times the PEL) and implement all corresponding interim protections.
explanation_cn: 8 CCR §1532.1(d)(2)(D) 将火焰切割归类为三级触发任务。在完成暴露评估之前，雇主必须假定暴露高于 500 µg/m³（PEL 的 50 倍），并实施所有相应的临时防护措施。

question_en: An employer wants to rely on previous lead air monitoring data from 14 months ago to satisfy initial monitoring requirements. Under Cal/OSHA lead standards, is this permissible?
question_cn: 雇主想依赖 14 个月前的铅空气监测数据来满足初始监测要求。在加州职业安全与健康管理局（Cal/OSHA）的铅标准下，这是允许的吗？

options.en: No, prior monitoring data can never substitute for new measurements
options.cn: 不可以，先前的监测数据绝不能替代新的测量

options.en: No, because the data is older than the 12-month allowable window
options.cn: 不可以，因为数据超过了 12 个月的允许时间窗口

options.en: Yes, previous monitoring data is always acceptable regardless of age
options.cn: 可以，以前的监测数据总是可以接受，无论其年龄如何

options.en: Yes, if working conditions are similar and methods meet accuracy standards
options.cn: 可以，如果工作条件相似且方法符合准确性标准

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1532.1(d)(3)(C) allows employers to rely on previous monitoring data only if it was obtained within the past 12 months under closely similar workplace conditions. Data from 14 months ago exceeds this limit and new monitoring is required.
explanation_cn: 8 CCR §1532.1(d)(3)(C) 允许雇主仅在过去 12 个月内在高度相似的工作场所条件下获得的数据可作为参考。14 个月前的数据超出了此限制，因此需要进行新的监测。

question_en: An employer provides clean protective clothing to employees working with lead. At what minimum frequency must clean clothing be provided to an employee whose lead exposure without a respirator exceeds 30 µg/m³ as an 8-hour TWA?
question_cn: 雇主为接触铅的员工提供清洁的防护服。当员工在不使用呼吸器的情况下的铅暴露量超过 8 小时 TWA 为 30 µg/m³ 时，必须以最低频率向其提供清洁的防护服？

options.en: At least daily due to the elevated exposure level
options.cn: 由于暴露水平升高，至少每天提供

options.en: At least once per week regardless of exposure level
options.cn: 无论暴露水平如何，至少每周一次

options.en: At the beginning of each new project or assignment
options.cn: 每个新项目或任务开始时提供

options.en: At least twice per week for highly exposed employees
options.cn: 对于高暴露员工，至少每周两次

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1532.1(g)(2)(A) requires the employer to provide clean and dry protective clothing at least weekly in general, but daily to employees whose lead exposure without a respirator exceeds 30 µg/m³ as an 8-hour TWA.
explanation_cn: 8 CCR §1532.1(g)(2)(A) 要求雇主通常至少每周提供一次清洁干净的防护服，但对于不使用呼吸器的情况下铅暴露超过 8 小时 TWA 30 µg/m³ 的员工，则必须每天提供。

question_en: A contractor uses compressed air to clean lead dust from a work surface. Under Cal/OSHA lead housekeeping regulations, under what condition is this practice permitted?
question_cn: 承包商使用压缩空气清理工作表面的铅尘。在加州职业安全与健康管理局（Cal/OSHA）关于铅清洁的规定下，在哪种情况下允许这种做法？

options.en: Only after HEPA vacuuming has been attempted and found ineffective
options.cn: 仅在尝试HEPA吸尘器且发现无效后

options.en: Only outdoors where natural ventilation disperses the lead dust
options.cn: 仅在室外，天然通风可以分散铅尘

options.en: Only when employees in the area are wearing full-face respirators
options.cn: 仅在区域内的员工佩戴全脸呼吸器时

options.en: Only when used with a ventilation system designed to capture airborne dust
options.cn: 仅当与设计用于捕捉空中尘埃的通风系统一起使用时

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1532.1(h)(5) prohibits using compressed air to remove lead from surfaces unless it is used in conjunction with a ventilation system specifically designed to capture the airborne dust created by the compressed air.
explanation_cn: 8 CCR §1532.1(h)(5) 禁止使用压缩空气从表面清除铅粉，除非与专门设计用来捕捉压缩空气产生的空气中尘埃的通风系统一起使用。

question_en: An employee's blood lead test result comes back at 25 µg/dl. Within how many working days must the employer notify the employee in writing of this result?
question_cn: 一名员工的血铅测试结果为 25 µg/dl。雇主必须在多少个工作日内以书面形式通知员工这一结果？

options.en: Within ten working days of receiving results
options.cn: 在收到结果后十个工作日内

options.en: Within three working days of receiving results
options.cn: 在收到结果后三个工作日内

options.en: Within thirty calendar days of receiving results
options.cn: 在收到结果后三十个日历日内

options.en: Within five working days of receiving results
options.cn: 在收到结果后五个工作日内

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1532.1(j)(2)(C) requires the employer to notify each employee in writing within five working days after receipt of blood lead test results, including the employee's blood lead level and applicable medical removal thresholds.
explanation_cn: 8 CCR §1532.1(j)(2)(C) 要求雇主在收到血铅测试结果后五个工作日内以书面形式通知每位员工，包括员工的血铅水平和适用的医学移除阈值。

question_en: A worker's blood lead level tests at 32 µg/dl. Under California's lead standard, what action is the employer required to take?
question_cn: 一名工人的血铅水平测试为 32 µg/dl。根据加利福尼亚州的铅标准，雇主需要采取什么措施？

options.en: Temporarily remove the employee from all lead-exposed work
options.cn: 暂时将员工从所有暴露于铅的工作中调离

options.en: Increase respiratory protection and continue lead work
options.cn: 提高呼吸防护并继续进行铅相关工作

options.en: Refer the employee to a PLHCP and await evaluation results
options.cn: 将员工转介给职业医护提供者 (PLHCP) 并等待评估结果

options.en: Issue a written elevated blood lead level response plan only
options.cn: 仅发布书面的血铅升高应对计划

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1532.1(k)(1)(A) mandates that the employer remove an employee from work with lead exposure at or above the action level whenever the last blood lead test is at or above 30 µg/dl.
explanation_cn: 8 CCR §1532.1(k)(1)(A) 要求雇主在最近的血铅测试结果达到或超过 30 µg/dl 时，将员工从暴露于铅的工作中调离。

question_en: An employee who was medically removed due to an elevated blood lead level wants to return to their former position. What is the minimum requirement before the employer must reinstate them?
question_cn: 一名因血铅水平升高而被医疗撤职的员工希望返回原来的职位。在雇主必须恢复其职位之前，最低要求是什么？

options.en: A physician's written clearance letter without blood testing
options.cn: 医生书面许可信，无需血液检测

options.en: Two consecutive tests below 20 µg/dl, at least 14 days apart
options.cn: 两次连续血液测试低于 20 µg/dl，至少相隔 14 天

options.en: One blood lead test below 20 µg/dl taken at any time
options.cn: 任意时间进行的一次血铅测试低于 20 µg/dl

options.en: Two consecutive tests below 15 µg/dl, at least 30 days apart
options.cn: 两次连续血液测试低于 15 µg/dl，至少相隔 30 天

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1532.1(k)(1)(C) requires that an employee removed for elevated blood lead levels must have two consecutive blood lead tests, each below 15 µg/dl and taken at least 30 days apart, before the employer is required to return them to their former job status.
explanation_cn: 8 CCR §1532.1(k)(1)(C) 要求，被因血铅水平升高而撤职的员工，必须进行两次连续血铅测试，每次血铅水平低于 15 µg/dl 且至少相隔 30 天，然后雇主才必须将其恢复到原来的职位。

question_en: How long may an employer be required to provide Medical Removal Protection benefits to an employee removed from lead-exposed work?
question_cn: 雇主可能需要为从铅暴露工作岗位上被调离的员工提供医疗调离保护福利多久？

options.en: Up to twelve months per removal occasion
options.cn: 每次调离最多十二个月

options.en: Up to eighteen months per removal occasion
options.cn: 每次调离最多十八个月

options.en: Indefinitely, until the employee returns to work
options.cn: 无限期，直到员工返回工作岗位

options.en: Up to six months per removal occasion
options.cn: 每次调离最多六个月

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1532.1(k)(2)(A) states that the employer shall provide an employee up to eighteen months of medical removal protection benefits on each occasion the employee is removed from lead exposure or otherwise limited pursuant to the standard.
explanation_cn: 8 CCR §1532.1(k)(2)(A) 规定，雇主应在每次员工因铅暴露或按照标准受到限制而被调离时，为其提供最多十八个月的医疗调离保护福利。

question_en: An employer voluntarily removes an employee from lead work, even though the employee's blood lead level has not yet reached the mandatory removal threshold. What benefit must the employer provide?
question_cn: 如果雇主自愿将一名员工从铅工作中移除，即使该员工的血铅水平尚未达到强制移除的门槛，雇主必须提供什么福利？

options.en: Medical monitoring only, with no earnings protection
options.cn: 仅提供健康监测，不提供收入保障

options.en: No benefits are required for voluntary removals
options.cn: 自愿移除不需要提供任何福利

options.en: Half the normal MRP benefits, prorated for voluntary removal
options.cn: 提供正常MRP福利的一半，按自愿移除比例计算

options.en: The same MRP benefits as a mandatory removal situation
options.cn: 提供与强制移除情况相同的MRP福利

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1532.1(k)(2)(F) requires that when an employer voluntarily removes an employee due to lead exposure health effects, the employer must provide MRP benefits equal to those required under subsections (k)(2)(A) and (B), the same as a mandatory removal.
explanation_cn: 8 CCR §1532.1(k)(2)(F) 要求，当雇主由于铅暴露对健康的影响而自愿将员工移除时，雇主必须提供等同于(k)(2)(A)和(B)小节要求的MRP福利，与强制移除相同。

question_en: When must a PLHCP provide each employee with a written medical report following a lead-related medical examination?
question_cn: PLHCP 在进行与铅相关的体检后，必须在何时向每位员工提供书面医疗报告？

options.en: Within 30 days of each medical examination performed
options.cn: 在每次体检后的 30 天内

options.en: Within 45 days of each medical examination performed
options.cn: 在每次体检后的 45 天内

options.en: Within 5 working days of each medical examination performed
options.cn: 在每次体检后的 5 个工作日内

options.en: Within 15 days of each medical examination performed
options.cn: 在每次体检后的 15 天内

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1532.1(j)(3)(E) requires the employer to ensure the PLHCP provides each employee with a written medical report within 30 days of each medical examination performed.
explanation_cn: 8 CCR §1532.1(j)(3)(E) 要求雇主确保 PLHCP 在每次体检后的 30 天内向每位员工提供书面医疗报告。

question_en: An employee disagrees with the initial PLHCP's findings after a lead-related medical examination. Within how many days must the employee notify the employer of their intent to seek a second medical opinion?
question_cn: 员工在一次与铅相关的医疗检查后不同意最初PLHCP的结果。员工必须在多少天内通知雇主其寻求第二医疗意见的意图？

options.en: Within 15 days of notification or initial written opinion
options.cn: 在收到通知或最初书面意见后的15天内

options.en: Within 7 days of receiving the initial PLHCP's written opinion
options.cn: 在收到最初PLHCP的书面意见后的7天内

options.en: Within 30 days of the initial medical examination date only
options.cn: 仅在初次体检日期后的30天内

options.en: Within 5 days of receiving the employer's written notification
options.cn: 在收到雇主书面通知后的5天内

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1532.1(j)(3)(C)2. states the employer may condition participation in the second-opinion process upon the employee notifying the employer of intent and initiating an appointment within fifteen days of the employer's notification or receipt of the initial PLHCP's written opinion, whichever is later.
explanation_cn: 8 CCR §1532.1(j)(3)(C)2.规定，雇主可以将参与第二意见程序的前提条件设为员工在收到雇主通知或收到最初PLHCP书面意见后（以较晚者为准）十五天内通知雇主其意图并开始预约。

question_en: What restriction applies to a PLHCP's written medical opinion submitted to the employer after a lead-related medical examination?
question_cn: 在进行与铅相关的体检后提交给雇主的 PLHCP 书面医学意见中适用什么限制？

options.en: It must only list the employee's blood lead test results
options.cn: 它必须只列出员工的血铅测试结果

options.en: It must be co-signed by a second PLHCP before submission
options.cn: 它在提交前必须由第二名 PLHCP 共同签署

options.en: It must omit findings unrelated to occupational lead exposure
options.cn: 它必须省略与职业性铅暴露无关的发现

options.en: It must include all diagnoses found during the examination
options.cn: 它必须包括在体检中发现的所有诊断

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1532.1(j)(3)(F)2. requires the employer to instruct the PLHCP not to include findings, laboratory results, or diagnoses unrelated to the employee's occupational exposure to lead in the written opinion provided to the employer.
explanation_cn: 8 CCR §1532.1(j)(3)(F)2. 要求雇主指示 PLHCP 在向雇主提供的书面意见中，不包括与员工职业性铅暴露无关的发现、实验室结果或诊断。

question_en: Under the California lead standard, which of the following is PROHIBITED regarding the use of chelating agents on employees?
question_cn: 根据加利福尼亚铅标准，关于在员工身上使用螯合剂，以下哪项是禁止的？

options.en: Therapeutic chelation performed in a clinical setting
options.cn: 在临床环境中进行的治疗性螯合

options.en: Diagnostic chelation ordered by a supervising PLHCP
options.cn: 由主管 PLHCP 下达的诊断性螯合

options.en: Chelation preceded by written notification to the employee
options.cn: 螯合前已书面通知员工

options.en: Prophylactic chelation used as a preventive measure
options.cn: 用作预防措施的预防性螯合

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1532.1(j)(4)(A) expressly prohibits prophylactic chelation of any employee at any time. Employers must ensure that no person they retain, employ, supervise, or control engages in preventive chelation.
explanation_cn: 8 CCR §1532.1(j)(4)(A) 明确禁止在任何时间对任何员工进行预防性螯合。雇主必须确保他们所聘用、雇佣、监督或控制的任何人不进行预防性螯合。

question_en: A contractor performing lead-related construction work in a public school must ensure employees exposed above 50 µg/m³ as an 8-hour TWA are trained by what type of provider?
question_cn: 在公立学校进行与铅相关施工工作的承包商必须确保暴露在 50 µg/m³ 8 小时 TWA 以上的员工由哪种类型的培训提供者进行培训？

options.en: A CDPH-accredited training provider for lead construction work
options.cn: 由 CDPH 认可的铅施工工作培训提供者

options.en: The contractor's designated in-house lead safety officer
options.cn: 承包商指定的内部铅安全官

options.en: Any licensed industrial hygienist with lead experience
options.cn: 具有铅经验的任何持牌工业卫生师

options.en: Any OSHA-authorized outreach instructor for general industry
options.cn: 任何 OSHA 授权的一般行业外展讲师

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1532.1(l)(3) requires that employees and supervisors engaged in lead-related construction work on residential or public buildings who are exposed above 50 µg/m³ TWA must be trained by a CDPH-accredited provider and certified by CDPH.
explanation_cn: 8 CCR §1532.1(l)(3) 要求从事住宅或公共建筑铅相关施工工作的员工和主管，如果其暴露量超过 50 µg/m³ TWA，必须由 CDPH 认可的培训提供者进行培训，并获得 CDPH 的认证。

question_en: What warning information is required on signs posted in a regulated lead work area?
question_cn: 在受管制的铅作业区域张贴的标志上需要什么警告信息？

options.en: "CAUTION — Lead Exposure Area — Wear PPE"
options.cn: “小心 — 铅暴露区 — 穿戴个人防护装备”

options.en: "WARNING — Lead Detected — No Eating or Drinking"
options.cn: “警告 — 检测到铅 — 禁止饮食”

options.en: "HAZARD — Airborne Lead Present — Respirator Required"
options.cn: “危险 — 有空气中铅存在 — 需要佩戴呼吸器”

options.en: "DANGER — Lead Work Area" with reproductive and CNS hazard language
options.cn: “危险 — 铅作业区”，附有生殖和中枢神经系统危害说明

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1532.1(m)(1)(A) requires signs reading "DANGER — LEAD WORK AREA — MAY DAMAGE FERTILITY OR THE UNBORN CHILD — CAUSES DAMAGE TO THE CENTRAL NERVOUS SYSTEM — DO NOT EAT, DRINK OR SMOKE IN THIS AREA."
explanation_cn: 《加州行政法规》第8卷 §1532.1(m)(1)(A) 要求标志上写：“危险 — 铅作业区 — 可能损害生育能力或未出生的孩子 — 造成中枢神经系统损害 — 此区域禁止饮食、饮水或吸烟。”

question_en: How long must an employer retain records of written elevated blood lead level response plans under the California lead standard?
question_cn: 根据加利福尼亚州铅标准，雇主必须保留书面血铅水平升高应对计划的记录多长时间？

options.en: For at least thirty years
options.cn: 至少三十年

options.en: For at least three years
options.cn: 至少三年

options.en: For at least five years after the plan is superseded
options.cn: 计划被替代后至少五年

options.en: For the duration of the employee's employment
options.cn: 员工就业期间

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1532.1(n)(4) specifies that written elevated blood lead level response plans required under subsection (j)(2)(E) shall be retained for three years.
explanation_cn: 8 CCR §1532.1(n)(4)规定，根据第(j)(2)(E)款要求的书面血铅水平升高应对计划应保留三年。

question_en: When a contractor goes out of business and there is no successor employer, where must lead-related employee records be transmitted?
question_cn: 当承包商停业且没有继任雇主时，涉及铅的员工记录必须传送到哪里？

options.en: To the California Department of Industrial Relations
options.cn: 加利福尼亚州工业关系部

options.en: To the local Cal/OSHA district office for archiving
options.cn: 当地 Cal/OSHA 区域办公室以便存档

options.en: To the affected employees' last known addresses
options.cn: 受影响员工的最后已知地址

options.en: To NIOSH for mandatory long-term record retention
options.cn: NIOSH 以进行强制性长期记录保存

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1532.1(n)(9)(B) states that whenever an employer ceases to do business and there is no successor employer to retain the records, the records shall be transmitted to NIOSH.
explanation_cn: 8 CCR §1532.1(n)(9)(B) 规定，无论何时雇主停止营业且没有继任雇主来保留记录，这些记录应传送给 NIOSH。

question_en: An employee observer is present during air monitoring for lead exposure at a construction site. Under what condition may the employer require the observer to wear PPE?
question_cn: 在建筑工地进行铅暴露空气监测时，有一名员工观察员在场。雇主在什么情况下可以要求观察员佩戴个人防护装备 (PPE)？

options.en: When entry into the area requires respirators or protective gear
options.cn: 当进入该区域需要佩戴呼吸器或防护装备时

options.en: Whenever monitoring is conducted in an outdoor location
options.cn: 只要在户外地点进行监测时

options.en: Only when blood lead levels among workers exceed 30 µg/dl
options.cn: 仅当工人的血铅水平超过 30 µg/dl 时

options.en: Only when the employee observer is a union representative
options.cn: 仅当员工观察员是工会代表时

explanation_en: 8 CCR §1532.1(o)(2)(A) requires the employer to provide and ensure use of respirators, protective clothing, or equipment whenever observation of lead monitoring requires entry into an area where such PPE is required.
explanation_cn: 《加利福尼亚法规》8 CCR §1532.1(o)(2)(A) 要求雇主在观察铅监测需要进入必须佩戴此类 PPE 的区域时，提供并确保使用呼吸器、防护服或设备。

question_en: A contractor plans to disturb painted steel on a bridge for 45 minutes using a torch. Under what condition is Cal/OSHA lead-work pre-job notification NOT required?
question_cn: 一名承包商计划使用火焰喷灯在桥上扰动涂漆钢材45分钟。在哪种情况下不需要向Cal/OSHA提交铅作业的事前通知？

options.en: The work area is less than 200 square feet total
options.cn: 工作区域总面积少于200平方英尺

options.en: Torch work does not exceed one hour per shift
options.cn: 火焰作业每班不超过一小时

options.en: The work will be completed within a single calendar day
options.cn: 工作将在同一日历日内完成

options.en: No more than three workers will perform the work
options.cn: 从事工作的工人不超过三人

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §1532.1(p), Exception 1(B), notification is not required when the only task performed is torch cutting or welding not exceeding one hour in any shift. At 45 minutes, this contractor qualifies.
explanation_cn: 根据8 CCR §1532.1(p)条款，第1(B)例外，当唯一执行的任务为每班不超过一小时的火焰切割或焊接时，不需要通知。由于此次作业为45分钟，该承包商符合条件。
code_reference: 8 CCR §1532.1(p), Exception 1(B)

question_en: A contractor discovers lead-containing materials on a job site and must begin urgent lead abatement work within the next few hours. What is the MINIMUM notification obligation to Cal/OSHA before work begins?
question_cn: 一名承包商在工地上发现含铅材料，必须在接下来的几个小时内开始紧急铅清除工作。在开始工作前，向加州职业安全与健康局（Cal/OSHA）报告的最低义务是什么？

options.en: File written notification within 48 hours of completing the work
options.cn: 在完成工作后的48小时内提交书面通知

options.en: Submit a written notification at least 24 hours before starting
options.cn: 在开始工作前至少24小时提交书面通知

options.en: No notification is required for unforeseen emergency lead work
options.cn: 对于不可预见的紧急铅工作不需要通知

options.en: Call Cal/OSHA before work starts, then send written notice within 24 hours
options.cn: 在工作开始前致电Cal/OSHA，然后在24小时内发送书面通知

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §1532.1(p)(1) Exception, for unforeseen urgent lead-work, the employer must give telephone notice to Cal/OSHA prior to commencement and follow up with written notification within 24 hours of the call.
explanation_cn: 根据8 CCR §1532.1(p)(1)例外，对于不可预见的紧急铅工作，雇主必须在开始工作前通过电话通知Cal/OSHA，并在电话通知后的24小时内提交书面通知。
code_reference: 8 CCR §1532.1(p)(1), Exception (Unforeseen Lead-Work)

question_en: Which of the following items is NOT required to be included in a written lead-work pre-job notification submitted to Cal/OSHA?
question_cn: 以下哪项不需要包含在提交给加州职业安全与健康局（Cal/OSHA）的书面含铅工作前通知中？

options.en: The projected starting date and expected completion date
options.cn: 预计开始日期和预期完成日期

options.en: The name of the supervisor responsible for lead-related work
options.cn: 负责铅相关工作的主管姓名

options.en: The amount of lead-containing material disturbed in square feet
options.cn: 被扰动的含铅材料面积（平方英尺）

options.en: The total contract price for the lead-related work scope
options.cn: 铅相关工作范围的总合同价格

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §1532.1(p)(2), no provision requires the contract price to be disclosed in the notification. Required elements cover logistics, personnel, and work practices — not financial terms.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §1532.1(p)(2)，没有规定要求在通知中披露合同价格。所需元素涵盖物流、人员和工作操作——不包括财务条款。

question_en: A contractor performing ongoing lead-related operations and maintenance on a single stationary steel bridge notifies Cal/OSHA at project start. The work extends to 14 months. What additional notification is required?
question_cn: 承包商在对一座单一固定钢桥进行持续的含铅操作和维护时，应在项目开始时通知加州职业安全与健康管理局（Cal/OSHA）。该工作持续 14 个月。还需要什么额外的通知？

options.en: A new full notification is required every six months
options.cn: 每六个月需要一次新的完整通知

options.en: Notify Cal/OSHA only when the work scope changes significantly
options.cn: 仅在工作范围发生重大变化时通知 Cal/OSHA

options.en: No further notification is needed for a single structure
options.cn: 对于单一结构无需进一步通知

options.en: A supplemental written update must be submitted at least annually
options.cn: 至少每年必须提交一次补充书面更新

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §1532.1(p)(4), when ongoing O&M lead work on a stationary steel structure exceeds one year, the employer must submit a supplemental written notification updating all required information at least once per year.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §1532.1(p)(4)，当对固定钢结构进行持续的维护（O&M）含铅工作超过一年时，雇主必须至少每年提交一次补充书面通知，更新所有要求的信息。

question_en: A material tested at the job site shows lead content of 0.4% by weight. Is Cal/OSHA lead-work pre-job notification required before disturbing this material?
question_cn: 在施工现场测试的一种材料显示铅含量为重量的0.4%。在处理该材料之前，是否需要根据加州职业安全与卫生管理局（Cal/OSHA）进行铅作业前通知？

options.en: Yes, any detectable lead content triggers notification
options.cn: 是的，任何可检测的铅含量都会触发通知

options.en: No, because the work area is under 500 square feet
options.cn: 不需要，因为工作区域小于500平方英尺

options.en: No, the material is below the 0.5% lead content threshold
options.cn: 不需要，该材料的铅含量低于0.5%阈值

options.en: Yes, only an air monitoring result can waive notification
options.cn: 是的，只有空气监测结果才能免除通知

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §1532.1(p), Exception 2, notification is not required if the percentage of lead in the disturbed material is less than 0.5% (or less than 5,000 ppm or 1.0 mg/cm²). At 0.4%, this material falls below the threshold.
explanation_cn: 根据加州法规 8 CCR §1532.1(p)，例外2，如果被处理材料中的铅比例低于0.5%（或低于5000 ppm或1.0 mg/cm²），则无需通知。该材料的含量为0.4%，低于阈值。
code_reference: 8 CCR §1532.1(p), Exception 2

question_en: During a lead abatement project, the contractor changes the work practices originally described in the Cal/OSHA notification. When must Cal/OSHA be informed of this change?
question_cn: 在一个铅污染治理项目中，承包商改变了原先在 Cal/OSHA 通知中描述的工作方法。应在何时通知 Cal/OSHA 这一变化？

options.en: Before or at the time the change is adopted
options.cn: 在采纳更改之前或同时

options.en: Within 24 hours after implementing the new work practices
options.cn: 在实施新工作方法后的 24 小时内

options.en: Only if the change affects the number of workers on site
options.cn: 仅当更改影响现场工人人数时

options.en: At the end of the project during final closeout reporting
options.cn: 在项目结束时进行最终结案报告

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §1532.1(p)(3), the employer must notify Cal/OSHA and provide current information before or upon adoption of any change to the starting date, surface area, type of work, or work practices.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §1532.1(p)(3)，雇主必须在采纳任何关于起始日期、表面面积、工作类型或工作方法的更改之前或同时通知 Cal/OSHA 并提供最新信息。

question_en: An employee requests access to their personal exposure monitoring records. Under 8 CCR §3204, what is the maximum number of days the employer has to provide that access?
question_cn: 员工请求访问其个人暴露监测记录。根据 8 CCR §3204，雇主提供访问权限的最长天数是多少？

options.en: Within 30 calendar days of the request
options.cn: 在提出请求后的 30 个日历日内

options.en: Within 45 days if records require retrieval from storage
options.cn: 如果记录需要从存储中检索，则在 45 天内

options.en: Within 5 business days of the request
options.cn: 在提出请求后的 5 个工作日内

options.en: Within 15 days after the request is made
options.cn: 在提出请求后的 15 天内

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §3204(e)(1)(A), the employer must provide access in a reasonable time, place, and manner, but in no event later than 15 days after the request for access is made.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §3204(e)(1)(A)，雇主必须在合理的时间、地点和方式提供访问，但无论如何不得晚于提出访问请求后的 15 天。

question_en: For how long must an employer preserve an employee's medical records after that employee's last day of work?
question_cn: 雇主必须在员工最后工作日之后保存员工的医疗记录多久？

options.en: For five years after employment ends
options.cn: 雇佣期结束后五年

options.en: For the duration of employment plus 30 years
options.cn: 雇佣期间加三十年

options.en: For ten years after the last exposure incident
options.cn: 最后一次接触事件后十年

options.en: Indefinitely, with no defined retention end date
options.cn: 无限期保存，没有定义的保留结束日期

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §3204(d)(1)(A), employee medical records must be preserved and maintained for at least the duration of employment plus thirty (30) years, with limited exceptions for minor first-aid records.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §3204(d)(1)(A)，员工医疗记录必须至少保存和维护至雇佣期结束后加三十（30）年，少数轻微初级医疗记录有例外。

question_en: A former employee requests a copy of their exposure monitoring records. The employer already provided those records at no charge previously. What may the employer do when providing additional copies?
question_cn: 一名前员工要求提供其暴露监测记录的副本。雇主之前已无偿提供过这些记录。雇主在提供额外副本时可以做什么？

options.en: Provide the records free of charge under all circumstances
options.cn: 在任何情况下免费提供记录

options.en: Charge reasonable, non-discriminatory search and copying costs
options.cn: 收取合理的、非歧视性的搜索和复印费用

options.en: Deny subsequent requests to limit administrative burden
options.cn: 拒绝后续请求以减少管理负担

options.en: Require the employee to pay all overhead and storage fees
options.cn: 要求员工支付所有管理和存储费用

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §3204(e)(1)(E), when records have been previously provided at no cost, the employer may charge reasonable, non-discriminatory administrative costs (search and copying expenses, excluding overhead) for additional copies.
explanation_cn: 根据《加利福尼亚行政法规典》第8章 §3204(e)(1)(E)条，当记录已无偿提供过时，雇主可以对额外副本收取合理的、非歧视性的管理费用（搜索和复印费用，不包括管理开销）。

question_en: A union (certified collective bargaining agent) requests a copy of employee exposure records on behalf of its members. What is the employer's cost obligation for this initial request?
question_cn: 工会（认证的集体谈判代理）代表其成员请求一份员工暴露记录副本。雇主对这一初始请求的费用义务是什么？

options.en: The employer may charge for copying but not for search time
options.cn: 雇主可以收取复印费，但不得收取查找时间费

options.en: The union must pay standard search and copying fees
options.cn: 工会必须支付标准的查找和复印费用

options.en: Costs apply only if records are stored off-site or archived
options.cn: 费用仅适用于记录存放在异地或归档的情况

options.en: Records must be provided at no charge for the initial request
options.cn: 初始请求的记录必须免费提供

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §3204(e)(1)(E), Exception 2, an employer shall not charge for an initial request by a recognized or certified collective bargaining agent for a copy of employee exposure records or analyses.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §3204(e)(1)(E) 第 2 条例外，雇主不得对经过认可或认证的集体谈判代理的初始请求收取员工暴露记录或分析副本的费用。
code_reference: 8 CCR §3204(e)(1)(E), Exception 2

question_en: A physician believes that giving an employee direct access to their own medical records regarding a terminal illness diagnosis could harm the employee's health. Under 8 CCR §3204, what may the employer do?
question_cn: 医生认为，给予员工直接访问其关于绝症诊断的医疗记录可能会对员工的健康造成伤害。根据 8 CCR §3204，雇主可以怎么做？

options.en: Deny direct access only; refer employee to a designated representative
options.cn: 仅拒绝直接访问；将员工转介给指定代表

options.en: Destroy the sensitive portion of the medical record
options.cn: 销毁医疗记录中的敏感部分

options.en: Provide a summary of the records in lieu of the originals
options.cn: 提供记录摘要以替代原件

options.en: Permanently withhold the records from the employee
options.cn: 永久性地不给员工提供记录

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §3204(e)(2)(B)4, the employer may deny direct employee access to specific terminal illness or psychiatric diagnosis information only, but must inform the employee that access will be provided to a designated representative with specific written consent.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §3204(e)(2)(B)4，雇主可以仅拒绝员工直接访问特定的绝症或精神疾病诊断信息，但必须告知员工，经过特定书面同意后，可以向指定代表提供访问权限。

question_en: A medical emergency arises on a job site. The treating nurse needs the specific chemical identity of a substance the employer considers a trade secret. What must the employer do?
question_cn: 在工地发生医疗紧急情况。处理的护士需要雇主认为是商业机密的物质的具体化学成分。雇主必须做什么？

options.en: Refuse disclosure until a confidentiality agreement is signed
options.cn: 在签署保密协议之前拒绝披露

options.en: Provide only the general hazard properties, not the identity
options.cn: 仅提供一般危害性质，而不提供具体身份

options.en: Immediately disclose the specific chemical identity to the treating nurse
options.cn: 立即向处理的护士披露具体化学成分

options.en: Disclose only to a licensed physician, not to a nurse
options.cn: 仅向持证医生披露，不向护士披露

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §3204(f)(3), in a medical emergency where the specific chemical identity is necessary for treatment, the employer must immediately disclose the trade secret identity to the treating physician or nurse, regardless of whether a written statement of need or confidentiality agreement exists.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §3204(f)(3)，在需要具体化学成分进行治疗的医疗紧急情况下，雇主必须立即向处理的医生或护士披露商业机密身份，无论是否存在书面的需求声明或保密协议。

question_en: An employer denies a health professional's written request for the specific chemical identity of a trade secret substance. Within how many days must the employer provide a written denial with supporting justification?
question_cn: 雇主拒绝健康专业人员关于商业秘密物质具体化学成分的书面请求。雇主必须在多少天内提供带有支持理由的书面拒绝？

options.en: Within 30 days of receiving the written request
options.cn: 自收到书面请求之日起 30 天内

options.en: Within 10 days of receiving the written request
options.cn: 自收到书面请求之日起 10 天内

options.en: Within 15 days of receiving the written request
options.cn: 自收到书面请求之日起 15 天内

options.en: Within 45 days of receiving the written request
options.cn: 自收到书面请求之日起 45 天内

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §3204(f)(8)(A), a written denial of a specific chemical identity request must be provided to the health professional, employee, or designated representative within 30 days of the request.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §3204(f)(8)(A)，针对具体化学成分请求的书面拒绝必须在收到请求后 30 天内提供给健康专业人员、员工或指定代表。

question_en: Cal/OSHA presents a written access order to inspect employee medical records at a construction company. Under 8 CCR §3204, what must the employer post and for how long?
question_cn: 当 Cal/OSHA 出具书面访问命令以检查建筑公司员工的医疗记录时，根据 8 CCR §3204，雇主必须张贴什么内容以及持续多长时间？

options.en: No posting is required for any government agency inspection
options.cn: 政府机构检查不需要任何张贴

options.en: Post the written access order for at least 15 working days
options.cn: 至少张贴书面访问命令 15 个工作日

options.en: A notice to employees for at least 30 calendar days
options.cn: 至少向员工通知 30 个日历日

options.en: A summary of the order for at least 5 working days
options.cn: 至少张贴命令摘要 5 个工作日

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §3204(e)(3)(B), whenever DOSH presents a written access order for personally identifiable medical information, the employer shall prominently post a copy of the written access order and its accompanying cover letter for at least 15 working days.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §3204(e)(3)(B)，每当 DOSH 提出涉及可识别个人医疗信息的书面访问命令时，雇主应显著张贴书面访问命令及其附随的信件副本，至少持续 15 个工作日。

question_en: Under 8 CCR §3204, how long must an employer retain employee exposure records, such as workplace air monitoring results?
question_cn: 根据 8 CCR §3204，雇主必须保留员工暴露记录（例如工作场所空气监测结果）多长时间？

options.en: Indefinitely, as no end date is defined for these records
options.cn: 无限期保留，因为这些记录没有定义结束日期

options.en: For at least five years from the date of collection
options.cn: 自收集之日起至少保留五年

options.en: For at least 30 years from the date of record creation
options.cn: 自记录创建之日起至少保留三十年

options.en: For at least ten years after the employee leaves
options.cn: 员工离职后至少保留十年

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §3204(d)(1)(B), employee exposure records shall be preserved and maintained for at least 30 years, with limited exceptions for background data and certain SDS records.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §3204(d)(1)(B)，员工暴露记录应保存和维护至少三十年，但对背景数据和某些 SDS 记录有有限例外。

question_en: When a company is ceasing to do business with no successor employer, how far in advance must employees be notified of their rights to access records?
question_cn: 当一家公司停止营业且没有继任雇主时，必须提前多久通知员工他们获取记录的权利？

options.en: At least six months prior to business closure
options.cn: 至少在公司关闭前六个月

options.en: At least three months prior to business closure
options.cn: 至少在公司关闭前三个月

options.en: At least thirty days prior to business closure
options.cn: 至少在公司关闭前三十天

options.en: At least one month prior to business closure
options.cn: 至少在公司关闭前一个月

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §3204(h)(2), when no successor employer exists, affected employees must be notified of their record access rights at least three months before the employer ceases business.
explanation_cn: 根据《加州行政法典》第8章 §3204(h)(2)条，当没有继任雇主存在时，受影响的员工必须在雇主停止营业至少三个月前被通知其记录访问权。

question_en: An employer intends to dispose of employee exposure records that are required to be preserved for at least 30 years. What is the minimum notice the employer must give to the Director of NIOSH before disposal?
question_cn: 雇主打算处置需要保存至少30年的员工接触记录。在处置之前，雇主必须至少提前多久向NIOSH主任发出通知？

options.en: At least one year written notice to NIOSH
options.cn: 至少提前一年书面通知NIOSH

options.en: At least 90 days written notice to NIOSH
options.cn: 至少提前90天书面通知NIOSH

options.en: At least six months written notice to NIOSH
options.cn: 至少提前六个月书面通知NIOSH

options.en: At least 30 days written notice to NIOSH
options.cn: 至少提前30天书面通知NIOSH

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §3204(h)(3)(B), an employer must notify the Director of NIOSH in writing at least three months (approximately 90 days) prior to the disposal of records required to be preserved for at least 30 years.
explanation_cn: 根据8 CCR §3204(h)(3)(B)，雇主必须在处置需要保存至少30年的记录之前，至少提前三个月（大约90天）以书面形式通知NIOSH主任。

question_en: A general contractor is closing its California business and a successor company will take over all operations. What is the outgoing employer's obligation regarding employee exposure and medical records?
question_cn: 一家总承包商正在关闭其加利福尼亚业务，并且一家继任公司将接管所有运营。关于员工暴露和医疗记录，离职雇主的义务是什么？

options.en: Transfer all records to the successor employer
options.cn: 将所有记录转移给继任雇主

options.en: Notify NIOSH in writing three months before closure
options.cn: 在关闭前三个月以书面形式通知NIOSH

options.en: Destroy all records before the transfer date
options.cn: 在转移日期前销毁所有记录

options.en: Archive records with the state labor department
options.cn: 将记录存档到州劳动部门

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §3204(h)(1), whenever an employer ceases to do business, all covered records must be transferred to the successor employer, who is then responsible for maintaining them.
explanation_cn: 根据8 CCR §3204(h)(1)，每当雇主停止经营时，所有受保护的记录必须转移给继任雇主，由继任雇主负责维护这些记录。

question_en: How often must an employer inform current employees about the existence, location, and availability of their exposure and medical records?
question_cn: 雇主必须多久向在职员工通报其接触记录和医疗记录的存在、地点和可用性？

options.en: Upon hiring and at least annually thereafter
options.cn: 入职时及此后至少每年一次

options.en: Whenever a new chemical is introduced to the worksite
options.cn: 每当工作场所引入新化学品时

options.en: Only once, upon first entering employment
options.cn: 仅在首次入职时一次

options.en: Upon hiring and at least every two years
options.cn: 入职时及此后至少每两年一次

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §3204(g)(1), employers must inform employees upon first entering employment and at least annually of record existence, location, availability, and employee access rights.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §3204(g)(1)，雇主必须在员工首次入职时以及此后至少每年一次通报记录的存在、地点、可用性以及员工的访问权利。

question_en: Under California Construction Safety Orders, which safety standard takes precedence when a Construction Safety Order conflicts with a General Industry Safety Order on a construction project?
question_cn: 根据加利福尼亚建筑安全条例，当建筑安全条例与建筑项目上的一般行业安全条例发生冲突时，哪项安全标准优先？

options.en: The Construction Safety Order takes precedence
options.cn: 建筑安全条例优先

options.en: The employer chooses which order to follow
options.cn: 雇主选择遵循哪项条例

options.en: DOSH issues a project-specific determination
options.cn: DOSH 发布项目特定裁定

options.en: The General Industry Safety Order always governs
options.cn: 一般行业安全条例始终适用

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §1502(b), Construction Safety Orders take precedence over any inconsistent General Industry Safety Orders at construction projects, except for Tunnel Safety Orders and Pressurized Worksite Standards.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §1502(b)，在建筑项目中，建筑安全条例优先于任何不一致的一般行业安全条例，但隧道安全条例和加压工作场所标准除外。

question_en: A contractor performing renovation work on a fixed structure discovers that a specific machine operation on the site is not addressed by the Construction Safety Orders. Which standards govern that operation?
question_cn: 承包商在固定结构上进行翻修工作时发现，工地上的特定机械操作未被《施工安全条例》涵盖。该操作受哪些标准管控？
