options.en: The contractor must submit a variance request to DOSH
options.cn: 承包商必须向DOSH提交变通申请

options.en: No safety standard applies to uncovered operations
options.cn: 对未涵盖的操作没有安全标准适用

options.en: Federal OSHA standards supersede all California orders
options.cn: 联邦OSHA标准优先于所有加利福尼亚州法规

options.en: The applicable General Safety Orders govern the operation
options.cn: 适用的一般安全条例管控该操作

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §1502(c), machines, equipment, processes, and operations not specifically covered by the Construction Safety Orders are governed by other applicable General Safety Orders.
explanation_cn: 根据8 CCR §1502(c)，未被《施工安全条例》具体涵盖的机器、设备、工艺和操作由其他适用的一般安全条例管控。

question_en: An employer holds a trade secret claim for a specific chemical identity. At what point must the trade secret claim be asserted when providing chemical information to the Chief of DOSH?
question_cn: 雇主对特定化学物质的身份拥有商业秘密权利。在向DOSH负责人提供化学信息时，必须在何时提出商业秘密声明？

options.en: Before any information is provided to any employee
options.cn: 在向任何员工提供任何信息之前

options.en: Only after receiving a formal citation from DOSH
options.cn: 仅在收到DOSH的正式通知后

options.en: Within 30 days after the information is disclosed
options.cn: 在信息披露后的30天内

options.en: No later than when the information is provided to DOSH
options.cn: 不晚于向DOSH提供信息时

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §3204(f)(12), a trade secret claim must be made no later than at the time the information is provided to the Chief of DOSH, so timely determinations of trade secret status can be made.
explanation_cn: 根据8 CCR §3204(f)(12)，商业秘密声明必须不晚于向DOSH负责人提供信息的时间，以便及时确定商业秘密状态。

question_en: A DOSH inspector determines that a confidentiality agreement does not provide sufficient protection against unauthorized disclosure of a chemical trade secret. Who has the authority to impose additional limitations on that disclosure?
question_cn: 一名DOSH检查员确定保密协议无法充分防止化学商业机密的未经授权披露。谁有权对该披露施加额外限制？

options.en: The local building department official
options.cn: 当地建筑部门官员

options.en: The employer's designated safety officer
options.cn: 雇主指定的安全官员

options.en: The Director of NIOSH
options.cn: NIOSH主任

options.en: The Chief of DOSH
options.cn: DOSH负责人

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §3204(f)(11)(B), when a confidentiality agreement is insufficient, the Chief of DOSH may issue orders or impose additional limitations or conditions upon the disclosure of the requested chemical information.
explanation_cn: 根据8 CCR §3204(f)(11)(B)，当保密协议不足时，DOSH负责人可以发布命令或对所请求的化学信息披露施加额外限制或条件。

question_en: An employer regularly disposes of records required to be preserved for at least 30 years. To minimize administrative burden, how may the employer streamline its NIOSH notification obligation?
question_cn: 雇主定期处理需要至少保留30年的记录。为了减少管理负担，雇主如何简化其向NIOSH的通知义务？

options.en: Notify NIOSH quarterly for each category of records
options.cn: 按记录类别每季度通知NIOSH

options.en: Notify NIOSH annually with at least three months' advance notice
options.cn: 每年通知NIOSH，并提前至少三个月通知

options.en: Transfer all such records directly to the state labor department
options.cn: 直接将所有此类记录转交州劳工部门

options.en: Notify NIOSH once per disposal event with no minimum notice
options.cn: 每次处理事件通知NIOSH，无需提前通知

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §3204(h)(4), an employer who regularly disposes of such records may provide at least three months' advance notice to the Director of NIOSH on an annual basis for all records intended to be disposed of in the coming year.
explanation_cn: 根据8 CCR §3204(h)(4)，定期处理此类记录的雇主可就计划在来年处理的所有记录，提前至少三个月每年向NIOSH主任提供通知。

question_en: Under 8 CCR §3204, which of the following employee record types is subject to the access and retention requirements when the employee has been exposed to a toxic substance?
question_cn: 根据 8 CCR §3204，当员工接触有毒物质时，下列哪种员工记录类型需要遵守访问和保存要求？

options.en: Personnel performance reviews and salary records
options.cn: 员工绩效评审和薪资记录

options.en: Workers' compensation claim files only
options.cn: 仅限工伤赔偿申请文件

options.en: Training attendance logs and certification records
options.cn: 培训出勤记录和认证记录

options.en: Employee exposure and medical records and analyses thereof
options.cn: 员工接触和医疗记录及其分析

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §3204(b)(2), the regulation applies to all employee exposure and medical records, and analyses thereof, of employees exposed to toxic substances or harmful physical agents.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §3204(b)(2)，该法规适用于所有接触有毒物质或有害物理因子的员工的接触和医疗记录及其分析。

question_en: What is an employer's obligation regarding copies of 8 CCR §3204 and its appendices with respect to current employees?
question_cn: 关于当前员工，雇主在提供 8 CCR §3204 及其附录的副本方面有何义务？

options.en: Provide each employee a personal copy upon hire
options.cn: 雇佣时向每位员工提供个人副本

options.en: Post the regulation on the company website only
options.cn: 仅在公司网站上张贴条例

options.en: File the regulation with DOSH district office annually
options.cn: 每年向 DOSH 区办备案该条例

options.en: Keep a copy and make it available to employees upon request
options.cn: 保存一份副本，并在员工要求时提供

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §3204(g)(2), the employer shall keep a copy of the regulation and its appendices and make copies readily available upon request to employees.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §3204(g)(2)，雇主应保留条例及其附录的副本，并在员工要求时随时提供副本。

question_en: Under California Construction Safety Orders, which of the following work activities would trigger the application of 8 CCR §1502 Construction Safety Orders?
question_cn: 根据加利福尼亚州建筑安全条例，下列哪项工作活动会触发 8 CCR §1502 建筑安全条例的适用？

options.en: Operating a warehouse distribution center
options.cn: 运营仓储配送中心

options.en: Renovation and repairing of a fixed structure
options.cn: 对固定建筑进行翻新和修理

options.en: Manufacturing components inside a permanent factory facility
options.cn: 在永久性工厂设施内制造组件

options.en: Performing landscaping on undeveloped open land
options.cn: 对未开发的空地进行园林绿化施工

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §1502(a), Construction Safety Orders apply whenever employment exists in connection with construction, alteration, painting, repairing, renovation, removal, or wrecking of any fixed structure or its parts.
explanation_cn: 根据 8 CCR §1502(a)，只要就业与固定建筑或其部件的建造、改造、涂漆、修理、翻新、拆除或拆毁有关，建筑安全条例就适用。

question_en: A trade secret employer refuses to disclose a specific chemical identity to a treating physician, citing confidentiality. Under what condition does this refusal expose the employer to a DOSH citation?
question_cn: 一名商业机密雇主以保密为由拒绝向治疗医生披露特定化学品的身份。在什么情况下，这种拒绝会让雇主面临DOSH的警告？

options.en: When DOSH has not yet reviewed the chemical's trade secret claim
options.cn: 当DOSH尚未审查该化学品的商业机密声称时

options.en: When the physician refuses to sign any confidentiality agreement
options.cn: 当医生拒绝签署任何保密协议时

options.en: When no occupational health need has been demonstrated
options.cn: 当未证明存在职业健康需要时

options.en: When the physician has signed a confidentiality agreement
options.cn: 当医生已签署保密协议时

explanation_en: This answer is backwards. If the physician has signed an adequate confidentiality agreement and the employer still refuses to disclose, the employer is subject to citation by DOSH.
explanation_cn: 这个答案是颠倒的。如果医生已签署适当的保密协议，而雇主仍拒绝披露，雇主将面临DOSH的警告。

question_en: Which entity may require that 30-year employee records be transferred to it when a construction employer ceases operations with no successor?
question_cn: 当建筑雇主停止运营且没有继任者时，哪个机构可能要求将30年的员工记录转交给它？

options.en: The U.S. Environmental Protection Agency only
options.cn: 仅美国环境保护署

options.en: The California Division of Occupational Safety and Health
options.cn: 加利福尼亚州职业安全与健康部

options.en: The local county or city public health department
options.cn: 当地县或市公共卫生部门

options.en: The National Institute for Occupational Safety and Health
options.cn: 国家职业安全与健康研究所

explanation_en: Per 8 CCR §3204(h)(3)(A), when no successor employer exists, the employer shall transfer records to the Director of NIOSH if so required by a specific occupational safety and health standard.
explanation_cn: 根据8 CCR §3204(h)(3)(A)，当没有继任雇主存在时，如果具体的职业安全与健康标准要求，雇主应将记录转交给NIOSH主任。

question_en: A contractor discovers that operator markings for underground utilities are no longer visible during excavation. What must the contractor do?
question_cn: 承包商在挖掘过程中发现地下管线的操作标记已不再可见。承包商必须怎么做？

options.en: Contact the regional center and request operator re-marking
options.cn: 联系区域中心并请求操作员重新标记

options.en: Stop all work until new markings appear
options.cn: 停止所有工作，直到新的标记出现

options.en: Use hand tools to re-locate all underground lines
options.cn: 使用手动工具重新定位所有地下管线

options.en: Proceed cautiously using the original site map
options.cn: 使用原始现场图小心进行

explanation_en: Per Government Code Section 4216, if operator markings become no longer visible during the job, the excavator must contact the regional notification center and request the operator re-mark the lines within two working days.
explanation_cn: 根据《政府法典》第4216条，如果在工作过程中操作标记不再可见，挖掘者必须联系区域通知中心，并请求操作员在两个工作日内重新标记管线。
code_reference: California Government Code Section 4216-4216.9 (Document p. 63, PDF p. 86)

question_en: How many calendar days is an Underground Service Alert ticket number valid before it must be revalidated?
question_cn: 地下服务警报（USA）工单号码在必须重新验证之前的有效天数是多少？

options.en: 10 calendar days from issuance
options.cn: 自签发之日起10个日历日

options.en: 14 calendar days from issuance
options.cn: 自签发之日起14个日历日

options.en: 21 calendar days from issuance
options.cn: 自签发之日起21个日历日

options.en: 28 calendar days from issuance
options.cn: 自签发之日起28个日历日

explanation_en: Per Government Code Section 4216, the USA ticket number issued upon notification is valid for 28 calendar days. If work continues beyond that, the excavator must revalidate before the ticket expires.
explanation_cn: 根据《政府法典》第4216条，通知发出时签发的USA工单号码有效期为28个日历日。如果工作持续超过此期限，挖掘者必须在工单到期前进行重新验证。
code_reference: California Government Code Section 4216-4216.9 (Document p. 62, PDF p. 85)

question_en: An excavator negligently violates Government Code Section 4216 but causes no pipeline damage. What is the maximum fine the excavator faces?
question_cn: 一台挖掘机因疏忽违反了《政府法典》第4216条，但未造成管道损坏。该挖掘机面临的最高罚款是多少？

options.en: Up to $100,000 per violation
options.cn: 每次违规最高100,000美元

options.en: Up to $50,000 per violation
options.cn: 每次违规最高50,000美元

options.en: Up to $10,000 per violation
options.cn: 每次违规最高10,000美元

options.en: Up to $5,000 per violation
options.cn: 每次违规最高5,000美元

explanation_en: Government Code Section 4216 sets the maximum fine for negligent violations at $10,000. The higher $50,000 and $100,000 penalties apply only to knowing and willful violations, with the largest reserved for pipeline damage causing hazardous escapes.
explanation_cn: 《政府法典》第4216条规定，疏忽违规的最高罚款为10,000美元。较高的50,000美元和100,000美元罚款仅适用于明知故犯的违规行为，其中最大罚款适用于导致管道泄漏危险的损害。
code_reference: California Government Code Section 4216-4216.9 (Document p. 63, PDF p. 86)

question_en: A contractor knowingly and willfully damages a gas pipeline during excavation, causing toxic gas to escape. What is the maximum civil penalty the contractor faces?
question_cn: 承包商在开挖过程中明知且故意损坏燃气管道，导致有毒气体泄漏。承包商面临的最高民事罚款是多少？

options.en: Up to $10,000 in civil penalties
options.cn: 最高$10,000民事罚款

options.en: Up to $75,000 in civil penalties
options.cn: 最高$75,000民事罚款

options.en: Up to $100,000 in civil penalties
options.cn: 最高$100,000民事罚款

options.en: Up to $50,000 in civil penalties
options.cn: 最高$50,000民事罚款

explanation_en: Government Code Section 4216 imposes a civil penalty not to exceed $100,000 when a knowing and willful violation damages a gas or hazardous liquid pipeline subsurface installation and results in the escape of any flammable, toxic, or corrosive gas or liquid.
explanation_cn: 《政府法典》第4216条规定，当明知且故意的违法行为损坏燃气或危险液体管道的地下设施，并导致任何易燃、有毒或腐蚀性气体或液体泄漏时，民事罚款不得超过$100,000。
code_reference: California Government Code Section 4216-4216.9 (Document p. 64, PDF p. 87)

question_en: How far in advance must an excavator contact the regional notification center before beginning excavation, excluding emergencies?
question_cn: 挖掘机在开始挖掘前（紧急情况除外）必须提前多久联系区域通知中心？

options.en: At least two working days, no more than 28 calendar days
options.cn: 至少提前两个工作日，最多不超过28个日历日

options.en: At least two working days, no more than 14 calendar days
options.cn: 至少提前两个工作日，最多不超过14个日历日

options.en: At least three working days, no more than 21 calendar days
options.cn: 至少提前三个工作日，最多不超过21个日历日

options.en: At least one working day, no more than 7 calendar days
options.cn: 至少提前一个工作日，最多不超过7个日历日

explanation_en: Government Code Section 4216 requires the excavator to contact the appropriate regional notification center not less than two working days nor more than 14 calendar days prior to beginning excavation, excluding emergency situations.
explanation_cn: 《政府法典》第4216条要求挖掘机在开始挖掘前（紧急情况除外）必须至少提前两个工作日、最多不超过14个日历日联系相应的区域通知中心。
code_reference: California Government Code Section 4216-4216.9 (Document p. 61, PDF p. 84)

question_en: A subcontractor plans to excavate on a job site in California. Which of the following is required before the subcontractor begins digging?
question_cn: 一家分包商计划在加利福尼亚的一个工地进行挖掘。在分包商开始挖掘之前，需要满足以下哪一项要求？

options.en: The prime contractor's USA ticket number covers the subcontractor
options.cn: 总承包商的美国票证号码涵盖了分包商

options.en: An excavation permit issued by the local municipality
options.cn: 当地政府颁发的挖掘许可

options.en: The subcontractor's own USA identification ticket number
options.cn: 分包商自己的美国身份证票号

options.en: Written authorization from the property owner
options.cn: 物业所有者的书面授权

explanation_en: Per Government Code Section 4216, every contractor or subcontractor performing excavation must obtain their own Underground Service Alert identification number. Sharing the prime contractor's ticket is not permitted.
explanation_cn: 根据《政府法典》第4216条的规定，每个进行挖掘的承包商或分包商必须获得自己的地下服务警报识别号码。不允许共享总承包商的票证。
code_reference: California Government Code Section 4216-4216.9 (Document p. 62, PDF p. 85)

question_en: A contractor discovers what appear to be human remains at a construction site that is not a dedicated cemetery. What is the correct first action?
question_cn: 在一个不是专用墓地的建筑工地上，承包商发现了疑似人类遗骸。正确的第一步行动是什么？

options.en: Document the find and continue work in unaffected areas
options.cn: 记录发现并在未受影响的区域继续工作

options.en: Notify the most likely descendant within 24 hours
options.cn: 在24小时内通知最可能的后代

options.en: Stop all work and contact the county coroner
options.cn: 停止所有工作并联系县验尸官

options.en: Notify the Native American Heritage Commission immediately
options.cn: 立即通知美国原住民遗产委员会

explanation_en: Health and Safety Code Section 7050.5 requires the contractor to immediately stop all work at the site and any nearby area reasonably suspected to contain remains, then contact the county coroner as the first step in the statutory process.
explanation_cn: 《健康与安全法典》第7050.5条要求承包商立即停止该工地及任何合理怀疑包含遗骸的附近区域的所有工作，然后作为法定程序的第一步联系县验尸官。
code_reference: Health and Safety Code Section 7050.5; Public Resources Code Sections 5097.9-5097.991 (Document p. 65, PDF p. 88)

question_en: After the county coroner determines that discovered remains are Native American, within how many hours must the coroner notify the Native American Heritage Commission?
question_cn: 在县验尸官确认发现的遗骸为美洲原住民后，验尸官必须在多少小时内通知美洲原住民遗产委员会？

options.en: Within 48 hours of the determination
options.cn: 自确认起48小时内

options.en: Within 24 hours of the determination
options.cn: 自确认起24小时内

options.en: Within two working days of the determination
options.cn: 自确认日起两个工作日内

options.en: Within 72 hours of the determination
options.cn: 自确认起72小时内

explanation_en: Per Public Resources Code Section 5097.9-5097.991, once the coroner determines remains are Native American, the coroner has 24 hours to notify the Native American Heritage Commission so it can identify the most likely descendant.
explanation_cn: 根据《公共资源法典》第5097.9-5097.991条，一旦验尸官确认遗骸为美洲原住民，验尸官必须在24小时内通知美洲原住民遗产委员会，以便其确定最可能的后裔。
code_reference: Health and Safety Code Section 7050.5; Public Resources Code Sections 5097.9-5097.991 (Document p. 65, PDF p. 88)

question_en: Which of the following penalties applies to a person who knowingly possesses Native American burial artifacts without legal authority?
question_cn: 以下哪项处罚适用于明知非法持有美洲原住民墓葬文物的人？

options.en: Mandatory contractor license revocation only
options.cn: 仅强制吊销承包商执照

options.en: A felony with imprisonment in state prison
options.cn: 重罪，判处州监狱监禁

options.en: A misdemeanor with a county jail sentence
options.cn: 轻罪，判处县监狱监禁

options.en: A civil fine up to $50,000
options.cn: 最高可达5万美元的民事罚款

explanation_en: Public Resources Code Sections 5097.94, 5097.98, and 5097.99 make it a felony to knowingly or willfully remove, obtain, or possess Native American remains or associated burial artifacts without authority of law, punishable by state prison imprisonment.
explanation_cn: 《公共资源法典》第5097.94、5097.98和5097.99条规定，明知或故意在无法律授权的情况下移除、获取或持有美洲原住民遗骸或相关墓葬文物属于重罪，可判处州监狱监禁。
code_reference: Public Resources Code Sections 5097.94, 5097.98, 5097.99 (Document p. 66, PDF p. 89)

question_en: Which of the following parties is NOT exempt from contacting a regional notification center before excavating on private property?
question_cn: 以下哪一方在私人财产开挖前不免于联系地区通知中心？

options.en: A homeowner improving their principal residence without a permit
options.cn: 在未获许可的情况下改善其主要住宅的房主

options.en: A homeowner who hires a licensed contractor for permitted excavation
options.cn: 雇佣有执照承包商进行许可开挖的房主

options.en: A licensed subcontractor hired to excavate at the jobsite
options.cn: 被聘请在工地进行开挖的有执照分包商

options.en: An equipment rental company providing a backhoe with an operator
options.cn: 提供带操作员的挖掘机的设备租赁公司

explanation_en: Licensed subcontractors are not exempt. Government Code Section 4216 requires every contractor or subcontractor performing excavation to obtain their own USA ticket number. There is no exemption for subcontractors performing excavation work.
explanation_cn: 有执照的分包商不享受豁免。政府法典第4216条要求每位进行开挖的承包商或分包商必须获得自己的USA票号。进行开挖工作的分包商没有豁免。
code_reference: California Government Code Section 4216-4216.9 (Document p. 62, PDF p. 85)

question_en: An asbestos consultant has been found to have obtained certification under false pretenses. What action must the Division of Occupational Safety and Health take?
question_cn: 发现一名石棉顾问通过虚假手段获得认证。当职业安全与健康部发现此情况时，必须采取什么行动？

options.en: Revoke the certification after due process procedures
options.cn: 在遵循正当程序后撤销认证

options.en: Suspend the certification for up to one year
options.cn: 暂停认证，最长不超过一年

options.en: Issue a formal warning and require reexamination
options.cn: 发出正式警告并要求重新考试

options.en: Refer the matter to the CSLB for license discipline
options.cn: 将此事提交给加州承包商州立委员会（CSLB）进行执照处分

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7183.5 requires the division to revoke the certification when fraud or false pretenses are found, but only after complying with the procedural requirements of Government Code Chapter 5, Section 11500.
explanation_cn: 《《加州商业与职业法典》规》第7183.5条规定，当发现欺诈或虚假手段时，部门必须撤销认证，但必须先遵守《政府法规》第5章第11500条的程序要求。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7183.5 (Document p. 411, PDF p. 434)

question_en: A licensed contractor with no asbestos certification needs to take bulk samples of suspected asbestos-containing material for bid preparation. What is the maximum number of samples allowed without certification?
question_cn: 一个没有石棉认证的持牌承包商需要取疑似含石棉材料的整体样本以准备投标。没有认证的情况下允许取的最大样本数量是多少？

options.en: No more than 25 bulk samples
options.cn: 不超过25个整体样本

options.en: No more than 5 bulk samples
options.cn: 不超过5个整体样本

options.en: No more than 20 bulk samples
options.cn: 不超过20个整体样本

options.en: No more than 12 bulk samples
options.cn: 不超过12个整体样本

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7180(b) allows a licensed contractor or registered asbestos abatement contractor to take no more than 12 bulk samples of suspected asbestos-containing material without certification, for purposes including bid preparation.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7180(b)条允许持牌承包商或注册石棉清除承包商在没有认证的情况下，为包括投标准备在内的目的，取不超过12个疑似含石棉材料的整体样本。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7180(b) (Document p. 409, PDF p. 432)

question_en: A building owner hires an asbestos consultant to inspect a building and also hires an asbestos abatement contractor for the same project. What financial restriction applies to the consultant?
question_cn: 建筑业主雇用一名石棉顾问检查一栋建筑，同时也为同一项目雇用石棉清除承包商。顾问适用什么财务限制？

options.en: The consultant must disclose any prior work with the abatement contractor
options.cn: 顾问必须披露与清除承包商的任何先前合作

options.en: The consultant's fees cannot exceed 10% of abatement costs
options.cn: 顾问的费用不得超过清除成本的10%

options.en: The consultant shall have no financial interest in the abatement contractor
options.cn: 顾问不得对清除承包商有任何财务利益

options.en: The consultant must be paid before the abatement contractor
options.cn: 顾问必须在清除承包商之前获得支付

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7187 prohibits an asbestos consultant or site surveillance technician from having any financial or proprietary interest in an asbestos abatement contractor hired for the same project.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7187条禁止石棉顾问或现场监督技术人员对同一项目雇用的石棉清除承包商有任何财务或所有权利益。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7187 (Document p. 413, PDF p. 436)

question_en: Under California law, asbestos abatement regulations apply only when the disturbed surface area of asbestos-containing material is at least how large?
question_cn: 根据加利福尼亚州法律，石棉清除规定仅适用于扰动的含石棉材料表面积至少多大时？

options.en: 200 square feet or more
options.cn: 200 平方英尺或以上

options.en: 50 square feet or more
options.cn: 50 平方英尺或以上

options.en: 100 square feet or more
options.cn: 100 平方英尺或以上

options.en: 500 square feet or more
options.cn: 500 平方英尺或以上

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7189.5 specifies that the article applies to asbestos abatement projects involving 100 square feet or more of surface area of asbestos-containing material.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第 7189.5 条规定，该条款适用于含石棉材料表面积为 100 平方英尺或以上的石棉清除项目。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7189.5 (Document p. 415, PDF p. 438)

question_en: A licensed contractor performing asbestos-related work is asked to provide a professional asbestos risk assessment for a client. Which statement is correct?
question_cn: 执行石棉相关工作的持证承包商被要求为客户提供专业的石棉风险评估。哪一项说法是正确的？

options.en: Allowed if the contractor is also asbestos-certified
options.cn: 如果承包商也具有石棉认证，则允许

options.en: Prohibited; only independent consultants may do so
options.cn: 禁止；只有独立顾问可以这样做

options.en: Allowed if included in the abatement contract scope
options.cn: 如果包含在治理合同范围内，则允许

options.en: Allowed if an industrial hygienist co-signs the report
options.cn: 如果工业卫生师共同签署报告，则允许

explanation_en: B&P Code Section 7188 explicitly states that no licensed contractor or asbestos abatement contractor may provide professional health and safety services or perform any asbestos risk assessment, to ensure independent professional judgment.
explanation_cn: 《加州商业与职业法典》第7188条明确规定，为确保独立专业判断，任何持证承包商或石棉治理承包商不得提供专业健康与安全服务或进行任何石棉风险评估。
code_reference: B&P Code Section 7188 (Document p. 414, PDF p. 437)
